name: Causality Ability Generation
description: The user is able to get an ability based on their actions. This means they could do something and it can lead to an ability. There is a tradeoff. The action must have a meaning to it. An example wold be punching a man in a fight. Since that punch is an action, the ability would be something like enhanced strength. All ability last as long as the effect of the action.
summary: The ability to gain temporary abilities based on one's actions.
strengths: Gain abilities
Abilities are boosted by effect of action and decision that caused the action.
weaknesses: Abilities last as long as the effects of actions.

name: Ability Reader
description: Well to tell it simply you'll be able to see anyone's type of power and skill which gives you an edge but beyond that it's just more insight so you know what your up  against and the display is like pop up icons.
summary: The ability to See your  opponents/ally's powers and  skills.
strengths: Know what power/skill they have.
Works with a picture of person.
Helpful in need to know bases.
weaknesses: Works only with sight.
Multiple  opponents might cause icon confusion.
Can't tell how powerful that power/skill is.

name: Angels Power
description: Having massive wings and  creating any kind of angelic weapon that you can think of.  Having the strength of an archangel or in really tough times become the size of which a normal angel in real life in the bible are 35 feet so about 65 feet. You are the fast thing that flies by flying around the world in  30 seconds and can shift to the spiritual realm. Not allowed to satan your purpose is to obey God. This is the Angels power. You can only get it if you are born with it and you get it by God.
summary: The ability to be half human half Archangel
strengths: Demons fear you.
You can shift to spiritual realm.
You can pull spirits right out of hell or out of body if granted by God.
weaknesses: Darkness is weakness.
Magic is a weakness.
You can be summoned by God at any time and are ordered to do his works.

name: Probability Field Adaption
description: The user allows one to adapt. By tapping into the probability field, the user's body is able to adapt in order to defend themselves from unknown events. Since probability is unpredictable, the user is constantly adapting, increasing/ decreasing in strength. This ability works well against lucky individuals/probability manipulators. The user can adapt to  an individual's luck. Probability manipulators are changing probability, so the user will instantly adapt to those changes.
summary: The ability to adapt based on the likelihood of might happen to you
strengths: Able to adapt based on things that might happen to you.
Adapt to a person's luck/ probability manipulator.
Could reach a new level of power when every single probable thing has been calculated.
weaknesses: Adaption is usually unpredictable.

name: Healing Stone
description: When you become fataly injured you can go into a deep slumber. In that state your body will become stone-like. As you rest you will heal at a accelerated rate and within a 9 hour period you will be totally healed.
summary: The ability to Heal yourself by going into a stony  slumber.
strengths: Can recover from injury faster than normal
Can heal any physical injury no problem.
weaknesses: Will be vunarable in your stone state.
Must complete your full hibernation to be fully healed.

name: Hero Choosing
description: User is capable of choosing main character of the story, granting him/her luck and (possibly) happyend. Usually, this ability also allows user to watch choosen one anytime, like person watching movie.
summary: The ability to choose the choosen one.
strengths: Grants target luck.
You can use this ability on yourself too.
weaknesses: Good character can become bad character. Then it's trouble.

name: Instinctive Reality Warping
description: This is pretty basic. The user can warp reality through reflex. When something is coming at the user, the user's reflexes will then warp up a wall or a shield or something to protect them. The user can also use this in combat, warping their body to become strong and fast. This ability only affects the user and the immediate area around them.
summary: The ability to warp reality based on one's instincts and reflexes.
strengths: Warp reality to protect yourself
Use it in fights
weaknesses: Short range
Only works on user, no one else

name: Instant Learning
description: This power allows you to instantly and perfectly learn, and permanently retain, any knowledge and skills about any and all subject simply by thinking about them, all of which without any problem, difficulty or deformity.
summary: The ability to instantly and perfectly learn any subject.
strengths: Never need to go to school again, always able to learn any and every skill imaginable.
No need for a dictionary as you will be a human dictionary.
Create new inventions, and learn any and all languages extremely easily.
weaknesses: Does not make you well practiced, have to practice with the knowledge and skills you gain.
Might become annoyed if people start to look to you for all of the answers.

name: Axiokinesis
description: With this power, you can manipulate how valuable something is to someone. This can apply to either everyone, or just a specific person/people. For instance, you could get things for super cheap from people by depreciating the value of those things in their eyes, or get people to want something by increasing its value. This works on people too; you can make yourself inexplicably valuable to your enemies, stopping them from harming you, or make someone value themselves less, leading to depression.
summary: The ability to manipulate the value of things
strengths: Basically get almost anything you want for little to no cost
Protect yourself from people
Make people not care about themselves
weaknesses: Won't affect people without any concept of value
Can make life a little too easy

name: Advanced Regeneration
description: Able to regenerate bodily damage, making the damaged area stronger each time it is healed. Broken bones become stronger each time they are healed, muscles and tendons become more resilient, etc. Fatigue is virtually eliminated, as lactic acid build up in the muscles is eliminated. Aging is slowed to the point where an individual doesn't appear to age at all, due to the body constantly regenerating the gradual decay of the aging process.
summary: The ability to regenerate bodily damage
strengths: Longer life span.
Come back stronger after each injury.
weaknesses: Outlive everyone close to them.

name: Aether Manipulation
description: Aether manipulation is the ability to manipulate the aether. Some applications are Transcendent Physiology: As a wielder of the fifth element, users will ascend into a powerful Demigod. Ethereal Form: User will become composed of the element and gain power that rivals other ethereal beings. Absolute Existence: User will possess control over their own existence to a very high extent. Shapeshifting: User will possess complete psionic control over his/her body.
summary: The ability to manipulate the Aether.
strengths: You are nearly invincible
you have lots of applications
weaknesses: You can be hurt
You can not give powers to people
You can be killed by someone who manipulates the nether and or manipulates the aether

name: Tele Automation
description: This ability acts like a factory. The user wants something down and this ability automatically does the rest. Example, the user wants the house to be clean everyday before he gets home. The user's ability will kick in and everything in the user's house will begin the the process of clean with a telekinetic force controlling it. This can make anyone a one many production crew. All you need are the materials to help perform the tasks.
summary: The ability to control any form of orderly process or system automatically via telekinesis.
strengths: Won't need to do tedious tasks
Be your own factory. (High productivity)
Automatic ( No humans, No Machines)
weaknesses: Have to have materials for certain task.
Not full telekinesis, it does things in an orderly manner and not by the users will.
Not good in instant combat. (Better in strategic warfare. )

name: Anti Gravity Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can utilize the force that is anti-gravity. Since this is the opposite of gravity, instead of pulling things towards you, you push them away. Wave your hands, and a wall is torn apart. About to be attacked? Throw them outward! You can even force things to come to you by putting anti-gravity pushing behind them. You even can make yourself fly by making your body exert anti-gravity, but breathing could be an issue when you do that. The options are almost limitless!
summary: The ability to create and control anti-gravity
strengths: Push objects that pose a threat away from you, and even push good things towards you!
Rip even the strongest of materials apart.
Combine Earth's gravity with the right amount of anti-gravity, and you get zero-gravity
weaknesses: May push air away from you or someone else, and they may asphyxiate.
Might accidentally rip apart someone or something you hold valuable.
Make people's ears pop.

name: Self Manipulation
description: With this power, you can transform your body and manipulate its features. You can turn your body heat to a thousand degrees farenheit or more to be defended or turn yourself into fire and launch it. You can either use your bioelectricity as a weapon or turn into lightning and shoot it. You can also change your regular body and increase its strength and youth.
summary: The ability to greatly change and control your body.
strengths: You are extremely powerful.
weaknesses: You must be creative.

name: Clearance Schmearance
description: With this power you can have access to any top secret file, facility or person. No need for a badge, password, ID or retina scanner just activate this power and go find what you're looking for. This power works with but is not limited too Governments, agencies, secret societies, secret clubs and satanic cults.
summary: The ability to have access to anything
strengths: You can have access to anything
weaknesses: You still have to find where the information you're looking for is being held
^But you have access to that information too so...
Not much use in physical combat

name: Power Automation
description: With this ability, one can program their abilities to act in a certain way in a given situation. Active powers can act without any intervention on your part. However, to use this power, one must have acquired Power Programming, though mimicry is permitted.
summary: The ability to greatly extend the capabilities of Power Programming to allow automation of your powers.
strengths: Live a life with normal perception but still enjoy the benefits of enhanced perception of the world.
Activate or deactivate superpowers according to a given situation using Josh's Power Switchboard.
Use active powers while unconscious.
weaknesses: You need to have Power Programming, but it may be mimicked.
Does not enhance the capabilities of your powers.
Useless without other powers; even if you also have Power Programming, you need powers to program.

name: Molecular Machinery
description: A person with this power has the ability to create nanomachines out of particles in the air. Also known as Synthesis. This power allows the user to create many things that are only possible in a lab and some impossible. For example they could create machines that would improve the efficiency of their own body or create tiny energy generators that are highly efficient. The only limit to this power is the inability to manipulate after a certain size and the available resources in the air
summary: The ability to create tiny functional nanomachines out of loose particles floating in the air
strengths: Can create any nanomachine as long as you have the necessary comp
Can become creative with this power
Also comes with the ability to sense microscopic things within surrounding air
weaknesses: Machines only have a single purpose after being created and the creation must happen in your hands
Need to have some understanding of chemistry to avoid dangerous reactions
Can't create gigantic objects only nanomachines

name: Elemental Life Force
description: This ability gives one a life force of an element. This is different from aura. Auras surrounds a person, while a life force is the spiritual energy of a person that keeps a human alive. The user will run on an element like fire, water,Copper, Helium,etc. If they are near an element of that matches to their life-force, then they get stronger. Of course, if you see fighting animation, the user can releases life-force to perform elemental attacks.
summary: The ability to be powered by a life-force of a specific element (natural or periodic).
strengths: Power up by element(natural or periodic)
Create Elemental life-force attacks
weaknesses: If you use it up, you die

name: Self Existence Manipulation
description: Did you ever looked in the mirror & said "I wish was something else"? Then fret no more! With this ability you can recreate everything in your life from your body and your soul, to the very fabrics of your essence the made you real. Imagine the possibilities of being your own creator; now you can decide if you can die or not. Decide how you are seen, heard, or felt by others? Or not at all. Or remake from how your life began. This ability also enables the creation of new super abilities.
summary: The ability to manipulate or recreate how you exist in this universe
strengths: The possibility of becoming one's own designer is limitless.
Death will be ultimately impossible for someone who can decide if he can die or not.
Can create new abilities for yourself
weaknesses: Transformations are permanent
Requires so much imagination it is utterly useless to someone who thinks with his fist

name: Electric Powered Strength
description: A person with this power can achieve many physical based powers including superstrength and speed by absorbing electricity. This also renders the user immune to any electrical attacks since all electric attacks only serve to strengthen/heal the user. The user can also absorb electricity actively through touching objects with electricity-later on they can do this from farther distances.
summary: The ability to absorb electricity to heal and/or boost natural physical capabilities to superhuman levels
strengths: Can eat electricity or absorb it through your skin with no problems-this includes draining batteries
Once you get a good charge going you can go on even footing with superstrength users
Can drain the power of machinery or batteries and even powe through touch to accelerate your healing
weaknesses: No ranged attacks-can't shoot lightning etc, but can still throw objects
Need a source of electricity to get power from but you naturally have some degree of extra strength
Absorbing electricity is subconsious so you need to active control it to not drain your electronics

name: Indestructability!
description: With this ability, you are immune to most kinetic damage. Your bones and blood become infused with a new element which is aware of you. Your teeth and skeleton become about 220 times stronger than steel. Your body mass stays the same. Your blood and organs become a "smart fluid" and will become 8 times tougher than steel when you scream "Indestructability! ", or when extreme danger is detected. You shut off the power mentally or by saying indestructability off.
summary: The ability to be immune to kinetic attacks when you activate this power.
strengths: Bones become 220 times tougher than steel while maintaining a degree of flexibility.
You can make the rest of yourself indestructable by yelling "Indestructability! "
Can be turned off. Permanent indestructable bone and teeth!
weaknesses: If someone else discovers the secret element/drinks your blood, they can turn durable/indestructable
Only stops kinetic force. Power is infused with bone(it has to in order to work).
Your bone and blood cells still depend on calcium for other things. Permanent indestructable bones!

name: Great Good Videogames Orders
description: create any terrific game that the owner of this superpower wants, regardless of whether video games were lousy before using this superpower and regardless of whether video games were once so good that can not be further improved. You can create any game, whether for video game consoles or Internet.
summary: The ability to have any terrific game that you want created
strengths: You can not make bad games
No need for lousy games since no effort is needed to create really good ones
No real limit on this super power's games
weaknesses: You could get in trouble for copyright infringement
You can also create a very short game
If your games are terrible they will switch to something better

name: Desiderium
description: Desiderium is latin for "desire" . The user knows exactly what people desire, and can make those desires come true if they choose to do so. By focusing on a specific person, the user can know their every desire, from the smallest ones, to the greatest one of all. If the user wants to, they can make desires come true, except the desires to cause harm or death to others, or to take a persons free-will away. The user can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes.
summary: The ability to know exactly what people desire, and make them come true
strengths: Know exactly what other people desire
Make desires come true
User can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes
weaknesses: Can't make desires come true if they cause harm or death to others, or take a persons free-will away

name: Perfect Self Control
description: With this power, you have complete and utter perfect, easy, and continuous control over yourself, thus preventing you from ever being controlled, manipulated, and corrupted by outside forces. As a side effect of having this power, you also have perfect, easy, and continuous control and use of any and all of your special, superhuman, and supernatural powers, abilities, skills, and talents too.
summary: The ability to have perfect control over one's self.
strengths: Never be controlled, manipulated, or corrupted by anything ever again.
Never lose control of any of your powers.
Have extraordinary willpower that is beyond anyone or anything.
weaknesses: Nothing bad whatsoever.

name: Body Reformation
description: When any of your body parts explode or get cut off,  they'll desintegrate into clouds.   Those clouds will then gather automatically to reform your body to it's original form.   Even if your whole body gets divided into countless pieces, you'll still reform.
summary: The ability to completely reform your body
strengths: Killing you permanently will become difficult
You won't ever permanently loose any of your limbs, or head
weaknesses: The pain before you would need this power
This power has no offensive purpose

name: Master Of Combat
description: The user is able to learn any form of martial arts that currently exist just by reading the martial arts or hand to hand combat moves from the respective manuals . However, the user is only able fully master a total of eight forms of martial arts
summary: The ability to instantly learn any form of martial arts just by looking at its basic movements
strengths: Can combat any opponent hand to hand.
Dont need to spend hours on training.
Easily defeat weak opponents that are horrible at hand to hand combat
weaknesses: The total of martial arts that can be mastered
Not strong enough to combat the major powerhouses

name: Density Control
description: You can manipulate your density to any range. From incredibly dense, indestructible body to ghostly intangibility. You can get hit by a car and not get hurt or let the car pass through you.
summary: The ability to become intangible or indestructible
strengths: Great for pranking people
Can't be hurt by bullets
Can sink and rise from the ground
weaknesses: You might fall if you become dense on a high building
Tag will never be the same

name: Will Power
description: Imagine you or someone you know is in a life or death situation and it is impossible to escape by normal means, well as long as you have the will and desire to save you or the other person, you can. Similar to the green lantern ring, the stronger your will and determination, the faster, stronger, and more durable you are. Can also be triggered by sudden anger.
summary: The ability to will yourself to accomplish feats of superhuman strength, speed, and durability
strengths: Do the impossible with enough determination
The greater the motivation, the greater the power
weaknesses: No willpower, no abilities
Some injuries will be sustained no matter how durable you become

name: Mimic
description: You can copy an opponent's power by many means. All bad features of powers are taken away. These powers are with you forever and cannot be mimicked by another person with this power.
summary: The ability to mimic almost anything.
strengths: Many abilities.
Almost unbeatable.
All bad self-harm powers have bad features taken away.
weaknesses: You are a copycat.

name: Location Mimicry
description: If you are underwater you may gain Breathe Underwater,  Hydrokinesis power, etc. This power basically aids you in the environment you are in. It doesn't help you fight, but makes you more comfortable, in a way.
summary: The ability to gain powers to aid you in the environment you are in.
strengths: You gain powers to aid you.
weaknesses: Doesn't aid you in battle.
No defense or offense protections/advantages/etc.

name: Self Matter Manipulation
description: Let me give you some examples, in case you don't understand. You could go up to a tank and absorb it into your body. You would look and feel the same... But you could instantly generate the turret on your back and blast away.   Also you could absorb a piece of candy and then endlessly keep creating that piece of candy in your hand/mouth/anywhere on your person.   Absorb a diamond and have diamond like skin. Absorb bullets when they are being shot into you.   An ultimate physical ability.
summary: The ability to absorb things into your body then from your body dispense infinitely what you have absorbed.
strengths: Never go hungry, because you can dispense what you absorbed.
Become ultimately powerful and dangerous.
Endless possibilities.
weaknesses: Can't stop mind control

name: Peak Human
description: With this power, your body would naturally be a perfect specimen of human development and conditioning, which you would never need to maintain whatsoever. Your strength, endurance, agility, speed, reflexes, durability, healing, and intelligence would all be at the highest limits of natural human potential. And you would have complete and utter immunity to any and all illnesses, diseases, disorders, disabilities, poisons, radiation, and the effects of intoxication by alcohol.
summary: The ability to be at the highest limits of natural human potential.
strengths: Physical and mental attributes all be greater than any ordinary human being.
Immune to any illness, and disease.
Never need to exercise to stay in shape.
weaknesses: Can never become drunk.
Not superhuman, but at a level just below it.

name: Crystallokinesis
description: Also called Ligurokinesis or Crystal Manipulation, one with this ability can psychically control gems, precious stones, minerals, and crystals. This means one can grow crystals and mineral deposits, summon them from one's surroundings (including salt and sugar), and form them into constructs like weapons, armor, shields, barriers etc. The user can alter their size, color, etc as well. At the higher levels, one can even change one type of mineral into another, or extract them from living bodies.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate gems, precious stones, minerals and crystals
strengths: Gems, precious stones, minerals and crystals can now be used as weapons
At the higher levels, even change one type of crystal, gem, mineral or precious stone into another
Great power for a jewel thief
weaknesses: Cannot turn non-crystalline matter into crystal (or vice versa)
Shooting crystal projectiles (bullets, shards, shrapnel, etc) requires accuracy
Everybody expecting expensive gifts (since you can summon diamonds and other precious stones)

name: Pencil Control
description: Whatever you write down will happen.
summary: The ability to make whatever you wrote down come true.
strengths: You would be able to have any superpower or do anything.
You would control almost everything.
Easy to use.
weaknesses: It only works with a certain pencil.
It can only be used once every hour.
If you have a messy handwriting, things won't turn out well.

name: Accelerated Healing
description: With this ability, if you get cut, injured, break a bone, etc., you will fully heal within 10 seconds.  You will still have to endure the pain, but you'll feel just fine 10 seconds later. Also regenerates limbs that are cut off.
summary: The ability to heal rapidly from any injury.
strengths: Extreme sports
Rough sex
Jumping out of a 5th story window
weaknesses: Surgical procedures might be difficult

name: I'm Already Finished!
description: Any tough work due next month? What about your graduate thesis, or that novel you were always planning to send to your editor? Want a gourmet meal or a dreamed-up video game? No matter how long or how expensive the undertaking is, you can have a free, finished product within a few seconds.   Here's how it works. Reality is your love slave. If someone asks you about a task you were assumed to be working on, and you choose to answer, "I'm already finished," you'll have the end product. Period.
summary: The ability to immediately have a expertly completed task or workpiece completed when someone asks you for it
strengths: Money and time mean nothing.
If people can make it, -you- can have a free customized version all for yourself.
You can be lazy all day and overachieve in any topic you want.
weaknesses: Someone has to -ask- you about the task. You could ask them to ask you though.
You still have to be subtle, or people might get suspicious.
Task has to be something a person can conceivably do on their own given infinite time and resources.

name: Battlefield Adaptation
description: With this power, you will be able to become stronger in a field of battle. Due to numerous battles and wars being fought in said fields, all the energy, hatred, aggression, and experience from all the fights before strengthens the combatants, allowing them to fight on equal or superior grounds with their opponents. Each battle fought strengthens the user physically, mentally and tactically, slowly turning them into a One-Man Army.
summary: The ability to adapt to the conditions of a battleground, and grow stronger with each battle
strengths: Slowly turn into a One-Man Army
Be prepared in just about any form of battle
weaknesses: The user needs some strength and agility to be more effective

name: Superhuman Habit
description: A person with this ability can specialize in any one action or a limited set of closely related actions and turn that habit into something supernatural in nature. For example a user can practice a single punch repeatedly such that using that punch will generate superhuman amount of force and the amount of force generated continues to grow with every repetition of the same action. Eventually the user may have to limit the times they perform that action because it may become too powerful.
summary: The ability to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of any one action you perform repeatedly
strengths: Can specialize in any one specific action turning that action superhuman in nature
Can be used to gain accuracy, speed, power, efficiency, and other attributes for any action
A customizable power able to adapt it to any one action you desire
weaknesses: May becomes impractical to use overtime ie it becomes overkill
Only applies to one action or set of actions
Action may be useless for current situation

name: Nuke Clap
description: The owner of this power wields the force of a nuke in his hands. When the owner claps hard enough, a huge blast wave shoots out with the power of a 5 megaton nuke. You don't want to be on the receiving end of this. But if your body can't handle the force of it, then it's a horrible idea to use it.
summary: The ability to Clap with the force of a nuclear blast
strengths: It is very damaging to enemies
It's so much fun to use
weaknesses: It destroys everything in a 20 mile radius
Unless your body can handle the force of it, it will kill you.

name: Impenetrable Skin
description: Nothing can penetrate your skin, not bullets, blades, needles, ect. In addition, your skin is immune to pain and burn marks. Having this power does not make your skin stiff, your skin is as flexible as usual, it just cannot be penetrated (or burned). Also, if you possess this power, than your bones become unbreakable. This power makes you indestructible and immune to pain, but not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury.
summary: The ability to have impenetrable skin
strengths: Skin is immune to penetration, burn marks, and physical pain
Unbreakable bones
weaknesses: Not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury

name: Accelerated Probability
description: Ever played soccer and wonder how to kick the ball into the goal? With this ability, you can slow things down, see the path before you, and move there with super speed. Once in probability mode, you can see every outcome and mathematically manipulate the odds in your favor!
summary: The ability to predict every outcome.
strengths: Slow down time
Foresee every outcome
Move at super speed to get things done
weaknesses: The ability works consciously (f.y.i you do not predict things constantly)
Can only use super speed in probability mode
You can only physically change the odds (Jet Li using a human shield in The One)

name: Mimicry
description: With this ability, you can mimic the appearance or abilities of any object, person or creature you can clearly imagine. However, you also take on the weaknesses of that object/person. One drawback of this ability is that it's much harder to mimic something you've never seen before, and you CANNOT mimic something which doesn't exist.
summary: The ability to mimic the appearance or skill of any object, person or creature.
strengths: You can transform, and/or gain the ability of any person/object/creature you can clearly imagine.
There is no time limit to how long you can stay in your mimic form.
You inherit all the strengths of your target.
weaknesses: You can't mimic something which doesn't exist. (Ex: a wizard. )
You also inherit the weaknesses of the target.

name: Book Of Everything
description: A person with this power has the complete encyclopedia. They can look up anything in the book. The information is constantly updated. Also you can rip out pages in the book. The ripped out pages will also be updated. Other than ripping the book is indestructible. This book does not tell you the future however it does tell you some secrets that are kept from the public. In addition this book is small enough to fit in a person's pocket, but can expand to fit the user's preference.
summary: The ability to have a pocket sized book with which you can research an topic that you will ever need to research
strengths: Handy encyclopedia
The book cannot be destroyed though you can rip pages off and separate the book
The book updates itself over time so that the facts are accurate
weaknesses: People can steal pages from the book and that page will be gone forever until they put it back
Some entries are blank because there is nothing that can be said about it

name: Power Writing
description: When anything descriptive is written on your skin, you instantly become as the word describes. You can write the words on, or someone else could do it. As the ink fades the described effect weakens, and if the writing disappears it wears off. A tattoo would have a more permament effect. For example, if someone wrote 'drunk' on your arm, you'd instantly become drunk. If you wrote 'super-strong' on your body, you'd get super strength. Drawings have no effect
summary: The ability to change your nature by writing on your skin
strengths: Can give yourself virtually any superpower
Can make yourself 'good-looking', 'healthy', 'rich', 'immortal' etc.
There's a lot of space on your body to write
weaknesses: Someone could write something really bad on you eg. 'dead'
Unless you re-write a description or go over the ink again, the effect will wear off
You'd have to be careful not to accidentally doodle on yourself, or write memos on your hand

name: Photographic Reflexes
description: Athletes have to train for years to throw a football perfectly, perform a championship gymnastic routine, or any other athletic skill. A person with Photographic Reflexes (also called Photographic Muscle Memory) can perfectly replicate any physical event after watching it only once. This means any martial art move, any Olympic dive, and every perfect free throw is totally inside their range. However, superhuman events are not.
summary: The ability to replicate any physical act after watching it once
strengths: Become the star quarterback
Become an amazing gymnast
Be a martial artist extrordinare
weaknesses: Cannot replicate superhuman feats (i.e. flight)
Can still be hurt
Cannot replicate what you haven't seen

name: Body Snatch
description: This power allows you to "jump" into a person's body (taking your own with you) and you have full control over them. In addition, you have all their memories and once you leave they will have no recollection of what you've done. However, someone with strong will or psychic abilities can resist you from entering. Some psychics might even be able to fight you once you possess them. Otherwise this power works well on most people and if they die you just jump out unharmed.
summary: The ability to hijack and take someone's mind and body
strengths: Full control of another person's body (including their powers)
Victims don't remember anything
Your body isn't left behind and you'll physically be safe
weaknesses: Those with exceptionally strong will can resist you from entering
Some psychics can use their own powers against you

name: Self Attribution
description: This power means that whatever certain attributes you have can be turned into superpowers. Such as you are overweight so you gain a gravitational field or you are skinny enough to slip between atoms or dimensions. It even counts for geneological attributes such as making a slight resistance to disease into virus immunity. It can even give some powers from psychological or ancestry traits.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on physiological, psychological, and other aspects of yourself.
strengths: There could be some good geneological powers.
Many powers.
weaknesses: Immeasurably rare to have a immortality trait.
Some powers you just can't get.
Might not get good ones.

name: Metalkinesis
description: This power is NOT magnetic! The ability to manipulate, create and control metal is highly unique. With Metalkinesis, your thoughts control what you do with the metal. You can use a bullet to create a shield, adding metal seemingly by magic. Create full body armour or convert the metal to liquid form without heat. Extreme heat or cold weaken your abilities, yet you can use them in space. As you age, this power and the control over it grow. It is wise to combine this power with immortality.
summary: The ability to create and control metal.
strengths: An armour is always available.
You can make any weapon with your thoughts.
You can absorb metal and save it for later.
weaknesses: Planets or areas without metal weaken you.
Very big magnets or heroes with magnetic powers make using your power unwise.
You are vunerable to extreme heat or cold when in metal armour.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Traitor
description: With this power, you can bring other people's shadows to life and command them to fight for you. When you animate a person's shadow, it separates from his body and becomes 3-D. The shadow is intangible unless you will it to be solid, making it virtually invulnerable. You can animate multiple people's shadows, giving you command over a shadow army. As your power advances, the shadows will even have the powers their original owners have.
summary: The ability to animate and command other people's shadows
strengths: Shadows have all the skills and, at higher levels, even the powers of their original owners
You can keep the shadows in a pocket dimension and summon them back at any time
Potential for a super-powered, near-invulnerable shadow army
weaknesses: Giving shadows the powers of their original owners takes experience
Commanding large numbers of shadows can be difficult and takes great focus

name: Chronos Blood
description: With this power you can create and control the Blood of Chronos, a liquid metal pearl-colored substance. You can make it appear from any part of your body. You can cover all your body with it, and then harden it and make a powerful armor, or you can make a melee weapon with it. The Chronos Blood metal is very strong, almost as strong as a diamond and its very light, so you can move freely while covered with it. It is also a non-magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
summary: The ability to create and control a liquid metal substance and then harden it and use it as a weapon or armor.
strengths: A very powerful defensive and aggressive power.
The Blood of Chronos is almost as strong as a diamond and it's very light, perfect as armor.
Chronos Blood isn't a magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
weaknesses: People with Liquid Control Powers will be able to manipulate it, even if its in solid form.
Blood of Chronos can be frozen in liquid form.

name: Personality Superpower
description: A person with this power gains a superpower based on their personality. For example, if you have a magnetic personality, you gain Magnetism. If you are a flexible person personality-wise, you can gain an elastic body.  You can only have one power with this ability and your ability can be unique because it is rare that someone will have the exact same personality as you. However, a person with multiple personalities can have more than one power, but can only access one at a time.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower based on your personality
strengths: The power will always become natural to use since it is based on your personality
If you have a split personality, you can have multiple powers
Split personality can give you multiple powers
weaknesses: It's based on your personality

name: Dc Superpowers
description: You could have an amazing array of powers with this one. You would have the exact powers of five different DC characters, of your choice. Credit to Vault since this is just the DC-version, with pretty much the same wording, of his Marvel Superpowers.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of five DC characters of your choosing
strengths: You could be like an amazing hero
weaknesses: Might not be five DC characters you want powers from

name: Vectors
description: The ability to control invisible and telekinetic arms capable of slicing human flesh, bone and even metal. They are also capable of deflecting projectiles, such as bullets. Vectors are incredibly strong, and can lift extremely heavy objects.
summary: The ability to control invisible, telekinetic arms
strengths: Great way to go on a killing spree.
Only people who share this power can see these "vectors"
weaknesses: Limited range.
Unable to stop certain projectile weapons.
Your vectors cannot stop another user's vectors

name: Physical Shape Shifting
description: Almost like Tonks in HP. You can change only the physical features of your body. (ex. Changing your hair color, length, type or doing your own nose job. ) It's probably good to keep a picture of the person you wish to look like. When you change yourself you must have the desired body part clearly in mind (ex. Hair or nose) before transforming. Remember- You can also change skin color too!
summary: The ability to change only your physical apperance
strengths: Great for spy work! You can look like any person you wish to be.
Never get zits.
Never need a haircut (or a nose job. )
weaknesses: The killer is in the details, so do a lot of research about your person!
Your voice remains the same.
You will not magically become the person you wish to be. You'll just look like them.

name: Photographic Deduction
description: A person with this power does not have enhanced sight but instead has superhuman processing of anything seen visually. For example, if they see someone moving their hands to draw something you can create an image of what they are drawing in your head without even being able to see the canvas. This also allows the user to read lips. Continued usage can lead to nigh prerecognitive abilities.
summary: The ability to figure out connections in whatever you seeing and process them in your head extremely fast
strengths: By looking at someone moving their pencil you can figure out what they are writing
You can read lips
weaknesses: You will be tempted to cheat in tests because looking at people's movements give you the answers

name: Logic Defying
description: Unlike Physics Rejector, or Physics Distortion which allows you to only defy the laws of physics, a person with Logic Defying has the ability to defy any type of logic in existence. That means that you can defy the laws of chemistry and biology or any other science as long as you don't believe that the laws apply to you. However, even the user themselves doesn't have any way to explain what they can do- they can do anything they want as long as they don't believe otherwise.
summary: The ability to defy any sort of logic as long as you don't believe that it applies to you
strengths: Nothing applies to you, or you choose what laws apply to you and what doesn't
You can do everything in Chuck Norris jokes just because you can
You can even skip any type of restrictions anyone put on you
weaknesses: Limited by a person's logic

name: Cell Generation
description: This power allows you to create cells in your body. You can even create new types of cells with unique properties. If you are injured create stem cells to turn into necessary ones or create the lost cells. If you are in a hostile environment you could create a cell type that heals you quickly or increases muscle power. If there is poison in your body you can make new immune system cells. Even make cells that take in oxygen more eficently.
summary: The ability to create biological cells for your own body
strengths: Works well with tissue generation and control.
Heal rapidly or go offensive.
Create new cell types to suit your needs.
weaknesses: Cant make magical cells.
Must have a somewhat decent knowledge of cells.
These cons cant be negated.

name: Every Kinesis
description: The ability to replicate any kinesis power: All the known abilities and also any new ones. If someone adds one that you don't have (yet), you can use it through this power. This also improves every aspect of your other (hard copy) kinesis powers, but only if you have Stackable Abilities.
summary: The ability to replicate any kinesis power.
strengths: Can have any kinetic power
Will be able any new kinesis of which you do not yet have a hard copy
weaknesses: Anti Power Mimicry

name: Will Projection
description: Most people can only will their own bodies. This ability allows you to will anything around you. But you must practice, because your will is just as strong as everyone elses at first. If you can build up your will, you'll be able to do more than move things. You can even will things to change into something else, as long as your not creating or destroying life. After mastering this, you could even will things into existince. But you still must follow the rule, no creating or destroying life.
summary: The ability to project your will onto anything or anywhere around you.
strengths: You can do almost anything if you can muster up the will
weaknesses: No creating or destroying life.

name: Imaginary Energy Manipulation
description: What do I mean by "Imaginary Energy". Well, in one episode of "American Dad" a guy mention that he could manipulate his own "Sexual Energy". We all know there is no such thing. The guy just sang an moved his body in an erotic fashion. The point is this ability could make that energy real. That is one part of the fun. The user can make up energies as well with their own effects and powers.
summary: The ability to make energies that don't actually exist real and control it
strengths: Bring fake energies real
Make up your energies
Control them
weaknesses: Using two or more energies in the same area might cause an terrible explosion.
Can't create an energy that is actually real.

name: Time Relativity
description: With this power you can make any person experience time for a relatively shorter or longer time than everyone else. One can make good times last years and bad times last seconds, and appear to be super fast by time go faster relative to your opponent, and one can talk to people for hours and for them only think it has been couple seconds. Electronics and other living things fall under this power, as well. While making relativity shift your body's needs (food, water, ect)still go at normal speed.
summary: The ability to control the passing of time for a person
strengths: Always have enough time to do what you want.
Parties don't end until you want them to.
Finish work in last five seconds after procrastinating.
weaknesses: Can't relive things you have made relatively shorter without another power.
Only you or the person you are affecting can notice the change in time relativity
Have to eat, drink, sleep eventually

name: Communication Scanner
description: Whenever an exchange of information is taking place through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can scan and understand the message. Knowledge of the language being used is not needed, though you won't necessarily get the subtexts when inside knowledge is required. It works on any type of communication means, including body language, electrical wires, fiber optics,... As long as the message is being transferred to a compatible receiver.
summary: The ability to detect, scan and understand a flow of information.
strengths: You are undetectable to 'muggle' ways of detecting intrusions.
You can even read someone's thoughts when they are thinking to themselves.
You can get your hands on private information.
weaknesses: A compatible intended receiver of the message is needed, that is one who can understand the message.
You won't get the subtext if some prior knowledge is needed to fully understand it.
You can't bypass any encryption algorithms, including the 'muggle' ones.

name: Superhuman Mimicry
description: With this power, you can have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers. With their powers, you will have the same amount of control as them. If you are taking the appearance of an animated character, then you will look however you imagine that character looking if he/she was real. Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever.
summary: The ability to have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers
strengths: Have the same powers and appearance as any fictional character with superpowers
weaknesses: Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever

name: Phantasmic Mimicry
description: You have a massive archive of passed people that you can choose anyone from to gain their knowledge, skills strength and also to mix their appearance with yours.
summary: The ability to use the ghost energy of any dead person to gain their knowledge, skill and physique.
strengths: Choose from any dead person.
You only take part of that persons apperance.
It is completely temporary.
weaknesses: People will notice the appearance changes.
Concentrated spectrum waves will negate the power.

name: Bio Energetic Force Aura
description: This power allows you to create a force field around your body that grants you flightand superhuman strength, as well as superhuman durability and can be used as a way to heal by manipulating your own bio-energy to speed up the healing process. You can also generate concussive bio-energy blasts, as well as being able to survive pressures of any type (water, atmospheric, etc. )
summary: The ability to generate a localized force field around yourself
strengths: Can protect
Used both offensively and defensively
Highly useful
weaknesses: Can be affected by certain forms of energy

name: Information Enchantment
description: With this power, one can give information supernatural properties, mainly effects on the reader/viewer/etc. The limitation, however, is giving new powers, although it can channel the effects of your other powers, such as using Friendly Power Gifting to give anyone who reads a particular sign one of your powers. Other examples include making something impossible to remember or impossible to learn to certain individuals.
summary: The ability to bestow supernatural properties on information itself.
strengths: You can contain the effect to a particular medium, so it does not spread.
Advertise anything and have it granted to those who read it.
The only limit is your imagination.
weaknesses: Effect may not last recreation by the human mind unless precautions are taken.
You cannot grant new superpowers with this, though you can simulate them.
This power cannot be modified by other powers, although you can use your powers through this.

name: Moral  Based Ability Granting
description: The user can give abilities to themselves or others based on lessons and morals that they learned. I don't mean like if you learn something from in school and now you have a power. I mean lessons about life like this for example. You fought someone bigger and stronger than you, and you figured out you need to out-think than out-muscle him. With that "Might is not always right" mentality, your ability kicks in and gives you enhanced intelligence to defeat your opponent's brawn.
summary: The ability to grant abilities to oneself or others based on life lessons or morals.
strengths: Gain new and unique abilities based on the morals that you learned.
As long as you hold those morals, the abilities are permanent
Read parables and stories that have morals
weaknesses: Ignorance can prevent you from learning morals

name: 100% Efficient Movement
description: When your body pushes against something, exactly half of the energy produced pushes against your body in an opposite direction. With this power, any punches, pushes and shoves are 100% efficient, as this waste energy is redirected into your target. You are now essentially twice as strong and as fast as any human your strength and build. You also now cannot damage your own tissue from over-exertion, e.g. you can't break your hand by punching a concrete wall. The wall will instead by more damaged.
summary: The ability to redirect the kinetic energy your body endures when it moves
strengths: You are as fast and as strong as any other human
No danger of damaging yourself with your superstrength
No sore hands or broken hands after a fight, which happens more often than you think
weaknesses: Attacks from others hurt you just as much
This isn't a particularly impressive power
You need to build up your strength by working out

name: Superhuman Reflexes
description: You can react to events nearly instantaneously.  "Think fast!" will be a slow and annoying practical joke.
summary: The ability to react almost instantly.
strengths: Dodge things
Impress your friends with your leet Whac-A-Mole skills
weaknesses: Laughing early at people's jokes

name: Life Force Manipulation
description: With this ability, you could easily analyze any organism's biological make-up simply by looking at it. You can read and interpret the health, special abilities, and personality of any entity, as well as manipulate the life force in it. You can pour your life energy into a living thing in order to heal it, or absorb another living thing's life energy simply by touching it, thereby gaining their memories, special abilities, and strength. This will weaken the target or even kill it.
summary: The ability to read organic substances and transfer life force by touch.
strengths: Quickly analyze something's health, personality, or any skills/superpowers they might have.
Heal any injury through physical contact.
Gain the health, memories, and skills of the target, weakening or killing them.
weaknesses: Healing weakens you as much as it strengthens the target.
Life extraction may manifest in a lust for life force.
May have difficulty controlling the power, resulting in accidental damage upon physical contact.

name: Antibacterial Body
description: Because your body is antibacterial, you can clean surfaces by touching them with your hands, feet, tongue, or any other part of your body! As a bonus, you are immune to almost any disease since harmful germs die as soon as they get on you!
summary: The ability to kill germs & clean surfaces with your own body
strengths: Clean surfaces with your own body parts.
Immunity to almost any disease!
You're like a living block of soap!
weaknesses: It's not quite impossible for you to get sick...
You can still be stained by discoloring substances like paint. Rinse yourself to wash them off.

name: Energy Morph
description: You could morph any part of your body into an energy that you could will into any form you can imagine. The energy is transparent and can be any color you want. You can even separate the energy from your body in the form of objects and projectiles. For example, you could form a sword then reform your hand around the handle. Morphing your hands is the easiest but not your limit.
summary: The ability to change your body into an energy you can reshape at will.
strengths: Very useful power.
The energy is nearly indestructible.
weaknesses: You can not morph all of your body at once.
Need to be creative to reach your full potential.

name: Blood Temperature Manipulation
description: You can control the temperature of someone's blood making them hot or cold you can kill them by making them really hot and exploding them or really cold and freezing them. You can also use this power on yourself
summary: The ability to control the temperature of someones blood.
strengths: Can make yourself the tempature you want.
weaknesses: Takes alot of concetration

name: Kinetic Speed
description: The ability to absorb kinetic energy (eg: from being punched, falling, voluntarily striking surface) and release it at will, usually in the form of superspeed. Can store the energy absorbed in body for later use. While storing and using energy the hero vibrates quiet rapidly, causing some discomfort.
summary: The ability to absorb kinetic energy and release it at will
strengths: Opponent's energy can be used against them.
Energy from using superspeed causes more energy.
weaknesses: Can cause some pain if too much energy is stored
Vibration while using the power can be uncomfortable

name: Indestructible!
description: Heal ridiculously fast from any physical damage, burns, bullets, amputations, etc. If a generous portion of your body is destroyed & one cell remains, the cell will regrow your entire body. You will steadily build a tolerance to most conventional injuries. Reattach limbs or grow new ones; your will controls every cell. Your bones will become nigh unbreakable and your skin will toughen. You will double peak human physiology. You will even learn to block out pain completely at will.
summary: The ability to be indestructible and build up a pain tolerance
strengths: Be unstoppable. Walk thru lasers, razors, run thru infernos, shed frozen tissue
Eventually (+/- one jupiter year) you will freak enemies out by taking their worse and smiling
Grow rhino-like skin, lift a metric ton, bones will be like thick galvanized rubber.
weaknesses: You are not invincible. Mentats hurt you & you could still be injured and even destroyed.
If your pain centers are off, touch will be off as well and it will take days to come back
Your body density & hair will grow. Eventually you will look like a pale Wolverine reject

name: Superiority
description: With this power, even the Hulk and Doomsday will have trouble! The moment you encounter someone with an ability that you can use, you will surpass all of their talents. "Anything you can do, I can do better" will no longer be a joke!
summary: The ability to surpass the powers and talents of others.
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and smarter than anyone!
Win at everything forever!
weaknesses: You will become a real world Mary-sue/Gary-stu
Nobody likes a Mr. /Ms. Perfect

name: Immortality Manipulation
description: Immortality can come in many forms. Lets see, anti-aging, resurrection, preservation and the weird one where you just don't die from wounds. Someone with this power can grant or remove any of these, and choose between which they grant. Physical contact is necessary and this ability can be used on yourself. You can even make up your own forms of immortality. Also you can change the kind of immortality someone has
summary: The ability to control immortality, in any of its forms.
strengths: Can grant any form of immortality and it can't be removed from you.
Can choose what form you grant and can make up your own kinds
Can be used on yourself AND can take back immortality from others.
weaknesses: Physical contact is necessary.

name: Power Wash
description: The user is able to heal any damaged cells, broken tissues, stressed materials, and mental strain to which they have suffered by focusing a stream of energy to bathe over their body. They are "washing" away the harm.
summary: The ability to clense oneself of wounds, physical and mental.
strengths: Can heal physical and mental obscurities.
Can be used on other people, if the user allows.
Can introduce a form of immortality.
weaknesses: Telepathy can cause drawbacks, if not shut the ability off completely.
User can still be killed by any conventional weapon.
The ability doesn't make the user invincible.

name: Comic Book Mimic
description: The name of this superpower has 'comic book' in it because the most common way to use this superpower is to copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books. Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics. The user must see an image of the superpower being used by a fictional character before he/she can replicate it. If the user acquires too many superpowers, they will all disappear and the user will have to acquire a whole new set of superpowers.
summary: The ability to replicate the superpowers of fictional characters
strengths: Copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books
Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics
weaknesses: The user must see an image of the superpower being used before he/she can replicate it
Aquires too many superpowers, they'll all disappear and you'll have to aquire another set of powers
How many you can acquire before you have to start over, is different for every user

name: Forcefield Body
description: Your entire body is made of force fields from a visible level down to your DNA. You have any strengths and weaknesses that an actual forcefield would have. If you take too much damage at one time, you will overload and die. With time and practice, you can control your force field body to do other things. Fly, reshape your arms into force blades, extend short-ranged tractor beams,... Anything that would work with a force field.
summary: The ability to have a body that is made of force fields.
strengths: You're a solid energy being.
This power combines with other force field powers (i.e. Impenetrable Field).
With time and practice, you can fly or reshape your force field body.
weaknesses: Energy draining powers will weaken or kill you.
The powers Barrier Melting and Wall Tearer will kill or hurt you.
As a force field, you'll have a finite damage limit.

name: Forcefield Projection
description: Force without mass is the greatest weapon. A person with Forcefield Manipulation can project durable, translucent fields of energy that will naturally form into bubbles unless mentally directed to do otherwise. They can be used as a shield or an offensive weapon.
summary: The ability to project and manipulate fields of energy
strengths: Easy to win fights
Even easier to defend yourself
Very versatile
weaknesses: Can be overloaded
Takes practice to use offensively
Takes focus

name: Reactive Knowledge Gain
description: Tied up with very hard rope and there is a bomb in the room? This power helps you by allowing you to gain knowledge of how you could break the rope and disable the bomb. There are limits of this power though, this power only helps you escape not win battles, and you gain knowledge as you need it, not as you want it.
summary: The ability to gain knowledge as you need it.
strengths: Gain knowledge as you need it!
weaknesses: Doesn't help you win battles.
Only when you need it, not wan't it.

name: Existence Manipulation
description: This is the fraternal twin of Self-Existence Manipulation. It allows you to control the existence of everything, but yourself. To put it more simply, you can control what things are. You are not the creator of all, but more like the molder. All of existence is yours to control.
summary: The ability to manipulate existence
strengths: Near unlimited power.
Can control existence of all things.
weaknesses: You cannot control your own existence
You have much power, but need even more control.

name: Scanning
description: With this power, you can make any plan foolproof. Find out what's wrong with any patient and be the world's best doctor. Or even fight super heroes/villains and use their weakness against them, winning the battle without even trying.
summary: The ability to see any weakness, flaw, or mistake by simply looking at something.
strengths: Pin point weaknesses, flaws or mistakes
Ace quizzes
Ultimate doctor, never lose any fight, unless you don't feel like winning. (pfft)
weaknesses: ..... Not really a power you can use without preparation

name: Top 10 Power Mimicry
description: The holder of this ability could be a very powerful person, as they have the top ten most wanted powers on the Superpower List. Unfortunately, once the preferences change, you get a new ten powers. Remember, the top ten may not be your favorites. However, if you do not like an ability, you can suppress it. If this is one of the top ten, you get the other nine and the eleventh.
summary: The ability to have the top 10 powers.
strengths: Getting some really good powers.
Having ten at a time!
You can suppress powers you don't want.
weaknesses: Not everyone has the same preferences.
Some powers are redundant -who wants Space/Time Manipulation and Teleportation?
The powers may change too fast for you to get experience.

name: Transformers: Rapido
description: With this power you automatically hold a higher rank than everyone else in the room. If a person that ranks higher than you in your organization walks into the room your rank and clearance level automatically increase. So if you were to walk into a room with the President or some other head of state you would automatically have a higher rank than them and be able to command them.
summary: The ability to outrank everybody
strengths: You outrank everybody
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Physically Perfect
description: Physically, meaning your body. This qualifies as looks and strength. This power allows the user to be extremely good looking and have amazing strength. Also, although you don't need to, if you take care of your body, in return your body will become resistant to physical harm and your appearance will become so attractive that you'll be able to take control over the will power of others. You'll be physically perfect.
summary: The ability to be physically perfect
strengths: Extremely good looking
Amazing strength, maybe resistant to physical harm
Control the will power of others
weaknesses: Mental imperfections remain

name: Approvability
description: This ability allows people around the user to speak nothing but positive things about him. This also makes people approve on your action even when it is down right cruel or evil. This can allow you to do almost anything within your power.
summary: The ability to be approved by everyone, even when you don't deserve it.
strengths: To be approved by all
All deeds will be accepted
weaknesses: Limited range

name: The Watch Of Destiny
description: The Watch of Destiny is a mystical object created by Father Time. If you obtain this you may see or control someone's age or fate. You can't lose this object because whoever possesses it will have it attached to their skin. The only ways to get rid of it is to die or cut your wrist off.
summary: The ability to control a being's fate.
strengths: Make it so a bully is two years old.
Make a supermodel make out with you.
Make your family discover a gold mine.
weaknesses: It hurts a lot to get it removed.

name: Nature Hero
description: When activated, you have access to every living species of animal on Earth. You can also draw strength from them and aquire their abilities. Since you are the Nature Hero, they obey your every command and operate on a "hive mind", meaning you can control an entire army of these beasties.
summary: The ability to evolve living creatures, tame them, and mimic their abilities.
strengths: Evolve a whale to an ocean fortress.
Mimic a tiger, bat, chameleon, wolf, and become a super predator.
See through the eyes of a hawk.
weaknesses: You are only capable of mimicking four different animals at one time.
Operating a "hive mind" could be frustrating.

name: Body Supremacy
description: Also called Body Mastery or Free Motion, this ability allows you a freedom of movement that is uninhibited by an unawareness of what your body can do. As such, you can use your body in various ways that would normally require practice first. Effortlessly do back flips, handstands, cartwheels, various fight moves, go from a supine position to upright in one move, and many other athletic feats. In addition, your motions cannot be dominated or otherwise controlled by anyone except you.
summary: The ability to have total awareness, familiarity and control of all the motions made by your body
strengths: Totally aware and familiar with every move you make (swim speed equals land speed, etc. )
Move by the most efficient means; get the most out of every move you make (conserve stamina)
Foes cannot take control of your motions by any means other than pure brute physical force
weaknesses: Control of the body doesn't mean Shapeshifting, Rapid Regeneration or Longevity/Immortality
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Immutability (can still be altered, etc. )
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Psychic Immunity (mind can still be read)

name: Power Of The Hercules Beetle
description: The user is able to lift up objects 850 times heavier that the user's body weight. For example, if your body weight is 60kg , you can lift up objects as heavy as 19,000 kg. This power also grants the user the ability to fly.
summary: The ability to lift up objects 850 times than your body weight as well as fly
strengths: Super Human Strength
Has the ability to fly
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: None so far has been observed

name: Precognitive Reflexes
description: With this ability, your mind is constantly in-tune to the forces of fate. As such, your body warns you of future events without being distracted by those pesky visions. In other words, if you need to do a certain movement (within your physical capability) in order to avoid danger, or otherwise help you out, then it will be done. This ability makes combat a breeze, because you don't even have to consciously think about it; your subconscious reflexes will kick in to do all the work for you.
summary: The ability to have one's reflexes facilitated through a subconscious perception of the future
strengths: Your subconscious always perceives the immediate future, often bestowing Superhuman Reflexes
Once you develop your power, it can be used for more than just combat (tests, sports, etc. )
This is just as effective against probability manipulation as Unpredictability
weaknesses: If you can't control it, may make social situations awkward or annoying
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the subconscious perception
If you decide to override your subconscious perception, may lead to disastrous conscequences

name: Sinister Luck
description: With this power, you can make yourself unnaturally lucky by stealing the luck from others. However, the luck that you drain from others will only last for 24 hours, so once your luck is back to normal, find someone nearby and suck out all of their luck.
summary: The ability to drain the luck from others to increase your own.
strengths: Win the lottery
Every gamble will work in your favor
Drain the luck from others like a parasite
weaknesses: Without their luck, people will fall into despair
Bad things will happen to them more often
Casinos may accuse you of cheating

name: Auto Dodge
description: This ability lets you dodge everything that is in motion towards you. For example, bullets and punches can be dodged. This ability is automatic so you must dodge no matter what. Even if you try really hard you must dodge. No one can ambush you since even if you don't see an object your body will dodge it subconsciously. This ability also means that you mostly can't be touched so you won't be able to hug anyone. This ability is active even when asleep.
summary: The ability to dodge anything and everything that can threaten you
strengths: Can even dodge bullets and perform superhuman feats in order to dodge
No one can ambush you
Can also learn how to counter at the same time as dodging
weaknesses: Can't be touched-You automatically dodge hugs and high fives
Your muscles still get tired if you dodge continuously

name: Conduit
description: When energies of other superpowers are directed at you, your body becomes a conduit for these powers. They pass through you and out again in your chosen direction. As certain powers pass through you, they may energise you. Users with high willpower are able to keep the power contained in themselfs for a short period of time instead of having to release them imediatly. (note: you do not keep the power only redirect it)
summary: The ability to channel energies or powers directed at you
strengths: Deflect energy blasts, elemental attacks and other powers back at their users
Immune to many powers
Channel energies such as electricty or magnetism if you can find a constant source
weaknesses: Does not work on all superpowers (physical attacks for instance)

name: Power Ring Summon
description: With this power you can summon any color power ring featured in DC comics (green, blue, indigo, orange, red, white, black, yellow, pink/violet) and use them to fight (or commit) crime. They work the same way they would in the comics. Once you summon them you cannot send them back and are forced to keep them.
summary: The ability to summon any color power ring
strengths: You can summon any power ring from DC comics
They can do anything they can do in the comics
weaknesses: You cannot send them back once you summon them

name: Aura Claws
description: The claws have a color that is the same as your aura because they are formed from your aura. The are sharper than the sharpest katana ever and will ignore the skin during attacks to deal internal damage to your enemies body.
summary: The ability to create claws around one's hands or emitted from the tips of one's fingernails
strengths: It's really hard for anyone to determine the extent of the damage that you have dealt.
Your enemy has to cut themself open in order to determine how much damage you've done.
weaknesses: The claws can be blocked by anything that has been created from an aura.

name: Transference
description: The wielder can transfer stamina, energy, strength and health to themselves or allies by draining it from opponents. This can physically wear out the opponent if a transference is made.
summary: The ability to transfer human neccesities to oneself and others
strengths: Transfer peoples stamina, health, energy and strength to the wielder or allies
Transfer fatigue, wounds and damage to other people
Strong combatant at close range
weaknesses: The transference can only take place through touch
The wielder can only transfer one thing at a time
Weak against long-ranged attacks

name: Aptitude Intensification
description: The bearer of this power has all of their innate,natural, and acquired skills increased to inhuman levels. They are automatically gifted in all range of skills they possessed beforehand and will be able to do anything they had practiced perfectly and effortlessly. In addition ALL of ones natural aspects(Strength, sight, speed, etc) related to the bearers specific skills will be increased as well. When developed the user needs only to learn the basics of a skill and instantly become good at it.
summary: The ability to increase all of ones innate or acquired skills and aspects.
strengths: It requires relativity little effort to  learn and master new skills.
Most people have some skill in most anything, even simple things can lead to aspect enhancement.
Any skills will have their related aspects enhanced as well.
weaknesses: Before your skills are increased you must actually HAVE skills to speak of. NCN
Those with one-upmanship abilities can still trump you.
Useless if one possesses no useful skills.

name: Surgical Precision
description: A person with this power has superb hand-eye coordination undeterred by fear or nervousness. In addition this power gives the user the ability to be calm when performing any operation. For example they can perform surgical operations with the utmost precision. In addition this power also works for any action taken. For example you can also learn to throw objects with the utmost precision and learn to play instruments with precision.
summary: The ability to be extremely precise in completing any action
strengths: Perform surgeries that are considered impossible
Works even when nervous or in state of fear
Applies toward any action you do.
weaknesses: Doesn't give you medical knowledge

name: Dragon Heart
description: If you are hurt, in distress, or simply want a better life, you can call upon one star of your choosing. It will come to you as a mythical dragon, who then will give half of it's own heart to you. As long as the dragon lives, so will you. You can heal from any wound or illness in a matter of minutes to hours, have greater strength, agility, and stamina, and also be much wiser than most people. You and your dragon can communicate telepathically, and have a powerful empathic connection.
summary: The ability to gain powerful supernatural abilities/immortality through bestowal and possession of a dragon's heart
strengths: The dragon will only aid people who are good
You can have a great friend and ally
You are immortal as long as the dragon lives, and vice versa
weaknesses: If either one is hurt, the other will feel the pain just as much
You are only partially immortal
If you both die, you will merge and transform back into the star from which the dragon came

name: Finite Power Manipulation
description: The user has a power that is capable of tipping the scales of most situations. The user can give anything a limited power that can be enough to fulfill a task. Since, it is finite, the probability of it failing are still possible. The user in a fight can boost their power to almost match the opponent, but it is up to the user that will decide the winner. The user can power machines enough to almost run the time that they need.
summary: The ability to create, induce, or infuse power that is "just enough" for any situation.
strengths: Power boost
Change the course of any situation to a bit of your favor
Power up other things with limited power
weaknesses: It is limited power
You have to think wisely to utilize its "full" potential

name: Mystical Zodiac Gauntlet
description: The person with this gauntlet is able to harness the power of the Chinese Zodiac. There are 12 Chinese Zodiacs and the user get one Zodiac power bestowed on them every month. It will change to another power when the month ends and when the new months begin. Dragon (pyrokinesis), rabbit (superspeed),ox (super strength), rooster(flight),monkey(super reflexes), dog(invulnerability), snake(invisibility), rat(size-alteration), horse(healing),pig(unbreakable skin), tiger(tiger traits), sheep (phasing)
summary: The ability to bestowed the powers of the Chinese Zodiacs when in possession of this gauntlet
strengths: Can take on powerhouses on some scenarios
Hard for enemies to adapt with powers keep changing every month
weaknesses: The user can be depowered if the gauntlet is removed from him or her
The user does not know what power he or she receives every new month until he or she uses it

name: Symptoms Reader
description: With this power all you have to do is see a person's symptoms and you'll instantly be able to diagnose them. Accurately and everything. Take that doctors!
summary: The ability to instantly diagnose someone based on their symptoms
strengths: You can diagnose people instantly and accurately
weaknesses: Doctors will probably hate you
Not much use in physical combat

name: Aversion Field
description: An invisible field constantly rotates around your body, preventing anything that is aimed directly at you from hitting you. Bullets will just miss you, punches and kicks will never land, etc.
summary: The ability to avoid being directly hit by anything
strengths: Never lose a fist fight
Enjoy bank robberies without the worries of gunshots
weaknesses: Indirect attacks like bombs, light flashes, etc cannot be avoided

name: God's Algorithm
description: You immediately know the shortest possible way to solve a problem.   For example:  * You are given a scrambled Rubik's cube and you would know the minimal moves needed to solve it.  * Someone asks you directions, and you'll know the shortest path to the location.
summary: The ability to know the optimal way to solve a problem
strengths: Know the shortest solution to any problem
Solve puzzles faster
weaknesses: Puzzles rarely pose an entertaining challenge
The shorted solution to a problem isn't always the best solution

name: Phase Transformation
description: With this ability, you can undergo a transformation that makes all of your natural and supernatural abilities more powerful. The side effect of this ability is that it takes more energy than your normal form. You can also go through stronger levels of phases, but each one drains your energy more than the last.
