summary: The ability to undergo a transformation which makes all of your abilities stronger.
strengths: Great for a sort of 'last stand' situation.
You can go through multiple levels of phases.
weaknesses: Requires more energy for each phase that you undergo.

name: Trident Of Poseidon
description: The Trident of Poseidon is a weapon with a mahogany handle infused with powdered diamond for strength, a solid gold base, and prongs of pure silver. When first summoned, it appears as a small pen, which then permanently links to it's first wielder, but only if they are good, with rightful and just intentions. The person can control water in any way they choose, and also use it to heal even the deadliest injuries or ailments in mere hours. The trident will always return to the user if misplaced.
summary: The ability to control water with Poseidon's trident
strengths: The trident permanently links with the first person who wields it, and only if they are good
It can make them near-immortal!!
Power limitation is only in the wielder's imagination, so enemies better watch out!!
weaknesses: None

name: Creation Training
description: This power allows you to use any power that you create. However, before you train at it, your powers will be very weak. Training involves practicing with the power until it becomes more potent. The amount of training required for a power to reach its full potential varies, but is never more than three months worth.
summary: The ability to use any power you create through training.
strengths: You can have a wide variety of powers.
Training at powers generally helps you to understand them better.
weaknesses: If you have this power, the only way to get powers you create is by training.
Training tires you and it takes time.

name: Focus Manipulation
description: This ability can make anyone gain or loss focus on what they want. This will help the user avoid attacks from their opponents. This ability can make anyone a powerful marksman or someone who really needs glasses.
summary: The ability to control anything's accuracy including oneself.
strengths: Gain Accuracy
Can avoid opponent's attacks
Can make people loss focus on their goals or pay attention to you.
weaknesses: effects only lasts for 3 days

name: Arcana 11: Justice
description: In any conflict, be it physical or social, between two people or groups of people, you can cause the result of the conflict to always be a tie. A coin toss would end with the coin falling on it's edge, two sports teams would end up with exactly the same scores, no matter how long they played. This power ignores any differences in respective skill- A chess grand-master could be rendered unable to defeat a chess novice.
summary: The ability to cause the most neutral possible outcome in any conflict.
strengths: You can determine the balanced outcome of almost any fight or conflict, including your own.
You can make certain that you never actually lose a fight.
weaknesses: This power has no ability to actually make anyone succeed at anything.
This power doesn't work when a single person is involved, such as in solitare.

name: Enhanced Progression
description: Everything takes time, they say. Not always true; a person with Enhanced Progression can adapt to a task much more rapidly than an average person. Martial arts training may take half the time, Newtonian calculus might become a weekend project, weightlifting gradients might pass by faster, and so on. This does not mean they are smarter or stronger. Rather, they must expend less time and effort to get the same results. There is a con--they cannot become superhuman in any area.
summary: The ability to learn or adapt much faster than normal.
strengths: Acquire new skills with prodigious speed
Lifelong commitments are no longer necessary
Become a master of karate, physics, weightlifting, etc.
weaknesses: Not inherently smarter or stronger
Still must spend some time learning the task
Cannot become truly superhuman in any area

name: Bodily Energy Unification
description: Humans produce many kinds of energy. Heat energy, kinetic energy, the energy from food or cells, etc. This ability combines them into a unified force that still have the properties of the energies that formed it. The user can then manipulate the new energy as the user pleases. Any outside energy that makes contact with the user will be temporarily absorbed and added on to the new energy. The new energy will act out all the energy that formed it so the user can function normally.
summary: The ability to combine all the energies in one's body to create a new energy and manipulate it.
strengths: New form of energy.
Manipulate it.
Energy has all the properties of combined energies.
weaknesses: Energies are combined forever, but you will still function like a normal human.

name: See It Know It
description: This power allows you to see things and their answer. For example, if you are stuck on a test, you can use this power and see the answers glow from your point of view. Like if the answer to the test is A, you would see the A bubble glow up. In the case of problems requiring steps to be performed, you will see them solve themselves right in front of your eyes, so you can repeat the steps.
summary: The ability to see things progress before your eyes
strengths: You will always get A
You can solve the hardest problem as it will solve right in front of your eye.
weaknesses: People would dump all their work on you

name: Crystal Kinesis
description: If you need to smash through a wall, cover yourself in crystals and/or diamonds.
summary: The ability to shoot crystal bullets out of one's body and cover oneself in a retractable crystal armor.
strengths: Can be indestructible.
You never have to reload.
Can smash through walls.
weaknesses: Easy to miss.
Crystals will break off.
You will look weird when covered in crystals.

name: Requiem Drive
description:
Upon physical contact with another person, the user can put the target to sleep in mere seconds. When the victim re-awakens, they will feel extremely dizzy. 
In addition, if the user cannot physically touch the target, they can chant a small verse while focusing on said target to knock them out from afar.
summary: The ability to render a person unconscious through touch
strengths: Tired of someone talking? - put them to sleep.
Want to sneak past a security guard or two? Problem solved
Suffering from insomnia? Use it on yourself!
weaknesses: Not much use if multiple opponents come at you all at once
Cannot be used to kill. Which is bad if your opponent wants your head.
May not actually work on its owner, so insomniacs may need sleeping pills.

name: Tactile Psammokinesis
description: This power allows a person to control sand at close range. It is slightly stronger than the normal form of this ability due to psionic energy emanated from the individual when in concurrence with any sand source. A user of the power can even infuse their body with it to increase or decrease their mass, strength, and power. They can also create sandstorms, tornadoes, etc.
summary: The ability to control sand when in contact or close proximity to it.
strengths: You have near-limitless regenerative capability when in or near any form of sand.
You can be a formidable combatant to an enemy.
You cannot be destroyed.
weaknesses: You can only control minute amounts of sand at first.
Water, heat, and wind can all weaken you.
If you are inexperienced, this power can fatigue you very quickly if amplified.

name: Sublimation
description: With this power, you can become a hazy mist that blinds anyone within range and gives you the power to phase through objects, intangibility, and of course, blinding.  With this power, you cannot feel pain, and it is very helpful in escaping dangerous situations. Unfortunately, you only have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
summary: The ability to change your body into mist
strengths: You can blind opponents
You have the powers of phasing and intangibility
Easily escape dangerous situations
weaknesses: You have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
You can accidentally blind allies.
Retreating is not always a good thing to do.

name: Strength In Numbers
description: With this power you can create up to 12 clones of yourself and each of them have super strength. Note you yourself don't have super strength only your clones do but you have complete control over your clones. Also if one of the clones dies you can simply recreate it.
summary: The ability to create up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
strengths: You can have up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
There is no time limit on the clones
The clones are under you complete control
weaknesses: You yourself don't have super strength
The clones are not invincible

name: Force Extension
description: Grab any item and smash an opponent with it from any range. This ability extends the force from the object you are wielding to the target point. However, there is a range limit of about 50 meters of extension from the tip of the object. More advanced users can create multiple extensions to create various effects, like a small wall of defence, and also the ability to slightly exaggerate the force, making it stronger than it would normally be. But you have to swing the object for this ability.
summary: The ability to extend the force of an object that you are using.
strengths: Extend the force of any object that you use, including blunt, pierce and slash forces
More advanced users can make the forces stronger and make more extensions
Use both offensively and defensively
weaknesses: Must be wielding an object.
Have to visualise where the extension comes from
Acts as a physical extension, so energy beings are immune.

name: Mastery Of Explosions
description: The ability to create, control, manipulate and absorb explosions. With this, you can: Fly- By creating small explosions at the base of your feet and stabilizing with other small explosions. Defend- By exploding any danger coming at you. Does not affect energies. Attack- Melee or energetic. By creating explosions from your fist to blow up someone's face or even just blow up their head from afar. It also allows you to stop explosions, including the explosions in guns, pistons in cars, etc.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate explosions
strengths: Can blow up anything and everything.
Can stop explosions, rendering cars, trucks, guns, anything with explosions useless.
Protection from physical harm.
weaknesses: Useless when unconscious.
Property damage.
Energy exhaustion.

name: Weakness Manipulation
description: Someone's weakness(including any of your own)can be changed to something else. You can also alter the severity of a weakness. You can make the severity of the the weakness no worse than a bad skin rash to a almost instant death reaction. You can match a weakness with someone's powers or give someone a weakness that contradicts a power they have. A icy weakness for ice power user or a friction weakness for a super fast runner. Changes like these aren't permanent however.
summary: The ability to change someone's weakness and/or the severity of the weakness.
strengths: Change your or a friend's weakness at will.
Make a weakness you have you no worse than a allergic reaction.
Make a foe's weakness into a deadly one.
weaknesses: Some weaknesses will only be temporary.
You can't negate a weakness with this power.
You have this power but so does your enemy.

name: Ultimate Upgrader
description: This ability lets the user access ultimate versions of their ability at will. Ultimate abilities are abilities that have been honed so much that their power is at max and their possibilities to do things increase. However, it comes at a price with having glaring weaknesses and chances to leave a trail of destruction. A person must know how to absolutely control their abilities to use ultimate abilities effectively. You can switch back to non-ultimate forms with the original level of power.
summary: The ability to evolve/devolve your own powers to/from its ultimate form
strengths: You get to use an upgraded version of your own power
You can switch between the ultimate and non-ultimate form
weaknesses: Ultimate abilities have glaring weaknesses such as indiscriminate paths of destruction
Ultimate abilities are harder to control than any other superpower and can be fatal to the user

name: Existence Affinity
description: The user has the ability to be stronger, faster, and more durable by something specific that exists; the  only limits is how many of them do exist, how significant the thing, or both. Example: If a smoker truly loves or desires cigarettes, the user will become more powerful by the number of cigarettes that exist in their vicinity.
summary: The ability to become stronger by something specifically that exists in their surrounding..
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and more durable.
Numbers are the key.
weaknesses: If that specific thing doesn't exist anymore, user is back to normal strength.

name: Visual Muscle Replication
description: With this power, whatever you imagine you can do in your head. Your body will do it. For example: you see a Jackie Chan feat that you want to do plus a few more of your own added. Now you can do it. This power is limited to your flexibility and realisticness. So you can't fly.
summary: The ability to perform any feat you can imagine.
strengths: Your muscle will be A LOT stronger. You bone will be lighter too.
Got pushed of a building, you'll be fine. Just imagine how you will land, your body will do it.
Do cool stuff, like qua-tripple spin on a skateboard even though you nerver skateboard before
weaknesses: You can't do superheroes feat. So if you want to jump like spider man, you''ll be like him for 2 sec

name: Fortune Cookie
description: Tired of having bad luck or not having any date? Well lucky you! With this power, you can create any fortune cookie with anything written and whoever reads it will be affected. For example: Mom reads a fortune cookie stating "You will become hot and sexy" and poof!! You got a hot and sexy mother. Be warned though, the effects are permanent.
summary: The ability to make a fortune cookie with anything written in it come true
strengths: Be a wonderful match-maker
Have everyone's mother become hot and sexy
Be worshipped as the Fortune Cookie God
weaknesses: Might want some "Unwanted Effects"
Can't use on yourself more than once a day
Might read the words "fat and ugly"

name: Overdrive
description: The user of this ability can change the cellular constitution of their own body to function faster or better, for example, change muscle cells to red blood cells for faster circulation. Or to change white blood cells to muscle cells, effectively making themself stronger but prone to more diseases. Changing cell constitution burns energy. They can also transform into an Overdrive body, making themself 300% more efficient, stronger and faster.
summary: The ability to change the cellular constitution of the body to function faster
strengths: Can change cellular constitution to become faster or stronger.
Overdrive Mode can make your other powers 300% more efficient and powerful.
Cellular regeneration is possible for skilled users.
weaknesses: Changing your cells burns energy so you have to eat a lot.
You can change too many of your cells, if unskilled, which is dangerous.
If you stay in Overdrive Mode too long, you will die from lack of energy.

name: Overclocking
description: A person with this power can increase their own abilities both natural and or superpowers for a period of time in exchange for side effects later. For example using this power you can increase your strength past its limit or increase your stamina and concentration. You can also increase the computing power of your brain. If you have superpowers you can also increase their power using this ability. The user receives a backlash of fatigue and hunger after using this ability.
summary: The ability to increase your own abilities beyond your normal scope for a period of time with side effects later
strengths: Increase your abilities when you need it the most
Decrease time needed to train or study in exchange for fatigue later
You can control how much you are overclocking and can tell when the backlash occurs
weaknesses: Backlash some time after use of this power
If you overuse this ability it is bad for your health

name: Utopian Hallucination
description: With this power you can cause someone to believe that they are in their personal utopia. As far as they are concerned, the world is their definition of perfect and nothing is bad or wrong. However in reality it is all in their head and the person's body remains in a coma like state until you free them. You cannot use this power against yourself and a person with this power cannot be subjected to it.
summary: The ability to cause someone to believe they are in their personal utopia
strengths: You can cause a person to believe they are in utopia
Non-violent takedowns
weaknesses: It is all in their head.
Victim is placed in a coma

name: Arceusforce: Sky
description: The user of this ability can channel the power of the heavens of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Flying-type. The user's skin turns periwinkle, their irises turn white and pupils turn sky blue. Under their avian guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Flying-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Flying attacks such as Aerial Ace, Drill Peck, Brave Bird, Hurricane and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Flying form.
strengths: The user can resist supernatural combat, insect and plant-based attacks. Immune to earth attacks.
Generation and manipulation of wind and avian aura to use Flying attacks.
The user gains feathered wings to fly like a bird.
weaknesses: The user is weak to electric, mineral and ice-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form
If grounded, the user can be hit by earthen attacks.

name: Karma Manipulation
description: Now, this ability is the ability to manipulate others' karma, that means that you can make good things or bad things happen to someone, for example if someone is good to you, you can just concentrate on good things happening to them, and then they'll like win on dozens of scratch tickets, or if they are bad to you you can think bad things and their car will crash, but they never die, and there are some rules, bad things will only happen to them if they deserve it.
summary: The ability to manipulate other people's karma.
strengths: You can control others karma.
You can reward or punish people who deserve it.
weaknesses: You don't know how it will happen, you can only chose whether it is bad or good.
If they are not bad people, and you try to make bad things happen to them, it will go back onto you.
You cannot change your own karma only other people's.

name: Youth Manipulation
description: This power allows alteration of how old or young a person looks or acts. For example, you could make a ten year old suddenly have an aching back or make yourself 21 for the rest of eternity. You can also subtly change how they think. For example, you can make someone in their 90s slowly over the course of weeks or months think like they did as a toddler.
summary: The ability to change how old or young a person looks or acts
strengths: You can live forever by making your body look the same age constantly.
Using this on an annoying classmate or teacher.
weaknesses: If you can't undo the effects.
If you can't control the effects of this power for some reason.

name: Titanium Scale Skin
description: Your skins changes to chrome Titanium and grows titanium scales all over the body except on the head, hands and feet. A tail with scales might also grow depending on the person but when changing back to human form, the tail disappears. The skin also provides great invunerability and durability. There are also 5 retractable claws on each hand.
summary: The ability to have titanium skin covered with scales
strengths: Enhanced invunerability and durability
Great agility and speed
Claws can slice through anything except for titanium armour
weaknesses: Difficult to learn how to use a tail

name: Calculated Moves
description: When in danger or combat situation, your mind analyzes calculates the surrounding are in a nanosecond or less. You instantly scan the area & opponents & determine the best course of action. From punching physics like how much strength to put in & the damage it will do to throwing something or shooting. Its like you have Terminator eyes to some extent. You won't have different imaging settings like x-ray, night vision or thermal etc. Just split second decision making processor.
summary: The ability to make precise calculated moves in combat
strengths: You're a human strategic super computer
weaknesses: Your mind is the only thing advanced really. No other superhuman attributes.

name: Consequence Manipulation
description: What happens if you didn't study for a test and you  knew you are going to fail? This ability makes your cause "Not studying for a test", and changes the effect "getting an F" to "getting an A". If the consequence is negative like that, you or someone else will suffer another kind of way. This works on your decisions as well. This ability can even negate effects from anyone's actions or decisions. In short, nothing will happen no matter what anyone does.
summary: The ability to manipulate or negate the effects of your or anyone else's actions or decision.
strengths: Able to make positive consequences more enjoyable.
Able to change the effect of your actions.
weaknesses: Might suffer if you change a negative consequence to a positive consequence.
Only works if action or decision has been made.

name: Shadow Controlling
description: Control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people or move poeple if they have shadows on them). You can completely control them, making your range limitless. You are at your strongest at night and your weakest in the middle of the day. Your shadow DOES NOT have to be touching other shadows to control them.
summary: The ability to control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people)
strengths: Can crush people.
Can pick stuff up with an extra set of extendable hands (shadows).
Nearly invincible if you wrap your shadow around yourself.
weaknesses: Your shadow can never be an exact copy of you.
There has to be a little bit of light for anything to throw a shadow
Shadows can follow you around.

name: Power Of The Fruit

Apples give superstrenght, oranges give invulnerability, bananas give elasticity, peaches give flight, pears give superspeed. Must be the real deal, no vitamin supplements or pills etc.

name: Body Armory
description: Using this power you can make every part of your body turn into a different weapon. You can turn your arm into a sword, your leg into a AK-47, your tongue into a Colt... Any limb and any weapon! BUT, the bullets must be made of something, like your bones, and when you shoot a bone bullet on someone it will take time until this bone grows back again. Reload very fast

name: Trait Replication

With this power, you can replicate all of those traits from other people. Also, for physical traits, you could take one persons say, face and body structure and another persons eye, hair, and skin color/tone.

name: Sleep On It
description: You need to study for the big test tomorrow but you have to hit the hay? With this power, all you have to do is put the book you want to gain knowledge from under or on top of your pillow, even in your pillow case is fine, or by using the book as a pillow. If it is the kind of book you need to find the meaning of what the author is trying to say, you'll know it immediately. It'll practically be second nature.

name: Golden Feeling
description: Every time you're feeling happy, exited, love, or any old good feeling, jewels and sheets of gold will emerge from your body on your chest, back, legs, or along your arms. The process is painless, and your skin looks as though the wealth was never there at all once removed. The amount generated depends on the intensity of the positive feeling, and will be continual so long as you are experiencing it.

So, if you try to flick steel, it will break, but you will break a nail and feel pain. To deal with your superior muscle, your skin is harder and is very difficult to pierce (you still feel pain). Your bones can also withstand the pressure of heavy lifting

name: Energy Armor
description: You can create a field of energy around yourself which forms into different kinds of armor, any kind of weapon, or an animal shape around you. If you make a bird shape, then you can fly, and if you're injured badly then the energy will form a shield around you that will heal you. The armor is almost completely invulnerable, and while you're in it then your mind will come out of your body and you will control the armor.

name: Second Thoughts
description: Let's say you were shot by a gun, still awake, and you just want to go back to that last moment and change it! It's sort of like time travel only more limited. You cannot go back thousands of years in the past to change some large event, only a minute is your limit. You will be able to do the same fight with someone countless times, memorizing their every move, feeling no pain after traveling back, eventually winning. A TV villain weakling did this on Batman and won, making a fool of him.

Even the best fall eventually

name: Likeness Control
description: This powers user is able to control any likenesses of themselves such as shadows, reflections, pictures, live video etc. Independently from their true body by locking "eyes" with it. These likenesses can interact fully with the likenesses of alike thing to affect them, such as the user's shadow strangling another man's shadow resulting in the other man's death. Only one likeness may be controlled like this at a time. After you give up control, the likenesses go back to their normal places.

name: One Man Army
description: You'll have the mind of a hardened soldier, the brain of a army technician,the body of a perfect soldier. And with your vast combat skills and creativity you would be able to take down multiple opponents with your knowledge on fighting, creating weapons, defusing bombs, creating bombs and weapons out of simple materials, tactics, pyschology. The army always develops so anything new will instantly be yours. You also have a rank of 5 star general, so you will have the perks they get.

name: Ability Resistance Adaptation

Being attacked again would make you invulnerable to that attack. If your foe decided to attack you a third time, your body would adapt to using it as a fuel, and instead absorb the attack, giving you power and energy. Using it against you again would allow you to harness that ability to an extent.

Another feature of this armor is that when the user of this armor is in danger, the armor will automatically form around the user in armor-mode. Increase your mass and strength using synthetic fibers.
Immunity to the intensities of heat, cold, and various forms of radiation.
weaknesses: Once you metamorphose into your second state, you rely only on instinct.
Be careful not to shoot bone/blood spikes around civilians.
Over using the "growth's" ability could be fatal.

name: Teleplasty
description: You are made of ectoplasm, have no solid body and require no sleep nor food. You can possess practically anything and use that body to live in; you gain all of its abilities, weaknesses and memories.
summary: The ability to control inanimate, organic, mechanical, dead or alive things.
strengths: Pretty much immortal
Can gain a wide variety of abilites and powers
You can be however or whatever you want to be
weaknesses: Must obtain some form or you will cease to exist
Vulnerable to psychic attacks
Can be taken over by stronger spirits

name: Inkheart
description: The ability to read a loud from a book, story, newspaper, something you yourself have written, etc. And make characters and/or objects come to life. By extension, it may be guessed that if the story was about you, and you were say incredibly strong, you might read and make yourself incredibly strong. Based upon the movie called Inkheart.
summary: The ability to read aloud from something written and make the characters or objects from the writing come to life.
strengths: You can write yourself weapons.
You can write yourself an army.
You can write and make yourself better.
weaknesses: You might accidently read yourself a supervillian.
You have to be able to read out loud.
You have to be able to read clearly or the character or object may not come out right.

name: Hyper Sensor Armor
description: A user full control, hyper-neuronsensor silver color metal skin armor that superbly reacts instantly to protect the body from any physical harm through a matter of millisecond.
summary: The ability to instantly protect the body from physical harm by forming a hyper metal armor.
strengths: Bullet proof, chemical, biological, and fire/ice resistant.
Can use other abilities once activated.
weaknesses: Weak against magnetism.
Partial physical exhaustion once deactivated.

name: Life Endowment
description: Allows you to bring any being back to life by touching them. You can't grant life to inanimate objects. There is no limit to the length of time that the being can be dead, though large amounts of decay will make it more difficult and require more concentration, and you will have to pool their decayed substance from other objects. Reviving a leaf ground to dust is nigh impossible unless you collect enough pieces. Reviving someone from bones requires concentration and time, taxing you physically.
summary: The ability to bring beings back to life by touching them
strengths: Don't have to worry about loved ones being killed by supervillans
Find information from deceased persons
There's nothing anyone can do to get rid of someone you need, unless they destroy the body
weaknesses: You can't revive yourself
Very dangerous! Killing someone or something doesn't ensure it is gone
Reviving a jerk will not cure them of jerkiness

name: Stratego
description: You can quickly and accurately develop a strategy for anything. Some examples are board/computer games, daily planning, and fighting against somebody. You know just how to counteract any other strategy ,and can do it precisely. Also, if something does not go according to plan, you can quickly improvise and come out successful.
summary: The ability to make extremely effective strategies for anything
strengths: Best chess player ever
Know how to beat anybody in a fight
You know how to do almost anything where you have to plan
weaknesses: Rules of physics still apply
Even if you know how to beat somebody, you might not be able to
This is a passive power (no direct effect)

name: Negativity Reversal
description: If someone, for example, steals your money, you'll actually gain the amount stolen plus your original amount. If someone attacks you, it will instead fuel your strength and energy. Here's the big one: If someone tried to kill you, instead of dieing, you would gain an extreme amount of power, energy, and it would increase your lifespan by extreme amounts. However, positive effects stay the same.
summary: The ability to reverse effects of any negative effect against you.
strengths: If someone steals your car, you would be rewarded with two new cars.
If someone tried to break your leg, your leg would instead become very flexible.
If someone tries to kill you, you would gain amazing power and have your lifespan greatly increased.
weaknesses: No one else is affected from negatively affecting you. (May not be bad, you decide. )

name: Ability Sponge
description: With this ability, you can gain any power that you're hit by. Struck by Pyrokinesis? Now it's yours. This includes any other superhuman abilities, and while being struck by a power and taking it for your own, it has no effect on you. This means that your also immune to basically every superpower.
summary: The ability to gain any power by being struck by it.
strengths: Immune to all powers
Can become extremely powerful over time
You also gain the user's skill with that ability
weaknesses: Some powers will have negative side-effects
You may never encounter any Superhuman abilities
Immunity only works against Superhuman abilities

name: Metal Mimicry
description: At will, anyone with this ability can become any metal they choose. Gold, silver, bronze, platinum, steel, tin, copper, mercury or any other metal I forgot about. Not only this, you'll have metallic reshaping powers. So, when in the middle of a fight, change your hand into a hammer, sword, wrecking-ball or any other metal based weapon.
summary: The ability to transform into metal.
strengths: You can transform into any metal
You can reshape yourself into anything
Different metals have different uses
weaknesses: Choosing the right metal for any situation will be hard
People might try to kill you for the gold

name: Propriophysical Manipulation
description: This can allow for extremely powerful strikes, immunity to gunfire, faster-than-normal movement, and faster-than-normal travel. Cannot negate any form of energy (fire, lightning, light, etc. ), meaning you still feel some measure of force from projectiles, depending on how much control you possess. Can work on a subatomic level with enough discipline. Cannot break laws of physics, only bend them. It affects the way you interact with physics, not how physics interacts with you.
summary: The ability to control the physics of one's own body.
strengths: Effectively renders you bulletproof.
Vast increases in speed and strength (you can even take a beating).
Affects anything you have. Don't have any bullets? Throw a marble and pierce their Kevlar.
weaknesses: Bigger objects mean more pain. Bullets? Bruises. Grenades? Gashes. Missiles? Broken bones.
Must be consciously activated. If someone is aiming a gun at you and you're not aware of it, goodbye
Control limited to your own body, and pain is still felt.

name: Rope Hand
description: Control a rope that pops out of your hand. You could lose both your hands, but you will gain many more grabbers. The rope will do anything you tell it to do.
summary: The ability to control a rope that comes out of your hand
strengths: Grabbers
Tiers
weaknesses: No hands.

name: Soul Search
description: With this ability, you can look at someone and fully grasp who they are, what they are, what their true intensions are, even if they are full out lying to you or not when you ask them a question. This is also helpful in medical cases, in order to see what ailments plague a person's body. Not only that, but you can also find out your enemies strengths and weaknesses with ease
summary: The ability to analyze a person's soul, spirit, mind, and body
strengths: You can know what a person's true intensions are instantly
You gain a sense of empathy; it's easy for you to understand people
Know who's a friend or an enemy
weaknesses: To read someone's soul/spirit/mind, you have to make eye contact
To read someone's body, you have to make physical contact

name: Instant Invulnerability
description: You can never get hurt or become ill. Never have injury inflicted on you or disease virus infect you. That's because if your body feels there is a threat, you instantly produce an impenetrable aura. Bullets will fall off you, but you might feel the shock, be knocked a little and might interpret pain. You will quickly recover. You lack super strength, endurance and immortality. So, you age normally and will eventually die naturally, though it may take a long time.
summary: The ability to become invulnerable to any harm when in danger
strengths: Never be hurt or get sick
Impervious to harm
weaknesses: You don't have super strength, endurance or immortality
You still feel a little shock, can be knocked by projected weapons and explosions
You will eventually die of old age, but it may take time

name: Rapid Osteological System
description: Your bones are ten times more stronger than normal. Even when great pressure is applied to them, they hold their shape. They become harder, resulting in harder shin kicks to your opponent's face. Your bones grow slower when you are an adult. But they stop growing when you're pretty old. Even when you're 80 years of age, Osteoporosis will be miles away.
summary: The ability to grow, strengthen and repair bones ten times faster.
strengths: Less broken bones
Your bones age less
More strength in hard impacts
weaknesses: They continue to grow until you're around 70 or 80.
They have a little more weight in them.

name: Nanite Symbiote
description: Nanite-Symbiote armor flows around the body like a liquid. The armor consists of billions of nanite-symbiote cells that can change into any shape such as bladed weapons. The cells posses the unique ability to absorb one specific power set based on what they first incounter, ie. Fire, water, radiation, bio-transmutation etc etc. The cells also have the unique ability to deconstruct the wearer and reassemble them later.
summary: The ability to shapeshift your nanite skin and to copy one element of power.
strengths: Customized weaponry to suit the need
Can escape almost any situation
Cells can anticipate damage and deconstruct the area to negate its effects.
weaknesses: No control over what power set the cells originally choose
Cells will eventually bond with the user at a genetic level
Cells are intelligent and run the risk of taking full control

name: Force Mimicry
description: This ability can make a person become a living force. This of course means they will also be visible unlike most real forces are. This will not only give them traits of the force they are mimicking, but also gives them manipulative abilities over the force that they produce. In their force form, they are either intangible or invulnerable, but they can be hurt if presented the the force's natural weakness or anything that could affect it.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become any kind of force.
strengths: Manipulative capability.
Intangible or invulnerable in force form.
weaknesses: Intangible or invulnerable won't work....
....against force's natural weakness or anything that could affect it.

name: Kinetic Duplication
description: The user is able to duplicate his or herself everytime he or she is hit by a force that is half or more than their body weight. The duplication that takes place everytime they are hit cannot be controlled. For example, sometimes one duplicate is produced, or at times twenty duplicates are produced. Each of the duplicates can produce their own set of duplicates when they are hit. Only knocking out the original will get rid of all the duplicates. All the duplicates are controlled by the original.
summary: The ability to duplicate one self every time the user is hit
strengths: Good at multi tasking
Good at distracting someone
Your own army
weaknesses: Number of duplicates cant be controlled

name: Light Wolves
description: The wolves will always be a bright white color and can rip and shred objects and enemies to bits. The wolves can only go a distance of 20 metres or as far as the eye can see whichever is further away. Also, the wolves can ignore the reflective properties of mirrors.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves made of light
strengths: Strong creatures under your control.
The light wolves can harm the wolves created with 'Shadow Wolves'.
weaknesses: Enemies with light manipulation can take control of and/or destroy your wolves.
The light wolves can be harmed by wolves created with 'Shadow Wolves'.

name: Water Resurrection
description: All physical wounds will close,you will come back to life, and your body will be brought back to full stamina when your dead body is fully immersed in water.
summary: The ability to come back to life only when fully immersed in water
strengths: A battle in the ocean.
weaknesses: The older you are the harder it is to find something on dry land that can hold enough water.
This power does not come with Water Adaptation.

name: Dragon Katana
description: (This katana was made from adamantium and bathed in dragons blood) the first is that the wielder Becomes immortal, second is that the wielder gains the power Aura absorption, third is that the wielder Gains dragon skin but without the wings, fourth is that you can summon the dragon of doom, fifth that anyone that is killed by katana becomes part of the katana.
summary: The ability to wield a katana that does five things
strengths: Youre immortal
You have a great weapon
You are a mass murderer
weaknesses: Mythological weapons that includes the spear of destine
If you lose the katana you lose the powers
Linda Tavara version of Aura absorption but without the contact port. You still have to kill them t

name: Metaphysical Mutation
description: The user is able to mutate their metaphysical side. So, their physical self won't experience the change. They will have all the power of a mutated monster but will look normal to the normal eyes. They will appear to have telekinetic abilities but it is just their metaphysical body doing the work. If mastered, the user will be able to evolve metaphysically.
summary: The ability to mutate metaphysically.
strengths: Have the power of a mutated monster
Look normal to most people
Learn to evolve your metaphysical side
weaknesses: Hard to control mutated metaphysically side
Can be seen by people who can sense metaphysical or control metaphysical thing

name: Paralysis Touch
description: Just by touching a part of somebody you can stop them from using their body parts of which is touched. If need be the touched part can temporarily be or fully paralyzed. Can also heal someone of paralysis that you have paralyzed or was born that way
summary: The ability to stop parts or all of somebody just by touch alone
strengths: Can stop someone in thier tracks
Can heal someone of paralysis
Can touch items that can pass on the effect
weaknesses: Takes time for paralysis to start working
Can paralyze yourself if taking on to much of the paralysis when cureing

name: Mass/Density Manipulation
description: With this power, one can control both the mass and density of an object, including themselves. They may apply changes to the whole object or merely parts. Potential effects primarily include changing the size of an object, but one can just as easily make their bones super-dense to resist injury.
summary: The ability to alter an object's mass and density to generate a large array of potential effects.
strengths: Change an object's size via altering mass, density or both.
Alter durability of an object by manipulating density.
Make an object incredibly heavy or incredibly light.
weaknesses: Powers such as Immutability offer defense.
While you can expand existing supplies, you cannot create or duplicate them.
The full potential of this power i difficult to realize without some creativity.

name: Darkness Empowerment
description: A person with this ability will be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when in total darkness. The user will be granted enhanced speed, reflexes, strength,the ability to see in the dark and the ability to blend into the darkness to escape
summary: The ability to be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when the user is in darkness
strengths: Fighting crime at night is no problem at all
weaknesses: No enhanced abilities during the day

name: Empathy Weapon
description: By activating this power, you can imprint a copy of someone's personality on your soul just by looking at them, then create a weapon mimicking a copy of that personality. The strength of the weapon depend on its its strengths and weaknesses, as well as its personality's likes and dislikes. The name of the personality's owner will be inscribed upon the weapon somewhere.
summary: The ability to create a weapon from someone's personality.
strengths: You can use your enemies' personalities against themselves, resulting in a sure kill.
Capturing an enemies personality has a chance to capture their powers in the weapon.
weaknesses: Capturing too many personalities leads to a memory overload...
...meaning that you have to release some every one in a while.

name: Object Fusion
description: You have the ability to fuse any object with your body for as long as you would like.  Through contact with the object and a desire to fuse with it, it will become attached to your body and you will gain control over it.  For example, fusing a gun to your body will allow you to fire it with a mental command.  You can even fuse yourself to objects much larger than yourself, such as vehicles, and still have complete control.  You can separate yourself from an object at any time.
summary: The ability to temporarily fuse objects with your body.
strengths: Modify your body to accomodate any situation.
Take direct control of powerful weapons and vehicles.
Separate yourself at any time.
weaknesses: Many objects would have little use when fused to you.
The number of objects that can be fused with at once is limited by your body's surface area.

name: Captain N's Super Powers
description: Captain N is the character of cartoons about games.  All skills can do video game characters using a joystick can do it to himself the character named Captain N with his Official Nintendo Entertainment System Joysticks. Captain N's weak point is that by using his super powers lot must be recharged for re-use.
summary: The ability to have super powers like the fictional character named Captain N
strengths: You can do any moves and atacks from playable Nintendo Entertainment System videogames moves and atacks.
You can do attacks using your Official Nintendo Entertainment System Zapper Gun
weaknesses: This have a weak point, the wake point is that by using his super powers lot must be recharged for re-use.
This superpower only works with the Official Nintendo Entertainment System Zapper Gun and Official Nintendo Entertainment System Joystick
You can do any moves and atacks from playable Nintendo Entertainment System videogames moves and atacks only.

name: Superhuman Endurance
description: An industrial robot has nothing on a person with Superhuman Endurance. They can run for days, lift weights for days, fight for days, and are no more physically fatigued than when they began.
summary: The ability to never become tired or fatigued
strengths: Become the ultimate marathon man
Win every fight by tiring them out
Get millions in overtime
weaknesses: Can still be hurt
Need to sleep
Are not super-strong, super-fast, etc.

name: Repertoire Of Knowledge
description: If you have this ability, you automatically possess knowledge of a certain skill set or field of study. One may automatically be born with skill in cooking, technology, athletic prowess, how to play a particular game, how to fight, but it usually implies something that one may end up doing in one's lifetime (the knowledge is already present, so when a situation arises, you're prepared); sometimes, the user can psychically scan the collective subconscious to gain new skills and knowledge
summary: The ability to access innate knowledge of skills
strengths: Tests are a breeze
Wondering which wire will defuse the bomb? Now ya know...
Go into a career field requiring your expertise
weaknesses: If your field of knowledge is on a dumb topic
If you're stuck in a situation not pertaining to your knowledge or skill set
If you're nervous, you may forget the knowledge or trip up on certain skills

name: Danger Sense
description: It's not paranoia if they really are out to get you. A person with Danger Sense sometimes develops this mindset. They can tell when something that could potentially harm them is near, like a wet patch of ground, an enemy fist, or even a slightly putrid hamburger. This Danger Sense is usually linked with their reflexes, so they can dodge without looking at the object. However, it cannot be turned off and their reflexes are still human--a bullet will still hit them.
summary: The ability to detect impending harm
strengths: Universal--anything from a fist to bad food
Linked with reflexes
Never being surprised
weaknesses: Reflexes still at human levels
May become a touch paranoid
Unable to be turned off

name: Psionic Field Manipulation
description: WIth this power, you control twelve arms that can be used in any way imaginable. The arms vibrate fast enough to cut through steel and flesh and can also act nimble enough to pick up small objects like coins. They can multitask to perform things such as cooking, typing and making objects. They are also strong enough to support multiple tons and can deflect speeding bullets. Each arm also acts as another limb and can be used to feel your enviroment.
summary: The ability to control twelve psionic arms.
strengths: Do a lot at once
Always know what's around you
weaknesses: Any damage inflicted to the arms affects you both mentally and physically
Each action requires you to think about moving the limb
Any lost arm takes nearly a year to regeneate.

name: Lady Luck
description: Your predecessors have spanned history for over thousands of years. The Greeks called the first and greatest Lady Tyche, and then the second Lady came into power, known to the Romans as Fortuna. The most recent Lady has conferred all her powers to you - and you may use them as you wish. As the current Lady, you are immortal until you pass your powers on to another, and can bestow infinite fortune to yourself and those you favor in a case-by-case basis. Chance means nothing to you.
summary: The ability to be an infinite source of luck.
strengths: Infinite luck!!! Dice games, lotteries, cards, raffles, et cetera - you can make them all succeed.
You may appear wherever some event's outcome depends largely on chance.
Limited immortality in the sense that you don't grow old.
weaknesses: Becoming the Lady turns you into a stunningly beautiful woman. Even if you started out male.
Your limited immortality does not mean you can't be killed.
The luck you grant will fade unless you apply more power. You can't make anything permanently lucky.

name: Ultimate Body
description: If your opinion of the perfect body is one that would make even Aphrodite jealous, this power would give you that body. If your idea of the perfect body is one with infinite dexterity you would get that. This power will give the holder anything that they think is part of their perfect body, but it only applies to the physical body. You only get to use this power once to get your perfect body. Once you use this power you can never again use physically altering powers on yourself ever again.
summary: The ability to have the body that you think of as the perfect body
strengths: You get whatever physical body you want.
Anything physical for your body is up for grabs.
Con: You can't make your body too powerful or your mind will shut down from managing too much power.
weaknesses: Your idea of the perfect body may change later in life.
Other people can change what you look like with powers but you cannot.
Transformation is defined as anything altering what your body looks, feels, sounds, or acts like.

name: Power Of The Ant
description: The user is able to lift up objects 30 times heavier than the user's weight. For example, if you weight 60kg you can lift up 1800kg with this power.
summary: The ability to lift up objects 30 times heavier than your body weight
strengths: Super Human Strength
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: Cant fly

name: Evolutionary Armory
description: Evolution is the best inventor, tinkering with organisms to make powerful toxins, deadly claws, and powerful muscles. An Armory can tap into these adaptations and manifest them on their own body. This allows them to use a bear's claws, a bee's venom, or even a shark's electricity-sensing.
summary: The ability to manifest the natural weapons of any creature
strengths: So much potential
Can even use extinct animal's adaptations
Combine adaptations (claws coated with neurotoxin)
weaknesses: Cannot add too much muscle to body
Cannot actually become the creature
Must be aware of creature and adaptation

name: Blackfire
description: Dark fire is super-heated, close to the heat of the sun. The dark matter (almost like telekinesis) contains it and directs it. It is solid due to the dark matter in it. Can be manipulated into shields/barriers, spikes/bolts, streams and waves. It is super strong but hard to control and keep contained. Has a huge drain on the human body and requires top training and massive self-control.
summary: The ability to generate black fire from the body
strengths: Super-heated to the temp of the sun
Solid as diamond
Extremely powerful
weaknesses: Huge drain on the body, only for high level mutants/heroes
Hard to control and contain due to the heat and dark matter
Due to the power, you are on your own

name: Ultraman
description: Ultraman's power is derived from the distance between his current location and the sun. For example, if he is on Earth, he has superhuman capabilities like super strength, invulnerability, flight, heat vision and super breath. When he is on Mercury, those powers are tripled, on Venus it is double and on Mars his power is reduced to peak human capabilities. His only weakness is iridium, a rare metal on Earth.
summary: The ability to become Ultraman , the ultimate example of a superhero
strengths: Very powerful on Earth
Ultimate symbol of good and justice
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: If transported to another planet far from the sun, will become normal human
Will lose all power when exposed to iridium

name: Goku Evoultion
description: When you are defeated, the foe was stronger than you, so with this power, exactly 5 days after you lose yo become 1 percent stronger than them.
summary: The ability to evolve or become stronger when defeated.
strengths: Become stronger than any opponent!
weaknesses: You can not become stronger than a god, or have the same power level as them.
They would probably become stronger in 5 days........

name: Shadow Wielding
description: A person who has the power of Shadow Wielding can make anything that they can think of, like armor or weapons. However, their power is only full if they are surrounded by darkness and they cannot move while they are activating their ability.
summary: The ability to bend pure darkness into any form or weapon
strengths: To have instant armor and weapons
Enpowered for the whole of the night
Useful in a team
weaknesses: Vulnerable to foes with super speed
Can't be used in daytime
Not useful without a team to guard while power activates

name: Superhuman Strength
description: With this ability, you will have the perfect physique and will be able to lift over a million pounds.  You will be incredibly strong, but will have absolute control over how much strength you're applying.  For the ladies, this ability applies to you too, but you won't look too muscular.
summary: The ability to have extraordinary strength.
strengths: Easily dig a pond in your back yard
Olympic gold medals up the wazoo
You can cash in on your abilities and become wealthy
weaknesses: You have almost no competition, which can be fun

name: Unconscious Force Field
description: With this ability, while you're asleep or unconscious, you generate a field of protection around you which keeps you from harm. Anyone / anything that attempts to harm you will be forced back. Fortunately, it can determine what poses a threat, and what doesn't.
summary: The ability to be protected by an energetic field while asleep / unconscious.
strengths: No one can ambush you while you're 'knocked-out'.
The field is invisible.
This ability never makes mistakes. Ex: Someone waking you up will not be forced back.
weaknesses: Only protects you while you are unconscious.

name: Graphic Deduction
description: This power allows you to holographically see the solution to a problem worked out in front of you. You naturally understand what the holographics are showing you, giving yourself a sort of false super brain by following the solutions the holographics present. The holographic solutions are always correct. Only you can see the holographics produced by this power.
summary: The ability to see the solution to problems holographically.
strengths: The holographics will always show you the correct solutions.
You will naturally understand the holographics.
Even if it's above your natural understandings, such as Quantum Mechanics.
weaknesses: Only you can see the holographics.
You are not super smart, just the answers to problems are given to you (it can't solve conundrums)
If you go blind then this power is useless.

name: God Of War
description: God of War is the ability for one to have all knowledge of all types of physical combat. Wrestling of any kind, any type of martial arts, weapons combat, you name it.
summary: The ability to use any form or style of fighting that has ever existed.
strengths: Heighten reflexes and incredible movement speed.
Knowledge of the highest combat strategies.
Presence.
weaknesses: You're not invincible or anything, you're human and CAN be hurt.
You take playful wrestling with your girlfriend way too far.
Constant butt whooping can be tiring.

name: Nemesis
description:
With this power, you can adapt your powers to be able to fight a particular opponent. To do this, you need to be able to see your target and call out whatever name they are known by, making them your "Nemesis". You instantly gain powers best suited to battle them. 

The moment your Nemesis is defeated and unable to continue fighting, you lose all powers and can declare a new Nemesis.
summary: The ability to gain powers to fight a specific opponent.
strengths: Right powers to stop your nemesis
Versatile
weaknesses: You cannot decide what powers you gain
Cannot declare new Nemesis until they are unable to continue fighting
When Nemesis switches with another person, your powers might not be able to stop the new threat

name: Kinetic Mimicry
description: Kinetic Mimicry is the ability to mimic the kinetic energy contained within anything in your range. This means you can mimic the speed and reflexes of any superspeeder, no matter how fast they are. And you can mimic the strength of any being, human or animal, no matter HOW strong they normally would be over you. And you automatically gain the adaptations needed to survive the power and force you can produce at the time.
summary: The ability to mimic the kinetic energy of anything in your vicinity
strengths: Mimic the fastest beings alive (at the higher levels, combine your speed with theirs)
Mimic the strongest beings alive (at the higher levels, combine your strength with theirs)
At the higher levels, also mimic other movement type abilities (swimming, flight, jumping, etc)
weaknesses: Does not diminish foes's strength or speed
Mimicry is not permanent until the very highest levels
At the lower levels, mimicry limited to things in your range WHICH YOU CAN SEE

name: Solid Regenerative Blood
description: Solid Regenerative Blood not only heals you at a super accelerated rate, but it also makes you quite tough. S. R. B. Makes your skeleton diamond hard, your skin and tissues durable enough to withstand bullets shot from over ten feet, creates a pain cap that allows you to feel only up to a moderate amount of pain and will completely regenerate up to your entire body from a single drop of blood. (biggest chunk regenerates, all other chunks dissolve into goo, wound severity determines heal time)
summary: The ability to regenerate from as little as a single drop of blood
strengths: Makes you tough.
Caps the amount of pain you can feel.
You can fully regenerate from a single drop of blood.
weaknesses: Regenerating from a single drop of blood can takes about a year.
Regenerating lost lims entirely takes about a month, stabs and such take about 5 minutes.
Can not regenerate wound while object remains in wound.

name: Rise Of The Lightning Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a lightning dragon. You can shoot lightning bolts from your mouth, you're super strong, you can fly, you have sharp teeth and claws, you have a deafening roar and very hard armor like scales that cover almost your entire body. In dragon form you are unable to communicate except for in the language of the dragons unless you have the power Dragon Language in which case you have the ability to talk to humans in their language.
summary: The ability to turn into a lightning dragon
strengths: You can turn into a lightning dragon
You have a variety of powers outlined above
weaknesses: You can't speak english

name: Positive Ability Feedback
description: A person with this power can gain any ability they get hit with only to be a better superpower user than anyone whose power they absorbed. The user has the ability to copy any superpower they get hit with. They must experience the power in its totality with their body in order to copy it. Now this is great for weaker powers that don't kill you, but useless for anything that can kill you in one shot. Also the user must be conscious to copy the ability-so no waking up with the ability later.
summary: The ability to copy the powers of other people except make it better at the same time but have to get hit first
strengths: Your version of someone's power is always stronger
Your version of the power also negates most of the cons
You can use several absorbed powers at once and combine powers together
weaknesses: You have to get hit with the ability first and you take all the damage of the ability
You have to be alive and conscious to copy any ability that you get hit with
More powerful and complicated abilities take multiple hits to absorb

name: Deathwrapped Gifts
description: Ever thought about how dying is so useless and time wasting? No, well here's something anyways! D. G is a passive ability that activates when you die. It bring you back to life in your original body! If that wasn't good enough you also receive a side power based on how you met your untimely demise! Por ejemplo, if you got your head cut off for some odd mafia related reason you would gain a power revolving around slicing or separation. Yep, with D. G you'll realy be looking forward to death!
summary: The ability to be reborn with a power related to the way you died in your previous life
strengths: Immortality is always a plus, right?
There are so many different side abilities you could receive. So try and collect them all!
You'll always be reborn in your original body.
weaknesses: You still feel pain.
The power you have in a previous life will always go away when you start the next life.
It's kind of random what power you will get.

name: Ability Introduction
description: With this ability, you can gain any superpower at will. However, you can only have one at a time, and you can't switch to a superpower that you've used before. You can have any ability that you can imagine, EXCEPT Omnipotence, or Omniscience. For example, Telekinesis would be fair game, but if you switched to Super Strength, you would be unable to switch to Telekinesis again.
summary: The ability to switch to different abilities at any time, as long as you've never used them before.
strengths: Multiple options of superpowers, as you can switch to almost any ability at will.
Every ability that you switch to will be a new experience.
weaknesses: Can't switch to a superpower more than once, so your options are lowered.
You should have some way to keep track of the powers that you use.
You can't use Omnipotence, or Omniscience.

name: Serpent's Tongue
description: Every single lie, deceit, trickery, and con you do/tell becomes undetectable.
summary: The ability to lie without being detected.
strengths: People will believe in you, even how unbelievable your lies are.
Easily persuade someone to be sympathetic with you.
Use it to turn the tables around!
weaknesses: It still a lie. That means that every lie you said is fake/untrue
If used too much, you might get used to telling lie.
Could make some situations complicated.

name: Suspended Rebirth
description: Usually used for more powerful beings, if your fatally struck, your body becomes a gelatin cocoon after one hour, inside the cocoon a new body gets created, making you stronger than before. Your soul is also in a suspended state, therefore you have no idea of whats happening outside your cocoon. The only way to destroy someone with this power is to incinerate them.
summary: The ability to regenerate
strengths: New body
More powerful new body
weaknesses: Vulnerable
Can't be left alone.
Takes time to achieve new body.

name: Adaption
description: Your body automatically adapts to any situation. If you're in a dark place for a long time, you get night vision. Stepping into daylight won't hurt because of your body adapting. You gain dense bones after getting in a fight, etc. However, it responds to the body's needs, not the mind's, so you won't get invisibility or camouflage. Also, you can't get rid of any of the adaptions, and you can't control what adaption you'll get for the situation.
summary: The ability to have your body adapt to anything
strengths: Literally ready for most situations
Eventually no weapon or disease can harm you
weaknesses: Can't remove adaption (might have gills, rhino skin, etc)
Can't control what you'll get
Won't respond to mental needs (don't want to be seen, etc)

name: Kinetic Boost
description: When you boost up your energy you can create a speed force and shock-waves your body gets stronger and you get faster.
summary: The ability to boost up your kinetic energy
strengths: Shock waves
Telepotation
Speed force
weaknesses: Some times it may not work if you are tired
It can give you a sugar rush
Can only go is speed force once a day

name: Reading Duplication
description: Some examples, if you were to read a book about gambling, you could go to Vegas and win limitless amounts of money. Or you could read about Someone with super powers and get the powers of that individual
summary: The ability to do or imitate anyone, anything, or any action you read about
strengths: Information grants strength
Can be used to get out of almost any situation or make oneself invincible
Increases intelligence with every use of the power
weaknesses: Powers gained are temporary
Can be rendered useless if blinded or illiterate
All uses of powers must be planned in order to have proper material to read

name: Repulsive Wave
description: This is one of the more unique abilities. A person with Repulsive Wave can create a shockwave from their hands that pushes objects away. This can range from as little as a hard shove or as much as a powerful maelstrom which strips flesh to the bone and sends cars flying for half a mile. This ability can only be produced from your hands.
summary: The ability to produce a directed wave which hurls objects away
strengths: Powerful deterrent
Is directed by your hands
Ranges from 'hard shove' to 'strip flesh'
weaknesses: Need hands to direct wave
May be regarded as menace

name: Lightning Armor
description: The user is able to generate an immensely powerful lightning armor around his or her body. The lightning armor makes lightning attacks almost impossible to hurt the user of this power. The armor also super charges the neural synapses. This means that the user can react faster to danger and push their body to their extreme limits, granting them extreme powers
summary: The ability to generate a lightning armor around his or her body.
strengths: Transonic Speed
Electric-enhanced strength
Immune to electrokinetic users
weaknesses: User may get the feeling nobody can beat them

name: Crystal Generation
description: The crystals generated are clear in color, similar to a diamond, and can be as durable as the generator wishes. They can be formed into weapons or other objects or used to create a bridge etc. The generator may also create an armor around them.
summary: The ability to generate crystals of varying strengths from or around your body.
strengths: You can become pretty much invulnerable to most things if used correctly.
Useful for creating objects that aren't too complicated to use.
weaknesses: Doesn't enhance your physical traits.
Although the crystals are light, they can increase your weight if used too much.

name: Bullet Time
description: When fighting, you can slow down the perception of time making everything slow movement to sped up. You have from a micro-second to a minute of added reflex, agility, & speed as time slows. Countering an attack or dodging. As your time manipulation ends, everything starts to speed up till its normal. You don't have all the power like in the Matrix or 300 & the One, just half. Not super strength or fly. Just a little bending of physic laws.
summary: The ability to manipulate & slow time in combat
strengths: Slo-mo fighting
Added speed & agility of up to a minute
weaknesses: Only have a short time frame of power
Not as powerful as seen in bullet time fighting movies

name: Chance Of Success
description: Increases the probability of your bet successfully becoming true only if you bet on the outcome with the lowest probability of occurring. The outcome is not guaranteed to occur with this power but those with mastery of this power can cause the probability to increase to 50%. Works on any bet that is made with other people. Works on the lowest probability outcome out of a set of outcomes that you are aware of.
summary: The ability to increase probablity if you bet on the outcome with this lowest probability of happening.
strengths: Have a higher chance on winning bets that you would normally lose.
Can be used to make a lot of money.
Can have different effects depending on what is being bet on.
weaknesses: If a bet has two outcomes with equal chance of happening then this power does nothing.
Can only raise probability to 50% so you can still lose.
Only works on the outcome with lowest probability.

name: Tissue Generation And Control.
description: With this power, you can create biological tissues that can give you new or stronger abilities. You can make more muscle tissue to be stronger or can create the tissue of an electric eel's electric organ for biological zapping powers. You can regenerate if you're hurt, but this will require many tissue regenerations. You do have to have bulky arms if you add more muscle tissue. You can however make the created tissues go away at will.
summary: The ability to control and generate biological tissue.
strengths: Don't have to consume water or food.
Can get other creative powers like electric eel organ tissue or bone spikes.
Can be super strong in seconds.
weaknesses: Must have imagination.
Have to be logical, tissues can make energy out of nothing but no super magic or other weird tissue.

name: Gift Of Dionysus
description: You can enchant any body of liquid (within a container, cup, etc., it cannot be directly from the tap). You can turn a regular glass of tap water into an elixir that heals all wounds, a love potion, an invisibility serum, or spike the drinks of others and have an army of slaves. You must be touching the object which contains the liquid, or the liquid itself. The maximum amount of liquid you may enchant is limited by your weight, e.g. if you weighed 100kg, then the limit you may enchant is 100L.
summary: The ability to manipulate and enchant water, or any body of liquid with magical qualities
strengths: Cure diseases. They can also be made to work for a limited time FYI
Make yourself and others smarter, younger, fitter, give them powers even!
An army of eternally loyal slaves to do your bidding
weaknesses: Could get into the wrong hands,
If you give you friends powers, it could corrupt them and they might go on to tell others about you
Use it as many times as you like but the amount you can enchant is limited by your body weight

name: Mobile Invisibility
description: Someone with this power can be invisible, but only while they are moving around. Until the higher levels of this power are reached the holder of this power cannot control whether they become invisible or not while moving around. Automatic functions of the body do not count as movement.
summary: The ability to be invisible while you're moving around
strengths: Can sneak around, but only while moving around.
Makes the whole body invisible regardless of what is moved.
If you have Superhuman Stamina.
weaknesses: Some users can only make the body part they're moving around invisible.
Forgetting that you have to move around for this power to work.

name: Peak Human Potential
description: Also known as peak human physical condition, this is the ability to reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter. This primarily involves the vastness of human feats such as athleticism or combat, with marksmanship included.
summary: The ability to reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter.
strengths: Your strength would be at the pinnacle of human perfection.
You would be able to run and move at speeds superior to those of any Olympic athlete.
Your musculature would be considerably more efficient than that of an average human.
weaknesses: Your strength would not be superhuman.
Your endurance and stamina would be limited.
You would still be susceptible to illness and injury as any normal human is.

name: Lightning Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a large dragon with black scales and yellow eyes from an alternate dimension. The dragon along with being able to fly, being super strong and having sharp teeth, claws and a loud deafening roar, can also shoot lightning bolts out of its mouth. The dragon is under your complete control and you can send him back to its home dimension when you're done with him.
summary: The ability to summon a dragon that shoots lightning bolts out of its mouth
strengths: You can summon a lightning shooting, super strong, sharp toothed, flying dragon
He's under your complete control
weaknesses: If he's killed you loose this power

name: Special Energy Body Repair
description: When a part of your body is damaged, you can create an energy-based version of it. While the original one is healing, you can do normal things again. The energy actually heals that part as long it is injured. This power can repair missing limbs as well. This ability can also do organs as well.
summary: The ability to replace damaged body parts with energy-based ones while the real ones heal.
strengths: It heals your body parts.
You can do normal things while you are still injured.
Does organs as well
weaknesses: None.

name: Realizer
description: You can take any living thing from a game and make it real.
summary: The ability to make any game characters or creatures become real
strengths: Can have an army of minions
Can meet your favorite character
weaknesses: If you don't have control, they can run wild

name: Durable Life Span
description: The person is indestructible to any damage.  He/She can never die from getting shot, stabbed, electrocuted, burned, or even get inflicted with ALL of the diseases in the world. Even when the person gets Radioactively vaporized, the person will rapidly regenerate.  However, there's a difference between being Immortal and having a Durable Life Span. Even though He/She is Indestructible, the person can still age and die from old age.
summary: The ability to be resistant of ANY damage imaginable.
strengths: You are Indestructible to any harm imaginable.
Since you have a longer life span, you age a lot slower. So you can live up from 150 to 310.
weaknesses: You are still susceptible to old age.
Since you are still susceptible to old age, you die of old age.

name: Ambient Empathy
description: Your physical attributes including strength, speed, durability, stamina, and healing will increase depending on how much ambient energy you absorb, e.g. photons, radioactivity, heat, magnetism etc. depending on the user and their experience and will power this ability can be limitless
summary: The ability to increase physical capabilities through interaction with ambient energies
strengths: Easy energy source for enhanced stats
limitless potential even potentially surpassing supermans strength
weaknesses: If not controlled properly, will short circuit electrical devices
Cannot redirect as beams or whatever
Requires a strong mind and training

name: Diamond Shards
description: Someone with this ability can impale several different people with the shards and puncture even the hardest metals on Earth. The power takes small portions of the carbon material already in your body and transmutes them into energy, so the more you use it, the less of your "self" you leave behind.
summary: The ability to shoot diamond-hard bolts of energy.
strengths: Nearly unstoppable energy attack
Impossibly sharp
Can shoot up to 10 shards at one time
weaknesses: The transmutation of the carbon atoms in your body leaves you weak
Takes several days to weeks to recover
Not effective against real diamonds

name: Age Transferral
description: With this power, you can make yourself younger or older by transferring the essence of age to a living thing. Thus, if you touched someone and made yourself a year older, they would become a year younger. It does not need to be a human; it can be any living thing, so you can ripen fruit quickly. This power requires skin-to-skin contact.
summary: The ability to transfer the essence of age between yourself and the environment.
strengths: Keep yourself at the same age for as long as you like.
Help the elderly and those with ageing disorders, as long as you have a source of youth.
You can absorb youth in a harmless way, such as by ripening fruit.
weaknesses: You need a source of youth to stay or become young.
Ageing is useless against immortals.
Requires touch.

name: Momentum Killer
description:
The ability to stop the movement of everything around you within a five-yard radius for a few seconds, including yourself. After the few seconds in which all movement is frozen, momentum is stopped and gravity takes effect. 

An example: a bullet is stopped in midair. After a few seconds in which everything is stopped, gravity kicks in and they fall to the ground. 

It can only be used for 10 seconds consecutively and then requires a 5 second cooldown.
summary: The ability to stop movement of everything around you, including you.
strengths: Can block bullets and drop them to the ground around you
Fire can be put out by stopping the vibration of molecules
Can be used to break a fall
weaknesses: Only lasts for 10 seconds, and needs a cooldown
You can't move while you use it

name: Layer Reinforcement
description: With this power, you can make anything harder up to the level of diamonds. You can selectively make only some parts be hard as well. Hardened objects are the same weight as before, but are deceptively more durable. The hard properties are only on the surface. Hardened liquids/gases stay on the surface they were originally on so you can create non-moving barriers of air or water. Also you can throw hardened air as projectiles or trap people in a hardened bubble of water or a cube of air.
