summary: The ability to make anything harder up to the level of diamonds without losing mobility
strengths: Iron body that is not heavy
You can harden air to walk on or create a barrier
You can reinforce your blunt force weapons
weaknesses: Hardened objects allow light and other particles to pass through(can be good or bad)
Can be mistaken as mimesis

name: Superhuman Durability
description: People have dreamt of Superhuman Durability ever since the Grecian age. A person with Superhuman Durability can withstand an I-beam being dropped on them with minor bruises, a knife with superficial cuts, and a bullet will only penetrate their skin. They are not invunerable (they can still be hurt), and they possess no other superhuman attributes.
summary: The ability to possess a superhuman resistance to damage
strengths: Things hurt less
Take less physical damage
Resistant to corrosives, burning, etc.
weaknesses: Not totally invunerable
No other superhuman attributes
Surgery

name: Inclusion
description: This power is virtualy the polar opposite of exemptedness because instead of exemp yourself you can include yourself in things. For example if youre enemy is attacking you and theres protection near include yourself in it. This also allows you to include yourself in information, people using their beneficial powers on a group and more. You can even stop yourself from dying by including yourself in a persons youth or the fact that they are not dead.
summary: The ability to include yourself in things.
strengths: Include yourself to a group or certain access.
Many different uses.
Include yourself in a person's list of trusted people.
weaknesses: If there is nothing to be included in.
Not much protection to be included in when confronted with high level powers.
Can't include yourself in a persons protection powers.

name: Creature Cloner
description: With this power you can clone any mythical creature/monster/cryptid. The clone will look exactly like the real thing but be under your control and only have half the strength/power on the real thing. You can only clone monsters that you've either seen in real life or seen a picture of.
summary: The ability to clone any mythical creature
strengths: You can clone any creature
The clone is under your control
You can summon and unsummon the clone whenever you want
weaknesses: The clones have only half the strength/power of the real deal
You can only clone creatures that you've either seen ir real life or some sort of depiction of

name: Mind Hopping
description:
Used as a reconnaissance ability, Mind hopping allows the user to transfer their mind to anyone within their line of sight. They essentially 'piggy back' on another's consciousness; they can see/hear/think what the host does, but the host is unaware. From this host, the user can 'hop' to another individual in line of sight, and so span great distances. 

To get back to their own mind, however, they need to 'hop' back via line of sight, and their body is left vulnerable while their mind is away.
summary: The ability to transfer your consciousness from one individual to another.
strengths: Gain information about people and places some distance away, even people's thoughts.
Suggestive influence whilst inhabiting a mind.
Be able to enter the deepest rings of an organisation completely undetected.
weaknesses: Body left vulnerable by absence. Can be overcome by hiding, but...
Difficult to get back to body, as sight is needed. Could have a partner to 'bring mind' back to you.
If someone you are inhabiting dies, you die.

name: Light Condense
description: Condense the surrounding light into a near indestructible object. You could create armour, sheilds and weapons. You can also use it to make walls, boxes and other helpful objects. Light objects can be warped to bend or twist. You can also condense the light in a room to a small object, effectively removing the light.
summary: The ability to condense light into solid matter
strengths: Always have a weapon ready.
You can put your enemys into darkness.
weaknesses: Would not be as effective at night.
If you tryed to condense light outside you could condense the sun creating a black hole

name: An Old Soul
description: This power lets you call upon and gain the strength and wisdom of all your ancestors when they were at their peak. You wouldn't even need to know about the ancestor, you can/will automatically get it..
summary: The ability to gain all of the strength and wisdom of your dead ancestors!
strengths: Super strength!
Super smart!
You get to know your ancestors
weaknesses: You'll have the memories of your ancestors. (good and bad ones).
Your ancestors don't get to know you

name: Genre Mimicry
description: Here is how this ability. The user watches a action movie. With this ability, the user becomes more a action hero. Depending on what genre they watch or read, the user can acquire powers that comes with the genre form. The person even changes clothes and personalities to fit the genre.
summary: The ability to become a different version of oneself based off a kind of genre.
strengths: Become a new you
Gain new powers
weaknesses: Won't work if have not seen a certain genre before

name: Projective Time Freezing
description: A person with this power has the ability to freeze time while astro projecting themselves. This makes them a great scout since they can see ahead while prevent anything from happening while they were out. You can go through all walls except for lead walls. You can also use subliminal messaging by whispering while in astral form. You can also hit normally intangible objects while in astal form. Their is no limit to your range, except you cannot enter/exit lead rooms and radiation still hurts you.
summary: The ability to astrally project while simultaneously freezing time until you return to your body
strengths: Almost perfect ghost buster--ghos's are frozen in time while you are free to attack
Can't be attacked and you can scout ahead or think of a plan while time is frozen
No time limit and you do not age when astral projected.
weaknesses: Can't attack other people unless they are a ghost/intangible
If you become distracted and time is forever stopped
Can't exit out of lead rooms

name: Containment Field
description: Got a highly flammable material or radioactive waste? Do you fear accidents happening? Fear no more! This power will create a forcefield that will not let anything out until the user decides the field is unneeded. Limits on field is it can be no bigger than a 1 kilometre radius and no smaller than a 3 centimetre radius.
summary: The ability to create a forcefield that lets nothing out
strengths: Anything can get in, nothing can get out (also a con).
Field stays up until user does not need the field.
Can move the field as needed.
weaknesses: Have to be able to control objects you summon
Anything can get in, nothing can get out (also a pro).
Enemies with Barrier Defiance or Barrier Melting.

name: Mental Hands
description: The hands can pick things up and toss them, vibrate at a high velocity and cut through anything. You can also push them into the ground to jump high. Your hands have a limited range (in meters), the range varies from person to person, some have a two meter range, others have an eleven meter range. Your hands are also limited to a certain number. You can get more with practice. From time to time your hands may become uncontrollable and might kill someone or cut something you don't want to cut.
summary: The ability to have transparent hands that can come out of your body and grab objects
strengths: Can amputate anything
Pick up anything
Can push into the ground to jump high
weaknesses: Having a range
Having a certain number of hands
Can't control hands at times

name: Selective Fusion
description: This ability allows you to take the best of one thing, and fuse it with the best of something else. For example, you could fuse a lightbulb and gun to make a light ray. It even works on people and animals. Any creatures you create are under your limited control. When you fuse two people, one of them will have main control over the body, while the other will be a voice in their head. If the people have superpowers, those will fuse too. You can also fuse things with yourself.
summary: The ability to fuse anything together.
strengths: You can fuse together almost anything
You have limited control over any creatures you create
You can fuse things with yourself
weaknesses: Some fusions might look disgusting
Some things can't be fused

name: Metalworks
description: You've probably seen the T-1000 in the Terminator movies--this ability is very similar.  You have the power to morph parts of your body into solid or liquid metal.  You can target specific areas of your body, or you can transform your entire body.  While you can always return to your normal self, the morphed parts of yourself will become a tough metallic substance. Because of the nature of this power, you will have rapid healing abilities in the event of cuts or puncture wounds.
summary: The ability to transform your body into solid or liquid metal.
strengths: If you're ever shot or stabbed, you can just morph the wound closed
You're tough as hell, and people won't want to mess with you
Mophing into an air glider and jumping off a cliff
weaknesses: Transformed parts of your body change to metal only
You can't alter your overall size
For guys, some of the ladies might be a little freaked out

name: Ergo  Ecosynthesis
description: Like photosynthesis, the user absorbs the elemental energies of nature around them. The  user's body is capable of combining the absorbed energies to enhance other forms of energy in the user, like their heat or kinetic energy. The user can also shoot the absorbed energy to enhance other external energies and those of other people's powers.
summary: The ability to absorb elemental energy and use it to enhance other energies.
strengths: Enhance the energies inside you
Enhance external energies
Enhance other people's power
weaknesses: Can't absorb man-made energies.
Difficult to absorb elemental energies produced by another being.

name: Student Of Power
description: Anyone who has a power must have a method to control it. If someone with this power learned what that method was they would be able to use that power. When a power is learned the users eyes flash orange.
summary: The ability to learn the powers of others
strengths: Knowledge to you would be power!
Gain multiple powers
weaknesses: People might not tell you their methods
Involuntary powers like healing are out of reach
Some powers are harder to learn than others

name: Hunger
description: A person with this power can absorb any properties of objects in their surrounding area. The user then stores what they absorbed inside a special organ in their body waiting for use. The absorption proses would look like a blur in the air coming from the drained object to the user. If the object is visible than you will see shards of the object instead of the blur. If the user absorbed too much then the excess will be ejected in bolts of plasma.
summary: The ability to absorb the essense of any objects in your surrounding area.
strengths: You can use and control the absorbed essense like a kenisis power.
Absorbing is permenent.
It is lethal when used on another person.
weaknesses: Can only absorb so much essence.
Can not only use on one thing in your surroundings.

name: Size Manipulation
description: This ability allows you to make things larger or smaller with your mind. You can shrink to fit into small spaces or grow to destroy things. You can make projectiles you throw large at the last second or shrink things thrown at you to make them insignificant. You can even make food larger to have giant feasts. Unfortunately, when you make things smaller (including yourself), they're quite vulnerable and are likely to be destroyed.
summary: The ability to change the size of yourself and objects around you
strengths: Shrink to fit into small spaces
Make things bigger to make them more powerful
Shrink projectiles to make them insignificant
weaknesses: Things are more vulnerable when small

name: Chameleonism
description: You can change your colour, shape or power to the shape/colour/power of what you are touching when you activate your power.
summary: The ability to copy a colour, picture or superpower onto/into your body.
strengths: You can get the looks or power of anyone you touch.
You can disguise yourself.
You can make yourself so good-looking that girls/guys swoon for you.
weaknesses: You have hardly any control over a power you copy.
You cannot change back after 24 hours.

name: Pain Suppression
description: There are two form of this power: the first form is the superpower to suppress pain at will like Noh-Varr. The second variation is the inability to feel any pain at all like Darkman. Both deliver the same results which makes them two variations of one power and each counts as a superpower. Characters with this power have fortitude beyond even peak human levels that make them superhuman. Torture doesn't effect them, they can withstand attacks, keep fighting when pain would stop normals, and more.
summary: The ability to inhibit pain at will or the inability to feel pain.
strengths: Freedom from pain.
Combat advantages.
Characters seem (but aren't) invulnerable
weaknesses: Characters with the second form could be unaware of greivous injuries.
Characters could accidentally injure themselves.
Characters with the second variation might not be able to feel anything.

name: Devil's Cards
description: Show people you're not messing around. Any cards around you will come to your side. Their edges turn to razor blades that can cut through steel, but unless the person is evil, people will only feel a scratch. This power is awesome when fighting against tricky villains.
summary: The ability to control cards at your will, turning their edges into a razor-sharp blade
strengths: Cards will always come to you, no matter what
Great power to kill tricky villains
Useful when cutting through villains' secret lairs
weaknesses: None

name: Energy Saver
description: You're able to absorb energy, either ambient or energy that's directed towards you, and use it in the form of a concussive blast. You're also able to store energy, increasing strength and recuperative ability as well as giving you a measure of invulnerability.
summary: The ability to absorb energy to use as a concussive blast or store it to increase strength
strengths: Increases strength
weaknesses: The energy will soon wear off

name: Needed Creation
description: The user can create any thing from ammo to the biggest building. However there is a catch, for the objects to keep existing the must be used. With more practice the user can "set" the rate of usage before the object fades away.
summary: The ability to create things as long they are needed
strengths: Quick, disposable, untraceable weaponry and shelter
Anything, even people, can be created
Create your own world
weaknesses: The people that you create do not count as "users" making your own world
Thing that you create then, forget they exist eventualy will cease existing
Enemys DO count as users

name: Physical Wealth Generation
description: Upon the acquisition of this power the user becomes capable of transmuting any "Disposable"(Skin, hair, nails,tears, etc) part or product of their body into priceless materials such as gold , silver, or diamond. Once transmuted these materials will fall off and any the body regenerates. This shedding does not have to occur immediately and the user may keep the transmuted parts on the body while they retain their original properties. Once developed the shed materials may be concentrated mentally.
summary: The ability to create an endless supply of valuable materials from ones body.
strengths: Being your own personal goldmine is a good way to make money.
At higher levels you can "Shed" materials such as platinum, iridium, or pure oil.
Psychically concentrate the materials into a convenient form(e.g. shed gold skin into gold bars).
weaknesses: No instantaneous regeneration until developed. NCN
There are relatively few direct combat applications.
The selection of materials is limited until further developed. NCN

name: Gravity Mimicry
description: Other gravity power permit you to control it but this one allows you to transform your body into gravity. You can draw objects to yourself and control gravity in the area. You can also drastically increase the gravity near you to crush physical matter and people.
summary: The ability to transform into a form of pure gravity.
strengths: Become gravity.
Crush foes.
weaknesses: Powers that reduce gravity or make you immune to it.

name: Perfect Gifter
description: Your mom's birthday coming up? Your one year anniversary with your girlfriend? And you have no idea what to get them. Now you will, with this power you will know exactly what they want or need and you'll also have the means to get it. For instance your girlfriend want some tickets to a sold out concert for her birthday you will suddenly win a radio concert to get them. Or if your mom wants a new car for her birthday you will find out that you inherited one from your deceased second cousin in law
summary: The ability to know what people want and be able to get it for them
strengths: You will always know what somebody wants for a special occasion and then be able to get it
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Self Projection
description: This power lets you take a force or energy in your body such as bioelectricity or lifeforce and project it on to something else or mold it. If you generated magic energy you could use it. This power even allows you to project and shape emotions to use in combat even if you are not feeling them at the time. This power also allows you to take an energy that has gone into your body and project it out such as defending against magic attacks.
summary: The ability to mold and project any force or energy in your body
strengths: Project out anger for a good offense.
Use lifeforce to heal.
Protect against attacks.
weaknesses: Can only defend against so much energy directed at you.
Does not work on death or kinetic energy.
Cons unaffected by con negation.

name: Blessed And Damned
description: Blessed and Damned is when the user can control luck like a type of reality manipulation. The user can make luck go good or bad but this power doesn't hurt the user. Like if a killer was trying to kill the user and throws the user out of window the users eyes will turn white(good luck)and the wind current will get strong enough to blow the user somewhere safe. Or the users eyes will turn black(bad luck)and the attacker will be harmed by a random force. The user has no choice in how the luck work
summary: The ability to manipulate luck through the eyes
strengths: Anything the user wants
Lucky
Keeps the user or anybody the user wants to be safe
weaknesses: No choice how the luck works
Tampering with reality
Make work in positive way or negative

name: Personifying
description: The ability to turn into the personification of anything like, death, probability, life, and hate. You've got to be creative.
summary: The ability to turn into the personification of anything.
strengths: Get the powers of what you turn into.
this is one of the best super powers on this website
weaknesses: You don't know what the personification of something might be

name: Excalibanana Summon
description: Ever got in a fight and wished you had a weapon? With excalibanana summon, you can summon excalibanana, a magic bannana that gives its user super strength to slap people with. You have super strength to, so you can knock someone out with the bannana. And you can summon it anywhere!
summary: The ability to summon a excalibanana
strengths: Summon excalibanna anywhere
Slap people with a bannana
Use super strength slap
weaknesses: It still is a bannana
People will laugh at you
Your enemy can eat excallibannana

name: Offensive Defense
description: With this ability, you gain an offensive superpower for an offensive situation. For example, if someone tried to attack you, you might gain Telekinetic Blasting, Pyrokinesis, Super-Strength, or any other power which could be used to harm the attacker. Once you gain this ability, you will know which ability you have gained. However, it only lasts until moments after the attack / offensive situation.
summary: The ability to gain a random offensive superpower in an offensive situation.
strengths: Gain a superpower for every offensive problem.
You know which superpower you have gained automatically.
weaknesses: The ability lasts until moments after the offensive situation.
You can only gain offensive abilities. (Super-strength, Pyrokinesis, etc. )

name: Metabolic Immortality
description: This power (also called Metabolic Continuation) makes the user's metabolism (as well as the user themselves due to it) immortal. As long as the nutrients that would normally be needed are gained the user is immortal(Recovers from all illness quickly, never ages, etc). In addition the users metabolism keeps them slim and healthy by utilizing any extra nutrients in the users body. In case the user would be going without nutrients for a time they can consume a large amount and it will be stored up.
summary: The ability to be efectively immortal as long as your body takes in the neccesary nutrients it would normally need.
strengths: Gain immortality(as well as slimness and orther metabolic benefits.
Recover from ANY normal biological ailment quickly(as well as other abnormal biological ones).
You can consume huge amounts of food and water to continue the immortality for long periods of time.
weaknesses: Recovering from abnormal biological ailments takes longer than normal ones.
Even if you consume lots of food and water you still need oxygen constantly.
If you don't gain nutrients regularly then the immortality fails(counteracted by third pro).

name: Security Zone
description: Creates a zone that increases the protection of those inside. Security and protection systems of any type, including alarms, safes, armors, and prisons, become more effective the longer they are within the zone. Security officers and guards will also have their effectiveness increased, even to the point of having super powers, as long as they correctly do their job. Also, it becomes easier to create security and protection systems. Finally, laws are easier to enforce.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes protection.
strengths: Increase effectiveness of Security and Protection systems.
Security officers and guards are empowered and can enforce laws easier.
Easier to create security and protection systems.
weaknesses: Others can create security systems to keep you out of areas within the zone.
Dangerous to break any laws.
Some security systems could break down once the zone is removed.

name: Power Control
description: With this ability, you can manipulate the strength of super powers, including your own. You can dampen powers rendering them useless, or you can maximize powers to a point in which they cannot possibly become any stronger.
summary: The ability to manipulate the strength of super-powers.
strengths: Maximize the powers of anyone.
Dampen superpowers, rendering them useless and uneffective.
Give yourself a super-charge to your powers.
weaknesses: Does not work on natural human abilities, unless they are boosted by superpowers. (ex: strength)
You may cause someone to lose their superpowers if you dampen them too much.
Maximizing someone's powers could make them more controllable, but they will still be dangerous.

name: Sleep Manipulation
description: This is a neat little ability to have. With just a look or a touch, a Sleeper can put someone to sleep, controlling how long they sleep and how deep they sleep. With some practice, they might be able to cause someone to sleep-walk, totally controlling their actions while asleep. But there is a flipside. Sleepers can also control there own sleep, and will wake completely recharged no matter how long they've slept.
summary: The ability to control sleep
strengths: You can totally control sleep
Always wake up recharged
weaknesses: Without control, this ability could be dangerous

name: Skill Theft
description: Most people have to devote years of their lives to master a skill; a Skill Thief needs half a second. By touching a person, they can take one of their skills-cooking, plumbing, martial arts-and use it for themselves. The target no longer has that skill. This requires touch, an idea of what to steal, and does not work on superhuman skills.
summary: The ability to steal the applied skills of others by touch
strengths: Become a plumber, neurosurgeon, black belt, etc.
Target no longer has skills
Given enough time, can become a master at everything
weaknesses: Must touch
Must have an idea of what to steal
Doesn't work on superhuman skills

name: Miracle Worker
description: This ability allows you to perform one miracle or impossibility a day. Your miracle is by definition bounds by no laws, so you can literally do anything, but only once a day. Any miracles affecting yourself will be undone by the activation of another miracle on yourself.
summary: The ability to preform 1 miracle or impossibility a day
strengths: Miracles can do anything
weaknesses: 1 miracle a day
Only 1 miracles can affect you at a time

name: Meridian Electrocution
description: Pressure point assault with the lightest touch anywhere on their body.
summary: The ability to deliver massive natural energy to a person in their acupunture meridians by touching them anywhere.
strengths: Effortless martial art kills.
Heal, paralyze and cripple with complete Dim Mak power.
weaknesses: Must touch the person.

name: Sticker Enhancement
description: With this power the user may alter a persons mood or abilities by placing a sticker on their body. Different types of stickers cause different effects. Animal stickers convey animal traits to a person such as enhanced strength, gills, or a mucus membrane. Item sticker convey skill with that item, such as a race-car making them a good diver. Smiley faces and the like change a persons mood. Abstract shapes are a wild card and you will not be able to predict what they will do.
summary: The ability to make someone take on the properties of any sticker you stick to them.
strengths: Give away powers and skills.
weaknesses: Only one stickers effect can be applyed at a time.
You must physically place the sticker on the person.
The effect only lasts until the sticker is removed.

name: Ignorance Invulnerability
description: This power makes you immune to any attack or deadly condition you can't see. Bullets, super fast punches, anything invisible, diseases, poisoned drinks, disguised explosive devices of any kind and other such assaults. What will hurt you is anything slow enough to see-an arrow,a throwing knife. A labeled canister of poison gas, a device that is clearly an bomb, or someone who is obviously contagious with a virus will nullify your invulnerability.
summary: The ability to be immune to anything you can't see with your own eyes.
strengths: If you had a power to replace regular eyesight nothing might affect you
The strongest invisible villain can punch you--you won't feel a thing.
You can find all the deadly traps for your friends
weaknesses: A substitute vision power may not be good as regular vision.
If you couldn't move and a big strong and slow villain is about to punch you

name: Bionic Skeleton
description: With this power it means your skeleton can never be destroyed. So you'll never break a bone and you can bash your skull against enemies without hurting yourself.
summary: The ability to have an indestructible skeleton.
strengths: never break a bone.
impress your friends that you can smash your head against wall without being hurt
weaknesses: you'll never get a cast when all your friends have one

name: Newton's First Law
description: An object in motion stays in motion and an object in rest stays at rest unless acted upon by an outside force. This means you can either make an object continually repeat any action it has done or make it stop its actions completely for a moment with this power. When the object has a large force applied to it, the object will break out of being continuous or paused. Takes a larger force to get a person out of being paused than to get out of being continuous.
summary: The ability to make objects continuous or paused.
strengths: Objects will repeat the last action they did continually.
Can pause an object to halt what it is doing for a moment and come to a rest.
Multiple objects can be made continuous or paused.
weaknesses: If a person is paused too long they will die from their heart not moving.
Harder to break objects out of being continuous or paused the larger the object is.
Things can be removed from being paused or continuous by other people even if you dont want them to.

name: Hypnotic Voice
description: With this power, you have the power of strong suggestion over a person or people. When you speak, they will instantly enter into a deep trance & you almost have complete control over them. Its only suggestive though & if the person has a strong will, they can resist & come out of the trance. Also it takes great focus to control a lot of people & you have to snap the person or crowd out of the trance when you are done unless you make them a sleeper. They will not remember anything afterwards.
summary: The ability to hypnotise a person or a group of people when you talk
strengths: Great power of suggestion over a person or crowd
Can turn them into a sleeper agent & use them when you need to
weaknesses: Need a  lot of concentration when controlling a crowd
If they have a strong will the can resist & reject being hypnotised
You have to bring them out of the trance once you're done

name: Reality Frequency Boost
description: With this ability, the user can be in the same reality as normal people but in a universal view, they are on a different frequency of reality. One example of this ability would be if the user ran, the user would think they are really running. When someone sees them running, to them, it appears that they are teleporting. Another example is the user's durability becomes invulnerability because their body is outside earthly boundaries.
summary: The ability to have supernatural physical attributes by being on a different frequency of reality.
strengths: Supernatural physical attributes.
weaknesses: Hard to live normally.

name: Adaptive Strength
description: With this ability, the user will match the strength of whatever is being thrown the users way (the force of a grenade, the strength of a punch, ect) with the addition of the users current base strength, there would be a high resistance to all types of physical attacks.
summary: The ability to gain super strength
strengths: Once adapted, the user would be stronger than the opponent
The user would stay superhuman until they stopped and rested
Would have a choice of becoming good or evil
weaknesses: This power is non passive (doesnt work unless the user is aware and makes the choice)
Could become to powerful for the users own good
Once the user stops and rests, they could pass out or slip into a coma

name: Chemical Invulnerability
description: With this power, you become invulnerable to chemical damage. Beneficial chemical reaction are unhindered, but negative ones are prevented. This effectively provides total immunity to poisons, any type of venom, acid burns, damage from a strong base and corrosion. It also cancels the negative effects of oxidants and provides immunity to most dangerous forms of radiation.
summary: The ability to be impervious to chemical damage of any kind.
strengths: Phenylketonuria is now irrelevant.
Dumped in a vat of acid? No problem.
No poison or venom in the world can affect you.
weaknesses: Anesthetics and most medications no longer work on you.
Certain types of medical examinations cannot work on you.
Supernatural chemistry is unhindered; normalization fluid will still knock out your powers.

name: Arcana 16: The Tower
description: Select one power, skill or ability you possess (Such as skill at writing or ability to throw fireballs). Over the course of several days, you will slowly lose this power or skill. After a few days without it, you will slowly regain your lost ability or skill, except the potential strength or finesse of the ability will have increased. You will still need to practice in order to reach the new skill level.
summary: The ability to destroy and reform skills or powers.
strengths: Able to slowly increase the power of any of your other abilities.
Works on mundane skills as well as superpowers.
weaknesses: You lose access to the power for the duration.
This power requires a great deal of time to function.

name: The Star Warrior
description: The user calls down a shower of stars to create an armor of astral energy around the user. When the armor is completed, the user can shoot star blasts from their hands and fly. Since it's made of star energy, the armor is very hot and will go out if the user enters (enough) water (long enough). The armor gives super strength and boosts speed. This must take place at night, though the armor can last in day time.
summary: The ability to create an armor of stars around the user
strengths: Gives power over star energy
Flight
Strength and speed boost
weaknesses: Goes out in water
Can only be used at night
Can burn people or things without wanting to

name: Illusion Creation
description: Depending on how strong the illusion is it usually will just go right through you. But with this ability simple focusing on an illusion causes it to become real. No matter what illusion it is you can make it real. You can not reverse this process.
summary: The ability to make illusions real
strengths: If you're an illusionist you'd be super powerful
This power works on all illusions
weaknesses: Useless against a illusionist
Can't be reversed

name: Kinetic Absorption
description: A person with Kinetic Absorption has one of the most useful abilities. They can selectively absorb kinetic energy--the energy that moving objects have--and use it for themselves. This means if they get hit with 500 pounds of force, not only will they be unharmed, but they can throw a punch with 500 pounds of force immediately afterwards. They can only use as much kinetic energy as they have stored, they can be overloaded (1,000,000,000 pounds), and they have to think about the ability to use it.
summary: The ability to absorb and store kinetic energy
strengths: Cannot be hurt when using
Able to use energy you've stored
Versatile
weaknesses: Must think about ability to use
Cannot absorb other forms of energy
Can be overloaded

name: Weight In Gold
description: With this power, you can turn objects or people into their weight in gold.
summary: The ability to turn items into their weight in gold
strengths: You'll be rich
weaknesses: Once you turn something into its weight in gold, you can't turn it back

name: Bestial Seasonal Manifestation
description: This ability allows you to invoke the four seasons as bestial physical manifestations. Summer would manifest as a large big cat with a bizzare coat and long slender body. Autumn would take on the form of a large golden brown stag with menacing antlers. Winter would manifest as a large white owl with scalloped wings. Spring would manifest as a massive scarlet butterfly capable of draining its victims of their life force. You can acquire their attributes as well as strength.
summary: The ability to summon physical manifestations of each season.
strengths: Capable of drawing strength and power from the seasons.
Each manifestation's power grows by tenfold in its orginal season.
Summoning one or all four seasons is optional.
weaknesses: Must concentrate to control all four seasons.
Still vulnerable.

name: Telepathic Healing
description: By using telepathy, you are able to control the brain of others into stimulating the body systems into the healing process. Also, through such ability, you can control the hormones, chemical mediators and cells of organic beings as an offensive form of the power.
summary: The ability to stimulate the brain's function to speed up healing.
strengths: Heal any form of injury.
You would be able to know which part of the body needs the most healing
Can heal multiple victims within psionic range
weaknesses: Tends to shorten life span of patients because of increased cellular regeneration.
The more victims and injuries, the greater concentration is needed.
Creates great fatigue to the user of such power.

name: Accurate Fists
description: A person with this power has fists that literally cannot be dodged and is always accurate. This manifests as an extra insurance attack that always hits the target. Even if a person dodges the blow they will still get hit by the force of the blow. In addition the user does not need to aim punches. If it is thrown into a general direction the intended target will be hit. In addition if you aimed at the head and actually hit some other part both parts will have been hit.
summary: The ability to have fists that cannot be dodged and will always hit the intended target
strengths: If people move out of the way they will still get hit by the force of your punch regardless
Instant accuracy--no need to aim punches only throw in a general direction
Can instantly flurry someone
weaknesses: Punch can still be defended against with armor etc.
Is only strong as your actual strength
There are power that can dodge this

name: Fissure Weak Point
description: This ability applies to anything except God, water, or intangible things. The user gives anything a supernatural crack on them to point out their physical weakness. One hit will cause the entire thing to bust like a vase. For living things, the same thing happens to them, but, unlike objects, they can be restored. When a living thing gets a weak point, they will be stunned. Only the strong will not be stunned.
summary: The ability to give someone/thing a weak point that is in a form of a crack or a fissure on them.
strengths: Anything physical will have a weak point.
Invulnerability is useless to this power.
Stun weak enemies.
weaknesses: Doesn't effect God, water, or intangible things.

name: Alter Ego Transformation
description: With a phrase (or just a word), you can transform into a hero/heroine, complete with transformation sequence, change of costume (sometimes other changes in appearance may occur as well) and additional powers. Nobody will be able to recognize you unless you transform right in front of another person, in which case they will be able to tell it is you.
summary: The ability to transform into a super-powered alter ego.
strengths: Gain powers and costume
Cannot be attacked while transforming
Easy to keep secret identity
weaknesses: Phrase, powers and appearance cannot be chosen
Cannot transform without the needed word or key-phrase
Power may be tied to an item which is then needed to transform as well

name: Ability Absorber
description: With this ability, you can absorb an ability from another person who has a special ability. So let's hope you meet a lot of superpowered people
summary: The ability to absorb an ability from anyone who has a special ability.
strengths: You can absorb someone's ability without him/her losing their ability .
You can try a new ability every time you come in contact with another super powered .
weaknesses: Might end up with abilities that you hate.

name: Kinesis Manipulation
description: You can weaken, strengthen, negate or cause temporary malfunctions in any power with -kinesis as part of its name, including this one. The range of this power is 500 feet. You have to see your target and know that he has a power that can be controlled.
summary: The ability to control any -kinesis power.
strengths: Strengthen the telekinesis of an ally.
Stop a pyrokinetic foe.
weaknesses: This power stops working beyond 500 feet.
You have to know someone has a power you can affect with this power.

name: Power Splitting
description: Say you're surrounded... well, just multiply twice and there's four of you that can multiply, plus the powers you gained off the list. During the multiplication process, your duplicate gets all of your powers PLUS a superpower from the list. So, basically, you can have an army of you with every superpower on this list. Yeah, good luck stopping you.  You can banish your duplicates whenever you want.
summary: The ability to multiply copies of yourself that each gains one of the powers from The Superpower List.
strengths: You become a super army of you
Fun to watch an attractive female with this abilty multiply into many attractive women
weaknesses: Your duplicates gain the powers, not you

name: Confuse Ray
description: The person with this power is able to make a single person or a group of person confused. When his or her enemies are confused, they would either attack themselves or other people. However if the user is trying to confuse a large group, the probability that the enemies would attack themselves or each other is lower.
summary: The ability to make people confused, resulting in them attacking their allies or even themselves
strengths: Good at turning enemies against themselves or their allies
weaknesses: Not that effective against large crowds
People with strong minds or mental powers can break away from it
Cannot directly control the person

name: Diamondification
description: This power lets you become completly industructable, becoming an unknown substance stronger than diamonds.
summary: The ability to turn your body into stone, becoming inpenetrable.
strengths: When stone, you're indestructible
You have amazing strength
You're impervious to magic
weaknesses: You're only indestructible when using your power

name: Life Force
description: You can put your life force in people, literally.You can have their power and basiclly live forever by putting life force into little babies.You can live to be hundreds even a thousands-years-old.And you can put thier life force into something else.
summary: The ability to put yourself into any other persons/thing body
strengths: Be someone else (the girl you like)
"LOOK" at yourself in the mirror(a girl)
Have another power
weaknesses: Poeple may mistake you for someone else

name: Copycatation
description: If challenged by a foe, you can copy all their abilities, including fighting skills and superpowers, and fight them. It is usually still good to protect yourself with tech, but no one can beat you in a one-on-one fight. Combine this with additional abilities and you will always win.
summary: The ability to copy all the abilities of one foe
strengths: Always win in a one-on-one fight.
Effect is permanent until replaced by new abilities.
Superpowers can be copied.
weaknesses: Cannot copy a gun, but can copy invulnerability.
Multiple enemies is a possible serious threat.
Accidentally copying a bad fighter will make you a bad fighter.

name: Dark Field
description: A person with this power is basically the dark Green Lantern. They can make bubbles of dark energy as well as fist, hammers, and so on. The user usually has an object that is the focal point of the power--a ring, necklace, or another object on their person. For more stuff that can be done with it, look up the things Green Lantern can do.
summary: The ability to create force fields and other things from dark energy
strengths: Be a force of darkness
Force fields
The different things it can be used to make are nearly unlimited
weaknesses: Limited by user's willpower
If the item is lost, so is the power
Does not give you the power to manipulate shadows or use them for travel

name: Stealth Rejuvenation
description: A thin aura thread surrounds the body like a cocoon, giving a stealth or camouflage appearance which takes half an hour to revitalize and heal wounds by absorbing all elemental energy in the area.
summary: The ability to heal all injuries and restore stamina by bio-thread aura cocoon.
strengths: No physical or mental side effects upon completion of healing.
Can be use for others by laying hands on the head.
weaknesses: High risk and vulnerability upon discovery by sensor types.
It takes longer time to heal if elemental energy is limited.

name: Atlantean Physiology
description: The atlantean physiology is the physiology  that all Atlanteans have. On the land, the Atlanteans have superstregth as well as invulnerability due to the difference in the pressure between land and the sea. The higher pressure in the sea, makes all Atlanteans stronger on the surface due to the extreme pressure they face under the sea, making their body tougher to hurt on land . In the sea, Atlanteans have the ability to breath underwater. All Atlanteans can also breath on land
summary: The ability to have an atlantean physiology
strengths: Can breath underwater as well as on land
Superstregth
Invulnerability
weaknesses: Under water, Atlanteans have normal strength and is as vulnerable as a normal human being

name: Outnumbered Exponent
description: A person with this power will become stronger the more outnumbered they are. When a person senses hostile presence around them, they can multiply all of their abilities, both natural and supernatural, at a rate exponential to the amount of people facing them. This means that it is very likely that the person with this power can defeat an entire army. Unfortunately, this power requires knowledge of being outnumbered, so it does not work when the user is ambushed.
summary: The ability to have all your natural and supernatural abilities multiplied the more outnumbered you are
strengths: Look badass by beating an army
A million people will have to fight you to the millionth power
You can also hide your strength and do not have to defeat everyone right away-holding fort, etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't work on one on one
If you get ambushed, the power doesn't activate

name: Capsule Transformation
description: You have the ability to transform objects into small portable capsules.   Those capsules have a release trigger that will transform the capsule back to the object in it's original size.
summary: The ability to transform objects into capsules that can be transformed back
strengths: You can capsulate your weapon, car, house and carry it in your pocket
No matter the weight of the object, the weight of the capsule is always low
You can carry many capsules with you.
weaknesses: You can't encapsulate living objects.
Capsules are easier to steal then the actual objects

name: Super Fighting
description: Powerful punches, destructive kicks, flip kicks, windmill kicks, use of the walls, ceiling and surroundings to jump from to get power, and super healing. You can turn it off and on at will. Have super karate moves and kung fu power. You're born with this power. It's a defense mechanism that can't be stolen or absorbed by opponents. You never get tired in "fight mode," and have super jumping power. Your weakness happens when sleeping.
summary: The ability to use various fighting skills to defend yourself and destroy your opponents
strengths: Controllable
Never allows you to be hurt
Never lose a battle awake
weaknesses: Immortal
Weak when sleeping
Defeated when sleeping

name: Tactile Illusion Projection
description: When you touch an object, you can create an illusory field around it that makes it appear as whatever you want, as long as the image has similar dimensions as the actual object. You can create a very exact illusion, or one with vague details that an observer completes subconciously, all with little focus. These illusions deceive all 5 senses. If the object loses contact with your skin, or an object linked to your skin, the illusion will fade within 10 seconds. You can even hide an object.
summary: The ability to project an illusion around objects you touch
strengths: Can change your own appearance and your clothes easily
Can use a piece of laminated paper as any ID
This would be fantastic for magic tricks
weaknesses: Can only create illusions around things you touch
If you lose contact, the illusion will fade fast
People may notice that they see an object slightly differently

name: Duplication Imagination
description: You can create exact duplicates of yourself, from anytime during your life. The duplicates cannot physically affect the outside world, but you can use them to confuse, manipulate, and distress opponents.
summary: The ability to create imaginary dopplegangers of yourself to confuse opponents
strengths: More difficult for your opponent to target you
Drive your opponent mad by confusion
Clones are imaginary and can go through walls to spy on people
weaknesses: Unable to use clones to attack
Clones can't touch anything
Limited by how far you can send them away

name: Pro Recall
description: This power allows the holder to use any power, skill, memory, physique, etc. that they have used in the past. For example, if you had a long lost memory, you could recall it. You can even use it for abilities. If you lost an ability, you could recall it. In addition, you can recall physical features--youth can be recalled from any age or become any weight you have been. Injuries can be erased by recalling your body from a time you didn't have that injury. Even positions in work can be recalled.
summary: The ability to gain anything you've had in the past.
strengths: Train once and keep results for life
If you lose a power, you can recall it.
Heal injuries.
weaknesses: If you don't accomplish anything in life.
If you lost a power, chances are you will lose this one.
Must be consciously recalled and returned.

name: Anything Magnet
description: A person with this power has the ability to attract or repel anything they desire. They just need to know what their target is then their body will adjust so that it attracts only that/those object(s) or repel only that/those object(s). This works on any object the user thinks of even if they are not in the room at the time or are far distances away - the effect is weaker at futher distances.
summary: The ability to make anything you want be magnetically attracted or repelled by you
strengths: Grab items from great distances and push things away without even touching them
You can change the strength of the magnetic effect
Can switch instantly and can turn it off at any time and it works on ANY object
weaknesses: You need to train to improve the power
Can only affect 1 item initially but can later be used on multiple objects or indiscriminately
Can be overcome with strength

name: Ability Theft
description: If a superhero is a person in a Ferrari, a person with Ability Theft is a carjacker. By merely touching a powered individual, they can steal and use the powers for their own ends.
summary: The ability to steal other people's superpowers
strengths: Can obtain some amazing abilities
Can combine abilities (i.e. radioactive super-punch)
Be a hero/villian without equal
weaknesses: Wary superheroes
Become hated and feared
Also absorb weaknesses (i.e. Kryptonite)

name: Sub Personality Creation
description: If you're attacked by a mind controller, you can create a copy of your mind to be attacked instead. You can then manipulate that alternate personality to do your bidding. Perfect for foiling evil plots under a supervillain's nose. Also, in a scenario where you need to hide, you can simply create a different person and hide. The original can prevent the copies from accessing other superpowers and retake control of his/her body at will.
summary: The ability to create alternate personalities which can be controlled by maker
strengths: Can create a personality that can be an exact copy or different from the original.
Personalities can be reabsorbed and (optionally) share experiences with the original
The original can control copies
weaknesses: May lead to confusion on who is the original
May be mistaken for MPD
Copies becoming aware of being copies could drive you insane

name: Enhanced Pack Invulnerability
description: This power is like Pack Invulnerability but has no limit on the number of people in your group. You use this power by having a shared vision of something (e.g. a utopian world or empire ruled by villains) with the other people. This power also gives the group a shared strength based on who's strongest, e.g. if in a group of three, one person can lift 250 lbs., all three of the group can each lift 750 lbs. If strength is equal (all three lift about 200 lbs. ), each will be able to lift 600 lbs.
summary: The ability to share invulnerability and more with other people.
strengths: Invulnerability and a strength that grows with each new converted to your vision of the world.
weaknesses: If you're not charismatic enough.

name: Natural Talents
description: You can make superpowers natural abilities. For example, if have super strength, then you can make that a natural talent.
summary: The ability to make superpowers natural talents.
strengths: Some powers only specifically affect other powers and not natural talents
weaknesses: Some you may have a hard time explaining, like cooking poptarts from your behind.

name: Colossus Creation
description: The ability to make a colossus and control it to what ever you want. But if you lose control it will go on a rampage, then explode which can only be prevented by destroying the colossus within 15 minutes from when control is lost
summary: The ability to make colossus out of any material
strengths: Can help with giant monsters
Can be made to adapt to any enviroment
Will follow order to the letter
weaknesses: The mini nuke if control is lost for 15 minutes
Rampage if control is lost
If creator is evil so is the colossus

name: Transitive Property Execution
description: Also known as "Transitive Property Enforcement", the user is able to use transitive property in supernatural ways. In a real life example, if the user has to fight a guy who lost to another guy that the user actually defeated. That means the user automatically wins without moving a muscle, because transitive means he is stronger than that guy without implying both fighter's skills and abilities. The user can also become stronger because of the effects of transitive property.
summary: The ability to imply the rules of transitive property into reality.
strengths: Use transitive property effect reality around you.
Gain strength and abilities by adding up the effects of transitive property that you use own others.
weaknesses: Have to be greater than a thing that is greater to another thing to work.

name: Octopus Mimicry
description: You have a flexible, elastic body that can squeeze through tight spaces or expand to a great size. You can breathe underwater, and can sprout eight tentacles with little suction cups to grip and manipulate multiple items at once. You also have the gift of camouflage, and can change your skin tone to blend in with your surroundings by will. Not only this, but you can expel a jet-black ink to form instant darkness, and a quick getaway.
summary: The ability to take on the traits of an octopus.
strengths: Eight handy tentacles.
Excellent flexibility.
Camouflage and ink blast.
weaknesses: You're born with a pinkish purple skin tone.
You'd be kinda freaky.
Might be heavier than you are now

name: Delete This Now Ok
description: ambiguous and a duplicate
summary: The ability to be ambiguous and a duplicate
strengths: Very useful power
weaknesses: Nothin

name: Aura Of The Phoenix
description: You unleash the Aura of the Phoenix. Giant wings of pure flame come out of your back, and you gain incredible regeneration abilities. While in use, most injuries you obtain heal within minutes. It has no real fighting abilities by itself.
summary: The ability to use the phoenix's aura
strengths: Can fly
Regenerate at an incredible pace
weaknesses: No fighting abilites by itself

name: Fabric Metamorphosis
description: The person who possesses this power can melt your skin with the clothes she wears. These dresses can be modified so as to turn into organic weapons and armors: a bracelet of wood can be transformed into a chakram, a gown can become a tangle of controllable lianas, a belt could become a whip, and so on. The power will only work with anything is intended solely as "wearable" (a bucket on your head can not be used in this way).
summary: The ability to transform your clothes in armors or weapons.
strengths: The wounds that would normally hurt your body will be "absorbed " by clothing.
Patterns, designs and pictures on clothing will undergo amazing changes.
weaknesses: The power has no effect on synthetic fibers (acrylic, nylon);
Whatever is launched, thrown or bolted retains its mutated form only for a while.

name: Shadow Kinetic Strengthening
description: The opposite to the original ability, this gives the user a boost the strength and durability of the user. The amount of the strength and durability boost depends on how many potiential energy they absorbed.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy of any solid thing to boost your strength and durability.
strengths: Physical strength and durability is increased.
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Old People Are The Best
description: With this power you get a new power every year on your birthday and all the powers you had before become more powerful. This power starts the first birthday you have after obtaining this power it does not work retroactively so if you're 75 when you get this power you do not get 75 powers but you get one new power when you turn 76 and so on and so forth.
summary: The ability to become more powerful as you become older
strengths: You get a new power every year on your birthday
When you get a new power all your other powers become stronger
weaknesses: This power does not work retroactively
If your birthday is February 29 you are not going to get a lot of powers from this power

name: Latent Power Absorption
description: This ability allows you to absorb the latent abilities of others for your own. This means that if a normal person is about to manifest a superpower, you can take that power from them, preventing it from even manifesting. I addition, if a super already possesses one or a few powers, and is about to manifest another (or his power is about to develop), the user can absorb that power, or the boosted version that's about to manifest. As such, this may be accompanied by Power Sensing.
summary: The ability to absorb the latent abilities of others
strengths: When you absorb powers before they manifest, you can automatically use them
Normal people with unmanifested powers often have no way to defend themselves
A person who already HAS a power, and is about to receive a power boost
weaknesses: People who can't have their powers absorbed
If you try to absorb already-manifested abilities, you'll overload, pass out and lose the power
Sometimes you don't get the Power Sensing, so you can't sense if someone has unmanifested powers

name: Dire Situation Adaptation
description: One with this ability can adapt to any dire situation. Similar to Reality Warping or Wishing, this can help one gain abilites if almost dead, if one was having trouble finding a partner, one would gain the necessary qualities to find one, or if one was poor and collected money from others, one would gain more and more til whenever one desires. This ability kicks in when one is under-average to get to an average or higher status than what one has currently and when one is in dire need
summary: The ability to adapt to any dire situation.
strengths: If you're homeless, you gain qualities and endeavorment or the opportunity to gain a place to live.
Money when poor.
Gain a suitable life partner
weaknesses: Doesn't work if one isn't in a dire need of something.

name: Impenetrable Cocoon
description: The user of this power can create a cocoon around themself that is impenetrable. While in the cocoon you can do up to 3 things: 1) heal all wounds on the body, 2) gain one other power, or 3) increase all physical attributes used in fighting by 150%. Options 2&3 have a limited number of uses. #2 can only be used once and #3 up to three times. You cannot gain godlike powers from #2. Also, the better the power/the worse the wound, lenghtens the time you need to be in the cocoon.
summary: The ability to create a cocoon around oneself for various effects
strengths: Can heal any wound while in the cocoon.
Can gain one power while in the cocoon.
Cocoon cannot be opened or damaged except by you.
weaknesses: Can't do anything while in the cocoon.
The worse the wound, the longer the time in the cocoon.
Allies can't wake you up even if you want them to.

name: Attractivness
description: The moment you gain this power all blemishes, scars, and integumentary flaws are erased. Your pheromones change to make you more appealing. Your skin can change to tan or pale to attract others. Your Adam's apple shrinks to be less noticeable. Your voice turns melodic and lighter. You can persuade people to do what you desire with voice, glance, or aura. Your muscles compact and strengthen plus become more slim. Your stomach becomes skinny and body fat decreases.
summary: The ability to be immensely attractive and charming.
strengths: Manipulating, attracting and persuading people.
Hair is glossy, thick and fluffy.
Eternally youthful.
weaknesses: Jealousy.
Only if you consider other things attractive.

name: Energy Blade
description: A person with the power of energy blade draws & absorbs upon surrounding energy & converts it from their hands into a energy bladed weapon. Its like having a lightsaber. The more energy your body absorbs, the stronger & shaper your blade will be. It can even deflect projectiles. Though if you use your power extensively in one setting, it'll start tapping into your body's energy making you weak & exhausted.
summary: The ability to absorb energy & turn it into a plasma bladed weapon
strengths: Absorb & create bladed weapons from energy
The more energy absorbed, the stronger the weapon will be
Can deflect projectiles
weaknesses: If there isn't enough surrounding energy & you use your power alot, it'll drain your energy

name: Obscure Ability
description: This ability is so puzzling that you don't even know what it truly is or does. It so ambiguous that not even I, the creator, know what it is or does! The user won't be able to understand it either. And the mystery is this ability's power. This ability is perfect against opponents who can study, absorb or mimic a person's skills and abilities. They won't be able to get it, before it is too late. This ability can be active, passive, offensive, defensive, (Meta)physical,  Try and guess what it is.
summary: The ability to posssess an ability that is so ambiguous, that it's difficult to describe.
strengths: Have a mysterious power
It can't be understood by anyone, even people who can study or copy an ability by sight.
This ability can be active or passive. It can be offensive or defensive.
weaknesses: If this ability can be understood, it loses it powers.
Unknown
Classified

name: Duplication
description: You can multiply into many copies of yourself.  You will ultimately have control over them, but they can help you get things done, fill up a party, mow the lawn, the sky's the limit!
summary: The ability to create physical duplicates of yourself.
strengths: Get things done quicker
When you're outnumbered in a fight
weaknesses: Explaining to people why you have so many twins

name: Time Transcension
description: You will arrive in an older or younger version of your own body, and the past or future mind of that body will be merged with yours. You will be able to use this ability to relive or perform events differently in your life. You retain full control over your past or future body.
summary: The ability to transfer your consciousness to your own body at any point between your birth and death.
strengths: You are virtually immortal.
You can redo things that you have screwed up.
weaknesses: If you suddenly die...

name: True Potential Absorption
description: This ability allows the user to absorb any person, creature, or non-living thing's dormant, true potential. They will inherit all the power of their full power. This only works on things that have not yet reach their true power. If they did reach it, the user cannot absorb it. The user will have control of this power but there are somethings catches to it(See The bad). Again this power gain is temporary. The user is also can see the conditions needed to unlock the true potential in his victims.
summary: The ability to temporarily absorb someone or something's true (full) potential.
strengths: Become more powerful through something's true power.
Gain abilities through those true powers
Know how to unlock the true potential in user's victims
weaknesses: Temporary
Since it's not the user's true potential,the body will sometimes reject it(depending on the quality)
If the victim can achieve the conditions to unlock their true potential, the user will lose that it.

name: Kenbusho
description: User can feel the presence of any being in a ceratin range, and predict their movements (like Jedis).
summary: The ability to feel the presence of others.
strengths: Can feel how many living beings are in a certain area.
Can predict movements of anything close to the user.
Can feel whenever a person/object disappears from that specific area.
weaknesses: If there are too many beings, or it is a war and to many persons die, it makes the user feel tired.
Can predict but not block attacks, that depends on the user's speed.
Range depends on user's experience, it can work from a single house to a city.

name: Repetitive Prowess Evolution
description: With this power you can get better at doing something the more you do it, but at a superhuman rate. If something takes you hours, days, years to master, you can now do it in minutes, hoursm days etc. Examples: Video games, sports, instruments, singing, writing, etc.
summary: The ability to get better at something at a superhuman rate the more you do it.
strengths: You can impress your friends and family.
People will look up to you.
Barely anything will be difficult for you.
weaknesses: You get really emotional and hate losing or doing a bad job.
You keep wanting to do more things and get better at them.
Life can get boring when you're good at everything.

name: Powerful Doubts
description: This power allows you to do almost anything, as long as someone says you can't. Let's say your friend says that you can't walk on walls. Instantly, you will forever be able to walk on walls. Or if someone says you won't live forever, you will become immortal. However, if you say that you can't do something, nothing will change. Only when someone else doubts you, will you be able to prove them wrong.
summary: The ability to do anything someone says you can't
strengths: Can gain great powers
Your friends can increase your power
weaknesses: People will have power over you (you can't disobey me, you can't live, etc)

name: Infernal Rebirth
description: This ability allows you rise up from the sable-coloured flames in a form three times stronger than the last. Each form will consist of fire and a more fearsome appearance every time this ability is in effect. Your primary abilities will consist of fire projection, flight, enhanced speed, strength, intelligence, and durability. With each death you increment in all fields of combat and so does your "rebirth rate".
summary: The ability to detonate when taking lethal damage and colescing back into a stronger form.
strengths: Incinerate your target(s) with bursts of flame
Rise and rise again each time you are struck down, stronger than before
weaknesses: You are still vulnerable and suspectable to damage.
High powered water and ice based attacks easily extinguish your flames

name: Numerical Superiority
description: Speak any number that you could actually write on paper. That is your enhancement to your abilities. Irrational numbers can be used to enhance your powers provided you have a full understanding of how big they are. You can speak smaller numbers to give manageable levels of power.
summary: The ability to boost a power by speaking a number.
strengths: Fully controllable power levels.
Infinite levels of power-provided you have a mathematics degree.
weaknesses: You can be muted.
You can't change power levels underwater or in space.
Someone could reduce your IQ so low you couldn't count over 10.

name: Rubber Kinesis
description: The user is able to create liquid rubber from his or her mouth , the rubber will then solidify into an object with rubbery qualities after it has left the mouth, for example a rubber wall, a rubber bullet or a rubber ball or protection sphere. The user of this power also has the ability to control anything that has rubber like properties.
summary: The ability to create as well as control all forms of rubber
strengths: Good against electrokinesis users
Good for stopping villains
weaknesses: Objects constructed are not usually strong enough to take down superhouses

name: Molecule Rearrangement
description: You can rearrange someone's molecules to be whatever you want--but it only lasts 1 hour. You cannot change someone into the same thing twice in a row. The thing you turn them into must be about the same size.
summary: The ability to rearrange your own or somebody else's molecular structure
strengths: It would help to unarm enemies
You could change enemies into something weaker
weaknesses: Only works on people

name: Spike Creation
description: Create spikes from any solid material. If a guy holds a gun up to you, you can sprout a spike from the gun to stab him. You can make metal spikes from a metal, wooden spikes and even fabric spikes. You can make and throw needle or spear like spikes. If you make contact with someone, you can grow a spike from their bones.
summary: The ability to create different width and length spikes from any solid object
strengths: You can make deffensive walls and then send spikes from the spike wall
You always have a weapon
weaknesses: You must be able to see the target material and it has to be within a mile of you
It only works on solids. Liquids and gasses won't work
Sand won't work because of it's shifty nature, thus not holding shape

name: Perfect Immortality
description: This power is the ultimate gift and curse. It's the ultimate gift because you can never die by any means and you are invulnerable to all kinds of damage, can never get sick and you stop ageing after you turn 30. Also, you will adapt to survive in whatever environment you are in and you will never have to eat, breathe or drink and you will never get tired. It's the ultimate curse because everybody else will die while you'll live forever. In fact, you will survive after the universe is destroyed.
summary: The ability to never age, get injured, sick, or die.
strengths: You will never die
You will never get injured
You will never get sick
weaknesses: It doesn't stop people from trapping you
Everybody else will die

name: Shadow Wolves
description: The wolves are pitch black in color since they originated from shadows. They can rip and shred any enemy you are fighting. You can control their individual movements but you can put them into an autonomous mode if you need to. There is a maximum radius of 20 metres that they can be from you. If you have no need to have them around, they will simply melt back into the shadows.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves made out of shadows
strengths: Strong creatures under your command.
The wolves are made out of shadows so they can't be killed.
This was inspired by two things: the user Shadowulf1 and 'Shadow of the Wolf'.
weaknesses: Second pro is null and void if the enemy has this power, 'Aura Wolves,' 'Light Wolves' or Umbrium.
The wolves are restricted in how far they can go from you.
Long-range fighters can just attack you from outside 20 metres and be safe.

name: Kinetic Energy Rebound
description: The power to send back any kinetic energy of one's choosing back at the source at ten to a hundred times the original power. No matter how much kinetic energy is coming at you, you can send it back with more power. If superman was to try and punch you while you are using this power, he would be hit by the energy from a punch that is a hundred times stronger than the one he threw. There is no limit to what amount of kinetic energy you can rebound.
summary: The ability to send kinetic energy back at the source.
strengths: Can win a fight just by standing around there.
Can deal out epic levels of damage.
Can bring even the strongest foes to their knees.
weaknesses: Only works on kinetic energy.
If you are using the power and a friend or a loved one gives you a pat on the back, they could die.
If two users of this power were to clash, they would be locked in an endless loop.

name: Perfect Style
description: Basically when you utilize this power you know how to use all your abilities(natural and super) in a way that suits how you want to fight. Ex. If you want to fight with minimal movement or fight with a style similar to Capoeira then you'll know just how to do that. The style will fit with how fit you are, how thick or thin, how tall you are, etc.
summary: The ability to fight in a style that perfectly suits how you want to fight
strengths: You'll know the perfect way to use your powers in a generalised situation.
Having a style similar to a martial arts is possible as noted by the mention of Capoeira.
weaknesses: Someone who knows exactly how to counter you.
Mind-readers.

name: Wolf Style Technique
description: Can turn into a wolf, summon wolves and dogs, have claws, enhanced strength, enhanced speed, can partially turn into wolf, can make fur sharpen and stand up like spikes, can talk to dogs and wolves.
summary: The ability to turn into a wolf, summon wolves and dogs, have claws, enhanced strength, enhanced speed, and more
strengths: Can talk to dogs and wolves
Stomach can handle raw meat
Still contains some enhanced strength in human form
weaknesses: If someone sees you transform, you could be labeled as a werewolf.
Staying in wolf-form too long can make you lose your humanity and come to your instincts.

name: Lipid Manipulation.
description: With this power, you can levitate, transmute, transfer and otherwise control lipids. For instance, you could control certain hormones, transfer fat from one individual to another or turn fat into biodiesel. One could even manipulate the cell walls of an individual, allowing levitation and harming of a person. The myelin sheath on neurons could be controlled, allowing you to paralyses an individual or relieve symptoms of multiple sclerosis.
summary: The ability to control lipids such as; fats, waxes and some vitamins.
strengths: Miriad of uses.
Limited control over the biochemistry of others.
Physical contact allows extraction and implantation of lipids.
weaknesses: You may need to learn what lipids are before using this power. Luckily, it is only an Internet searc
Physical contact is necessary at least at first for lipid extraction or implantation.
You need a lot of material to produce a decent amount of biodiesel.

name: Psionic Storage
description: More of a 'supplemental' power than a 'primary' power. (Not intended as a crime fighting power, but could be used that way). Simply touch any object, item, creature, or person, (and in a flash of light), you store it in your mind, until you are ready to summon it back into reality. While the item or creature is stored, it does not age and is completely safe. Store ALMOST anything: a hot dinner, an animal, a person, a weapon, a car, a house, or even a 747 jet or skyscraper. (Not a city).
summary: The ability to store any physical object in your mind.
strengths: You can store as many things in your mind as you want. Very small items store faster! Like bullets
If planned correctly, the power could be used as a weapon, (even capturing enemies).
You can 'store' yourself, moving into an alternate universe of your own creation.
weaknesses: You can only store one object every minute. (60 an hour)
You can not store an entire city. (at least not in a single flash)
A few people might suspect you are a thief?

name: Back To Square One
description: With this power, you can be near indestructible if you are awake. This can negate anything that people throw at you.  When someone shoots at you, the action is done but the consequence-someone getting hit and possibly dying, is negated.
summary: The ability to negate the consequences of any action that you choose
strengths: Indestructible
With greater control, you can selectively negate consequences-such as preventing side effects
You can choose not to negate your own consequences
weaknesses: You must be awake to use the power
You must know the consequences to negate them
Cannot negate death but you can negate things that induce death

name: Bioabsorption
description: You need physical contact to absorb biomass. Once biomass is absorbed it goes to a extra-dimesnional pocket inside you that holds up to 100 tons of it in biostasis. You can't genetically alter what you absorb but can extrude mixed biomass from your body. Say you absorbed a tiger and a octopus,you could extrude a tentacle with a tiger's jaw on the end of it. You can just expel biomass(i. E the tiger) alive and intact to make room for more or different biomass.
summary: The ability to absorb biomass into your body and extrude it as limbs,weapons or armor.
strengths: A power limited only by the biomass you've absorbed and your imagination.
A life preserving extra-dimensional space is useful by itself.
You don't kill what you absorb,you can release it alive and intact.
weaknesses: Finding the best animals,plants,fungi and bacteria to absorb.
You need physical contact to absorb biomass.

name: Variant
description: You are not alone. Meet Variant an unseen force of who is, by all conventional means, indestructable. Variant is you on steroids. It can do anything you can do autonomously, invisibly. Passively Variant is an extra pair of eyes and hands. In a fight Variant is an automatic double-team. Variant has no need of sleep and could watch over you always. You are always mind-linked and control Variants actions pseudo-subconsciously. It's like hard-shaped telekinesis.
summary: The ability to have an invisible, indestructable version of yourself accompany you
strengths: Variant is you with 2 times your physical attributes
It is invisible in EM spectrum and durable enough to survive a mountain drop on top of it
Variant is an extension of your senses, see what it sees etc. Send it on missions, control its moves
weaknesses: You must stay within 1760 yards of Variant for it to operate at full strength.
If its invisibility is compromised, it slowly loses its invulnerability factor
Variant fights like you. If you fight like a runny-nosed 1st grader, so will it.

name: Life Injector
description: You can inject life into other people that are dying. You can make them live longer by constantly injecting life into them.
summary: The ability to inject life into other people.
strengths: Saves people.
weaknesses: Will get tired after a few injections.

name: Geo Metamorphosis
description: Think of your body as a living rock, magma running through your veins and whatnot.
