This power allows you to change into anything from sandstone to steel, including diamond, a form that is unbreakable and packs a painful punch. Turning into rock will also give you super strength, and the ability to turn into sand makes for quick attacks, and in magma form you can really heat things up. You can also turn back into human form at any time, and in your normal form, you will still have super strength.
summary: The ability to transform your body into any form of rock or mineral, including metal and sand
strengths: Super strength and invulnerability
Turning into sand makes up for slow mobility
Ability to mold rock body into different shapes, i.e. knife or hammer shapes
weaknesses: Diamond and steel forms are hard to maintain without perfect concentration
Slow mobility when in a solid form
If you stay in rock form for too long, you may not be able to change back

name: System Activation
description: No batteries required. A System Activator can turn on anything just by touching it: cars, televisions, and electric toys are excellent examples. They can also reverse their power and deactivate existing systems. Most spectacularly, they can partially re-activate lost or stolen superhuman abilities. Unfortunately, they may not be able to turn on the support structures as well (i.e. the stronger bones that come with Super-Strength.).
summary: The ability to jump-start any pre-existing structure
strengths: Turn on cars, appliances, electric toys, etc.
Can reverse power and deactivate existing systems
Can re-activate lost or stolen superhuman powers
weaknesses: System must exist in the first place
Linked with emotion
May not re-activate superhuman support structures (strong bones, etc.)

name: Impact Shield
description: With this power, you can pad yourself with a transparent layer of space that prevents fast moving solids and liquids from impacting with you. Basically, only slow moving objects can touch you. This protective layer is 3 inches from your skin and can be turned on and off at will.  While it requires active thought to use, it can be targeted to specific areas of your body if so desired. So go ahead, run into that spray of bullets like you've always wanted to!
summary: The ability to shield yourself from fast moving solids and liquids
strengths: While in use, you're impervious to bullets and other angry fast moving objects
Objects that hit your impact shield stop moving
Never get punched, stabbed, axed, or pooped on by seagulls again!
weaknesses: Slow moving blades
Requires active thought to use
Gases (even fast moving ones) aren't affected by your barrier

name: Nycto Kinesis
description: The one thing you must know about this power is, it is strongest at night. As the sun goes down your power grows allowing you to create portals from the darkness, bind people, sever limbs, create appendages from the darkness, or tie ones soul to darkness bringing out the worst within them. Sunlight however is the one thing that can stop or even destroy the darkness thus making these attacks useless but without it you can even cloak a lightbulb and thus create more darkness.
summary: The ability to manipulate darkness in relation to the light/dark ratio and time.
strengths: Becomes more potent as the sun goes down
Complete manipulation of darkness when at night and in complete darkness
Only sunlight can stop the darkness of some of the attacks
weaknesses: Power is weakest at midday
Sunlight can stop the darkness of some of the attacks (solar energy shield to keep from being bound)
You obviously can't hide the sun in darkness (remember that solar energy thing I was talking about?

name: Possession Virus
description: When you make skin to skin contact with someone, you can by choice infect them with a psychic virus that spreads your hivemind into their body. You can now simultaneously and easily control their body at the same time that you use your's, possessing their actions and senses. Each person you recruit is essentially you, as your mind is distributed equally among your subjects, so you can't die even if your original body is destroyed. You absorb memories of someone you overwrite, so you can mimic.
summary: The ability to forcibly recruit others into your hivemind by touching them
strengths: You can create an army with which you have total control over
You are now essentially immortal, as if one body is destroyed all the rest carry on with your mind
You can perform many actions at the same time with all your bodies
weaknesses: You may feel distanced from others
Some memories you overwrite may be traumatic
Can be resisted

name: Paragon
description: A paragon is capable of superhuman strength, near invulnerability, superhuman speed, flight, and energy projection. Your powers allow you to survive in harsh conditions and temperatures both high and low. You will adapat to any location your battles ensue such as: underwater, deserts, mountains, domestic, darkness, volcanoes, rainforests, jungles, skies, and the vacuum of space.
summary: The ability to become a model of perfection.
strengths: Virtually invincible.
Certain conditions and locations will evolve you for adaptations.
weaknesses: You are a model of perfection. You powers render power negating obselete.

name: Electroreception, Active
description: With this ability, your body generates a weak electic field, usually 1 - 2 body lenghts, but longer is possible. You can sense the environment by the distortions generated by the other objects within the field. You can identify and discriminate between objects by thier different resistance and capacitance characteristics. Works best in aquatic environments, but o. K. On land.
summary: The ability to sense your surroundings through detecting distortions in an electic field
strengths: Orient yourself in the dark or low-light areas
Supplements or replaces your other senses
Detect hidden friends and foes
weaknesses: Objects that generate powerful electical fields may disrupt this ability
Someone with electroreception may sense you using this ability
Objects with an electical resistance similar to the surrounding medium are nearly undetectable

name: Evolutionary Strength
description: Evolutionary Strength is the ability to build up strength in seconds. This is enough power to fight Superman. This power lasts over long durations of time, between 12-24 hours max. You could start lifting 5 tons in 15-30 seconds by using your muscles. Example: You attempt to pull a car which will hurt your muscles, but within seconds, you should be able to pull it NO PROBLEM. You temporarily have to lift, push or pull in order to build up strength.
summary: The ability to build up strength rapidly
strengths: Becoming stronger than any entity across the universe
Having the power to fight entities like Superman
Becoming the strongest in the universe
weaknesses: It can wear off within an amount of time
You are still vulnerable to fire, radiation or any other element
You need to keep working out every hour in order to keep up your strength

name: X: The Extraordinary Blueprint
description: The X blueprint is a schematic of your own body. With it you could grant yourself amazing powers and abilities by adding to or altering the sketch & by adding notes. Manipulate age, height, weight or muscle mass (like dense skin, telescopic eyes, enlarged limbs to name a few. The blueprint is on a highly durable linen which can only be destroyed by gaseous flame.
summary: The ability to grant yourself superpowers with a detailed blueprint of you
strengths: Get amazing powers by adding sketches & notes
The more detailed the note or sketch the more powerful you are (lessens chance of weakness)
Heal by simply erasing the affected part and redrawing it (which tickles a bit)
weaknesses: Adding too many powers at once will send you into a violent roid-rage leading into a coma
If someone gets a hold of the print they could control you
Keep the print away from gaseous flame. If the blueprint is destroyed, you are destroyed.

name: Full Body Bullet Proof
description: If you have this power your entire body is automatically bullet proof and cannot make yourself unbullet proof. You are immune to the effects of any type of bullet.
summary: The ability to become bullet proof
strengths: Your entire body is bullet proof
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by darts, arrows and other types of weapons

name: Ground Block
description: This ability allows you to pull walls out of the ground in any direction, width, height, and density.
summary: The ability to raise walls out of the ground
strengths: Slows enemy down
Instant house
Barricade
weaknesses: It's out of the ground so only semi-easily destroyed earth
Takes longer to make bigger walls

name: The Earth Power
description: As long as you're touching the ground you can absorb energy from it. This energy can be used to recharge yourself, gain strength, heal, shoot energy blasts, and other such things. Also, you can store this energy in yourself so that you don't need to absorb it from the ground. This is good because if you're seperated from the ground you can't use your powers. To use this power you must imagine energy flowing from the ground, through your legs, and into your body.
summary: The ability to absorb and channel energy from the earth
strengths: You can gain energy rapidly and use it in different ways
You can store the energy in yourself
There are other ways you can channel the earth's power
weaknesses: You must be touching the ground to absorb the power.
It takes concentration to absorb energy

name: Person Creator
description: With this power you can create people, or recreate existing/fictional people, and alter their/give them personalties in any way you wish. You can also alter their looks according to your liking and they're also completely under your control. You can make as many as you want, but only a hundred of them can exist at once.
summary: The ability to create people
strengths: Make an army of people that will do whatever you say.
Hang out with friends.
weaknesses: A hundred people can be (re)created and exist at once.

name: Percussive Maintenance
description: A person with this power can fix anything by hitting them. TV broken--just give it a light tap and it will be fixed. Rogue robots---punching them will also fix them. Person being mind controlled--punching them reverts them back to their original self. Someone has a headache punching them also fixes the person up. However even if the object is fixed they still receive damage from your punch so if you overdo it, it will still break.
summary: The ability to fix anything by hitting them
strengths: Fix things---a universal interpretation of the word fix
Excuse to hit things
Can be used on anything and everything including people
weaknesses: If a part is missing this will not regenerate the lost part
If the thing that needs fixing is on fire or is otherwise unhittable---or unadvisable to hit
Cannot change the inherent properties of an object--no upgrades or modifications

name: Multi Jump
description: Double jumps have nothing on you. With this superpower, you can jump and then jump again in the air. You can jump again and again in the air. You have to practice and time your jumps. You get higher with each jump in the air. You need to develop your jump stamina or you will only jump a few times.
summary: The ability to jump and then jump again and again in the air.
strengths: Jump, then jump again and again in the air.
With every jump in the air, you get higher and higher.
If you time your jumps, you get the most out of this power.
weaknesses: If you don't time your jumps, it's harder to get higher.
If you don't practice, you will not be used to jumping or get too high in the air.
If you don't jump while in the air, it will not work.

name: Healthy Hands
description: You now have the power to physically reach into someone's body and pull out anything keeping them sick, be it a tumor or something bacterial or viral. People will start to come to you with their problems and maybe even pay you!
summary: The ability to reach into someone's body and pull out anything that ails them.
strengths: Need an organ transplant for one of your family members? Now it's free.
Become a world famous doctor.
People you save may owe you favors or reward you.
weaknesses: You have to find something to do with whatever you pulled out.
You have to build up a great immune system to be able to withstand diseases.
Doesn't work on yourself.

name: Super Physique
description: You can train and have good physique and get more muscle but never lose the old you have. Even when you get old, the powers stay. You never get tired and you do not need to sleep. However, you need to recharge your body with water and food at some point after the human limits. But the great thing is, you stay fit all the time, never needing to train. This is not like the power Contained Metabolism, because there you don't need to eat.
summary: The ability to keep running and moving without ever getting tired.
strengths: Never get tired
No need to train your body
No need to sleep
weaknesses: Need to eat and drink
You can get injured
You can die when the internal organs stop of old age

name: Money Magnet
description: You can activate this power and control the strength of the magnetism; you must have some of the type of currency you mean to attract or repel. By type I mean American money, Monopoly money,etc.
summary: The ability to attract currency (money) like a magnet, or repel it
strengths: You can atract all american currency with a penny.
Throw people by repeling the money in their pocket
weaknesses: If you have no money of the desired type.
If enemies are broke
You might get pummeled by large amounts of change

name: Super Human
description: A super human is able to go far beyond the limitations of their mind and body to be able to perform all manner of actions. This power gives its holder super enhanced versions of the following: strength, speed, reflexes, agility, acrobatics, endurance, toughness, senses and mind. This allows the holder to lift extremely heavy objects, leap huge distances, run at high speeds and withstand all forms of physical and mental attacks to a certain extent.
summary: The ability to lift objects, jump great distances, run extremely fast and be supremely tough
strengths: Strong, fast, agile and tough
Enhanced intelligence
Prepared for all manner of situations
weaknesses: Takes a long time to learn how to control
Can only improve with training, but con 3 is still valid
Very strong and fast but those with just super strength are a little stronger and likewise for speed

name: In My Pocket
description: For all those times people ask you for an odd item when you're stuck in a jiffy, such as needing superglue, a pen, a calculator - or to be more creative, a lightsaber, the first issue of X-Men Giant Size to credit cards, etc. ANYTHING that's requested basically.  Also, the probability of you being able to possess the object through natural means is inverse to the object's potential to malfunction, i.e. it may be likely to have a pen handy, but not a Harrier Jump Jet - so expect malfunctions.
summary: The ability to have any item or object in close proximity upon request by another person
strengths: You are always equiped
You would become the most useful guy/gal in the world
The more people you know, the more items it's reasonable for you to have access to
weaknesses: Someone else MUST request the item before you can materialize it
The probability that you could possess the object is inverse to the usefulness of the object

name: Ability Replication
description: An Ability Replicator is a highly adaptable and unpredictable foe. By touching another superhuman, they can copy their abilities: Telepathy, Super-Strength, even Flight is not beyond them. The downside is that they can only hold on to one power at a time; with extensive time and practice it might be able to be expanded to 2 or 3.
summary: The ability to copy the superpowers of others by touch
strengths: Can copy foe's superpowers
Surprise factor
No superpower beyond you (Telepathy to Super-Strength)
weaknesses: Can only hold on to one power at a time
Must touch target
Getting stuck with an awful power

name: Cryptid Caller
description: You get to call upon the creatures mankind believes does not exist, like the Loch Ness monster, Sasquatch, etc.
summary: The ability to call upon the creatures of myth to do your bidding
strengths: Can call upon some really powerful allies
They never turn their back on you
Can become unstoppable
weaknesses: Some people may try to expliot you
Must be a strong believer
Must know exact name of cryptid you try to call upon

name: Character Creator
description: The ultimate power for aspiring authors or crazy fangirls. A person with this ability can recreate fictional characters or create their own as long as they have enough information.
summary: The ability to replicate characters from movies/books or to create your own.
strengths: You're own Edward Cullen.
A bunch of hot guys.
A bunch of hot girls.
weaknesses: You can't return them.
The questions that people will ask you.

name: Rules Of The Room
description: With this power, you can make rules that must be followed by anyone who enters the room. You write the rules within a rulebook that you must read to people after they enter the room. You must clearly state the rules before they are in effect. If someone disobeys the rules, they will die. The rules must be able to affect everyone. For example you cannot write "Only I can attack", but you can write "No violence" or "A punch for a punch". Also, you can ban superpowers, except this one.
summary: The ability to set up an area where your rules must be followed
strengths: "No violence" is good for protecting you, "A punch for a punch" is good if you have superstrength
The rulebook can regenerate
You can also create a game with the rules
weaknesses: You must follow your own rules and they must be able to affect everyone
You cannot make exceptions, unless they can be utilized by everyone
You have to be very specific to cover loopholes

name: Urban Empathy
description: The city: full of artists, businessmen, and culture. For an Urban Empath, it's the home of something else as well--their abilities. While in a city, they gain strength, agility, and intelligence relative to its inhabitants. If they live in a major city they can stop a semi, freerun through the urban jungle with reckless abandon, and outwit anyone who crosses their path. However, they are uneasy around large amounts of plant life, cannot grasp simple technologies, and get ill when in pure air.
summary: The ability to become superhumanly strong, agile, and intelligent while within a city's limits
strengths: Strong enough to bench a firetruck
Agile enough to freerun on the tallest buildings
Canny enough to outwit any normal person
weaknesses: Powers quickly dissipate as user leaves a city
Strength of powers relative to inhabitants of the city
Adversely affected by the presence of plant life and pure air

name: Newton's Third Law
description: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction unless this power is involved. Normally when a force is applied to an object and equal force is applied to what caused the force. With this power you can strengthen, weaken, or negate either the original or the reactive force.
summary: The ability to control kinetic reactions.
strengths: Negate the force applied to you when you use force on something.
Double the force of a blow to your opponent if they hit you.
Break through a wall because it wont react to your force to stop you.
weaknesses: Would fall through floor if the floor didnt supply a reactive force to hold you up.
Would easily break objects accidentally if power was not controlled.
People could be easily hurt just by touching you and having their force multiplied.

name: Power Cards
description: You can put any chosen powers into cards but there are four conditions. 1. The being who has the power(s) involved has to allow you to put them into the card(s). 2. The power is removed from the person (not copied) and is then pasted. 3. 1 power per card. 4. Anyone can then use the power the card contains ONLY while they own the card. FYI this power can NOT be altered at all.
summary: The ability to put powers into cards
strengths: Can help people who don't want to have powers anymore.
You can use the power the card contains.
You can use this on all your horrible powers and give their cards away.
weaknesses: Person has to be willing.
Power is permanently removed.
Anyone can use the cards.

name: Avatar Creation
description: This ability grants the user the ability to manipulate his aura and make a warrior 5x bigger than the person to cloak him/her. The avatar is powered by the persons aura/desire to win which can be good or bad. One can also generate weapons with aura as well, to be wielded by the avatar. The user can actually model how the avatar looks by manipulating his/her aura.
summary: The ability to create a warrior made of aura to cloak the body
strengths: You have a portable arsenal that you can summon at will
You gain a physical advantage when outnumbered
You can generate any weapon to suit your situation
weaknesses: The avatar is fueled by the user and he/she aura.
If the user becomes badly injured or loses the will to win the avatar will disintegrate into nothing
The avatar is particularly weak against aura or magic based attacks.

name: Staff Of Montezuma
description: This staff is made from coconut timber. This staff is bathed in gold and is covered in jewels. This staff can turn things into gold.
summary: The ability to possess a staff that can turn things into gold
strengths: You have more gold than Midas
You can feed a nation by turning a mountain into gold
You'll never be poor
weaknesses: This staff cant torn living things into gold
You are a gold maniac
Everyone will want this staff

name: Ventriloquism
description: With this ability you are able to project your voice from any living creature that is within visual range. When doing so the person or living creature is completely unaware of what is taking place.
summary: The ability to project your voice.
strengths: Create a diversion...
weaknesses: Making non-human creatures talk can be unnerving to others
If a person is asked what they said, they are unable to repeat it as they were unaware of what they had said while under control

name: Repetitive Damage
description: Whenever you cause a damage to something or someone, the same amount of damage will keep being dealt again and again. For example, if you cut something with a knife, new cuts will keep opening afterwards. If you punch someone, they will keep being struck again and again. The new damages are exactly the same as the original one and appear around the same area and outward. The frequency of appearance is linked to both the violence of the damage and your experience with this power.
summary: The ability to make any damage you deal repeat itself indefinitely.
strengths: You can deal great damage with a single hit.
Continuous damages can be increased. For example, the effects of poison can increase dramatically.
The effect continues even if you deal a new damage. So, you can overload regenerators and healers.
weaknesses: Useless if the original damage has no effect in the first place.
You need to be present, or else the damages stop appearing.

name: Aspect Humanization
description: A few examples of different aspects: anger, fear, happiness, jealousy, heroism, insanity, intelligence, ignorance, religion, future predictions and past self. The more diversified you are, the more you get.
summary: The ability to give different aspects of your personality human form to fight for you
strengths: They can have different abilities depending on how you see your emotions.
There can be a lot of them
The more you know yourself the more powerful you become
weaknesses: You can't be confused about who you are or they may attack you
You may only have one loyal aspect
If you ignore who you are it is useless

name: Animate Inanimator
description: A person with this power can change any living thing within sight into a non-living thing as long as the non-living object has roughly the same mass. That means you can change your enemies into chairs or even turn them into weapons that you can throw. You can also turn one animate object into multiple objects that are lighter. If you throw one, the other objects will follow the first object till the 5-foot limit and the creature will reform and hit the intended target-you can throw giants!!!
summary: The ability to change anything living to anything non-living thing and back
strengths: Change your enemies into chairs or multiple footballs and then kick them
Change animals into swords, clubs, guns, etc. To use against people further away
As long as the mass is the same, you can also change the person into multiple objects
weaknesses: If you throw the object farther than 5 feet, the object(s) will bunch together and reform
The power wears off if the object is 5 feet from you
As an inanimate object, the creature/person becomes indestructible

name: Avatar
description: It is like a secondary body for your brain. The avatar is usually a more advanced humanoid. It gives the user access to siddhis, a form of psychic magic. It lets the avatar use levitation, creation of physical constructs, use of the original five elements, see into the past, present and future, bilocation (split body), make the body impervious to harm for a short time, attain a higher level of consciousness. If the avatar is killed, the human body sustains a similar wound.
summary: The ability to create your own avatar
strengths: The avatar is stronger and more powerful than the human
They can learn to access siddhis after a long use of the avatar
Constant use of the avatar will let the human gain use of both sides of the brain
weaknesses: If the avatar is killed, it cannot be recovered
If the avatar is killed, similar wounds will happen to the human
The human may not want to go back to its human body

name: Vive Chacun
description: With this power you can control how long people live. From only 1-year-old to 1000+ years-old. As long as they die sometime. You can also control how they die. By "they" I mean anyone or everybody or someone or him or her, etc.
summary: The ability to control how long people live
strengths: Controling death
weaknesses: Cannot control how they die

name: Super Transformation
description: This power lets one transform into a more powerful being that increases ones overall fighting prowess and boosts existing powers. Drains a lot of energy; have to transform back when energy is spent.
summary: The ability to transform into an ascended version of ones self
strengths: Become more powerful
Everything is increased from its original state
weaknesses: Can use only once every day
Can only activate it when strength levels meet the requirements
Uses a lot of energy to activate

name: Genetic Conjugation
description: Unicellular organisms can perform an act called conjugation, wherein they take up DNA from a second bacteria. Individuals with Genetic Conjugation can also do this. With simple physical contact, they can 'swap' nucleic acids with a second organism--trading traits for skin pigmentation, eye color, bone density, muscle growth, etc. The traits do not appear right away, rather, they take a period of time to respond--the old manufactured proteins must be flushed from the system.
summary: The ability to trade genetic material with another organism
strengths: Trade traits for muscle density, skin pigmentation, etc.
Can pass acquired traits down to offspring
Can't be felt
weaknesses: New genes not immediately in effect
If a developmental stage is past for you, no genes will change effects of that stage
Cannot take up learned skills

name: Arrow Strike V2
description: With this power you can shoot arrows from your hand that can pierce through anything. You have an unlimited supply of arrows and the arrows cannot hurt you.
summary: The ability to shoot arrows from your hand that can pierce through anything
strengths: You can shoot arrows from your hand
You have an unlimited supply of arrows
The arrows can't hurt you
weaknesses: You can't make the arrows disappear

name: Medical Zone
description: With this power, you designate a zone to become a medical zone where only healing can take place and nobody can be harmed. While inside the zone any physical or mental harm will be reversed and absorbed so that the person is healed instead of becoming hurt. Also while in the zone any mental problems will begin to fade and physical imperfections will be improved. If within the zone long enough even limbs can be regrown. People inside the zone are immune to any negative force used against them.
summary: The ability to create a zone where only healing can take place.
strengths: No harm while in zone. Ultimate safe area.
Will be healed instead of hurt from attacks.
Mental and physical problems will be fixed.
weaknesses: Can not hurt others even if you wanted to.
Zone could become safe haven for criminals looking for safety.
Power negators can still do what they want.

name: Psionic Energy Armor
description: You are protected with your mind as you psychically create armor for yourself. Its as strong as a tank & boosts your strength. You can also shield people around you & vehicles you are in. Though all of this takes great mental concentration & if you sustain to much damage, your armor will become weak & fade leaving you mentally exhausted & unprotected.
summary: The ability to produce psychic energy armor
strengths: Create durable armor from psychic energy
Shield people & items
weaknesses: If taking to much damage, the armor disappears

name: Hibernation
description: You get hurt bad enough to be killed. No problem. Just enter a sleep state, heal, and come back. Also slow your aging process in order to live longer, physically much stronger, faster, and younger than normal humans.
summary: The ability to heal fatal injuries by hibernating and slow aging process.
strengths: Completely indestructible while hibernating.
Extremely hard to kill
Stay stronger, faster, and younger for more time than normal people.
weaknesses: Decapitation, instant death
You can be hurt as easily as normal humans, So train to be a better fighter/survivor
Hibernating may last days or even weeks depending on how badly you're injured.

name: Virtual Melding
description: For any amount of time up to 24 hours from started (with the same amount of time you spent using as recharge time), you can meld yourself with a custom character of your creation in a virtual world (gaming, online profiles, offline games. This character can also be fine tuned a tiny bit to fit you (make yourself thinner to fit the character hair length, type and color).
summary: The ability to for a time meld your self with one of your custom game characters
strengths: You gain their powers
You can look like your dream person
Good in fights cause you will always have the weapons and spells you like most
weaknesses: Someone else has this power and their character is better than yours
If it's a long fight you could lose powers after 24 hours and start getting beaten

name: Lucernae Marque
description: The subject is able to give a superpower to someone else drawing on his/her skin a luminous symbol by spreading his/her hands. The color and shape of the "tattoo" and the power acquired vary from person to person, and they are determined by genetic factors. Everytime the power is turned on the symbol will shine.
summary: The ability to give superpowers to other people by drawing a shiny symbol on their skin..
strengths: The symbol is removable, so the power is not permanent if not liked.
weaknesses: The process of drawing consumes a big quantity of energy and leaves the subject very tired.

name: Reincarnation Determination
description:
With this power you can access all the abilities of previous reincarnations and can reincarnate to whatever you desire as long as that person does not yet exist

You have "immortality" since you can't "die" just reincarnate.
summary: The ability to reincarnate into anyone as well as keep all your memories and abilities
strengths: If you reincarnate into a rich person you can leave your money to your next reincarnation
If you reincarnate into an individual with superpowers then you can have multiple powers
Spite your enemies by reincarnating into their offspring
weaknesses: You can still die
If you accidentally attach yourself to someone who is immortal then this power is negated
You can only reincarnate into humans or demigods, so no reincarnating into a god or demon

name: Scan
description:
This ability allows you to find out about every single detail about any one person no matter how irrelevant.
You have total knowledge of there strengths, weaknesses, attributes and other status info. But you must focus all your thoughts on that person.
summary: The ability to analyze the strengths, weaknesses and other info on anyone.
strengths: Know everything about a person.
Use persons weaknesses to your advantage.
weaknesses: Sometimes it's best not to know about someone.
Must focus all thoughts and mind on that one person.

name: Metal Manipulation
description: A user of this ability can create a construct with metallic minerals, create armor, control iron in someone's blood, dismantle mechanical devices. A user who possesses this ability must be in contact with the ground in order to use this power properly, being separated from the ground will abruptly halt this power.
summary: The ability to manipulate the Japanese element of Metal as long as you're in contact with the ground
strengths: Protection from Damage
Weapon usage
Constructs
weaknesses: Limited power range
Obvious weakness
Usage of power makes someone vulnerable to attack if not already protected.

name: Oblivion
description:
Using this ability, you create a force field around an area, however the larger the area, the more effort is required. You cause devastating explosions within that area that erase everything within from existance. 
Your supremely powerful with Oblivion.
summary: The ability to create a force field around an area, and obliterate everything within.
strengths: No limit to the size of area, that you are destroying.
Everything on the inside of the shield can not leave; and visa versa,
weaknesses: No way of reversing this power.
Larger the size of area, more effort required.

name: Relationship Manipulation
description: Relationship manipulation is the power to manipulate the emotional bonds between individuals, partners and couples. The user has influence over the emotional ties between people in the sense that they can both loosen and secure these ties. You can make partners turn away from one another, disband groups and friendships, but also can strengthen the bonds that bind one person to another. The effects of this power are long-lasting and fade depending on how long a person has been exposed.
summary: The ability to manipulate relationships.
strengths: You can get the partner of your dreams.
Build a dream team.
Get rich friends.
weaknesses: Unlikely, but someone can learn you're doing it.

name: Power Hold
description: This makes all your powers including this one virtualy become one with you so that they cannot be seperated from you, isolated, have their effects reversed by Forced Reversion or other powers, be under someone's control or be denied your access. You can freely use your powers even under hypnosis and you cannot be astrally or otherwise evicted from your body. Your powers can affect your body in their designated ways, unaffected by powers that cancel their effects.
summary: The ability to be virtualy one and the same with your powers
strengths: You cannot be seperated from powers, you can always use them.
Beat Omnipotent Power Blocking and forced reversion, or just reverse.
Works perfectly with Power Safety!
weaknesses: None.

name: Cancer Manipulation
description: The power is simple, power over cancer. The user can create cancer in him and other living creatures. The user can make the cancer grow to kill his opponents or make the cancer grow out his skin to turn them into tentacles.  The most useful part of this ability is that the user can remove it painlessly or painfully.
summary: The ability to create, control and remove uncontrolled division of abnormal cells.
strengths: Control cancer
Give enemies cancer.
Remove cancer
weaknesses: To the unprepared, the cancer the user put inside him could kill him.

name: Endurance Manipulation
description: This ability will go through some evolutionary changes before reaching the final phase. First, you will secretly drain the endurance from others so that you can withstand more things than anyone else. The next phase is when you have extra endurance, you can use all of it in a physical tackle. The final phase is the full on manipulation of it all. This will make you "INVINCIBLE" if you focus on it, and you can destroy your enemy by taking away their stamina.
summary: The ability to control the endurance (or stamina) of yourself and others through an evolutionary process.
strengths: Control the endurance of yourself and others.
Hidden Ability #1: If you absorb the endurance of those with a healing ability, you can have it.
Hidden Ability #2: If you absorb the endurance of those who are invincible, you'll be as well.
weaknesses: It is an evolutionary process.
Anything absorbed by this ability will go away in a short time.

name: Intuitive Duplication
description: People with this ability can duplicate any power or ablity that the user wants once its used against them by understanding how that power works.
summary: The ability to duplicate any power that is used against the user.
strengths: Can pick which power you want so you wont duplicate one that you dont want.
No limit on how many you can duplicate.
Have complete control over the power or ability once duplicated.
weaknesses: Can only duplicate one power or ability at a time even if the other person has multiple powers.
Must accually touch the other person to duplicate some powers.

name: Pan Dimensional Self Exchange
description: With this power you change your body into the version of your body from a different parallel dimension. You gain the abilities, skills, and weaknesses of the other version of yourself that you are turning into. When you change bodies you will have the clothes and personal items of the other version you are turning into. (If they have a sword with them normally you would gain their sword while changed into that version). You will not gain their personality however.
summary: The ability to turn your body into the body of one your other-dimensional selves.
strengths: Infinite dimensions to choose from.
Will have all the training of the version you are turning into.
If the version you are changing into uses any special items you gain those items.
weaknesses: Have to wait a short period of time to recharge before you can change again.
Skills get lost and replaced when you change into a different version of yourself
Will have to handle any weaknesses of the version you change into.

name: Strong Force Manipulation
description: No exaggeration, this ability may be the most powerful physics-based skill. It allows the user to attempt to influence the strong force--which holds together atomic nuclei. A person with this power could make objects disintegrate into thin air or make protons/neutrons from the environment incorporate into chemical elements and vice versa. Due to the power in the strong force, users can usually only influence objects through direct contact, with immense focus, and only temporarily.
summary: The ability to tinker with the interaction that holds protons to neutrons
strengths: Hold the key to a fundamental force of physics
Make objects float apart into airborne atomic dust
Make atomic elements exchange protons/neutrons with the air, transmuting them into other elements
weaknesses: Takes immense focus, much energy or effort, and direct contact
Usually ages user prematurely due what it takes out of you
Disintegrated objects snap back into shape immediately afterward

name: Rapport Inducing
description: A person with this power can get along with anyone by being in sync with them and become able to see how they view the world as well as developing mannerisms to complement the mannerisms of anyone they like thus inducing the other person to like them. This can be used as precognition in fighting since you can simply move along with their movements a la dancing. This power can induce trust very quickly and it can be used to gain friends and customers as well.
summary: The ability to be able to get along with anyone at will and build trust easily
strengths: Can see the worldview of anyone and be able to show them your worldview
Can become anyone's dance partner including the ability to dance to dodge people's attacks
Can get you into any group of friends you want
weaknesses: Just because you can get along with everyone doesn't mean you will want to
Harder to get along with multiple people at the same time
Cannot be in sync with two parties that have opposite viewpoints at the same time

name: Fire Empathy
description: Warming up used to be something reserved for athletes. A Fire Empath gains power from large sources of heat--a bonfire, a space heater, the blazing sun--and channels that energy into enhanced strength, speed, durability, senses, and reflexes. As a side effect, the user is totally fireproof. Of course, if there is insufficient heat no enhancements will be available, and cold will affect them more than most people.
summary: The ability to draw energy from sources of heat
strengths: When sufficiently warm, develop enhanced strength, speed, etc.
Can draw power from space heater, sweltering day, cigarette lighter
Fireproof
weaknesses: If there isn't enough heat, no powers
Cold affects you more
Might not know how much strength you have

name: Word Of Power
description: The subject becomes stronger and more resistant than normally possible everytime he/she hears a specific word said by someone else. This word could be every word spoken in any language or dialect. The subject can chose the word that activate his/her power, but only after a deep self-persuasion and autogenic training. The duration of the power is three or four hours.
summary: The ability to obtain a superhuman strength everytime someone says a specific word.
strengths: The word chosen by the subject could be ANY spoken word all over the world;
The word can be changed anytime.
weaknesses: The duration of the power is limitated;
The power doesn't work if the subject him/herself pronounces the word;
The effect of the word is not combined.

name: Shadow Kinetic Change
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them and direct the energy into the user's genetic code. This causes the DNA to kinetically move to the user's will. The changes only last on the amount of potiential energy is absorbed.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to cause a biological change of the user's body.
strengths: Change your DNA
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Strategy Affinity
description: This ability is very good for thinking- types. The user is capable of becoming stronger, faster, and more destructive when he thinks or hears a strategy or plan. The more complex it is and likelihood of that plan to work, the stronger the user become. The user will know how strong he got as well.
summary: The ability to become stronger when one thought up or hears a strategy.
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and more destructive.
Know that your or other's plan will work.
weaknesses: Complexity is Key to power up.

name: Conflict Style Manipulation
description: There are five known styles of conflict. They are Avoidance, Accommodation,Competing, Compromise, and Collaboration. This ability allows the user to control one or all of them. They can change people's conflict styles into anything else. They can make a competitive jerk into shy guy who avoids conflict. With more experience, the user could acquire new abilities based on the styles he changed to or on others.
summary: The ability to change and control one or all aspects of conflict styles.
strengths: Control aspects of conflict styles
Change others' conflict styles
With experience, gain abilities based on those conflict styles.
weaknesses: Beware the competing conflict style, it could be the most uncontrollable

name: Bibliokenesis
description: Also called: Literacy Manipulation  The user has the ability to manipulate all forms of physical literary objects that are printed, written or drawn (books, comics, magazines etc. ), including their physical forms/materials and anything written, printed, illustrated, or drawn in them.   In extreme cases the user may have access even to the media that doesn't truly exist, but is only mentioned in other media or imagined to exist.
summary: The ability to manipulate books, manuscript pages, and text paper
strengths: Transform a written word into the actual object
Trap people/objects in the books
Break the fourth wall and rewrite your own story!
weaknesses: User who doesn't have a book handy is helpless
Books aren't the most portable or compact objects.
Usefulness depends of the quality (fashion magazine vs RPG Bestiary) and quantity (single book vs li

name: Vector Control
description: With this power, you can change the direction of anything under the laws of physics. For example, you can change the vectors of bullets and forces like lightning. You can also change the direction of natural forces, such as gravity and air resistance, to make yourself a little faster as well as increase your own power by directing all the force of your punch into one concentrated point.  However, you cannot change the direction of aging since that falls under biology.
summary: The ability to control anything's direction
strengths: Takes 0 energy to activate this power and you can set to default to reflect back
Reflect enemy attacks
Concentrate you own power
weaknesses: You need to be good at math/physics to use this power at its fullest
If you are physically unfit, this power cannot really augment your strength at all
If you do not know where something is, you cannot manipulate its direction

name: The Opportunity To Learn
description: Once you get the power, your mind erases everything that you learn socially, but not at school. As you grow stronger everyday, things will be easier and come more naturally to you.
summary: The ability to learn anything that is possible
strengths: Awesome education
Smart creations
weaknesses: Need to sleep to rest the mind

name: Tactile Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to tell a lot about anything by feeling it. For example, it is possible to find a lot of secret messages on the wall comprised of words that have been previously erased, you can feel the indentations caused by the writing. I if the person is adept, they can use this ability to figure out the composition of the top layer of any object. In addition they can feel cracks on the wall to find an object's weak point.
summary: The ability to recognize patterns in whatever you are touching revealing aspects not seen with the visible eye
strengths: Can find secret messages on walls-even those that may have been "erased"
By touching some materials you can figure out what it is made of - including type of wood
Figure out weaknesses in a wall then attack those spots to break it
weaknesses: You need to have a reference to figure out what material it is made of
Even if you figure out the weakest part of the wall you need to have strength to break it

name: Energy Spike
description: This ability gives the user control over the energy that lies dormant in the body. By concentrating, the user can create spikes of energy throughout the body. If you can't fight, then you can use this power to strengthen your body by hiding the energy spikes under your skin. If you want to kill someone, then this is your power. And if you want to reach high places, then draw the energy to either one of your hands and place your hand on the ground or a wall and a spike or spikes will come forth.
summary: The ability to create spikes of energy from the energy that lies within one's body.
strengths: If someone had a gun to your head, you can kill that person or guard yourself.
Using the energy in your body, you are able to make the spikes appear anywhere on your body.
You can create a body armor from the energy spikes.
weaknesses: Using the energy spikes can take a major toll on your body, unless you train yourself.
If you didn't want to kill the person trying to rob you, then it was a mistake using your power.

name: Weakening
description: This ability i got from a reminder of Wabisuke from bleach... Whatever you hit/touch you can make it weaker by an amount that varies based on your choice. The stronger your power, though, the more you can weaken something.
summary: The ability to weaken whatever you touch
strengths: You always win physical fights
Can destroy almost anything in an instant with a touch
You would always be stronger than your opponent (weight lifting, hand wrestling, etc. )
weaknesses: Can cause deaths from making them so weak their body cant support themselves
Have to actually touch the thing you want to weaken (can't be something intangible)
Doesn't increase your own strength so you would have a false sense of massive power

name: Weapons Master
description: With this power you can know how to use any type of Weapon both magical and normal. You can also know how to use anything as a Weapon. You'll be a a master of the Sword,Spear and all Weapons and know how to use them. You can also know their strengths, weaknesses.
summary: The ability to know everything about any weapon and how to use anything as a weapon
strengths: How to use any type of weapon, both magical and normal.
Know how to use anything as a weapon
weaknesses: You can still be killed
You can still be killed

name: I Want...
description: If you say,"I want _____", then clearly state what you want, then you'll get it. Just make sure that you really mean what your saying before saying it. At first, you'll only be able to ask for things that you NEED. Then you'll be able to ask for things that you WANT (has to be something that already exist). If you get really good at using this power, then you can ask for things that you want, but don't exist. Remember, word choice is key!
summary: The ability to get what you want
strengths: Now you can have whatever you want
weaknesses: At first, you only get what you need
Be careful what you wish for
Karma

name: Physical Overdrive
description: This gives you the ability to temporarily turn off all the limiters in the human body. This means any and all physical limiters are gone meaning you have an insurmountable amount of strength and speed. This ability also takes of the limiters on the brain, allowing 100% of to be used witch in turn gives you superhuman level smarts and senses.
summary: The ability to put the user's body into a temporary state that breaks all the limiters in the human body.
strengths: Remarkable amount of strength
Unsurpassable speed
Beyond this world IQ and superhuman senses
weaknesses: Limit of use: 10 minutes
Going beyond limit will damage body. After 30 minutes there will be damage that can not be fixed.
Beyond an hour means certain death after leaving overdrive mode.

name: True Nature
description: This power transforms people into their true forms.  True forms are beings greater than humans that exist solely for their true natures. All of their attributes are enhanced, and human parts are more attractive. Each has multiple distinct abilities, and other general powers. Most appear half-human, but they can also appear nonhuman or human. Their bodies and powers are manifestations of their true natures, and no two forms are the same. Feel free to post a comment if you are at all confused.
summary: The ability to unlock people's true nature and release their true form. Read full description.
strengths: Enhanced attributes and tons of power for you or anyone else
Can use on anyone and still keep ability - even if you use on yourself
Transformations are awesome to watch!
weaknesses: True forms can be very dangerous
Never know what form they will take
TRUE NATURE CAN NOT BE REVERSED!

name: Shadow Damage
description: With this power you damage objects by damaging their shadows. This does not amplify force. Hitting the shadow of a building will produce the same amount of damage as hitting the building normally. Stomping on the shadow of a human, however, will have stunning effect. This makes it easy to fight people from a distance. You can also shoot someone without leaving the bullet inside of them. However, your best times are dawn and dusk. Midnight and high noon do not work well for you.
summary: The ability to damage an object through its shadow
strengths: Fight from a distance
Shoot without a trace
Stomp on heads with minimal effort
weaknesses: Doesn't amplify force
Only good at certain times of the day
May have to appoint a sidekick to hold a flashlight

name: Human Puppetry
description: A maximum range of 85 feet is the length of the threads. These threads can be made visible for the user's amusement. Each finger releases one thread and controls entire limbs or, for more advanced user's, entire sections of the nervous system. Each movement of the fingers is a movement of the body. These threads can only be severed through loss of concentration.
summary: The ability to create psychic invisible threads that attach to a organism and manipulate it's movements.
strengths: The maximum amount of 'puppets' is 500
It is not limited to humans. It controls all living bodies
No being can resist these psychic bonds
weaknesses: They are severable
The power exhaust the user and can even induce a coma
At some point the people you manipulate become emotionless and soon just empty shells of themselves

name: Skin Produced Diamond
description: With this power, you gain diamond's most well-known characteristic which is to be unbreakable. Your muscles become used to diamond's weight and gain superhuman strength.
summary: The ability to produce diamond from your skin
strengths: Your defence is flawless against any kind of attack
Superhuman strength
You can get richer by selling your home-made diamond
weaknesses: Your weight becomes astronomical!
You can't swim in water
And you're very very visible

name: Situational Defenses
description: With this ability, your body will defend itself against anyone or anything that attempts to harm you. For instance, if someone were to throw a fist at you, your skin may become razor-sharp. If someone tried to slice off one of your arms, for example, you skin would become extremely dense and simply ruin the blade. If you obtained any disease, your body would be able to easily defeat it.
summary: The ability to gain natural defenses based on offensive situations
strengths: This power protects your body physically, and mentally
You can take almost any type of punishment, and still be left without a scratch
No average being can cause any sort of harm to you
weaknesses: This only triggers when you're attacked, or your body is in danger
You can still be harmed if your body is attacked extremely quickly, or is extremely damaged
If anything can seriously injure you, you will be unaware

name: Carbon Manipulation
description: Can control only carbon atoms, however in order to control the atoms you must direct them with your hands. Takes a lot of concentration the bigger the object or the denser you are making the object.
summary: The ability to control carbon atoms
strengths: can kill in an instant
can turn skin into diamonds
control over most objects in the universe
weaknesses: overpowered
can't be used if you have no arms

name: Book Synchronization
description: This ability allows you to copy the abilities and skills of characters of books. These include short stories, manga, novels, etc. As long as it has been officially been published, you can use it. Also, you don't have to read the entire book to use it as a power, but it might be a good idea to do so.
summary: The ability to do anything associated with books and written stories
strengths: Use the powers of characters from your favorite books
Bring characters from books to life and have them fight for you
If you own the book, you grow stronger
weaknesses: You MUST know the name of the book
You can't do anything extreme (like being God)
If an enemy knows more about the book, you might lose

name: Expression Realization
description: With this power, one can induce a literal version of any expression. The expression "use it or lose it", for example, could be exploited to lose weight or strip an enemy's powers. The only restriction is the target performing the required action (in the case of depowering an enemy, not using the targeted power).
summary: The ability to manifest a literal version of any expression.
strengths: Creativity can give this power a lot of uses.
The more expressions you know, the more powerful you are.
Unusual; harder for an opponent to predict and therefore counter your attacks.
weaknesses: The target must complete a certain condition.
The expression cannot be made up.
The strength is the weakness.

name: Lie Detector
description: With this ability, you will always know whether someone is being genuinely honest with you or just giving you a line of bull.  You'll also be able to detect which parts of a story are stretches of the truth or near-truths, although you won't automatically know the actual truth unless the person tells you.
summary: The ability to know for certain whether someone is telling the truth or lying.
strengths: Have a much easier time trusting people who consistently tell the truth
Accusing people of thinking you're hot, then catching them in a lie when they say no
You have the ultimate upper hand when playing poker and negotiating with salespeople
weaknesses: Sometimes not knowing the truth is better

name: Superhuman Leaping
description: A person with Superhuman Leaping has a sort of specialized Super Strength. Instead of the strength being in the upper body, a Superhuman Leaper has enhanced leg muscles and bones. They can jump up to seventy-five feet straight up, 150 feet in a long jump, and they can survive most falls. They have no enhanced arm strength and no other superhuman attributes.
summary: The ability to jump great heights and distances
strengths: 75 feet straight up, 150 foot long jump
Can survive most falls
Good for escapes
weaknesses: No enhanced upper body strength
No other superhuman attributes
Confined spaces

name: Selective Intangibility
description: A person with this power can make selective parts of their body intangible at a time. For example, they can make only their head intangible to dodge a punch to the head. When a person phases through someone and becomes tangible again, their body parts will fuse temporarily through space-time until the person becomes intangible again. Objects grabbed by the user can become intangible as long as the hands are intangible as well.
summary: The ability to make only certain parts of your body intangible at will
strengths: Hostages can be punched through
You can make things you touch fully intangible
You can immediately make any part intangible, including the head, without any consequences
weaknesses: You cannot make your whole body intangible at once
You need to concentrate on which body part to make intangible

name: Metaphysical Change
description: This ability allows the user to twist another's ability upon physical contact of the person. The change is not harmful nor disastrous upon change. However, the ability will no longer be the same as the ability the other user had before. It will most likely be the opposite. The target user does not keep their old power but is bestowed with a new one. However, it is different from Power Bestowal (or anything similar) in the sense that a new power is not added to the user, only changed.
summary: The ability to force an ability user's ability to distort and become another random ability.
strengths: Change a potentially annoying power to something else.
Change an unwanted power to something perhaps useful.
weaknesses: The target's power may be... Even more annoying afterward
Need to develop new strategy to face new power.

name: Insomniac Strength
description: The longer you stay awake, the more your strength and invulnerability increase. When you are asleep or have just woken up, you are baseline human, but two hours after waking up you will be impervious to small arms fire, and able to throw people around one-handed. You become tired as fast as normal people, but stimulants can help keep you awake. At full power you could withstand a tank shell or a napalm attack, and benchpress a commercial jet.
summary: The ability to become stronger and tougher by staying awake
strengths: For most of the day you have considerable powers, and by night you're a serious force
Can take stimulants such as caffeine if you really need to use your full power
When you're so tired you can't focus in a fight, your invulnerability will still protect you
weaknesses: You need to shave etc in the first half-hour you're awake, before your hair becomes indestructible
You could be fairly easily killed early in the morning
You find it difficult to use your full strength, as you'll be very tired by then

name: Incognito
description: With this power, at will you can go completely incognito in an instant.  In a mirror you might look the same, but in incognito mode, nobody will recognize you, and they won't be able to recall what you looked like.  You won't leave fingerprints, hair, or any incriminating evidence for that matter. And, to make things better, you won't appear at all on cameras or in photos.  So go ahead, go incognito and rob the bank!  But just make sure you've hired a good getaway driver.
summary: The ability to become completely anonymous--nobody will recognize you and you'll leave no tracks.
strengths: Easily get away with certain things
Become a kickass spy
Avoid annyoing ex-girlfriends (or ex-boyfriends)
weaknesses: You might be tempted to break the law, and often
You can still get caught (however, they won't know who you are)

name: Half Succubus/Incubus
description: Someone with this power will have boosted strength, speed, and magical power though mostly for illusions. They will also have fangs, claws, a pointed tail, and wings as well as a beautiful/handsome appearance (no zits, smooth skin, slender, well-built, etc). They will also give off pheromones that attract the sex that they are interested in.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-succubus/incubus
strengths: You will always look good and never have to work on your appearance.
You can attract anyone you want for a mate
You always have claws to fight with if something goes wrong.
weaknesses: If you for some reason have this power but don't like people, everyone will be attracted to you.
Note: It would be half-succubus for females, half-incubus for males.
Someone who has no feelings or is immune to pheromones.

name: Manual Adaptation
description: Reactive Adaptation allows you to become immune to something after being exposed to it a few times. With Manual Adaptation, why wait? You can willingly become immune to threats as soon as they attack you! You can make yourself immune to high voltage attacks, bullets, and nuclear blasts as soon as you wish it. Also, your body and mind will become stronger as a result.
summary: The ability to choose your physical and mental weaknesses.
strengths: Be invincible!
Choose what can harm you
weaknesses: It's a Mary Sue ability
You must be aware of the threat

name: Talent Thief
description: If the victim has the ability to pilot a plane, when you use this power, you will immediately receive that power as well. Steal any abilities a person has (superpowers don't count).
summary: The ability to steal any abilities of the victim.
strengths: Jack of All Trades, Master of All
Never lose the victim's powers!
Become amazingly powerful.
weaknesses: Choose a bad person? You're stuck with his talents forever.
Ego.
Choose a person with piloting skill, cannot steal someone else's piloting skills.

name: True Luck
description: Someone with True Luck was born under the watch of fate, God, or some other power that keeps them safe.  They never get hurt, or sick, or cheated when it can possibly avoided.  It seems as though the laws of causality and probability will bend (if not break) to give them a shot.  However, it's also not under that person's control; and the powers that be are notoriously fickle.  They don't like it when someone tries to exploit them, meaning you can't try to win at blackjack with this.  Good Luck.
summary: The ability to exist in a perpetual state of good luck.  Sort of.
strengths: Nothing bad really ever happens to you, it's avoided in some way or another.
You will always be provided for, i.e. you'll aquire money, food, shelter... whatever you may need.
Various perks gained from 'good' outcomes that occur to you, as long as it was unintentional.
weaknesses: Nothing particularly 'good' can happen to you, especially if you try to plan for it.
Your definition of positive, and fate's definition, may not always match.
Since you're not in control, you may wind up being confused about what's happening and why.

name: Phasing Extension
description: The ability to go through solid matter without any harm. This ability also extends to other items, even when they are out of your hands for a short period of time. If you threw a baseball across a 20 yard field, within 15 yards it would uncontrollably phase back into solid matter. It depends on how strong or weak your ability is: If you are focused and have much, then the object will be phasing for a longer period of time.
summary: The ability to phase yourself and objects while out of your hand
strengths: You can phase
Other objects can be out of your hand and still be phase
The stronger the person, the longer the phasing effect lasts
weaknesses: The phasing of other objects only last for a short period of time
It takes concentration to phase an object while out of your hand
You cannot un-phase the object once it is out of your hands

name: Infinite Stamina
description: You can exercise all day long and never get tired. You can run a long distance race at your fastest sprinting pace. If you can do something once you can do it millions of times. Unfortunately you can't ever sleep. Also, you have to actually work for a while to be strong and you still won't be super strong. If you're slow you'll still be slow you just won't ever get tired. But if you put in some work you'll be like a batman who doesn't ever have to take a break.
summary: The ability to never get tired
strengths: You can exercise for hours without fatigue standing in your way
People who stand in your way will eventually get tired and give up
You are always energized and alert
weaknesses: You can't sleep
Requires work to become useful

name: It's The Thought That Counts
description: With this power whenever someone thinks of you you become stronger
summary: The ability to become stronger whenever someone thinks of you
strengths: Whenever someone thinks of you you get stronger even if they're thinking of you badly
weaknesses: The extra strength wears off as soon as nobody is thinking about you anymore

name: Photoshop
description: A Photoshopper can copy, paste, add effects, merge, change colors, and otherwise edit people and objects.
summary: The ability to modify just about anything
strengths: Retouch your face
Erase your annoying sibling's mouth
Select all the water in a flooding area and delete!
weaknesses: People expect you to fix their flaws
You can't copy and edit the power.
If you have no artistic talent, you might mess things up badly and not be able to fix it.

name: Ability Snatch
description: This only works if you are within, at least, ten-feet away from your "victim." Once you're near, your "victim" will lose their ability and you will be able to use it.
summary: The ability to temprarily steal the abilities of others.
strengths: You can negate an opponent's ability, without any physical contact.
You can snatch more than one ability.
You'll be immune to physical-contact powers (ex. super strength)
weaknesses: There's a limit to the amount of abilities that can be snatched (just like a normal thief).
Powers, other than physical-contact powers, will be difficult to snatch.
You'll lose your obtained ability(s) when you're at a certain distance away from your "victim."

name: Complete Physical Mastery
description: Someone possessing this power can alter and regulate their bodily functions at any time. Increase your metabolism to prevent gaining weight. Turn off your body's ability to register pain. Increase your body's production of lactic acid to prevent fatigue. Increase production of bodily cells for accelerated healing. Be aware of the position of the body, any diseases or foreign materials in it, their center of gravity and tissues.
summary: The ability to be aware of and manipulate all of the processes of one's body.
strengths: Enhanced balance, healing, reflexes, and instincts
Immunity to poison and being controlled
Total control over bodily processes (heartbeat, breathing, etc.)
weaknesses: Using this power to its full potential requires intricate knowledge of how your anatomy works.

name: Blade Manipulation
description: The power to control bladed objects around you including knives, swords, axes, spears, anything with a blade. The power also includes having the ability to protrude blades out of your body (like wolverine on a bigger scale). Can create armor out of the blades protruding. Becoming unconscious can cause an uncontrollable flurry of bladed objects which would have to be controlled by your mental will. This can also be cause by high amounts of bodily harm or trauma.
summary: The ability to control bladed objects and protrude blades from body parts
strengths: Can deflect and create a shield of blades
Surprise attacks
weaknesses: Losing control can create an uncontrollable flurry of blades
Unconsciousness causes bad 1
Can sometimes control body

name: Dislikes Disappear
description: Anything that you dislike about a person, place, or thing, you can get rid of. This power also works on yourself. Also, let's say you don't like your voice. It wont just disappear, but instead it will change according to your preference (in this case, whatever voice you would prefer or want/like best).
summary: The ability to rid any person, place, or thing of all the things you dislike about it
strengths: Get rid of anything you dislike like about a person, place, or thing
Things you dislike change according to your preference (whichever alternative you would like best)
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Exterior Materialization
description: You could change your skin (exterior) into any material you touch.
summary: The ability to change your exterior to any material you touch.
strengths: You could change your skin
You will never be naked
You couldn't be hurt
weaknesses: Careful what you touch
Can't really feel anything

name: Master Storyteller
description: You have the ability to craft amazing stories, most ideas you have you can flesh out into full stories. Be a best selling novelist or screenwriter, be able to think up the best alibi or excuse.
summary: The ability to entrance and entertain people by crafting amazing stories
strengths: Be a best selling Novelist, Screenwriter or Director
Entertain millions with your work
Live in luxury thanks to your works
weaknesses: You might prefer being in the limelight rather than a behind the scenes person
Fame might not be for you
While many will adore your works, there will always be critics

name: Man
description: Control movement, mind and bodily elements of humanity, as well as augment any natural feature of a human being including yourself, as long as you sit on throne.
summary: The ability to control every aspect of humanity
strengths: You have all humanity as an army, as long you had contact with them
You reduce backstabbers by controlling their minds so that they have undying loyalty to you
You can enhance any part of a normal human into a deadly weapon.
weaknesses: Does not work on animals, human hybrids or non humans.
You sit on a throne at all times in order to keep the humans you've met under your control
You will have to met them first

name: Triumvirate
description: You have the ability of flight, durability, and energy projection, but there is a catch. You cannot use all 3 abilities at full strength once. You can use one ability at full strength, two abilities at medium strength, or three at a relatively weak strength. Flight at its strongest allows Mach 2 speeds. Your durability at its strongest allows you to block virtually all physical attacks and most high energy attacks. Your energy blast at its most potent could level a city block.
summary: The ability to fly at extreme speeds, be super durable, and fire energy blasts, but not at the same time.
strengths: You can fulfill several rolls on a battlefield that you can change as the situation calls for it.
Using all 3 you could still fly faster than most, withstand low caliber fire, and shoot lasers!
You can be a Lightning Bruiser, Mighty Glacier, Glass Canon, Fragile Speedster, Stone Wall, and etc.
weaknesses: If somebody uses rock when you're using scissors.

name: Intelligence Mimicry
description: There are different types of intelligence. For example, there is Naturalist Intelligence or "Nature Smart". This ability lets the user mimic and add on to his amount of that intelligence for ten hours. This can allow the user to mimic the instincts of animals, the powers of those who can read minds or see the future.
summary: The ability to analyze and mimic by touch any creature's strongest form of intelligence.
strengths: Gain more intelligence.
Gain animal instinct.
Gain some psychic powers.
weaknesses: Each mimicked intelligence, instinct, or psychic power lasts for ten hours.

name: Muscular Enhancement
description: With this power, all your muscles gain a much greater degree of strength without being bigger. A child with this could easily lift two hundred pounds. You can also run, jump and climb faster and longer because your muscles won't tire out as easily. You can rip sheet metal. You also live longer because your smooth muscles work better and your respiratory and cardiovascular muscles keep you going longer. Your muscles are also immune to tranquilizers.
summary: The ability to have increased muscular power.
strengths: Live for hundreds of years.
Almost no effort needed for physical hard work.
Take longer to tire out.
weaknesses: Not a long-range attack power.
Immune to muscle relaxants at doctors.

name: Psychic Aim
description: It's almost like "spider-sense" or the movie Next with a twist. You get a glimpse of the future of your target and where they will be. So you already know where to shoot or kick or punch, hitting them perfectly. It mostly just works in danger-type situations, like combat. The vision, which seems long, is really a micro-blink. You also just have normal reflex so you barley miss getting hit cause of your power. The ability works up to a mile radius all around.
summary: The ability to have have psychic premonition of your targets in order to perfectly strike them
strengths: Can predict where to shoot
Fight your intended target perfectly
weaknesses: Only works in combat
Psychic vision up to mile radius
Normal reflexes. You only dodge attacks because of premeditated knowledge

name: Significance Manipulation
description: This ability can rearrange the importance or desirability any living thing, any object, any concept, and anything else including the user. The user could make make the ugliest of men the most desirable or the president to be as important as a bug that was squash. This ability can get specific in what thing is important to certain group. In a fight, the user can make their attack so significant in an universal prospective that it causes more damage than it should.
summary: The ability to change the amount of importance or desirability of anything.
strengths: Make anything important or desirable
Make anything unimportant or undesirable
Can increase damage of one's attack by making it significant.
weaknesses: Changing the desirability of anything too high will result in magnetic-like attraction.
Changing the significance of anything too low will result in fading from existence.

name: Wormhole Color
description: It's as simple as taking a can of paint and splashing it on the wall! If you make a similar painting somewhere else, you have a wormhole connecting the two markings. The colors have to match to each other, meaning you can have 2 wormholes per color shade. If you paint more,it cancels the first one you made. You can determine it the paint should be a wormhole or not.
summary: The ability to create wormholes with paint.
strengths: Teleport to places you've already been.
Other people can't go through unless you're touching them.
Get away from situations with a splash of color.
weaknesses: You need paint.
You also need to paint in the location you're heading to.
People grabbing onto you can use the portal.

name: Choshech (Darkness)
description: Black smoke clouds cover your body filling your lungs and everything you do is done a thousand times faster, stronger, and more powerful. For example, you can run 1000 mph, your skin can become as tough as concrete, you can also jump a thousand miles farther. Those are just some of the things this power has to offer.
summary: The ability to do everything a thousand times better.
strengths: Can run at 1000 mph
Skin is as tough as concrete
Are 1000 times stronger than you already are
weaknesses: You might hurt someone by accident with this power

name: Toonforce
description: With this power, you can warp reality for comedic effects, defying every law in existence for the sake of laughter. You can do anything as long as it is funny. Thus, the only limit to this power is if the action is funny. You can also interrupt fights with funny intermonologue and you can break the 4th wall. You also get a hammerspace full of objects to induce laughter. You can also survive getting flattened like a pancake. This power can only be used when someone else is present.
summary: The ability to warp reality to create comedic effects
strengths: Be like Bugs Bunny
Virtually unstoppable unless facing a superior toonforcer
weaknesses: You can only use this power in the presence of others
You need to be partially insane to use this power correctly
Sometimes you will look ridiculous, but you are supposed to be

name: Static Strength
description: With this ability, by touching electricity, you can consume it and gain strength. Your body also thrives with electricity, giving you a chance that you may shock someone. Feeding off large amounts of electricity will allow you to perform extremely powerful and electrical attacks. If you feed on too much electricity, you may hunger more and more for electricity until the hunger becomes unstoppable.
summary: The ability to gain power and strength from feeding off electricity
