strengths: Electricity gives you a boost in physical strength, and also gives you a lot of static.
It sometimes has a nice taste to it.
weaknesses: Feeding off electricity is addictive.
You could accidentally give someone a shock, even while not fully-powered.

name: Appearance Alteration
description: An Appearance Alterer is a government coup waiting to happen. They can reshape skin, hair, and vocal cords any way they want to; no color is beyond them. They literally smooth out someone's face, making it blank, then rebuild it in whatever pattern they please. They can also affect other parts of the body too, adding tattoos, adding or taking away hair, or even adding animal parts (claws, fur, etc.). The effect lasts for 48 hours, can be removed by extreme trauma, and cannot be used on yourself.
summary: The ability to physically alter the appearance of other individuals
strengths: Creating spies that look like people in the establishment
Making women hotter
Able to add claws, spines, etc. as weapons
weaknesses: Lasts for 48 hours
Can be removed by extreme trauma
Cannot be used on yourself

name: Pack Invulnerability
description: This is the power the flickerspawn have. This power requires at least one other person you trust and has trust in you. This power will work for up to five other people. This power won't work if you or a member of your group already has an invulnerability. This power works by touching each member of your group. All of you now are invulnerable. For someone to kill one of you or hurt one of you, your entire group has to be hurt or killed at the same time.
summary: The ability to be part of a group and only being able to be hurt or killed as a group.
strengths: Great for a team of heroes.
Great if one of your team can turn invisible or teleport.
Great if everyone on the team has super speed.
weaknesses: Bad for a team of villains.
Bad if your team is fighting in close quarters.

name: Music Induced Abilities
description: Music holds power over all of us. A person with Music-Induced Abilities takes that to the next level. When they listen to music, they develop an ability that varies with the genre of music. Translation? Classical music lets them create Force-Fields, dance music grants them Luminescence, rock lets them Induce Explosions, blues lets them Phase, metal gives them Super-Strength, etc. The ability ends as soon as the song ends, and it takes a while to kick in at first.
summary: The ability to gain different abilities by listening to different types of music
strengths: Put your iPod to good use
Different genres grant different abilities
Surprise factor
weaknesses: Ends with the song
Takes a few seconds to kick in
Loving the ability the genre gives you but hating the music

name: Were Anything
description: You can be anything or anyone ... if there is a full moon. You could change into a werewolf, but why stop there? Why not change into a super(hu)man? a super werewolf with wings and a suit of armor? Don't get carried away, because you could end up being an Abomination for the night.
summary: The ability to change into anything you desire under a full moon
strengths: Be anything
You could be super strong
It doesn't even have to exist
weaknesses: The transformations hurt the first few times
You may not always be in control
You will fell exhausted in the morning.

name: Movement Stopping
description: With this power, you can prevent someone from flexing specific muscles, causing them to stop dead in their track when they attempt to move these muscles. You can even disable complex actions, such as snapping one's fingers, opening a bottle or flipping the finger. You can only prevent voluntary movements, so you can't stop someone's heart, involuntary breathing or reflexes. However, you need to actively keep the effect going, or else, it will wear off.
summary: The ability to prevent someone from completing a movement.
strengths: You can even affect the muscles involved in the voice, to impede their speech.
Many powers require you to do certain gestures or actions, which you can easily prevent.
weaknesses: You can only affect voluntary movements.
You need to actively concentrate to stop your target's movements.

name: Soul Invasion
description: With this power, you can inhabit any soul-carrying vessel (body) and passively share its experiences or take direct control. Upon transfer, your memories and knowledge are carried with you, and you can acquire the knowledge and memories of your host. You can choose to passively join the other soul in its vessel, temporarily take control, or forcibly eject (and therefore kill) the other soul. You can exist outside of a vessel until you find one to inhabit.
summary: The ability to exist as a soul that can invade and control other bodies.
strengths: Immortality
Possibility of complete domination over others
Ability to be whoever you want
weaknesses: No body of your own
Limited by the physique of your host
No personal identity unless you live as someone long enough

name: Sugar Rush
description: One with this ability is often considered quite the lucky dog. With every bit of sugar they intake, they will only get stronger, faster and more durable. And if they take in enough, they will go into a berserker rage that tears through most foes with relative ease. Not to mention, they can intake sugar to regenerate, and no sugar they ingest will affect the body negatively (no diabetes, no tooth decay).
summary: The ability to gain heightened strength, speed, stamina, reflexes and agility with the consumption of sugar
strengths: Sugar you intake increases your strength, speed, durability, stamina and reflexes
Ingesting sugar heals you (and you can never get any disease/condition from high sugar intake)
If you intake enough sugar, it sends you into a berserker rage that can take out really strong foes
weaknesses: Berserker rage is just like ANY berserker rage (dangerous for friend AND foe)
After the berserker rage, you crash HARD
You can still be in trouble if your sugar is too LOW

name: Writers Faith
description: This power gives you the ability to make anything and everything that is written or that you wrote come true and happen no matter what, whenever you want, after you write down the words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " Note: in order to be able to use this power, you have to have faith in God, the Father who gave his one and only son to save us from the wages of sin, thus the reason for the words.
summary: The ability to make anything that is written come true and happen with your faith.
strengths: This power will work on any medium, whether it is paper and pen, a computer, a wall, etc.
Need faith in God, the Father, to make this power work.
Can make anything that is written or you wrote come true and happen.
weaknesses: Atheists are never able to use this power.
Have to be careful what you write for it will come true.
Words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " have to be exact. Including the " ".

name: Sensikinesis
description: Sensikinesis is the ability to control the physical and mental senses of other people. This comes in very handy when fighting a superhero, or villain, that relies on his/her senses for their abilities. Superstreght, for example uses the sense of touch. Say you where to take away their sense of touch, their powers would be rendered useless. It would be considered "Unfair" if you where dueling someone with hand-to-hand combat, it would be cheating to make your senses unparalell.
summary: The ability to control the senses of other people.
strengths: You could blind a whole room to escape a sticky situation.
You could paralise a person set on destroying you.
You could greatly increase your senses so you would be a unparalell fighter.
weaknesses: It takes a little to work, and do again. Much like you have to wait for it to recharge
If you increase your senses too much you could be too confident and misjudge your opponent.
Your powers ware off if you leave them for too long. About 6-7 hours they will last.

name: Age Control
description: This power through touch allows you to age a person till they are dead & dust or de-age to genetic ooze & anywhere in between. Either way, you absorb & extend your lifespan & minorly de-age yourself.
summary: The ability to age or de-age a person by touch
strengths: Control over age in another person
Extend your lifespan
Minor de-age in yourself
weaknesses: Has to touch & hold a person for the power to work

name: Splicer
description: The Splicer ability allows you to splice any thing living or non-living together. You can choose the new species' traits, defects and abilities.
summary: The ability to splice anything together.
strengths: You can make new species.
You can make the species' traits the way you want.
The species doesn't have to be all alive.
weaknesses: It could be uncontrollable.
It may not survive.

name: System Manipulation
description: A system is a set of interacting or interdependent entities forming an integrated whole. Put simply, this means different things working together for a purpose. Many, many things fall under this, if not all things. Now, all power must have boundaries and limits. The limits of this power is that the user must have a basic understanding of the system to be able to control it. For example, you could control your genetics because biology is a system.
summary: The ability to manipulate and control any and all systems.
strengths: A lot of power
Can do almost anything
weaknesses: You must have a basic understanding of the system you' want to control.

name: Georegeneration
description: A hero who is constructed out of rock or some other mineral can heal oneself using nearby minerals. Its appearance would then be changed depending on the mineral used. As an example, if asphalt is used in the healing process, a stronger, black body would be constructed. After a certain amount of time, the new body would shed away, leaving the default rock body underneath.
summary: The ability to be a huminoid rock hero who can heal using surrounding minerals
strengths: Potential immortality
weaknesses: Finding yourself broken without any nearby minerals

name: Master Of The Will
description: A more accurate way of describing this is the ability to not only continue to live but fight, exercise,think and so on through sheer will power. These people could be completely burned, frozen paralyzed, on deathbed, smashed, virtually anything and still have the strength to get up. Mental attacks are difficult, if not impossible due to this willpower. These people will never stop till their goal is complete.
summary: The ability to survive through will
strengths: Form of immortality
Dangerous even with body in pieces
Looks at the worst situation without fear
weaknesses: Won't look to good missing an arm and your legs
Give up and you die
May be covered with stitches

name: Shadow Shield
description: You are able to call forth a shield which can control the shadows and darkness. You can teleport through shadows and make them come to life. You also get night vision in dark places. You can only do this when you wield the shield. Your powers are stronger at night.
summary: The ability to wield a shield which can control shadows/darkness
strengths: You can teleport through shadows
You can control shadows
You get night vision in dark places
weaknesses: You need to wield the shield to have the powers
You are only stronger at night
Your weakness is Light

name: Surpass Strength
description: This is an ability that will even give Superman a hard time. This ability allows the user to gain strength to when fighting an opponent or obstacle and continue to gain more until they gain enough to crush them  You'll be able to take down any strong guys, even if those guys were actually stronger than you.
summary: The ability to gain more strength when confronting an enemy or object.
strengths: Able to defeat strong opponents.
Able to crush objects.
weaknesses: The only way to gain more strength is to go hand-to-hand with the enemy or object.
Trying to handle mind-blowing weight could result in a full body strain.

name: View Grower
description: When viewing a watermelon you can grow it without the danger of explosion. Or shrink it until you can no longer view it. Using an magnifying glass or microscope enhances powers. You can only grow people evenly. You cannot just increase someone's height, but you can grow a body part such as each leg individually to increase height.
summary: The ability to enlarge or shrink anything in sight
strengths: More food for less
Grow peoples body parts; cheap plastic surgery
Enemies can be shrunk to action figure size
weaknesses: Controlling it---overly sensitive power
People wanting you to grow there wifes breast's secretly
Trying to help starving people. Just can't get to them all.

name: Dragon Master
description: With this power you can control the mighty dragons even summon them from anywhere you want. If there a dragon you can control them but only if your stronger than them. If they are stronger than you they can break free and attack you. One who has this power after a time can fashion himself a dragon form with powers that any dragon they have encountered has even modify there own form to there liking in essence they become a dragon with a human form as well.
summary: The ability to control dragons.
strengths: Can control dragons
Can become a dragon
Can summon dragons
weaknesses: Dragon stronger than you can break free and kill you
May end up hated and or feared by those you care for
Might end up hunted by dragon slayers.

name: Ultimate Armor
description: With the ultimate armor you are invincible to anything and everything. However you can still be moved. No special powers go past the armor, not even spacial or time powers and it negates abilities that travel through a medium such as shock waves. Telepathy is also useless and objects on the other side of the armor cannot be controlled. The user can also go without necessities indefinitely. The user cannot move at all when the ability is activated nor activate any other abilities.
summary: The ability to materialize an unbreakable armor that provides ultimate protection
strengths: You are invincible to everything but only when your power is activated
You are very heavy so not many people can lift you.
You can "live" indefinitely as long as your ability is active and you can still talk
weaknesses: You cannot use your other powers when activated and you cannot move
If you deactivate it you can get hit, such as throwing them into a lake
If you stay in the armor form too long you will eventually lose your ability to think

name: High Hopes
description: Make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
summary: The ability to make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
strengths: You don't need to worry about getting your hopes up
weaknesses: What you get might not be as good as what you would have gotten

name: Crystallization
description: With this ability, a person is able to make crystals from any substance that is physically attached to the physical world (like leaves, rocks, skin, and even blood). The crystal material is like steel on the outside. If the user traps a person with this ability, they can decide whether or not the object will be crystallized or it being a hollow crystal and just trapping that person. The crystals can also vary in size and shapes. The crystal itself is very durable from the inside and out.
summary: The ability to make and control a variety of crystals and crystal structures.
strengths: Crystalize anything
Almost unbreakable to any attack
Can win a fight without actually hurting anybody
weaknesses: May lose control and crystal anything in a 5-mile radius
If not in control, anything the user touches will crystalize and disintegrate with it
Very weak to ultrasonic waves, and light, if pointed to the user, will cause temporary blindness

name: Hollowing Essence
description: This ability allows you to steal and store the essence of anyone or anything. This process leaves behind nothing but a hollow shell of the absorbed object. The stolen essence is stored in your body, but this ability does not give you contol of that essence.
summary: The ability to steal and absorb the essence of anything, leaving behind a hollow shell.
strengths: Steal essence
Kill any living thing
Get to keep the stolen essence
weaknesses: Hollow shell is left behind
Ability does not give you control of the stolen essence
Can be countered/resisted by certain abilities

name: Electro Shielding
description: Create a field of Electricity to cover your body and others. Very few things can phase through it without being destroyed or in pain. Does not hurt the weilder of the shield nor the people inside it. The shield may expand to massive size depending on the wielder's strength. No one can stop the shield unless inside the shield or The weilder gives up.
summary: The ability to create a shield of Electric charge and power.
strengths: Protect your self
protect others around you and love ones
stop bullets from hitting you
weaknesses: may hurt others
Dont use in rain. may electricute yourshelf
massive strength in a persons hands

name: Light Mimicry
description: The speed of light is 299,792,458 meters a second. A Light Mimic can become light and travel this quickly at will. When they travel, they have some control over their direction. Being sent through a prism splits them up into six different people with one mind. However, they can be washed out by a stronger source of light, can never completely stop, and are subject to all of light's natural laws (i.e. mirrors)
summary: The ability to turn your body into light
strengths: Can travel at 299,792,458 meters a second
Have some control over their direction
Going through a prism splits you up into 6 bodies
weaknesses: Can be washed out by stronger light
Can never totally stop/slow down
Subject to natural laws (i.e. mirrors)

name: Postscience
description: You can have knowledge of the past. You instantly learn how, when, where, who, why and what of the things that happen in the past. Want to know the answers to a test? Wait until the test is passed out, and you'll know. This power however cannot tap into the present or future.
summary: The ability to have knowledge of the past
strengths: Know history.
Solve crimes and mysteries.
See who was right in an argument.
weaknesses: Past only. No futuristic equipment? LAME!!
Involuntary
Don't see the past, just know it.

name: Subconsciencial Form Shifting
description: When this power is activated you lose your body and just have a body of no distinct appearance.  This ability has two modes.  1) You can pick something to look like (e. G. Hottest female) and you will look like that to everyone. It will be different for everyone, and it works even if the person doesn't concisely know what it looks like.  2) You pick a specific body from someone and become it physically, with all of it's attributes.  You can look at someone and know their version in either mode.
summary: The ability to turn yourself into things from subconsciences. Please read full description.
strengths: Immortality - Don't have to age or get sick or have normal needs in a specific body
Gain powers
Be the hottest person on the planet or your enemy's worst nightmare
weaknesses: Lose your body
Cannot merge or modify forms

name: Hyper Strike
description: With this ability, your attacks can be sped up to past the speed of sound. At that velocity, a hit with your fist could shatter any bone in your opponent's body or break through stone. Slashing with the blade of your hand or foot could slice through someone like a knife.
summary: The ability to accelerate parts of your body for devastating blows.
strengths: Deliver powerful attacks with any weapon that involves physical contact
High speed could also be used to block
Your body is extra durable so as to prevent you from shattering your hand when you punch
weaknesses: Can't be used for super-speed movement, as it lasts only a fraction of a second
Doesn't increase your reflexes

name: Heat Strength
description: With this power your strength level rises with the temperature in your present location. If you turn up the heat in your house you become stronger or if you travel to a hot place you become stronger. You also become weaker in the cold so if you're fighting a villain in the winter or in Canada or something you'll probably lose if this is your only power.
summary: The ability to become stronger depending on how hot it is in your location
strengths: You become stronger depending on how hot it is in your present location
weaknesses: You become weaker if it's cold

name: Life And Death Control
description: You might not be able to control your powers sometimes unless you practice a lot. When you are using this power, you might feel rage or love. The undead might attack the living people you are controlling.
summary: The ability to bring back the dead and control them, and control people that are alive too.
strengths: You could bring back the people you love.
Control anybody, even animals.
Be able to make your enemies do whatever you like.
weaknesses: You might feel rage and maybe go too far because of it.
The undead might try to attack you for waking them up from their deep sleep.
You might not be able to control your powers most of the time.

name: Lung Adaptation
description: Carbon monoxide poisoning, nerve gas, even drowning have claimed thousands, if not milions of lives. A Lung Adaptor never has to worry about that. Without even thinking about it, they can automatically breathe any gas or liquid safely: tear gas, water, etc. They can also hold their breath for hours--days--at a time. Unfortunately, this offers no resistance to ingested or skin-absorbed poisons.
summary: The ability to hold one's breath indefinitely and to breathe anything safely
strengths: Breathe tear gas, carbon monoxide, etc. without harm
Use nerve gas as a weapon with no fear of death
Win every breath-holding contest
weaknesses: No resistance against ingested poisons
No resistance against skin-absorbed poisons
Still as vunerable as a normal person to damage

name: Super Soldier Serum
description: Makes you stronger, faster, smarter, enhances your senses. Makes you an enhanced human, not superhuman (not smart enough to read or control minds, as fast as the Flash or as strong as the Hulk).
summary: The ability to have all your normal attributes increased
strengths: Makes you way stronger than an average human.
Senses are way more alert you can almost never get caught off guard.
Makes you way more durable.
weaknesses: All traits are increased, even anger. It increases irritability.
Cannot control powers, serum is part of you forever.
The super soldier serum shortens life, at most you can an average age of 35.

name: Matter Into Armor
description: The ability to touch any solid matter and it covers your body, turning it into armor
summary: The ability to touch matter and turn it into armor.
strengths: Can absorb anything solid like stone, metal, rubber and anything else that is solid.
You could absorb mostly stone if you were in a fight
Metal is useful for strong attacks
weaknesses: You can't absorb liquid or gas

name: Equilibrium
description: You have the combined physical prowess of whatever you're fighting. Up against 100 men? You'll have their combined strength, speed, stamina, agility, etc. However, with every enemy you take out, you're abilities decrease in response to the decreased enemy force. No matter what, your mental abilities remain the same.
summary: The ability to be the physical equal of whatever force you're fighting
strengths: You'll always be just as physically powerful as your enemy.
You can respond to a large variety of threats.
weaknesses: Your abilities constantly fluctuate.
Long, drawn out fights due to equal abilities.
If you're up against a physically weak super-genius, you'll most likely lose.

name: Sentience Granter
description: This ability gives objects the ability to be self-aware, talk, and move(either levitation or rolling/walking).  You can also take away their sentience.  All objects have a predisposition to their owner, they will attempt to return to their owner.  You can use this power to have money continuously come back to you.
summary: The ability to give sentience to inanimate objects
strengths: If there are no witnesses you can question the evidence itself
You can convince objects to work for you. And, if you lose them, they will come back to you
You can have the book teach you by talking to it
weaknesses: Some objects will have annoying personalities or destructive tendencies
It's weird to talk to objects and will freak other people out
If all the objects joined to take over the world.

name: Omnidirectional Blast

strengths: Talk to relatives or friends on the other side of the world to your physical body.
See if anything is happening dangerously.
weaknesses: You'd be in pain if people are currently mining out of you, an things like that.

name: Rare
description: Being rare is useful and enjoyable. You can be immune to mimickers because you can have the trait of being one of a kind. You can be protected like rare things so you can have wards etc. You can also use the rare things general attribute of being loved so that people are kind to you and will like you. You can also increase your value to people so many more positions are now available to you. Other attributes of rare things can also be valid for you
summary: The ability to manipulate the aspects and attributes of rare things in yourself.
strengths: Pros cant be negated.
It is good to be valuable.
weaknesses: Can be affected by power sacrifice.

name: Atomicity
description: Also called Indivisibility, one with this ability has a powerful defense. The user's body cannot be divided by any means. This means that his body cannot lose limbs, cannot be dismembered, cannot be vaporized, cannot have its soul forcibly removed, cannot have powers forcibly stolen and cannot have positive psychic links broken. In fact, it even prevents inconvenience with joint conditions, because the joints are designed to keep the body perfectly together, for the rest of the user's life.
summary: The ability to resist being forcibly divided
strengths: Prevents dismemberment, power theft and Astral Eviction (makes psychic links unbreakable)
Never worry about joint problems
Doesn't disallow Anatomical Automatism, Astral Projection or other voluntary separation powers
weaknesses: Doesn't prevent ALL types of damage (acid, fire, electricity, psychic attacks, etc. )
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a physical level
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a mental level

name: Sonic Bomb
description: You take a deep breath and blast the sound from your body. Your body will amplify the resulting sound in the area, making the blast bigger. The bigger the sound you make, the stronger the reaction.
summary: The ability to blow up an area with sound waves
strengths: people can never touch you as use it
in a life or death situation you can stop the bad guys
the military can't touch you
weaknesses: you can't use a big wave in big public areas
you have to watch your tone at people
you can't be too loud or you could destroy a big area

name: Entropy Manipulation
description: A person with Entropy Manipulation can control how focused the energy of an object is. If they decrease the amount of concentrated energy avaliable the remainder bleeds off as heat and the object can thus do less work; in simple terms, packs less of a punch. Bullets become hard blows, hard blows become light powderpuffs. While dispersal takes less energy/focus, concentrating energy requires much focus. The effects, however, are amazing; thrown pins can pierce a human head. Effects are temporary.
summary: The ability to make energy more usable or more dispersed
strengths: User gains command over integral natural force
Can disperse work energy into heat (punches into powderpuffs)
Can concentrate heat into work energy (powderpuffs into punches)
weaknesses: Requires basic grasp of Second Law of Thermodynamics for full potential
Much harder to coalesce energy than to disperse it
Objects that undergo dispersion warmer; objects that undergo concentration colder

name: Hole Creation
description: This power enables you to open a hole on any surface you're concentrating on, through a process of displacing its material away. Any hole you created stays open if you stop concentrating on them. You can expand the hole or deepen it, move it around or even close it by reversing the process and allowing the material to move back into place. Any object caught in the hole while it's closing can either stop the process if the material is too soft or friable, or be crushed if the material is harder.
summary: The ability to open holes through any layers of material and to manipulate them
strengths: Reach whatever is inside a closed container or behind a wall.
Go through any wall by creating a passage through it.
Trap anything or anyone by opening a hole beneath them.
weaknesses: Don't forget about your holes on the ground. You could fall accidently!
Only works on inorganic matter.

name: Selective Invulnerability
description: The user of this power can be only invulnerable to one specific threat to his or her life. For example, if a user of this power chooses to be invulnerable to being injured by physical contact, then powers like super strength has no effect on them. But if the get hit by a concussive beam then they will become vulnerable and get injured
summary: The ability to be invulnerable to a specific thing only
strengths: Invulnerability
weaknesses: Only invulnerable to one certain power
Easily defeated if weakness is known

name: Matrix
description: With it you can collect as much information about something as you want. You can also train or relax as long as you want. You don't physically go there as only your mind taken. You even remote control your body! It is in essence a computer / virtual world on demand.
summary: The ability to step into and out of a virtual world
strengths: Unlimited access to information
Play games in "reality"
Do whatever you want on the computer.
weaknesses: Your body is left in the real world
You die if your body does

name: Dark Wing
description: You can fly. Your wings can't be hurt but can be injured. In rage mode, your true wings would show up (from 2 pairs of black angel wings to 6 of them), and if you're fat, ugly or short haired, when in normal wing mode, your body will change, but it could hurt a lot!
summary: The ability to fly, defend yourself, counterattack the enemy and enter a "rage" mode
strengths: You can fly.
Your wing can defend you.
When your wing is injured, the blood that flows out burns everything it touches.
weaknesses: When in rage, you can't choose whom to attack, even if friend or foe.
When in normal mode, you get a little bit tired.
When the wings get in/out of your body, it's so painful.

name: Gift: Shadows
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling shadows and darkness than other beings. Thus their shadow- or darkness-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of darkness from them. However, someone with this power can only receive shadow-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of shadows and darkness
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over the shadows as someone with this power.
Shadow-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only shadow-based powers now.

name: Tolerance
description: This power lets you build up a tolerance to most things, even negation of powers. You have to endure the thing to tolerate it and this power can't be negated for obvious reasons. You can build up a tolerance to damage or poison, and tolerances last forever.
summary: The ability to build up a tolerance to most things.
strengths: Tolerance to negation.
Tolerances last forever.
weaknesses: Tolerance does not mean immunity.
Just a small tolerance.

name: Size Shifting
description: Having this power, you will be able to increase  or decrease your size. To being as tall as a 100 story building down to the size of a molecule. The drawback is that you can't grow & shrink rapidly or your body structure will become unstable.
summary: The ability to grow or shrink at will
strengths: Become a giant
Shrink to the size of an ant
weaknesses: can't size shift rapidly or body structure will become unstable
1,000 ft. is the max limit you can grow to
Cannot shrink past the size of a molecule

name: Fairy Maker
description: People often refer to a "(something) fairy" as a joke or expression to say something is almost magical. For example, upon learning that junk mail was very flammable, someone joked "it's like a combustible fairy visits my mailbox and gives me gifts". You just think of a description for a fairy (and any other details you want, but they have to be tiny female humanoids with brightly colored insect wings), its typical task, and snap! The fairy will soon visit you in the night to bestow its benefits.
summary: The ability to make a fairy for any task
strengths: Can get anything you can make a fairy for, and you can befriend them/have them serve other tasks
Have lots of little friends to call upon, if you befriend all the ones you make
You can steal their wands for magical effects, or eat them to regain health (they'll ALL hate you)
weaknesses: You can call upon fairies as you want, but their first post-creation visit is always in the night,
While you're in bed (though not necessarily when you're sleeping).
If you don't make it specific, they'll also delever gifts to other people, based on some criteria
tags: kind of creepy sneaking in like that

name: The Chamber Of Understanding
description: With this ability, all you have to do is state the words "I'll be in The Chamber of Understanding! " like professor Farnsworth fro Futurama. The chamber has a disco ball inside and different types of music that plays inside of it. The chamber has an endless supply of oxygen, the perfect temperature/humidity level, and blocks out distractions. The chamber is made out of a transparant, durable material that's harder than glass. Understand chemistry, the cure for cancer, world peace, and the truth.
summary: The ability to make a chamber drop out of nowhere that allows you to understand things better.
strengths: Understand things you never thought possible.
Be at peace within the chamber. No distractions!
You can understand very helpful and abstract subjects more.
weaknesses: Although it takes less time, it may still take a really long time to understand something.
You still need to study or you might not have enough information to understand.
Secret societies run by insane people might stop you from thinking and understanding. Thought police

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Double
description: With this power, you can separate from your shadow, turning your shadow into a duplicate of yourself. This shadow duplicate has your exact appearance, knowledge, skills, and powers. It can function by itself exactly like you would, but it is also completely obedient to you. You can use the shadow duplicate to be in two places at once, or you can double your chances of winning a fight. If the shadow duplicate dies, you are left unharmed
summary: The ability to turn your shadow into a duplicate of yourself
strengths: Two of you is better than one, be it for difficult fights or conflicting obligations
The shadow can do everything you can do, and it will do whatever you tell it to do
You are unharmed if the shadow duplicate is harmed
weaknesses: Neither you nor the duplicate will cast a shadow while this power is in use
You can only summon one duplicate at a time
If your shadow duplicate dies, you must wait half an hour to summon a new one

name: Diamond Mimicry
description: Diamonds are forged in the depths of the earth and are the hardest substances known to man. A Diamond Mimic can convert their body into solid diamond at will. They become extremely hard to injure, tireless, able to support great weights, and resistant to temperature changes. However, this diamond body has no super-strength of its own, only being able to support weight. Also, it has a flaw. Striking this flaw will cause them to shatter.
summary: The ability to turn your tissues into solid diamond
strengths: Become nigh-invunerable + tireless
Able to support great weight
Impervious to temperature change
weaknesses: No super-strength; only able to support weight
Diamond body has a flaw; will shatter if struck
Unable to swim

name: Diamond Tail
description: With this power you can grow a tail made out of diamonds. You can use the tail as weapon or to trip people. The tail can also be detached to be used as a melee weapon or to sell to make some extra money. Once you detach it you can instantly grow another one so you can have multiple weapons or make lots of money by selling several of them or you can do both and still have a tail growing out of your back.
summary: The ability to grow a tail made out of diamond
strengths: You can grow a tail made out of diamond which you can use to trip people or hit people
You can detach the tail to use it as a sword or sell it for money
Once you detach it you can still grow a new one
weaknesses: Growing the tail is painful (but detaching it is not)

name: Price Label Substitution
description: With this superpower, you can move the decimal point on any price tag. For example, something costs $250, but you change it to $2. 50 and BAM! It's yours for the new price! The best thing is, shop owners feel compelled to sell it to you at your price. They can't claim it was a miss-print. The only limitation to this power is that you must leave at least one digit before the decimal point. The lowest you can go is, say $2. 70. You can't change it to $0. 27.
summary: The ability to move the decimal point on price tags
strengths: Buy anything you want at a reduced price
Shop owners can't refuse to sell you the reduced item
You can buy a $5m mansion for $5. 00
weaknesses: Might become a shopoholic
You'll have heaps of useless stuff
You might get greedy/corrupted by this power

name: Quetzalcoatl
description: When activating this ability, you gain the following: superhuman strength, speed, near invulnerability, acute olfactory receptors, and keen sight. You can also metamorphose into a feathered serpent or a humanoid feathered reptile. Your claws are nigh indestructible and skewer through targets with ease. As a result of acquiring Quetzalcoatl's powers, your life prolonged a hundred years (possibly more). Your feathers can also be utilized as razor-sharp flechettes.
summary: The ability to bestow upon yourself the abilities of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl.
strengths: Virtually immortal.
Change into a feathered serpent for possible flight.
Serpentine anatomy/physiology offers higher elasticity and a tougher skeleton.
weaknesses: Still susceptible to attack. (still vulnerable to stronger enemies)
Limited shapeshifting.
Your feathers are dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Reflecting Shield
description: Basically, what happens is long-range attacks go in an almost full circle around you. Just enough so that they get returned back to the same place they were launched from. This works on all long-range attacks whether natural, supernatural, etc.
summary: The ability to make long-range attacks return to their users
strengths: Eliminates one field of combat for the enemy. Fields of combat: long-, medium-, and close-range.
All long-range attacks natural, supernatural, etc.
Returns the attack back to the enemy.
weaknesses: Only helps in long-range fighting.

name: Guardian Powers
description: While guarding things you will have superhuman strength, speed, senses, and invulnerability to make you into the best possible guard. It doesn't matter what you protect so long as you know what you are guarding.
summary: The ability to have certain powers only when guarding things
strengths: If you already have the powers in the description, you will still have them when not guarding.
weaknesses: Most likely going to end up guarding things for others.
If you don't know what it is you are guarding.

name: Lullatrick
description: With this power, if you sing any lullaby, you will put anyone (except those with a power that prevents then from sleeping) to sleep immediately. You can only sing at "full power" to one target at once, but the others will feel a little drowsy. It affects anyone in the immediate surrounding, even those with you.
summary: The ability to sing a lullaby able to put someone to sleep
strengths: Put (almost) anyone to sleep easily
Good to soothe a crying sibling/baby in the middle of the night
Also good if you are cornered.
weaknesses: Will affect you and anyone with you at the moment, even if you don't aim it at them
Might be a little difficult to choose targets if you are cornered
You do not get any knowledge of lullabies from this - if you do not know any lullabies, too bad...

name: Bio  Overshadow Proximity
description: This ability allows the user to make anything physical into an organic version of the user. Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this. The things that changed will bare similarities to the user like color of his skin or have his face, etc. The user is also able to telepathically control them and capable of giving them feelings. The things will stay that way as long as the user is near them. There is a certain amount of space that this ability affects.
summary: The ability to turn everything around you into the organic equvalant of oneself and manipulate it.
strengths: Make things be more like you
Control over them
weaknesses: You will have certain amount of space that this ability affects.
Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this.

name: Negativity Deconstruct
description: The user is capable of destroying things with their negative attitude. The more negative the user is, the more destructive he/she becomes. Positive attitudes will diminish its power. It will look like Phoenix's disintegration attack from The Last Stand and it breaks down all forms of matter.
summary: The ability to deconstruct things with one's negative attitude.
strengths: Destroy things with your negative attitude
weaknesses: Positivity weakens it

name: Bronze Skin Transformation
description: In bronze armored form, you have the strength, which enables you to lift at least 160 tons under extreme conditions. You have the stamina, which means that you will tire much, much slower than regular human beings and can continue exerting yourself for hours without tiring. While in this state, you also do not require food, water or air to sustain yourself and can withstand high impact assaults as well as extreme temperatures. You can even use your fingers to pick locks or safes.
summary: The ability to convert the tissue of your entire body into an organic bronze substance.
strengths: Bronze is a mixture between Gold and Silver.
The bronze skin is so hard and brittle you can bend anything.
weaknesses: You can't jump.
Won't be able to eat, drink, sleep, and breathe while in armored form.

name: Sleep Control
description: Having trouble getting to sleep? Don't want to deal with some annoying person? Want to stop bad guys before they even do anything? Then this power is right for you! Just think about making someone fall asleep, and they will! No matter their current circumstances, and they'll stay asleep for as long as you please.
summary: The ability to put people to sleep on command.
strengths: Able to put yourself to sleep.
You can stop your foe by making them take a permanent nap.
Get for revenge.
weaknesses: They can still hurt you if you don't use your power first.
They'll wake up eventually if you don't think of how long they'll sleep.
Only works on humans.

name: Pressure Vision
description: You are able to produce large amounts of pressure from your eyes. This allows you to crack slabs of cement, warp metal, turn lumps of coal into diamonds and even break people's bones. You can shoot it in bursts or a long powerful beam to hit from a distance.
