strengths: You can warp metal.
Turn lumps of coal into diamonds.
Produce large amounts of pressure.
weaknesses: You can only shoot in bursts or powerful beams.
The blast can only come from your eyes.

name: Elastic Anatomy
description: A rubber band is very hard to hurt. So is a person with Elastic Anatomy. They can distend their body as though it was rubber, allowing them to stretch over 1 and a half football fields in length and remold themselves into any number of shapes. They also have an extreme resistance to injury---explosives, corrosives, and even bullets cannot penetrate their rubbery form. They have weaknesses to extreme heat (uncontrollable stretching) and cold (a total inability to stretch).
summary: The ability to stretch and distend your body
strengths: Extreme resistance to injury
Stretching over 1.5 football fields
Never have to get up for food again
weaknesses: Extreme heat makes stretching uncontrollable
Extreme cold makes it impossible to stretch
Is possible to "overstretch", causing great pain

name: Force Back
description: There are no rules of force back and concerns about this power.
summary: The ability to force back any power as twice as much power
strengths: Throw back any power. ANY.
weaknesses: None

name: Emerald Armor
description: One can cover their body in emerald and can have a deadly punch. With the armor, you are hard to hurt. You also can form the armor to be deadly. For example, you can give it spikes, or form claws on your hands.
summary: The ability to cover oneself in emerald.
strengths: You look nice
You have awesome powers
Not much can hurt you
weaknesses: People think you are bad
People get jealous
People will try to steal bits of your armor to sell

name: Psychic Extension
description: Making solid copies of your body parts out of energy. It requires you to make the movements yourself and have the 'energy copy' follow. If mastered, it is possible to make an entire body copy. Generally the ability is used to mimic fighting moves from a safe distance, replicating punches and kicks. But it can also be used to handle dangerous substances from a distance. While you take no damage from a punch to a wall, whether or not the wall is damaged depends on your concentration of energy.
summary: The ability to make energy duplicates of your own body parts.
strengths: Manipulating things normally, without danger due to a lack of proximity
No physical damage in combat
Can be used as a limited form of telekinesis
weaknesses: The action must be made by the weilder for the energy counterpart to follow
Limited range - about 15 feet, any further out and the less strength the extension has
No feedback - you have to see the extension to know if you punched an enemy or picked up something

name: Hormokinesis
description: For those who don't know this, hormones are chemicals that are released in the body with different effects. Pheromones are chemicals that are giving off from the body as a warning sign or an atempet to attract a mate. This ability gives many gifts. First you could control the hormones in your own body. Releasing more testoserone to build more muscles is one example. Or you could pheromones to attract a date, or making your enemies wary of you.
summary: The ability to control hormones and pheromones.
strengths: Very useful
Can decrease hormones to cause unconciousness or even death
weaknesses: Its hard to reverse any changes you've done to yourself

name: Regenerative Duplication
description: Every bloody piece of you has the ability to quickly regenerate into a fully grown superpowered you once it is seperated from your body. The level of power the new versions of you will have depends on how much you cut off. A slice of your skin will give you a sidekick power like Pie or Forced Standing. Teleportation, Invulnerability or Telekinesis will cost you an arm and a leg. They are all you, you are central point watching & guiding their every move.
summary: The ability to hack off pieces of your body which become superpowered copies of you
strengths: Create a superpowered army of yourself that you control.
You will be able to experience every superpowered adventure without being in harm's way.
The more important the body part the more powerful a copy you make
weaknesses: You have a fast healing factor but it will be painful & it will be messy
You will feel all the pain your copies feel in the part they originated from
The death of one of your copies will always haunt you. You will always feel like they are here.

name: Cartoon Affect
description: Survive any disaster that might come across like cartoon chacters do. Recover life threatening injuries.
summary: The ability to survive disasters like in cartoons
strengths: Almost invulnerable
Super recovery
weaknesses: May have your physical shape altered in order to survive.

name: Plasma Energy Fists
description:
This ability you must clench your fist and focus for them to be trans-fused in plasma energy.
You can shoot plasma energy at opponents and punch opponents with fists severely damaging them with the plasma energy surrounding fists.
summary: The ability to clench your fists into a plasma energy
strengths: Shoot out the plasma energy
Touching opponents will burn them with the plasma energy.
weaknesses: Touching yourself with plasma fists will burn you.
Don't want to touch someone you care about with this ability active.

name: Hall Of Armor
description: The ability to use any armor in iron mans vault or in the universe.
summary: The ability to use any armor in iron mans vault or in the universe.
strengths: Its limitless
You have the weapons
weaknesses: One at a time
Its hard to master

name: Molecular Orbing
description: The user has blank molecules (that vary in size) floating around them. When the user conjures them up, they are able to make any element on the periodic table and then mnipulate them. However, with this form of orbing, you must have knowledge about elements.
summary: The ability to create elements using your molecular orbs
strengths: Make a toxic gas to kill a group of people
Make a steel shield or sword
Create oxygen while underwater
weaknesses: No knowledge, no power
Can only make elements that exist
The elements you create lose their molecular bond, so be wary

name: Plans Within Plans
description: With this power, the user can make a plan that will out trick, out think, and out plan the enemy.
summary: The ability to come up with a clever plan which contains another clever plan.
strengths: Great for traps, and back up plans. (if you need them)
weaknesses: If you're enemy can read minds, you're screwed.

name: Affinity Change
description: Affinities are the things that, in the superpower world, makes someone stronger. A normal user usually has one or two, but this ability can allow the user to change his affinity. This makes him able to be powered- up anything he wants.
summary: The ability to change one's affinity at will.
strengths: Change your affinity
Gain strength, speed, and possibly other abilities
weaknesses: Can only have one affinity at a time.
Can only gain a certain amount of power

name: Immunity Mimicry
description: This ability makes the user to copy what anyone or anything else is immune too. This also works on what they are selectively invulnerable too. With this, a user change from survivor to immortal if they find the things to copy. Find out what selective invulnerability on http://powerlisting.wikia.com/wiki/Selective_Invulnerability.
summary: The ability to mimic other things' immunities or selective invulnerabilities.
strengths: Gain different Immunities
Gain different invulnerabilities
Pass on some immunities to something else.
weaknesses: There are some immunities that you mightnot want

name: Fist Scanner V3
description: With this power you will be able to know what an object is made up of just by pointing your fist at it. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to know what an object is made of just by pointing your fist at it
strengths: You can know what an object is made up of just by pointing your fist at it
You can discover the secret formula of the krabby patty
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Experience Pull
description: The user feels any experience coming at them. They would know potentially bad experiences even when they aren't obvious. By reading the experience, one could gain knowledge about something, like watching a video and learning about something.
summary: The ability to sense the type and strength of an experience around you.
strengths: Could "go through" a role like being a celebrity, writer, athlete, etc.
Could learn information by reading the knowledge tied to an experience.
Could possibly sense any bad experiences that are near the user.
weaknesses: One might start to feel overwhelmed by the experiences around the user.
A fear of bad experiences could develop.

name: Sorted
description: With this power you can organize a group of objects or names or words or people or anything into neat categories or patters. This power also provides you with multiple suggestions for categorization and whatnot.
summary: The ability to instantly organize things into categories or patterns
strengths: You instantly know how to sort things.
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat.

name: Element Matter Asorber
description: This ability allows you to touch any type of element or matter and absorb and you gain its properites. It could then be made into body armor. It only comes out as a thin coating of the material you touch.
summary: The ability to touch any matter and absorb it.
strengths: You could turn into any type of material you want.
You could have any properites of the material you touch.
weaknesses: It only comes out as a thin coating of the material you touch.
It can only protect you for a little while, unless you are weakened.

name: Vital Amplification
description: With the consumption of different vitamins and minerals, you have the ability to attain enhancement through the nature of the source of nutrient consumed. The enhancement may extend beyond measures depending on the amount of serving the user consume. Examples of the  enhancements consist of Vitamin A improving sight, and accelerate healing process as well as internal infections due to the antioxidants. Minerals like Iron, and Zinc will enhance endurance and durability. The list goes on...
summary: The ability to enhance multiple physical and mental attributes through consumption of vitamins and minerals
strengths: 1-Can of a Monster Energy can dramatically enhance a user's abilities to the limits.
Become Superhuman on every level to having Super; Strength, Durability, Reflexes, and Intelligence
Immune to Vitamin Poisoning
weaknesses: Enhancements only last for up to 12 hours from the time consumed

name: Empathic Amplification
description: Also called Emotion Amplification, Emotion Amplifying or Emotion Heightening, this ability allows you to make a subject's current emotions stronger. With this power, you can make angry people irrationally irate, make fearful people hysterical and paranoid, or even make sad foes depressed enough to want to commit suicide. You can even heighten their emotions to the point that they're incapable of functioning AT ALL.
summary: The ability to amplify emotions
strengths: Heighten positive emotions in allies; Heighten negative emotions in foes
If a person thinks you're cute, turn it into full-out undying love; if people are mad, make 'em riot
Heighten emotions even to the point of immobilizing them or sending them into shock
weaknesses: Can't otherwise manipulate emotions
Can't compel anyone whose emotions you manipulate (make them REALLY mad, and then what? )
Can't perceive emotions like TRUE Empathy

name: Human Inertia
description: A compromise between immovability and unstoppability. When activated, your body's inertia will dramatically increase, but not to infinity, making it very difficult to change its speed, its direction of movement and its rotation, even for you. Only strong enough forces, especially if they are continuous, can significantly affect you. This ability works down to the molecular level, making you near invulnerable to sudden and brief external forces. It doesn't affect bodily functions
summary: The ability to be very difficult to move and very difficult to stop or change direction when moving.
strengths: You're nearly as unstoppable as the Juggernaut and nearly as immovable as the Blob.
Your body gains a lot of inertia, including rotational inertia, without gaining any mass.
You also have some form of invulnerability.
weaknesses: You're not completely unstoppable, nor completely immovable.
Continuous external forces can affect you and cause damage to your body.

name: Item Merging
description: Like by merging guns with your arm, your arm can then become multiple guns in one. This can be used with anything.
summary: The ability to merge objects with yourself.
strengths: Pretty good combinations.
weaknesses: Guns can run out of ammo.
There are some bad combinations out there.

name: Superman Spell
description: With this ability, you can give yourself or others Superman's powers. The difference is that you get to vary up the source of power. If it's a rock, you'll be at 20% strength; if it's a nuclear reactor in New Mexico, you'll be at 120% strength. This allows you to bestow and remove the powers at will, and if someone abuses the power you give them, you can reduce it or take it away!
summary: The ability to cast a spell to give yourself or others Superman's powers.
strengths: Become a different version of the man of steel (Sentry, Hancock, etc. )
Give yourself and others superpowers!
weaknesses: Some of the empowered may not be so noble
Power supply may become obvious
Making disposable items a power source

name: Weredragon
description: Whenever you are scratch or bitten by a baby dragon that hatches out of its egg, you are able to transform youself into a humanoid dragon which includes a serpentine body with large arms, can have fire-breathing capabilities, superhuman strength, able to resist penetration by small caliber bullets, and able to breathe fire onto your enemies.
summary: The ability to transform into a strong, fire-breathing humanoid beast.
strengths: Can also fly.
May attack your foe with a long tail.
weaknesses: Can get killed by a sword to the heart.

name: Nano Re Animator
description: Your body makes re-animation nanites. You touch someone to inject them. Nano-reanimates retain full IQ and can heal and stop decay and aging. Limb reattachment is possible. Those who use technology powers can affect nano-reanimates. If a nano-reanimate has technology powers of his own, then this is no problem. Nano-reanimates do occasionally need to ingest the raw material their nanites are made of to stay nano-reanimated.
summary: The ability to re-animate newly dead people using nanites.
strengths: Better re-animation through nanotechnology.
You can't nano-reanimate yourself, but someone else could.
weaknesses: A nano-reanimate lacks technology-control powers.

name: Avatar Condition
description: An avatar is a higher force, like a god or idea, in human form. They can be strength incarnate, evil incarnate, Vishnu incarnate, the fighting spirit of their homeland incarnate, or any one of a hundred different descents. Those that do discover the truth about themselves can command all of their idea's power. For example, a Strength Avatar could be as strong as all humanity. These Avatars may have specific weaknesses; damaging their souces usually weakens them personally.
summary: The ability to be the physical representation of an idea or concept
strengths: Can be one of a thousand descents (Vishnu, evil, intelligence)
Commands all of their given idea's force
One in a long chain of similar avatars
weaknesses: May not discover the truth about self
Idea has a huge command over your personality
Have a specific weakness, usually the source of your powers

name: Blademancy
description: Produce blades of any size from your palms, such as daggers, throwing knives, katanas, hook swords, dual swords, and broad swords.
summary: The ability to produce swords and daggers from your hands.
strengths: Can break out of a trap.
Swords are indestructible.
weaknesses: When you first get the power, it is unpredictable.

name: Binary Vascular System
description: You possess two hearts, each even stronger than that of a long-distance Olympic runner, which work in conjunction to pump blood around the body. Your heartbeat is therefore as low as 10 beats a minute, and your circulation is far better than normal humans. When under extreme stress or during an adrenaline burst, your hearts combined beat far faster than any human's could, and safely as well.
summary: The ability to have two hearts working together
strengths: You are far stronger, fitter and faster than normal humans
Attacks to the heart (e.g. being stabbed) will miss, as their locations are off
If one heart stops beating, you can survive without difficulty with the other, until you restart it
weaknesses: If both hearts go into cardiac arrest, they must both be restarted
Doctors unaware of your condition could easily kill you when performing surgery
Your speed and strength has limits, and is not a lot above top human levels

name: Half Dragon (European)
description: 'Half Dragon' is similar to but different than this power. First,you can only spit fire from your mouth instead of ignite it anywhere on your body. Also,your skin is covered with scales except for your face,you have claws and fangs instead of nails and canines,you have horns coming out from the sides of your head,and you have wings that are proportional to your body. Not only that but your intelligence,strength,speed and magical power are all well beyond that of an ordinary human's.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-dragon
strengths: You have higher physical and magical attributes than most humans.
You could do well as a blacksmith considering that the fire you spit out is at a high tempurature.
weaknesses: A full dragon can still defeat you in all-out physical combat with no allies and no weapons.
Due to the horns and wings, you definitely do not look human and may be mistaken for a demon.

name: One Size Fits All
description: With this power you can make any article of clothing fit you just by putting it on (or trying to put it on). The article of clothing remains your size until you take it off then it reverts to its original size until you put it on again.
summary: The ability to make any article of clothing fit you perfectly
strengths: You can make any article of clothing fit you
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Sense
description: You know where all the mythological creatures in the area are. You can sense them up to a hundred miles.
summary: The ability to sense where mythological are located
strengths: Prove or unprove hypotheses about mythological beings.
Capture and sells the animals.
weaknesses: Jurassic Park like situations.

name: Intuitive Weakness Sensing
description: A person who has this ability would be able to size up an opponents and objects in a quick glance, allowing them to know immediately their pressure points, soft spots, and generally all the places where they would rather not be hit and/or where the most damage can be done..
summary: The ability to detect weak points in objects and people
strengths: Able to sense any skeletal damage
Able to detect a bad leg or such
Able to efficiently deal with such a person
weaknesses: No superhuman strength
Cannot work on non-biologicals
No special fighting prowess

name: Remote Contact
description: If you want to touch a person or an object but they are out of reach, you just have to reach in front of you and you will feel them and act on them like they are right here. So, you can effectively push, punch, grab, kick, and all from a distance. Furthermore, you can extend this ability to any object you're holding. So, you can stab with a knife, burn with a flame, knock with a blunt object from very far away! It works no matter the distance, but only if your target is within your visual field.
summary: The ability to make physical contact with a distant object or person no matter the distance
strengths: Turn close-range attacks into long-range attacks
You can attack people without them knowing from where the attacks came from
No need to precisely aim since faraway targets are much "closer than they appear"
weaknesses: Your enemies could try to hide or get in your blind spot
You can still get hurt by the object or the person the moment you make contact with it

name: Money Maker
description: This is very similar to "Money Controller", except with this you can go anywhere and make as much of their currency as you want or need. Unlike counterfeit, you just have to touch the actual currency and your skin will analyze everything about it and copy it 100%.
summary: The ability to make any kind of money, from different countries or different worlds
strengths: You will be rich anywhere
Buy anything you want
Use your money to help the world, like poverty
weaknesses: Massive inflation within the economy
A lot of people might try to rob you
It will be hard to trust anyone or have a person who likes you for you

name: Chi
description: Martial artists gain superhuman capabilities by learning to harness chi. This type of method generally provides extraordinary strength, speed, durability, and reflexes. Also often used for superhuman awareness, energy blasts, elemental powers, and sometimes invulnerability.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman capabilities by learning to harness chi.
strengths: You could enhance your abilities to extraordinary levels.
You would be able to increase your strength.
You would be capable of running and moving at speeds greater than even the finest Olympic sprinter.
weaknesses: You would have to learn martial arts.
Your stamina would be limited.
You would still be vulnerable to injury

name: The Superpower List Choice
description: Pick any power from the "superpower list" and you can have it! But you only get one, so choose wisely. Luckily for you, the "superpower list" is full of awesome superpowers! Also, let me note that if the user got to have more than one superpower, his or her strength would have to be divided into the superpowers, making them weaker, but because the user only gets one superpower, that power is at its greatest strength!
summary: The ability to pick any ONE power from the "Superpower List" and attain it
strengths: Pick any power from the "superpower list" and you can have it
Because the user only gets one superpower, that power is at its greatest strength!
The "superpower list" is full of awesome superpowers
weaknesses: You only get one, so choose wisely

name: Charisma
description: Being liked is something that we all want. A person with Charisma can make people to feel friendly toward them for no apparent reason. This can range to anyone they choose to extend it to, even sworn enemies. Perhaps more sinisterly, this can be forced, making your target hang on their every word and thus be willing to do anything for them. Skilled telepaths might be able to detect the ability when it's being used, but only the strong-willed can resist it.
summary: The ability to make people feel good toward you
strengths: No shortage of friends
Can even be extended to sworn enemies
Anything from warm fuzzy feeling to slavish devotion
weaknesses: May be tempted to use for evil
Can be detected by Telepaths
Can be resisted by the strong-willed

name: Ultimate Weapon(Shield)
description: A person with this power has the ability to create an unbreakable and unstoppable physical shield that floats in the air in front of their field of vision. The shield negates any type of superpower used against it. It moves with the user and can be used as a battering ram. Besides the shield in the front, the user can also create additional shields in any direction. Shields are unmovable after creation but can disappear at will. The shield can be any design the user wants, except being small.
summary: The ability to have a giant unbreakable and unstoppable shield floating in front of you
strengths: You can make multiple shields
A good offense and defence
It negates any superpowers that try to pass to the other side
weaknesses: You can't see past the shield (it also negates your x-ray vision)
You might hit allies-see con 1
If you don't like having a big thing blocking your way

name: Shockwave Transfer
description: This ability allows the user to transfer energy out of his or her body into another person or object, internally damaging the person's bones and organs, or destroying the objects inside. At higher mastery levels, the user can liquefy organs or shatter bones, or cause inorganic things to explode or even implode. At the highest level, the user can use the kinetic energy around them to generate the shockwave, instead of their own energy. Must come into physical contact to use.
summary: The ability to damage organic and inorganic things internally
strengths: Pierces all defenses.
Can use energy in environment for shockwave at higher level of mastery.
Extremely powerful.
weaknesses: Must come into physical contact with object/creature.
Need to use your own energy at lower-mid levels of mastery.

name: Rpg Class
description: With this power you are able to take on the aspects of any fantasy RPG class such as those found in World of Warcraft and Diablo. You do not have to acquire the same abilities and can learn your own unique powers as long as you stay within the theme of the class. You are allowed to have multiple "accounts" of classes which you are allowed to switch between, but you must level each separately. Class armor can also be obtained as you level up a class.
summary: The ability to level up as a fantasy Role Playing Game class character.
strengths: Many Classes to choose from, and many abilities to be learned.
Can have multiple "accounts" to switch between many classes.
Can obtain class armor to increase your powers if you level up high enough.
weaknesses: Limited to staying within the theme of each class.
Each RPG class "account" has to be leveled separately.
Level Cap is 100.

name: Name Strength V2
description: With this power whenever you say a person's first and last name they will gain superhuman strength and invulnerability for 24 hours. You don't have to be near the person or even ever have met the person.
summary: The ability to give other people strength by saying their name
strengths: You can give people super strength by saying their name
weaknesses: You cannot use this power on yourself

name: Mad Genius
description: With this power the angrier you are the more intelligent you will become. Frustration and anger will make you a master strategist, scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician & musician. Your IQ will be immeasurable.
summary: The ability to let your anger fuel your brain, intellect and intelligence
strengths: Anger increases your brainpower, let your ire grow until you have no intellectual rival
Their will be no code, crime or strategy you couldn't unravel
If angered enough you could outmatch any intellect, machine
weaknesses: Only happens when you are angry
Unangered you are prone to absent-mindedness
Brain matter may constantly grow to grotesque proportions

name: Dermal Microspines
description: This ability allows you to form small (nearly microscopic) spines anywhere on your skin. The spines are nearly indestructible and sharp. These small spines can produce a multitude of effects. They can allow you to cling to walls, use your skin like sandpaper to harm your opponents by tearing skin, or even allow them to break off in your opponent causing intense pain.
summary: The ability to create near microscopic spines on your skin
strengths: Wall Climbing
Your skin is now a weapon
No hugs from people you don't like
weaknesses: Hard to get close to people
Hand to hand combat required
Sometimes you can't suppress it...

name: Titan's Grip
description: With this power you can focus your energy in your hands creating a dark red energy that lets you crush or hold things in your hand without losing your grip. The focused energy increases the strength of your punches causing them to hit with the force of a large meteor. The force can also be focused into a melee weapon, such as a sword, to greatly increase its destructive force. The melee weapon would become indestructible, weightless to the user, and would also glow with same energy.
summary: The ability to have increased hand strength and brawling abilities.
strengths: Power of a titan.
Increased strength with fists and melee weapons.
Never lose your grip on your weapon.
weaknesses: Only increases strength in hands.
May crush things by accident often.
Dark red energy gives away when you are using power.

name: Energy Flux Field
description: A field surrounds your body in which all forms of energy are constantly in flux turning you into a walking natural disaster. Everywhere you go destruction will follow as you tear everything to pieces with fluctuating kinetic, electromagnetic and thermal energies. With concentration the power can be repressed so that everyday activities can be preformed. Strong emotions cause the energy field to increase and affect a larger area.
summary: The ability to generate a field of constant energy flux around your body
strengths: Complete destruction of enemies
Great destructive rampages
Affects nearly EVERY type of energy
weaknesses: People avoid you
Mostly places you as evil

name: Shattering
description: A person with Shattering is a china shop's worst nightmare. By pointing and focusing, they can make solid objects break into a million pieces. This is easier the smaller and brittler the object is, although it can be performed on all solid objects.
summary: The ability to make solid objects break or burst suddenly into pieces
strengths: Anything is a fragmentation grenade
Nothing can really block it
Range only affected by sight
weaknesses: No effect on liquids or gases
Harder the larger it is
Harder the less brittle it is

name: Invulnerability Defiance
description: Invulnerability is often thought to be the end-all, beat-all in defense, capable of withstanding all manner of physical damage, no matter how strong or powerful. This ability counteracts it. One with this ability harms invulnerable subjects and superhumanly durable subjects just like he can harm normal people (often requiring no extra force). In addition, any weapon the user wields will be able to harm invulnerable or durable subjects for as long as they are held by him.
summary: The ability to bypass Invulnerability and Superhuman Durability when attacking
strengths: Harm durable supers as though they had normal durability
Harm invulnerable supers as though they had normal durability
Any weapon you wield will hurt them, too
weaknesses: Weapons will only hurt invulnerables when directly held by you (bullets still don't work, etc)
Sometimes, it only acts like a downgrade (invulnerability treated like superhuman durability, etc)
Invulnerables with Power Negation, or with Power Negation Immunity

name: Power Based Surrogates
description: Allows you to create a new body from one of your superpowers. The new body can be any age, gender or style and comes with clothes and items that go with the power used to make the Surrogate. While controlling the Surrogate, you can only use the power used to make it, though with enhanced strengths. Surrogates that are not in use are stored in a separate dimension where they slowly heal. People with mind enhancing powers may be smart enough to control multiple Surrogates with different powers.
summary: The ability to switch to and control a new body based on a superpower you possess.
strengths: Spare bodies in case one is damaged.
Power is enhanced in Surrogate form.
Can become a new person.
weaknesses: Cannot use other powers, unless you exit the Surrogate.
What power you will be using is easily predictable.
Increasingly hard to control multiple Surrogates.

name: Unbreakable Guard
description: Catch anything moving at rates that normal people would have a tough time with. The only way you can use this technique though is by sitting down and catching with your feet, like Yoshimitsu in Soul Calibur 4.
summary: The ability to catch anything from bullets to swords and anything in between
strengths: Unbreakable guard!
Catch arrows, swords, knives bee stings, anything
Your feet never get injured
weaknesses: Have to be sitting down to catch anything.
Can't use your hands and expect the same result

name: Self Density Control
description: The user can change his body density and mass. This allows the user, when light, to move more quickly and leap long distances. When heavy, the user has great physical strength and rock-hard durability.
summary: The ability to control the density of one's own body.
strengths: You can eat as much as you want; the extra weight won't affect you!
Ever need to hammer a nail in? Just use your finger!
You can get paid handsomely to do normally impossible physical labour if heroics is not for you.
weaknesses: Shifting from light to heavy too often will put much strain on your bones, making it painful to move
The extra power might result in un-intentional property damage, which'll come out of your pocket.
While lightly dense, you're extra vulnerable to injury.

name: Viral Strength
description: Touch one person and infect them with a geophysical virus that allows you to add their physical prowess to yours, as long as they are on the Earth's surface. When they touch other people, they also add to your strength. The virus spreads and every muscle in your body becomes stronger with every infection. Imagine starting the virus at a concert or sporting event, in a school, wherever people are gathered.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength by spreading a geophysical virus
strengths: Handshakes, hugs, accidental bumps, even a pat on the back add to your power
Touch as many people as you can, spread your viral effect faster and reach your desired strength
You will probably average a lifting capacity of 27,272 tons, run over 12,000 mph
weaknesses: If you or the people you infect are airborne you are not as strong as when they are grounded
The day before the infection dissipates you are too powerful to touch anything without crushing it
Every 28 days the viral effects stop and you must start the process again

name: Delete This Now Okay
description: poorly worded
summary: The ability to be poorly worded
strengths: Becoming a dating guru
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Fatigue Reversal
description: This is a very useful power. If you have this power, you can reverse physical exhaustion. When your body gets too tired, it automatically restores your strength and speed to before you got fatigued. Fighting someone with this power can be challenging, since they will not tire easily. Unfortunately, this isn't unlimited stamina; you have to get very tired for this power to activate.
summary: The ability to reverse fatigue or exhaustion
strengths: You can reverse physical exhaustion
You will be challenging to fight, since you won't tire easily
This power restores your strength and speed as well
weaknesses: You have to be very tired for this power to activate
This does not give unlimited stamina

name: Arcana: 0 The Fool
description: This ability is passive and automatic. It activates in the split second before you are harmed. It reverses time to a few seconds, and then warps probability to make it impossible for the harm to happen. No matter what actually happens, you won't get hurt. A bullet will miss, a gun might jam, something might get in the way. You could stand in front of a car about to hit you and this power would jerk time and probability to somehow get you out ok.
summary: The ability to prevent harmful events from happening.
strengths: Virtual Invulnerability.
Always safe from physical harm.
weaknesses: Doesn't prevent unstoppable attacks.
Probability manipulators.
Won't stop non-physical harm.

name: Mental Energy Hands
description: A person with Mental Energy Hands can create giant, translucent hands that can manipulate objects. These mental hands are directly controlled by the user's real hands. They can be projected up to 100 yards away and be made to be 100 feet tall.
summary: The ability to form and manipulate giant hands made of psychic energy
strengths: One-man wrecking crew
Nearly limitless ability to use them
A form of super-strength
weaknesses: If real hands are tied, the Mental Hands will be useless
Strength of hands tied to concentration
Can be resisted

name: Glass Shard Strike
description: With this power you can shoot shards of glass out of your hands. The glass cannot shatter inside of your hand and you cannot be hurt by the glass even after it leaves your hand. You have unlimited shards of glass in your hands and can shoot them out of both hands.
summary: The ability to shoot shards of glass out of the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot shards of glass out of your hands
You cannot be hurt by your shards
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by shards of glass that did not come from your hand

name: Palmer's Chain Link
description: With this ability, By swiping your hand across someone else, or shaking their hand, you're given a piece of their strength, and intelligence. You could achieve great distances depending on how many people you touch. Over time, you'll possess superhuman strength and intellect. Soon, you could be able to lift vehicles with your muscle, and your mind could become strong enough to gain psychic abilities.
summary: The ability to touch someone to increase your mental/physical peak and performance
strengths: It won't hurt anyone you touch - you're simply sharing strength, and intelligence through a link.
You can break the chain at any time if you concentrate on excactly who to break it with.
Build on the natural Human psychic ability.
weaknesses: Psychic energy may begin to easily set off.
Difficult to explain how you lifted that Fire Engine.

name: Meteor Power Creation
description: The ability to create metors which can give people powers. If you are hit with 2, you will gain 2 powers and if you are hit with 1, you will gain 1 power. You can keep giving yourself powers too.
summary: The ability to create meteors that give people super powers
strengths: Give yourself powers that you choose
Pretty cool power
Deliberately giving people bad powers
weaknesses: If you lose control, this power can be fatal
May be stressful giving people powers all the time
Bad super heroname: "meteor man"

name: Ability Reflection
description: This is the ability to reflect anything back to the person who used their ability on you. Ex. If somebody threw fireballs at you, the fireballs would reflect off of you and burn the person who attacked you, If someone tried stopped time around you, time would speed up around them, if somebody tried to read your mind, they would only be able to hear their own thoughts. Even physical abilities such as super strength punches and turned against their owner
summary: The ability to reflect the effects of anyone else's power onto the person who used the power against you
strengths: Reflect anythind back to the original caster and hurt them with their own power
You're not affected by any powers no matter what, and also no limit to reflected power
Good team back up
weaknesses: You can be hurt by people who dont use/have an offensive ability ex. Adaptive breath
Team members cannot use their abilities to aid you ex. Healing touch or Ability boosting
If the person is evil, then they would be every superheroes nightmare

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Powers
description: The Powers, also known as the Authorities, are the bearers of conscience and keepers of history. They are also warrior angels who remain loyal to the superior. As a Power, you oversee the distribution of power among mankind, hence the name. Powers appear as beautiful humans clad in gold sapphire-studded armor, they also have incredibly long hair which sparkles and glistens like a river in the summer. The Powers carry two beautifully crafted longswords which are hidden in their red velvet wings.
summary: The ability to become a celestial keeper of history.
strengths: Acquire knowledge of past, present, and limited history of the future.
Clear through armies of enemies with ease.
Ultimate beauty.
weaknesses: Powers have no key weaknesses, although they are not ultimately invulnerable.

name: Healer 8: Enzyme Addition
description: With this power, you can generate a field with a radius of 25 kilometers inside which all individuals have all normal enzymes. As a bonus, if any of them have other enzymes in their body which are blocked, this power will restore them too. You can also mimic enzymes found in other species or from any superhuman who enters your field, allowing you to survive a greater range of internal pH and resist changes in temperature. The field expands a meter each year and can be switched off at will.
summary: The ability to restore enzymes and mimic those of other species.
strengths: Many poisons are not as effective or even useless.
Range of 25 kilometers, increasing by one meter each year. Can be turned off at will.
Instant cure for enzyme deficiencies such as phenyketonuria.
weaknesses: Limit to temperature resistance; your DNA still falls apart at 120 degrees Celsius.
Enzyme deficiencies will return shortly after people leave the field.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Battleforce
description: An energy that is driven by a combination of willpower, emotion,and courage and channel this energy into anything the user sees as a potential weapon. Some traits enhanced would be durability, power, range, agility, or mechanical function.
summary: The ability to enhance or upgrade weaponary
strengths: Synergies with a skilled combatant
Makes any last minute weapon a deadly tool
weaknesses: Requires a certain amount of courage and willpower
Useless without some form of weapon

name: Singularity Generation
description: You can create bowling ball sized exposed singularities. You can guide up to two towards a single target or hit two targets that are close together. Any armor or forcefield will be destroyed first. Powers that defy the laws of physics or give protection from changes to the laws of physics give someone immunity to this attack. Powers of invulnerability or intangibility also give immunity. Otherwise, this attack destroys any target made of energy or matter.
summary: The ability to create exposed singularities and guide them to targets.
strengths: If you had binoculars or telescopic vision and could fly, you can hit someone from miles away.
Kills foes made of matter or energy.
You can send two singularity balls at once.
weaknesses: If someone has immutability, quantum intangibility, space/time indemnity or physics rejector.
If someone has other powers that work like the ones above.

name: Sensory Organisation
description: Tired of mental confusion from several information-providing powers? Does Super Hearing hurt you ears? Is Ability Detection distracting? With this power, all those powers are managed by your body like normal senses, allowing you to use them all at once, while they adjust their power level and work in tandem. Best of all, this works for your normal senses.
summary: The ability to coordinate your senses.
strengths: No more mental overload.
Information is easier to understand.
This is a passive power.
weaknesses: Some powers still make you fall unconscious.
It's more useful for people with sensory superpowers.
While you would normally stay conscious with this power, some powers will still knock you out

name: Super Cloak
description: If you are standing next to something, you can become an exact replica of it. You are only able to be a replica for 10 min. Then, there's a 1-hour cool down.
summary: The ability to become a replica of something you're standing by
strengths: If you're hiding from someone, you can become a replica
Can keep you out of trouble
You can turn into something useful to you and use it
weaknesses: Short period of usage time
1-hour cool down time

name: Summoning: Tsukuyomi
description: Tsukuyomi, god of the Moon, brother of Susanoo and Amaterasu. His power is the strongest at night. He can strike down your opponents with illusions, and drive them to insanity.
summary: The ability to summon Tsukuyomi.
strengths: Summon Tsukuyomi.
Illusions.
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Chains Of Wrath
description: They are made of the strongest metal in the universe. You can also wrap your entire body in them to make a chain body armor thing. But the the chains are made of metal that is liquid until it comes out your skin. You must absorb large amounts of metal to use large amounts of chains
summary: The ability to shoot chains at your enemies. They can tie them up or kill them depending on how fire
strengths: Always have chains to shoot
Can make armor that will protect you and make you extremely strong
Can tie up or kill enemies
weaknesses: Must absorb metal
Chain armor is heavy and can slow you down
Extreme heat can melt chains

name: Myth Power: Atlas' Atonement
description: Atlas, in Greek Myth, was the Titan god of stamina, endurance, patience and daring, as well as the Bearer of the Heavens. As such, channeling him allows one to gain Superhuman Strength (especially upper-body strength), Endurance (Durability), Stamina and Sturdiness (Steadiness). In addition, one gains Superhuman Physical and Mental Resilience, and can withstand irrational fear and heightened mental states. One can even psychically project a miniature atmosphere, to use as a forcefield, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Atlas' command over the essence of stamina, patience, endurance and daring
strengths: Superhuman Strength, Endurance (Durability), Stamina and Sturdiness (Steadiness)
Superhuman Physical/Mental Resilience; withstand irrational fear and heightened psychological states
Psychically project a mini-atmosphere to use as a forcefield (similar effects to a real atmosphere)
weaknesses: No Pain Immunity or Invulnerability until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 requires that one personally hold the atmosphere up to keep it active (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Cratos' Workout can disrupt this ability (NCN)

name: Trust Keeper
description: Gain anyone's trust and never lose it no matter what.  You need to touch the person to use this power.
summary: The ability to gain anyone's trust and never lose it, no matter what.
strengths: Gain trust
Never lose it
Easy
weaknesses: Need to touch person your gaining trust from

name: Blood Synthesis
description: You can create any number of creatures out of your blood. They are a hive mind with you at the center, so you can communicate with them in a cell-phone like way, but with better reception, and move their muscles as your own. They have no minds of their own, so they cannot do anything (even in their own defense) without your command, don't need food, and are immune to pain. Also, you can mutate the blood even OUTSIDE of your body.
summary: The ability to make creatures out of your blood
strengths: Completely obedient servants that will never disobey you.
Legions of super-soldiers that will show no mercy.
Fun-sized ones will be truly fun!!
weaknesses: You don't have any super-regen yet, so you could rip a pretty big hole in yourself accidentally.
You also don't have super-concentration either.
The red cross blood drive will be kinda interesting, and a couple people won't get much better
tags: the red cross and how screwed it is if you get this power.

name: Manticore Summon
description: With this power you can summon a manticore, a mythical beast with the body of a red lion, the head of a human (with three rows of sharp teeth) and the tail of a scorpion which can shoot poison barbs that can injure but not kill an opponent. The Manticore is under your complete control and when you're done with it you can send it back to wherever it came from. Also you can only summon one at a time but if one dies you can summon another one.
summary: The ability to summon a manticore
strengths: You can summon a manticore
It under your complete control
If one dies you can just summon another one
weaknesses: The poison barbs can only injure not kill

name: Osteoblast Mimicry
description: This power gives you four abilities. First, your body can secrete a soft collagen-based substance you can model in any way. When you're done, it solidifies into a brittle bone. Second, you can telekinetically move substances containing calcium or phosphate within a short range and form tiny but extremely strong crystals out of them. Third, you can telepathically communicate with anyone with this power. And finally, you can strengthen or inhibit the bone-destruction ability of Osteoclast Mimics.
summary: The ability to create bones of any shape, manipulate calcium and phosphate within a short range and more.
strengths: You can (or rather, should) use calcium/phosphate manipulation to strengthen your bones.
You can use your own body (except your bones, see con 2) as a source of calcium and phosphate.
You can strengthen your own skeleton, but it's not recommended if you don't have Osteoclast Mimicry.
weaknesses: Without either calcium or phosphate, the bones you create will be easy to break.
You can't manipulate calcium nor phosphate that have already been integrated into bones.
And therefore, you can't telekinetically manipulate bones, including the ones you create.

name: Face Mimicry
description: This power is basically a shape-shifting power limited to the face area, excluding the hair of course. With this you can copy the face of any person you see. However, you can't copy their body, their hair, or their voice. You won't even change your gender. The skin color of your entire head will change to match the targeted person though. You remember all the faces you've mimicked so you can change into them again later.
summary: The ability to copy someone else's face, and only their face.
strengths: Not being able to copy the voice is not a problem if you keep quiet.
Not being able to copy the hair and body is not a problem if you wear a burqa, a niqab or a chador.
Not being able to change gender is not a problem if you explain you just had realignment surgery.
weaknesses: Nothing as long you can come up with an excuse for why you don't look yourself today.
Nothing if you don't meet someone who knows the person you're copying.
Nothing if you can hide your body and your hair from other people while you're transformed.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Half Dragon
description: Being half dragon gives you the ability to produce fire from anywhere on your body. You can grown big wings to fly at top speed. Finally you have a very tough skin that reduces the damage you take.
summary: The ability to be half dragon
strengths: You can fly
If you have a sword you can swing it and fire comes out
You can turn full dragon for an hour at most for your ultimate power
weaknesses: You are often being chased by the government to do testing
You are known as a freak and a monster
When you get really angry you lose control of yourself

name: Bodily Propulsion
description: You are able to bodily generate thermo-chemical energy and release it from your skin. It comes with an enhanced boost to your base energy levels and endurance. When energy is stored 'behind' a limb or entire body & released, that limb becomes invulnerable to physical harm during propulsion. This power enables multiple other abilities, eg: a personal force field, making explosive shockwave upon impact (landing, hitting)
summary: The ability to store energy in or behind any given limb and release at will, propelling yourself or the limb.
strengths: Use the energy for jet propulsion (and negating the negative side effects of flight)
Unstoppable and unvulnerable while using the energy to move - creates shockwave upon impact
Personal force field to make you almost invulnerable
weaknesses: Unstoppable during propulsion while using the energy; just like the Juggernaut against the Hulk.
Eventually, energy needs to be replenished

name: Psychic Network
description: A person with this ability has the power to grant anyone psychic abilities as long as they consent to listening to an mp3. Once the other person, becomes an esper, you also gain the same abilities as the other person. The more people that are in your network, the stronger everyone in the network will be. Only the moderator/proxy/owner has multiple abilities and they can kick out anyone from the network at will as long as they are in a lower rank. The owner can use the group as a calculator.
summary: The ability to create a network of esper whose power increases due to the network sharing
strengths: Create an army
Get everyone's powers if you are the owner
Have the calculating powers of your entire network
weaknesses: You can still be defeated by someone outside your network
Sometimes kicking out someone does not remove their psychic powers
If someone finds your identity as the owner they can plot to kill you so they become the new owner

name: Successor Of The Dragon
description: When this ability is active, you acquire superhuman abilities, such as enhanced strength, endurance, energy projection, speed of light, and flight. You are able to undergo a state rendering you invulnerable to all incoming damage; you metamorphose into a human/dragon hybrid with razor sharp claws that can distort space.
summary: The ability to serve as an avatar for a cosmic dragon.
strengths: A fearsome warrior who can easily strike fear into people with a single gaze.
Use your "thousand claw method" to annihilate armies of enemies.
weaknesses: Intense "dragon beams" could wipe out innocent bystanders.

name: Super Edge
description: With a blade, you can cut through the toughest of armors as though it was butter.
summary: The ability to cut through anything.
strengths: Can cut through pretty much anything
weaknesses: Must have a blade in hand
You'll be feared even if you only have a cutlery or a pocket knife

name: Exp Collector
description: You play your life like a video game and earn Exp from everything that you do. When you reach a certain amount of Exp for an activity, you level up and have a chance to get an ability related to that activity. There is a higher chance to both get an ability and get a more useful ability the higher your level is. (Other powers can make you lose your skills but not permanently).
summary: The ability to gain experience points and level up from simple (or complicated) daily activities
strengths: You can't lose Exp permanently. (once you are able to do something you can always do it)
Can gain superhuman abilities at high levels.
Can train (gain Exp) in as many activities that you can imagine / do.
weaknesses: You are terrible at anything new you try until you train.
Takes a while to be able to get useful abilities to make this power worth it.
You can become bored with no competition after training so much in something you like.

name: Chaos Absorption
description: While chaos control allows you to give others bad luck, chaos absorption allows you to gain strength through the aggression and rage of others, whether they attack you or whether they attack other people.  War, greed, and sickness are your power source, allowing you to do whatever you want!
summary: The ability to gain power from destruction
strengths: Tempt others
Can become nigh invincible
Unlimited power supply
weaknesses: Peaceful resistance will weaken you
Will turn you into the bad guy

name: Soul Warrior
description: Collect souls that have recently become souls and use them as any weapon, armor, shield, or skill that your imagination can come up with. You also obtain 3 forms. The first being an aura that flares when contact is made with others. The second, you obtain the skill called soul tempest. The third, you now have the Blade Of Oblivion which may be used once per fight.
summary: The ability to collect the souls of the dead and use them as weapons and the like.
strengths: The more souls, the more powerful you become.
The more souls, the more effective your weapons, shield, armor, etc.
The more souls, the more powerful your forms become as well.
weaknesses: The less souls, the weaker you are.
If your imagination is weak, so are your weapons, shields, armor, skills, and forms.
After the first slash with the Blade Of Oblivion it dissapears until you are in a deadly situation.

name: The Dragon Creator
description: This ability is that the user can create dragons out of anything the harder the materiel the tougher the dragon. The dragons gain abilities on what they are made of like a rock dragon gains geokinesis or a sapphire dragon can create sapphires
summary: The ability to create dragon out of anything
strengths: Dragons!!
Get rich quick
Everyone wants one
weaknesses: Can't control it
Only one ability per dragon
Dont make the dragons too big!

name: Ultimate Vacation
description: This power gives you the luck to get an all-expenses paid vacation to any destination you wish. Vacation lasts aas long as you want.
summary: The ability to be extremely lucky to receive an all-expenses paid vacation.
strengths: Free vacation
Anywhere you want
As long as you want
weaknesses: None

name: Power Mall
description: Go to this website, explore the superpowers then click on one, look at what percent like the power and put that many currency into the screen (80% is 80 dollars). The money will melt into the screen, and you now have that power, both on this site and IRL!
summary: The ability to buy powers on this website
strengths: You get superpowers
weaknesses: It cost money.

name: Revenge
description: Whenever you get hurt, you can convert the pain/damage into muscle mass. Therefore, if you have been damaged really badly or have been tortured you can become extremely big and strong!
summary: The ability to change pain and physical damages into muscle mass.
strengths: Revenge is yours!
Don't ever be afraid of thugs, if they attack and harm you, pay it back to them double time!
You can easily win a body builder contest, just by slapping yourself before start!
weaknesses: The power isn't permanent.
Pain will make you stronger, too much pain will kill you!
Muscles aren't everything, good to have some brains too!

name: Creature Call
description:
This ability you can summon powerful creatures to take down your enemies, take you long distances in short times and anything else wanted done.
The creatures can possess varying powers from creature to creature. Creatures from summoning go from a Minotaur, Medusa, Dragon to even a tiny little Imp.
summary: The ability to summon mystical creatures to do your bidding.
strengths: Can summon any mythological creature from choosing.
Can dismiss creature any time to back wherever they came from.
weaknesses: Summoned creatures can lose or die in a battle.
Do not possess a direct power to oneself.

name: Piezoelectric Crystal Form
description: You are a walking electrified crystal being with the strengths and weaknesses of crystalline material and the ability to stun or kill someone with your touch. Your body without a source of electricity to recharge with has enough energy for 300 stun touches. A kill touch uses up 3 stun touches. You could function as a defibrillator and save the life of someone who's having a heart attack.
summary: The ability to become an electrified crystal elemental.
strengths: You can choose stun setting if a bad guy really doesn't need to die.
Or kill setting if he's a cutthroat, then fry him as if you were the electric chair.
Electricity doesn't harm you.
weaknesses: Someone who controls electricity or is immune to it.
A long drawn out fight in the great outdoors.
This power requires touch-unless you have some way to conduct your electrical charge.

name: Identity Switch
description: One can just switch his identity with anyone else by knocking into that person. Their souls will switch. The switcher will get his powers (if he has any), knowledge and skills he possessed, as well as those he originally had. However, the victim will not remember anything and will automatically think that he is the switcher himself, but he will not be able to switch identity as the real switcher is already in his body.
summary: The ability to switch your identity, body and mind with someone else
strengths: Can understand or learn something easily from another person
Can get the taste of others' powers
Can use others' identities to complete tasks
weaknesses: If you lost your original body, you will not be able to switch your identity back.

name: Railroad Track Generation
description: This power can only be activated if you are wearing long sleeves and holding your arms parallel to each other and directed toward the ground. When activated, you will generate any length of rails you want. As soon as they are shot out of your sleeves, the rails will slither along the ground to create a railroad. When you're done, the tracks will attach themselves to the ground and there you are, a brand-new railway track!
summary: The ability to shoot steel railway tracks out of your long sleeves.
strengths: If you are a Train Mimic.
If you have train-related powers.
You can generate steel in the form of rails.
weaknesses: You can't generate bridges to cross over chasms.
You can't generate trains to use the railroad.
You must be wearing long sleeves.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Dead Power
description: With this power you can use the power of any currently dead superhero such as Elongated Man, Superman-2, Abin Sur, Al Pratt (Golden Age Atom) etc.
summary: The ability to use any power that a dead superhero had
strengths: You can have a vast array of super powers
weaknesses: Once the character comes back to life his or her powers are no longer available to you to

name: Organic Metal Muscles
description: Every muscle in your body is organic metal muscles, with hardness, flexibility and weight similar to titanium. You can still move as normal, but are now far heavier. Your bones are also just tough enough to be able to cope with the extra stress. Your strength has increased accordingly. Your muscles secrete far less of their equivalent of lactic acid, so your stamina is increased. As your legs are super-strong, you also have slight superhuman speed.
summary: The ability to permanently possess organic titanium muscles
strengths: Most of your body is now basically indestructible
You are now stronger, tougher, faster and have greater stamina
Your abs are now actually rock-hard
weaknesses: You are now far heavier, so you could easily break things with your weight, e.g. chairs
Your bones aren't as indestructible; you could still be killed by a high-calibre bullet to the head
You have to get used to your new strength and weight, which could be dangerous

name: Hide In Anything
description: A person with this power can hide in anything. This is not an overstatement. You can hide in anything be it a tiny spec of dust or something that doesnt even have volume to hide in. In addition you can "see" when you are hiding so you can tell where you are and where you are going. However you take the damage that the object/person you are hiding in would have received when hit so you can be defeated even when hiding unless you hide in something unbreakable by the people after you.
summary: The ability to hide inside anything regardless of volume capacity or living/non-living status
strengths: They don't notice when you slip in
Always win hide and seek
The volume does not matter
weaknesses: Can only be used to hide
You take the damage of the object/person you hid in
You still need to do things like eat and go to the bathroom, you can sleep though

name: Cartoon Powers: Team Rocket
description: With this power you can fall from any height and survive with only a few minor scratches and bruises. This is useful if you need ever need to fake your death, or escape from pursuers and have to jump off of a cliff. Or if you're parachute doesn't open while sky diving. Of if you're frequently launched into the sky by a ten year old and his pet mouse.
summary: The ability to be able to survive any fall from any height and be relatively unharmed
strengths: You can survive any fall from any height
weaknesses: You still get some minor cuts and bruises

name: Avatar: The Swordmaster
description: You embody the art of swordfighting itself. On attaining this state, you gain the skills, knowledge, and physical limits of any sword user that has existed or will exist in the universe. As such, you can defeat all opponents who face you with a sword. Against other foes, you are still a power to be reckoned with.   As a universal force, you do not age unless you give your power to a worthy successor, or are slain. You may appear wherever a sword battle occurs and fight for the side you favor.
summary: The ability to be the physical embodiment of swordfighting.
strengths: A limited form of immortality. You also get the physical limits of any other being that uses swords.
You may pass on your abilities to any other intelligent being of your choice.
You are the best swordfighter in the universe.
weaknesses: On gaining this power, you are only allowed to fight with swords.
You hold the form you had when you gained this power and can still be crippled or killed.
If you die without passing on your power, it instead travels to the nearest intelligent being.

name: Self Infusion
description: This ability allows one to infuse one's self into other things. It makes them more cooperative with the user. They will become more like you... Personality-wise. No actual transformation. People will be more open to you, but they won't be under your control. You will have to persuade them, with which the ability helps. Items will obey since they are more like you.
summary: The ability to infuse part or all of one's very being into a person, item, etc.
strengths: Make new friends and allies
Manipulate items
weaknesses: Sentient being that you infuse, can become destructively obsessive with the user

name: Human Sword
description: The user of this power can turn any part of his body into a sword-like object, in addition to turning other objects--like a ceramic vase--into sword-like objects.  The swords can be broken, however, which leads so cuts, bruises, or even broken bones in the swordified extremity. Fortunately, you can also repair and maintain swords of all kinds.
summary: The ability to produce swords and other blades from ordinary materials or your own body
strengths: Aid other heroes by turning yourself into an adaptable blade
Easy and fast way to produce weaponry
Turn yourself into a sword to hide
weaknesses: Does not ensure sword skill.
Turning into a complete sword renders all your clothes torn and useless

name: Physical Karmic Increase
description: One with this ability gains a physical boost from their positive actions. This includes strength, endurance, stamina, and it also powers your other superpowers (if you have any). The effects of this ability are unlimited, so if you're a complete saint, this ability would probably make you unstoppable. However, a negative action causes you to lose some of your karmic bonus.
summary: The ability to gain power, strength, stamina and endurance based on positive actions
strengths: Gain a physical boost from all of your positive deeds.
If you're a complete saint, it could potentially make you unstoppable.
Negative actions only weaken your bonus, and not your overall physical ability.
weaknesses: Negative actions still weaken your karmic bonus.
If you're always doing negative things, you may never experience the effect of this ability.
Does not increase your luck.

name: Fate & Free Will
description: Fate is what will happen. Free Will is your choice. I believe both are connected. With this power, before you make a decision, you will accurately know the consequence of the chosen decision. It allows the user to wisely make the right choice.
summary: The ability to accurately determine the consequence of all choices.
strengths: Know what will happen, depending on the choice you make.
Makes decision making a whole lot easier.
weaknesses: There is a possibility that only a negative will result in either choice.
Only applies to the choices you will make. (Doesn't work with other people).

name: Injury Absorbing
description: This ability heals the owner and any others within range. The injuries are turned into enhanced strength, powers, speed, etc. Things like ageing are also absorbed. So, if an ageing person walks nearby, they rapidly age back to the prime of their lives. The owner does not need to eat, but only if they have stored injury and they weaken to a normal human if they do. This cannot be turned off and it only works on living people.
summary: The ability to absorb injuries.
strengths: Live forever.
Torture people.
Doctor by day, superhero by night!
weaknesses: Can't permanently hurt enemies without killing them.
Can't be turned off.
Cannot resurrect the dead.

name: Death Restriction
description: Used on others, this power would basically allow you to beat someone to death and they would still be alive thanks to your ability. Used on yourself, as long as you have this ability, no force can kill you or others around you. You will live the longest, and most natural life as you or other people can. You can change what could kill you or others.
summary: The ability to make yourself or others around you die by only one thing.
strengths: Longevity of life, and minor accelerated healing factor.
You can change what can kill you or others
Takes away mostly all possible death factors, but one
weaknesses: Only one thing will kill you instantly.

name: Forced Drunkness
description: Able to make someone drunk instantly. This also can make someone sober as well.
summary: The ability to instantly make someone drunk or sober
strengths: Makes foe sluggish
Can cause someone to get arrested for public intoxication
weaknesses: Some people like to be drunk
Irish plus drunk equels better fighting and more anger

name: Charge!
description: With this power, you can literally charge the enemy with a force that's not humanly possible. If you learn to only use so much stored energy, you can also start throwing kicks and punches or throw with superhuman speed, but that takes practice, experience and control.
summary: The ability to store energy into your body and charge at speeds up to 300 mph
strengths: You can move at superhuman speeds
With training, you can do normal strikes at superhuman speeds by successfully distributing energy
You are basically unbeatable in a fist fight
weaknesses: If you don't distribute your stored energy, you'll get tired really fast
If you charge into a hard surface, it'll hurt a lot
If you trip while charging into the enemy, it'll hurt a lot

name: Accelerated Stamina
description: Accelerated Stamina grants you the ability to quickly recover your energy. With such ability, you are able to run all day. You remain at the speed you are at. However, it will not work due to a lack of blood, nutrition or oxygen.
summary: The ability to rapidly recover your breath.
strengths: Have nearly unlimited energy
Run away from anyone
Run all day if you have to
weaknesses: Still need blood, nutrition or oxygen
You remain at the speed you are at
You can still die

name: Biological Bullet Firing
description:
Anyone with the power of Biological Bullet Firing will never feel unsafe because they are able to fire unbreakable bullets from their arms. Though these bullets do take time to remake themselves, you have a limited supply, you shouldn't need to overuse this power. Especially since the bullets are immune to heat, kevlar, and most metal.

Since the bullets are generated from your bones you also have unbreakable bones.

This power takes practice and thankfully is actively engaged.
summary: The ability to fire unbreakable bullets from your arms
strengths: Can Penatrate Most Blockades.
Fires Silently Even During Machine Gun-esque Firing
Easier To Fire Than A Gun
weaknesses: People Will Get Annoyed With Your Scarface Impressions
Possibly Having To Register Yourself As A Legal Weapon
Takes Practice To Fire. Otherwise They Just Slip Out.

name: Blades Of Nature
description: You can make any ordinary blade of grass of leaf, or anything related to leaves and grass, into extremly sharp objects.
summary: The ability to make any ordinary blade of grass or leaf into incredibly sharp objects.
strengths: Make a weapon from nature.
You don't need to waste money to buy weapons.
weaknesses: Useless in areas without grass or plants.

name: Power Monstrocity
description: Once this ability is used, you change into a monstrous, scaly beast which becomes stronger when struck by superpowers. However, unless you are skilled with this ability, you may lose your reasoning skills, and it can become chaotic. Has decent defense and offensive capabilities. Did I mention that while in this form, you can inherit superpowers absorbed? (However they only last while you are in this form. )
summary: The ability to shifts into a state which becomes stronger by being struck by superpowers.
strengths: Your form grows in strength and size as you absorb strikes from superpowers.
This ability does not have a limit.
If you revert, and re-transform, skilled users can recover their former strength from this form.
weaknesses: You can lose skills of reasoning and become chaotic unless somewhat skilled with this ability.
May be seen as a threat to mankind (Not saying that conclusion isn't just. )

name: Blood Bending
description: With body movement, you lock onto a target (it has to have blood in it). You can control the blood and make the body move however you want. For example, you can swing your fist when you're attached to someone. The person who you're attached to will swing their fist too. You cannot control for more than 20 min. and you have to wait 30 min. before using it again.
summary: The ability to control someone else's blood for at most 20 min.
strengths: Can get people to do what you want
Have them hijack a car, give it to you and they take the blame
weaknesses: The 30 min. cooldown

name: Empathic Exoskeleton
description: Bugs are, for their size, the strongest animals on the planet. This is in part due to a durable exoskeleton that helps support the weight. A person with an Empathic Exoskeleton generates a similar structure from their body in times of duress. It is extremely tough, and grants the person the ability to lift 5 times their own weight. The exoskeleton is reabsorbed when the threat has passed.
summary: The ability to generate a tough carapace in times of need
strengths: Gain bug-like strength
Surprise factor
Carapace largely invunerable to harm
weaknesses: Only activates in times of danger
Really obvious
Mostly involuntary

name: Heart Beat
description: Give yourself super strength,speed and agility by speeding your heartbeat up, this makes you veritably invincible... For a short amount of time, the advised amount of time is ten or so seconds,because prolonged exposure to this state creates the risk of a cardiac arrest.

strengths: Really tough, I mean really tough
Walls are nothing to you
You also give off intense heat
weaknesses: Cardiac arrest
If you have high blood pressure the amount of time you can use this is 3 seconds
Blurry vision

name: Exoproxykinesis
description:
You can step out of your body into another plane where every force takes the forms of different cubes, and time is slowed down. Sound will have clusters of cubes floating out from the source, other powers have cubes from the user or what the user is effecting, etc. With this, you can see and redirect any force. 
EX: Movement can be taken from a person walking to a rock. The person will lose movement or fall and the rock will move. 
Similar cubes can also be combined to increase the force.

You can do lots of funny things. Invisible pantsing!
Don't even have to get up to do it
weaknesses: Your body is defenseless when you are on the other plane
Can't combine unsimilar cubes, like heat and sound. Only heat and heat or sound and sound.
Have to touch cubes in the other plane to move or combine them

name: The Other Power +Free Burgers!
description: Assuming you're seeing this in a "would you rather" comparison, this power gives you the exact same abilities as the other power over there, but you also get free hamburgers!
summary: The ability to do whatever the other power says, plus get free hamburgers!
strengths: Same as the other power
Plus free hamburgers!
weaknesses: Same as the other power
You'll get pretty fat
You have to pay for the fries

name: Superpower Zone
description: This power allows you to create a zone with special rules inside. In comics and other fictional sources, characters are often able to gain superpowers from odd situations. With this power, everyone has a higher chance of superpowers developing from the situations they are in. Once obtained, the superpower will not disappear just by leaving the zone. If a person stays in the zone long enough, their power may evolve depending on the situations they experience.
summary: The ability to create a zone that increases the probablity of gaining a superpower.
strengths: Create a large zone to give a group superpowers.
Create an isolated zone for yourself to train and gain superpowers.
Predict what situation will give you a power you want and cause it to happen.
weaknesses: Once zone is created, anyone can use it till it is taken down.
The superpowers may get out of hand if a large number of people are within the zone.
May get unwanted powers from being in strange or bad situations.

name: Faultless
description: Do whatever you want and you will never be guilty. Rob banks, forge checks, steal cars, punch, kick, cheat on a tests, etc. You will never be blamed, never accused, and never caught. If anyone asks about you the response is always favorable. People will always think positive of you even if they have evidence to the contrary.
summary: The ability to never be accused or blamed for any wrongdoing
strengths: You could get away with anything and are incapable of being accused.
Be lazy or rotten at work or school or commit the perfect crime, no matter the severity
Someone will get the blame but it will never be you
weaknesses: The person in nearest proximity immediately gets blamed for whatever dirt you do

You are not perfect; everybody just thinks you are

name: Bone Materials
description: With this ability you will be able to change the material your bones are made of. You could change them to steel and deliver a stone crushing punch or change them to rubber and bounce back from any blow. Your creativity defines the usefulness of this power.
summary: The ability to change what matierial your bones are made of.
strengths: Have tough unbreakable bones
Have elastic rubber-bones
Imagination improves its usefulness
weaknesses: Choosing a bad material may cause damage

name: Cash Manipulation
description: A person with this power can be an awesome thief because their power is to control.... Paper money. They can use it to quickly create a storm or create a giant fist of money or other structures out of cold hard cash.
