Best of all, they can attract a crowd of bystanders that can disrupt any of the heroes. Heroes will be powerless before the might of your cash attack, since destroying money is a federal crime. Imagine beating someone and stealing their wallet at the same time... Brilliant.
summary: The ability to control paper money including summoning them from other places
strengths: Control money
Can make it rain money or create structures out of money, money grenades, money sword... You name it
Can blast people with money
weaknesses: You can't really be a hero with this power unless you happen to use your own money

name: Chemical Element Mimicry
description: You can transform at will into any chemical element, such as oxygen, iron, potassium or carbon. You keep your human shape and senses, but if in a liquid or gaseous form you can shape yourself. You can also become differet allotropes of the same element, such as becoming either carbon or diamond. If you lose part of your body, you can replace it by absorbing that element from your surroundings. While in an element form you are difficult to kill, as you possess no organs.
summary: The ability to transform into any of the elements of the periodic table
strengths: You can become far more durable by becoming diamond or platinum
You have 118 elements to choose from, so you are quite versatile in combat
You can take advantage of elements' properties. For example, you can now conduct electricity
weaknesses: You can have undesirable reactions, such as bursting into flame caesium
If a radioactive element you are incredibly harmful to be close to
You cannot mimic any compounds, or more than one element at a time

name: Ability Master
description: This superpower enables the user to be very proficient and effecient with his/her other superpowers. They master the use of any other superpower, but it doesn't affect the power itself. It doesn't evolve, get better or get rid of its cons.
summary: The ability to master all of your powers
strengths: You master any power
weaknesses: Doesn't evolve the power
The cons are unaffected and still apply (unless they have to do with mastery)

name: Unrestricted Power Usage
description: Normally one has restrictions on their powers to keep from using all the power that they have. With this power all restrictions are ignored and all the power can be used. This includes every single bit of the being's life force. Using your power without a regard for safety while you have this power can be fatal if you are not careful.
summary: The ability to ignore all restrictions on one's power
strengths: You have to concentrate to use this power.
Can temporarily boost powers well beyond the normal limits.
weaknesses: This power will cause death if not used wisely.
Due to the fact that even immortals have life force they will burn themselves out if they overdo it.
Burning out means that you erase all of your own existence by using every scrap of power you have.

name: Strength Leeching
description: Absorb the strength of other people by touch. Actually gain the strength of 10 men or women, but it only lasts for a day.
summary: The ability to absorb strength from others through touch
strengths: Become stronger from other people.
weaknesses: Have to touch the person in order for the power to work.
Can only absorb  up to 10 people's strength.
Only lasts a day.

name: Thief Hunter
description: You have to picture anything that once was yours but has been lost or stolen and express the desire to get it back. If it still exists, a terrifying skinless man-horse hybrid is called forth. The creature knows exactly where to look for and it will hunt it down until it is retrieved. It also has dangerous abilities, like a poisonous breath, dissolving touch, flesh-eating body secretions and to shoot fire from its single eye. Thankfully, its abilities are ineffective on the user's belongings.
summary: The ability to get back anything that once belonged to you.
strengths: The creature is tireless and gets more powerful the longer it takes to retrieve the target.
Even if it's somehow destroyed, you can always summon a new one.
The target can be a living being, an object or even an ability.
weaknesses: You can summon only one creature at a time.
You could cause unimaginable destruction.
The creature's one weakness is its phobia of fresh water.

name: Evisceration
description: With this power, you can be either the best doctor in the world or the most evil assassin ever. When this ability is activated, the other person's organs will appear in your hands. While they are out of the body, the person is still living due to an illusory substitute that works like a real one. You can fix injuries on the organ and return it, or you can stab and destroy the organ, then return it. You can also switch the organs with something else.
summary: The ability to remove people's body parts without killing them(yet)
strengths: Best doctor, no need to cut up people just need to operate on organs or just put in replacements
Cruelest assassin-stab organs then return them, switch organ with a bomb, sell organs
While out of body, the organs you hold do not die due to removal
weaknesses: Creepy, very, creepy
For those with fear of blood

name: Armor Body
description: With this power your skin becomes five times harder than a rock and three times more resistant to damage. The skin now somewhat looks like a suit that you might see on a superhero. Every part of the body has its own outline with each muscle also partially outlined. Sexual organs are all hidden under flaps of armor if they would be visible on a normal human. The color scheme is always random at first, but can be changed with other powers.
summary: The ability to have skin harder and more resistant to damage than normal with a distinctly different look
strengths: Your skin is harder to damage and break.
You could fight without clothes on and noone would care since it would look like you're dressed.
Don't have to transform or alter your body for the defensive properties.
weaknesses: Can't take the armor off since it IS permanent seeing as how it is your skin.
You may not like the way the armor looks.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Anesthesia Breath
description: A person with this power can knock people out by breathing at someone's face releasing a powerful anesthetic gas that immediately knocks them out painlessly. However if you use it repeatedly on the same person they can slowly build up a resistance.
summary: The ability to knock people out by breathing in their face
strengths: Quick knockout
Non-lethal
The effect is instantaneous---at least the first time you use it
weaknesses: Can only be used to knock people out
Can accidentally knock people out when you yawn
People can build up a resistance over time

name: Dissassociating Particles
description:
The best way to obtain invincibility is to avoid all harm, no? If all your molecules are free floating, whatever comes your way will just pass through you! 
you could even spread out your molecules and hide..In Styrofoam!
summary: The ability to turn from solid form to gas form and change the shape of your body
strengths: avoid attacks
turn your own body into a weapon
weaknesses: get blown away in the wind while in gas form
Fire both makes you rise (gas form) with the hot air and burns you better

name: Solar Cooling
description: With this power, whenever you are in sunlight, you can eliminate heat. The more sunlight, the more cooling you can manage, thus you can easily survive the temperatures of the sun. As you get more experienced with this power/the stronger it gets, the more efficient the exchange rate of sunlight to cooling.
summary: The ability to cool yourself down when in sunlight.
strengths: Hot days are often sunny, so they are less of a problem now.
Sunlight can't make you too hot.
If you have a spaceflight power, you can survive on the sun.
weaknesses: Limited uses.
Hot days with cloud cover could leave you more vulnerable.
Useless indoors, unless in a greenhouse-like environment.

name: Box Ing
description: The ability to create a world inside a box --limited to a distance of 500m away if created outside and limited to the size of the room if created inside-- where anything can happen, given what you desire to happen inside the box
summary: The ability to create a box where anything can happen within it
strengths: Anything is possible
Able to trap anyone inside
Negotiate all powers within the box
weaknesses: Only occurs within the box
Limited to a distance of 500m outside
Limited to the room when inside

name: Bio Energy Enhanced Strength
description: With this ability you can store large biological energy and then use it to increase muscle mass. You get realllly big muscles. You get super strength, swat super man like little fly, near invulnerability, and you can finally smash through all those annoying buildings and look like a bodybuilder on Megasteroids. But after your fun spree of destruction is over, you turn back to normal and are so exhausted you can't move for up to for up to 1 hour. It lasts for as long as it takes to use the energy
summary: The ability to store and use biological energy to increase muscle mass
strengths: Super Strength
Near Invulnerability
Really big muslces
weaknesses: Have to wait 2-3 hours to store energy
Only lasts as long as you have energy to burn
When it's over, you collapse and can't move for up to an hour

name: Energy Vampire
description: If you touch & grab a person, you'll drain & absorb that person's energy. You'll convert it into a special ability like increased strength, speed, stamina, & if you draw enough, you could have telekinesis & even energy blasts. The downside is you leave the person you "feed" off of weakened & may go into a coma or perhaps die. Also the power makes you dependent & crave energy otherwise you'll be in a weakened state.
summary: The ability to drain & absorb energy from a person & convert it to a powerful ability
strengths: Absorb energy to convert into a superpower
weaknesses: Draining a person's energy leaves them weak & may fall into a coma & die
You become an energy addict
If you don't feed within so many days, you'll become weak

name: Writer
description: The holder of this power can write in any language with perfect grammar, punctuation, etc. They need only to know what message they wish to convey and their hand(s) will automatically write in the desired langauge.
summary: The ability to write in any language without prior training
strengths: Goes great with the power, Reader.
weaknesses: Once you stop writing, you have no idea what you've written.
If a language has no written alphabet or characters.

name: Lion's Roar
description: The origin of the name "Lion's Roar" comes from a Chinese idiom which translates in the English language as "the lion east of the river", but it is a roar-like yell powerful enough to shatter wood and glass, tear the plaster off walls, and lift anyone off the ground like ragdolls. An innocuous side effect of your training is your ability to raise your voice loud enough to overpower a group of a hundred or so people speaking loudly in unison.
summary: The ability to release soundwaves around you with your vocal cords at super high volume.
strengths: You can stun the opponent, giving you a free hit.
weaknesses: Using it too much can give you a sore thorat.
You'll lose your voice.

name: Surgical Blade
description: This power allows you to create surgical scalpels out of energy from your body that have the ability to cut or separate objects from the inside. The surgical blade can pass through any object, cutting it from the inside. The blade can also separate two objects without damaging either object. A second personality or types of mental control can be separated out of a body. The blade can even touch the intangible. Masters can even separate certain powers out of a super-powered person.
summary: The ability to create scalpels made out of energy.
strengths: Cut objects from the inside.
Separate objects without hurting them.
Remove second personalities or types of mental control from a body.
weaknesses: This power can not put objects back together.
Need knowledge of objects you are cutting so that you do not cut the wrong parts.
Powers that can block or disrupt the energy that makes the blade.

name: Ordinary Attack Immunity
description: With this ability, you can reflect physical attacks from inanimate objects and people without superpowers. When someone attacks you, you don't get hurt and the impact will hurt where they hit twice as much. If someone punches you, they will feel like their fist got hit with a fist. If a car hits you, the impact will not push you away. The force of the impact gets reflected. The limit of this ability is 100,000 pounds per square meter. Animals and superpowered beings can still hurt you normally.
summary: The ability to reflect physical attacks from inanimate objects and non superpowered humans.
strengths: Reflect impacts from inanimate objects and people without superpowers.
As long as the attack is not concentrated in a small area, you don't get hurt.
Any person or anything attacking you will get twice as hurt where it hit.
weaknesses: Animals and superpowered beings can still hurt you normally.
Poisons and desease can still hurt you.
Limit of 100,000 pounds per square meter of force.

name: Aura Synchronization
description: Basically your aura synchronizes in such a way that you and one other ally can fight without impeding each other. That is you won't get in the way of your ally's attacks and neither will they. Everything the two of you do will be in perfect concert with the other person.
summary: The ability to synchronize one's aura with another's and enhance both side's battle capabilities
strengths: Don't impede allies in combat
weaknesses: Can't synchronize with more than one person until higher levels. Maximum is three other people.

name: Natural Leader
description: You always come up with good ideas depending on the situation. People tend to want to befriend you. People tend to listen to you.
summary: The ability to have the best solutions to problems and make people listen to you
strengths: You are always given important roles or jobs
You are great at solving problems
weaknesses: Not for you if you"re not a people person
Have a lot of weight put on your shoulders

name: Bullet
description: This power also grants you a way of flight. If you jump in the air and speed up your entire body. If you jump up and speed up your legs so they hit the ground harder when you jump, you can jump very high. This power also grants you a version of super strength. If you speed up your fist as you punch, it will cause a very powerful blow. One can pretty much use this power for half of the superpowers in the world. You can also rapidly speed up your growth, making oneself a giant, along with others.!
summary: The ability to rapidly speed up any or all parts of your body
strengths: Fly / jump high and far
Superstrength
Superspeed
weaknesses: Becomeing too big

name: Atp Manipulation
description: Adenosine triphosphate, also known as ATP, is the chemical energy source of all living animals. With this ability, you can produce it within yourself, induce its production in others, and control how much is produced. That means you can control how strong any metabolic process is (breathing, digestion, motion, thought, superpowers, etc. ), making them stronger or weaker. At the higher levels, you can even cause mitochondria to stop producing it altogether, slowly shutting down the body.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate adenosine triphosphate, the chemical fuel of the body
strengths: Enhance metabolic processes of yourself and allies
Hinder metabolic processes of foes
Induce death at will, or prevent it
weaknesses: Does not work on organisms whose bodies don't operate on ATP to survive
Cannot CONTROL thoughts, motions, etc. Other than strengthening them, weakening them or the like
Cannot reverse death of living things, or bestow life on inanimate objects

name: Object Absorption
description: It is possible to absorb any object into the body, and expel it at the speed it entered.   Only 5 objects may be absorbed at once. The weight of the object is negated, almost as if it no longer existed. The effect of the object is also negated whilst inside the body (for example a magnet no longer attracts).   If something living is absorbed, it does not age and has has no memory (if not a plant) since the absorption. You cannot absorb yourself, or the Earth.
summary: The ability to absorb objects into the body.
strengths: Pass through airport security with illegal objects
Cannot be knowingly shot (as you can just absorb the bullet and shoot it back at them)
weaknesses: Can only hold 5 objects at once

name: Mangekyoyomi
description: An eye ability, the Mangekyoyomi allows the user to fully understand the workings of a power, skill, or ability by seeing it. By understanding the ability, the user sometimes learns how to use it. Also through understanding, the Mangekyoyomi user can know all the weaknesses, strengths, applications, and counters of the seen ability. When reading an ability, the irises flash different colors and spin, hence the name: Kaleidoscope Reader.
summary: The ability to see a power and completely understand strengths, weaknesses, applications, and counters.
strengths: Understand enemy powers, thus knowing weaknesses.
Ranged (Only have to see, not touch the power or person)
Can be used on powers and skills (such as karate techniques).
weaknesses: Basically useless to a non-strategist.
Usually does not grant the scanned power.
The opposing user must perform the skill correctly for a complete scan.

name: Stereotype Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can create, eliminate, or change any stereotype at will. You can make people with no confidence get all the girls. You could eliminate thugs. You could make nerds dress like winners. Make geeks stupid and poor. Turn the bum stereotype into a rich bum stereotype. Make up a stereotype that is superfun. Doesn't work on superpowered beings.
summary: The ability to change, create, or eliminate stereotypes at will
strengths: Make nerds dress like winners. People will now see nerd as a synonym for winner.
Eliminate thugs and bullies. Eliminate all stereotypes.
Make up your own, superfun stereotype.
weaknesses: Can be used for evil.
Make jerks even worse.
Someone could use this to make brothers more annoying.

name: Consciousness Transfer
description: At will, you can remove your consciousness and transfer it to an unconscious person, e.g. someone asleep or in a coma. The moment you touch them, their memories, skills, and personality is then merged with yours and their body is now yours, while your old body is left in a coma. You must physically touch this person for it to take effect and the merging of their personality with yours is permanent, in effect you kill them. You can however return to your old body at any time.
summary: The ability to transfer one's consciousness into another unconscious person.
strengths: If you have access to an unlimited amount of unconscious clones, you have practically immortality.
You can take on the role of anyone, providing you are there when they are unconscious.
You have their memories and personality. If you pretend to be them, no one will ever find out.
weaknesses: You will die if you are hurt away from your clones or other unconscious people.
After collecting so many personalities and memories, you may forget which ones were originally yours
Insanity and depression is a high risk. Suicide may be inevitable after many years.

name: Immovability
description: The ability to make anything around you immovable or unstoppable.
summary: The ability to make anything around you immovable
strengths: You can make yourself immovable.
You can make yourself unstoppable.
weaknesses: No superstrength.
No unstoppable force.
Non invulnerability.

name: Robotic Spider Summon
description: With this power you can summon thousands of small robot spiders that are under your complete control. Each spider is equipped with a laser, can walk on walls, and has super strength. When one is destroyed you can just summon another one to take its place.
summary: The ability to summon thousands of robot spiders
strengths: You can summon hordes of robot spiders
They're under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be destroyed
They can be reprogrammed

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Ring
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When the stone on this ring is turned inwards to face the palm, and the hand of the bearer is closed into a fist, the wearer will be rendered invisible from whoever he or she so chooses.
summary: The ability to use the stone and ring of Eluned the Fortunate
strengths: Become invisible to everybody but one person. Have fun making them think they've gone mad!
weaknesses: People might think you're married if you wear it on the wrong finger.

name: Human Transformation
description: With this ability you can change anyone into anything and they will remain alive in whatever form the thing you changed them into is in (as long as there are still some of the particles the item is made of in something they will be alive in it. For example: some idiot annoying you? Change him into a burrito and eat him. He will then be digested and excreted. He will be alive for all of the process because there is still some of the particles that the burrito was made of in the feces.
summary: The ability to change people into whatever you want
strengths: You can have anything you want--made right from a person
weaknesses: It is permanent
If you havn't activated it for awhile it will activate randomly

name: Tactical Cards
description: The cards are created by waving your hand in front of their face at which point a card with their stats will appear in front of you. The card will have their current power levels, strength, speed, agility, dexterity, intelligence, health, and class (RPG-type closest match possible) level at the point the card was created. Also, the card will have at most two of their powers identified on it. The card will not update itself when the person becomes stronger or weaker.
summary: The ability to create cards that have data on people
strengths: You can have information on people at the start of any battle.
The cards could be used to know how much power you need to use to heal someone or a group of people.
Con: The cards can be stolen. Pro if used in conjunction with the next con.
weaknesses: Between battles people can become stronger thus making the previous data obsolete.
Enemies with more than 2 powers will need multiple cards to know all their powers.
Ex: Vespert will take at least 350 cards possibly more.

name: Contained Metabolism
description: Most metabolisms are pretty high-maintenance. A person with a Contained Metabolism does not fall into this category; their body recycles all its nutrients, hormones, and energy. Thus, they do not need food, water, nutrients, or even as much sleep. However, if the system loses nutrients (i.e. wounds), they will have to be put back in by eating. Also, the user is not resistant to injury in any way, though they will tend to have more endurance than usual.
summary: The ability to sustain yourself without eating, breathing, etc.
strengths: Body recycles nutrients, so you never have to take care of it
Tire less quickly
No more bathroom breaks
weaknesses: If your body loses nutrients, they will have to be replaced
Not resistant to injury
Poison stays with you twice as long

name: Death Reversal
description: When killed by anything besides old age, your body transforms into a creature that is half human and half of whatever killed you. For example, if you're killed by a gun, you would have a metal body and could shoot projectiles. The transformed state only lasts for a period of time, you stay transformed longer from a more painful death.
summary: The ability to gain power based on whatever kills you.
strengths: Don't have to fear about getting killed.
Can gain nearly any power for a limited time with creative deaths.
After transformation wears off, you are fully healed.
weaknesses: Have to die to use power.
Must get killed to activate this power.
If you're accidentally killed, everyone would see you transform.

name: Enhanced Synesthesia
description: This ability not only allows you to see sound but control it in different ways. First of all, you see sound as colored wisps of light coming from the source. You can move them around without the sound dying out. You can intensify and weaken them. Sadly you can not create sound with this ability. Other than basically controlling sound you can do two more things. You can make sound visible to others. And you can make people come to you by focusing on them and making a constant stream of sound.
summary: The ability to see and control sound
strengths: You can see and control sound
You can intensify sound enough to break stuff and weaken it enough to hide it
You can make sound visible and call people to you
weaknesses: To turn off your "sound vision" you need to concentrate constantly
You still can be hurt by sound
You can't create sound with this ability

name: Empowered Naming
description:
This ability lets you amplify any attack by declaring it before performing it or increase the effect by declaring it afterward. Attacks can also be weakened by giving it a funny or weak sounding name. 

Even normal non-superpowered attacks can be amplified this way and can obtain characteristics similar to the name

For example if you yell "Flaming Punch" you punching attack will be slightly hotter than usual but not as hot as it would be if you actually punched with real fire
summary: The ability to increase the power of your actions by giving it a name
strengths: Make anything you do more powerful
weaknesses: You have to declare your attacks to make this work

name: Mega Fists
description: With this power, you can create energy hands that act as extensions of your hands. They can be the same size as your normal hands or giant. You can use them to deliver devastating blows or to lift extremely heavy things. You can contend with super strong opponents or shield yourself from attacks. With enough creativity, it can be an incredibly versatile power.
summary: The ability to create giant energy hands as extensions of your hands
strengths: Engage in hand to hand combat while a safe distance away
Mimic super strength
Easy to catch falling objects or reach things
weaknesses: Hands can only reach 100 feet away from you
Have to be able to move your hands to move energy hands
Can still get tired using energy hands

name: Subatomic Pulse Generation
description: The user of this power can then direct the amplified energy in one direction in order to hit the intended target. This power will take up a lot of the user's stamina and energy for each use. Maximum range is 10 metres for the pulse and 100 metres for use on any object or being.
summary: The ability to amplify the energy given off by the movement of subatomic particles to fire off pulses of energy
strengths: Good for extending the maximum range of a weapon (10 metres is nothing to laugh at).
weaknesses: Energy-consuming
Long battles

name: Danger's Light
description: Say someone's going to attack you with say a bazooka and you don't know they're around. Normally you would die, but with this power the path that the ammunition from the bazooka would shine with a bright white light that only you can see. This effect applies to any possible danger regardless of how much damage it would do to you. The light shows up 10 sec before the dangerous event happens.
summary: The ability to see bright white light where it is dangerous to be
strengths: You know exactly where to stand in order to avoid a danger.
You have enough time to react after the light apears.
weaknesses: If you have invulnerability, even stuff that would normally kill you, but is now harmless shows up.
Thousands of bullets will hurt your eyes.
Be sure not to move into an attack that is already occuring while trying to avoid a future attack...

name: Instant Blueprints
description: By holding up a piece of paper you can use this power to copy a blueprint of whatever the paper covers in your line of sight. The blueprints you create can be of anything, including people. The blueprints include notes of important information about the subject. For people this includes weaknesses and powers.
summary: The ability to create blueprints of anything on any paper held up to the subject
strengths: Let's you create a blueprint of anything.
Shows weaknesses of people
Blueprints contain notes of the subject.
weaknesses: Must have a piece of paper to use this power

name: Induced Entropic Destruction
description: The ability to separate anything into a closed system and increase entropy in that system therefore causing that system to break down. For example, walls crumble, metal rusts, bones break. Eventually if the system is exposed to further entropy, it is broken down into an atomic dust.
summary: The ability to cause things to break down
strengths: Escape from any place
You are difficult to stop
weaknesses: Could destroy the world if left unchecked

name: Swallowing
description: You can make your cells "swallow" anything, making it a part of your body. This power activates only at will. If you interact with an other human being, that person becomes a part of you. The person's body mass makes you bigger, increasing your muscle and body mass. If the interacted person has a power, you get that power.
summary: The ability to interact your cells with anything.
strengths: You're invincible, basically.
Absorb many human beings and grow big muscles.
The absorption is unlimited, absorb all you want.
weaknesses: The absorbed person's feelings are given to you.
You can be defeated, but the chances aren't very high.

name: God Of Cooking
description: With this power, you can make any meal appear in front of you as long as you visualize it.   The food can be eaten or thrown. You can change what ingredients are in there.   By any ingredient, I mean that, besides extra salt/pepper or other spices, you can also add more things such as laxatives, poisons, and even explosives.  As long as it can be feasibly put into the human body, it can be made.
summary: The ability to create any type of food out of thin air
strengths: You can create any type of food that ever existed
You can add any ingredients you want
You can make it look like anything you want
weaknesses: You have to visualize the dish to make it

name: Invisible Body Guards
description: With this power you can summon two body guards that only you can see. The body guards will do anything in their power to protect you and are super strong, agile, know how to use any weapon and can shoot lasers from their eyes. If both of the bodyguards die you cannot summon new one and you lose this power.
summary: The ability to summon two invisible bodyguards
strengths: You can summon invisible super powered body guards
weaknesses: They can die

name: Catch Master
description: With this power you will automatically be able to catch anything that is thrown to you. You will never drop the ball in a sport game or anything else ever again. You can turn this power on and off so you aren't constantly catching grenades or bombs that are thrown at you by enemies.
summary: The ability to catch anything that is thrown to you
strengths: You can catch anything that is thrown to you
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Power Of The Chimera
description: With this power you can transform two different animals into a single new one, this new animal specie will be called a Chimera. You can create the most powerful predator to ever existed by transforming great predators into one, like a Rhino and a Lion (weird one). But, if you make something too aggressive or too smart it might turn against you. You can't use this power on humans because they are too smart, and you must be careful while creating a Chimera, its a complicated process.
summary: The ability to transform two different animals into a single new one, a chimera.
strengths: You can create a powerful and unstoppable predator with the right animals.
You can create a powerful virus or bacteria too, since they are simple organisms.
Chimeras created by you will be always under your control, as long as you be careful with them.
weaknesses: This power doesn't work on humans, they are too complex and smart.
You can't create something too aggressive or smart, it would turn against you.
Creating a chimera is a complicated process, if you forget to create a single artery it will die.

name: Total Self Bio Control
description: This ability lets you control anything that was ever a part of your biological body remotely. You can control dust that has been a part of your body and you can automatically summon them from any part of the world or universe. Biological implants that have synchronized with your own body can also be controlled. You cannot control things that have been turned into base elements like oxygen however. Carbon dioxide can also be controlled.
summary: The ability to control every non-element that has ever been part of your body
strengths: Every time you spit saliva or pick booger or scratch yourself you add more particles to control
You can control your own blood and body as well as dust, sweat, filth, and dirt
If you have lived a long time this power is very very strong
weaknesses: You cannot control diatomic particles or particles that have been converted into base elements
Controlled things have a tendency to mix when manipulating more than one object
Your controlled objects are highly combustable

name: Full Sleep
description: Ever had to wake up early for a job? For school? Ever get in a bet where, if you fall asleep first, you would lose? Well, you won't lose because you won't sleep for very long!
summary: The ability to get a full night sleep in only 1 minute!
strengths: Only takes one minute to sleep!
Go to sleep faster!
1 minute of sleep equals 12 hours of sleep!
weaknesses: Your last time you'll ever sleep, you'll sleep for about a month and die in your sleep.
Snore horribly loud!

name: Infinite Teeth Healing
description: With this superpower, your teeth will always heal. They will heal cavities and always be strong healthy and white. If your tooth breaks in half, it will heal itself in a matter of seconds. It heals using seemingly magical particles and the teeth enamel comes from a parallel universe. You will never have to worry about broken teeth or cavities ever again. It might be a highly advanced form of science that seems like magic that allows the teeth to instantly heal.
summary: The ability to have your teeth heal completely even if it's broken in half or chipped.
strengths: Never worry about broken teeth again.
Never worry about cavities again.
Your teeth are always strong, white and healthy.
weaknesses: Your teeth aren't any stronger than metal.
Your teeth can be knocked off whole out of your human gums.
Your teeth aren't perfect.

name: Idea Spheres
description: A noun is a person, place, thing or idea. An idea is the only one of those that you can't touch. Until now. This ability allows you to create glass spheres out of ideas. Images of that idea will be floating within the sphere. If the sphere breaks, the idea it contains will enforce itself on its surroundings. Create a Sphere of Freedom when you're in a jail cell. Create a Sphere of Destruction in the middle of a fight. Create a Sphere of Power to power your house.
summary: The ability to hold ideas as a physical thing.
strengths: You can create idea spheres
There are hundreds of different spheres you can create
When the sphere breaks, its idea is enforced on its surroundings
weaknesses: Your house will be covered in shelves of spheres
A sphere's surroundings almost always includes you
Some spheres are dangerous

name: Wish Granting Sword
description: A person wielding the Wish Granting Sword and selected people are given the ability to make their wishes come true. The wish granting sword does not give power right away but makes it possible and highly likely to happen. For example if one wished for power, the sword will turn heavy so the user can train. If the user really needed power the sword can grant superstrength. It all depends on how much the person needs it. Thus a person that is desperate will wield tremendous power with this sword.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that will grant your wishes (eventually depending on need)
strengths: You can get your wishes granted
The sword can self-repair even if only one molecule is left
If you want to live this sword can resurrect you a second before you die
weaknesses: You have to work with gained wishes to make it effective, superstrength needs to be developed, etc.
Cannot be selfish with this power, only desperate needs are granted
Sword can be stolen and used

name: Author's Immunity
description: Having your abilities copied or replicated is an undeniable threat to any superpowered person. It doesn't matter how powerful you are, a copycat hero will only use whatever power you have against you. And most often than not they can beat the crap out of most people because of their diverse selection of powers. However in the presence of a person with this ability any superpower which was originaly 'created' by 'him' cannot be used against in any way possible.
summary: The ability to become immune or to be completely unaffected by the superpowers that you created.
strengths: All of your power cannot be used against you.
This ability grants the user complete immunity against stolen or copied abilities.
This ability grants the user the ability to nullify any copied or stolen superpower.
weaknesses: Originality is a must.
If the ability being used by your opponent is not created by you.
If you are up against the author of this ability.

name: Omnipotent Power Blocking
description: Annoyed with powers like Power Safety and Cellular Regain? This power will allow you to get rid of their powers. The secret is that it doesn't affect the abilities in any way; it severs the person's body from the power, so that they cannot use it. For example, if a person has regeneration, the regeneration will still be intact, but the person's body cannot use the power, rendering the person powerless for all intents and purposes, only powers like cellular regain won't be of any use.
summary: The ability to deny access to a being's abilities.
strengths: Great if you can mimic powers.
Can turn the effect off.
Nothing will restore the powers except you.
weaknesses: Does not undo things they have already done.
Erases all powers; you cannot select one you want to remove.
Has to be mentally maintained until you touch them.

name: Power Negation
description: With this ability, you could stop, reverse and negate the powers of other beings.
summary: The ability to cancel the superpowers of others.
strengths: Others would not be able to use their powers on you.
Your power could not be used offensively.
You could allow specific individuals to use their powers in your presence if you wish.
weaknesses: You may have to be touching the target.
The target must be in close proximity to you.
It may be involuntary and uncontrollable.

name: Furnace Hands
description: Furnace Hands give you ability to smelt and reshape metal into any form just by touching it. It can't add mass to anything, so you can't make a piece of metal bigger than it already is, simply reshape it into a different form.
summary: The ability to smelt and reshape metal by touch.
strengths: Reshape any form of metal.
Smelt any form of metal.
No need for a furnace.
weaknesses: Not great for combat, unless someone is swinging a sword or such at you.

name: Mega Minions
description: To be able to make minions that will do anything for out of the four basic elements.
summary: The ability to create minions out of the elements
strengths: They'll do anything for you
Can't make as many minions as you want at a time
4 max.
weaknesses: Cant make more than four minions

name: Arachnid Mimicry
description: You can sprout eight legs from your body, and project a sticky silk to form webs. You can climb up walls and have a venomous bite. You also have two extra appendages which end in pincers, or sprout a scorpion-like venomous tail.
summary: The ability to take on the traits of an arachnid.
strengths: Venomous bite/sting.
Sticky silk.
Eight legs & wallclimbing.
weaknesses: Look kinda freaky.
Might develop a spider-like personality.

name: See Through
description: Ability to literally get into someone's shoes and view whatever is happening at the moment in their point of view. Happens randomly, not always by choice.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of others
strengths: Understanding what others are going through
New experience, gain knowledge
Primary source to what really is happening
weaknesses: Might sway your opinion to the person's whether it's right or not
Can experience horrific atrocities
This happens against your will

name: Sthenomaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you become a monstrous flesh-like beast which grows and gains power from physical harm. Everytime you're physically harmed, it makes you stronger, giving you superstrength. As your size and strength increases, your form will become more demented, possibly growing new arms. Despite you invulnerability to physical harm, it becomes harder to think rationally, and you are highly susceptible to mental harm.
summary: The ability to transform into a state which grows and gains power from physical harm.
strengths: Grow and gain strength from being physically harmed.
As you grow, your form becomes more wicked, and you begin to grow extra arms.
weaknesses: When you revert to normal, you lose all the effects that you gained from this form.
Mental harm causes you to revert to normal.

name: Fear Guardian
description: A person with this power has a guardian made up of their own fear. The guardian evolves based on their fears. It also tells the user where danger is ahead of time. The guardian can only be seen by the user and cannot be damaged, but it will grow smaller the less afraid the user is. It will never go away unless the user is unafraid of anything. The guardian becomes intangible when there is nothing that is threatening the user. The guardian attacks with physical force.
summary: The ability to have an ally made up of your own fear
strengths: It can attack people near you, its strength is relative to your fear
Gives you something close to precognition
You can control the guardian if you master your fears
weaknesses: Guardian will not help you unless you are afraid of something
The guardian will always want to destroy the source of your fears even when you want to run away

name: Welding
description: You can create a jet of fire from your body like a blow torch that welds objects together. It welds objects together by creating a liquid metal over whatever it burns that instantly solidifies when it is cooled down. Objects can be welded together without burning the objects but the fire must still go over the area that you wish to be welded. The metal is strong but not indestructible.
summary: The ability to create flaming daggers that welds objects together.
strengths: Weld objects together.
Can choose to burn objects or not while welding.
Metal created to hold welds together is strong.
weaknesses: Might burn people by accident.
Will have hard time removing welds that you make.
Have to be able to reach what you want to weld. Limited range.

name: Apotheosis
description: Apotheosis is the ability to become completely immune to anything. The power manufests itself by bringing you back to life after you die. You are now immune to whatever killed you. You can only adapt to the fatal force after you die. Thus anything that slows you down, traps you, or knocks you out remains a threat.
summary: The ability to adapt after death
strengths: you can't die
weaknesses: you have to die to become immune

name: Dark Path
description: As fun as heck with a path going at 300 MPH (miles per hour). You must have a dark ring on at anytime you use it (ring included).
summary: The ability to move on a path of darkness.
strengths: Quick transportation
Fun glide
Go to almost anywhere
weaknesses: Can not go through solid objects
You must have a dark ring on at anytime you use it (ring included)
You can travel by using other objects' shadows to connect

name: Scout
description: Afraid of what might lye ahead in your path? With Scout, you can scope it out before moving on. However,while you're doing this, your real body becomes immovable and vulnerable to attack and you can only scout ahead 100 feet in any direction.
summary: The ability to send a ghost form of yourself ahead of you.
strengths: Seeing what lies ahead
weaknesses: Vulneable body
Limited distance.

name: Animal Control
description: You can take over and control any animal for as long as you'd like.  Your human self will be "asleep," but your conscious mind will be fully awake within the animal.  You can choose to not feel pain, will know how to use all of the animal's bodily functions, and if the animal you're controlling dies, you'll be transported back into your body again.  This ability excludes controlling other humans.  To make matters better, the sleep you get while controlling the animal is good, quality sleep!
summary: The ability to fully control any animal (excluding humans).
strengths: Hunt on the savannah
If your animal dies, you don't
weaknesses: As an animal, being killed might be pretty terrifying
Your human self goes to sleep when you control other animals

name: Beast
description:
You choose which animal to act as in nature, any animal from any time period. Mythological animals are not included, only animals that have really existed, this includes dinosaurs. E.g if you chose a rhino, you act instinctly with a strong running charge.
However an animals weaknesses are also included.
summary: The ability to act as an animal would in nature, any animal from any time period.
strengths: Have a rhino's strength
Have a bird's flight capabilities. (Unless you chose an Emu).
Have a whole range of animals to choose from.
weaknesses: As a snake your vision is clouded.
Do not take the animals form, only instincts and abilities.
Mythological animals are not included

name: Omnikill
description: Omnikill causes death onsight. The user can cause an instant or prolonged death with a gaze at a victim. The gaze does have to connect with the eyes of the victim in order to have a full effect. When the user gazes at bare skin of a victim the victim may experience anything from a slight tingle to nuclear radiation on the bare skin being looked at. The ability has no connection with telepathy so it cannot be used by thinking about a person. Wearing strong UV glasses may weaken its effects.
summary: The ability to kill on sight
strengths: Seemingly limitless power
Easy to use
Hard to avoid
weaknesses: Very hard to master control of
Can accidently kill loved ones
Can accidently kill the wrong person

name: Ability Examination
description: With this ability, you can examine superpowers. You can learn every detail about them, such as what they are, how they are used, side effects, and how powerful they are with the user that possesses them. You cannot, however, learn how to possess that power.
summary: The ability to examine one's superpowers, and learn every detail about them.
strengths: Examine superpowers of other super-powered beings.
Learn strengths, weakness, how they are used, how powerful it is with the user, etc.
weaknesses: Cannot learn how to use the superpower you examine (unless it is a technique. )

name: Grenade Punches
description: You are able to create a mini explosion when you punch objects which is equal to that of a grenade. But it uses up your calories so you need to eat a lot- so you don't need to exercise.
summary: The ability to create mini explosions with your fists
strengths: Exploding punches
You don't have to exercise
weaknesses: You need to eat a lot of food

name: Rocket Move
description: When you concentrate and punch or kick, you will be able to increase your power 100 fold. Your punches or kicks could destroy an entire block.
summary: The ability to punch or kick with the power of a rocket.
strengths: Increase your punch or kick power 100 fold.
Wipe out the competition.
weaknesses: Could injure or kill a lot of people.

name: Perfect Reception
description: Where ever you are in the world, you always have perfect reception on your mobile phone.   It doesn't matter what mobile device, the moment you take it in your hand those bars indicate 100% signal strength.   Even when you're in an underground lair with lead shielded walls, and located in the middle of nowhere.
summary: The ability to always have perfect reception on your mobile
strengths: Never out of reach with our mobile phone.
weaknesses: If the battery of your mobile is depleted then you still can't call.

name: Magnetic Field Boost
description: You can amplify a magnetic field's force up to the level of a magnetar's force (10 to the 15th power gauss) from as low as that of a refrigerator magnet's force (100 gauss). However, using this power to its maximum level will enact such a strain on your body that you will die in 5 seconds. Also, you can only amplify magnetic fields that you are touching.
summary: The ability to amplify the strength of a magnetic field.
strengths: You can make any magnetic field really strong, possibly stronger than that of a black hole's.
weaknesses: A magnetar is well past the point that you would want to amplify a magnetic field as doing(to con 2)
(from con1) so could possibly kill you as well as everything in a 30-kilometre radius.
You are not immune to the effects of magnetic fields that you create with this power.

name: Boomerang
description: With this power whenever you throw something you can cause it to return to you whenever you want. You can turn this power on and off whenever you like.
summary: The ability to cause things to come back to you when you throw them
strengths: You can make things come back to you when you throw them
weaknesses: If you forget to turn this power off and you throw a grenade it could have disastrous results
tags: it's all coming back to you

name: Thief Tracker
description: With this power whenever something of yours is stolen, you will instanly be alerted and you will know who the thief is. You can track the thief and view its location (as well as the way to location) of the thief at will until you have retrieved what was taken from you.
summary: The ability to know if something of yours has been stolen and who stole it
strengths: You will automatically know if something of yours was stolen
You will know who stole it
Track the thief and view its location, as well as the way to it.
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Rpg Item Pack
description: Like a character in a RPG, you can carry absurd amounts of stuff in a tiny, half-backpack-sized pack. In fact, you can pull from this pack nearly anything you own. The pack will stretch quite a lot to allow moderately large items to be withdrawn, but you won't be able to pack a fully assembled car. Your pack cannot be stolen, but if you're beat-up pretty good, your attacker will get random stuff of yours. (You can leave your pack in a safe place to avoid this. )
summary: The ability to pull anything you own from a compact RPG-style pack.
strengths: You have instant access to all of your possessions at any time.
The pack works like teleportation and thus has no inherent weight limit.
You don't have to think ahead and pack, all unpackable items you own are always available.
weaknesses: The pack is not ugly, but not really a fashion statement.
Very large items (furniture, cars) cannot be "carried".
Anyone who knows you have this power will insist you always supply the camping equipment.

name: Rightful Rule
description: Also called Regal Bond, this is the ability to gain supernatural royal status in one's homeland (depending on the strength of the ability, this may mean one's city, state, country, planet or beyond). One with this ability automatically gains love and respect from neutral or same-aligned citizens of said homeland. In addition, any decree one makes in that homeland is considered law, as well as any consequence assigned to it. One's presence even psychically affects the environment (weather etc).
summary: The ability to gain supernatural royal status in one's homeland
strengths: Be loved/respected by neutral/same-aligned citizens of one's home street/city/state/country/world
Any decree one makes within one's home land is considered law (as well as accompanying consequences)
One's presence affects environment (weather, plant growth, wildlife behavior, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive layout and citizens of one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bend reality within limits of one's homeland until developed (NCN)

name: Roll Back
description: This power gives you a pair of numbers on your hands. To use this power you must designate a number. This number will be imprinted on your left hand. From that moment on, for every action that you take that causes physical change to something or someone else, that action is counted on your right hand. When the number n the right hand goes over the number on the left every physical change you caused is undone and the number on your right hand resets to zero.
summary: The ability to have everything you've done undone after a certain number of actions.
strengths: Undo every physical change you make.
The undoing does not effect where you are.
weaknesses: You have to keep track of how many actions you have left before the reset.
Once the right hand counter has ticked up once you can not change the left hand number.
The numbers are plainly visible on your hands.

name: Video Game World
description: This power allows you to put yourself into any video game you're playing, at will. You can be any character you want, and if you die, you automatically reset the game from any previous point in the game of which you completed. You can pull any item, or anybody out of the game when you want to come out.
summary: The ability to put yourself into the video, and be any character you want.
strengths: Any item you want out of the game is yours.
Be in any game you want, even 8-bit game.
When you die, you reset from a previous point in the game that you already completed.
weaknesses: If the system gets shut off while you're in the game, you can't leave until it is turned back on.
You can still feel pain, but none of it will kill you for real.

name: Weight Control
description: You can change the weight of anything you want, like make an apple weigh one million pounds or you can make an enemy so heavy that he/she can't move at all or make them so light that they are bouncy.
summary: The ability to control weight.
strengths: Have you ever struggled to carry the gallon of milk? Now, you can make it easier for yourself.
You can use that to train yourself by using pencils as weights.
weaknesses: It won't go back to the original weight until you change it back.
Requires serious concentration.

name: Deadly Copies
description: You are able to do just that- create a copy of any living person. The only difference between the copy and the actual person, is that the copy has deathly pale skin and blood red eyes. The copies can see in the dark perfectly, but are weakened by sunlight.
summary: The ability to create a copy of any living person.
strengths: You can create an army.
You can get someone else to do your dirty work.
weaknesses: The copies are weakened by sunlight.

name: Durability Drain
description: With this power, anything you touch will become more easily breakable the more you hold it. User can increases the rate of decrease of endurance but cannot turn his power off.  The durability of anything can be drained and if the durability is low enough, it will shatter due to external (or internal) force. Effects will go away after 5 hours if not in constant contact.
summary: The ability to decrease the durability of anything you touch at an accelerated rate
strengths: Smash any type of armor, even magic armors and barriers
Pseudo Super Strength
weaknesses: Still hurts your hand if you are touching anything sharp or punching something hard
Typing on your computer too long might cause it to break
Cannot deactivate power

name: Empathy Energy Waves
description: If you are controlled in your emotions, like, say, a buddhist monk, you would probably be very deadly with this... unless you're a BUDDHIST monk! It all depends if you're very moody or not. If you can control your rage or happiness you can probably win the fight.
summary: The ability to create bursts of energy rays which vary on strength depending on your mood
strengths: Not that complicated to figure out
Pretty powerful once you got it done
If you play a song that makes you happy in your head it will help control it
weaknesses: Girl on their period beware!
If you are a  very moody person this will be probably be bad cuz you will kill everyone in the room

name: Vibranium Skeletal Structure
description: The user is able to protract and retract vibranium claws from the user's hand. Vibranium can penetrate any material on Earth, because vibranium is the strongest metal on Earth. It's also lighter than most metals. It can also absorb vibrations and kinetic energy, which strenghtens the metal while not hurting the user.
summary: The ability to protract and retract vibranium claws as well as having a vibranium skeletal structure
strengths: It can penetrate any material and makes the user's movement more silent.
It's not a mutagenic and not more susceptible to being irradiated with energy than other metals
Like Adamantium Beta, it doesn't inhibit the biological processes of bone.
weaknesses: Vibranium is metal, easily defeated by enemies with the power over magnetism
Can be destroyed, but is very hard

name: Brain Knowledge Absorption
description: Everything they could recall is now yours to access. Memories, knowledge, ideas, etc you can access all of it. This power works best on living brains and you must be given permission to absorb the brain.
summary: The ability to gain all of a person's knowledge and memories by absorbing their brain
strengths: You can quickly gain knowledge.
Eating also counts as absorption, so using this power and 'Brain Eater' is a good idea.
weaknesses: If something was erased magically or psychically, you won't gain it.
Must have permission from the person giving the brain (No Con Negation).

name: Power Concentration
description: This ability implies that one can focus all of their bodily strength into one point (such as, a foot, hand, or head) into one monumental use, such as focusing the peak of one's strength into a single punch, or all of one's stamina into a burst of superhuman speed.
summary: The ability to focus the peak of one's strength into one monumental use.
strengths: Preform a super punch.
A burst of superhuman speed for quick get-a-ways.
Super jump over cities.
weaknesses: Only one monumental use.
Takes sometime before one can use this ability continually.
Using this ability at the wrong moment.

name: Iridium Skin
description: Iridium is the strongest, densest, lightest and most resistant metal known to man. By wielding this power the weilder posses superhuman strength, resiliency,muscular frame allowing him to jump to great heights and extreme distances. The wielders blood has also become a metal, mercury making him invulnerable to most human diseases.
summary: The ability to cover the wielder in a skin of iridium
strengths: Absorb most physical and long range attacks with little difficulty
Inhuman strength and muscular frame
Can repair wounds to his skin relatively quickly
weaknesses: The weilder is permanently stuck in the iridium form
Extremely weak at high and low temperatures, the mercury would freeze or evaporate
Terribly weak from mental attacks

name: One Upmanship
description: The person has the ability to "one-up" anyone. No matter what the ability is the "One-upman" is better. He can be defeated by someone without ego or who is selfless in their action. This ability can work with non meta-humans. Ex: 1)If you were around Einstein you would be more intelligent than him. 2) If you're playing a sport you would be the best on the team.
summary: The ability to one up anyone whom you are around.
strengths: Better than anyone else with superpower abilities or average people.
Able to defteat most forms of evil.
weaknesses: Once a person is defeated then the hero loses his "one-upmanship" ability.
Ability does not work on selfless people.
Comes across as being arrogant and a know it all.

name: Affliction
description: Also called, Injury Inducing is the ability to inflict painful wounds upon foes by pure force of will. The user could only induce injuries that have already happened before to himself or to the subject they wish to affect (even wounds the user may still currently have); they could not induce sickness at all (and could not induce death unless the user has himself suffered death; this would be impossible, unless he is capable of Resurrection).
summary: The ability to induce wounds and injuries on foes
strengths: You can beat the crap out of people without touching them
You can always level the playing field (playin with a broken arm? If you do, so does he)
You don't have to still be injured to inflict the injuries
weaknesses: If you've never had a serious injury in your life, the power won't be strong
If your second ability you develop is Invulnerability, this power is useless
May subconsciously activate on ANYONE you get mad at (even loved ones)

name: Chaos Shift
description: The Chaos Shift is a complex ability that is part of the chaos line of abilities. First, looking at your victim, you stun them, making them unable to move. You then put both hands around their ears and scream loudly for about 12 seconds. As you scream, your victim's eyes bleed; meanwhile, you keep screaming louder and louder until your jaws start to separate. You continue to scream as your body falls to the ground. That body dies as you take control over your victim's body.
summary: The ability to take control of another person's body.
strengths: Takes control of victim's body.
Kills victim's soul.
weaknesses: You lose your body.
Very loud.
Hurts a lot.

name: Seduction
description: You can seduce anybody using this ability.  The cuties at the bar, the hottie next door, your teacher, your friend's mom, or even your friend's grandma (hey, I won't judge), it's all in the bag.
summary: The ability to seduce anybody.
strengths: So much action
weaknesses: So little time

name: Blade Boxing
description: Uses creation magic to make swords appear at user's extremities. Upon punching, a sigil appears in front of your fist, and out of it comes a sword. Said swords are usually stopped from going completely out of the sigil (usually the grip remains inside the sigil), but with expending x3 the usual power, one can launch the blades across medium distances. Attacks can vary, such as stabbing from a punch, or slashing from a round house kick.
summary: The ability to combining hand to hand combat with creation magic
strengths: Great increase in power
Any blades can be used (sword, spear, knife, etc)
Magical blades can be used
weaknesses: Relative short range
Without magical blades, can only be used on people (no destroying buildings)

name: Nerve Stimulation
description: Manipulate ones' own and others nervous system. Can be used to cause pain or pleasure in others while also elimination the feeling of pain from ones' self.
summary: The ability to manipulate one's own and others nervous system.
strengths: The ability to enhance pleasure can be as simple as enhancing the nerve reseptors on the tongue.
One can nullify anothers nerves so they do not transmit, immobilizing the other party.
There is no true defence agains it exept for the issue of range.
weaknesses: In most cases, the power can only effect others through touch. Skin to skin is not required.
Power is not viable against non-organic material.
Drugs that effect the nervous sytem can hamper the user's ability to control their power.

name: One Man Fusion
description: Fusion means to merge with someone, becoming one being. With this ability, you can add someone else's talents to your own. If someone is stronger or faster than you, add their talents to yours, and wipe them out!
summary: The ability to add someone else's talents to yours.
strengths: Add someone else's talents to your own
Wipe out the competition
weaknesses: You must know whose talents you are adding

name: Clothing Manipulator
description: With this power you can change the sizes and designs of any article of clothing. You can make an enemy's shirt to tight so it chokes them or make your cloths be able to fit you forever. You can also change the designs of any article of clothing.
summary: The ability to change the sizes and designs of clothing
strengths: You can change the size and designs of any article of clothing
You can strangle your enemies with their own shirts
weaknesses: You can only control clothing not anything else

name: Illusion Of Light
description: You can create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light. This illusion will cause others to think you are a being of good, and will induce hope into them. With practice, you can cause an illusion of warmth.
summary: The ability to create the illusion that your body is shining light
strengths: Create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light
Induce hope into others
Takes practise to create an illusion of warmth
weaknesses: It's just an illusion

name: Zygote Mimicry
description: Zygote Mimics have two abilities. The first one is mitosis, the ability to duplicate oneself. The second one is to change this power into any Cellular Mimicry power you want. Beware as the second ability is irreversible, so make sure you have at least one clone left with Zygote Mimicry. Search the site with the keywords "cellular series" to get the list of available powers you can get.
summary: The ability to be the omnipotent/totipotent, most powerful Cellular Mimic of all Cellular Mimics.
strengths: You can get any power in the Cellular Mimicry series.
You can clone yourself to outnumber a foe.
You can create an entire army of Cellular Mimics with various powers.
weaknesses: If you change this power, you can't have it back.
If you change this power before creating any clone, you've just ruined this power's full potential.
Some Cellular Mimicry powers are arguably more useless than others.

name: Get This Power Button
description: With this power, the Get This Power button on the Superpowerlist website is continuously and permanently active 24/7 for you and you alone. After you push the button, you will instantly and physically gain the power that the button appeared next to. It shall be permanently active and you can use this power to gain any powers that you have submitted to the superpowerlist website too.
summary: The ability to have the Get This Power button constantly active for you and you alone.
strengths: Gain any power on the Superpowerlist website you want.
Also works for your own submitted powers
weaknesses: Still have to train to improve your control over the powers
Can still only get one power per day, despite the button being active all day

name: Reflexive Super Strength
description: One with this ability gains superhuman strength from one's own physical pain (getting punched, stabbed, etc). The body of the user of this ability is more sensitive to pain than the average person. When the user's body's pain receptors react, it fuels their adrenaline and physical strength. The more one receives pain, the more strength the user gains.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength through one's own physical pain.
strengths: Gain super strength from an abundant source.
More sensitive to pain, means more strength.
weaknesses: No pain no gain.
You can still feel pain and with this ability one is more sensitive to it which can cause blackouts

name: Red Sun Rebirth
description: Ah, sunrise. The birth of the new day. But for you, the real beauty of it comes from the power you can harness from it! Upon witnessing sunrise, your body flows with energy that allows you to be virtually indestructible. Effects only last 1-3 hours, and it gives you a good reason to wake up early.
summary: The ability to manifest ultimate power during sunrise.
strengths: Gives you ultimat power and control over the elements.
Sure beats coffee.
weaknesses: You must be exposed to the sunrise's rays to activate it.
You also have to wait 1-3 minutes for it to work.

name: Reaper's Essence Absorption
description: With this power, you absorb the essence of whatever you kill. It could be anything related to the creature, such as enhanced physical attributes (sight, speed, etc. ), skills, and even superpowers. However, the version of the ability you acquire is only about 5% as strong as that which belonged to the original creature. You can compound it with more killings, but only up to 50%. You also gain any associated weaknesses. You keep the new abilities forever, unless something supernatural interferes.
summary: The ability to gain new abilities, properties, and powers for each creature you kill.
strengths: Can collect many powers
Powers can be used to compliment one another
You'll have an edge against anything you've faced before, which grows greater with each success
weaknesses: Each power will never be as powerful as the original
You must kill to gain powers
May not know what to do with all your powers (if you kill a lot)

name: Bursts Of Invincibility
description: A person with this power has invincibility but only in short burst at a time. For 5 seconds the person is invulnerable, unstoppable, and cannot be moved by anyone else. When invincible, any and all powers that target the user directly are negated. All weapons and bullets bounce off. The user becomes shiny when they are in an invincible state.
summary: The ability to be invincible for short bursts of 5 seconds
strengths: You are invulnerable during 5 seconds
You will be unstoppable and unmovable by anyone else for 5 seconds
Through training, the user can use this power at crucial moments
weaknesses: There is a 10 second period between bursts
You cannot extend invincibility to others but you can shield people
Can still be distracted during the 5 seconds

name: Weakness Mimicry
description: If you're fighting against Superman, you will grow Kryptonite armor and be able to shoot Kryptonite quills. If you're fighting Flash, you will be able to vibrate the ground under your feet to trip him up or at least make him lose traction. Fighting against Aquaman, you emit a drought-like heat that evaporates water quickly. All of these come from this one power, if it's for one specific weakness like Superman/Kryptonite or power-based weakness like Aquaman/No water to use.
summary: The ability to morph your body into your opponent's weakness, according to their abilities
strengths: There is a high chance that you could win every fight.
Multiple opponents means mutiple adaptions
Their weaknesses never hurt you.
weaknesses: If you're not facing that one person, you lose that adaptation.
If they have no weakness, which is highly unlikely, you will not be able to adapt.

name: Redrum
description: If you say anyone's name, he or she will die. If you say anyone's name backwards, they will come back to life. You can only use this power on people you have already met personally. If more than one person has the name you're saying, it will kill the person you met last.
summary: The ability to kill people by saying their name and raise them from the dead by saying their name backwards.
strengths: Kill your enemies
Resurrect your friends
weaknesses: You can't say anyone's name unless you want to kill them

name: Sound Conversion
description: The person with this ability is able to turn sound in their surrounding into a concussive blast. The strength of the blast is dependent on how loud the sound is in the first place
summary: The ability to turn sound into a concussive blast that depends on how loud the sound is
strengths: Sound is everywhere
Can be used to fight evil
weaknesses: If you are rendered deaf you cant use this power

name: Power Induce
description: You can force someone with superpowers to activate any of the superpowers he/she possesses.   You can do this by looking at that person or a picture of him/her, and then calling out the name(s) of the superpower(s) while you have 1 finger in your nose and 1 finger in your right ear.
summary: The ability to induce the powers of someone with superpowers
strengths: You can defeat a superpowered foe by inducing conflicting powers at the same time
You can help out your superpowered friend who has problems activating his superpowers.
weaknesses: Have to resist the urge to play pranks on your superpowered friends.

name: Break
description: You're about to get hit, what do you do?... Break! You will shatter upon contact, then reform. You can reform behind your opponent for a sneak attack or propel the shards at him. If some of the shards get stuck, your body won't reform completely and will bleed from where the shards were.
summary: The ability to break into shards that reform
strengths: Bullets won't go through you
Hits can't touch you
Cut somebody using your body shards
weaknesses: If some body shard get stuck, you will get a a wound when you reform

name: Regeneration Block
description: A person with this power has the ability to prevent a person's natural healing ability to heal from cuts or bruises or any type of damage. This also applies to regeneration. This may not seem like a great power at first but it is. Anyone hit by this ability will eventually be unable to fight due to the staggering amount of injuries and the pain from torn out muscles. Unless the original user deactivates it, the person remains affected. Death does not deactivate the power.
summary: The ability to prevent a person from healing until chosen
strengths: Once you hit someone with this power it will only be a matter of time
Death by a thousand cuts--you would be a master of torture with this ability
Outlast other people in sporting events if you are evil with this ability
weaknesses: People can still sew themselves up or make external repairs (still not as good as regular healing)
Only works on organic tissue

name: Your Super Smash Bros. Powers
description: Use your moves and powers you would have if you were part of the videogame called Super Smash Brothers. The videogame called Super Smash Brothers is a videogaeme about combat in which they compete and fight the characters of Nintendo, all the powers and abilities of the characters in the videogame called Super Smash Brothers are based on the skills and powers used in his previous Nintendo videogames. This super power is just like that. This super power is inspired of Super Smash Brothers games.
summary: The ability to use your movements as you would if you were part of the videogame called Super Smash Brothers
strengths: You can find out how they could be your movements, abilities and powers in Nintendo's videogames
You probably also have a lot of abilities and powers that you used in your current life
You can also use the shield using the characters in the videogame called Super Smash Brothers
weaknesses: This ensures superpower not know what your life as a series of Nintendo
You can only use certain abilities and super powers about yourself
Your shield is not eternally invulnerable to all

name: Pokemon Summoning
description: With this power you can summon any non-legendary Pokemon. The Pokemon are under your control. When you summon a Pokemon for the first time they are at level five but the more you summon it and train it the stronger it gets.
summary: The ability to summon any Pokemon
strengths: You can summon any Pokemon
weaknesses: They start at level five
You can't summon legendary Pokemon

name: Second Time Around
description: You've got a strange sort of aura always hanging over you. Whenever you face a person in combat, regardless of whether you win or lose, their every movement, habit and ability is recorded in your mind. If you survive the first encounter and by chance, you ever battle that person again, your body automatically responds, dodges and perfectly counters any ability they throw at you.
summary: The ability to never lose to an opponent you've already faced once before.
strengths: After facing anybody once, you can never lose to them again.
There's nothing cooler than a guy that CAN'T be hit.
weaknesses: If you die during your first encounter, you're pretty much screwed.
No practical use whatsoever outside of combat.

name: Doxiakinesis
description: Any question anyone directly asks you i. E what is the meaning of life, you would be able to answer, you don't know everything, but you will remember what the answers were. The questions would have to be directed towards you. You aren't forced to answer the question, you can keep it to yourself or lie.
summary: The ability to be able to answer any question directly put to you.
strengths: Become an expert with quizzes.
Can gain any knowledge you want.
Can easily learn the truth.
weaknesses: Information could confuse or contradict your beliefs.
Some things you are better off not knowing.
Has to be asked to you directly

name: Cybor Lycanthropy
description: You can change between a man and a giant metallic wolf or a hybrid form. Characteristics are proportionate to size of body and may take some getting used to. This power is usually a result of an attack by anyone with power to alter DNA or genetic makeup. Power cannot be reversed by anyone. Also as a bonus injuries to metallic form are reversed by changing back into human form However fatal wounds are more difficult but possible to heal.
summary: The ability to transforn into a giant metalic wolf.
strengths: You can gain strength by changing into a metalic wolf
You can heal by changing back into a human.
No'one will say "Go fetch! Unless they want to die.
weaknesses: Changing forms takes a little while, bad for being ambushed and takes a while to master.
When in human form your body is still subject to age and normal injury.
Extremely heightened aggresion or hearing in human, Takes lots of focus to over come.

name: Superpower Of The Day
description: Automatically gives you the Superpower of the Day every day. However, after it changes, you lose the previous Superpower of the Day.
summary: The ability to always have the Superpower of the Day
strengths: It's always something good
weaknesses: It changes every day
You might already have it

name: The Doodle
description: With this power you can trap enemies onto paper as small animated drawings. The trapped person can be messed with by drawing other things on the page. You can also trap objects to make realistic drawings.
summary: The ability to trap an enemy as an animated drawing on a piece of paper.
strengths: Trap your enemies
