Trap objects for cool drawings
Mess with trapped enemies by drawing on the page
weaknesses: Enemies are animated and still have all their abilities(although they are drawn too)

name: Whd's Power Broker
description: You have the ability of granting as many people that ask a portion of 25 different superpowers. People touch your hand and they have a limited amount of your top 25 powers. What's in it for you? Once your grant power to more than 25 people the most popular power is yours. After another 25 you get the most popular 2 powers. After 75 and more you will always be granted the full spectrum of the 3 most popular powers.
summary: The ability to grant people a portion of 25 different superpowers, granting you the most popular powers
strengths: You could easily fluctuate between powers & abilities
Your abilities grow stronger with the amount of people with granted abilities
You are able to grant enhanced strength, speed, or whatever your top 25 favorite powers are
weaknesses: Your power is based on demand of your clients, their desires empower you
You have no control over how much power is granted & you could be making your enemies
You favorite three powers may not be your clients' favorites

name: Iron Clad
description: Iron is stored in the hollow of your bones, but you can expel the iron on command to layer over your skin as a exo-suit.
summary: The ability to store iron in the hollow of your bones but release it onto your skin like an Exo-Suit
strengths: When in your bones it makes it impossible to break your bones
Also gives you enhanced strength
Gives you an almost impervious exo-suit
weaknesses: Makes you slow
Makes you heavy
It is very exhausting to stay powered up

name: Mirror Monsters
description: When this ability is active, you are able to invoke paranormal forces through mirrors, puddles of water, glass or any other reflective surfaces. You can easily annihilate your foes with the element of suprise and never have to fight alone. As a result of acquiring this ability, you are capable of traveling through mirrors and dragging your victims into the monsters' den.
summary: The ability to summon creatures through reflective surfaces.
strengths: Being around stores and skyscrapers is the perfect place to be.
Summon massive monsters from sparkling lakes and rivers.
weaknesses: Some reflective surfaces may be too small for travel.
Some locations may not have any reflective surfaces.

name: Soul Successor
description: A person who has this power will never truly die. When someone kills the user, their essence/soul/being is instantly transfered to a successor. They can't fully control the succesor but will always be behind the person and can talk to him/her. While they are in another body, they can add the other person's physical strength, knowledge and memories to their own and they can manifest themselves for a time if that person agrees to do so. The user can be trapped by abilities that target souls.
summary: The ability to live on in others
strengths: You can never be fully killed but you will never be able to act independently again
You can keep on living to fulfill a grudge then give others guidance
You can give others more strength that was gained through training and your original powers
weaknesses: You cannot keep powers that are specific to your successor-but knowledge like magic is kept
You must choose a successor before you die or you will be placed in a random person
You have to stay forever as a spirit of guidance

name: Killing Intent Manipulation
description: At the lower levels of power, this power can only control whether or not a person strongly or weakly desires another being's death. At the higher levelsof power, this power can affect the physical world using nothing more than the user's killing intent. However they cannot create with this power, they can only destroy. The killing intent can be used to 'punch,' 'kick,' 'slash,' etc. I repeat: The more powerful effects only work with the user's own killing intent.
summary: The ability to manipulate the desire to kill others
strengths: Cause mass havoc by making people want to kill each other (May be con if you abhor people killing).
Can affect the physical world wit nothing more than the desire to kill others.
Can control whether people want to kill. If that's not powerful, I don't know what is.
weaknesses: Takes years to reach highest levels of power.
You must have killing intent to use the higher levels of power.
Con Negation and similar powers do not affect this power.

name: Fear Induced Powers
description: This is pretty basic. If you are afraid of heights, you gain flight. Tight spaces: Shrinking. Fire: Cryokinesis. Etc. The twist is that they only work if you are actively experiencing fear. If you are falling you can't just think, "Oh, well. I'll just wait for my flight to kick in. " You have to think that your powers could give out at any moment. Even the slightest sense of comfort, happiness, or confidence will cause them to short out. Ultimately, this is only good for defense.
summary: The ability to gain helpful powers from fear
strengths: Always have an appropriate power to get you out of a jam
Kicks in automatically
Easy to operate
weaknesses: Fear must be contsant and intense
Only good for defense
You can never have full confidence in your ability

name: Food Generation
description: This gives you the ability to make any food you want. This is not limited to condiments as well. You can produce any kind of food and you can end world hunger.
summary: The ability to create food and generate it from your hands
strengths: You can end world hunger
Never be hungry again
Never have to eat cafeteria food
weaknesses: You need plates and cups
Dirty hands

name: Will Breaking: Corrosive Will
description: Achieved only by those who have mastered the discipline of molding will, this ability enables a person to transmute not only their will but also the will of those around them into a viscous liquid-like phantom substance that corrodes logic and rationality, along with perception. Almost visible to the naked eye, this transparent and extremely poisonous substance is pure intangible will that weakens the victim's body and willpower, leaving them vulnerable to other will-breaking techniques.
summary: The ability to corrode logic, rationality, and perception through will.
strengths: Weakens the willpower of your victims.
Instantly kills organic targets.
Can be materialized around you.
weaknesses: Requires other will-breaking abilities in order to finish off strong-minded victims.

name: Always Thinking
description: With this power you always have a good idea: it can be a way to defeat a villain or ultimate recipe for sponge cake. It's completely random but it's always good in some way or another.
summary: The ability to always have a good idea
strengths: Might come up with a great way to defeat your enemies
weaknesses: Will always be a good idea but might not be particularly useful at the moment

name: K.O. Immunity
description: This ability works well in fights. Your opponents would have a hard time defeating you. You'll keep on coming back up with enough energy to stay up until you are knocked back down. This ability also increases one's stamina and endurance to a level that a cannonball won't normally kill you.
summary: The ability to be unable to be knocked out.
strengths: Good for fights, able to get energy when knocked out.
High stamina and endurance boost.
If you stay alive long enough and only get knocked down/out, it's harder to kill you later.
weaknesses: Works only for knocked down, can still be killed by bullets, etc.

name: Dragon Egg
description: You find an egg that looks nothing like any egg you've ever seen, so you decide to break it open and see what's inside. Sparkles start to surround your body as you absorb the power within. You now have the powers of a dragon, which include but is not limited to shape shifting, elemental breath (fire, ice, lightning, etc. ), flight, super strength, above average speed and reflexes, razor sharp claws, enhanced senses, prehensile forked tongue, and magical scales.
summary: The ability to gain all the abilities of a dragon
strengths: Lots of power found in such a puny egg.
You can breath four different elements of your choice.
Your scales allow you to block, use, or absorb magic from spells.
weaknesses: Your belly is your weakness. If it's hit, it's like getting kicked in the groin.
You can only choose four elements. (not ice, fire, earth, air, shadow, lighning) Only four.
Sickos trying to hunt you down thinking you're a big lizard.

name: Pocket Full Of Kryptonite
description: Everybody has a weakness, right? Even Superman, arguably one of the the most powerful heroes of all time, is vulnerable to Kryptonite. Well, with this power you have the the weakness of whoever you're fighting in your pocket, so you can use it against them
summary: The ability to have whatever your enemy's weakness is in your pocket
strengths: You have your enemy's weakness in your pocket
weaknesses: If you're enemy doesn't have a weakness this power is useless

name: Kiss Strength
description: With this power you gain superhuman strength and invulnerability for an hour after you kiss somebody. It doesn't matter who it is as long as he/she is a member of your species (if you are a shapeshifter it has to be of the species that you are at the time). You then have superhuman strength and invulnerability for sixty minutes after that time you lose the strength until you kiss somebody or are kissed again. The kiss can be anywhere on the face for it to work.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength and invulnerability after you kiss somebody
strengths: You can gain super strength
weaknesses: They have to be of your species
The kiss has to be somewhere on the face
You only have strength and invulnerability for an hour

name: Dust
description: You're able to turn your body into a living sandstorm, blinding enemies or attacking them with slashing dust, which can get so severe as to flay the flesh off your victims. However, in order to turn back into your normal self, you need to go back into the clothes you came out of.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a living sandstorm powerful enough to flay the flesh off your enemies
strengths: Leave your enemies with scars
Blind your enemies
weaknesses: Must get back into previous clothes

name: Forced Reversion
description: Sick of Perfect Immortality and other powers which change the body of the user? Then this is the perfect power for you - you can undo any change done by superpowers, even if they can't do so themselves. With practice, you can prevent such powers (e.g. Reality Warping) from working when around you. Needless to say, this power is best used as part of a team. If a foe is adaptive, he or she will have all adaptations stripped until they are re-adapted away from you.
summary: The ability to undo changes done by superpowers.
strengths: Excellent defense against Perfect Immortality
Great against a power mimic.
You can free people of changes done by another's powers.
weaknesses: This power can only be used in certain situations
Don't use this on an ally with Immortality who is hundreds of years old.
If you undo something beneficial, this power cannot restore it.

name: Offense Shield
description: This power is kind of like invulnerability, but it works only one way. If you punch a wall, the wall gets damage, but not you. If you body slam someone, they recieve damage, but not you. You are not protected from kinetic damage directed toward you. If a car hits you, you receive damage. If someone punces you or you get hit by bullets, you receive that kinetic damage and get hurt. It only protects from the kinetic damage you attack with, not the kinetic damage coming towards you.
summary: The ability to be protected from the kinetic force you cause to other things. Read Description.
strengths: Be protected from damage your attacks cause.
Protection against any kinetic damage you direct towards other things.
You can finally punch the wall without getting hurt.
weaknesses: Does not protect you from kinetic force directed towards you.
If someone punches you of you get hit by a car, you recieve that kinetic damage.
Only useful if you attack.

name: Mathematical Intuition
description: With Mathematical Intuition you can solve anything from 3489x243+21 to a rubiks cube in seconds flat. This can also have amazing accuracy by applying geometry to the situation.
summary: The ability to instantly know the solution to any mathematical problem.
strengths: Can solve the most difficult puzzles quickly.
Be an amazing marksman
weaknesses: This power only applies to mathematics

name: Wards
description: Energy wards are magical constructs set up by someone as a warning/defensive system. To create a ward you must first mentally visualize the area you place the ward in. Next you must focus your own magical energy into one marble sized energy ball. Then mentally move the ball in the shape of the ward you want. The ball will etch a energy trail behind it until you cease to direct it. How much energy you put into determines the strength of the ward.
summary: The ability to create magical energy wards
strengths: You can create magical energy wards of varying strengths
You can control the power level
The wards become invisible when you stop focusing on them and only you can see them with your mind
weaknesses: Forgetting to take down a high-power ward
Though you can't be affected by wards your friends can

name: Flow Disruption
description: Power naturally gathers in an area of the body, generally the heart. When using a power, some of that power flows from the gathering place to where it is needed. With this power, you can "disrupt" or block the flow. This in turn stops the use of powers on certain parts of the body for a shot period of time. This powers requires the target to be physically touched. This power does not stop energy needed to keep an area alive from getting to the area.
summary: The ability to disrupt the flow of power
strengths: Enemy can't use any power on part of their body for a short while.
Stops the power currently being used from getting more power.
The flow of power will slowly return to the affected area.
weaknesses: Have to touch the target.
The blockage only stops power for a short while.
Con Negation and similar powers do not work on this power, Power Safety etc. do

name: Human Interface
description: You are able to bring up your own interface, with it you can decide how long you want to sleep, exercise etc for example you can set your self to skip till after work entirely, you still hold the memories of work but didn't drag yourself through it. You just bring up the interface and set yourself to work for the whole day and your body takes over, you just skip ahead to when the task you have set is over.
summary: The ability to control what you do, when, where and how long for.
strengths: A days work over in a flash
The tiring hours at the gym over in seconds
Be able to study and remember perfectly, AND be your own alarm clock
weaknesses: Can throw you off as 8 hours can pass in seconds
You are brought out of your "sleep" to make any major decision
You might miss out on experiencing something great

name: Blackstars
description: When the power is used, you can take a stack of black shurikens and throw them at the opponent. Then, it all disappears. It will appear on the first object, enemy, wall, etc. straight in front of where you threw it. It will flash red and then explode. All this happens in one or two seconds, depending on the distance. You can throw a deadly multitude of shurikens at the foe, covering their entire body before throwing the last one into the head, causing the opponent to fall and explode.
summary: The ability to throw black ninja stars that explode on contact.
strengths: Could even make doors explode when in contact.
weaknesses: In water, the entire process slows down the speed, including the period of time.

name: Chirality Reflection
description: A chiral object is an object that is not equal to its mirror image. A person with this power has the ability to turn any object or part of an object into its mirror image. In addition this power can be used selectively to target only a single chirality center or point of difference. This power can work on a molecular level to synthesize compounds or prevent someone's body from working correctly.
summary: The ability to change any object into its mirror image based on a point of chirality
strengths: Give your enemies two left feet--to trip them up
Can make it easy to synthesize hard to make compounds
Can switch which arm someone hits you with or simply just make their body not function properly
weaknesses: Less useful, if the user is not skilled enough to affect molecules
Useless against something that is symmetrical

name: Incandescence
description:
The Incandescence ability has two facets: the ability to increase the body's rate of metabolism, leading to an increased body temperature and surge of physical stamina, and the ability to emit a glowing light through bioluminescent molecules in the skin, triggered by the aforementioned high levels of body heat.

This power is activated by stimulating the brain tissue which causes religious experiences.  This stimulation can be prompted by meditation, prayer, etc. Suits holy men or paladin types.
summary: The ability to increase body temperature and emit a bodily glowing light
strengths: Resistance to cold
Constant access to light, and a counter against darkness-based superpowers
Increased physical stamina and alertness
weaknesses: Increased use of calories, leading to more rapid exhaustion.
Lack of stealth while using ability.
Requires self-confidence and a state of calmness.

name: Living Nightmares
description: Lets just say your enemy's worst nightmare is being kissed by his grandma in public...ha ha... you could make it happen! To use this power you need lots of concentration, enough to bring it to life.
summary: The ability to bring others nightmares to life.
strengths: It scares the enemy half to death.
weaknesses: It could attack you.

name: Monster Creation
description: The rules include: that the monsters do what you want them to do and they have to be inanimate objects to begin with.
summary: The ability to change objects into monsters with a random power
strengths: Getting rid of bullies
Doing things without getting blamed
Get what you want
weaknesses: No one gives you the credit you deserve
The creatures attack you when you are knocked out
Creatures disintegrate once defeated

name: Sleep Benefits
description: The duration of your rest corresponds to your power level; a cat nap is much less beneficial than a full-night's sleep. You could lift a maximum of a couple tons and survive a large explosion. As you spend time awake, your powers decrease until you have been awake longer than you have been asleep.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength and durability from sleeping
strengths: Various levels of superstrength and durability
Incentive and excuse to sleep more
weaknesses: Your powers will begin to lessen as you spend time awake
If you cannot obtain sleep you are powerless

name: Drug Touch
description: If you have heard of the name of a drug and its effects, you can cause a person to feel their effects by touching them, only when you have skin to skin contact. The drug will actually manifest in the subject's system. You can replicate recreational and medicinal drugs, and control the dosage created. The subject's body will burn through the drug at the normal rate, and you have to touch them again to remedicate.
summary: The ability to cause someone to feel the effects of any drug by touching them
strengths: You can treat the ill and needy by giving them expensive medicines for free
You could make a lot of money giving people the effects of recreational drugs
If in great danger, you could sedate an attacker, or give them a lethal overdose
weaknesses: Your power doesn't work on yourself
You need to research drugs and medicines to use your power to its full potential
Drugs you create still have their full side-effects

name: Canine Mimicry
description: Canines are one of the dog family on Earth. A canine mimic has a power that allows the person to take on or duplicate on the natural abilities of canine species, such as superhuman senses, physical attributes of strength, speed and agility. They can also track down preys.
summary: The ability to take on characteristics and abilities of canines, such as wolves, coyotes, foxes and other species
strengths: Keen sense of smell, hearing, and eyesight
Extreme physical strength, speed and agility
Easily provoked and quick to anger
weaknesses: If you cannot smell
You are very sensitive to loud music and vibrations, etc.

name: Sorcerium (Liquid Metal)
description: This metal is immune to magic and can be fully manipulated into any shape at higher levels. At lower levels it is only resistant to magic and can only be in the rough shape of weapons or armors. Note: the metal is NOT Mercury aka Quicksiler or Hydrargyrum.
summary: The ability to create and control a liquid metal that is immune to magic of any kind
strengths: Protect yourself from magic by covering youself with the metal.
weaknesses: People who can control magentism can take control of this metal.

name: Valuable Excrement
description: Instead of producing waste, you excrete valuables depending on the day of the week. Monday it's gold. Tuesday it's diamonds. Wednesday it's Silver. Thursday it's Emeralds. Friday it's Platinum. Saturday it's Rubies. Sunday it is random.
summary: The ability to you excrete valubles from your rear.
strengths: Eating more the richer you become
Fun suprise Sunday's
weaknesses: Possible damage to intestines or hind quarters.
Accidently flush toilet.
Need special toilet.

name: Transformation Mimicry
description: This ability can allow the user to get as strong as the person that transformed. Example, say the user was fighting Goku until Goku transforms into a Super Saiyan. The user can use this ability to transform into a Super Saiyan too. The user gets all the powers and perks that the transformation gives. This ability's effects wear off as soon as the opponent turns back to normal. If the user stays in a form too long, they will burn themselves out.
summary: The ability to mimic another person or thing's transformation.
strengths: Transform into what your opponent (or ally) transformed into.
Counter their new form
All of the perks, none of the weaknesses
weaknesses: Wears off when turned back to normal
Stay in a form too long, then you will burn yourself out.

name: Being A Clayfighter
description: Clayfighter is a series of video games from the official brand called Interplay is about a special meteorite that made the characters and particular things become versions of dough with super powers and related to what are features. This superpower allows its owner to become a wrestler typical dough about it with super powers related to the typical it. A detail not mentioned is that like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
summary: The ability to fight and being are like the characters in the video game series called ClayFighter
strengths: Like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
You have super powers real good about yourself
weaknesses: Can die as humans die

description:
If a person asks you to bestow them with wealth beyond measure. You can do so, or you could choose to give them poverty beyond measure. Playing with extreme wealth, or extreme poor. If the latter is given, all their assets are reduced to a net worth of zero, or go into a considerable debt.
This power can only be applied if the person asks you to bestow riches on them. You have the choice of wealth, or poverty, however once asked of you, you must make an immediate decision.
summary: The ability to bestow fortune or ill-fortune on others, only if they ask.
strengths: Decide on whether the person becomes wealthy or poor.
Hopefully this will get me top spot alphabetically on the list.
weaknesses: Power is only active when someone asks it of you.
You must make the decision when asked of you immediately, instinctively you won't become indecisive.
You won't be sure whether this person deserves ultimate riches or to suffer unbearably in complete poverty.

name: Politician's Answer
description: With this power you will always be able to come up with an answer that will satisfy whoever it was that asked the question. Disclaimer: You may be caught contradicting yourself.
summary: The ability to always be able to come up with an answer that will please whoever is asking the question.
strengths: You will always have a satisfactory answer.
weaknesses: There was a disclaimer and everything.

name: Substitute Kryptonite
description: With this power, you can make any object anybody's kryptonite.   The target person will react the same way Superman reacts when he is exposed to kryptonite-all their powers will be gone and they will cringe in pain, prolonged exposure leads to death.  The effects only work on one person at a time, so if you are fighting a team, then tough luck.   This weakness however works on all clones and alternate reality versions of the same person.
summary: The ability to make any object someone's weakness
strengths: In a one-on-one fight, you always have the advantage
You can turn anything into a person's weakness, even people
weaknesses: Lead suits block weakness effects from afar
You can only target one person's weakness at a time
People will call you cheap

name: The Promise
description: Allows you to make sure anybody's promise to you come true. Useful if someone promises money or anything valuable, but deadly if the promise is of death or defeat.
summary: The ability to make any promise held against you come true, or not.
strengths: You can instantly gain anything from promises.
You can finally get that promotion your boss promised you.
weaknesses: Sadly, you can't promise to yourself.
Death and injury is always a bad thing, right?

name: Iron Cloth
description: This technique can cut through almost anything depending on how much Ki you infused with it. You can also throw it depending on how much Ki you put in is how long it will last when not in contact.
summary: The ability to enforce the tensile strength and cutting edge of fabrics
strengths: Make cloth material as sword, whip, makeshift flails.
weaknesses: Using Ki tires you

name: Forced Time Travel
description: On a touch you can force someone into the future or past. The distance of the time travel depends on how skilled you are with the power and obviously it would be a terrible idea to send someone to the past. Cannot send self.
summary: The ability to punch people into next week.
strengths: Get someone out of your hair for a while.
Make someone miss their appointments.
Hide people in the future.
weaknesses: Cannot travel in time personally.

name: Orbital Pull
description: The wielder can force any object with solid matter to orbit around their being creating a near impenetrable armour and shield. They can also release the control of an object and direct into any direction with accuracy and destructive force
summary: The ability to have any object orbit your being
strengths: Can make any object orbit you to create a near impenetrable armour and shield
Can direct objects with accuracy and destructive force
Can attract any object into his orbital pull
weaknesses: Can only attract solid objects with physical matter
Is extremely vulnerable to mental and illusion attacks
After a maximum usage of 4 hours the wielder is drained of energy

name: Liquid Shock Absorb
description: If your body senses imminent impact, Liquid Shock Absorb will turn your tissues into a gelatinous substance capable of absorbing or redirecting the force. Depending on what hits you, the vibrations may be enough to crack pavement or break bones. After being struck your cells relax and enter a liquid state which is more susceptible to damage and is more difficult to control. Because of this, successive hits may eventually cause damage, but it also allows for increased flexibility.
summary: The ability to resist impact force by temporarily becoming gelatinous
strengths: Ability activates automatically
Almost invulnerable
Increased flexibility and striking power
weaknesses: Succesive hits may cause damage to internal organs
Losing control of your body in liquid form

name: Reverse Pain Empath
description: One may cause others to expirience the pain they are currently feeling. If one inflicts the pain over more than one person, the intensity is diluted. Using this power does not cause the pain to go away. The pain inflicted will be in the same place on the original recipient. (On amputees will relocate to opposite side of the body)
summary: The ability to inflict the pain one is expiriencing onto another person.
strengths: Can harm and disable ememies.
Is untracable (no one can prove it was you. )
High pain tolerance.
weaknesses: Must be hurt to use power.
May cause one to become emo and/or sadistic.

name: Plagiarizer
description: With this ability, you have the ability to tamper with history and rewrite people's lives in order to incorporate you into them. With this ability, you could become the President of the United States by slowly changing the past. You could convince someone that they were madly in love with you for as long as they could remember. You could erase someone from history by denying their birth from the records.
summary: The ability to change history in any way you want in order to change your life.
strengths: Become whatever you always wanted to be.
Get to extremely high places in government in mere minutes.
Do anything you want without fearing the consequences, because you can rewrite the past.
weaknesses: If you change too much in a short period of time, people notice.
If people found out, they could be mad and go into a frenzy
You are still mortal and, as such, you can die before you can rewrite an event to stop your death.

name: Vicarious Replication
description: A virus reproduces itself by using existing cells. So too does a Vicarious Replicator. By touching and holding another person, they can cause that person to become a perfectly indistinguishable duplicate of the user, down to their memories. However, the change can be resisted by those with a particularily strong will and only the user can replicate himself. Finally, when the user dies or loses the ability, all the duplicate people are restored to the state they were changed from.
summary: The ability to duplicate yourself using other people's bodies
strengths: Nearly limitless source of material
Take over your foes before they can do you harm
Duplicates look like you, think like you, and know what you know
weaknesses: Change can be resisted by a strong will
Only user can replicate themself, not duplicates
When user dies/loses ability, duplicates return to normal

name: Living Blood
description: Someone who holds this power has a lifeforce that is different. Their lifeforce will give their blood its own life, its own emanations of power and bring their blood to life upon leaving their body. The blood will take on the form of a random organism and will generally listen to the requests of the one it came from, because it recieved its life and power from them.
summary: The ability to have blood that can move around on its own
strengths: Possibility of a hard-to-kill servant.
Any blood you spill is your enemy's nightmare.
This and the power Endless Blood.
weaknesses: Make sure your wounds are cleaned.
The blood organisms may not listen to you.
The blood organisms might be living, but they don't have souls (May be pro).

name: Self Cleaning Wounds
description: Many people have died because of wound infection. With this ability, all of your wounds you recieve will clean themselves. No need to reach for that painful rubbing alcohol to clean the wound. If you concentrate a little, small pieces of glass or spinters hurting your skin will escape the wound. If you super concentrate, you can get rid of bullets, pins, and cactus thorns in the wound. Never worry about wound infection again. Does not make you heal any faster.
summary: The ability to have your wounds clean itself. Read description.
strengths: Have wounds clean themselves. No more painful rubbing alcohol!
Get rid of splinters and small pieces of glass or splinters in your skin.
Get rid of pins, cactus thorns, and bullets from your skin.
weaknesses: Does not make you heal any faster.
Takes some concentration to get rid of glass pieces and spinters from your wounds.
Takes an extreme amount of concentration to get rid of pins, cactus thorns, and bullets from wounds.

name: Substance: Trait Negation
description: With this power, you can permanently negate the properties or traits of a chemical element, combination or substance in the near vicinity. For example: Lead is a very dense element. If you have a strip of it in your vicinity, you could negate that trait to make it as dense as a sponge. Chlorine trifluoride is a highly flammable compound, but with this power you could make it incombustible, so it's not flammable anymore. The effects are permanent, so you only need to concentrate for a few seconds
summary: The ability to negate the traits or properties of a particular substance, chemical, etc.
strengths: Negate the properties of a substace until they no longer have the trait at all.
Change is permanent, no need to concentrate.
You can directly target chemical in the area, or a large burst within the vicintiy of 100 metres.
weaknesses: Change is permanent, that might not be so good.
You can only negate the porperties that the substance already has.
With large bursts, you could make technology important to everyone useless

name: Body Switching
description: Using this power, you have to look into the eyes of a person, then your mind will switch with their's. You will have their body & vice versa. You will gain all of their super abilities if they have any, but not their skills & knwoledge that they learned. This only lasts for a day till the spell wears off.
summary: The ability to swap your mind & personality into another person's body
strengths: Swap bodies with another person
Gain their super powers
weaknesses: Have to look into their eyes for the power to work
You don't get any of their learned skills or personal knowledge
Only lasts for a day

name: Mirror Cracking Ugly
description: Mirrors will just break whenever you smile at your reflection. It works no matter how ugly you really are. However, you need to see your own reflection and it only works on mirrors you can see yourself reflected in.
summary: The ability to fracture mirrors when you smile at them.
strengths: You must see yourself in the mirror, but others don't have to see you in the mirror.
Make people believe THEY made the mirror crack by being careful with angles.
weaknesses: You will be given 7 years of bad luck for each mirror you crack.
You will only be able to see how you look when you smile for a split second.

name: Pain Powered
description: With this power you become a sadist. You feed off of others pain and agony, just to gain strength. But with that strength you become more durable, faster reflexes, smarter, super strong, and super fast. With enough torment surrounding you, might even be able to use other powers of anyone who stands in your way. Involuntary
summary: The ability to gain strength from other's suffering
strengths: Smarter, better, faster, stronger. (Eat your heart out Kanye)
Gain strength from anyone's pain, that includes your enemies
Involuntary; no matter who suffers you will gain power
weaknesses: Sadistic
Might be seen as evil
Enough pain and suffering could kill a victim

name: Photograph Resurrection
description: It was once believed that, when you take a picture of someone, the camera takes that person's soul. Photograph Resurrection allows you to bring old loved ones back to life in a non-corpsy form. All you need is a picture of them and their dead body. Simply wave the photo over their heart (which must be INSIDE the body) and snap. They will be back to life at the age the picture was taken. They can still die again and they will dissappear from the photo, so have lots of photos of them XD
summary: The ability to bring a person back to life in their (non-corpsy) body by using a photograph of them
strengths: Bring people back to life
They won't be corpsy
They come back the age they were in the picture
weaknesses: They can die again
You need a picture of them as well as their body WITH a heart inside
The photo can only be used once, since they will disappear from the photo

name: Author's Power Channeling
description: Do you possess a lot of powers you made, only to get them negated, stolen, etc? If so this will be very useful to you. In such a situation, you can channel the power from someone who possesses that particular power. They cannot stop this with any power, although they are not harmed in any way. However, it does not work on those mimicking the power. Unfortunately, powers such as Con Negation do not affect this power. If you lose this power, you lose all protections.
summary: The ability to channel the powers you made.
strengths: Keep the powers you made.
The more popular the power, the harder it is to permanently negate it.
No limit to range, no defense and the target is not harmed.
weaknesses: Only works with powers you made.
Mimics do not help in any way -the target must have acquired the power in the normal way.
Does not provide immunity to counters (e. G. Telepathy vs Anti Telepathy)

name: Napalm Stomp
description: You can slam your foot into the floor, causing a huge catastrophic eruption and damaging all foes. This might be great thing for clearing out whoever gets in your way.
summary: The ability to slam your foot to the ground that causes to the ground to erupt.
strengths: Could cause some explosions just by stomping your foot.
weaknesses: If you stomp on a floor full of oil can accidentally blaze yourself to ashes along anyone with it.

name: Death Wish
description: With this power, you are reborn when you are struck by a killing blow (as a passive defense mechanism). After you are reborn, your strength and speed is enhanced. However, your subconscious will take over and exact revenge on your killer to your body's full extent, using all known skills. During this phase you will feel no pain nor any emotion. If you die in this state, no ability can resurrect you. This "reborn" form cannot be switched off at will, and will switch off only when your goal is met
summary: The ability to be reborn when you die, giving you extra strength and speed.
strengths: Allows you to swiftly exact revenge upon enemies.
Your body will fully utilize all abilities it knows.
No distractions or wasteful movements; every action is intended on killing the enemy.
weaknesses: Lack of thinking before you leap.
You cannot return to the living once killed.
Incredibly exhausting.

name: Concentration
description: To divert blood flow and muscle tension to a single body part. Said body part also develops extreme elasticity and durability, enabling it to withstand heavy blows and recoil. Muscle mass increases also, and the extremity develops a dark red tint due to the extreme blood pressure. Concentration in the arm enables extreme strength, in the legs extreme running/jumping abilities, etc.
summary: The ability to focus strength and endurance into a specific extremity or body part--e.g. piledriver fist, etc.
strengths: Heavy hitter when the time comes!
Maneuverability! Nobody can catch someone with super-legs.
Huge, dark red arm looks AWESOME.
weaknesses: Extended numbness results from the huge blood pressure afterwards. Sorry!
If you overuse it, you might just lose a limb. Be careful!
If you can't "concentrate" fast enough, it's over...

name: Synchronization
description: The power to fuse yourself with anything within 2 feet. Can create a single being working in unison.
summary: The ability to fuse with objects and people
strengths: Gain characteristics of object in range
Is not permanent
You have a majority of the mental control
weaknesses: Only lasts an hour.
Think before you fuse
Some results may make you appear repulsive

name: Reactive Density
description: Human tissue is easily torn. But a person with Reactive Density automatically increases their density with external pressure. This makes them generally impervious to harm: knives shatter on their skin, bullets flatten on impact, and even a speeding car cannot hurt them. However, there are some downsides. The user can still get sick and there is no super-strength that comes with it. Even more dangerous, massive pressure (1000 tons+) causes the user to over-dense. This results in a heart attack.
summary: The ability to increase your density in response to pressure
strengths: General invunerability
Not having to worry about safety concerns
Presence
weaknesses: No super-strength
Can be burned (though less badly than normal)
1000+ tons pressure causes heart attack

name: Instant Appraisal
description: This is a very useful ability. It allows the user to detect and appraise objects of value. Whenever an object of value comes within 15ft of the user, they'll get a feeling of warmth and well-being. When they actually see the object, they'll instantly know how valuable the object is.
summary: The ability to detect and appraise things of value.
strengths: You could find some really great deals.
With good negotiation skills, you could make a lot of money
weaknesses: You have to find the object yourself, the detection won't give you the location.

name: Razor Wire
description: This ability allows you to fling lengths of razor sharp wire from any point on your body. The wire can attach to nearby static objects and is very strong/durable. You could even use it in a spider-man fasion for travel. Wire can be retracted back into your body.
summary: The ability to shoot lengths of razor sharp wire any point on your body
strengths: Wire is razor sharp to cut enemies
Can use the wire for travel
Wire can be fired from any point on your body
weaknesses: May harm innocent bystanders
Difficult to use as a form of travel

name: Bullet Rain
description: With this power you can cause armoro piercing bullets to rain from the sky. The bullets can pierce through the even the strongest armor but they cannot hurt you or anybody else with this power.
summary: The ability to cause armor piercing bullets to rain from the sky
strengths: You can cause bullets to rain from the sky
You cannot be hurt by the bullets
weaknesses: You can't hurt other people who have this power

name: Superpower Shifting
description: You can manipulate from which part of any individual's body any of their powers manifest, are channelled, etc. You could transfer Heat Vision from the eyes to the index fingers to shoot heat beams out of them. You could compress Invulnerability to, let's say, a foot, so only the foot is invincible. You could expand Bone Claws so the claws come out of anywhere on the body. You cannot completely suppress a power though, and the shifts can sometimes have unforeseen consequences.
summary: The ability to change the location of a superpower in an individual's body.
strengths: You could mess with anyone's powers, so they have a hard time figuring out how to activate them.
You can use this power on yourself in case you're prevented from using another one of your powers.
You can change the way you use this power, from contact to sight or even with your voice.
weaknesses: This power touches the true nature of superpowers, beyond a simple description of what can be done.
Putting a power somewhere you think will make it useless can have unexpected results.
For example, X-Ray Vision in a hand could give the power to make objects see-through on contact.

name: Merging
description: You may get the chance of combing two or three persons, places, things, and/or even universes.
summary: The ability to temporarily merge two beings into which results in a completely new and stronger being.
strengths: A great way of having two things into one
You may even surprise you friends and family members about this ability
weaknesses: Having this merging ability may have devastating  consequences

name: Sp: Empowering Presence
description: 'SP' stands for 'Sharing Presence'. This ability allows you to empower others around you more and more the longer that they stay nearby. This also grants you a bonus: You gain as much power as all the empowered people around you. Increases your natural abilities, and supernatural abilities. Basically, try to get as many people around you, for as long as possible to maximize effect. Can be 'turned-off'.
summary: The ability to empower others in your presence, and gain strength for each person empowered.
strengths: Increase power of those around you, and yourself at the same time.
This ability can be 'turned-off' if wanted.
weaknesses: Although you benefit, you may not want to use this around multiple enemies.

name: Author Power Manipulation
description: With this power, you can control the powers you made. Unfortunately, a loss of focus with some of the finer movements can be disastrous; your victim may attack and destroy you.
summary: The ability to manipulate the powers you created.
strengths: Manipulate the powers you made.
While you cannot block powers you made, you could stop them from doing anything productive.
The more you make, the more useful this is.
weaknesses: Useless if you do not make any superpowers.
Lack of focus/concentration can be dangerous.
Useless against powers you didn't create.

name: Mind Overthrow
description: Using the Mind Overthrow, you can force the victim's mind to break and destroy it completely, turning them into what is referred to as 'a vegetable'. However, using this also allows you, if you succeed, to place your consciousness into the victim's body. Using this, as long as you can break someone's mind, you can live indefinitely.
summary: The ability to overthrow minds.
strengths: Control someone else's body completely.
Live forever.
weaknesses: You lose your old body.
Risky at times.

name: Titanium Battle Armor
description: The user is able to equip his body with a near indestructible Titanium Battle Armor. The power source is a compact quantum power cell. The power cell is able to give a charge lasting for a month. After the cell has worn out , it must be charged for 24hours. The suit will have power using the solar cells installed at strategic spots on the armor, but only limited abilities
summary: The ability to equip your body with a Titanium Battle Armor
strengths: Near invulnarability
Has the ability to have supersonic speed
Has the ability to fire laser beams
weaknesses: Recharging the battery is tedious
Cannot achieve independent space flight

name: Induced Paralysis
description: With induced paralysis you can stop anyone from moving or talking. This power only applies to movement and in no way effects organs or the blood stream. Though it usually wears off in an hour, with extreme concentration, you can leave someone permanetly paralyzed.
summary: The ability to hinder all the muscular functions of the body.
strengths: Shut up anyone
Win any fight
Keep annoying people still
weaknesses: Lasts for a very short time
Takes a good ammount of concentration

name: Kinesis One
description: Persons with superhuman abilities are drawn to you. If within 60ft of you they trigger your "kinesis" which snatches their abilities from their body & grants you the power. Their power is yours while the person is near & they in turn are powerless, weakened & slowly dying. The process completely & permanently changes their power, enhancing certain portions, twisting others, or cancels the power. If they manage to get away from you their power is forever deformed, distorted & twisted.
summary: The ability to use the 1st form of kinesis to absorb special abilities and alter them
strengths: Subconsciously pilfer the superpowers of others within 60 feet of you.
Permanent distortion of abilities (when the victim gains them back)
You cause other ability replicators, dampeners, thieves & reflectors to implode
weaknesses: Alone your telekinetic ability will allow you only to lift, move minor objects.
Superhumans are slowly dying in your presence, you are no team player
You will never truly copy anothers abilities, effects are random,the power will forever be perverted

name: Voodoo Doll
description: You can instantly create dolls that you can imbue with the power of voodoo. Ultimate control!!!!!
summary: The ability to create voodoo dolls of any living thing.
strengths: Take revenge, and control every human and animal
Control yourself, to save yourself from danger (throw the doll in the direction you want to dodge)
Can do anything to the doll, and it happens to the person (give it to your dog ... )
weaknesses: Must know what the person or animal looks like
If you aren't good at coming up with torture ideas ...

name: Energy Fist
description: When you run out of choices and want to defeat the enemy quickly and effectively you use the energy fist. You clench your hand into a fist and energy slowly circles your hand. Next, you punch the ground and you send a very powerful wave of energy to your enemy. You can also direct where the energy wave will hit.
summary: The ability to punch the ground with your fist and send energy waves to a particular direction
strengths: Defeat the enemy quickly and effectly.
Very powerful attack.
Strength increases.
weaknesses: Could hurt your hand from the force you are hitting the ground with.
If you don't direct your energy wave, you could hurt your allies/friends.
Need lots of energy and could drain you from power which will cause you to faint after the attack.

name: Power Dealing
description: You can steal others' superpowers, containing the powers in your body, and then grant the powers to others. You can chose to remove individual powers, or remove all of the subjects' powers. You cannot use the powers stored in your body.
summary: The ability to steal powers, store them in your body, then give them to others.
strengths: You could sell superpowers for a lot of money, becoming very rich
When attacked by a superhuman you could take away their powers
Some people would probably pay large amounts to depower a superhero/villain
weaknesses: You have to take powers from someone before you can empower others
You'll probably have to buy powers off others before you can sell them for large amounts
You could be violently forced by someone to give them powers

name: Sword Attributes
description: This superpower gives you the ability to have the attributes of a sword. You can turn any part of your body into a sword, but your whole body cannot turn into a sword just parts of your body. The attributes of a sword can be metal, wood, sharp heavy etc.
summary: The ability to have the attributes of a sword
strengths: The user can create swords at will
weaknesses: You cannot turn into any other weapons other than a sword
You have to see the material to make one of your body parts to become a sword

name: You "Matter"
description: Any piece of item (like trash), body part, or really any type of matter can be "switched" with another form of matter. But you cannot create new matter or destroy it. (kind of like alchemy but you can switch back faster and without barely thinking about it.) Its like transforming matter but if you had lets say a ball and then make it into a sword, you can still get the ball back. your just taking an item from one location (inter-dementions work) and bringing it to you
summary: The ability to "switch" matter
strengths: You can get any item
you can change its size & composition
you can change things like sounds
weaknesses: The items/parts-its-made-of have to exist elsewhere
cannot trade in anything for more than 99x its size
not indestructable

name: Map Eyes
description: To know every map there is. So each time you close them, you see a map to anywhere, even a map through the body. You could use it to escape enemies or figure out where you are when lost.
summary: The ability to see maps in your eyes
strengths: See maps
Never get lost
Escape enemys
weaknesses: Could lose in battle

name: Superpower Equalization
description: With this superpower you have the ability to make your opponent's superpower cut in half, and add a half of that superpower to your own superpower repertoire. So you and him would have equally measured superpowers of the same type.
summary: The ability to halve your foe's superpowers and gain half their superpowers for yourself

You become equally matched as far as superpowers go
