weaknesses: You are equally matched, so unless you have a bit more brains than your enemy, none of you will win
You both have the same superpowers, so it's going to be hard to win the fight

name: Fifth Amendment
description: No matter what you do, blow up a building, kill dozens of children, you will not be held responsible for ANY OF IT by ANYONE.
summary: The ability to not be responsible for any crime you may commit
strengths: No time in jail. Ever
Great if you're a villain.
weaknesses: If you want to go to jail
People with strong willpower will still hold you responsible

name: Mimic Absorber
description: Faced with someone who mimicked this power, from you or not, you'll steal their copy from them and make it disappear. It affects any power which was acquired by creating a copy of this power as a reference, while giving them or not changes. It doesn't work on someone who obtained this power legitimately. It works on stolen ones only if they were mimicries to begin with. The best is noone can even copy this power from you as copies will be absorbed before they can even reach the duplicator.
summary: The ability to absorb any mimicries of this power.
strengths: This power is impossible to copy from you! As copies will be absorbed before they go anywhere.
You'll absorb any instances of mimicry of this power, whether it was mimicked from you or not.
Two mimicked Mimic Absorber powers will absorb each other and disappear.
weaknesses: It's unmimickable. Big deal! It doesn't even do anything! Besides, good luck finding mimicries!
It can be stolen from you and it cannot be backed up, as a backup is a copy.
If you absorb a copy with alterations, like enhancement or reversal, you can't keep the alterations.

name: Twin View
description: Imagine yourself going to school,and you know two good paths. You can't decide which path is the less dangerous path. So, you use Double View, and you see yourselve in one view, taking the path within the quiet neighborhood. You see that you are okay, but in the other view you see yourself being beaten in the path that is near the pizza shop. OUCH!! Better take the first path.
summary: The ability to see your  future consequences in two different sights.
strengths: You can see the future.
You can see your mistakes.
You can use your powers to become a swami. (but,I don't recommend it)
weaknesses: You'll get headaches.
Might see a nasty future.
You might be stuck in the future.

name: Pokemon Shifting
description: If you want to be big and strong, shift into a Snorlax. If you want to be a fighting master, shift into a Machoke. If you want to be cute, shift into a Jigglypuff... You get the idea!
summary: The ability to shift into any pokemon that you want
strengths: You can be strong, fast, cute, big, and you can scare people!
No need to buy a costume for halloween
weaknesses: You can only shift into one pokemon at a time

name: Hush Ruckus
description: Your skin absorbs sound making complete silence until you redirect through your voice as an ultra ruckus or a concentrated super scream.
summary: The ability to absorb sound and redirect it as a loud, extremely annoying noise or super scream.
strengths: Awesome sound manipulation.
Speak in an altered voice or to more than one person at once with different words.
Create complete silence.
weaknesses: Can annoy you too much.
Will shatter glass upon activation.

name: I.Q.
description: You will be able to either increase the intelligence of a person to make them a genius or lower it to the point where they become brain-dead. You must touch their head for it to work though.
summary: The ability to raise or lower someone's intelligence.
strengths: Grant a person increased intelligence or lower it.
Does not work on yourself.
weaknesses: Must touch their head for the power to work.
Might make them too intelligent or too dumb or even kill them if they're brain-dead.

name: Dragon Force!
description: The Dragon Force, similar to the Phoenix Force as it is an immortal entity born between states of being, is the physical embodiment of matter in all realities of the omniverse (whereas the PF is the epitome of psionic energy). The user can tap into the Dragon Force to harness complete shape-changing qualities, matter and anti-matter manipulation, incalculable levels of superhuman strength, invulnerability, flight and speed, as well as create and destroy life.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Dragon Force.
strengths: The user is encased by solid matter that takes the form of a giant green dragon.
The Dragon Force is based on matter that had once existed, is existing, or will one day exist.
The user can call upon any number of powers the Dragon Force employs.
weaknesses: The user may lose to stronger entities.
The user may grow insane do the power of the Dragon Force.

name: Pain Charge
description: This power allows the user to enhance his abilities/strength/speed/skills and other powers (if he/she has others) by 50% for every injury such as wounds,contusions and even internal body damage suffered by the one gifted with this superpower. Amputations or loss of body parts,except the head, will instead give a 500% increase in efficiency of all the user's skills and capabilities. Sickness or ailments,on the other hand,will yield a 1000% efficiency in your powers.
summary: The ability to increase the efficiency of one's abilities and skills with every injury suffered
strengths: Wounds and other injuries will no longer hinder you from your tasks
Amputations and other fatal injuries will turn you into a superhuman
Your enemies will become hesitant to attack you
weaknesses: You can still die from suffering too much injuries and bodily damage
You will be restored back to normal once your injuries are healed
You must still possess enough strength to move or do stuff upon suffering injury

name: Aversion Change
description: Aversion are the things that, in the superpower world, makes someone weaker. A normal person would usually have one or two, but this ability can allow the user to change his aversion. This makes him able change their weakness to something that no one could find out.
summary: The ability to change one's aversion at will.
strengths: Change your aversion
Remain strong
weaknesses: Can only have one aversion at a time.

name: Criminal Mastermind
description: With this power you are a natural master criminal, you know what to steal, how to get it, who to sell it to, and how to launder the money, it's in your nature. Whether it is being a con artist, a drug dealer or a master thief you'll know how to work your operation, best of all you cannot be caught by any law enforcement at all, even if you admit to your crimes they won't believe you, however this does not stop other criminals from trying to take you down.
summary: The ability to be the ultimate criminal mastermind
strengths: Make a lot of money and retire early
You'll always know how to operate or pull of a job
You can never be caught by any law enforment
weaknesses: You could hurt innocent people, depending upon what you do
Other criminals might try to take you out to take your place, but it is easy to stay hidden
One way or another you might be hurting someone

name: Self Hypnosis
description: A person with this power can command their body to act in anyway physically possible. They can access 100% body strength and all their composite skills. They are immune to mind control since they command themselves. They can also give themselves special skills, such as hypnotizing themselves to be expert gunmen or hypnotizing themselves to play the piano extemely well. The user must first will himself in order to activate his power; if they are not motivated it will not work.
summary: The ability to give commands to yourself in order to perform feats to your full potential
strengths: You can access your full potential at will
You can access skills that you normally wouldn't have
weaknesses: You will be very tired after using this ability for a long time
Cannot transcend own physical limits without consequences
You must be motivated in order to activate your power

name: Super Power List Leech
description: When you gain this ability you choose any member of the Superpowerlist and gain access to any power that person has gained. The problem though is that if you gain a power and the person you leech of gains the same power, your version of that power is cancelled and you can not use the power anymore. Once you choose a person to leech off of you can not change your decision.
summary: The ability to use almost any power obtained by another member of your choosing.
strengths: Use any power the person you choose has that you do not have.
Can use on a person with a lot of powers to quickly gain many powers.
Has no effect on the person you are leeching off of.
weaknesses: Can not change which member you leech off of once you pick.
If the member you leech off of stops using site you stop gaining powers.
If they gain the same powers you gain then that power cancells out for you.

name: Iron Arms
description: Lining your arms with metal can be really helpful. One can mold the iron into a weapon of choice and the weapon would be of the strongest material. Use them to touch some of the hottest objects, the most powerful of acid, and the toughest walls. The power can be activated on and off whenever you choose for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to line your arms in metal.
strengths: Shape into any tools, keys, weapons,etc.
Touch just about anything
Powerful and tough
weaknesses: Can be a bit stiff
No feeling, so you don't feel texture

name: Sentient Superpower
description: More noticeable if you have multiple superpowers. Each and every one of your powers acquires a personality. They are capable of acting on their own and taking over your body. Unlike DID, you are conscious of your condition and can discuss with your abilities. You have still access to all your powers, but using one may cause the power you're using to take over your body. Moreover, a certain power doesn't mean a defined personality. There are a lot of possible personalities that could fit.
summary: The ability to have each of your abilities have a personality of their own, including this one.
strengths: Your superpowers can perceive the world through you. So, they may notice something you don't.
If you can't stand up to someone, maybe one of your abilities will.
Each personality has access to the superpower they represent.
weaknesses: The more abilities you have, the more personalities you have to deal with.
There may be conflicts between your personalities.
You could lose your body to your abilities, though it's usually temporary.

name: Animated Arms
description: With this ability, you can create a pair of animated 3D hands and control them. You can use them to long-distance slap someone and never get caught. Can make them disappear too
summary: The ability to create a pair 3D animated arms and move them.
strengths: Have an extra arm under your control
weaknesses: If people see you creating them

name: Atomic Filtering
description: When you touch something, you have tiny, atomic-sized pores on your skin that have vacuum-like properties. This vacuum pulls substances into it, and with a bioelectric charge, separates it into groups of like atoms. When the substances exit your pores, regroup and rebuild, you are left with basic elements. You can also reverse the process.
summary: The ability to separate substances on an atomic level.
strengths: You could separate deadly chemicals from the air to kill victims.
You could separate pollution from oxygen and breathe better air.
You could reverse the vacuum and launch out a glob of iron. Heh, face-breakin time!
weaknesses: You have to be in contact with the substance.
You have to know what you could use offensively and defensively.
You have to be pretty smooth, and quick-witted.

name: Anger Control
description: Also called Four Humors: Yellow Bile. With this ability you are able to raise or lower the anger inside of people. You can strike the anger of a completely calm person and make them go into an unstoppable rage or make a completely angry person relax or sleep. Your anger levels can not be affected by Agitator Pulse, etc. At higher levels, Berserker Rage and Hatred could possibly be more powerful.
summary: The ability to completely control the anger in people.
strengths: You can make people not hate you.
Make people kill themselves by raising their rage level past limits, but that could make you evil.
Make Berserkers relaxed or fall asleep.
weaknesses: People can still kill you.
Only at the higher levels will anger-based powers be more powerful.
People with Emotionless, Omninscience, etc. Are not affected by this ability.

name: Hyper Move
description: This ability will make you tired, but it will be worth it to release a catastrophic ability. This power will charge your body to perform one (or more if you're strong enough) move or technique in a destructive way. You can do it again within 5-10 min.
summary: The ability to launch a full on strike within one move.
strengths: Very powerful
Can perform any move with catastrophic force.
weaknesses: It will make you tired and weak.
You can do it again within 5-10 min.

name: Auto Negate
description: A person with this power has the ability to negate everything that directly affects them. This means that they cannot be the direct targets of any superpower. This obviously means no instant kill powers work on them. They also cannot be lifted up by telekinesis. Indirect attacks still work. For example the telekinetic can still throw boxes at said person. This power also negates the positive effects of your own powers that affect you directly.
summary: The ability to automatically negate the effects of any power that directly affects you
strengths: No instant death or erasure from existence
No type of power theft at all
Another Con or Pro: You cannot be teleported
weaknesses: Can still be hurt by indirect attacks
Also negates any positive effects of any power that directly affects you
Can still be trapped in a time loop if time is targetted not you

name: Green Guardsmen Power Ring
description: The user is able to form constructs made up of pure energy from a green power ring using the power of justice. These rings choose people on their ability to have great virtue , is just and have no mood for injustice. The ring's only weakness is the negative energy used by the grey power rings which is injustice and evil. The symbol of the ring is a shield. The battery source is stored in a giant scale of justice placed in the Green Guardsmen Corps homeworld
summary: The ability to use the mysterious green  power of justice
strengths: Can make constructs made out of pure of energy fueled by justice
Can shoot bolts and beams of pure energy
weaknesses: Weak against negative power of injustice
Must recharge the ring using a power source from a miniature golden scale.

name: Power Fusion
description: This gives the user the ability to fuse someone elses power with another and make it one. In order for this to work, the two subjects must be in physical contact with each other at all times for the user to fuse their powers. For example, if the user combines the powers of invisibility and super strength, both targets will be invisible and super strong as long as they remain physically contacted with each other. Once contact is seperated, the fusion is canceled. Some powers may not be fusible.
summary: The ability to fuse any power with another
strengths: Fuse two powers together to create something better
No time limit
weaknesses: Targets have to have phyical contact with each other until the fusion is canceled
Some powers may not be fusible

name: Attack Replicating Ground
description: You need to direct one of your attacks toward the ground which will absorb it. Then, the same attack will be released from the ground in one of three ways. First, the attack can be released all around you, save for a tight spot where you stand. Second, it can be released out of a remote area. Third, it can progressively be released toward a target, following them if they move. The attack released is the same as the one dealt to the ground, but replicated to cover a bigger surface.
summary: The ability to let the ground below you absorb your attack and release it over a big surface.
strengths: You can greatly increase the power of an attack and its range.
Just stick a sword in the ground and create hundreds of blades.
Shoot fire toward the ground and create fields of fire.
weaknesses: It only works on the ground and you could attack yourself in the process if you're not careful.
It only lasts as long as you keep attacking the ground with your attack.
The attacks can only be released from the ground in your vicinity and your visual field.

name: Curse Of Life
description: The Curse of Life, a powerful curse that affects the user instead of someone else. Once used, the person who uses it can't die, from disease, old age, or any form of attacks. The head can be severed from the body, and it will still live. Injuries will heal at a supernatural pace also. However, it is a curse because it allows the user to never die.
summary: The ability to be constantly affected by the Curse of Life.
strengths: Can't die ever.
weaknesses: You have to live forever.
The people you love will continue to die around you.
Can still feel pain.

name: The Write Stuff
description: When you forge a signature, you actually channel the person, perfectly replicating their writing style.
summary: The ability to perfectly forge anyone's handwriting.
strengths: Never have to bring home a permission slip again.
Get all the prescription drugs you want.
Get bills passed.
weaknesses: Prepare for possible incarceration for fraud.
People will be asking you for celebrity autographs.

name: Insomnia
description: Have you ever been in a heated battle with an arch foe and you grow overwhelmingly tired? With Insomnia, you're able to put yourself into a trance and stay awake as your senses and strength heighten. But if you stay in the trance too long, you'll turn into a brainless zombie for eternity. Or until a slayer kills you.
summary: The ability to go with out sleep and heighten your senses.
strengths: Able to stay awake to fight.
Grow stronger.
Senses heighten.
weaknesses: Stay in trance too long & you'll turn into a zombie.
A slayer may kill you.

name: Target Eye
description: Also known as Eyehole Effect. This power causes objects to be attracted toward what the person see similar to a blackhole. Also the user can distort light in front of their eye so that they can see things that are farther away up to 2500 meters. Eye gets stronger the more it is used-the retina gets bigger and the eye veins grow. When at its peak, the user can create a black hole where they are seeing thus being extremely strong but the user becomes effectively blind. Best used for sniping.
summary: The ability to cause projectiles to home in at what you are seeing and if mastered a black hole
strengths: As long as you are looking at it, nearby projectiles will be attacted to it like a blackhole
Target Eye also give the user vision up to 2500 meters-the range for this ability
Can deactivate the power at will in early stages or by closing your eyes
weaknesses: Another Pro: You can just train one eye to have the black hole
Dangerous to user when up close(Blast Radius-and sucked into own hole)
Continued use causes lack of control and leads to Blackhole Vision

name: Persistent Revival
description: A person with this power refuses to give up. When they are knocked out or if their heart stops, the body sends an electrical signal that either restarts the heart or wakes up the person, regardless of their physical condition. Also, the body will be able to perform CPR on itself to resuscitate the user. However, this does not fully revive the person's strength.
summary: The ability to revive oneself when put out of commission
strengths: The toughest wrestler-Who can pin you down unconscious?
Can't be knocked out by sucker punches. Will get back up.
You can be revived indefinitely as long as you have the will to fight
weaknesses: You can still die
People will think that you are a glutton for punishment
You can still feel pain

name: Warp Spasm
description: Warp Spasmers are dangerous to see, mainly because that means the Spasmer can see you. A person with Warp Spasm involuntarily goes into one when they have become enraged to the point of no return. Their bones and flesh twist in their skin, their features distort like wax, and they go mad. In this state, they cannot feel pain and have enhanced speed, strength, and endurance. They are very difficult to stop and will kill anyone on sight, usually starting with the source of their anger.
summary: The ability to distort your body in a spasm of rage
strengths: Happens whenever you are absolutely furious
Unable to feel pain
Enhanced strength, speed, and endurance
weaknesses: Involuntary
Hard to keep yourself from spasming
May kill friends, family, etc.

name: Fisticuff
description: With this power, the user breaks both speed and stamina barriers allowing them to punch their enemy for hours or even days without the enemy being able to escape the blows or dodge them. Fisticuff can even "speed match" to keep superspeed or teleporting opponents from escaping. Unfortunately, the move is strictly punches and so the chain can be broken by an accidental alternative blow such as a kick, throw, headbutt, or even open hand blow. This would allow an escape for the enemy.
summary: The ability to deliver an endless amount of high speed punches to an enemy
strengths: You can never get tired of punching and so can deliver blows for hours or even days
"Speed match" keeps even quick-moving enemies unable to escape.
weaknesses: All blows have to be punches in order to work
The chain can be broken if a blow is delivered that is not a punch, such as a kick or a throw

name: Technological Clock
description: It basically means that you could go to a tiny tribe, jump the technology forward and make them superior to modern US. Basically, make any technology more or less advanced. It can be very useful.
summary: The ability to control the level of technology
strengths: Mess with people you don't like
Jump humanity forward (cool!)
Make your stuff better than anyone else's
weaknesses: It only works as long as you're thinking it

name: Jelly Stingers
description: A person with this power has developed cnidocyte cells. In other words they can sting people like jellyfish. They can decide the lethality of their sting from simply stunning to putting people into a coma or straight up killing.
summary: The ability to have cnidocyte cells(stinging cells)
strengths: Can sting people
It can be volunary but being surprised causes you to accidentally use it
Can decide the lethality from stun to coma to kill
weaknesses: Being surprised causes you to use it-----(though nonlethally)
No aqautic adaptation (no breathing underwater, or otherwise mimicking a jellyfish)

name: Phobomaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a state which grows and gains power from the fears of others. You become a dark, horrifying beast. Not only do you also become larger and more powerful, but as you grow, you become increasingly terrifying, and you may strike people with claws which put them into a state of shock and fear. You can also let off a horrendous roar, which causes emotional trauma, and can potentially kill people, depending on how strong you have become.
summary: The ability to transform into a state which grows and gains power from fear.
strengths: Strike people with claws, or let off a horrendous roar which can cause emotional trauma or kill.
You become more invulnerable to physical, emotional, and mental damage the larger you become.
Growing larger will probably strike additional fear into people.
weaknesses: Resistance to fear will cause you to lose power, and revert if you become weak enough.
People with less fear towards you can cause more damage.
Once you revert, you lose the effects gained while in this form.
tags: Paul McCartney's wife (Vespert: lol How dare you!)

name: Condensation
description: With this power, you can condense anything you can see into any size smaller than it was originally. For example, you can condense a cloud to flood the area below it. You can condense your enemy into a pile of flesh and bone. Even make a black hole out of the Earth by condensing it. You just need to be able to see the object. You cannot expand an object though.
summary: The ability to condense material with your mind.
strengths: Flood an area with a cloud.
Kill that guy with a gun.
weaknesses: Diabolical people will destroy the Earth.
You cannot put something back to the way it was.
What will you do with that pile of flesh?

name: Bone Breaker
description: With this power you can break any person's bones with a snap of your fingers. You need to have that person in front of you. Concentrate on the bone to break, and then snap your fingers. Also, you can fix bones with the same procedure. It is better if you have an extensive knowledge of human anatomy.
summary: The ability to break bones with a snap of your fingers
strengths: Break the bones of your enemies in any dangerous situation.
Repair bone in any accident
You will never have a broken bone
weaknesses: Needs full concentration in the beginning
If you aren't careful, can cause serious damage to yourself or others.
People will suffer in pain if you don't use it wisely

name: Scarecrow (Scare Crow)
description: This ability is really good if you prefer to scare than attack. This causes any humanoid likeness (ventriloquist's dummies, mannequins, dolls and, of course, scarecrows) to become more and more creepy until it's creepy enough to bring to life. When they've reached their "peak creepiness", and enough fear has been imparted into the desired effigies, they can be animated; they will be able to exert greater strength and speed than any being that fears them.
summary: The ability to make inanimate humanoid likenesses become very creepy, and use their creepiness to animate them
strengths: Creep enemies out
The creeping discomfort that they generate allows them to come to life temporarily
They can exert greater strength or speed than (and track) any being that finds them scary
weaknesses: Only works on inanimate humanoid likenesses (dummies, dolls, mannequins, etc.)
If they creep YOU out, too, then they can overpower YOU, as well
Animation is only temporary

name: Hades
description: Hades the god of the underworld, also referred to as Hades the god of riches and the dead. This power not only gives you the power to manifest vast amounts of riches to your disposal whenever you wish, but it also allows you to control the dead. You also have Cerberus as your partner, but all dogs big or small have needs. It's very unwise to ignore the needs of this 30 story puppy. You'll reek of corpses most of the time and have pale skin.
summary: The ability to gain the powers of the god of the underworld.
strengths: Untold riches
Control of the dead. (souls and zombies)
Giant three headed dog at your disposal
weaknesses: Giant dog droppings. (grab the pooper scooper)
Reek of corpses
Pale skin

name: Werepire
description: It can only work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire, and you'll become a werepire (often referred to some as werevamp and vampwolf). Your strength and speed increase significantly, allowing you to move several meters and down a story in less than a second, as well as the ability to change partially, such as your eyes and teeth and even turn your fingers into claws.
summary: The ability to become and posses the powers of both Werewolves and Vampires.
strengths: Can't be affected by sunlight.
Could turn others into Werepires.
weaknesses: It'll work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire.

name: Positive Power Charge
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling positive.
E.g Happy, cheerful, joyous, excited.
However you are weakened by people with negative feeling. Ths power opposes Negative Power Charge.
summary: The ability to gain strength based on positive feelings and emotions.
strengths: You feeling positve, doubles the extent of your power.
weaknesses: Must rely on people having positive feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Photon Repressed Superstrength
description: Photon-Repressed Superstrength is generated by specialized cells all over the body. However, light causes these cells to become inoperative. So, at 12 midnight under a cloudy sky, you could bench 100 tons. At noon under the sun, you could bench 100 pounds.
summary: The ability to have superhuman strength determined by how dark it is
strengths: Become an awesome night watchman
Impress people at night concerts
Beat people up in the night and leave
weaknesses: Little to no superhuman endurance
Little to no superhuman durability
Light, day, night in New York, floodlights, etc.

name: Arcana: 8 Strength
description: You are strong, fast, invulnerable to harm! As long as you stay calm and centered. As opposed to getting stronger from fury, this power makes you grow in strength from calmness. The angrier and more emotional you get, the weaker you get. Showing extreme rage or sorrow will make you weaker than a normal person. A totally centered and calm person with this power would be able to tip over skyscrapers, run faster than the wind, and survive being hit by a bullet train.
summary: The ability to get stronger, faster, and more durable the calmer and more serene you are.
strengths: Strong, Fast, and Hard to hurt.
Harder to mentally dominate.
weaknesses: Showing emotions makes you weak. Literally.

name: Half Wyvern
description: Someone who has this power has wings proportional to their body, fangs, and a long tail with an arrow-shaped barb. Anyone who they bite with their fangs will contract a deadly but noncontagious disease. Also, someone with this power will have boosted strength.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-wyvern
strengths: If you bite your enemies, they will die in pain.
weaknesses: Long-range fighters prevent the use of the bite.

name: Literally Literally
description: When someone says "literally" and they meant figuratively you are able to activate this power and make their statement actually literal. The power is activated by saying "Literally?" when a figurative statement is said with the word literally. Example: statement said "I'm so hungry I could literally eat a horse." "Literally?" effect - the person who said the statement begins to devour a horse.
summary: The ability to make a statement literal when "literally" is said but figuratively was meant.
strengths: People will learn real quick to use the word literally properly.
Power can be used on self to make something true. ex: I'm literally dating "celebrity name here".
weaknesses: There is no way to undo the effect once this power is activated.

name: Human Mood Ring
description: When you read someone's emotions you know what they're feeling and your body turns into the color of their emotion. For example, If you sense that someone is feeling very happy your body turns into a dark blue color. It's all based off the mood ring colors.
summary: The ability to read people's emotions.
strengths: You can help someone out if they don't know what they're feeling
Use it on your BF or GF if you are not sure that they love you
Use it on your boss if you think he or she is mad at you
weaknesses: Others can tell that you are reading their mood by your change in color
Does not help with reading your own moods

name: Human Gun
description:
From bazooka to pistol. From sniper rifle to double barrel shotgun. You can shoot any kind of gun from anywhere on your body. But there are 3 rules that follows it. 
1. For every gunshot there is a price of energy so shoot wisely. 
2. You can not make up a gun, the gun must exist. 
3. You can not shoot for nothing, there must be a reason for every shot you make.
summary: The ability to shoot any type of bullets from your body
strengths: As long as you have a reason, even the most stupidest one, you can shoot
You can make your own gun and it counts as existing
You can regain energy by any means
weaknesses: If you lose all your energy you fall alseep untill you gained all you energy back
If there is no such thing you can't shoot it
You can't shoot because you feel like it, you need a better reason

name: Whitelighting
description: You can heal a cut, a bruise, a rash, anything except broken bones and if the person you're healing isn't already dead. This of course applies to yourself also. You're not immortal, you can just heal slowly.
summary: The ability to slowly heal anyone or anything that isn't dead. This does not apply to broken bones.
strengths: Heal fallen friends
Heal yourself.
Regain strength quicker when hurt.
weaknesses: It's slow.
Doesn't work on the dead.
Doesn't work on broken bones.

name: Origamimancy
description: An artistic ability transforms paper origami to life. It can provide entertainment, attack your enemies and uch more. You control the former origami figures and they will do your bidding without question.
summary: The ability to transforms origami objects into life.
strengths: Spy agents.
Artistry
weaknesses: Short paper supplies.

name: 2 Door Destiny
description: You are able to make two doors pop out of nowhere and show you which destiny you should follow if you do this thing. If you are deciding over a girl or to kill somebody, it shows you what to do.
summary: The ability to have two doors show you your destinies.
strengths: Able to make decisions easily
Know what you should do and shouldn't do
weaknesses: Can't always control your own destiny
Sometimes you have to let go of some things

name: Cerebropathy
description: This ability amplifies the brainwaves of the user. It is not clear whether it finds mutants by the power signature they send out when they use their powers or by the presence of the of the X-gene in their body; both methods have been used throughout the comics.
summary: The ability to detect and communicate with super-powered mutants with X-genes or Genetic Engineering
strengths: Detect mutants worldwide
Find mutated aliens outside of the planet
weaknesses: How your power works is mysterious to you, but at least it works.

name: Electroreception, Passive
description: All living beings generate a weak bioelectric field. In a method similar to how some sharks, fish, and even the platypus hunts for food, the possessor of this ability can sense the weak bioelectic field generated by the muscles, nerves, and in some cases, the gills, of other living beings. This sense is generally tuned to low frequency signals. A close-range ability, usually good within a few feet unless the it puts out a powerful bioelectric field. Also may be used to sense non-living things.
summary: The ability to sense the weak bioelectic fields generated by other beings and locate them
strengths: Know the location of nearby beings, despite being hidden or in dark
This can be used to supplement or replace your other senses
May even be able to find your lost cell phone
weaknesses: Devices that put out electomagnetic fields may disrupt this ability or hide the target

name: Enlargement
description: This ability allows you to enlarge any part of your body.  The user can even turn them self into a giant.  When punching or kicking the person when their body is enlarged, the user feels no pain at all.  When the user punches somebody while their fist is enlarged, it can send the victim across a football pitch.
summary: The ability to enlarge any part of your body
strengths: Can become a gaint
Gives superstrenght
Feel no pain
weaknesses: Can over enlarge
May squash a love one

name: Quadarmy
description: With this power you can summon four bodyguard/soldiers. They are all under your control and they are trained in all kind of fighting and know how to use any type of weapons. If one of them dies you can only summon tree and so on and so forth once all four die you lose this power.
summary: The ability to summon four soldiers
strengths: You can summon four soldier bodyguards
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Symbiosis
description: Symbiosis is the ablility to call forth a symbiote that enhances your strengths and weakness. Your abilities will be enhanced depending on the type of sybiote you have. You can change your form as well in sybiote form.
summary: The ability to withdraw a symbiote from your body
strengths: Enhances your ablilities
Makes you look cool
Can change form
weaknesses: Can get too attached to you
Enhances your weakness
Fire and super sound are your weaknesses

name: Strength Multiplier
description: The person with this power will become more powerful than the currently most powerful person within the room or within a 500ft radius. For example, if Superman is in the same room as you are, you become 2 times stronger than Superman. Note this power only works for physical strength, you will not gain any superpowers
summary: The ability to become more powerful than the most powerful person currently in the room ir within a 500ft radius
strengths: If a powerhouse is within the room or 500ft radius you will become stronger than that he or she
You are the strongest person in the room or 500ft radius
weaknesses: When there's nobody around, this power is, useless
If the strongest person leaves the room or 500ft, somebody else is targeted. Ergo, you lose strength

name: Cloth Manipulation
description: You can telekinetically manipulate any cloth or fabric, shaping it in any way. These can be clothes someone is wearing, curtains or a nearby roll of silk.

strengths: Can control someone's movements by moving their clothes
Could choke an enemy with their tie/shirt
Could use a roll of strong cloth as a grappling line
weaknesses: Very limited power
Little to control in a rural or unpopulated area
Cannot control too much cloth or fabric far away

name: Get This Power
description: With this power, you can add the "Get This Power" button on any power on the superpowerlist.com. You can easily get any power and help other get their favorite power. However, you have to be on the page you want to add a "Get This Power" to and you can only add the button to ten powers per hour. Although the button only stays for the remainder of the hour you put there, it will also be active 12 hours later if it's still on the same day. Can still only get one power per day.
summary: The ability to add the "Get This Power" button on superpowers.
strengths: Add the "Get This Power" button to superpowers.
Get some of your favorite superpowers.
Help others get their favorite powers
weaknesses: Max of ten active powers per hour, button is only active for the hour you put it there
You have to be on a page to make it active.
Can still only get one power per day

name: Thorn Man
description: With this power you can generate thorns all over your body. You can remove the thorns with your hand or you can shoot them out of your body at high speeds.

strengths: You can generate thorns from your body
You can shoot them out of your body at high speeds
If you dye your hair pink or something you can be like a human rose
weaknesses: Once they are removed from your body the thorns can hurt you

name: Nanite Swarm
description: You release millions of nanites out of your body through your skin. They automatically target and destroy the enemy or object you make them attack. They are fully controlled by the brain.
summary: The ability to summon a swarm of nanites that destroy anything in their way.
strengths: Very few defenses against it
Very precise in targeting
weaknesses: No defensive positions
Might gross some people out

name: Reverse Agitator Pulse
description: A person with this power has a more advanced form of agitator pulse. Instead of making people fight to the death, he can make everyone desire the death of the specific target. This is caused by a feedback pulse forcibly caused by the initial pulse from the target so that everyone else near him that can get the pulse will also try to kill him/her. However this pulse only lasts 2 minutes afterwards affected parties except initial target will have amnesia and forget the whole incident.
summary: The ability to shoot a pulse at a biological target causing everything else biological to attack said target
strengths: Your enemies now have to fight everyone that is not immune to this power
Pretty much that's it--your target becomes the target of everybody's enmity for 2 hours
weaknesses: This power runs out in 2 hours
Enemies can avoid spreading the pulse by staying away from moist areas and metal/touching people

name: Double Voice
description: When you desire, you can speak in two distinct voices simultaneously. The second voice is opposite of your gender. You may not speak in the second voice alone. This ability has little application outside of intimidation.
summary: The ability to speak in two voices at once.
strengths: Effective intimidation tool.
Users have full control over when they use this ability and can speak normally.
weaknesses: People are likely to fear you if you do this, possibly believing you are a demon.

name: Power Imbued Jewellery
description: This power allows you to create jewellery that has random power inside of it. That piece of jewelery will only respond and uses its power for you unless the jewelery is given by you to someone else.
summary: The ability to make jewellery with powers inside them
strengths: Many different powers to have
Only works for you
Very small and inconspicuous
weaknesses: It takes great concentration to create a piece of power imbedded jewelery
You don't know what power you're going to get
If you get a cursed power or a negation power you're screwed

name: Wing Appendages
description: You will have bat-like wings attached to you. Your body structure will be different so you can fly. The wings will be attached to your shoulder blades. Your bone structure will be hollow so you'll be light. If in high places, you'll use the wind current to glide, but in low places it'll be difficult to lift off the ground. Plus you might get exhausted from flapping your wings a lot and if you're carrying something, that's more weight on you.
summary: The ability to fly/glide with wings
strengths: Fly/glide via wings
weaknesses: If on low ground, it'll be difficult to take off
Might get exhausted from flapping your wings

name: Fixed Form
description: A person with this power has both a curse and a blessing. Their body's form can never change. They can't grow taller or shorter, or perform shapeshifting. The person can talk but they can't change their facial expressions. They also seem to never age. The user is immune to cuts and bruises since their skin cannot be changed, so the person won't bleed. However, they will still feel pain. Also, the person is immune to injuries, like bone fractures. The person can get sick but with no indications.
summary: The ability to have a body whose physical features can never change
strengths: You never seem to age-good if you are not still a kid or are already an old man
You are immune to cutting and piercing damages and cannot be injured ever
You can walk on spikes but still feel pain
weaknesses: You will look the way you did from the moment you have received this power
People will think that you are a witch since it doesn't look like you age
You do not know when you are sick

name: Corruption
description: We all have a darkness in us. A Corruptor can set it free. They can secrete a fluid that, on contact, supresses the inhibition center of the brain. This includes the inhibition to disobey orders, the inhibition against violence, and the inhibition against hurting ourselves. If the target is not given direction, they will go on a mad rampage. The effects wear off in 4 hours.
summary: The ability to release someone's inhibitions by touch
strengths: Send a crowd on a mad rampage
Great as a distraction
Crazy army at your disposal
weaknesses: Don't get in their way
Must touch target
Wears off in 4 hours

name: Palindrones
description: A palindrome is a word, phrase or number pattern that reads the same way when read forwards and backwards. A Palindrone is a robot that hovers on one single leg, has two arms with knife like fingers and a sigle red eye that can shoot lasers of various strengths ranging from slight burn to "hey remember when there used to be a person where that pile of ashes is". They also have several turrets that shoot tiny cannon balls from them all over their body. These features also appear on the bots' back
summary: The ability to summon an army of drones that look the same in the front as they do in the back
strengths: You can summon an army of the above described Palindrones that are under your complete control
The Palindrone's can never be subject to a surprise attack due to their weapons and eyes on their ba
Cks.
weaknesses: The drones can be subject to robot controlling powers

name: Hyalokinesis
description: A person with Hyalokinesis can manipulate glass in any shape, color, or density. They can repair, reshape, or recolor it without heating it up. Naturally, it can also be used as an offensive weapon (slicing or stabbing) or as a defensive tool (super-dense body armor or a levitating shield). However, they cannot create glass. In addition, they are not immune to the damaging effects of glass--i.e. cuts and blood loss.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate glass
strengths: Glass is everywhere
Effective offensive weapon (stabbing + slicing)
Good defensive tool (shields or dense body armor)
weaknesses: Cannot create or destroy glass
Not immune to its damaging effects (i.e. blood loss)
Takes concentration

name: Celestial Deity: Sun
description: You have powers over: Fire, gravity, life and are the strongest Celestial deity in general. You are the only one who can use celestial summon skills. You can also teleport to the sun, suffer no damage from being there and when returning you either return to the point where you left or to another preset point (like your house).
summary: The ability to have dominion over the power of the sun.
strengths: You are super powerful.
weaknesses: Careful not to squish the earth with that gravity power.

name: Landscape Mimicry
description: This ability lets the user turn, partially or fully, into any piece of landscape found naturally. This would include mountains, waterfalls, a giant tree, etc. The user can only mimic landscape they have seen firsthand themselves. The user can turn completely into the landscape they saw, or only take on certain traits. Able to manipulate their landscape form to a certain extent. Can only mimic one type of landscape at a time.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become a form of terrestrial landscape.
strengths: A very good disguise in a natural setting.
Manipulate your full or semi- landscape form.
Gain the traits of any type of landscape.
weaknesses: Bad disguise in cities.
Can only take on the attributes of one type of landscape at a time.

name: Delete This Duplicates
description: duplicate
summary: The ability to be a duplicate
strengths: duplicate
weaknesses: same

name: Individual Confrontation
description: With this ability, you have a +50% chance of defeating someone while confronting them individually (no one can step in and interfere), which means it improves your odds against them no matter what you're doing (chess, racing, battling, etc. )
summary: The ability to have a +50% chance of defeating someone while confronting them individually.
strengths: Increases your odds against anyone while confronting them one on one.
Takes effect in any subject (racing, playing chess, battling, etc. )
weaknesses: It still doesn't guarantee your success.
Can make competitions too easy.

name: Addiction Storage
description: With this power you can store the need to do something your body is dependent on such as eating, drinking, sleeping, breathing or anything else your body is addicted too. While the addiction is being stored you will not feel negative effects of ignoring the addiction. The stored addiction can then be passed onto someone else if you wish, such as making somebody else feel your collected hunger. You would then have to recollect your hunger to use again.
summary: The ability to store the need to do something your body is dependent on for later.
strengths: Not feel the effects of hunger or anything your body is dependent on.
Can force your body's needs onto other people.
Do not have to worry about becoming addicted to new things.
weaknesses: Will have to wait for your own hunger to build up before you can force it onto another person.
If to much of an addiction is stored and forced on someone it could kill them.
Using drugs to often because you are not worried about becoming addicted.

name: Reverse Power Change
description: With this power you can activate it to make anything that attempts to reduce your powers strengthen them instead but it also makes anything that attempts to strengthen you while it is active weaken you instead. You can still be harmed but things that affect how strong, smart, fast, etc you are get reversed. If you get affected by a power removing power you will gain Power Safety.
summary: The ability to make things that make you weaker make you stronger and vice versa.
strengths: Gain strenght equal to how much people try to weaken you.
If powers are attempted to be stolen then it can be reversed to give Power Safety.
Can be turned off and on at will.
weaknesses: If turned on and something strengthens you, you will become weaker instead.
Intelligent foes may catch on and strengthen you while you have it on.
Does not reverse harm to the body, only things that sap or give a form of strength.

name: Golden Needles
description: You can throw needles at your foe, which cause hallucinations when they penetrate the skin. It also induces temporary paralysis, a slight swelling in the tongue (resulting in slurred speech) and leaving them momentarily with a bad headache.
summary: The ability to toss out needles to your opponent that causes them to have hallucinations.
strengths: A good way to screw up an enemy's mind.
weaknesses: Those won't work when they have armor on.

name: Suicidal Strength
description: With this power you can kill yourself and benefit from it. You gain twice your original strength, however you feel the pain until your heart has stopped, or is cut into tiny little pieces. After you kill yourself, your body will regenerate, but with more muscle tissue.
summary: The ability to commit suicide and come back with twice the physical strength.
strengths: No more bodybuilding (hee hee)
Good for if you're extremely suicidal
weaknesses: Bad if you're not extremely suicidal.
You will freak everyone out in the proximity with your emo abilities.

name: Mark And Track
description: You need to touch the object or the person you want to mark and track. Frow now on and until you release the mark, you will sense exactly where they are at any time. You can mark as many things as you want and you will still be able to remember what they are and distinguish them, though too many marks may overwhelm you. Also, the closer the marked things are to you, the stronger they will attract your attention. As such, if they are in your visual field, you can clearly pinpoint their location.
summary: The ability to mark anyone or anything and keep track of their position.
strengths: You can easily tail anyone. You just need to mark them or one of their possessions.
There's no limit to how many persons or objects you want to keep track.
If one of them gets too close to you, you will know it immediately.
weaknesses: You need to touch the person or the object you want to mark.
If you marked someone's possession, they can still leave it, lose it or give it to someone else.
If you mark too many things, you may be overwhelmed by the huge quantity of marks.

name: Transforming Dragon Master #1
description: As Master of all known Martial Arts, styles & ways you are gifted with the ability to transform into literal forms of fighting styles. For example, if fighting in tiger-style within a few moves you transform your hands into the form of a tiger paw. More moves in the same style grants your more bodily changes. If you fight long enough you morph into a human-hybrid of the form able to use heightened senses & strength. Eventually able to reach dragon level, your ultimate form.
summary: The ability to transform into the many forms of various martial arts styles
strengths: The easiest transformations are made within animalistic styles: leopard, monkey, tiger, mantis
Drunken master techniques allow you to enibriate anyone watching you
T'ai Chi transforms you into different form of energy (fire, lightning, etc. ) emotion dependant
weaknesses: Each level requires focus on your kata, lapses in focus revert you to a normal fighter
You cannot force the animal form, each situation dictates what style you will use
You will destroy your dojo a few times before you perfect your abilities

name: Fearless Gas
description: You have the power to release an anti-fear mist. This gas removes a person's fears, leaving them unable to discern harmful from harmless or even good from bad.

strengths: You can strip anyone of their phobias
Make an opponent run fearlessly off a cliff, into a hail of bullets, etc.
weaknesses: They could go recklessly out of control after you take away their fears
Fearlessness disappears as the gas is metabolized

name: Human Dictionary
description: Basically the ability to know every meaning and definition for every word in any language.

strengths: Easily pass English and L.O.T.E
Know the meaning to EVERY word.
Can swear at people in other languages.
weaknesses: Can make you feel like a nerd

name: Iron Skin
description: You can transform your skin into a hard protective iron coating/shell. It will still flex and bend with your body movements.

strengths: Great protection from bullets.
Good protection from alpha particles.
weaknesses: Affected by moisture, you can rust.
Your weight increases by 10 times
You attract magnets.

name: Impersonal Effects
description: This ability allows the user to make a connection of sorts between two things or people. This means that if something happens to one thing to will happen to the other. For example: if you use your power on a ball and a boulder, whatever you do to the ball will happen to the boulder. But if something happens to the boulder nothing will happen to the ball. That's because the ball is the control object. The user can choose which is the control. So it's kind of a universal voodoo.
summary: The ability to cause something to share the state of something else
strengths: You can control things and people
It looks really cool (set a candle on fire set your enemies on fire)
It takes only about 3 seconds to create or destroy a connection
weaknesses: You must touch at least one of the objects for it to work
All affects are shared so if you move the control the connected thing moves with it

name: Zeo Crystals
description: The user is able to harness as well as use the powers that are embedded within the five mystical zeo crystals. There are in total five zeo crystals, each crystal with a different color has its own unique power. The Red Zeo crystal has the ability of flight, the green zeo crystal has the ability of superstrength, the blue crystal is super speed, the yellow crystal is invulnerability and finally the pink crystal is healing.
summary: The ability to use the abilities embedded in each different zeo crystal
strengths: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Only gives power to the person that is good in nature
Cannot be stolen
weaknesses: Cannot combine two crystals together to get two powers

name: Black Hole Immunity
description: The summary says it all. With this ability, you can never get sucked into black holes. It also has the added bonus of letting you actually go through white holes, so you can see what's on the other side. So it also means you can escape black holes. However, you can still be sucked in if you touch the black hole (but who would actually do that? )
summary: The ability to be immune to the attraction of black holes.
strengths: Be immune to the gravity of black holes without being immune to any other gravity.
Escape black holes with ease.
Go through white holes and find out the truth of black holes.
weaknesses: Where are you going to find a black hole?
You can still get sucked in by touching it.

name: Myth Power: Aegle's Aesthetic
description: Aegle (Aigle), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the radiance of good health, and the honor paid to people in the medical/healing profession. As such, channeling her allows one to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition, and always look healthy. In addition, one can withstand any injury, as they ruin/damage one's physical appearance. Furthermore, one can resist any disease that ruins/damages one's physical appearance. One even gains enhancement to any other healing/restorative powers.
summary: The ability to channel Aegle's command over the essence of the radiance of good health
strengths: Always look healthy; snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Immune to any injury, spot, blot, blemish, wrinkle or ailment that ruins one's physical appearance
Any medical/healing/restorative powers one has are enhanced; insured to NEVER die ugly
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate medical/healing/restorative abilities until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically steal beauty, by touch until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Human Vault
description: With this power you take on the properties of a vault. Your skin becomes impregnable and you gain the ability to open your chest and store items within yourself. You have infinite storage space, and the items you store will remain as they were when you stored them.
summary: The ability to take on the properties of a vault.
strengths: Impregnable skin.
Infinate storage.
weaknesses: You may be targeted by people who want to get inside your vault.
You can not eat by storing food in your chest.

name: Chaos Sense
description: One with this ability has a great gift on his side. It allows the user to sense current chaos as well as impending chaos. In other words, the user can tell when people are about to fight as well as sensing when a fight is about to take place, or the presence and movements of beings already in an altercation. This can even be used to discern if two beings dislike each other (and to what degree) or if they have conflicting beliefs.
summary: The ability to perceive chaos and discord
strengths: Tell when a fight is about to start
Tell when a fight is already occurring in one's immediate vicity (if you can't physically see it)
Sense if two people have conflicting beliefs (good at avoiding trouble)
weaknesses: Doesn't tell you how to RESOLVE conflict
Not good for offense
May sense that a bigger, stronger, meaner foe dislikes YOU

name: Equalizer
description: If you fight someone stronger than you, you will get more powerful and glean some of their skills and, in some extreme cases, their powers, so that you are equal to them. Unfortunately,it has the same effect if you fight someone weaker than you.
summary: The ability to make a fight fair
strengths: It is hard to beat you
You always have a chance
If your enemy has a superpower, you will gain it just because it is the only way to beat them
weaknesses: It is hard to beat anyone as you will be equal to them
Your enemy always has a chance
Not ideal for fighting a group of enemies

name: Dinosaur Summon
description: With this power you can summon dinosaurs to help you fight (or commit) crime. You can summon any species and as many dinosaurs as you want and they are under your complete control. When you're done with them you can just send them back in time.
summary: The ability to summon dinosaurs from the past
strengths: You can summon any amount of any species of dinosaur.
They are under your complete control.
When you're done with them you can just send them back in time.
weaknesses: They might accidentally harm innocent people.

name: Importance Aura
description: With this power you will be able to see an aura around every object that tells you how important an object is to your current situation, or how important it will be to future situations. Different colors of the aura would tell you how important the object is or will be, and the strength of the glow (very dim to very bright) would tell you the amount of time you have left until the object will become important. If the object is important more than once the glow will reflect the more important tim
summary: The ability to sense how important a object is or will be to you
strengths: Know what objects will be of vital importance to you
You would know what objects could save your life based on the color of the aura
weaknesses: The aura does not indicate when or how the object will be of importance

name: Reoccurence Eliminator
description: A person with this power has the ability to prevent anything from occuring exactly the same again. By exactly this means that something has to be different by a certain amount. Ie if a person tries to hit you with a cross hook and you use this they can never use a cross hook in the same arc ever again if you decide to do so. Try as they might they can never do that thing again. This power is permanent so it will force the other person to adapt and do things in new ways.
summary: The ability to prevent something from happening again
strengths: No one can ever beat you in the exact same way
Enemies can't make the same exact move every time thus limiting choices
Is self controlled ie you don't suffer the same handicaps
weaknesses: One Hit KO's
People that have lots of imagination--to come up with new ways to do stuff
Permanent power--if that person becomes your ally they will be crippled

name: Letter Of The Day
description: The letter of the day starts with A on the day you get this power and changes each day, cycling through Z until you lose this power. You gain control over anything starting with the letter that is the letter of the day. Also works on people if the first letter of their name is the letter of the day. This power can be resisted by strong-willed people.
summary: The ability to gain control of anything starting with the letter of the day.
strengths: Control over anything starting with the chosen letter.
Wide range of power.
Works on people's names.
weaknesses: Cannot control which letter is the letter of the day.
Need large vocabulary to use more effectively.
Strong-willed people can resist this power.

name: Skeleton Form
description: At the user's command, they will become an animated, fleshless, hairless form of their own skeleton. This skeleton form will be indestructible, and whenever someone is killed by this skeleton, the mass of their bones will be added to it. This carries over to the user's human form, and the rest of the body will adapt to the new size.
summary: The ability to become a powerful, animated skeleton at will.
strengths: Indestructible skeleton form.
Can change form at will.
Can become larger.
weaknesses: May eventually become strangely large in human form.
The weight of your bones alone is light initially.

name: Claymore : Dark Parasite
description: This Claymore feeds on other powers to the point where it becomes worthless. It is immune from detection. The blade is made from black obsidian. The hilt is made from iron. It is the oldest claymore( 4. 5 billion years)
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that feeds on other powers
strengths: Detection immunity
You have the oldest claymore
Feeds on other powers
weaknesses: Other claymores are immune ( no con negation )
This claymore looses its power during night time
you can only have one claymore ( no con negation )

name: Password
description: A person with this power has the ability to control his own passwords as well as that of others. Passwords can instantly be discovered and even changed to whatever the user wishes. Passwords can even be protected so that others, even someone with this power, can not affect them. Passwords can even be placed on objects you own so that they can not be used without having the password.
summary: The ability to have control over passwords.
strengths: Discover and change passwords.
Protect your own passwords.
Place passwords on objects.
weaknesses: Can't discover passwords of other people who have this power.
Only works on passwords and not other security items like fingerprint scanner.
Having to use passwords to activate all your items.

name: Thuper Lithp
description: With this power, anyone criticizes your speech at their own risk. You can gain nearly any power by saying its name, but only by saying it in a lisp. So, instead of saying "super strength", you'd need to say "Thuper Thrength". For "size manipulation", you'd need to say "Thize Manipulathion". And while the power may be used for nearly any desired length of time, the cool-off time is just as long as power use. Otherwise, you need to say it again if you want to have that particular power again.
summary: The ability to gain superpowers from speaking the name of the power in a lisp
strengths: Just say the name of nearly any power to get that power.
Could briefly confuse enemies.
Lithpth are AWETHOME
weaknesses: People could make fun of you; Might get the wrong power by saying the name wrong.
Level of powers that can be used must develop as this power develops
Power not permanent; to use it again, you must say it again (after the cool-off time).

name: Ophiomancy
description: With this power, you are the best snake charmer ever. To summon the snakes, focus on the word "snake" and all the snakes within a 5-mile radius will slither to you and be at your command. You can control these snakes to fight and bite your opponents. In addition, all the snakes you've summoned will have a venom boost, and you will be immune to snake venom. However, this isn't the best power if you live in a place where there are few snakes.
summary: The ability to control and summon snakes
strengths: You can summon and command snakes to attack your enemies
All these snakes (even nonvenomous ones) have a vemon boost
You will be immune to snake venom
weaknesses: This isn't a good power if there are few snakes where you live
Summoning can sometimes drain your energy

name: Quiz Genius
description: With this ability, you will know the answer to every question on any test you take. You might not understand the answer, but you will definitely know it. You can only use this ability to answer questions that have solvable answers. By the way, if someone asks you a question, that's considered a sort of test, so you'll know the answer! You can't test yourself.
summary: The ability to know the answer to every question on every test you take.
strengths: Always be right.
You can solve people's problems.
weaknesses: You might need bodyguards.
You might not learn anything in school.

name: Wall Tearer
description: When you are facing any kind of wall, you can plunge your hands into it and tear it open. You can only use your hands to do it, and these and your arms are the only parts of your body that are immune to whatever effect the wall can have. The rip will stay open indefinitely until it is repaired or closed in a way.
summary: The ability to rip walls open, including magical barriers, forcefields,...
strengths: Great against barrier-type powers.
Your hands are immune to the effects you should get when touching the wall.
No wall is strong enough to block you.
weaknesses: In case of a normal wall, parts of the building or structure may collapse as the wall is weakened.
The rest of your body is vulnerable to magical effects.

name: Heavy Powers
description: Each power actually possessed,stolen,mimicked,duplicated or copied with power backup ability adds together and multiples the person's density by that number. Author power mimicry adds all the powers created by that person. Shadowulf1 tamer add all powers created by Shadowulf1. It takes 50 copies(the power backup ability) to equal one power. Top 10 power mimicry adds up to 10 powers,depending on how many of them the person actually possesses. Omni power mimicry counts as one power.
summary: The ability to give someone's powers weight and increase that person's density.
strengths: Make a power duplicator to heavy to move his own body.
Slow or stop power thieves.
Another way to stop someone using author power mimicry.
weaknesses: Someone with super strength.
You give someone invulnerability with this power.

name: Daily Powers
description: Your powers change every day. There's no limit to the powers that you'll have!
summary: The ability to powers change daily
strengths: There's not limit to your powers.
New powers everyday.
weaknesses: Once you used that power for a day, it will never come back.

name: Chainokinesis
description: With this ability, you can control chains with your hands as well as release them from your hands. It is a lot more draining to release chains. If you are more adept, you can even release chains from walls and the ground.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate chains.
strengths: Never run out of chains.
Lock people down.
Beat people with it.
weaknesses: Very draining
Useless if you have Intangiblity
Can be melted with fire

name: Delete This Life Crusher
description: You can grab your opponent by the neck, filling your fists with dark energy, and start consuming their life force. Then, you even punch your enemy in the stomach and allow the charged dark indigo firey energy to burst through them before throwing their body to the ground, and then stomp on their back that breaks their spine.
summary: The ability to completely drain the very life of your foe to death, then stomp on their back.
strengths: Could steal a person's life to gain a new one.
weaknesses: Can't give back a life that you stole from a person.

name: Costume Power
description: You are able to change into the things you wear. For example, you are able to have the powers of a sorcerer if you dress like one, or you are able to have the powers of a superhero if you dress like one. If you need to learn about people from the past, you can put on those types of clothes and see what it was like. That also includes if you want to learn about a famous person, you could dress like them and then know what they know. But you can always go back to just being you if you want.
summary: The ability to gain powers depending on what costume you wear.
strengths: Can be different persons
Can totally freak people out during Halloween
Fun
weaknesses: You might not have the costume you want
People might think you're weird if you always wear a costume
Can't merge two costumes, e.g. you can't add angel wings to an alien costume

name: Saboteur
description: The Saboteur is capable of disturbing the peace among individuals, small cliques, communities, and with enough willpower, towns or countries. The Saboteur's greatest tool is chaos and utilizing this element augments your strength drastically. The Saboteur also draws power from civil disputes, anger, shouting, and other forms of rage. When the Saboteur is fueled by chaos, he or she will emanate a burgundy aura. The aura can discharge in several forms of offense and defense.
summary: The ability to become a superpowered expert in the art of sabotaging.
strengths: Riots will transform you into a virtually invincible being of unmeasurable power.
Blast targets with beams of raw chaos.
Expanded knowledge of sabotage; possibly unlimited solutions.
weaknesses: Pacifists and monks are your worst enemies.
May be portrayed as a sociopath.

name: Negative Power Charge
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling negative.
E.g Angry, upset, frustrated, moody.
However you are weakened by people with positive feeling. Ths power opposes Positve Power Charge.
summary: The ability to gain strength based on negative feelings and emotions.
strengths: You feeling negative, doubles the extent of your power.
weaknesses: Must rely on people having negative feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Demolition Zone
description: This power creates a zone that changes things that are inside. Things inside the zone lose their invulnerability and immortality for as long as they are inside the zone. Objects become more brittle the longer they are inside the zone. People also begin to develop the power the create controlled explosions on inanimate objects to demolish them. The effects of the zone fade though when the zone is left.
summary: The ability to create a zone that allows the destruction of anything.
strengths: Enemies lose their invulnerability and immortality.
Objects become weaker.
Ability to cause controlled explosions on inanimate objects.
weaknesses: You lose invulnerability and immortality too.
May start breaking things you do not want.
Foes can cause explosions as well.

name: Perfect Power Detection
description: This power will look at everything about a person- from their passions, dislikes, and personality to what other people think about them, and will tell you what the perfect power for them would be. You can also limit what it's based off (for example, just based off of their desires and nothing else, or just what power would make them happiest), and limit what powers there are to choose from (for example, "of the powers off of the super power list... ").
summary: The ability to detect what power would be perfect for someone
strengths: A must have for power-granters! You also get to know *why* it's perfect.
Also does the reverse, you can look at some of the powers that they'd hate the most
Will manage your own powers too if you have Josh's Power Switchboard (see very first comment).
weaknesses: Without power-gifting powers, completely useless
No more asking people "what power(s) would you want, if you could have superpowers"
(since you'll already know the answer)

name: The Guardian Of Eden
description: The power to protect and use the Garden of Eden. The Garden can give you powers or let you see into the future, each gift is different for each individual, however, the Garden can make it's own choices and if you prove unworthy, it will kill you or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
summary: The ability to protect and use the Garden of Eden
strengths: The Garden gives you a gift it see's you need. (weaponry/powers)
You have the ability to protect Eden and use the wisdom and powers of the Tree.
You are viewed as a high ranking Angel which can move in an out of Eden at whim
weaknesses: If proven unworthy to the Garden it will either kill or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
You cannot change the future.
You cannot use the Garden for revenge or murder.

name: Correlation Inducement
description: With this ability, you can make any one factor influence another, with a positive or negative correlation. You can make any one factor influence any other, such as making the amount of toast consumed positively correlate with longevity; the more toast a person eats, the longer they live.
summary: The ability to make any one factor influence any other.
strengths: Achieve a huge variety of effects.
Universal.
Fits several specialized purposes.
weaknesses: Universal.
It lasts until death or intentional reversal, so you could forget it is in action.
Be careful not to make one factor influence another when the opposite is already in play.

name: Death's Scythe
description: The ability to summon death's scythe which can slice and dice anything no matter how strong. The scythe can also grab people and send them for judgement which will either send them for eternal punishment in hell or eternal happiness in heaven.
summary: The ability to summon Death's Scythe
strengths: Can cut through anything.
Send enemies to hell.
Can summon it wherever you are.
weaknesses: Anyone can use it while you're unconcious if you had it in you're hand.
Enemies may go to heaven or choose to to come back to life.
Can be used on you.

name: Weight Shift
description: Your center of gravity is the point in your body through which you find it easiest to balance. With this power you can shift your weight to move it about your body at will with no visible effects. This concept was briefly explored in Futurama where it grants Hermes mad limbo skills. However, there are many other uses. If you place it in your head it can make you very difficult to knock down. Placed in your feet it makes it easier to get up. A variety of ninja-like skills are at your disposal.
summary: The ability to shift your center of gravity to anywhere in your body
strengths: Very Versatile
Ninjaesque
No visible changes
weaknesses: Difficult to get the hang of
Feels slightly uncomfortable
Placing weight in your head only works if you are hit in the head

name: Calcium Manipulation
description: With this power you are able to control not only calcium, but objects that have a large amount of calcium in them. This means that the user is able to create and control things such as milk, bones, and shells. It is even possible to change an object with calcium into a different object with a large amount of Calcium, such as turning Milk into Bones. Calcium is the most abundant metal by mass in many animals.
summary: The ability to control and create calcium, and objects made out of Calcium.
strengths: Control and create Calcium and objects with large amounts of Calcium.
Control objects such as Milk, Bones, and Shells.
Animals have a large amount of Calcium in them, making this power useful against them.
weaknesses: Objects need a large amount of Calcium in them to be controlled.
Creating objects that have Calcium in them is harder than creating pure Calcium.
People with stronger metal manipulating powers.

name: Psychopompism
description: This ability is not one to be toyed with. It allows the user to lure a person's soul out of its body by imitating the experience of near-death. This may mean causing the subject to see "The Light", or causing their life to flash before their eyes. Either supernatural method makes the soul feel like it's time to leave and go on to the afterlife, effectively killing the person in whom the soul resided.
summary: The ability to lure souls out of their bodies, resulting in death
strengths: Kill foes with no trace
Their spirit won't even haunt you
If used on discarnate spirits, it sends them to the afterlife as well
weaknesses: Can't be undone
Once the process starts, it can't be stopped
Immortals, time-defiers, astral projectors, animals and plants are all immune to this power

name: Anger Vision
description: With this power, your anger turns into radiation that your body stores. You can project it from your eyes at will. The angrier you get, the stronger it is. And if it reaches the maximum zone--or "M-Zone"--it will be uncontrollable, shooting a huge beam out of your eyes. The only thing that blocks it is titanium. The only way to know people have this power is a red glint in their eye (which turns bluish when they're happy).
summary: The ability to shoot anger from your eyes
