strengths: Shoot anger out of your eyes.
Give bullies a run for their money.
Finally get the treatment you deserve.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable powers.
People with titanium armor.
People can tell you have this power from a red/blue glint in their eyes.

name: Altered Ego Cloning
description: Everyone has an alter ego. They could be superheroes, villains, even a successful businessman, I don't know. Those are the people we dream of being, just like you and me but only better. They could also have powers but it is a one-time chance to create your altered ego. For me, I would have my altered ego be like me, but only stronger, faster, and more impervious to physical damage.
summary: The ability to create different version of yourself.
strengths: Your altered ego can be anything you want.
There are no limits on how many abilities or skills it would gain.
You can make it disappear or reappear whenever you want.
weaknesses: You can only make one.
Once you create your altered ego, you can't change it.

name: Inconvenience Destroyer
description: Whether it's comfort or the situation where you owe a friend $1 and you only have 99 cents, this power will eliminate inconveniences, generating that extra cent. This power works on minor inconveniences, not major.
summary: The ability to eliminate minor inconveniences.
strengths: None really, it's not that useful.
weaknesses: Only minor. Not major.
Not really useful, as it's only minor inconveniences.

name: Chaos Incarnate
description:
The essence of Chaos flows through you. 
Schrodinger's cat is every outcome between death and life until it is observed, right? This power is something along those lines. 
Essentially, your body exists in a never-ending state of flux. All of your qualities are constantly subject to change. 
Experience extreme mood swings; levels of intelligence, strength, reaction speed, etc. Unexpectedly change; shapeshift (although retaining a basically human form); use magic, see things, die, be water.
summary: The ability to defy expectations. Or fulfill them. Or something...
strengths: Possibilities are endless.
Dying occurs, but not permanently.
Make your enemies tremble in fear.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable state of being.
Probably not rational more than half the time.
Make your friends flee in terror.

name: Myth Power: Ares' Arrogance
description: Ares, in Greek myth, was the god of war, battle, bloodshed, violence and manly courage. As such, channeling him allows one to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition. In addition, one gains superhuman strength, speed, durability, stamina, reflexes, agility and dexterity. Furthermore, when one is angry or afraid, one can psychically enter a battle rage, which negates one's irrational fear and boosts allies' morale. One can even psychically produce a powerful sonic scream, when injured.
summary: The ability to channel Ares' command over the essence of war, battle, bloodshed, violence and manly courage
strengths: Snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Gain superhuman physical stats; when angered, enter a psychic battle rage, similar to berserker rage
Gain Sonic Scream, when injured
weaknesses: Cannot harness one's rage to induce Rapid Regeneration until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand damage from (and gain physical power from) weapon attacks until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia provides especially strong influence over one with this ability (NCN)

name: Carnage Blade
description: The blade has great power and can cut through the most toughest materials and metals and it can be activated at will.
summary: The ability to create a blade from your strongest arm
strengths: Can cut through the toughest materials and metals
Has great power
Can be activated at will
weaknesses: Can hurt many people

name: Heartless
description: If you have this ability, you can withdraw your heart from your body in the form of a glowing golden light. When your heart is outside your body, you can experience no emotion, but your body and clothes will be entirely in black and white. When this power is first gained, it can be used to heal someone at the cost of your own stamina in the area of pain. Once trained to full power, it can be used as a weapon and without losing any of your own strength.
summary: The ability to use your heart as a weapon
strengths: Heal people and bring back the dead
Use as a light in dark places
Experience no emotion when in use (no sadness or loss of temper)
weaknesses: Experience no emotion when in use (obvious that it's being used)
Lose all color on your clothes and body (obvious that it's being used)
Needs to be trained a lot before it can be used as a weapon or without losing any of your own health

name: Web Willpower
description: The primary function of the it is to provide a weapon capable of transforming your thoughts into physical constructs through the your strength of willpower. You can create any particular items or construct that they can imagine as long as you have the willpower necessary to will it into existence. The constructs are made out of Web Fluids, which is an expression of pure willpower. You can also create web based missiles or bullets.
summary: The ability to construct anything that you can imagine made from webs
strengths: It can used in offence or defense.
weaknesses: Those webs can wear off and dissolve into a powder.
Willpower-based; a lack of focus will result in a failed construct

name: Resin Excretions
description: With this power the user can excrete different types of resin from their skin. Sticky resin, which when hardened is stronger than stone. Elastic Resin which acts like rubber. Flammable resin. Resins with healing and toxic qualities. Slick resin that reduces friction. But to use them, the area you excrete it from must be bare.
summary: The ability to excrete a number of differant types of resin from your skin
strengths: Healing and poisons.
Weapons and armor.
Quick ways to get around.
weaknesses: The resin comes out of your skin, so don't dress to heavly.
You cannot controll the resin, only excrete and fire it.
Water will wash it away in its unhardened state.

name: Death Manipulation
description: This superpower allows a person to communicate with anybody who is dead. They are able to see them and speak to them as well as have the deceased to talk back. However, this ability would be really terrible for a battle or a fight. This power, when in use, renders the person invisible to anything around them. Unfortunately, if used for too long of a period of time, the person using it will eventually want to join them and kill themself.
summary: The ability to communicate with those who have died
strengths: You get to communicate with the dead
You get to become invisible except to those who are deceased
weaknesses: Not very good for fights
Does not actually bring the deceased back to life
You could die from wanting to join them if communicating with them for too long

name: Direct Sunlight Absorption
description: When your skin is exposed to natural sunlight, the energy is instantly diffused to every cell in your body and instantly consumed for your superpowers: super strength, invulnerability, healing, super speed and flight. You cannot store this energy, and when in darkness, you lose your abilities instantly. If the sun's light is blocked or dimmed, your powers instantly diminish. Having just a fingertip exposed to sunlight will raise your power levels to slightly above human level.
summary: The ability to have superpowers only in sunlight
strengths: On a sunny day or above the clouds, your power is great
Can heal injuries just by standing in the sun
weaknesses: You'll probably have to fly/fight half-nude to absorb more energy
At night or in the dark you could be killed easily.
If you try to fly down into a heavy cloud cover, you'll fall and die

name: Aura Of Masculinity
description: The user becomes a master at anything men find appealing, including, but not limited to: rugged good looks, fighting (with or without weapons), wooing women, intelligence, and access to the best cars and clothes. He is also granted a powerful voice that girls find irresistible and enemies find horrifying. This lets him negotiate with anyone and anything. He can perform unbelieveable feats due to this manliness. In short, he becomes the ideal man, a living action hero, a man's man.
summary: The ability to become the manliest man on the planet.
strengths: Able to master anything that men find appealing, like fighting, picking up girls, and drinking beer.
The user is able to perform impossible feats because his manliness defies space, time, and physics.
Any living thing will fight for the user because of his looks, talents, and manliness.
weaknesses: If the user leaves his planet, his power becomes useless.
Might cause an arrogant nature in the user.
If the user abuses his power, it could be devastating to both him and those around him.

name: Bird Control
description: With this power, you can control all types of birds, which means you can make birds poop on people you don't like or you can make them peck people's eyes out.
summary: The ability to control birds.
strengths: Can make birds poop on people you don't like.
Can make birds peck people's eyes out.
weaknesses: Not useful when fighting cat-themed villains.

name: Imbue Genetic Trait
description: You can put genetic traits into things, but you need DNA from a creature with those traits. You can also take out traits if you know their genetic sequences. You can see someone's DNA by tasting it and know what every thing does.
summary: The ability to put genetic traits into things.
strengths: Can give yourself powers from allies.
You will make an uber-vampire.
Give your enemies bad traits or take away their powers.
weaknesses: Must taste their blood.
Might get like AIDS or something.
Will probably need some paper to write the looong sequences on.

name: Equal Power
description: With this power whenever you're fighting a person/creature/people/creatures with the same super powers as you your superpower automatically becomes the same power level as theres. So if they have more practice with the power and there's is stronger your power automatically becomes stronger as well.
summary: The ability to have the same power levels as the person or people you're fighting
strengths: If you're fighting someone with the same powers as you your powers become as strong as their's
weaknesses: Your power reverts back to its normal level after the fight is over
This power is useless if your opponent doesn't have any of the same powers

name: Schwann Cell Mimicry
description: Your skin is made of an electrically-insulating material. Whenever you are grasping something, you can command your skin to stretch and roll round it, locking, consolidating and tightening your grip. Additionally, you can allow Neuron Mimics who can create special signals to direct them toward desired Neuron Mimics within a medium range, though you cannot make one who can't generate these signals create one. You can also undergo mitosis.
summary: The ability to have an electrically-insulating skin, stretch it and roll it round things you want to grasp.
strengths: You are needed if a Neuron Mimic wants to send their signals to another Neuron Mimic.
You are immune to the effects of electricity.
You can wrap things with your skin to protect them from electricity.
weaknesses: The Neuron Mimics still require Astrocyte Mimics to receive signals sent by other Neuron Mimics.
Unlike Oligodendrocyte Mimics, you can't detach yourself from things you've wrapped.
You are useless to a Neuron Mimic who can't even send signals.

name: Ability Source Link
description: A user of this power can link one power's source to another, charging it up. For instance, if they had Telekinesis, this power and Direct Sunlight Absorption, they could make their telekinesis gain strength when they stood in sunlight without reducing the power of Direct Sunlight Absorption.
summary: The ability to link the sources of your powers together.
strengths: Boost any power.
Take full advantage of your situation.
Benefits a variety of power choices.
weaknesses: Can weaken linked abilities too.
Must have an ability with a factor as a source to boost another power.
If one power is rendered nonfunctional, the link is broken.

name: Substance: Trait Enhancement
description: With this power, you can permanently enhance the properties or traits of a chemical element, combination or substance in the near vicinity. For example: Copper is a good conductor of electricity and heat. If you have a strip of it in your vicinity, you could enhance that trait to turn it into a super conductor. Titanium is a tough, heavy metal, but with this power you could make it almost indestructable.  The effects are permanent, so you only need to concentrate for a few seconds.
summary: The ability to enhance the traits or properties of a particular substance, chemical, etc.
strengths: Enhance substance properties to their maximum potential.
Change is permanent, no need to concentrate.
You can directly target chemical in the area, or a large burst within the vicintiy of 100 metres.
weaknesses: Change is permanent, that might not be so good.
You can only enhance the porperties that the substance already has.

name: Metaschizophrenia
description: In the occurrence of a metahuman, or superhero/supervillain, is diagnosed with Schizophrenia a rare abnormality may happen in which each personality that is developed may have a separate power. These powers do not have to be similar and could possibly be polar opposites.
summary: The ability to become a schizophrenic human with multiple personalities, each having a different power
strengths: More than one power
weaknesses: Not all personalities can be good

name: Dinosaur Physiology
description: As a result of incorporating a serum containing all DNA of every dinosaur that has ever lived, you now have all their abilities at your disposal. You have the following abilities: superhuman strength, speed, endurance, acute olfactory receptors, durability, and sight. You can produce claws or extra limbs with ease and quick recovery.
summary: The ability to acquire dinosaur limbs and extensions along with their characteristics.
strengths: Your thick hide renders firearms useless.
Clear through dozens of enemies with an ankylosaurus tail.
Become the ultimate predator.
weaknesses: Weak to roving blackouts.
The intensities of cold temperatures will pose a threat to you when this ability is active.

name: Instant Degree
description: You will instantly be granted a legitimate Ph.D. (just about the highest degree one can earn) in any field of study of your choosing.  You will be given all the knowledge and experience that goes along with it, including a decent set of friends and connections.
summary: The ability to instantly have a Ph.D. and all the knowledge that comes with it for one field of study.
strengths: Truly be a master at one subject
Earn a lot more cash
Be the man
weaknesses: Choosing which field of study
If you skip college, you'll miss out on all the good times
The process of learning can be fun

name: Reptile Control
description: With this power you have complete control over all reptiles (snakes, lizards, chameleons etc. ). You can make the reptiles fight for you or you can put on cool animal shows at zoos and make some extra cash.
summary: The ability to control reptiles
strengths: You have complete control over all reptiles
You can make them fight your enemies for you
You can put on cool animal shows at zoos
weaknesses: Your reptiles can be killed
If there are no reptiles near you you have a problem

name: Iron Stomach
description: With this power you can consume anything without it having an adverse affect on you. You can eat anything you were allergic to without having an allergic reaction, you can eat anything that has been poisoned or is spoiled and you will not die or even feel sick. You can even eat fire or explosives and you will be fine even if the explosive is set off in your stomach you will not feel a thing and you will not die.
summary: The ability to have an invincible stomach
strengths: You can consume anything without having an adverse reaction to it
You can eat anything poisonous or explosives
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you eat the person you're fighting or something

name: Myth Power: Heed Hysmine
description: Hysmine and the Hysminae (Hysminai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fighting (fist-fights, street fights, etc). As such, channeling them allows one to perceive and induce fighting in any two or more subjects. In addition, one gains superhuman fighting prowess, and the ability to perceive a foe's moves in combat (or to predict the moves of ANYONE in radius with hostile intent). Furthermore, weapons and other potentially harmful objects in radius will turn intangible to the user AND the foe.
summary: The ability to channel Hysmine and the Hysminae's command over the essence of fighting and non-martial combat
strengths: Gain superhuman prowess in unarmed and non-martial (non-war) combat; perceive/induce fights at will
Predict the moves of any foe, in combat or in everyday life (Combat Precognition)
Exude a radius that turns all potentially harmful objects intangible (forcing PHYSICAL combat)
weaknesses: Cannot amplify physical damage from hits of self/allies in combat until the higher levels (NCN)
Only negate mental and energy abilities (forcing hand-to-hand combat) at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Resculpt
description: With this power the human body has the properties of clay to the user. In other words you can reshape the human body, make a person shorter or taller, resculpt them into an animal or another human including members of the opposite sex, you can also combine two people into one, like conjoined twins. When the power is activated the person you are resculpting freezes then you litterally sculpt the persons body like they are clay. The changes are real, if you turn someone into a dog they are a dog.
summary: The ability to resculpt anyone as if they were clay
strengths: Great for pranks
After some training it becomes reverseable
Shrink bad guys
weaknesses: The power mainly relies on the users artistic skill if you can't sculpt it wont look good.
Initially you can't reverse what you are doing.
Changes are real

name: Power Non Interference
description: Your powers will not interfere with you or your other powers. For example, if you obtained all of your powers at once, along with this, then any that might horribly mutilate you or guarantee you'd die would be automatically disabled until you willed otherwise. In short, you'll always be able to live a normal life if you choose. Secondly, they can't interfere with each other. Your powers can't say "Having this means you can never be immortal" or "This can be your ONLY power. "
summary: The ability to prevent your powers from interfering with you or each other
strengths: Picked up some bad powers? Now you don't have to be afraid of getting the downsides
Careless wording like "Can't be immortal" where they meant "Doesn't make you immortal"
Automatic & knows what you want (Hate immortality? It's off. Want it? It's on. )
weaknesses: Does nothing to the downsides that powers apply to themselves.
If this power can't just negate the downside, it disables the powers until they're needed instead.
As with all meta-powers, useless on its own.

name: Skin Reforming
description: With this power, you can make calluses to endure an attack, make your hands soft (I don't know what good that is), or fashion weapons attached to your skin. You could make your fist into a huge club or make your whole arm into a shield. This does not require your hands, you just need to will your skin to do it.
summary: The ability to control the thickness and shape of your skin.
strengths: Your elbow is now a spear.
Make calluses on your feet to endure a fall.
Never need Lotion Mimicry?
weaknesses: It is not passive. You need to make it happen. The sniper wins again.
You are not invulnerable, just pretty close.
It might be hard to transform that jumbled mess of a club back into your hand

name: Starfire
description: Starfire's powers are superhuman strength, stamina and durability, flight, energy projection (called starbolts), and linguistic assimilation. The color of your starbolts varies from person to person. Linguistic assimilation allows you to know the language of another person by physically touching that person.
summary: The ability to have the powers of Starfire (Teen Titans)
strengths: Superhuman strength, stamina and durability
Flight, energy projection (called starbolts), and linguistic assimilation
Color of your starbolts varies from person to person
weaknesses: Must physically touch a person to know the language(s) that they know

name: Command Discs
description: A person with this ability has the ability to transfer their will to another object through the use of discs. The discs can be thrown or inserted and they will enter anything thrown, unless it does not have enough surface area to absorb the disc. The discs are the size of standard cd-roms. You can only create commands that physically fit on the disc(written). You can also throw multiple discs. Cannot take control of any person unless the disc is inserted into their head.
summary: The ability to creat disc that contain your will and cause the written command to be executed by whatever it hits
strengths: Even if people dodge, whatever is behind them will carry out the command
You can materialize an infinite amount of discs
You can make commands which are impossible, such as "walk away and explode"
weaknesses: You need to write on the discs beforehand and the discs take time to be materialized
You need to have a good throwing arm or secretly insert discs at close range
Needs to hit someone's head to make his whole body fulfill the command

name: Warrior Insect
description: Many insects have the ability to defend themself or a colony with amazing abilities. Become an ever adapting insect-human hybrid. Your skin hardens to a bulletproof exoskeleton. You can grow transparent wings. Large retractable stingers can grow out of hands and feet. Insect abilities at human size will give you an advantage that is nearly unbeatable.
summary: The ability to mimic insect physiology
strengths: You could look normal but have every insect power imaginable or scare enemies by changing features
In an instant you could grow wings, stingers, mandibles, claw-like hairs to climb walls and more
Super-senses: Enhanced vision, hearing, smell
weaknesses: Revert to normal human agility and reflexes in cold weather
You will be addicted to sugar
With this power men will be instinctive followers, women will be natural leaders

name: Esc Key
description: You'll become a super escape artist. Master of Escapology. If you are tied up, handcuffed, restrained, or locked in something. Using your power, the locks or rope or whatever is holding you will instantly unlock or un-tie. Nothing can hold you.
summary: The ability to know how to escape from any restraint or trap with ease
strengths: Become a super Houdini
weaknesses: Only works if in a restrained item or situation

name: Geo Mimicry
description: You'll be like the Thing except your not orange & you can change back into human form. Your body will take on the property of rocks. You'll have an increase in size, superhuman strength, endurance, a super tough & thick hide that makes you almost invulnerable. Bad thing is your speed & agility will be slow, you'll sink to the bottom in bodies of water & strong winds will cause erosion.
summary: The ability to turn into a humanoid rock creature
strengths: Become a living golem
Become taller & larger, super strength, endurance & rock skin
weaknesses: Movement is slow
Can't swim, just sink
High winds will turn you into dust over time

name: Ability Switching
description: You can switch your ability with another person's. You can also just switch other people's abilities, and even switch abilities into normal people.
summary: The ability to switch a person's ability with your or another person's ability.
strengths: Try another power.
Mess with people.
weaknesses: Useless powers.

name: Ability Division
description: An Ability Divider makes superhumans share. By touching a superhuman and another person-usually non-powered-they can divide the superpower evenly amongst them. This leaves the superhuman half as strong, half as fast, etc. However, as the other person uses their half of the power, the superhuman begins to regain their full power, until the other person has none. The other person also does not have as much control over it as the original superhuman. This can be used on yourself with great focus.
summary: The ability to temporarily divide one superpower amongst two people
strengths: Weaken a foe
Strengthen a non-powered ally
Can be used on any power
weaknesses: More effective on a power+non-power than a power+power
When recipient uses split power, the donor regains power
Recipient does not have as much control as donor

name: Selective Omniarch
description: This allows you to rule over few things, about 1 or 2 things, 3 at most. Although you do have to prove yourself worthy to rule these things. EX: To rule over time you must prove yourself to be a strong time warper. If this test is failed you do have the opportunity to do this test again.
summary: The ability to rule over few things as long as you are worthy to rule over them.
strengths: Rule over some things.
weaknesses: You could only rule over 3 things at most.
These challenges are extremely difficult.
If the thing already has a ruler, than you can not rule it as a second ruler.

name: Offspring Of Darkness
description: This is what happens when a Children of the Moon(credit to Avoontap)and the Child of the Night (more credit to Avoontap) have a child. It grants the abilities; Razor tongue, Transform into a beast or incredible strength at will, Fast and strong at night and razor claws and teeth. Have purple eyes which can be easily identified. These offspring are taught to fight at the age of 2 so watch out for some vicious beasts.
summary: The ability to become a powerful beast at night
strengths: Super Fast and Strong at night, slightly weaker then average humans in day
So many things to try out!!!
Parents are AMAZINGLY POWERFUL!!!
weaknesses: Pale skin and purple eyes are easily identified.
Just a weak human during day

name: Arceusforce: Earth
description: The user of this ability can channel the power over the planets of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Ground-type. The user's skin turns light brown, their irises turn gray. Under their earthen guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Ground-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Ground attacks such as Earthquake, Mud Bomb, Earth Power, Fissure and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Ground form.
strengths: The user can resist mineral and poison-based attacks and is immune to electric-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of earth and seismic power used for Ground attacks.
weaknesses: The user is weak to water, plant and ice-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form

name: Reincarnation 8: Power
description: With this power, your soul is attached to your powers, so if it is absorbed, stolen, copied, etc, your soul is anchored to that person. You can control those who acquire powers from you and even use them as a new body if needed. As a side effect, your control over the power is enhanced. If you lose a power, you can channel a weakened version of one power acquired by someone else (with experience and only if this power is working).
summary: The ability to link your soul to your powers.
strengths: Friendly Power Gifting becomes more useful.
If you die, you have plenty of potential bodies.
If you lose this power, it's effects continue.
weaknesses: If people lose the powers they acquired from you, you lose your connection to them.
Once others discover you have this power, they won't steal or copy it.
Control and possession of others can be stopped by powers such as Anti Telepathy.

name: Superhero 3: Captain America
description: Captain America obtained his powers from the Super-Soldier serum, which gave him enhanced strength, speed, endurance, and agility. Which will happen to you when you get this power. You also have a metal shield that rebounds on walls when thrown and protects from you bullets.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the shieldwielding supersoldier, Captain America.
strengths: You're stronger, faster, agile than you ever were.
You can beat people at gym and the Olympics.
You also have a cool shield that comes with this power.
weaknesses: You're not entirely superhuman.
You could accidentally kill somebody in a fight.
Bullets will most likely harm you.

name: Detective
description: This ability will undoubtedly assist you in the law enforcement career. You've got a knack for solving crimes, using your detective skills. You're like a modern day Sherlock Holmes. You also get the criminal.
summary: The ability to solve the unsolveable crimes, using your keen detective skills.
strengths: Reduce the crime rate.
Take down the worlds most notorious criminal masterminds.
weaknesses: Criminals might seek revenge.
Don't possess any power, to defend against attacks from the criminals.

name: Perfect Teeth
description: Your teeth will always be in the right position in your mouth for whatever they need to do at the moment whether it is smiling, eating or something else. Also, your teeth will never get cavities and if any of your teeth are taken out of your mouth it will be replaced by a new tooth within a couple of minutes.
summary: The ability to always have a set of perfect teeth
strengths: You will never need a dentist ever again.
weaknesses: The tooth that comes in after losing a tooth isn't any stronger or durable.

name: Parasite
description: Here's how it works: When you bite someone, you can give them stuff (for example, your pain/damage), and you can take stuff, like their talent, intelligence, strength, and power. You then form a parasitic link that allows you to transfer these attributes at will. You can have many parasitic links, but you can't get rid them, although you can stop using them or give back stuff.
summary: The ability to when you bite some one you form a parasitic link
strengths: You can have many parasitic links
weaknesses: You can't get rid of links but you can stop using them or give back stuff
You must bite the person

name: Momentum
description: When you build up momentum, you can keep it at a steady pace with this power. The build up requires energy, but once you keep it at the same level, you won't have to expend energy. This means you can go on forever. It doesn't mean you're invulnerable, though.
summary: The ability to keep your momentum at a steady pace.
strengths: Keep going forever.
Conserve energy once you have momentum
weaknesses: Not invulnerable.
Build-up requires energy

name: Multicomplexion Effect
description: A Multicomplexion is a person who has two or more abilities of different origins, but can only use one depending on how strong they are. So basically, this is more of a condition than ability. People who are Multicomplexions and have two or more abilities of different origins, their bodies can't accept the new power so they repress the new ability and take the stronger ability. If the stronger ability has been weakened or taken away, the other ability kicks in and cannot be weakened or stolen.
summary: The ability to have two or more abilities of different origin, but can only use one depend on how strong you feel
strengths: Won't overload the body if filled with abilities.
Will supply you with other abilities if the first one is gone.
Won't let the weakest ability be weakened or stolen.
weaknesses: Won't be able to use all your abilities all the time.

name: Masochism
description: While the name does arouse a connotation that's more kinky than capable, this ability is a very useful, helpful one to have. It allows the user to perceive pain as pleasurable (as implied by the name), and to gain power from anything people would normally consider painful. Any attack short of instantaneous lethal damage will only EMPOWER the user, bouncing off of him like he has Superhuman Durability/Invulnerability, instead of doing harm.
summary: The ability to take pain as a positive effect instead of a negative one
strengths: Normally-painful stimuli are now pleasurable
Empowered by normally painful things
Any damage short of instantaneous lethal damage (beheading, Death Touch, etc. ) only HELPS you
weaknesses: Death Touch, Lifeforce Drain, Necrokinesis, Necromantic effects still can kill user
Suicide attempts can still kill the user
People think you're weird when they ask about your powers

name: Bubble Manipulation
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate bubbles. Not just soap bubbles they can manipulate any bubble. Of course there are many applications for this power, this includes but is not limited to parties, office work, combat, and medical work. The only limit is your imagination and your willpower.
summary: The ability to manipulate any bubble including shape, velocity ,and durability
strengths: Make different shaped bubbles ie bubble structures-----just because you can
Can increase the durability making it useful as a concussive weapon--they'll never expect it
Can also make bubbles violenty explode releasing air pressure as a weapon
weaknesses: Need to have a source of bubbles---can't create bubbles
Manipulation relies on mental power and concentration
Need to understand the physics behind bubbles to make them explode

name: Vibrate
description: You will be able to make powerful vibrations like a jack hammer. Either make soft vibrations till you wear an object down or make it soft or powerful ones that turn an object to dust or even explode it.
summary: The ability to make powerful vibrations
strengths: Go into roadside construction or demolish a building
weaknesses: You'll be considered an earthquake

name: Chemical Factory
description:
With this ability you can create any chemical in your body as long as you know the formula and have the base elements within your body. 

Your body's digestive system is replace with a chemical plant in a dimensional pocket where chemicals can be stored

This makes you immune to the effects of any chemical swallowed. 

Nutrients are made from the chemical factory to be place within your body

Your body's pores are also immune to chemicals
summary: The ability to produce chemicals within your own body and spray them from your pores
strengths: Produce acids, adhesives, slicks and other stuff if you know the formula
You can give yourself a diet by selectively choosing what type of nutrients go to your body
You are immune to chemical damage
weaknesses: Must know chemistry
Must eat several chemicals to use power effectively

name: The Death Flower
description: The power of The Death Flower is basically flowers that can turn into any weapon you can think out of your imagination. It may be weak when beginners use it but once you have mastered it, the stronger it will be.
summary: The ability to use any kind of flowers and turn them into weapons.
strengths: It can cut through anything once you have mastered it.
The flowers is your medium and you are the master.
It becomes handy when the user is fighting an enemy. It doesn't matter if he/she is weak or strong
weaknesses: For beginners, it's harder to control and it would take up most of your energy.
And that's mostly all of the bad things that could affect the user of this power.

name: Panontic Bracelet
description: The panontic bracelets are made of the same material as the archs. The bracelets only give one power and only work for three dimensions. Ergi-lets you radiate the heat of that dimension from your body. Ithuri-lets you travel to Ithuri. Nameless-you can temporarily summon a minion of one of the inmates trapped there. The heat of Ergi only has a range of five inches. You can't control what minion you get and the minion only stays thirty minutes. Bracelets and arches work together.
summary: The ability to gain powers by using a panontic bracelet.
strengths: Summon a horrible creature to help you.
Travel to a dimension where you can go to any other dimension.
Radiate ultra hot heat from your body
weaknesses: The creature only stays thirty minutes.
The ultra hot heat only goes five inches from your body.

name: Luck Reversal
description: This ability is not to be taken lightly. It does not allow direct manipulation of luck and probability, but rather reverses whatever stochastic effect is currently at work. In other words, if the user sees a subject is experiencing bad luck, he can reverse this, so that subject will instead experience good luck. In the same way, he can reverse a foe's good luck to bad luck. The user, if his power is strong enough, can even affect himself.
summary: The ability to reverse stochastic effects
strengths: Change allies' bad luck to good luck
Change enemies' good luck to bad luck
Influence situations (without directly affecting PEOPLE)
weaknesses: If you can't control this power, you can also change your own good luck to bad luck
If you can't control this power, you can also change a foe's bad luck to good luck
If you are really lucky in your life, people may get suspicious

name: Vortex Punch
description: Make a fist and directly in front of the fist all surrounding matter (except user) is sucked violently toward that specific point till user stops or till 250,000 lbs. Is reached within the ball that is compressed to a quarter's size. This can be kept for as long as the user has his hand in a fist, once released the matter violently returned to it's former density in an explosion (that is directed away from user by controled release. All living things contained within are reduced to meat soup.
summary: The ability to make quarter sized balls of up to 250,000 lbs.
strengths: Can take many opponents at once
Can use with both hands
Can be used as defence against bullets, missiles,... Etc.
weaknesses: Can only use as many as user has hands at a given time
Hands become basically useless except for punching since already In a fist.
May be harmful to other members in party

name: Paper Falsification
description: To use this power, you just have to write down on a sheet of paper, a card, a badge or any writable support the heading of the forgery, such as "Passport", "Police" or "Contract". Anyone who reads it will believe it to be genuine. Additional contents, such as the object of a "contract" or the identity of a person on a "passport", are optional but adds to the realism of the forgery. Furthermore, the effect is carried on if the inscription is scanned, photographed, filmed or photocopied.
summary: The ability to make anyone believe some written material is genuine.
strengths: You can easily falsify any official paper.
You can make people believe someone else is the writer or the owner of a paper.
You can make anyone believe false facts about you, such as your identity, your job, your side,...
weaknesses: People have to at least read the heading of a paper for your power to affect them.

name: Flinching Invulnerability
description: In old platformers, you sometimes turn invincible when you get hit. A person with this power basically has this power in real life. When they flinch, they become invulnerable for a few seconds and attacks will go through them. While not as useful as true invulnerability, this power is nevertheless useful in increasing its users survivability. In addition, this power works the instant you flinch, and you can move while invulnerable allowing you to learn how to flinch at specific triggers.
summary: The ability to be invulnerable and semi-intangible for a few seconds after you flinch
strengths: Two for flinching--fails to affect you
Immune to multiple hits--since you would flinch then get out of the way while invincible
Can be bulletproof if you flinch the moment you hear the gunshot
weaknesses: Invulnerability only happens for a few seconds and you blink at those times
Simple to use but hard to master---who can teach you how to flinch correctly?

name: Healer 3: Strength Restoration
description: When this power affects someone with muscular deterioration, their strength is restored to it's former level instantly and permanently. This does not recover muscle lost to lack of activity. As a benefit for you, you gain the same amount of strength.
summary: The ability to restore the lost strength of others and gain strength for yourself.
strengths: Range of 25 kilometers, increasing a meter each year of possession. Can be turned of at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain the strength too.
weaknesses: You cannot restore muscle lost to lack of physical activity, unless extreme.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Artistic Replication
description: You can draw, paint, sculpt, whittle, etc. anything you see or have seen. Includes signatures and such.
summary: The ability to recreate what you see / have seen through artistic medium
strengths: If you get mugged, you can draw an accurate picture of him.
Become a famous artist.
Forge anything from the Mona Lisa to your boss' signature.
weaknesses: Won't help in a fight.
Can't recreate original fantasy art since it applies only to things you've seen.
If you don't remember what it looked like well enough, you can't recreate it.

name: Ultimate Vaccination
description: With this power you can gain immunity to anything if you inject some of it into you. So if you inject yourself with alcohol you will never be able to get drunk again. If you inject yourself with a virus you will immune to that virus. If you inject yourself with coffee, it will never be able to keep you awake and active again.
summary: The ability to be immune to the effects of something if you inject yourself with it
strengths: You can be immune to anything
weaknesses: Once you inject yourself you will always be immune to that thing

name: Encouraging Voice
description: Have your voice be the most inspiring and encouraging yet with this power. Perhaps your mother is depressed over her divorce; with this power the user can encourage her and she will be filled with joy. If you use this power used wrongly, she may be depressed even more.
summary: The ability to encourage any whom needs it.
strengths: Be like Martin Luther King Jr. , inspire anyone!
weaknesses: If used wrongly, the power will backfire, discouraging anyone.

name: Social Engineering
description: With this power you can manipulate large number of people through verbal persuasion and deception without a failure.
summary: The ability to influence social behaviors and attitudes
strengths: Can make people believe in the unbelievable
Can establish relationships with an ease
Can rule the world and beyond
weaknesses: Can't use when your mouth is shut
Is immoral!

name: Humanity Separation
description: This ability was actually made to prevent near-death situations, but now, with the proper training, it can be used in more ways than one. When you separate, your body will be in atomized pieces, your spirit will travel as a ball of light, and your mind will travel in brain-waves. Eventually, you'll have to come back together, so before you split up, think of a location. Then, all your pieces will return at that spot. You can do this to anyone else as well.
summary: The ability to split oneself or others into their mind, body, and spirit.
strengths: Good escape plan.
Different form of transportation.
weaknesses: I don't know if this ability is good for fighting yet.

name: Evil Eye
description: To know what true intentions of your enemies your eyes glow Dark Red, this ability allows you to see if a person's a cheater, swindler, rapist, or some other vile fiend.
summary: The ability to see what sinful person has done in the past, present, and/or future.
strengths: Criminals might fear you.
weaknesses: Never try to use your power on National TV.

name: Hibernation (Enemy's Hand)
description: Simply put, if an enemy attacks you, your power reflects their force back on them and it forces them into a hibernation state. They go to sleep and their systems are reduced to a slower pace. Depending on the power they use, they will be in hibernation for as little as minutes or as much as a year.
summary: The ability to force any enemy into a hybornation state.
strengths: You can use this ability to gain time to carry out complicated plans.
This power is often used instinctively so you're never ambushed from behind.
You won't kill anyone so this power makes capturing really easy
weaknesses: You must be attacked before this power can work.
Immortals, Demons, and Time changers are immune to this power. If you use this power on someone,,,,,
With the same power you could get caught in a recoil effect and trap eachother in hibernation 4 ever

name: Spl Mimicry 1: Ability Chain
description: Once you gain this power, you gain all of the powers in your profile. If you lose this power, you retain your acquired powers. Your powers are not mimicked from another source, but now legitimate. Unfortunately, you must gain this power legitimately or through others in this series for it to work. Luckily, once you gain one in the series, you gain all of them. No power can eliminate this power's cons.
summary: The ability to gain your profile powers.
strengths: Gain all of your powers in real life.
Gain all other powers in this series, whether you possess them or not.
The powers are legitimate and not dependent on this one.
weaknesses: Must be legitimate or acquired through possession of other powers in this series.
You must get an opportunity to gain a power of your choice for this to be useful.
Serves no use on it's own; you must have a profile on the Superpower List.

name: Shock An Awe
description: When you use this ability, you can slam your fist into the ground causing a shockwave, that stuns any person, group or any piece of technology, in a 1-mile radius for 10 seconds. You cannot stack the time and you must wait for the full 10 seconds before using the power again.
summary: The ability to make a shockwave stunning a person, group or technology for 10 seconds
strengths: Stuns people for 10 seconds
Disables technology for 10 seconds
Stuns up to a 1-mile radius
weaknesses: Cannot stack the time
Must wait for a full 10 seconds before using again
Only works in a 1-mile radius

name: Backseat Driving
description: With this power you can control any vehicle you are in contact with like it was part of you body as long as you are touching it or touching something (other than the ground) that is touching it. You could surf behind your boat and be the driver at the same time but if you let go of the rope you'd have to swim back to the boat yourself
summary: The ability to control any vehicle you are in contact with without touching the controls
strengths: Con take control if driver is unconcious, drunk or unfit to drive
Can show off on your way to work "surfing" on top of your car
If kidnapped can drive from trunk or cargo area
weaknesses: People can't stop you if you are drunk
It's dificult to see where you are going from the trunk
Car has all the limits it would if you were at the wheel

name: T Vkinesis
description: With this power, you can go into the television shows you love and be a part of the show, completly changing the plot as you know it.
summary: The ability to go into television shows or movies.
strengths: Everyone thinks the show was originally made the way it was while you were in it.
You will look like the characters in the show. E.g. If it's a cartoon, you will be animated.
You can take stuff from the show with you back into the real world.
weaknesses: You could get killed in the show and no one will know you.

name: Faith Induced Abilities
description: Conditional awesomeness! This power gives you all the powers people believe you to have. If they believe that you have super strength then you do--on the other hand if they believe that you are extremely weak then you will be
summary: The ability to have all the powers people believe you to have
strengths: You can be a god if others believe you are
You can be an invincible hero as long as people believe you are
You can be anything if people believe you are
weaknesses: If people don't believe in you, you lose your powers and turn into a loser
If people believe you can shoot rainbows from your armpits or the like
If someone says that they don't believe you, you will be paralyzed when they are saying it

name: Neatness
description: In your presence, things are put away,cleaned, dusted, you name it, in your presence.  But just because everything is cleaned doesn't mean you are organized (can't find a folder,etc.)
summary: The ability to have things cleaned in your presence.
strengths: Everything is neat.
weaknesses: You may not be organized.

name: Rainbow Forcefields
description: You can create rainbow that act like something telekinetic. You can move stuffwith it, use them as shileds etc.
summary: The ability to moves things with your hands or mind and create force shields that look like rainbows
strengths: You can block hits
You can move people around
You can use your powers to clean up
weaknesses: The shield don't last that long
Powers become out of control when you are angry
You can lose your powers if you don't use by the time you turn 18

name: Skill Reversal
description: Reverse another super human's power
summary: The ability to reverse other's powers
strengths: May increase team mate's power
May weakens enemy's power
weaknesses: May weaken team mate's powers
May strengthen enemy's powers
Lasts fifteen minutes

name: Attractive Pheromone Release
description: What can I say not only are you a babe magnet but you're bettering the babes that are attracted to you and the effects are maintained until the user wants it to stop. When this occurs, the women returns to its normal self. And this is used with extreme ease and no time at all.
summary: The ability to make selected women be greatly attracted to you and enlarging the women "features"
strengths: Hotter women
Hotter women love you
Stays until the user decides to stop pheromones
weaknesses: None

name: Turbo Superhuman Fighter
description: You'll be fighting like Goku or a Street Fighter. Deliver a 1000 lightning kicks at once or a bullet time punch that has the effect of a shotgun or rocket jump in the air & crash down creating a devastating earthquake with your fist. Even creating a powerful blast of air with a punch. You defy fighting physics.
summary: The ability to be a superhuman fighter
strengths: Kick ass turbo style
weaknesses: You have to control your strentgh or you'll accidentally injury someone

name: Endeavor
description: With this ability, you can make someone feel your pain. They feel excactly the same pain as you do. However, you still also feel the pain, and you must be concentrating on that person to activate this ability. They must also be within eyesight.
summary: The ability to make someone feel your pain.
strengths: Show someone how you feel about your pain.
Also works with forms of stress, or mental conflict.
weaknesses: Cannot show them why you feel that way, if it is stress / mental pain.
It can really hurt someone to give them your pain.

name: Power Clothes
description: The powers put into the clothes can be any power that the user of this power currently has. The user of this power cannot put anything too powerful into the clothing such as Self-Existence Manipulation, Power of Imagination, Con Negation, Death Touch, etc. Anyone who can wear the article of clothing can use the power it has. 1 power per article of clothing.
summary: The ability to put powers into clothes
strengths: The user keeps the power they put in the clothing because a copy is put in the article of clothing.
Can be any power the user has except thos mentioned in description and con 2.
weaknesses: Power can be used by anyone who can wear the article of clothing.
Omnipotence, omniscience, etc. Nothing too powerful. Ask if you aren't sure.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers do not work on this power.

name: Muscle Programming
description: Normally, we control our muscles using our subconscious mind. This ability forges a sort of connection between the conscious and subconscious mind. By using visualization, programmers can set a series of action for their muscles to do. After doing this, and then activating their ability, the user's body will go into a sort of auto-pilot,like trance. They will carry out whatever actions they programmed in before.
summary: The ability to program your muscle to perform certain actions.
strengths: During auto-pilot, you will move with more balance and agility than moving normaly.
You'd have more control over your body than others
weaknesses: At first, breaking out of your trance before it's finished will be nearly impossible.
But with practice, you will be able to do this easily.

name: Acid Rays
description: With this power you can shoot a beam that can corrode anything from the palms of your hands. You can melt through skin, stone, metal, wood and other strong materials.
summary: The ability to shoot beams that corrode anything from your hands
strengths: You can shoot beams that can melt through anything from the palms of your hands
The beams can melt through even the toughest materials
You can shoot the beams out of both of your hands
weaknesses: You might melt your own skin

name: Samson's Strength
description: Samson was a sort of biblical superhero who could basically call down the powers of the Lord to turn himself into a hurricane of ass kicking. At one time, he used the jawbone of an ass to kill 1,000 Philistines who had been sent to capture him. The weakness of his ability, however, was that it came from his hair. The longer it was, the more strength he gained. Samson was eventually betrayed and made powerless when his hair was cut off in his sleep.
summary: The ability to draw incredible strength and power from your hair.
strengths: Gain awesome strength
Become nigh-invincible in combat
weaknesses: You have a prominent weakness

name: Induced Agony
description: This ability works by stimulating the pain receptors in the body. It affects everything within a 12-foot radius. This power can be turned on and off. With great concentration, focus and mastery over this ability, the user will be able to induce agony in a target over great distances.If used too much the ability will backfire and cause you pain or turn on and off without control.
summary: The ability to cause those around you to feel extreme pain.
strengths: Opponents won't know what hit them.
Good for close combat and crowd control.
