strengths: Your basically the ultimate good guy and hero.
Your fully capable of inspiring and uplifting people to be better, act better, and do better.
Provides you the capacity to stay calm, cool, & collected in any situation you find yourself in.
weaknesses: Finding yourself at odds with people who don't share your point of view.
Most corrupt or evil individuals definitely hating your because of this superpower.
Doesn't provide you any other superhuman powers or abilities.

name: Vampiric Aura
description: You have an aura that steals life-force from other living beings. You can then use that stuff to reverse age, heal, stop aging, etc. Anything that has to do with life can be done. Restoring life to others takes tremendous amounts of stolen life however even with a body to put the life into.
summary: The ability to have an aura that steals life
strengths: You can live as long as there are other life forms.
You can be whatever age you want.
You can restore life to others
weaknesses: You must have other life forms near you.
No one will want to approach you (but Immortals don't mind; they have infinite life-force to give)
If you can't turn this power off for some reason when you need to.

name: Suspended Division
description: When you knock over a glass, it hits the ground and shatters, right? Not any more! With this power, you can postpone when an object will break. You may knock over a glass, but when it lands it will be intact. You can then decide when it will shatter. When you stab or injure someone, it leave no initial mark or wound, but when you decide the wound will appear, the breaking action will occur. This happens to anything that breaks, tears, evaporates, breaks up etc, any action that divides an object
summary: The ability to postpone the breaking up of an object
strengths: Postpone accidental and deliberate breakages caused by you.
Stab someone, then use your power as blackmail.
Object remains intact until you so desire.
weaknesses: It only works with things you break, not anyone else.
Some get suspicious when water won't evaporate, cheese is uncuttable and food is indigestible.
You don't need to say anything, so just thinking about an object breaking might be enough.

name: Color Change
description: With this power you can change the color of anything you want. The change is permanent if what the change is done on is wanted by the person or the item's owner.
summary: The ability to change the color of any item or person to any other color
strengths: You can be any color you want.
You can make others any color they want to be.
weaknesses: No true combative use.
Only affects colors, nothing else.
Color changes are only superfluous at worst.

name: Coin Flip Of Truth
description: With this power you can ask any true or false, yes or no question and flip a coin to know the answer. Heads is true or yes and tails is no or false.
summary: The ability to know the answer to any yes or no question by fliipping a coin.
strengths: Pass test with little to no studying
Know if someone is lying to you
Always win the coin toss by asking an easy question
weaknesses: Need a coin
Only yes or no questions

name: Waterisation
description: You can use this power to make anything within a 5 mile radius into water but you won't be turned into water , although if you learn to control it you can turn youself into water. When you lose concentration everything will go back to its origional form unless its water.
summary: The ability to turn everything around you into water
strengths: Water!
Never be thirsty
Really win a fight with this
weaknesses: Its just water
As soon as you lose concentration everything turns back
If you can't swim then learn. Now!

name: Immortal Slayer
description: Basically you can kill anything that has eternal life, or general invincibility, simply by touching it, and it stays dead.
summary: The ability to kill immortals
strengths: Defeat any super powerfull characters that try to play the "invincibility" card. "
Kill vampires, werewolves, zombies, ghosts, etc. Simply by touching them
weaknesses: Does not work on anything mortal.
You have to come into physical contact with the immortal.

name: Cellular Regain
description: If there is one thing I learned about superpowered heroes (and villains) is that, without their powers, they are almost nothing. So, that is why I made this ability so that, if that actually happens, Cellular Regain would kick in and will return that person's ability to fight once again.
summary: The ability to not lose your other abilities if someone or something drains it.
strengths: You'll never lose your powers.
If the opponent who is draining you holds on, they will either explode or burn out.
This ability works  with inner energy, blood,and genes as well.
weaknesses: You'll never lose all your dangerous powers.
Your opponent could be more powerful if they hold on.
Your opponent could mutate into the form of your powers forever by 20% chance.

name: State Of Zero
description: Attacks, willpower, strength, ability, thoughts, anything can be reset to a point of zero with this power. Enough said.
summary: The ability to reset anything to a point of zero
strengths: No one can take action against you since all their actions return to a point of zero
If you kill someone, their death state is also turned to zero, causing an infinite death loop
This power is very broken
weaknesses: You cannot prevent aging since it will reset your age to zero(You die)

name: Bone Claws
description: The bone claws are unbreakable and they can cut through anything. So if you are a good guy you can tear someone's face up. If you are a bad guy you can cut into a bank vault. But there is a catch. if you don't have a healing ability you will have a lot of scars. Also, it will hurt really really badly (you'll get used to it).
summary: The ability to make unbreakable bone claws come out of your saces between your knuckles
strengths: Looks wicked cool
They are unbreakable
Can cut through anything
weaknesses: It hurts
Takes a while for skin to heal

name: Perspectivation
description: You can make people see the cause for revenge against someone, or make the reason clear why you like something, or someone. Basically people would know how you feel about a situation.
summary: The ability to make people understand things the way you see it.
strengths: Could gain allies from people who understand.
Assure someone of something you're gonna do.
Make someone know a decision's reason, but not when you change your mind.
weaknesses: People will know exactly what you feel, so you can't lie.
May make people hate you for the way you see something.
Hard to control and may allow people to predict your decisions.

name: Love Nerd
description: This ability know what turns on anyone. This ability will make you never fail with the ladies or men. You just think of someone in an affectionate way and you'll know exactly what attracts them. Although that's all it does, it only makes people attracted to you when your doing the things they like.
summary: The ability to know what attracts anyone
strengths: Never fail with a lover.
Always know what people like in other people.
weaknesses: Doesn't really help you with bad guys
There not really attracted with the real you.

name: Spirit Helper
description: With this power you get a spirit helper. A spirit helper is a ghost like thing that can go inside of you and sort of possess you though you both can control your body. While the spirit is in you, you are stronger, fast and can fly. You are also immune to mind control, telepathic and psychic based attacks and powers due to you having multiple personalities in your body. You also cannot be possessed by an evil spirt even if your spirit is not inside of you. Your spirit can also only possess you.
summary: The ability to have a spirit helper/sidekick
strengths: You have a spirit helper
You are stronger, faster, can fly and are immune to psychic, telepathic and mind control attacks
You cannot be possess by another spirit even if your spirit helper is not inside of you
weaknesses: Your spirit helper can take full control of your body but only in extreme cases
If you die your spirit helper can take control of your body (not necessarily a bad thing)

name: Wolf Hybrid
description: If you are a wolf hybrid you would be part human, part wolf. You would have mostly the bone structure of a human, but your skull might be shaped more after a wolf's. You would have most (or all) of a wolfs abilities.
summary: The ability to be part wolf and gain part (or all) of a wolf's abilities
strengths: You would have a much farther developed sense of smell
You could jump far and run at great speeds
You would have the nails (and the teeth if your face is like a wolfs) of a wolf.
weaknesses: Your ability can't 'turn off' it would be a perminent part of your chemical make-up
You would be furry and have a tail. (though in some cases considered adorable)
You would have a much higher temper, it would be easy to anger you

name: Card Stack Abilities: Ace
description: Access the powers of the elemental spirit of consciousness and control the spiritual realm. You can turn your physical body into an astral one and possess creatures. Break through the toughest mental bariers and rewrite the memories and personalities of your enemies. If your feeling particularly nasty, rip out the spirit of a creature and decide whether or not you want to give it back its body. Summon spirits of the dead back into their former bodies and control them.
summary: The ability to have complete control over the spiritual realm
strengths: Saying hello to your great great great grandfather whenever you want.
Possess people and make them do whatever you want
Avoid physical injury by switching into an astral form.
weaknesses: A spirit binder or ghost hunters
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Pencil Based Powers.
description: This power allows you to turn your entire body into a mixture of metal and wood for defense and still have the same freedom of movement you had before. For creation you can produce diamond-hard lead spikes and projectiles out of your body and you can create black shapes of objects as if they had been drawn. For deletion you can create a pink rubber material that absorbs forces or energy (which you can reshape) or create a pink energy that breaks apart atoms.
summary: The ability to have a metal/wood body and have powers based on creation and deletion.
strengths: Have a metal / wood body.
Can produce lead weapons and black drawings that act like the real thing.
Can make rubber barriers and pink energy that deletes objects.
weaknesses: Takes more power and control to use black drawings and pink energy.
The black drawings are not as strong as the real things.
The pink energy works slowly unless you concentrate a lot of power in one area.

name: Lydian Tunic
description: When activated, the Lydian Tunic can glow light green & illuminated, can use it to put a force field around yourself which causes projectiles to be redirectly move back at your opponent, can block all kinds of attacks, but it can be extremely light and/or very heavy for someone else to use. Pretty effective against weapons of any kind.
summary: The ability to use it to have defensive invulnerable protection.
strengths: It could grant you extreme durability & enhanced strength.
weaknesses: It can be harmed by dark magic or even psychic attacks.

name: Gaze Of The Mischief
description: The toughest warriors, the coldest women, none are left behind by the gaze. All and truly all within the gaze commence to misbehave as soon as you activate your gaze. Thieving, fighting, childish behaviour and naughty actions will be unavoidable. Be warned the effects are temporary and if you use it to much on someone, they will become devious forever.
summary: The ability to make anyone within your sight misbehave and be naughty.
strengths: No need to fight, just look at some people and flee while your enemy is destracted.
All are effected so don't be surprised if one who is normally far to serious becomes a grown child.
The gaze is only temporary, when used in moderation the subjects are returned to their normal state.
weaknesses: People might want to kill you while under the gaze.
People who are recovered could hold you responsible for their deeds.
People who are hit by the gaze multiple times a day will experience side effects.

name: Tactile Career Match
description: With this superpower, you instantly know what the perfect job is for any person you meet just by shaking their hand. You don't need to know anything about them, not even their name. Just by shaking their hand you instatly match their skills to the perfect occupation or career. However, it doesn't work on yourself.
summary: The ability to instantly match any person to their perfect career
strengths: You'd make a great career advisor
You're always 100% correct
You could make a lot of money with this power
weaknesses: It doesn't work on yourself
You can't switch it off
Some people might not be happy to hear they're in the wrong job

name: Tag
description: There are some people who are so charismatic that they are universally loved. And then there's that one guy who everone hates. Tag excites these general feelings around a person you designate, amping them up to the point where they either beat him mercessily or they deify him.
summary: The ability to make a person loved or despised by touching them
strengths: Help someone out who deserves it
Beat someone down who deserves it
Cause a distraction
weaknesses: Temporary
Cannot be used on yourself
Person who is touched feels a small shock

name: Numbing Point
description: With this power you can cause a person's entire body to become numb just by pointing at them. You can not limit the numbing effect to certain parts of the body and the victim only stays numb while you're pointing at them.
summary: The ability to cause a person's entire body to become numb as long as you're pointing at them
strengths: You can make people numb by pointing at them
weaknesses: You can not limit the effect to certain parts of the victim's body
They only remain numb while you're pointing at them
It happens whenever you point at someone

name: Catharsis
description: Also called Purgation or Purging, this is the ability to purge the body of all ills at will. All the user needs to do is inhale deeply, and when he breathes out, any bodily impurities are sublimated (changed into a gas) and released from the body. One with this ability can breathe out viruses, bacteria, stresses (stress-inducing hormones) or the like. This improves the speed of recovery from sickness, or even inflict said impurity on others.
summary: The ability to breathe out impurities
strengths: Breathe out all your stresses, diseases and viruses at will
Helps speed up healing process
Inflict the exhaled impurities on others
weaknesses: Cannot breathe out stresses until they build up immensely
Aniothability can allow user to resist being afflicted with exhaled stresses
Immunity can allow user to resist being allficted with exhaled diseases/viruses

name: Antithesis Mimic
description: With this power, you can become the antithesis of anyone you meet. For example, if you meet a super lazy person, you can use this power and become a super smart and organized version of the same person and vice-versa. If you copied someone while they were weak but they later became strong, you can access both versions of the same person. You have limited control over the copied person's personality. Copying a hero will turn you into an anti-hero, and if not careful, a villain.
summary: The ability to become the antithesis of any person or being you know
strengths: This power can show people their possibilities
Limited disguise since you look the same (most of the time) but have different strength/control
weaknesses: You also have the good attributes reversed too-if you copy a good person you will become evil/darker
The antithesis can only copy powers that a person had at the time that you met them

name: The Strength Of Goodwill
description: The more goodwill people feel towards you, the stronger, tougher and faster you become. Distance is not a factor. There is no limit to how many people or to whether or not they are human. Billions of intelligent beings in the universe means a billion times amplification for your powers.
summary: The ability to be more powerful through the goodwill of those who believe in you.
strengths: Near infinite speed, toughness and strength.
weaknesses: Mr. Lonely. No time off. Billions of people who want help.
Must maintain a perfect public image at all times.

name: Punch Invulnerability
description: Whenever you get punched, it leaves no damage or pain.
summary: The ability to be invulnerability to punches
strengths: Great in fight
weaknesses: Doesn't help if you get kicked
Bad wrestler
Mostly useless

name: Focus Attraction
description: Focus Attraction is the ability to select someone and centre their focus on yourself or an object, causing them to be obsessed with the object as long as you hold concentration.
summary: The ability to attract all focus on to something.
strengths: Can stop someone from attacking by changing their focus.
Cause someone to be obsessed with you or someone else.
While they're focused you can attack them and they will not respond as long as you hold it.
weaknesses: Not offensive.
Only affects one person at a time.

name: Transformation: Sticky Thing
description: The user is able to transform his or her form into a translucent , liquid sticky substance that can stop any projectile, like bullets or medium velocity projectiles that are thrown by enemies.
summary: The ability to change his or her whole body into a sticky substance
strengths: A good defensive power
The sticky substance can be used to ensnare enemies
weaknesses: Might get ridiculed by the public

name: Children Of The Virus
description: You are Child of the Virus. You have a razor sharp tongue. You also have sharp claws that are coated with the virus. You don't get nutrition from regular food, but you feed off people. Every person you infect you feed off of their life force psychically until it runs out. There is no limit to people you can infect. The more people you infect the stronger you get. Also those that are infected have to do whatever you say. If you get hurt you can heal by eating your infected's life force.
summary: The ability to infect people by scratching them or cutting them with a whip-like tongue, and control the infected
strengths: Be invincible by infecting many
Slice enemies in half with your long toungue
Heal yourself by eating a large amount of your infected's life force
weaknesses: Basically you have to slowly kill people to live and become strong
You have to come into contact with someone to infect them

name: Fighting Words
description: Any combat-related word that you use (like punch, kick, jump, etc.) will affect your foe in the way that you speak ('kicked' people will feel as though they were kicked, etc.); this is awesome, but can also be a downer; you can't control it, or turn it off or on; so you are stuck with it for life. ANY combat word you say will affect people (unless you direct it at a certain person, it'll affect everyone in radius).
summary: The ability to use your words to fight
strengths: Doesnt take a lot of energy
Only have to say words
Good to have big mouth
weaknesses: If you go hoarse it doesnt work
Cant turn it off
Doesn't work if you cant pronounce the word

name: Sacrificial Superiority
description: At will the user's speed, strength, and dexterity multiply. It can be done only a little (x2) or a lot (x10). However much the user powers up, though, is the level of strain on their bodies. Unless they are very seasoned in this ability then the higher levels, such as x10 or higher, can kill them if they use it for too long. The most famous user of this ability was none other than King Arthur, who, according to legend, once successfully used x20 in combat.
summary: The ability to enhance your speed, strength, and dexterity at the cost of physical strain
strengths: The user's overall performance can multiply well beyond normal measures.
weaknesses: A strain on the body; lower levels barely wind the user, though higher levels may cause injury.

name: Non Fractal Invulnerability
description: Kinetic damage from non-fractal matter has no effect on you.
summary: The ability to be immune to any non-fractal kinetic damage.
strengths: Nigh invulnerability to most kinetic attacks.
weaknesses: Fractal damage could still cut you to ribbons.

name: Blade Edge Rotating
description: The result of rotating the edge of the blade is that it can cut through objects more easily than a normal blade. A side effect is that the rotating edge also gains molecular teeth like what is on a saw. The rotation goes around the sharp edge then before it reaches the hilt at the handguard it completes the circuit so that no molecules or atoms are lost from the blade.
summary: The ability to cause the edge of a blade to spin like a chainsaw
strengths: Makes it several times easier to cut through things.
weaknesses: Noone can see or hear anything different so it appears as if nothing is happening until you cut.

name: Alphabetical Name Based Powers
description: If you had this power, and went to the superpowerlist.com, and clicked the "explore" button, and clicked "A-Z", and found the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name, then you would have thet power. For example, my name is "Niko", so I would get "Nightmare Manipulator" because that's the closest superpower to my name alphabetically.
summary: The ability to get the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name on the superpowerlist.com
strengths: Might get an awesome power
weaknesses: Might get a stupid power

name: Soulerite (Diamond Metal)
description: Pure Soulerite is as hard as diamond and also boosts the power of soul-based powers. Alloys that are at least 50% Soulerite have the hardness and the effectiveness of the boost is at least one-fourth that of pure Soulerite. In an alloy with less than 50% Soulerite, the alloy will retain the hardness but lose the boost to soul-based powers. If the percentage of Soulerite becomes less than 40% though the alloy's toughness will start to drop fast.
summary: The ability to create and control a metal that has the hardness of diamond
strengths: Soulerite is really hard to break and can be turned into weapons.
weaknesses: Making alloys of Soulerite can be ineffective.
10% Soulerite in an alloy is not much better than steel.

name: Alien Language Translator
description: With this power you can translate any alien language. This is useful is you're trying to talk to aliens in order to make peace or just to make conversation.
summary: The ability to translate any alien language
strengths: You can talk to any aliens
weaknesses: Only works with aliens you don't necessarily know all the languages of your planet
Doesn't work with animals

name: The Perfect Werewolf
description:
You transform into a werewolf at night but you can use some of your abilities as a human. 

- As a human: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Sensing Danger
- As a werewolf: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Claws, Fangs, Sensing Danger, Resistance to Injury

Since you have the body of an animal, pretty much anything can kill you, but it takes a while for someone to do so because of your resistance to injury
summary: The ability to be the perfect version of a werewolf.
strengths: Can turn into a werewolf on any night (not just a full moon).
weaknesses: Anything can kill you (swords, guns, etc. ).

name: Nth Metal
description: Nth metal is one of the magical metals. Nth metal appears very similar to gold but is infinitely more valuable. That means it can be manipulated through thought-waves. So after creating it you can will it into armor, weapons, cloths with enth thread,or almost anything else you can imagine. You can fly with Nth metal boots. Also it can absorb magical energy. The metal will only respond to its owner so unless you give or sell it the metal will only serve you.
summary: The ability to create Nth metal
strengths: You can create one of the magical metals
The metal is nearly indestructable and extremely valuable
You can move and reshape it with your will
weaknesses: Creating Nth metal is very hard and tiring
It can only absorb magical energy not expel it
You can't create the other magical metals

name: Power Backup Ability
description: If you have this power, every 24 hours this power will make a backup of itself and any other powers you have. These backups will remain dormant until you permanently lose a power through some sort of power negation or some sort of power theft. As soon as that happens, a dormant backup will awaken and your lost power will be restored. Dormant backups are undetectable and can't be stolen or negated or altered due to an active version working.
summary: The ability to make copies of your own powers so you can't lose them.
strengths: No fear of power thieves or power nullifying if you plan things right.
It works with any number of powers.
weaknesses: It takes time to build up a good number of backups.
This power can be altered or controlled without triggering a backup to awaken.
Power thieves and power nullifiers will join together to get you.

name: Quick Bridge
description: With this power whenever there is a gap that you can't cross (or you can cross it doesn't really make a difference) you can make a bridge appear that is the exact length of the bridge and that is strong enough to hold any amount of people/vehicles/animals/other stuff. After you and your party cross the bridge you can make it disappear again.
summary: The ability to make a bridge appear over any gap
strengths: You can make bridges appear
The bridges can hold an infinite amount
You can make the bridges disappear when you're done
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Odd Evening
description: Not only does this ability allow you to compute probability to a certain degree, it gives you some power over it. If you fall from a great height and there is a chance that you will live, no matter how small, you can even the chances between life and death, making it 50/50. Further probabilities, such as breaking bones vs. not breaking bones, require further concentration. You can seriously improve your chances in any situation, but it will always come down to a toss-up.
summary: The ability to make all outcomes of an event equally likely to occur
strengths: Can even all possible outcomes instantly
Can even influence people's thoughts by evening their likelihood to make a certain decision
Make bullets more likely to misfire
weaknesses: No guarantees that it will work in your favor
Some outcomes must be broken down further

name: Peace Manipulation
description: With this power, you can be the ultimate peace keeper or peace breaker. You can alter how one person or group of people feels about another person or group of people with no restrictions on group size. If you strive for world peace, you can have it. If you're a psycho and strive for world destruction, well, go for it you crazy bastard. One restriction--you can only use this power once every 24 hours, so choose your sides wisely. Works great when you need a good cat fight to cheer you up!
summary: The ability to manipulate the level of peace between one or more people.
strengths: Pit the world against your greatest enemies
You can implant motivations for being on your side
The ultimate war: Bitches vs. hoes
weaknesses: One use per day
A world of peace might be boring and predictable
If the hoes lose the war, all you have left are bitches  :(

name: Dance Of The Dead Marionette
description: Ability to control the actions of others. Can force others to use their superpower. Can control the whole body. The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute. Complete death of a live target in 5 min.
summary: The ability to control the actions of others.
strengths: Works incredibly well on undead/dead.
Allows for full control.
Can control just body parts if you want (ex. Only an arm)
weaknesses: The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute.
Complete death of a live target in 5 min.

name: Organic Deconstruction
description: One can reduce living cells into nothing, and when developed can, in theory, destroy a person, people or any living things. Eventually, and with the will, one can develop the ability to raze entire areas of everything living. If the individual had an emotional bond with someone, had touched them or had a good look at them, then he/she could break them down if they were, for example in a mile range depending on that persons strength. Emotions can effect the strength and range of this ability too.
summary: The ability to break down living things
strengths: Can potentially destroy numerous dangerous people or animals in an instant
Useful in war and law enforcement
Practically invulnerable
weaknesses: Vulnerable while sleeping or unconscious
Would have committed a sin and a crime, and would become an enemy of your country
Will and state of mind affects range and power, could be taken down with long range gunshot

name: Magic Tricks
description: Stage magic and true magic are two different things. This is the bridge between the two. After creating a magic trick, and performing  it successfully, the user will be able to do it for real. Let's say you figure out how to make objects vanish and reappear. After you perform it, you will be able to make objects vanish and appear at will. You must create the trick yourself for this power to kick in.
summary: The ability to gain powers through magic tricks
strengths: Gain great powers of deception
Become one of the greatest performers of all time
weaknesses: Must create the trick for this to work.
Must perform the trick successfully (without anyone seeing how you did it)

name: Stackable Abilities
description: Let's say that you have 2 powers that both give you the side-effect of superstrength. Now you may think that will be useless but with this power it will not be. Now any power that you gain that is similar to an existing power will increase the power and efficiency of both powers and any power related. This power can not be negated or tampered with.
summary: The ability to increase power and control of any existing ability when you gain a similar ability
strengths: Stack all your speed and strength and durability powers to have better power and control
This power can not be negated or tampered with---but your other powers can
Any ability that overlaps with another will increase the overall effectiveness of all connected
weaknesses: Need to have similar abilities first

name: Collective Noun Morph
description: You can become a warfare of hydra,a culture of bacteria,a swarm of nanites,a skynet of cyborgs or a nucleus of physicists. Any collective noun form that exist in a book or on website. When reduced to your last body,you revert to normal,and can't use that lost form for a day. Your collective noun form is average size. Any skills given by it are good but not the best. Some forms aren't allowed. Con negation won't let you use those forms.
summary: The ability to literally become a collective noun for anything alive or that can move itself.
strengths: There are collective nouns to give you mythic,undead,jedi,angelic or other kinds of powers.
You can add your own collective nouns to a website or self-publish a book.
Collective forms can give you new skills
weaknesses: You revert to normal if reduced to one body,and can't use that particular form for a day.

name: Singing Perfection
description: An individual with this ability has a perfect, beautiful, & unbelievable singing voice.
summary: The ability to have a perfect singing voice
strengths: Fame
Fortune
Admiration
weaknesses: Fans Constantly Chasing you
Paparazzi

name: Tattoo Power Seal
description: A person with this power can seal another superhuman's power upon touch by absorbing it into their body. This process creates a tattoo on their body that represents the sealed power. The touching part means either touching the person using the power or having the power come in contact with your skin. Once one of these conditions is satisfied, the user can then take away that power and turn it into a tattoo on their body. The user can also give back the power thus causing the tattoo to disappear.
summary: The ability to seal a person's powers within your own body upon touch by turning it into a tattoo
strengths: Combined with Tattoo Power, this means power stealing
As a bonus, this comes with power negation--if the power is directly used on the user
Can also give back powers to original owners
weaknesses: Will be heavily tattooed if you use this too much
If the other person's power is so powerful that the tatoo can't fit on your body

name: Epic Absorbsion
description: "Eparticals" or epic particals are the substance that makes things epic. You will have the ability to absorb these particals from people or things. The more eparticals you have the more epic your actions become. Turn a punch in to a "EPIC PAWNCH". Or a kick into a "EPIC KICKUH". Bewarned if you absorb eparticals from people they will become less epic. Or if you absorb too many eparticals you will turn into Chuck norris (wait i dont think thats bad).
summary: The ability to absorb "Eparticals"
strengths: Become more epic
Make a epic PAWNCH
Become chuck norris
weaknesses: If you dont like becoming chuck norris

name: Unpredictable Time  Boost
description: This ability, if you know the time when the boost will hit you, can be useful in almost any situation. The way this work is that it works for different people. When the ability boosts your body it will give you energy, and a boost of speed, strength, and agility. This ability boosts your mind's percentage by 50% and gives a basic telekinetic ability when the time comes. When the ability boosts your spiritual side, you'll be more at peace with yourself and able to dodge most hits.
summary: The ability to power up your body, mind, or spirit in different sets of time.
strengths: Very powerful.
Multiple ways to attack or defend yourself.
weaknesses: You might get a different boost than the one you need.
Your boosts will come at different and unpredictable times.

name: Human Maraca
description: It won't activate if you move your body in a normal way, unless it is natural for you to rapidly shake your body of parts of your body. So, just like a maraca, you will make similar shifting and shuffling sounds when you shake any part of your body. It can also activate when you halt fast movements of your body, because your body vibrates shortly before coming to a stop. Running also activates this power because your body is actually shaken up and down.
summary: The ability to make a sound similar to maracas when you shake your body.
strengths: If you forgot to bring your maracas.
It only activates if you shake your body, which you don't usually do if you need to be quiet.
weaknesses: The sound just ruins the mood of oriental booty shakes. Seriously.
You need to analyze in which situations your body shakes. For example, shivering is a body shake.

name: Power Vampire
description: With this power you become a power vampire. You can absorb the life force and energy of any living being gaining vampire like powers including superhuman strength, speed, staminia, durability, healing and senses, immortality, minor shapeshifting, flight, and any traditional vampire powers, abilities, and knowledge. The more life force you absorb the more you crave and eventual with constant absorbtion you will be unable to go without draining someone and go gradualy insane.
summary: The ability to become a power vampire.
strengths: Gain Vampire Powers
Gain minor control over the people you drain
Gain any powers, abilities, or knowledge the person had.
weaknesses: The power weakens the victem(s) and can kill with repeated absorbtion(Bad for a hero)
May be hunted by vampire hunters
Draining the life force from sentiant beings(anything but plants) causing gradual insanity

name: Souls
description: "Souls" is the ability to make dolls come to life and obey your every command (stage 1). Once the power advances, you are able to transfer your soul into any doll (stage 2). The next stage is that you are able to transfer your soul into someone else's body and when you get killed your soul will be set free so you can take control of a new body as your own (stage 3). You can have other people's souls go into other bodies (stage 4).
summary: The ability to control souls.
strengths: Control dolls
Transfer your soul into dolls
Controlling someone
weaknesses: Your energy is drained
You get tired when your doll is destroyed
You see all the dead souls

name: Thriller Dance
description: Everyone knows the iconic Thriller from Michael Jackson. With this power, you can compel zombies within a 60 feet radius and/or within your line of sight to do the Thriller dance. They automatically know the dance and so do you. They recognize you as the main dancer, if you opt to join in. Even works on zombies that are under somebosdy else's control, but does not workon superhumans that used a power to become a zombie.
summary: The ability to compel zombies to do the Thriller dance
strengths: Thriller.
Dancing zombies.
Prevent from being eaten till help arrives
weaknesses: When the dance has ended, you have to 5 minutes to use this power again.

name: Living Powers
description: With this power you cause all of your other powers to come alive and gain a spirit body and personality. The personalities will always have your same goals. The living powers can even teach you how to use the powers better. You can even let a living power take over your body so that it can use the power to its fullest. If the power is negated it will appear as if the spirit is repelled from your body. When the spirit returns so does your power. Affected by all power affecting powers.
summary: The ability to have your other powers come alive.
strengths: The Spirits can aid you to use your powers more effectively.
Mimicry mimics the spirits also but the spirit remains loyal to you.
The spirits can be suppressed when not needed.
weaknesses: Does not work on this power.
You may not like the personality of your power.
Having many powers will cause them all to come alive.

name: Sp: Defensive Presence
description: SP stands for 'Sharing Presence'. With this ability, people in your area are given extra defense against all forms of harm. (Physical, mental, etc. ) In return, you gain the amount of defense given to people by this bonus. For example, if 5 people are in you're area, they gain defense, and you gain their totalled defense. Can be turned off.
summary: The ability to give people around you more defense, and in return you gain the amount of defense given.
strengths: Extremely helpful in fights of all sorts.
Can be turned off.
weaknesses: You may occasionally forget to turn this ability off.

name: Stockpile
description: With this ability, you gain more and more strength over time. By simply not exerting your physical strength, it can stockpile to become dozens of times stronger than usual. This also applies to not using your superpowers. For example, if you don't exert Telekinesis for long enough, you'll be able to move larger things, such as tall buildings.
summary: The ability to become more powerful by not using your strength / abilities.
strengths: Patience is the key.
Doesn't have any negative effect on your strengths.
weaknesses: Patience is the key.

name: Blood Weaponry
description:
By creating a small cut on your body, you can control your blood to create weapons like shuriken and swords to fight with. Depending on the attack used, and whether it is held or not, very little or a lot of blood is used.

However, there is a catch. You can possibly kill yourself by expending too much blood too fast. Draining more then 75% of your blood in an hour will likely pass out unconscious, and your injury will continue to bleed, possibly leading to death by blood loss.
summary: The ability to create weapons made of your own blood.
strengths: Always have a readily available weapon on hand
Weapons are sharp as titanium
Blood can be reabsorbed into body if still in contact with skin
weaknesses: Can lead to death due to too much blood loss
Requires some focus to retain control over blood
Uneffective against vampires and other creatures that feed on blood

name: Jeweled Tears
description: Your tears will literally turn into jewels when you cry. They can be sapphires, rubies, diamonds, emeralds, etc. The size of the jewels are the same as the tears.
summary: The ability to create rare jewels by crying
strengths: You can get lots of money by crying a lot.
weaknesses: Tears are generally really small.

name: Dagger Strike
description: With this power you can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands. You have an unlimited amount of dagger and the daggers are sharper than normal daggers, even being able to cut through metal.
summary: The ability to shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
You have an unlimited supply of daggers
The daggers are sharper than normal daggers they can even cut through metal
weaknesses: You might accidentally stab yourself

name: Wanted
description: You can strip someone of all their powers & replace them with the least wanted power on This List. Depending on how many powers they have is the factor of how many most wanted powers you gain.
summary: The ability to make someone have the least wanted powers while you gain most wanted
strengths: Give someone the crappiest powers created
Gain the MVPs (Most Valuable Powers)
weaknesses: Can only gain has many most wanted powers as the # of powers the other person has
Least wanted could become more popular each day

name: Bio Metallic Parasite
description: You can manipulate the (beneficial)parasite's size to make an near-indestructible metal shield or create a slide to prevent a hazardous fall. The parasite will react instinctly when your in harm. Example, someone is about to punch you from behind and the parasite will coil around your enemies arm preventing the punch. The parasite responds to your mental commands so if you think it, you get it.
summary: The ability to manipulate a small piece of metal that lives on  your body
strengths: You will rarely get hurt
Traveling isn't much of a problem
You can make it small enough to prevent you from feeling it
weaknesses: It will tire you easily if you don't  build your endurance
A reflex time may not be quick enough to prevent some attacks
Sometimes the parasite will have a mind of its owns

name: Magi (Magus)
description: When you are a magi you gain the ability to call forth a mystical sword that represents your essence. You also gain acrobatic skills, stronger endurance, and the ability to discharge energy from your body. The "magi blade" is indestructible and can either slice through any object or deflect it. Your sword is easy to call forth although if separated from it you must concentrate to call it back. A magi can also sense the presence of other magi.
summary: The ability to call forth a sword and become a superhuman.
strengths: You may have abilities that other Magi don't have.
Your endurance is extremely high so you can take a lot of punishment.
An energy discharge is much more lethal than a firearm.
weaknesses: You are not the only Magi so there will be rivalry.
Must concentrate to call back sword.
Other Magi can sense when you are near.

name: Ultimate Physical Strength
description: The person that wants this power is either very powerful or a fool. This power grants the user unmatched physical strength but does not grant any of the necessary powers to make it useful. The user is not able to even move without causing a disaster, except by blowing through their mouth. The user remains as brittle as ever, thus their arms can break if not actively repelling anything. Please do not choose this power if you don't have the required secondary powers or it will be your own undoing.
summary: The ability to have unmatched physical strength without the required secondary powers
strengths: No one can beat you in a head-on fight (except yourself)
Your very movements can cause natural disasters
weaknesses: Super Strength does not give you super speed or endurance
You cannot move or else the ground you walk on will become a crater and your foot will be stuck
You cannot even use this power without the required secondary powers

name: The Perfect Vampire
description: A perfect vampire is basically a vampire without all of the stupid weaknesses. Powers: Strength, Speed, Agility, Senses, Healing, and Hypnotism. You have fangs that can be used to pierce the skin of humans to suck blood. The only things that can kill you are getting your head cut off and being set on fire and burning to death.
summary: The ability to be the perfect version of a vampire.
strengths: You can actually walk in the sun.
Crosses, holy water, wooden stakes, and silver DON'T hurt or kill you.
weaknesses: Decapitation (getting your head cut off) kills you.
Incineration (being set on fire and burned) kills you.
Lack of blood will make you tired and dizzy.

name: Polymer Reformation
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Polymerkinesis, but can only break up polymers (and selectively reform them), not control them like a magnet. A person with polymer manipulation can break up any type of polymer within a 7 ft. range and can also selectively reform polymers within a 1 ft. range. Besides manipulating plastics and nylon, the user can also break up the proteins in muscles and reform them, giving them either tougher or more elastic muscles.
summary: The ability to break up synthetic and natural polymers (and reform them)
strengths: You can instantly "recycle" any plastic and change its properties to a certain extent
You can control your own muscles to make it either more elastic or tougher
You can break up muscles or plant tissues at will
weaknesses: Can only reform polymers when less than 1 ft. away
Accidental Clothing Damage if not mastered, also this does not work on metals

name: Human Imprintation
description: You can take the soul of any human and put it in something or someone else. If you put the soul in an inanimate object they will feel the thing as their body and be able to comuniicate through limited telepathy. If you put the soul in someone else, the person will either develop split personality disorder and the other personality will be the souls, or the soul will just be a voice in their head, depending on the willpower of the person
summary: The ability to take the soul of a person and put it in an inanimate object
strengths: Mess with people.
Put bad guys literally, and permanently in jail
You could rule the world
weaknesses: It's permanant and you could regret doing it
It takes time
VERY hard to control

name: Blackened Bone Manipulation
description: If parts of the bone grows outside of the body, the outer area in contact with the air becomes black and near indestructible. The bone feeds of the blood of its enemies, and will become stronger the more blood it absorbs. Another point is that the bone that has been grown outside of the body can be snapped off without pain and used as a weapon. However, this bone becomes weaker than it would normally be. Small shards of bone can be fired from the under side of the wrist.
summary: The ability to grow bones in any area of your body, the bone hardens on contact with the air.
strengths: Any normal broken bone can be replaced by this untill the original has repaired itself.
Almost no limit to the amount of bone than can be grown.
If developed properly, the bone can also be used as a form of armour.
weaknesses: Because of the thirst of blood that the bones have, the owner can become driven crazy by the thirst.
The uncontrollable thirst can sometimes leave the owner open to attacks.
They need blood to survive. If they do not get enough, then they will feed upon the owner's blood.

name: Composing
description: Once this ability is first gained, the user can memorize a song completely the first time the song is heard all the way through. Once this ability has been trained halfway to full strength, hearing the name of a song causes them to memorize every word and note of the song. Once the ability has hit full power (or once the user turns 21, whichever comes first), they've memorized every song in the world and gain a new ability every time a new song is sung all the way through.
summary: The ability to hear the name of a song and immediately know every word and note
strengths: Be a great singer
Never forget words to any song
Become stronger based on other people's songwriting talent
weaknesses: Cannot gain new abilities based on your own songs
Takes years to master this power, even if you are born with it
Really hard power to gain (like one in a million)

name: Parody Power
description: This power requires a good imagination and a good sense of humor. You have to observe what someone's power does. You have to be a 100 feet or closer. You have to think of a parody of the power you're observing. The parody effect last for a hour. Joke powers and cartoon-based powers are immune to this power as is this power itself.
summary: The ability to temporarily change someone's power into a parody version of itself.
strengths: Alter a foe's power and have a laugh at the same time.
A good power if your funny and imaginative.
weaknesses: You are dull-witted.
You choose to read a quantum physics book rather than watch a funny movie.

name: Myth Power: Apheleia's Affinity
description: Apheleia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of simplicity and plainness. As such, channeling her allows one to force subjects to speak bluntly and straightforwardly, with a touch; they will be unable to speak beyond the understanding capability of the least intelligent subject in the room. In addition, when one touches a subject/object, they can instantly learn all of its parts, functions and rules needed to operate. One can even touch a text and psionically reduce it to its simplest terms at will.
summary: The ability to channel Apheleia's command over the essence of simplicity and plainness
strengths: Force subjects to speak plainly and bluntly (make conversation easy to understand)
Psychically learn object/subject's anatomy/parts/functions/operation (Intuitive Aptitude), by touch
Touch a text (written, typed, etc) and psionically reduce it to its simplest/easiest terms
weaknesses: Cannot psionically translate languages (written, spoken, typed, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically reduce/simplify a foe's understanding, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: E Mail Powers
description: With this ability, your e-mails are divided into categories like clothing stores, Junk, and of course superpowerlist. Clothing store mails would give you clothing powers, Junk mail gives you trash control, superpowerlist e-mails give you the power if accepted, rejected ones are corrected to be less overpowered,more orginal (etc.), then given to you.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on e-mails.
strengths: You could get many powers.
weaknesses: No email.
Don't believe in sending or receiving e-mails

name: Compass Corpse
description: You need to have a corpse. Other forms, such as bones or ashes, can be affected once you master this power. By touching the body, you can cause it to signal in which direction their murderer(s) is(are) if there are any. If the deceased was a strong-willed person or at least would have shown some determination to help capture the culprit(s), the body could even move on its own toward their killer(s). This power doesn't discriminate between intentional and accidental killings.
summary: The ability to make a corpse look/point toward their murderer(s).
strengths: Help families get closure by identifying the murderer of their loved one.
Discover on whom you should take revenge for the murder of your loved ones.
Traumatize the culprits by making the corpses move.
weaknesses: The deceased won't be able to perform actions other than indicating who killed them.
You have to touch a dead body.
If you're the culprit and you didn't know it.

name: Movie Projector
description: With this power you can produce any movie that ever appeared in a movie theater onto any flat surface from your eyes. You don't have to have seen the movie but you have to know the name of it and the year it was released in theaters.
summary: The ability to project any movie onto any flat surface from your eyes
strengths: You can project any movie onto any flat surface
weaknesses: It has to have been in theaters
You have to know the name of the film and the year it was released in theaters

name: Power Purge
description: Caution: Since otherwise it would be a real bother, especially if you have too many powers, you can't decide which powers to get rid of. When activated, this power automatically chooses which powers to delete based on how often they were used, how proficient you were in using them, how beneficial they were to you and how long you had them. It only works on powers you own. Depending on the situation, the discarded powers may still get back though. Also, this power is NOT immune to its effect.
summary: The ability to get rid of powers that are of no use to you
strengths: No more dumb powers you only got because you didn't have more time to look and grabbed those!
It automatically cleanses your superpower list for you, saving you the bother of looking though it.
It uses a very careful process based on your past uses of your powers.
weaknesses: It doesn't take into account the future possibilities of your powers.
What if you come across an unlikely situation where a dumb power you had would have been useful?
Remember to use this power often, otherwise it can commit 'superpower suicide'.

name: Invulnerable Eyes
description: With this power you can make your eyes invincible. Your eyes cannot be poked out or become blind. Your eyes also won't hurt if you look at the sun or other bright lights. You also will never get a black eye again. It works on both of your eyes (or all of your eyes if you have more than two) and you can't turn this power off.
summary: The ability to make your eyes invulnerable
strengths: Your eyes are invulnerable
weaknesses: Not an offensive power

name: Shadow Caller
description: This superpower allows you to call upon someone else's shadow. After the shadow has been called upon, it morphs into a demonic-looking plasma-covered dog and it will stand by your side awaiting orders (it can also morph into a darker version of its original body). The side effect of stealing someone else's shadow is that they slowly suffocate and are unable to speak. This power also allows you to become a shadow as well.
summary: The ability to call upon other people's shadows
strengths: Quick and easy to create an army.
Able to hide from foes easily.
weaknesses: You can get stuck as a shadow and eventually die.
If someone's will is strong enough, they can call back their shadow.

name: Immunity Detection
description: Anything immune to your powers is immediately detected. Even if they would normally be immune to such detection, you can still detect them by sensing the absence of information. It is like dark is the absence of light; you cannot see the dark itself, but you can see the lack of light.
summary: The ability to detect people with immunity to your powers.
strengths: You can finally detect those with Beneath Notice.
Find those immune to which powers before you start a fight.
With other powers, you can identify the nature of the immunity.
weaknesses: May pick up normal items (e. G. Will detect normal humans if you have Ability Detection).
Less useful without other powers.
Very limited uses; if something is immune to a power of yours.

name: Horse Control (Horse Mastery)
description: WIth this power you can summon any kind of horse and adjust their size or take control over any horse you see. You can summon giant horse or tiny horses or even medium sized horses. With enough training you will be able to make the horses even bigger and be able to change the sizes of horses that you haven't summoned. You will also be able to control zebras, donkeys, mules and other horse related animals but not summon or size shift them.
summary: The ability to control horses and similar animals
strengths: You can control horses
You can summon horses
You can change the size of horses
weaknesses: Its bad if you're allergic to horses or horse related animals
If you never meet anybody with Karate Zebra you will never be able to use the karate zebra control
Part of this power

name: Induced Insomnia
description: With this power you can cause people to never be able to fall asleep causing them to become weaker, slower and eventually go mad due to lack of sleep. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to cause people to never be able to fall asleep
strengths: You can cause people to never be able to fall asleep
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Blood Monsters
description: With this ability, a red fog appears on you, getting darker as you get angrier. About 3oz of blood work their way out of your body, creating a monster based on your anger, up to 10. These monsters are either Offensive-Scouting, Defensive-Scouting, or in rare cases Offensive-Defensive.
summary: The ability to create monsters from your own blood.
strengths: They are at your command.
weaknesses: If you have no blood to give.
If you are peaceful and calm.
They can be dissapear if you want them to, but can never be unsummoned until mastered.

name: Duplicate Inhabiter
description: With this power you can transfer your consciousness into any clone, robot, statue/wax figure version of yourself and move around in that body. This is useful if your enemy makes an evil clone version of you and takes it back to his base, you can transfer then inhabit the clone and be able to see where the enemy's base is or even fight the enemy as your clone. Or you can build a robot version of yourself and give it powerful weapons and abilities and then transfer your consciousness into it.
summary: The ability to inhabit the bodies of clone/robot/statue versions of yourself
strengths: You can transfer your consciousness into any duplicate of yourself
You don't have to be near the duplicate to inhabit it
weaknesses: If you're real body is destroyed while you're inhabiting a different one you are stuck in that form

name: The Seer Of Horizons.
description: This power is a ability that only manifests in those who are neither good nor evil, hanging onto the threads between both forces. The Seer is able to see far over the hypothetical horizons, thus into the future. An outfit also comes with this, but it changes to fit the user, but the colors will always be faded light blue, grayish white, and dark purple. The user can see just seconds, minutes, hours, even years into the future and even split-seconds. The Seer also obtains a gold crystal ball.
summary: The ability to become the Seer.
strengths: Is almost impossible to sneak up on, if that wasn't already clear.
One can even see over the horizons of other people.
The crystal ball enhances the ability of the Seer.
weaknesses: Sometimes seeing the future isn't always pleasant, you won't always be able to change it.
The user of this power is able to lose it by being influenced by external forces.

name: Builder's
description: These builders are super tiny (i inch) but can do amazing things, they are able to build anything. Literally.
summary: The ability to summon very tiny beings that are the greatest builders.
strengths: Build anything.
weaknesses: They are easily stepped on.
Since they are tiny, they don't get things done fast.
You are able to temporarily able to make them disappear, but not fully until mastered.

name: Laughing Point
description: With this power you can make people laugh just by pointing at them. You can make your enemies laugh uncontrollably during battle distracting them from doing whatever evil thing they were doing.
summary: The ability to make people laugh when you point at them
strengths: You can make people laugh just by pointing at them
You can make sure people always laugh at your jokes
You can distract your enemies
weaknesses: If you don't have any fingers this power is useless
As you stop pointing at them they stop laughing

name: Sertoli Cell Mimicry
description: This power can only be activated if you are a male. As a Sertoli Cell Mimic, you can absorb dead cells from your species, whether they're yours or not, and convert them into nutrients inside your body. Additionally, you can feed other people by injecting them with nutrients stored inside your body. All you need to do is touch them.
summary: The ability to convert dead cells into nutrients and inject your own nutrients inside someone's body through touch.
strengths: You can feed those who can't feed themselves.
You can feed on your own dead cells if you're hungry.
weaknesses: You need to find a large amount of dead cells to produce a decent amount of nutrients.
You have to be a male or be able to become one to use this power.
You can only feed on cells of the same species as yours.

name: Arthropod Armour
description: Chitin is a tough, resilient material; the main component in the exoskeletons of arthropods (invertebrates, like centipedes and lobsters). When this power is activated by triggering a chemical reaction in the skin, a thick layer of segmented chitin grows to encase the user's body. The armour is extremely durable almost to the point of being impenetrable, able to deflect knives and bullets. Repeated attacks will eventually damage the armour, which then must be shed to be removed.
summary: The ability to generate a resilient chitinous substance that envelops the body like armour
strengths: It is almost impossible to be physically harmed when armour is formed
Armour is dense enough to protect the user from explosions and impact damage
weaknesses: Your speed and manoeuvrability is greatly hindered when ability is active
Armour is vulnerable at the joints, much like in crustaceans
Armour does not protect against non-physical damage, such as extreme heat or toxic gasses

name: Snap You're Dead V2
description: With this power you can cause a specific person to die by saying their first and last name and then snapping. If their are multiple people with the same first and last name they will all die unless you add a middle name when you use the power.
summary: The ability to cause people to die by snapping your fingers
strengths: You can kill people by snapping
weaknesses: If multiple people have the same name they will all die

name: Reverse Nature
description: You can reverse the way any part of the human body works. Example: The more someone swallows, the more their mouth fills with spit until they drown. The more someone eats, the emptier their stomach becomes until it devours itself. The more someone urinates, the more their bladder fills until it ruptures.
summary: The ability to reverse the natural course of the human body
strengths: You can kill people
You won't get your hands dirty
You can watch someone die slowly
weaknesses: You can only use one aspect at a time
It might look gross
Killing is not legal

name: Overflow
description: A person with this ability can control the flow of fluids in their own body. They can make blood flow faster so that they can get more energy. They can release adrenaline at will into their bloodstream and skilled users can release a fluid called overflow into their own body, increasing energy output by 100-fold but destroying body cells in the process. Other people without this ability are not benefited by overflow in their bodies but will still have their body cells destroyed.
summary: The ability to control the flow of fluids in the user's body
strengths: Can make yourself stronger and faster anytime you want.
Can pump overflow into enemies so their cells are destroyed.
weaknesses: Can accidentally put overflow into allies.
Most people cannot create overflow in their bodies.
Does not increase fighting capabilities just increases strength and speed.

name: Kickmaster
description: With this power you have a super strong kick. You can break anything with your feet or send enemies flying. Your foot is not invulnerable though unless you're kicking something though.
summary: The ability to have a super strong kick
strengths: You have a super strong kick
You can kick through anything
weaknesses: Your foot is only super strong/invulnerable when you're kicking things

name: Volume Manipulation
description: With this ability, you are able to multiply the volume of an object by the number of powers you posses/created. If you acquired a power you made, you get twice the bonus. Unfortunately, this only works for powers acquired directly from the site, not through other powers.
summary: The ability to increase the volume of an object proportionally to the number of your powers.
strengths: The more power you made or possess, the larger the volume can be.
The object stays the same on the outside and the extra weight is not detected.
Works on any seal able container.
weaknesses: If this is your only power, it is useless (you are multiplying it by 1).
Powers acquired through mimicry do not count.
The cons cannot simply be eliminated by other powers, though other powers will solve the first con.

name: Rise Of The Ursagryph
description: With this power you are able to transform yourself into the mythical ursagryph, a creature that is a combination of a bear and a falcon. In ursagryph mode you can fly, have enhanced strength and agility and you can injure people with your talons or beak.
summary: The ability to turn into an ursagryph
strengths: You can turn into an ursagryph
You can fly and have enhanced strength
You can attack people using your beak and/or talons
weaknesses: People might attack you thinking you're some kind of evil monster from hell or something

name: Supernetics

description: With this power, you can never be full. You either have a bottomless stomach or an insane metabolism: Possibly both. And since it is impossible for you to eat enough, you can never gain weight or suffer from overeating.  You probably also have such an efficient digestive system that you never have to use the bathroom.
summary: The ability to eat as much as you want without getting full or gaining weight.
strengths: You never feel the pain of being way too full.
You always have room to finish eating your food and/or anyone else's.
You can never get fat from eating too much.
weaknesses: Never being full means that you are ALWAYS hungry.
You have a monstrous appetite, which can use up all your money if you are the one feeding yourself.
People are reluctant to feed you because you will eat all their food if given the chance.

name: The Scepter
description: With this power alone you can cause anyone to suddenly get 100 cuts all over their body without actually being cut by making a slashing motion. The depth of each cut is random and can be from. 002 millimetres to 4 centimetres. If you have the powers, 'The Throne' and 'The Crown' as well then you can cause the damage without gesturing.
summary: The ability to cause anyone physical damage by gesturing with one's hand
strengths: You can make anyone go nuts trying to figure out why they're hurt if you have all three powers.
This will seriously hurt anyone it affects.
weaknesses: You can get caught if you don't have the other two powers as well.

name: Potential Unlocking Blood
description: Anyone who drinks your blood will be able to use the full powers that they were born with (but can't use yet) along with all powers of higher leveled beings of their race. Ex: an ordinary vampire could become a daywalker or a kitsune could gain tails to become a nine-tailed fox. Also, if the being has no potential for ESP or magic your blood cannot give them those abilities.
summary: The ability to unlock hidden potential power of others with one's blood
strengths: Allies can now fight at full power.
Works even with a drop of blood. May be a con.
weaknesses: Letting enemies get ahold of vials of your blood.
Will not give powers that a being does not have the potential for.

name: Your Killer Is...
description: With this power whenever you stand within ten feet of a dead body you will instantly know who the killer was (if there was one). If the person died of natural means this power will do absolutely nothing.
summary: The ability to determine who killed a person
strengths: You are able to determine who a person's killer is
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
If the person died of natural means this power does nothing

name: Passover Power
description: Wherever and whenever danger occurs, you change into a large mist that'll not kill, but  to make everyone dose off.
summary: The ability to turn into a mist and put almost every one to sleep
strengths: You might only use this power outside.
weaknesses: Whenever you use this power, you can slip inside building of enemy bases.

name: Pain Transference
description: Passive ability. All pain and injuries that are dealt to you (self inflicted or otherwise) will be transferred to the next person you touch. This ability only works with injuries that will not kill you. It unfortunately works with the sense of pleasure, so apathy is sure to follow.
summary: The ability to transfer all pain and injuries to the next person you touch.
strengths: All fights end with you leaving without a scratch and your opponent bloodied
Feel wronged? Break your arm and shake your enemy's hand.
You feel no pain
weaknesses: You feel no pain, so you might think you're invincible.
Might hurt loved ones. Sorry mom!
Also feel no pleasure. Sucks for you!

name: 0 Blood
description: Every single speck of blood will from the person's body in an instant. Thus they will die of no oxygen after a few minutes.
summary: The ability to instantly destroy all blood in a person's body by touching them and saying, "Die"
strengths: Near instant kill unless target has Bloodless.
10 minutes or so is not enough to replace 50% of the blood in a person's body.
weaknesses: Blood Manipulation can negate the effect. Infinite Blood prevents this power from working at all.
Ability Reflection or Immunity can be annoying.

name: Thorn Strike
description: With this power you can shoot an unlimited amount of thorns from the palms of both of your hands. The thorns can penetrate even some of the strongest materials such as stone and metal.
summary: The ability to shoot thorns from your hand
strengths: You can shoot thorns out of your hand
The thorns can pierce even some of the toughest materials
weaknesses: You might accidentally shoot yourself with a thorn

name: Robot Parts
description: Different parts of your body can be turned into robotic parts. You will look like a cyborg, but it can be switched off anytime so you can become fully human again. You can be power by electricity (which you can absorb) or by a battery of some sorts (internal/external). You are able to from a part of your body into a powerfull battery.
summary: The ability to turn your body into robotic parts
strengths: You can transform into robotic parts.
You can become electronic devices.
absorb electricity to power yourself
weaknesses: You can rust.
You're susceptible to EMPs and magnetic powers
You'll need a power source for the devices

name: Insect Controller
description: With this ability, you can control bugs to do as you wish. No matter what kind of insect or how far it is, and yes, it must be an ACTUAL insect, they will come at the snap of your finger.
summary: The ability to control insects to do whatever you want, and have insects come to your aid.
strengths: You can play some pretty good pranks.
Helpful at the toughest physical situations.
You'll be a whiz in entomology class.
weaknesses: Bugs will worship you, meaning finding you at the worst of times.
Pranks could backfire.
They may use your ear as a nest.

name: M Part
description: You could transfer any superpowered part to any part of your body. Infuse yourself with Cyclop's eyes, Batman's brain, the Thing's fists, the Flash's legs, the Hulk's arms, or block bullets with Power Girl's chest. Close your eyes, focus and empower yourself.
summary: The ability to use any metahuman's superpowered body part
strengths: Invision any super-part, touch that part of your body & you will have that part with their power
M-Part looks like the part of the person you borrowed it from
Interchange abilities, ex. Firestorm's hand & Mr. Fantastic's brain would make you formidable
weaknesses: Borrow only two parts at a time for 12 hours or until you return the use to the owner
Takes a lot of focus to return the power to owner before expiration time
The part is useless and numb to the owner while you are powered

name: Timely Appearance
description: Are your friends surrounded by a bounch of enemies, a deadly creature or a very difficult to kill bad guy that only you could beat, but you are too far away to arrive in time? No problem, with this ability it's sure that you will arrive just in time to block that deadly blast directed to your friend, beat the bad guy(s) and save the day. Does not matter if you are a hole continent away from that place, a bunch of lucky circunstances will get you there just in time.
summary: The ability to appear at the most unexpected time in a fight
strengths: You will be the hero of the day
Your friends will not die
Always arrive at scene in the best dramatic entry
weaknesses: The fact that you arrive does not mean that you can beat the bad guy
You will not have any advantages in battle
That people depend on you is not always good

name: Arrow Strike
description: With this power you can shoot arrows (as in bow and arrows) from either of your hands. The arrows work like normal arrows but they are twice as durable and twice as fast.
summary: The ability to shoot arrows from your hand
strengths: You can pierce people's chests or heads with arrows
You have an unlimited supply of arrows
They are twice as strong and fast as normal arrows so they can cause more damage
weaknesses: They can't pierce very powerful armor or helmets

name: Blurbed
description: This power will let you know things about a foe. Useful, useless and dull or useless and funny and/or humiliating. There's a 33. 3333333% chance each could appear. The factoids are 2-D balloons that you will always be able to see and read. These factoids will stay for three seconds. What you find out could be his weaknesses, his favorite color or things that a tabloid would pay good money to know.
summary: The ability to have popup balloons of information appear over a foe's head.
strengths: 33% chance of a fact popping up to help you win a fight.
33% chance of a fact popping up that a tabloid pay good money to know.
Telling a foe about a weird secret they're keeping could distract them in a fight.
weaknesses: 33% chance to learn when he learned to walk.

name: Liquid Storage
description: Absorb liquids no matter how large into the body, then become able to use hydrokinesis.
summary: The ability to absorb all large liquids into the body
strengths: Good for making a country turn against its leader due to drought problems.
Be able to use water attacks
Good for when you're thirsty.
weaknesses: You can't drain liquid from living things.
You have to resupply every time you use a huge amount of water.
If liquid amount is large enough, it can leak from the body.

name: Railway Teleportation
description: As long as two locations share a railroad track connection you can teleport between the two locations. You must touch a length of railway at one location to teleport. You also must know the second location. As a side benefit you're invulnerable to any damage a on coming train could do to you. This invulnerability extends to any parts of a train thrown at you.
summary: The ability to teleport by touching a railway a one location and reappearing at another.
strengths: Teleport anywhere were train tracks exist.
When teleporting trains can't hurt you.
weaknesses: You'll have to memorize or keep a book of of teleport locations.
You must make contact with a railway track to teleport.

name: Alligator Mimicry
description: With this power you can mimic the skills of an alligator. You can open your jaw very widely, you have very sharp teeth, you can jump long distances, you have almost impenetrable skin and claws.
summary: The ability to mimic the skills of an alligator
strengths: You can mimic the skills of an alligator
weaknesses: You can't mimic the skills of a crocodile

name: Phantom Anatomy
description: Also called Phantom Body or Phantom Body Parts, this ability implies the presence of organs which are invisible and intangible to the naked eye. However, this doesn't mean the whole BODY is invisible or intangible; the user may have a Phantom Eye that allows him to see the invisible, Phantom Arms that allow him to touch the intangible; a Phantom Brain that allows the user to perceive the presence of ghosts, Phantom Bones or the like.
summary: The ability to utilize organs which are phantasmal (ghostly) in nature, that can interact with other phantom things
strengths: Phantom body parts or body systems are immune normal harm (and still function normally)
Interact with similarly-imperceptible things (Phantom Ears hear ghostly noises, etc. )
Make phantom body parts visible with light concentration (or in sunlight)
weaknesses: If powers aren't strong enough, phantom body parts make the user look like an amputee
If adaptation goes wrong, phantom body parts phase out of the body (you DIE)
Phantom things are exposed to phantom danger (phantom ears sensitive to white noise, etc. )

name: Division Of Power
description: With this, the wielder is able to split one's own power, allowing multiple uses for a single power, resulting in new forms of power not usually available to them. A hydrokinetic could be able to actually generate water and in massive quantities, while having cryogenic abilities from the division. All "new" powers are still a sub-category of the existing power.
summary: The ability to divide one whole power into separate forms.
strengths: Bodies could attack independently or together.
Serve as lethal distractions.
Bodies never wear out or tire.
weaknesses: YOUR power will be reduced depending on how many bodies you create.
You're not immortal.
Best used as a last resort.

name: Bling Bling
description: The user is able to summon and control any valuable mineral, like diamonds, gold, silver, platinum, pearls, rubies, sapphires, emeralds, etc. They can also fuse the jewels with their body, enabling them to withstand any attack or environment (they don't need to breathe, eat or sleep) and reform if they are damaged. Creativity with this power allows the user to make any weapon out of these minerals, which can be just as indestructible. However, the minerals are going to stay for only two hours.
