summary: The ability to summon, manipulate, and turn into any precious material.
strengths: Absorb the minerals and become virtually indestructible and strong.
Create weapons out of the minerals, which become just as durable.
Money problems are a thing of the past.
weaknesses: The minerals disappear after two hours, so be careful when fighting or bribing/buying.
People will annoy the user by constantly asking for jewelery.
Although durable and able to reform, the minerals will break permanently if hit by others you made.

name: Killing Jar
description: With this power you have a small pocket sized magic jar. When you open the jar a six foot three strong and deadly warrior appears in front of you. The warrior is under your complete control and is skilled in all forms of fighting and can use any kind of weapon. The warrior disappears as soon as you close the jar. If you lose the jar or it gets stolen from you it will automatically teleport back into your pocket.
summary: The ability to have a jar with a deadly warrior inside of it
strengths: You have a jar warrior
The warrior is under your complete control
He is skilled in all forms of fighting and can use any weapon
weaknesses: If the warrior is somehow killed in battle you lose the jar as well

name: Myth Power: Heroism
description: Greek mythology had no shortage of heroes. As such, channeling them, one can gain Odysseus' cunning and wit; Autolycus' theft/disguise abilities; Amazon Queen Hippolyta's fighting/tactical prowess; Achilles' weapon/fighting skill; Daedalus' ingenious invention skill; Orpheus' musical skill; Bootes' keen hearing; Lynceus' keen sight; Atalanta's speed and athletic prowess; even, at the higher levels, Heracles' level of physical strength (before deification), King Midas' Golden Touch and the like.
summary: The ability to channel the Greek protagonists and their command over the essence of human heroism
strengths: Best abilities/traits of the most powerful/famous Greek heroes, to the degree the hero had them
Autolycus could turn invisible, shapeshift, turn his loot invisible and change its appearance
Heracles was the strongest man ever to live; Everything King Midas touched turned to gold
weaknesses: You have it to the degree they had it, no more, no less (be careful when channeling Midas) (NCN)
Also gain their vices (Achilles' heel, Daedalus' flighty mind, etc) (NCN)
You may be unaware of some of the heroes you can channel (better study up)

name: Implant Growth
description: With this power you can mentally trigger a change in your body that causes a mechanical implant to be painlessly grown. You can mentally track the percentage of growth of the implant until it is finished. Each implant fits perfectly inside your body so that you can look normal on the outside. An implant could take several years to grow to peak performance. Possible implants include: Reflex Booster, Optics Enhancer, Logic Co-Processor, Sub Dermal Armor, and Phoenix Monocyte Breeder.
summary: The ability to grow implants into your body over the span of your life.
strengths: Grow any type of implant you can imagine.
The implants, when fully grown, are very strong.
Can even grow an implant to make the implants immune to technomancy.
weaknesses: Takes a long time to grow the implant to its full potential.
Can not decide to stop growing implants.
Stuck with the negative aspects of implants unless it is surgically removed.

name: Snap No Sense Of Direction
description: With this power you can make people lose their sense of direction by snapping at them and saying "No direction for you! " The person will then be unable to tell where they are going and unable to get to where they want to go until you snap at them and say "Direction for you! " You can only give people a sense of direction after you've taken it away from them already so you can't use this on people who already have no sense of direction.
summary: The ability to make people have no sense of direction by snapping
strengths: Make people lose their sense of direction
weaknesses: This power has no effect on people who already have no sense of direction

name: Broken Enlargement
description: With this power you can make any object bigger as long as you're holding a piece of it. The piece does not have to be attached and you can make the object as big as you want. You cannot make the object smaller with this power.
summary: The ability to make something bigger as long as you're holding a piece of it
strengths: You can make objects bigger
The piece you're holding does not have to still be attached but it had to at one point be attached
weaknesses: You can't make things smaller again
You have to be holding something for this power to work

name: Agitator Pulse
description: A person with this power has the ability to send a weak electric pulse, either through touch or through a medium, that upon contact with the brain stimulates the limbic system to focus on aggression. This will cause the person to view anything it sees as a possible enemy and give them a desire to fight to the death. It also increases the person's strength and skills and gives them the ability to predict other people's moves through observation.
summary: The ability to make people fight to the death
strengths: Makes other people kill each other
Enhances people's strength and skills, though they become a homicidal maniac
There is a delay time for the ability in which you can run or hide from the affected people
weaknesses: Cannot deactivate the power without other abilities
You have to hide so that people can't see you

name: Tangled Web
description: With this ability, you make lies a very deadly thing. Every lie the foe has ever told will be strewn together into a physically tangible supernatural web that binds the foe. This web will continue to gradually get tighter and tighter until the foe can no longer breathe and is suffocated (or it releases tiny Styx Spiders with an anti-lie venom); if he compensates every lie he's ever told with a TRUTH he'll be released; if he keeps lying, the web tightens even faster (or the poison gets stronger).
summary: The ability to tangle the foe up in every lie he has ever told
strengths: Most people have told A LOT of lies  (hard to get free without revealing the truth)
Web is impenetrable by anything except the user, the truth, others with this power, and divinity
Foes who keep lying (or don't reveal ENOUGH truth in time) are either poisoned or squeezed to death
weaknesses: Panmnesiacs can remember every lie they've ever told, so they'll make short work of the web
Sometimes the web ONLY constricts or ONLY releases the Styx Spiders
Immortals, people with Poison Immunity and Invulnerables/Impenetrables

name: Shrink Belt
description: The user of this belt is able to shrink to become smaller or even to microscopic size. A person with this belt also can shrink objects or people that are currently in the shrinking field that is emanated by the belt
summary: The ability to shrink to become small or microscopic size
strengths: Good for getting into small places as well as well as fixing objects that requires a small person
Good at spying and getting information without anyone knowing
Good at escaping from enemies
weaknesses: Not really combat oriented

name: Master Of Karma
description: You just have to look into a person's eye and you can decide what kind of fate they will have in their next life. You can decide if they deserve to be a human at all, you can put your enemies into an extremely unfortunate life, and you can reward your friends with making them powerful and happy people.
summary: The ability to decide in what form other people will reincarnate.
strengths: You have the control over other people's fate.
It's not scenic when you use your power, so nobody will know what you have done to them.
It's fun to talk about your power without having anybody around who thinks it's serious.
weaknesses: There's no visible effect of using this superpower, so most people won't believe you.
Even you can't be sure that your power truly exists or you are just a bit psychotic.
You can't have an effect on your own Karma.

name: Necrotic Physiology
description: This ability is from the result of intense UV rays. When this ability is active, your entire biological make-up is virtually "dead". Your pain tolerance is incredibly high so you can take amples of punishment without shedding a single tear. You can also utilize ten 6" long claws. You are also prone to blacking out and assuming a bestial form when taking damage.
summary: The ability to acquire superhuman abilities through the utilization of dead skin cells.
strengths: You are still in control of your muscles and other bodily functions.
Never have to worry about rigor mortis or other skin conditions.
Harden your skin like diamond.
weaknesses: Your skin will develop a grey-coloured appearance.

name: Voodoo Doll Creation
description: This power lets you create a voodoo doll copy of a person or object that is an exact replica of what is copied. You can create a normal voodoo doll of a person or something like a dollhouse if you are coping a building. The dolls can be opened up and they will have realistic parts (like organs) inside. If a voodoo power is used the dolls can be opened up without the original object being ripped apart, unless that is what you want.
summary: The ability to create a voodoo doll copy of a person or object.
strengths: Can create an exact replica voodoo doll of any object or person.
Can be paired with another voodoo power to increase its power.
Can be used to study an object without interacting with the object.
weaknesses: Not much use if you don't have another voodoo power.
Can only create one doll per object. (unless origenal doll is destroyed)
If the doll is lost or stolen it is not much use.

name: Superrevival
description: This power will only work if your abilities have been destroyed by the power Super Losers. You will regain all lost superpowers and keep new ones that have been collected!
summary: The ability to regain superpowers
strengths: Recover superpowers
weaknesses: Powers are gone until this superpower is acquired.

name: Quartz Prison
description: This ability allows you to trap your enemies within a large quartz crystal. After you touch an enemy, quartz will grow from the point of contact until it has engulfed thier body. Those trapped in the quartz are left in suspended animation until released.
summary: The ability to trap enemies in a large quartz crystal
strengths: Trap enemies in quartz
Enemy is left in suspended animation
weaknesses: Must touch your enemy for it to activate
Takes a few seconds for the target to be completly engulfed

name: The Five Newest Powers
description: With this power you automatically have the five newest powers on the super power list. Your powers change whenever a new power is added to the list.
summary: The ability to gain the five newest powers on the super power list
strengths: You can get some pretty awesome powers
You have five powers
weaknesses: Your powers are almost constantly in fluctuation

name: Explosive Blood
description: Tihs power is unique and can be very dangerous, espcially in close combat. A person with explosive blood can get their blood on walls, people, etc and make it explode whenever they choose. If you encounter a person with this ability it could be dangerous going into the fight. You would have to make sure not to even the tiniest scratch this could prove to be a huge advantage to the user. Blood is limited and losing to much can kill you. Th body of the user has adapted to this and can produce more
summary: The ability to make one's own blood or the blood of other to explode at will.
strengths: Fling or spit you blood at people and make it explode or just wait till they bleed.
The body of a person that has this ability produces more blood than the average person.
Even the tiniest scratch can give a user a huge advantage.
weaknesses: Losing to much blood.
Limited blood of course.
If in the situation, distance of the oppenent if they aren't bleeding.

name: Telephoneportation
description: This power allows you to transport through phones. Any kind of phone will work, just stick your head in and climb on through. It works on objects too, meaning you can put stuff through the phone as well as yourself. This method of transportation is one way, so only things on your side can transport. If signal is completely lost while you have a body part extended into the phone, that body part will be cut off.
summary: The ability to transport through telephones
strengths: Punch people through the phone.
Talk face-to-face with anyone who has a phone.
Give people things through the phone.
weaknesses: Lose signal, lose body parts. Keep your head on!
You can only send, never recieve.

name: Gokai Change
description: When you were young did you want to be a Power Ranger? Well, with this power you can transform into any member of the groups that are considered by their fans to be the inspiration for Power Rangers! The name of this power is the transformation phrase for the 35th of these groups, Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger, and you need to say the name of this power in order to use it. Also don't be surprised if you end up fighting a giant space empire, or if the "Monster of the Week" explodes on defeat.
summary: The ability to transform into any member of the first 35 Super Sentai.
strengths: So. Many. OPTIONS!!!
You get a giant robot too!
weaknesses: You may end up being forced to defend the Earth from a giant space empire.
You need to know what the various groups are.

name: Soil Nourishing
description: With this power, you absorb nutrients from the ground which are used to enhance your strength, stamina, endurance/durability etc. So it becomes good if you are out in the wild. Only once it's completely mastered, you'll no longer have to touch the ground with bare flesh (but you still need to touch the ground).
summary: The ability to absorb nutrients and minerals from the ground for strength.
strengths: You'll get enhanced strength, stamina, endurance/durability.
Will be able to fight for a long time if you stay on the ground.
weaknesses: Most times, you'll have to touch the ground with your bare flesh.

name: Contract Fulfiller
description: With this ability, you can be the best bounty hunter, treasure seeker, or bodyguard in the world. As long as you have established a contract with someone, you will gain the abilities needed to fulfill your contract and also the knowledge of how to fulfill the contract. However, the user is bound by the rules of the contract. The user can interpret the contract in the way they see fit, but they cannot go against the contract or the contractor, unless allowed by the contract.
summary: The ability to gain abilities to fulfill any contract
strengths: You can fulfill any contract and you can choose which contracts to accept
If two parts of a contract are in contradiction, you can choose which part to follow
You can choose your own interpretation; unless the contractee is very specific
weaknesses: You are bound by the conditions of a contract and you don't know what abilities you get
If the contractee dies, the contract is null and void, unless stated otherwise in the contract
Contract Nullification stops your powers

name: Eat This
description: Whatever you eat will make you stronger and invulnerable for a limited time. Don't hold back. You can eat anything. Eat stones and for and hour you have all the density and ability to lift whatever they weigh. You will not get fat. Eat brick walls, eat the sidewalk, eat normal food in truckloads.
summary: The ability to eat everything, making you stronger and more durable
strengths: Your body can metabolize anything to make you a physiological powerhouse.
Keep adding to your mass and density and you could go toe to toe with the man of steel and Thor
Your teeth are always the most dense and durable substance known to man
weaknesses: Your bowel movements destroy any and every toilet and or bathroom
You breath smells like a rotting corpse slowly decomposing in toxic waste
You wake up each day as normal person. Don't be an idiot and tell some sweet thing your secret

name: Time Travelling Blast
description: The Time-travelling Blast is a unidirectional force sent from either the past or the future. It is impossible to use it in the present. The force and time difference of the blast may vary according to the the wielder's strength and control. The blast may also "miss" and continue forward/backward in time for a brief period. Once it has successfully been sent, it also takes some time for the blast to travel to the intended target, requiring some planning of specific targets at specific times.
summary: The ability to project blasts into or from the future
strengths: Nobody would ever know it was you, as you (probably) wasn't there.
It could confuse enemies, unless they already knew it was you
weaknesses: Inaccurate - you have to know when and where
Hard to learn
Messing with the timeline can be dangerous

name: Goldworks:  The Golden Fleece
description: The Golden Fleece is the wool of a golden ram in Greek mythology. It has many powers, including healing and nature refertilization. It will heal any living thing it touches and wherever it goes, nature will become fertile and strong. Also, whoever wears the Fleece gains great strength and durability. It basically boosts the life force of everything around it. It can also disguise itself as another piece of clothing such as a golden coat or cloak, but only for limited periods of time.
summary: The ability to wield the Golden Fleece
strengths: Great strength and durability
Healing and life force boosting
Fleece can appear as another piece of clothing
weaknesses: When the Fleece leaves, nature returns to its normal state
All of the Fleece's diguises are golden and temporary

name: Curiosity Inducer
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anyone curious about something or more curious than usual. For example, if you make an outrageous offer, other people will wonder how you will do it rather than think you are crazy. You can also use this to make people more interested in what you say. You can also use this power remotely, prompting people to look out of their hiding place so that you may find them. This power does not override free will.
summary: The ability to induce people's curiosity about things
strengths: Can help people become more interested in things
Can use it to convince people to do things
Make people listen to what you have to say
weaknesses: Cannot force people to do anything
Does not look like an amazing power
Must have prep to make this effective

name: Rise Of The Kryptonian
description: With this power you can turn into a Kryptonian with all of the powers and weaknesses of Superman.
summary: The ability to turn into a Kryptonian at will
strengths: You have C.Ks powers
weaknesses: Red sun radiation makes you human
Kryptonite is very bad for you and can kill you

name: 3 Headed Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a three headed dragon. The dragon can fly, is super strong and under your complete control. All three of its heads have super sharp teeth but that's where the similarities end. One of the heads shoots lightning out of its mouth, the second one shoots poison that kills people on contact and the third head shoots out a green goo that is highly acidic and burs through anything it makes contact with.
summary: The ability to summon a three headed dragon
strengths: You can summon and control a three headed dragon that shoots lightning, poison and acid goo
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: It might accidentally kill you

name: Causality Reversal
description: The causality of anything you do is reversed. If you did A to get to B, then you have got to B and just have to do A, which means you are now at B again. Only an extremely strong will or great luck can negate your power.
summary: The ability to reverse causality
strengths: Everything has 99.9% chance of success
Anything you do is permanent
weaknesses: You cannot undo what you have done, even by time travel
You must explicity say what your intended consequences are before doing the action
Other people can manipulate you into doing their will

name: Judgement
description: If you touch someone you can see their soul, including every sin they committed. If the soul you see is suffering from one of the seven deadly sins, you can force the corrupted soul out of the body and send it to Hell.
summary: The ability to judge souls
strengths: Get rid of evil.
See people's sins.
weaknesses: See people's sins.
You can see your own soul.

name: Camera Power: Capture
description: A person with this power has the ability to capture people on film-not in the usual way. The user can transfer people, objects and scenery in the real world into their camera film. The people caught on film cannot get out unless the film is developed. If it is a Polaroid (tm) camera, nothing can get out unless the user lets them out. However the person can still talk while in the polaroid picture. Any type of camera works, even miniature. Cannot capture translucent or transparent objects.
summary: The ability to capture and store people or objects in film
strengths: Everything in the screen is captured
You can capture parts of objects
You can release objects that you have captured on film by developing it
weaknesses: You need to have film
Destroying the film or picture causes the objects to be destroyed(could be pro or con)
Anyone can develop the film unless you use a Polaroid or similar type camera

name: Explosive Cutter
description: Someone with this power can disarm any explosive by cutting it. The location that is cut does not matter as the explosive will lose whatever it is that causes it to explode.
summary: The ability to disarm any explosive by cutting it
strengths: Anti-bomb squads will love to have you if you have this power.
weaknesses: Only really helps if there are multiple explosives around that need to be disarmed quickly.

name: Blessing Of Athena
description: Athena is the Greek Goddess justice, warfare, strategy, and courage. The characteristics all needed for a superhero or heroine. Once Athena gives the blessed one her blessings, they will be granted an indestructable suit of armor to carry out justice and defend the weak
summary: The ability to be blessed by the Greek Goddess Athena
strengths: You have an indestructible armor
You are the symbol of justice
weaknesses: You can't fly

name: Dagger Strike V2
description: With this power you can shoot super sharp daggers from your hands. The daggers can cut through anything but if you accidentally stab yourself with your own daggers you don't feel a thing.
summary: The ability to shoot daggers from the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot daggers from your hands
The daggers can cut through anything
They can't hurt you
weaknesses: You still have to aim

name: The Throne
description: With this power alone you can create one ordinary human soldier an hour to fight for you. Each soldier has a shortsword, chainmail armor, and a round shield. If you have the powers, 'The Crown' and 'The Scepter' as well then you can create 5 soldiers per hour instead of 1.
summary: The ability to create soldiers to fight for one's cause
strengths: 120 soldiers per day if you can stay up all 24 hours each day and have all three powers.
It can take up to one month to get an army of 480 soldiers. 16 soldiers per day, 8 hours of sleep.
weaknesses: Most modern armies have guns and probably well over 1 million soldiers.
The weaponry is somewhat obsolete.

name: Patriotic Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain super powers based on how patriotic they are. The more patriotic they are , the more powerful they become. They also have the ability to draw power upon the patriotisme of the crowd as well. Superpowers include super strength, flight, and limited invulnerability and the ability to project force fields
summary: The ability to have superpowers based on how patriotic you are.
strengths: You get superpowers depending on your patriotisme
Fight enemies that want to harm the innocent people within your country
You are patriotic to your country not the government
weaknesses: You can be patriotic, but can be an enemy to the government
If you lose your love for the people in your country, you lose your powers
If the people within the country lose faith in you or the country, you alsol lose your powers

name: King Of The Hill
description: With this power you can cause a giant palace full of jewels and expensive items to appear on any hill by pointing at it and saying "I'm the king of the hill! " You can use this power up to ten times. The palaces also have an armory full of state of the art weapons and military vehicles and the palace is indestructible so it make for a good fortress as well. This also means that you can't make the palace disappear so once you use this power ten times you lose it.
summary: The ability to cause giant palaces to appear on hills
strengths: You can make palaces appear on hills
They are full of money
They are indestructible and have an armory full of state of the art weapons
weaknesses: You can't make them disappear
You can only use this power ten times

name: Blood Bath
description: Blood of other living beings' heal you. Foreign blood upon contact with your body immediately begins to heal you of broken bones, damaged tissue, even mental attacks. If you are not injured it acts as a stimulant igniting your adrenaline, charging you to peak strength, mental capacity & beyond.
summary: The ability to heal yourself by the blood of others
strengths: You can fully heal from any injury even death
Blood Bathing will take you to adrenaline enhance levels of physical prowess
Letting the blood dry on your skin gives you slightly enhanced durability
weaknesses: I don't suppose people will just let you cut them
Finding enough blood for each injury will pose a bit of a problem
You will need to be submerged in blood to be brought back from death

name: Lord Of The Dance Floor
description: If anyone is dancing, you will immediately be able to dance twice as well as that person. If a group of people is dancing, you will be able to dance better than all of them combined. This superpower applies to all forms of dance. The presence of another person/being dancing and music in the background is required for this superpower to activate. Its effects will then last until you stop dancing.
summary: The ability to always one-up anyone who's dancing
strengths: Become an instant hit.
Impress your audience.
Take on the world!
weaknesses: Superpower doesn't work if you dance alone
Superpower doesn't work if there's no music
Superpower doesn't grant any basic ability to dance on your own

name: Undying Love
description: By admitting your undying love for a certain person, place, object, or an ideal and attempting to protect it, you are able to pull a flaming sword from your chest and fight with it. Not only does it increase your drive to protect the thing you love most, but also increase your ability to do so.
summary: The ability to use your undying love for a person, place, thing, or ideal and create a sword from that drive.
strengths: You get a sweet, flaming sword to fight with.
Fear doesn't affect you as much with your increased drive, causing you to not stop fighting.
You become a better combatant with improved reflexes and fighting prowess.
weaknesses: You can't have any doubts about whether or not you love said thing, person, place, etc.
It might be a bit shocking the first time a flaming sword erupts from your chest.
Fear doesn't affect you as much, which might cause you to make mistakes.

name: Super Squad: Bird's Eye View
description: You can see through your normal eyes and then you have a bird's eye view. Owned by mythical superhero "Bald Eagle".
summary: The ability to see from two angles, your normal eye view and from straight above.
strengths: Bird's eye view.
Good to see if there is anything above you.
Can even see above buildings when inside
weaknesses: If a plane or something hits your bird's eyes, you feel a lot of pain.

name: Better Life
description: This power can only be used once. When the user decides to activate the power, their current family will give the user up for adoption, and almost instantly, a very rich, loving, and beautiful (inside and outside) family will adopt you. The previous family will never re-adopt you and the better family will never un-adopt you (nor want to). The new family lives in a mansion with cooks, maids, butlers, servants, and gardeners (maybe more). The family can pay for you to get a huge makeover.
summary: The ability to get adopted by a very rich and loving family
strengths: Rich, loving family
Mansion with cooks, maids, butlers, servants, and gardeners (maybe more)
Better life
weaknesses: Some people may like their current family

name: Vortex
description:
This ability allows you to create a vortex.
The vortex sucks all nearby objects inside it turning it all into nothing.

A vortex is like a miniature black hole that is more directed.
summary: The ability to call a vortex whenever you desire.
strengths: Can summon a vortex, whenever you choose.
This power is not accidentally misused.
With enough patience, practice and focus you can conjure miniature vortexes further from you.
weaknesses: If you are nearby the vortex, there's a chance you could be sucked in.
All Vortexes summoned work with the same pulling and gravitational forces, that you cannot variably alter.

name: Lateral Magnetizer
description: The user can make anything stick to the surface of an object similar to a magnet. The strength of the attraction depends on the user. Employed the user can effectively walk on walls or ceilings except gravity still works. When close by your opponent they cannot move their legs to dodge although they can still move the upper body. It is not real magnetism so heat will not affect it, but brute strength can rip a hole off the surface to move.
summary: The ability to make objects along a surface that your are touching attract objects similar to a magnet
strengths: Stop people from dodging your attacks by magnetizing the ground
Walk on walls if you use a lower magnetic setting
Prevent people from fumbling you by making your hand magnetize
weaknesses: You would be stuck to the surface too
Brute strength may be used to escape or breaking the surface or limbs

name: Es Excalibur
description: This power is similar to the ones that turn humans into weapons, but this allows for greater power and control of the weapons created. When the person with this power applies him/her self to another being as an ES (Equip Soul) the persons body turns to 4 Excalibur sword replicas, a full body armor, and provides full regeneration. The 4 swords can be dual wielded by the soul of the ES and by the being ES is equipped to, or can be combined together into a full version of Excalibur for more power.
summary: The ability to use Equip Souls
strengths: Heals the one being equipped.
Privides increased speed, power and knowledge to use the weapon properly.
The equipped being retains all it's original powers.
weaknesses: ES can not fight on its own.
The ES has to rely on the equipped person to fight.

name: 3 Forms Of Body
description: When you activate this ability, you will separate into the 3 forms of body. The Skin Form, The Muscle Form, and The Bone Form. Each Form has its own strengths and weaknesses. The Skin form is constantly regenerating and healing. It is susceptible to poison and radiation. Muscle Form is incredibly strong but is susceptible to psionic attacks. The Bone form is immune to all poisons, radiations and psychic attacks and has increased defense, but is less intelligent and prone to error.
summary: The ability to separate yourself into the three forms of body.
strengths: Three bodies are better than one.
Have three different powers at once.
weaknesses: Splitting up is unpleasant.
Have three distinct weaknesses.

name: Orbs
description: The orb ability is when you shoot out blue orbs with bright lights in the middle. it is super powerful against almost anything.
summary: The ability to cast out orbs at your opponents
strengths: you can orb your self to any place in the universe
you can orb anything to anywhere in the universe
you can fly
weaknesses: It has no affect on electricity
you can not rearrange yours or anybodys body parts
It takes a while for your powers to be at their full extent

name: Power Reincarnation
description: This power only aplies if you want to come back to life with all your memories and/or use of all but 1 of your powers. If you do then you get to choose whether you want to be male or female, but you can't choose anything else before being reborn. The power you lose due to this power is completely random.
summary: The ability to come back to life at the sacrifice of one power
strengths: You keep all your memories and all but one of your powers when reincarnated.
You could lose your most useless power.
weaknesses: Only thing you can decide about your next body is your sex.
You could lose your most useful power.
The power lost is random.

name: Charonian
description: If you possess the charonian you can keep people from dying but to do it you have to suck youth from others to keep them alive.
summary: The ability to keep the doors of death closed for some people to die
strengths: You can make people immortal if you suck a lot of youth.
You can live VERY long!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
You can suck away youth from enemies.
weaknesses: You hav to suck a way youth to do it.
It is soooooo hard!!!!!!!
It is really stressful

name: Exploding Swarm
description: The user appearance is a cross between a white zetsu and clay face. The user can create up to three duplicates/ clones at any given time, the clones will try to latch onto the enemies. When attacked and pieces of the clone are separated from the clone's main body(example: an arm)that piece will transform into another full clone. The clone also has the ability to explode(similarly to a possessed abomination in Mass Effect 3)
summary: The ability to create duplicate/ clones that can be deonated
strengths: Overwhelm enemies
Normal phyiscal attacks are useless
Feel no pain when exploding
weaknesses: A tiny piece of the user needs to remain intact or willl die.
After a clone explodes the user must wait two minutes before creating more.

name: Giggly Palm
description: To emit nitrous oxide, you must first catch the enemy then cover their mouth with your palm- but don't worry, they won't struggle for long. The gas will enter their body and take over their being, causing them to laugh uncontrollably and eventually wear their lungs out when they will suffocate and die.  This is normally a power for a super villain due to the hilarity of the event (it's just plain fun to watch).
summary: The ability to release laughing gas from your palms
strengths: Stun your enemy
Wears the enemy's lungs out
Almost always kills (if not killed, they will be severely scarred)
weaknesses: Must cover their mouth with your hand to emit the gas
Comes only from your palms

name: Wushu Finger Hold
description: The ultimate Kung Fu move. You grab the forefinger of your enemy with all of the fingers in your hand except the pinkie. When you flex your pinkie you deliver a massive amount of chi energy directly to the body resulting in a mass explosion of chi force. No one knows exactly what happens to the opponent, but they disappear after the move is completed.
summary: The ability to completely obliterate your opponent
strengths: I think the good parts are obvious
weaknesses: Cleaning up the mess afterword

name: Bread Crumbs
description: With this power you will never lose your way. As you walk, you can leave trails or spots of light which only you can see. You could also use this power to mark an object.
summary: The ability to leave a trail or spots of light which only you can see
strengths: Never be lost
Tag objects to identify them
weaknesses: Only you can see the trails

name: Knight Owls
description: With this power you can summon up to 57 knight owls. Knight owls are more or less just owls with armor, their armor is impenetrable and they can be summoned during the day or night. They are under your complete control and you can unsummon them when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon a flock of knight owls
strengths: You can summon a flock of knight owls
They are under your complete control
Their beaks and talons are sharper than those of normal owls
weaknesses: They might eat your mice friends
They can die
You can only summon 57 of them

name: Naga Morphing
description: This power allows you to transform into a Naga and back. Nagas are half-humanoid, half-serpentine creatures with humanoid features from the waist up and a snake's body from the waist down. This power gives you the traits of both a human and a snake. You also gain Naga Magic so you can hypnotize people.
summary: The ability to transform into a Naga
strengths: You can scare off criminals by turning into a fearsome naga.
Climb up walls and constrict foes.
Some nagas have camouflage and/or venom!
weaknesses: Controlling your new lower extremities.
It takes time to shift between forms.

name: Monster Converter
description: The power to turn people into Monsters. The power makes other people into Monsters that only you can control. The Monsters look a lot like Hollows (from the manga cartoon Bleach).
summary: The ability to turn people to Monsters that only obey the one who used the power
strengths: You can make an extremely big army of Monsters
You never need to take orders from anyone, just turn them into monsters ;P
You can reach world leadership pretty easily
weaknesses: You need to touch the person you want to turn to a Monster
You cannot use it on yourself
You always have to fear that the Monsters turn against you

name: Sculptor's Touch
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anything they touch be extremely malleable enough to be bent easily. When effected object is not in contact with your hands the touched object returns to its usual malleability. Some real applications of this ability include the uses of it in the arts and possibly in several sports like archery or pole vaulting. In battle this can be used to tie people up in knots or hitting people through their bendy armor.
summary: The ability to make things that are in contact with your hands be malleable
strengths: You can make sculptures very easily and are good at making art
Make things malleable or non-malleable at will
Very useful auxilary power in combat
weaknesses: Bending things is not the same as destroying things
Its very hard to return things to the exact way they are after bending them

name: "Speak Humans!"
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak any human language. They will know how to speak the language with perfect grammar and even know how to use slang words.
summary: The ability to give any person the ability to speak any language (bestow Omnilingualism)
strengths: You can give people to the ability to speak any human language
They can speak with perfect grammar, no matter what language
They will even know slang words, colloquialisms and figurative expressions
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Gauntlet
description: To change the size, shape, and density of your arm.
summary: The ability to change your arm into an unbreakable claw
strengths: looks cool
crush things
shield
weaknesses: heavy
rips shirts
slow

name: Blunt/Piercing Conversion
description: With this power, you can change the damaging effect of any thing. Things that normally deal blunt damages, such as punches, kicks, hammers or falling on the ground, will open holes. Things that normally deal piercing damages, such as nails, stakes, arrows or bullets, will deal a blow.
summary: The ability to convert piercing force into blunt force and vice versa.
strengths: If you are shot, you will get knocked by the projectile rather than bleed to death.
Deal serious damages with a single punch or the edge of your hand.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect you from harm.

name: Armor Of Light
description: So long as the wearer is true of heart, noble in cause and just in intent then The Armor of Light may be bestowed upon the Hero. It is a nigh indestructible full body armor composed of brilliant, glowing holy magic and energy that cannot be destroyed by conventional means. Can only be summoned when the situation is at its darkest, despair is imminent and defeat is possible. The hero must be strong willed and a believer in such things. It is however weak to corruption of wearer and dark magic.
summary: The ability to summon a magical suit of armor of holy energy
strengths: About gaurentees that the Hero will never loose
Is immeterial (thus need not be carried nor can be destroyed)
Its holy signature and radiant glow is inspiring and can rally allies
weaknesses: It doesn't mean the Hero can win either
Should the hero grow currupt, loose any requisits or stop believing, the armor is lost
It can not be used at all times, only when it is truely needed

name: Moon Blade 4th: Emerald Green
description: A Sword that is completely green. Able to heal a target by stabbing it, and in the process, dissipating into the body. Once the target is healed, you remove the blade, which detaches from the body and returns into the sword form.
summary: The ability to create a healing sword.
strengths: Heals the target in seconds.
Can be used with any of the moon blades.
Can be swiped through a target while just running past them.
weaknesses: Has no offensive or defensive abilities.
First time patients may be skeptical to be stabbed.

name: Computer Entity
description: When this ability is activated/obtained, the user is transformed into a 'living' computer. Their body is just a 3D metal (it's colored and it doesn't look metal) rendering. It starts as themselves, but it can be tweaked/recreated to be different. They know all commands, and have a unanimous operating system that can run mac, windows, or linux files. Somewhere on their body they will have a metal plate for hardware replacements. They start out with very high quality hardware, though.
summary: The ability to be a computer. Please read description.
strengths: Be the best hacker/pirate/digital artist/computer user/gamer ever and watch/do it in your head!
Never need a phone, computer, gaming system, etc. again! You can use all types of files/data!
Morph your metal body to whatever you want it to look like and can implant upgrades!
weaknesses: Could get a virus or an error.
You'll need to morph your body slightly to go swimming.
Could get hacked/VNCd

name: Physigy
description: There are many physical attributes, but I will give you only one example. Strength is one. You can change strength into energy and then you can crush anything. Just don't overuse it or you will suffer pain depending on that attribute.
summary: The ability to turn one's strongest physical attribute into energy that is used the same way and amplified.
strengths: You will be stronger depending on your strongest physical attribute.
weaknesses: You will suffer pain if you overdo it.

name: Assess Abilities
description: Just by looking at someone you can see any special Abilities or special powers that person has.I don't mean things like being able to count backwards really fast I mean Superhuman Powers or Extraordinary Abilities
summary: The ability to know what superpowers or abilities anyone possesses.
strengths: You can Prepare Yourself for any Possible Situation Involving that Person.
You will Know What Their Value to you Would Be.
It Will Help You to Understand a Persons Quirks or Odd Behavior.
weaknesses: You May Try to Exploit People for their Abilities.
You may Need an Ability and you Waste Time Looking for That Person.
You May become Superficial in Dealing with People and their Powers

name: Sacrificial Augmentation
description: This ability, as the title suggests, allows you to sacrifice any form of living entity to gain physical strength. If you have any, this also enhances any 'superpowers' that you may possess. Note that the strength gained by the sacrifice is determined by the size and strength of that which is sacrificed.
summary: The ability to sacrifice living entities to enhance your strength.
strengths: Strength!
Sacrificial Powers!
Now everyone has a purpose :)
weaknesses: Not beneficial to anyone but yourself
Cannot be used on invincible entities
Not everyone may want this to be their purpose :/

name: Paneth Cell Mimicry
description: Despite having an offensive and defensive role, this power is not a type of Leukocyte Mimicry. This power allows you to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. When you recognize a foe, you can trigger a second ability, the one to release a volatile substance which can create holes through their skin, and this only attacks a foe's skin. Also, you can secrete a liquid substance with antibacterial properties.
summary: The ability to detect foes and release a substance which pierces only their skin, as well as secrete antibiotics.
strengths: You can secrete antibiotics.
You can detect foes, especially those you can shapeshift to evade detection.
You can release a deadly airborne substance that only targets foes.
weaknesses: You do not have any of the other abilities of Leukocyte Mimics.
So, you can't clone yourself, nor distort your body.
Once you've released your deadly product, you need time to replenish your supply.

name: Graphic Novel
description: With this power you can turn regular old boring novels into fun and exciting graphic novels. If the book already has a graphic novel version it will become that, but if there is no graphic novel version of the book in existence this power will create one for you drawn by your favorite artist/in your favorite style. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn books into graphic novels
strengths: You can turn books into graphic novels
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Epitome Of Beauty
description: The user can appear to whomever they choose as their personal epitome of beauty/attractiveness/sexiness. The user can use this power in three ways. 1) They can appear as ONE persons personal epitome of beauty, and appear that way to everybody. 2) The user can appear to EVERYBODY as their personal epitome of beauty all at once, appearing differently to each individual. 3) The user can become their OWN personal epitome of beauty, making them the most beautiful person ever by their own standards.
summary: The ability to appear to others as their personal epitome of beauty
strengths: Appear to others as their personal epitome of beauty
weaknesses: 3 different ways of using this power, but only 1 of those ways can be used at a time

name: Dual Appendages
description: Can split your arm(s) into two arms, effectively doubling your record of arm wrestle wins and punching someone twice with one swing. From any joint or attachment, one can sprout second limb from. Turn yourself into a quadrapede by growing two new legs, grow to bodies attached to one head, two tongues, ten fingers on one hand, four ears, etc. Best of all... Two heads!
summary: The ability to grow two working pairs of any appendage(s) or limb(s), at will.
strengths: Can easily climb with a second set of forearms or multitask with two heads!
Endless and undiscernable source of flesh and bone!
Become the ultimate gamer and speed up your typing!
weaknesses: Gets slightly uninteresting after a while, and gross.
Can only make two of each appendage.
Will not regenerate lost limbs only duplicate them.

name: Special Event Embodiment
description: This ability allows one to become a physical representation of an event that they hold most dear. It could be a good moment, a tragedy, or even an embarrassing moment. They will represent it. They will have certain abilities depending from that event like producing items or living things that where from that event especially if it was relevant to that event, create the same event again, and even produce effects that have to be based on that event.
summary: The ability to the embodiment of a special event or moment in one's life.
strengths: Be the a living embodiment of an event or moment
Become stronger if other people remember
Gain certain abilities based on that event
weaknesses: Only one event or moment
You will never forget

name: Panthera Cantus
description: By touching your chest with two fingers, and saying the name of the ability, your upper body's clothes disintegrate, and black lines (tattoos) cover most of your body. You gain claws on both feet and hands, and become advanced at martial arts.
summary: The ability to become a panther/human hybrid.
strengths: Great hand to hand power.
High speed
weaknesses: Due to clawed hands, you are unable to use weapons.
Can speak, but unable to use spells that require an incantation.

name: Personality Implantation
description: With personality implant, you can temporarily place your mind into anyone else. They'll think like you, act like you, and so forth. You can use it to make your own sports team, make everyone agree with you, or just mess with someone. Only problems would be that if the person you were using it on is unable to physically do things that you can. Also, your mind stays in your body; it's like copy-paste. However, the person you're using it on will eventually turn back into themselves.
summary: The ability to place your peronality into others.
strengths: Get your own group.
Make enemies have your mind, so they'll be good.
Group projects should be easy because your group thinks like you!
weaknesses: Wears off with time.
The people you use it on don't remember anything.
Since it's not a hive mind, the yous don't have to listen to you.

name: Soul Inspection
description: You can see another's soul.  By being able to inspect their soul you are able to see all the kindness they have done in the past, or all the sins they have done.  This ability allows you to know every aspect of them, their birthday, age, all of their abilities.  This power allows you to some of their next movements.  If you train this power you will be able to take their soul out of their body.
summary: The ability to inspect another's soul.
strengths: Inspect their soul.
Know their powers.
If you train enough then you can see the graces and sins they will do.
weaknesses: Taking souls out of body means that for a short second their life will flash before your eyes.
Their is a 30% they will know they are spying on you (Permanently)
You can only focus on 10 souls at a time.

name: Triforce Of Power
description: With the triforce of power you have vast power, immortality, you can transform into a dark beast and you are almost undefeatable. But on the other hand, you are corrupted and led to evil.
summary: The ability to use the triforce of power
strengths: Vast power
Transform
Undefeatable and immortal
weaknesses: Evil
Corrupted

name: Eject
description: With this power you can eject yourself or others from any vehicle. When this power is activated a hole will instantly appear in the roof above the person's head. The person will then shoot out of the car and receive parachute. This works for any and all vehicles and can be used on any person.
summary: The ability to eject yourself or others from a vehicle
strengths: You can eject yourself or other from any vehicle
Free parachute
You can use this power on any person and any vehicle
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you're fighting in a vehicle

name: Pixelization
description: Real Life is in an amazing resolution. So amazing that it sometimes gets annoying. The user of this power can change anything touched into a pixel form, even himself. The resolution (the amount of pixels) can be chosen, and a pixelyzed entity can be reshaped, although it needs time and talent to make great changes. A pixelyzed living being doesn't feel pain, but if their pixels are separated, it will need to find them before turning back to normal - or live without a part of its body.
summary: The ability to change any solid or liquid matter into pixels and shaping them.
strengths: Retro-style version of life.
Reshape things easily.
Immune while in pixel form.
weaknesses: Need physical contact to work.
Problems if disgregated while in pixel form.
Only lasts for 24 hours.

name: Flaying Focus
description: Skin enemies live and core apples in seconds! Enemy armor stopping your bullets? Not a problem! Give them a glare and the armor will tear, leaving you with a soft, squishy human target! Works every time you focus. The longer you focus, the more you tear away.
summary: The ability to rip layers from targets with a glare
strengths: Remove layers of anything
weaknesses: Fail all vision exams
Can no longer have staring contests.

name: Summon Chuck Norris
description: Ability to Summon Chuck Norris once a day to your aid in battle.
summary: The ability to summon Chuck Norris to fight for you.
strengths: He will fight and win every battle for you, defeat every foe for you.
He will protect you from harm.
You will be in the presense of greatness.
weaknesses: Can only be summoned to battle your foes.
Can only be summoned once a day.
Power will not work if you are a ninja.

name: Mesmeric Fear
description: This is a very nasty curse. Whenever the accursed should feel fear or know they should avoid something or doing something as it might cause them troubles, injuries or even death, they will actually feel a very strong attraction, curiosity and pleasure, prompting them to jump into the lion's den. However, this curse can only be inflicted to someone who frightened or injured the user.
summary: The ability to make anyone attracted to what they fear and what they know might hurt or kill them.
strengths: The accursed is now willing to get hurt and to kill themselves
People should avoid using fear-inducing powers against you.
weaknesses: You have to be injured or frightened in the first place.
The accursed cannot be attracted to something they didn't notice, consider or realize is dangerous.

name: House Maker
description: If you draw a house (including furniture), it turns real and goes where you want it. Use your wildest imagination.  If you can't draw, you can also write out a description of your house.
summary: The ability to make a house for free.
strengths: Free stuff.
Famous inventor.
Free money.
weaknesses: It comes out exactly how you write it, so spelling could be a problem.

name: Lucky Boomerang Effect
description: All you need to do is throw the object and it will always come back, unless it gets stuck in something or someone catches it in midflight. The power is automatically activated, so be extremely careful with what you throw.
summary: The ability to throw any object and have it come back to you, like a boomerang would.
strengths: You can throw something and have it come back to you.
Easily strike anyone out in baseball as long as you're the pitcher.
weaknesses: If the object gets stuck or caught, then it won't come back

name: Sound Absorption
description: A person with Sound Absorption can absorb all sound in a 50-foot radius whenever they please. No sound can leave or enter the area, and no sound in the area is audible.
summary: The ability to absorb all sound in the area
strengths: Sneak up undetected
Become an amazing secret agent
Never hear an annoying sound when you don't want to
weaknesses: Effectively deaf when using ability
Still not invisible
Sudden loss of sound very noticeable

name: Melting
description: When using this ability, you'll need some conscious effort to melt objects.  A novice at this might cause the object to "partially" melt objects, but a more skilled person could melt an object in an instant.  Also, this ability just doesn't work by touch.  You would be able to melt any object with in the your sight. The greater the size, the more the concentration.  This ability doesn't cause the temperature of the object to rise and is not effected by the type or density of material.
summary: The ability to turn solid materials into liquids
strengths: Instant water from ice
gets rid of obstacles in you way
weaknesses: Can't turn melted objects back to solids
creates messy puddles

name: Effect Persistence
description: Knock an illusionist unconscious and their illusions will fade away. Kill a telekinesist and the things they were manipulating will drop. Well, with this power, whatever powers you were using when you fell unconscious or died will remain active and even have their effects reinforced. So, illusions will remain and seem even more real, things moved with telekinesis could speed up or gain a life of their own, fires born from pyrokinesis will grow fiercer, forcefields will become more impenetrable.
summary: The ability to maintain and reinforce the effects of your powers when you're unconscious or dead.
strengths: Killing or knocking someone unconscious will no longer be a solution to stop a power or a curse.
When you die or fall unconscious, all or most of your life energy will reinforce your powers.
The effects will be maintained as long as the energy you had will allow it. It could take years.
weaknesses: Be careful what power you're using. With Imperceptibility, no one will be able to find you.
Once you come back to life or regain consciousness, the effects will be back to normal or even stop.
It doesn't change the fact that you're vulnerable or even dead when it happens.

name: Ancient Beast: Cerberus
description: With this power, you not only gain the power of pyrokinesis and geokinesis, but you also gain untold strength and durability, the ability to morph into Cerberus, and the ability to split yourself into three, in either human form or Cerberus mode. Souls of the dead fear you because you can feed on them to strengthen yourself, but that strength is only temporary.
summary: The ability to have the powers of Cerberus
strengths: Strength and durability
Pyrokinesis and geokinesis
Split into three
weaknesses: Power is only temporary when you eat souls
Changing into Cerberus tires you out quicker
Souls don't taste very good. (Bleh! )

name: Doom Bringing
description: Cause the doom of ANYTHING! A person, a planet, an object, a virus, world hunger. ANYTHING that can be destroyed/ended. Obivously the bigger/stronger it is, the harder it is to destroy it. Also negates immortality/endless youth
summary: The ability to cause doom unto anything
strengths: Doom to all who oppose you
Can simply do it by thought.
Make immortals into mortals
weaknesses: One a day
Can't "undo" anything you used it on

name: Gift: Liquids
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling liquids than other beings. Thus their liquid-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of liquid from them. However, someone with this power can only receive liquid-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of liquids
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over liquid as someone with this power.
Liquid-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only air-based powers now.

name: Double Metabolism
description: With this power, all your powers are boosted passively to double their strength. However, this comes with a side effect; you will require twice the metabolic energy to sustain yourself. However, you simply need to eat more and move less to provide this energy.
summary: The ability to boost your powers to twice their strength, but require twice the energy.
strengths: Double power strength!
Passive and applies to all powers at once, stacking with others.
Harder to gain/not lose weight.
weaknesses: Food requirements may be daunting at times, especially without sustenance powers (e.g. Heat Eater).
Need to have other powers to be useful.
Cons cannot be removed by powers like Con Negation.

name: Power Puppet Telemetry
description: This power only works with the consent of someone else (who can have powers of their own). When you use this power, your body goes comatose and now have the fives senses of the consenting person. You can only use your powers. However, any powers that steal, copy, alter or negate other powers will only affect the powers of your telemetric volunteer. Mind-effecting powers only affect you. If your volunteer is killed, the affect will be if you had a stroke. You can release your volunteer at will.
summary: The ability to transmit your powers through another person you control.
strengths: Be an overweight lazy couch potato and fight crime.
Any powers you have can't be directly affected. They're in your body and you're at home.
The best secret identity possible-it's not you actually fighting crime.
weaknesses: You can feel the pain of your volunteer.
Let a villain go to keep the volunteer alive or have a virtual stroke?
In a coma. Alone. In your house. How's your home security? What if there's a fire?

name: Expandito
description: You may expand any part of your body in any way you choose.  You may increase the length of your legs, stretch or neck, make huge fists, and the like.  Strength to operate such enlarged body parts is included.
summary: The ability to expand any part of your body.
strengths: May became gigantic
Super fighting skills
Hit with the ladies (if you know what I mean).
weaknesses: You cannot shrink, expansion fades within the hour.
Takes concentration to expand

name: Baysplosion
description: WIth this power you can make fake explosions happen whenever you want. The explosion look and sound convincing but nothing and nobody gets damaged when you make them. They are good for scaring your enemies or friends and also for making movies.
summary: The ability to cause fake explosions to happen whenever you want
strengths: You can make fake convincing explosions
You can make cool action movie scenes
You can scare people
weaknesses: They aren't real explosions

name: Half Lich
description: A being with this power has higher magical power and a better-looking body than an ordinary human. They can fully regenerate their body from a single cell or take control of a human's body so long as even a cubed centimetre of their phylactery exists. The phylactery is less vulnerable than an ordinary lich's as it is in the half-lich's body, looks like what they want it to look like (maximum size is 3 centimetres cubed) and can withstand much more damage than a lich's can.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-lich
strengths: Don't need to do a ritual to become a half-lich, unlike a lich does.
Hard-to-destroy phylactery.
Don't need to hide a deformed or ugly body like a lich would.
weaknesses: The magic boost differs between beings and can be from 2 times better to 1000 times better.
Phylactery will not change location if the half-lich takes control of a new body.
Cannot change the look or size of the phylactery once it is outside of the original body.

name: Dust Click
description:
May be considered a dangerous or useless power.
Turning any solid object to dust all yo have to do is focus on the object you want converted into dust, and click your fingers. Then that object turns into dust.
You can even turn people to dust, however you can not turn them back.
summary: The ability to turn any solid object to dust with the click of your fingers.
strengths: Turn any object to dust.
A very powerful power against those impervious to death.
weaknesses: Can not turn an object back to normal once you've clicked it into dust.
Objects must be solids.

name: Conscious Body
description: This power lets your body react to help you without you knowing it with the added bonus of being able to do anything you could do better than you could have done yourself. Your body will consciously defend itself from any and all attacks and you can do many things at once.
summary: The ability to have your body move for you
strengths: Full Automatic-you don't need to think when doing physical activities
Your body automatically knows what you know and more and does what it thinks is best for you
Mind control does not work on a self conscious body since it has no "brain"
weaknesses: You cannot fully control your body(without real willpower)
When asleep or knocked out your body works on its own(so you have to sleep in chains)

name: Lessen Others
description: This powers works like the -less power but only affects other people and the effects are usually malevolent (can be used benevolently). Nose, spine, skin, life, mind. Any word with a -less and a negative effect is possible with this power. Add -less to future and a foe is going to die very soon. Penniless makes a foe lose all objects they own. Mind, Soul, Heart,etc. Lifeless (or Breathless) is instant death. Just find all the negative words ending in -less...
summary: The ability to lessen others in some manner.
strengths: Multiple ways to kill someone or strip them of something.
Can be used to achieve something good (e.g. use it on a ally's weakness)
You can mostly counter this power with the -Less power.
weaknesses: This power doesn't provide a word for every situation.
This power has many counter powers.

name: Tactile Cellular Lag
description: With this ability, your touch will impede the human body's cellular processes. These processes include, but are not limited to, cell division and migration (wound healing and immune response) and metabolism (growth, digestion and the generation of energy). With practice and prolonged skin contact, users of this ability can halt the growth of cells completely and induce necrosis (the premature death of cells in living tissue) on a massive scale, effectively killing their target.
summary: The ability to slow the body's processes on a molecular level via direct skin contact
strengths: You can tire foes easily by halting their metabolism and waiting for them to wear themselves out.
With practice and control, you can prevent those you touch from ageing for a short period.
With prolonged contact, you can prevent opponents with regenerative abilities from healing.
weaknesses: You must make direct skin contact with the target.
People with little control over this ability can cause serious harm and even kill by accident.
You can only slow the body's processes, not speed them up to boost healing or growth.

name: Reptilian Characteristics
description: Due to your reptilian DNA, you possess large patches of hard green scales on your body, particularly your back and chest. Your canines possess a paralytic neurotoxin that can be released at will. You can dislocate your jaw, and taste the air like snakes. You can also sense air movements and vibrations, and see infra-red radiation. You possess small talons instead of your nails. Your skeleton is now made of many smaller bones, so your are more flexible, and have a larger muscle percentage.
summary: The ability to permanently share traits of reptiles
strengths: Slightly increased agility and strength with your claws can help a fight easily
Several extra senses
You're still warm-blooded, with all of its advantages
weaknesses: With green scales and small claws, you'll look like a freak
Have to milk your poison or it will leak
Dislocating your jaw looks gross

name: Birds Eye View
description: You can see what is coming at every corner near you even in the near future. Unfortunately, you can't decide when to use it. It just kicks in when you need it.
summary: The ability to see behind every corner near you
strengths: If people tried to jump you, you would know and go another way
If you wanted to hurt someone you would know when they are coming
You could avoid someone you didn't want to see
weaknesses: You probably would never be surpised

name: Gift: Transformation
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at transforming than other beings. Thus their transformation powers are better than most other being's powers and it is harder to prevent their transformations. However, someone with this power can only recieve transformation powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at transforming
strengths: Almost no one is as good transforming as someone with this power.
Transformation powers are boosted slightly.
Better disguises
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the prevention aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only transformation powers now.

name: Feng Shui Master
description:
With this power, the effects of feng shui become real and you now know how you should place objects so that it can benefit you or someone else. 

This power can also be used in battle. You can figure out the exact location where you take less damage or where attacks will fail to hit and also cause Rube-Goldberg reactions by hitting the right places.
summary: The ability to know the correct positition of things that will bring you luck
strengths: Have good luck
Have enemies trip on something you placed in a "convenient location"
Always find the exact spot where the opponent's attacks don't hit.
weaknesses: You may not like how things look or the weird positions you would be in
If someone can prevent you from moving things around or moving yourself

name: Superman Hand
description: The owner of this power has a hand that has all the powers of Superman - that can be used with a hand. For example, it is invulnerable, has superstrength, and can fly. Unfortunately the power is only contained in the user's hand. With only a single hand the user is still considerably powerful, able to crush coal into diamonds and otherwise defeat even superhumans with a single flick of a finger.
summary: The ability to have a single hand with the powers of Superman
strengths: Can fly at low speeds because hand drags you along
Can crush coal into diamonds
Finger poke of doom
weaknesses: Only your hand has invulnerability
Does not come with super senses, heat vision, or superbreath
Can't choose which hand you get this power on

name: City Of Heroes
description: Just imagine it. With just your imagination, you could physically create a city filled with superheroes. Give some of them ice powers, or make some of them invulnerable. Make some of them acrobatic, or give them magical powers. The city itself is yours to reshape, making it a sci-fi haven for anyone who visits!
summary: The ability to create a city of superpowered individuals.
strengths: Entering a city of fantasy
Make your own superheroes
weaknesses: The government may try to draft them
They won't have a normal life

name: Dart Parasite
description: Fling darts and the opponent's body and the ones that hit transform into a parasites that quickly go into the victims brain and eat it. Afterwards, the parasites emerge as scaled reptile/dog hybrids emerging from the stomach and growing to 7 feet in 5 seconds, becoming loyal familiars to the owner.
summary: The ability to fling darts at opponent and turn those darts into parasites.
strengths: Kill an enemy and get a nigh-vulvernerable pet
Familiars are nigh indestructible
If by some chance, the pet is killed, the owner can eat the heart to gain immortality
weaknesses: The user does not have pin point accuracy so the percentage of actually hit target is slim
The darts must be darts made for the dart board game.
Darts are easy to dodge

name: Gift: Sound
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling sound than other beings. Thus their sound-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of sound from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve sound-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of sound
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over sound as someone with this power.
Sound-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only sound-based powers now.

name: Super Bite
description: With this power you have a superhuman bite. When this power is used your teeth become sharper and poison tipped. You have the ability to your open your mouth wider than the average person. Your jaw also becomes stronger and it cannot be broken and if anybody tries to punch you in the jaw they will break their hand. You can turn this power on and off but if you turn it off all parts of it (sharp teeth, poison, wider mout, invincible jaw bone) are turned off you can't pick and choose.
summary: The ability to have a super bite
strengths: You have a super bite with sharp poison tipped teeth a wider mouth and an invincible jawbone
The poison cannot hurt you
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You can't pick and choose which parts of the power are turned off it's all or nothing

name: Super Repellant
description: With this power you can cause anybody with superpowers to stay away from you. You can pull off crimes without fear of being apprehended by superheroes or keep super powered villains out of your city. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to repel superhumans
strengths: You can repel superhumans
weaknesses: Does not work on aliens, wizards, robots or demigods

name: Radio Connection
description:
Connect your mind to the radio to listen to songs, change radio stations and listen to your favourite radio talk shows :) Songs are played in your mind, as if you had ear phones in. 
Stronger when you are near an actual Radio.
summary: The ability to connect your mind to the radio and listen to whatever is playing
strengths: Listen to songs anywhere
No need for earphones or physical radios
Listen to songs in class/work without getting in trouble
weaknesses: Only you can hear the music
Signal will be very weak under large buildings (for example underground Carparks)
You may get no signal at all - for example The desert

name: Idiosyncratic Mimicry
description: This ability makes the user become the thing they have a strong connection to or have some traits of it. For example, the user's favorite thing was a hockey stick. This ability will make them have hockey sticks for limbs, become human-sized hockey stick, or become what the hockey stick is made of. If the possession is small, the user can disperse into that small object.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become ones most prized possession.
strengths: Become your favorite possession
You can change in and out of it
Small objects: can disperse and reform
weaknesses: You can only be one prized possession unless the connections are equal.

name: Ossiokinesis (Osteokinesis)
description: This ability lets you manipulate your bone structure. It also allows you to regrow bones you have lost or used.
summary: The ability to manipulate your bones
strengths: You can fix any broken bones.
You can create weapons out of bones.
weaknesses: It hurts to have the bones come out.
They can break if they are too brittle or thin.

name: Cash Mine
description:
Creates a Gold/Silver mine at the location specified, this gold respawns every
two hours. One Gold/Silver Deposite per two foot radius, can create an infinite amount,
Gold/Silver is allways exposed. Can destroy mines too, and have all Gold/Silver appear at your feet, can choose for them to respawn instantly.
summary: The ability to create Gold/Silver mines.
strengths: Wealth.
Infinite Gold/Silver.
Instant "Harvest".
weaknesses: You have to sell it.
You have to explain infinite Gold/Silver.
You'll be used. (could be a pro. )

name: Space Umbrella
description: A person with this power has not need for an umbrella. Falling objects that would hit the person's head or body from the top are all diverted to the side. That includes downswinging swords an axes. Rain will fall around the person thus giving this power its namesake since a person with this power would have no need for an umbrella.
summary: The ability to divert falling objects away from your head
strengths: No need for an umbrella
Falling objects fall around you and if the object is too big a hole is made to protect you
You can dive very far since the water on top of you is diverted to the side
weaknesses: Things going straight at you or from the ground are not diverted
Things coming at an angle have a slight resistance to this power

name: Duplicator's Physical Boost
description: The four physical traits are speed, strength, endurance and toughness. This power only affects one copy of you-the original. Duplicates,clones or copies. All work with this power. A Swarm of You power or something similar works with this power. Forced shapeshifting type powers work with this power also. The range of this power is Earth-planet in area. You can't receive a boost greater than by a factor of 10.
summary: The ability to multiply four of your physical traits by the number duplicates that you have.
strengths: Having a swarm shapeshifting power can make you very hard to defeat.
The Earth is a big place where enough of your duplicates could hide.
If you have a invulnerability power or invisibility or a teleport ability.
weaknesses: This power doesn't work beyond a Earth-sizied area.
Your duplicates(clones,etc) can't get a physical boost even though they have this power.
You can't receive a boost greater than by a factor of 10

name: Anti Solid Field
description: A person with this power cannot be touched by anything that is in the solid state. There is a field around their body preventing contact with solids. Thus bullets and conventional melee weapons are useless since it will never make direct contact to hurt you. However liquids, gasses, and energy will affect you. With practice the user can extend their field to repel solid objects.
summary: The ability to never be touched ever by anything in the solid state
strengths: Bulletproof and Hitproof
Forces can still affect you so gravity will keep you down even when your feet are not on the ground
You can push back solid objects with practice.
weaknesses: You can never high five or give a hug
You can only eat liquid food and you have to slurp it(no spoons)
People can use acid, flamethrowers, tasers, teargas to bypass your power.

name: Plant Mimicry
description: You are able to turn into a plant that you you know of you also gain any skill which the plant has, e. G tree's allow you to have enhanced durability and strength. You are still able to move, walk and talk in your plant form. You will need sunlight in order to change, you are able to store some sunlight for night time.
summary: The ability to turn into a plant
strengths: You turn into a plant
You can walk, talk and move in your plant form
You can absorb sunlight
weaknesses: You need sunlight to change

name: Symptoms Spreader
description: A person with this power can give anyone the symptoms of any disease that they have ever experienced. This power is not control over bacteria, viruses, etc. Instead, this power controls the human body to produce the desired symptoms. The user can produce any symptom caused by any outside contagion. In addition a skilled user can produce the symptoms of various diseases at the same time. The effect continues as long as the user is concentrating on their target(s).
summary: The ability to give anyone the symptoms only of any ailment that one has ever experienced
strengths: Give anyone fever, headache, sneezes, stomachaches etc.
