Produces the symptoms only and bypasses immune system
Generally non-lethal and is non-contagious, so you can use it on yourself to fake illness
weaknesses: Wears off over time based on the user's mental capacities
Can not be used to give people immunity

name: One Hit Ko Punch
description: With this power you grow a switch on the back of your neck, if you turn the switch on you able to kill anybody with one punch no matter how light the punch is. If you turn the switch off your punches only do normal damage. No matter what your punches won't hurt you though.
summary: The ability to kill anybody with one punch
strengths: You can kill anybody with just one punch if you want
Either way your punches won't hurt you
weaknesses: Somebody might turn this power on without you realizing by flicking the switch on your neck

name: Power Hunger
description: Once you eat a full superhuman, you gain their sbilities. You want super strength, eat someone super strong. The problems with this power are you have no way of stopping once you start eating, you can't stop and you have an restless hunger for superhumans.
summary: The ability to devour superhumans and gain their abilities by doing so.
strengths: Gain many abilities.
When doubled with Power Sensing and Digestion Adaptation makes this power deadly.
Superhumans will fear your voracious hunger.
weaknesses: The hunger will make you continuosly want to eat more superhumans.
You eat bones and all so you should have a digestion adaptation along with this power.
Primal eating will occur. (No fork, no knife, no cooking, etc. )

name: Gamma Ray Bursts
description: Gamma-ray bursts are intense flashes of gamma-rays that cause the nucleus of a cell to explode. The user can emit these intense rays from his body but the target has to be within medium distance for the gamma-rays to reach the target and to not disperse. Overuse of this ability poses a great physical strain on the body which can eventually result in muscle degeneration.
summary: The ability to produce gamma-ray bursts
strengths: Targeted limbs or whole bodies can be exploded at will
The waves can be fired at a 9m radius
Close-combat attacks will be unable to hit the user as the person coordinating the attacks will expl
weaknesses: Waves can be reflected, refracted and diffracted. If wave is reflected back at user the will explode
Limited radius to fire waves
Overuse causes muscle degeneration and user can become crippled

name: Rough Skin
description: Your skin gains an insane amount of friction, allowing you to "stick" to surfaces, as well as increasing the power of your hits due to your skin's roughness, easily scraping away enemy skin, or even stone. Your skin also becomes unnaturally durable and invulnerable to heat, making it possible to heat your body to high temperatures by rapidly rubbing it on something. You can control the level of friction to some degree, but can't turn it off completely.
summary: The ability to have unnaturally high-friction skin that is harmful to the touch
strengths: Can resist other forces (like gravity, or a punch) through friction on another object
Can cause damage through scraping or heat through your incredibly frictitious skin
Resistant to physical attacks and invulnerable to heat
weaknesses: Skin may wear away anything it comes into contact with (including clothes)
Skin must come into direct contact with something to affect it
Your skin will always be rougher than that of a normal person

name: Inward Blades
description: This ability grants the user to cut their opponent from inside out by touching their body and saying extend.  The beginning of the blade is visible but it looks like a broken blade but the reason why it looks like that is because the rest of the blade is invisible
summary: The ability to use the inward blades
strengths: Very unexpected
Good for stealth
weaknesses: A maximum of three blades
Can cut yourself
Cannot cut things from the outside

name: Dinosaur Morphing
description: With this power, you don't just look like a dinosaur, you can also become gigantic and have the powers of the dinosaur you want.
summary: The ability to become a real dinosaur.
strengths: Be any dinosaur you want
Super strong
weaknesses: Uses energy
Big means clumsy

name: The Eraser
description: An "eraser" can remove superpowers from any super being simply by touching them. The super being must submit to the "eraser" for this to be successful. Super powers removed by the "eraser" may or may not affect the "eraser", depending on the power being removed.
summary: The ability to "erase" powers from super beings, done by touch.
strengths: Is extremely helpful to unintentionally evil super beings.
Can help in investigations of evil super beings.
Can save lives.
weaknesses: Death can happen if the super being's power is very harmful.
Does not work if the super being won't submit to the "treatment".
"Erasers" are VERY hard to find.

name: Schultze Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. You have a very sharp nose and whenever you smell an odor, you can shoot either electricity or a special signal containing information about the smell. You can use these signals to make people smell what you smell by sending them through the area between their eyes. They can also be sent to Neuron Mimics from a short distance, only if they can receive them. You can't smell odors a normal person can't smell. If you're a female, this power becomes stronger when you ovulate.
summary: The ability to have a keen sense of smell and shoot electricity or special signals when you smell something.
strengths: You can identify and perceive odors much more easily than a normal human being.
You can make people smell what you smell.
There are many things to smell so you can nearly shoot electricity whenever you want.
weaknesses: You are very susceptible to strong, pungent smells.
You can't smell odors humans can't smell to begin with.

name: Superhero 5: Iron Man
description: With the armor of Iron Man, you have superhuman strength, durability, speed (in running/flight), and an array of weapons such as repulsor rays, the Uni-Beam, rockets, turrets, and flares. You are like a human tank.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the armored avenger, Iron Man.
strengths: You have an armored suit that makes yuy stronger, fly faster, and more harder to hit.
You shoot lasers from the palm of your hands and chest.
You're like a tank.
weaknesses: You need to recharge.
People will try to copy the technology used to make the armor.
In space, the armor will stop and freeze.

name: Gene Knockout Punch
description: As there are quite a lot of genes in any punchable opponent, the gene to be inactivated or deleted must be called out before contact occurs. The effect can be specified by gene, trait, allele, or protein associated with the gene targeted for deactivation/deletion, e.g. "I'm gonna knock the lux (A) out of this Vibrio fischeri!" The default effect is that the given gene is deactivated, though as the example implies, deletion is possible by indicating destructive intent while "calling" the attack.
summary: The ability to delete or inactivate a given gene in a person via a punch to that person.
strengths: Any mad scientist, doctor, or biologist worth their salt will be willing to hire you.
You can legitimately beat the disease out of your victi- experi- err... clients.
Insane savings on equipment while tinkering with the very building blocks of Life itself.
weaknesses: You do actually have to punch the container of the targeted gene.
Not very relevant if you don't know the first thing about genetics.
If you don't know quite enough about genetics, you can easily mess something up... permanently.

name: Lucky Winner
description: Say that you went Las Vegas and participated in a poker tournament; you could win at every hand and get a lot of money. You would do nothing illegal, so the owners of a casino couldn't prosecute you.
summary: The ability to win at every poker game
strengths: Win every time.
weaknesses: Doesn't effect slot machines
You would have to know the Card ranks e.g. Full House, Royal Flush etc

name: Rural Empathy
description: Who doesn't love backwoods areas: the isolation, the friendly people, the banjos? A Rural Empath has another reason--away from civilized centers, development, and complex technology, they become superhumanly durable, strong, and quick. This lets them resist a direct shotgun blast, lift a tree, and outrun a car. Unfortunately, this strength logarithmically decreases as they approach cities or towns. They may also become physically ill at the approach of urbanization.
summary: The ability to become superhumanly durable, strong, and quick while away from civilization
strengths: Durable enough to resist a rocket blast
Strong enough to benchpress a redwood
Quick enough to outrun a car on the highway
weaknesses: Powers quickly dissipate as user approaches cities or towns
Complex technology causes mild discomfort
Development and urbanization causes nausea

name: Hyperflexible Spine
description: This superpower gives you an extremely flexible spine. The spine is more flexible because it is stretched out more. The stretched out spine, makes you at least 2 inches taller by default. You get good at limbo.
summary: The ability to have an extreme flexible spine
strengths: Have an extremely flexible spine.
Be taller.
Be good at limbo.
weaknesses: Only your spine is flexible...

name: Cremate
description: In order for the power to work, you have to stare at the person or people for a minute & focus. Your eye's iris will turn black pupil red. Their body will create a super flash of spontaneous combustion from the inside out in seconds. Soon your target will become paralyzed & crumble into ash.
summary: The ability to turn a person to ash & dust
strengths: Cremate people instantly
weaknesses: Have to focus & stare for a minute to work

name: Absorptive Consumption
description: Eat anything, literally anything, and your body will turn that into nutrients, well considering on what you eat, it can also give you a boosted stat. Eat nails, get tougher skin and bones, etc. As an added bonus, your stomach acid is highly corrosive. Your body is only immune to being melted because of this power. If you were to throw up on the ground, a hole would form.
summary: The ability to eat anything like a garbage disposal
strengths: Never go hungry
Vomit can be a projectile.
Immune to melting in your own vomit
weaknesses: Your clothes aren't immune to melting, so you could end up running around naked in your own vomit.
If you touch anyone with that vomit, then they melt.

name: The Armor Of Achilles
description: (This armor is legendary and it has a history to it) this armor was created by Hephaestus and given to  Achilles. As long as you wear the armor you can never be harmed by any weapon. This armor is rare to Find. You have to know your history
summary: The ability to wear an armor that is impenetrable
strengths: You have an armor that is impenetrable
You have the coolest armor
You have an armor that was created by Hephaestus
weaknesses: You not immune to aging
You are not that powerful
You remove the armor you die

name: Power Self Negation
description: One with this ability has perhaps among the ultimate in superhuman ability protection. When a Power Negator, Power Mimic or Power Absorber uses his ability, your subconscious mind beats him to the punch, cancelling out any superhuman powers or physical features that you possess. Therefore, when the negator's powers reach you, they will bypass you as though you are a normal person. When the threat passes, you can elect to reactivate your powers and/or features at will.
summary: The ability to protect your superhuman abilities from negation/mimicry/absorption by temporarily deactivating them
strengths: Protect your powers from being negated, mimicked or absorbed
Reactivate them at will (or wait for the threat to pass, and they reactivate subconsciously)
This power itself cannot be negated/mimicked/absorbed (works reflexively;hard to counter)
weaknesses: Still rendered without powers for as long as the threat is present
If somebody IS fast enough to steal/mimic/negate your power before your ability activates
Can't cancel out superhuman features if you aren't human

name: Find Your True Love
description: Somewhere in the world, there is this one person for whom you are destined. You are MADE for each other. You will find true happiness when you're finally together. This power gives you the power to know where he or she is at any moment.
summary: The ability to be guided toward your true love.
strengths: You will find true happiness! You will find true love! Your life will have a purpose!
And the MOST important thing: YOUR true love will find THEIR true love!
weaknesses: There's nothing bad as long as there's LOVE!

name: Cerberus
description: With this power you can summon the giant threeheaded hellhound Cerberus from the Underworld and have him under your complete control. You can make Cerberus fight for you, scare people for you, eat people for you or you can just ride on him and use his as a pet. When you're done with him, you can just send him back to the Underworld.
summary: The ability to control the mythical threeheaded hellhound Cerberus
strengths: You can summon and control Cerberus
When you're done with him you can send him back to the Underwolrd
weaknesses: Hades might get pissed off at you and have you killed

name: Empathic Healing
description: A person with this ability can completely heal others from wounds and illnesses through skin contact, but by doing so, they transfer the wound or illness onto themselves.
summary: The ability to heal others by taking the wound/illness onto themselves.
strengths: Can heal other people.
weaknesses: Get the injury or wound they healed the other person from.
Painful.
If the injury is fatal, it could cause the user's death.

name: Super Smash Bros. Summon
description: With this power you can summon any fighter from any of the Super Smash Bros. Games and they will be under your complete control
summary: The ability to summon any fighter from any of the Super Smash Bros. Games
strengths: You can summon powerful characters like Mr. Game and Watch or Bowser
Lots of characters to choose from
weaknesses: You can only summon playable characters

name: Myth Power: Titanomachy Rematch
description: The Titans, in Greek myth, were gods older than the Olympians, presiding over various aspects of primordial nature and the human condition. As such, channeling them, one can release the Titans from Tartarus to do one's bidding; they automatically act favorably toward whoever released them. This means that they will not use their primal elemental powers to destroy the user or anything or anyone he holds dear. In addition, they'll be a threat to anyone or anything who tries to.
summary: The ability to channel the Titans, and their command over the essence of the primordial forces of nature
strengths: Summon the Titans (superstrong, very powerful elemental giants)
They do your bidding; they like you and protect you (and defend your interests)
Can be unsummoned at will
weaknesses: They won't always obey
They've been known to fear lightning (among their only weaknesses)
Only summon Titans not named in other MythPowers (no need to know names, but they won't be famous)

name: Manual Control
description: A person with this power has no reflexes whatsoever. While many may find this power useless and even detrimental, others can use this power to access their full physical potential. You are immune to flinching and have control of heartybeat and lung functions. In addition your body can move even when in great pain this includes moving even after hit with a low blow. In addition your body will always be able to access its 100% capacity since the reflexive limits are gone.
summary: The ability to have no reflexes whatsoever
strengths: You don't flinch
Can move even when in great pain
Can use your full 100% potential all the time
weaknesses: No reflexes means that you cannot dodge reflexively
You must learn to actively dodge things that you cannot block
No reflexes? No autonomic functions...fool lie detectors.

name: Equivalent Warp Compensation
description: Whenever you get "warped"(mind,body,soul,etc) you gain a warp that you can use on yourself. This means that you can turn into a desired form to fight whatever warped you(be it reality bender,mentalist,etc). Your warp can be anything from a huge elemental to just warping back into your previous form, however the warp must be equivalent to the warp done to you(no empowered stellar entity by being warped into sadness). This power also lets you build up your number of warps to shapeshift more often.
summary: The ability to get warps based on how often you've been warped before
strengths: Get many forms
Get many powers
Versatile.
weaknesses: Lasts for a short period of time
You can only warp yourself and you only get warps if someone else warps you.
If your opponent just never warps you in the first place.

name: Ash Cloud
description: Turn into a cloud of ash and reform your body at will at any time and be able to move about freely in the form of the ash cloud
summary: The ability to turn into a cloud of ash
strengths: Fit through tight spaces easly
Highly useful for stealth
Impervious to firearms and melee weapons both blunt and sharp
weaknesses: Can be frozen by ice
Water can easy render you helpless

name: Susanoo Manifestation
description: Loosely Based on Susanoo(Naruto). This power allows the user to manifest a Giant-Humanoid around him. It possess no Life or Soul, but works on the feelings of the user. It is a sort of a guardian deity. Allows the user to move and fight. Susanoo can have one weapon which he likes the most. But, it can't be changed thereafter.
summary: The ability to create a gigantic, humanoid being that surrounds the user
strengths: Protects user from Physical attacks & Magic/superpower, based on user's ability to master it.
Attacks through a weapon which user once chose as his style
Acts as a force-field. Can allow others to be in it too
weaknesses: It consumes the user's vital life force and stamina
Lasts only for small durations
Causes Headaches, fatigues & visual impairments after the use.

name: Vampire's Bite
description: The ability to bite someone, drink their blood, and inherit their powers, abilities, and anything else that person can do.
summary: The ability to drink someone's blood and gain their powers, abilities, and strengths.
strengths: Anyone you bite you have their powers.
Your powers are exponetional.
weaknesses: You have to drink blood.
Unless you have a rengenerative healing factor (like wolverine) you might get AIDS or something
You need a hard bite.

name: Lie Inducing
description: This power is very simple. You can make anyone lie. When they lie they only notice what is coming out of their mouths and cannot do a thing to stop it(besides cutting off their tongue). In addition this power can be used consecutively forcing them to be unable to tell the truth as long as you are around. They can't even say that you are the one that is making them lie. However the limitation is that you can't control what they lie about--so they can mutter nonsense to attract attention.
summary: The ability to make people lie
strengths: If you infiltrated a group and someone found out----make them lie
When they lie it does not show up on lie detector tests
Ostracize people by establishing them as liars
weaknesses: You are making people lie

name: Shattering Form
description: With this power, you harden your body and shatter it into razor-sharp cellular shards, one of which you regenerate from.
summary: The ability to explodes into shards with great force
strengths: You shatter with incredible force and power and amount of shards.
You will always regenerate instantly.
On rare occasion, if your regeneration shard shatters again, you will be cloned.
weaknesses: If the shards dont penetrate, they will shatter again into less effective pieces.
You cannot control EXACTLY where the shards go and they can hit your allies.

name: Child Creation
description: With this ability all you have to do is touch 2 parents and you can create a viable offspring based on their DNA. The offspring will have the best traits of both parents and will not have any genetic defects if created from two parents who would not normally be able to breed together, such as parents of the same sex or different species. There is no pregnancy necessary, as the child appears fully formed in your arms.
summary: The ability to create children based on two people.
strengths: Grant children to people who would never be able to have them otherwise.
Save endangered species.
weaknesses: You do not control exactly what traits the child gets.
You may be approched by some pretty weird people.
Both parents must be organic, living beings.

name: Dark Heart
description: First of all, credit to Ghost. His comment about me being cold-hearted actually made me think of adding this idea I made about a year ago for a short story. Dark Heart is an ability that allows people to absorb the dark nature and evil intentions of others. The closer they are to such people, the strong they get. Their endurance, power, and speed boosts near people who are evil. Not necessarily evil themselves.
summary: The ability to absorb evil.
strengths: Absorb evil.
Strong when near, or fighting evil people.
weaknesses: Only works near evil people.
Doesn't work on yourself.

name: Passive Aggression Deflection
description: This ability allows one to deflect any passive-aggressive powers back toward the offender forcing them to confront problems and issues directly. It blanks their mind of evasive language and gestures, stopping their tongue, eye movement and body language only to move when their motivations are acknowledged either by their internal struggle or external confrontational forces. This force can't be deflected or ignored. It is activated by the passing over of one's face while wearing a glass ring.
summary: The ability to deflect passive-aggressive behavior forcing others to become direct and confrontational.
strengths: The ability to move forward in word and action
Minimizes internal stress
Keeps it real
weaknesses: Too much Pent-up aggression released at once
Everyone starts arguing (adust strategies)
Ability to lie develops ( rare but possible)

name: Demolisher
description: With this power you can cause any building or structure to explode just by looking at them. You can turn this power on and off so you're not constantly destroying buildings.
summary: The ability to demolish building and structures just by looking at them
strengths: You can destroy buildings or structures just by looking at them
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You might forget to turn the power off

name: Tailoring
description: With this ability you gain extreme talent in making/mending clothing, and as you make more clothes this skill advances to cranking out more clothing with less materials and less effort.
summary: The ability to have extreme talent tailoring, or the art of making clothes.
strengths: Create your own clothes!
weaknesses: Where are you going to find materials to make clothes?
Really not that great....
Nothing is really great about it except its good quality put into it.

name: Snap Flash
description: You can snap and create a blinding flash so anyone near you will be instantly blinded or temporarily blinded. Up to you.
summary: The ability to snap and create a blinding flash.
strengths: You can blind bad guys.
You can screw up your friends' sight during a soccer game.
You can do anything you want with no consequences because what nobody sees won't hurt them.
weaknesses: You might accidentally blind someone.
After a person is hit 20 times in a day, he or she will gain the power as well.
You can lose your power by trying to use it on too many people.

name: Purification Method
description: The user possesses a recessive genetic anomaly that can uniquely sustain and harbor infected agents in their blood. The anomaly breaks down infected agents, such as viruses, diseases, poisons, intoxicants, medications, and drugs, much faster than the normal human body would. An outcome of that process generates raw energy and sugar, feeding it back into the user's system. This somehow augments the natural flow of adrenaline, enhancing the user's physical prowess by many-fold.
summary: The ability to be immune to addictives
strengths: Get stronger, faster, etc. , almost instantly.
Never have to worry about being drunk or high ever again.
weaknesses: Tremendously large doses of something can slow or even stop the user.

name: Death God's Promise
description: If anyone breaks their promise(s) with you they will be killed by a Death God with whom you have made a promise with. You are bound to the Death God by your promise for eternity. The promises can be anything from: 'I promise I will not call you derogatory names,' to 'I promise I will love only you'.
summary: The ability to have anyone keep any promise they make with you
strengths: Once a promise is made with you, it will be followed.
You can release people from their promises if you want to.
weaknesses: If you break your promise to the death god, you will die even if you are immortal.
You are unable to use this power on other people with powers.

name: Adaptive Personality
description: Capable of something, not capable of something--it's all in the personality. A person with Adaptive Personality is able to make chameleon-like shifts in their psychoemotional makeup depending what is most beneficial. If they need to work, they will become studious. If they need to clown, they will become goofy. If they need to fight, they will become vicious. If they need to love, they will become affectionate. The only weakness is an inability to associate with friends due to mood swings.
summary: The ability to alter your personality depending on the situation
strengths: Chameleon-like psychoemotional shifts
Always beneficial to the situation
Always conscienseless when it's necessary
weaknesses: Inability to associate with normal people
May regret crazy actions later, when personality is more stable
Unable to maintain a normal personality

name: Elemental Target
description: The possessor of this power designated a "target person" that from that moment onwards will become the target of all the elemental powers (such as cryokinesis, pyrokinesis etc. ) within a certain area. If someone who has an elemental power and the "target" too are located in this area, and the possessor of the elemental power directs his/her power to someone or something, that power is automatically diverted to this "target person". The "target" stop being such only to the subject's liking.
summary: The ability to designate a person as target of every elemental power within a certain area.
strengths: The subject can also choose him/herself as target;
The subject can defend his/her friends and him/herself damaging his/her foes.
weaknesses: The subject can also choose him/herself as target;
The power only works with material elements (forces, waves phenomena etc. Are not aviable).

name: Fake Skin
description: A fake skin can be created that changes a persons body structure while it is worn. The fake skin can be designed so that it makes the wearer look like another human, or it can be the fake skin of an animal as long as the animal is of similar size and has same number of legs/arms. You will have the same body structure, except for voice, as what the fake skin is of for as long as it's worn. Multiple can be worn but body only takes attributes of the outermost fake skin.
summary: The ability to create fake skins that alter the wearer.
strengths: Perfect disguise (minus voice).
Can be used to mimic an animal.
Can wear multiple ones on top of each other, or give extras to friends.
weaknesses: Voice isn't changed.
Can feel uncomfortable as body is compressed and changed by wearing the fake skin.
The fake skin can be forcibly pulled off returning you to normal.

name: Four Horsemen
description: The ability to possess powers of the four horsemen.  Pestilence, War, Famine and Death. This Power only lets you to have all four powers at once. E.g Pestilence  - allows you to cause a disease on a enemy. War - become combative and immortal.  Famine - allows you to disinergrate living things. Death - allows you to become grim, one touch and someone'll go dead in an instant.
summary: The ability to possess the powers of the four horsemen.
strengths: You might not become a respectable hero when using this power.
weaknesses: Don't let this power corrupt you.
You'll become extremely evil.

name: Shapeshifting Immunity
description: With this power you will be immune to any powers that could cause you or any part of your body to shapeshift.
summary: The ability to be immune to shapeshifting
strengths: You are immune to forced shapeshifting
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat if your enemy does not have any forced shapeshifting powers

name: Villian Mimicry
description: Imagine if you think an evildoer can outsmart you and get even tougher, you can take some payback advantage to the situation like you can copy/impersonate and mix some of powers of any Supervillian and you might even get the upper hand.
summary: The ability to copy and impersonate any villian inpecticular.
strengths: 2 or a thousand wrongs might or might not miake a right.
weaknesses: Must stare at the enemy to work.
Some superhero teams might not want to accept you when using this ability.

name: Cartoon Powers: Fourarms
description: With this power you can sprout two additional arms (or the necessary amount to bring your up to four). The extra arms both (all) have super strength and are invincible. Unfortunately only your extra arms have super strength and invincibility you cannot transfer this to your original arms or any other part of your body.
summary: The ability to sprout two additional arms that have super strength
strengths: You get two additional super strong invincible arms and hands
weaknesses: Only the extra arms and hands have super strength and invincibility

name: Template Swapping
description: The user of this ability is able to "mark" a superhuman by touch to make a template of their powers. They can mark as many as they want. Then, they can swap all other powers they own for one of the "marked" people's power collections. However, when unconscious, dead or negated, their entire collection reverts to normal.
summary: The ability to swap your collection of powers for someone else's.
strengths: Get a lot of different powers.
If the "victim" gains a power, their template grows.
The "victim" is unharmed.
weaknesses: You lose all your powers other than this one.
If the "victim" loses a power, their template shrinks.
If you fall unconscious, die or have this power negated, your entire collection reverts.

name: Super Spikes
description: That's pretty much it. Just shooting out spikes from your hand. Your spikes can go as far as 500 miles and are very fast. The spikes are very durable as well.
summary: The ability to shoot out very sharp spikes from the top of your hand.
strengths: Extremely fast
Stab enemies
They can go as far as 500 miles.
weaknesses: May kill a loved one

name: Loophole Finder
description: With this power, you can find the loopholes of any contract, if there are any.
summary: The ability to get out of any contract
strengths: Can get out of any contract
weaknesses: Can only find loopholes for written contracts
There are no loopholes

name: Metabolism: Spiritual
description: This power is a useful one to have. It allows the user's metabolism to function on the spiritual level and with spiritual things. You can fight off spiritual illness, absorb spiritual energy, heal from spiritual wounds, etc. The user even has the ability to have the normal nutrients they take in produce spiritual energy and the spiritual energy they take in be used for normal metabolic processes. In addition any spiritual powers or abilities that the user posses are boosted by the metabolism.
summary: The ability to have a metabolism that also functions spiritualy.
strengths: Have ANY spiritual powers or abilities boosted by metabolic processes.
Be capable of healing on the spiritual level and taking in spiritual energy.
Convert normal metabolic fuels into spiritual energy and vice versa.
weaknesses: You might have to take in more nutrients to manage the physical and spiritual body.
You might never come across much spiritual energy to absorb.
Spiritual illneses have more affect on you.

name: Mimic Backlash
description: With this power, you will be able to cause intense pain and discomfort in a person when they try to mimic or copy your powers. This does not work if they acquired the powers by other means.
summary: The ability to inflict pain on people who try to mimic your powers.
strengths: Cause pain to mimics
weaknesses: Doesn't work on people who acquired the same powers by other means

name: Cerebral Spike
description: At will you can turn your index finger into a sharp, hard spike, which when plunged into another's brain will allow you to absorb all their knowledge and memories. Stabbing another body part will not absorb anything.
summary: The ability to turn your finger into a spike to plug into others' brains
strengths: Can soon learn massive amounts of information
No need to interrogate your foes
You can use your spike as a weapon too
weaknesses: Unless you have an excellent memory or write the info down, you will forget it
Others have to die for you to learn
Any forcefield or strong armour will block your spike

name: Vulcanizing
description: Rubber is bouncy, stretchy, floats on water, and is nearly indestructible. With just a thought you can make anything like rubber. Vulcanize your arm and use it as a whip. Vulcanize the car you're about to crash. Vulcanize your feet and bounce around. Vulcanize your entire body and become indestructible. The world is rubbery with this ability.
summary: The ability to give anything the properties of rubber
strengths: Vulcanizing anything and everything
Becoming rubbery
You can also devulcanize things
weaknesses: If you Vulcanize rubber it becomes explosivly bouncy

name: Jewellery
description:
Change anything into jewellery. 
The new formed jewellery will maintain one feature from it's past form, for example:
a lamp into a ring - the ring lights up.
summary: The ability to change anything into jewellery
strengths: Always impress the ladies
Have jewellery with useful features (glowing rings)
weaknesses: You might run out of storage for your jewellery
You might get a bad feature (spikey necklace)

name: Bomber's Touch
description: When throwing items to other people, simply turn those into bombs and they shall learn their lesson of messing with you.
summary: The ability to turn anything into a bomb.
strengths: Anything can turn to bombs, even people.
weaknesses: Accidentally touching yourself while this power is active will turn you into a living bomb.

name: Essence Mix
description: This ability is used in conjuction with Hollowing Essence. With this ability you may mix two or more essences stored or otherwise into a brand new essence which will be stored within you.
summary: The ability to mix the essence of two or more objects into a new essence
strengths: Create a brand new essence
Get the best of two things into one essence
weaknesses: Must havethe essence you want to mix nearby.

name: Deathmatch Field
description: The user of this power pictures a place in their mind and designates it as an "arena". That area is then enclosed by a bright red "boundary". Any person who enters or is caught within the "boundary" is trapped inside of it until they are the last living person in the "arena". Anyone who goes "out of bounds" before this dies of massive internal hemorrhaging. The only other way to deactivate this power is with your death.
summary: The ability to create a "arena" that only the last person standing can leave
strengths: Trap people inside the "arena".
Escape pursuers by traping them in an "arena".
Turn teams (heros and villains alike) against one another.
weaknesses: You could trap youself in your own power if your not carefull.
You can only have one "arena" up at a time.
The "arena" doesn't force people to fight, mearly puts them in a situation where it is likely.

name: Panontic Arch:Gray Abyss
description: Gray Abyss - home of phasing monstrosities. The first ability is to turn into something inhumanly strong, fast and tough. You look like a creature that was left out of the Necronomicon. You can also use the phasing power but only in your hideous monster form. You are unaffected by the sight of yourself in monstrous form. While in monstrous form, seeing creatures like yourself has no affect on your sanity.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Gray Abyss dimension.
strengths: Inhuman speed, strength and toughness.
The phasing power.
weaknesses: You're not invulnerable.
Your monstrous form could shatter the minds of the weak-willed.
Heroes will easily mistake you for some sort of vile monster.

name: Story Teller
description: Gives you ability to enter any story (lives of humans are also concidered their stories) and observe it. You are given unlimited powers while you are observing a story. You can help people or harm them, hovever there is a limit.
summary: The ability to observe any story.
strengths: You have ultimate/unlimited power.
You can change your favorite stories or help people you know.
weaknesses: You take physical and mental damage each time you significantly affect the story.
Saving someone from death will cause you the most damage.

name: Sonic Scream
description: You can make your voice incredibly loud.  Great for stunning people, getting people's attention, and being "that guy" on live concert albums.
summary: The ability to scream at a super high volume.
strengths: Shock and confuse people
Project your voice
Get people's attention
weaknesses: You could damage people's hearing if you're not careful

name: Handful Hands
description: This ability allows you to create thousands of hands that will appear wherever you want them to appear. The movements of the hands follow the movement of your original hands. When one of your hands is destroyed, you won't be able to feel any pain.
summary: The ability to create thousands of hands.
strengths: Makes tasks easier for you to do
weaknesses: You decide...

name: Holy Power: The Reaper
description: With this power you can "activate" the Reaper mode. You gain a powerful energy armor and the powers of the Reaper. While using the reaper, you get Super Strength Level Omega, Superhuman Senses and invulnerability. You also become able to use all the other Reaper ability's. To acquire the Reaper you need Six Paths of Light, and you must not send anyone to hell or heaven, you can only kill your enemies. Reapers are ill-considered by other enlightened's.
summary: The ability to use the powers of The Reaper, the second Path of Light.
strengths: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Reaper.
Makes you so strong that you are able to raise a "small" tectonic plaque.
Allows you to use the Reaper Scythe, who brings death to all the ones who deserve it.
weaknesses: Hard to get, Reapers are considered black sheep's by the other enlightened.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Web Shot

name: Instant Karma Booster
description: To understand this power, you must see your life as a balance. On one side, all the good you've done and, on the other, all the bad you've done. This balance is known as Karma. When your good side outweighs your bad side, good things will happen to you. But sometimes evil is stronger, in that case the Instant Karma Booster is the power you want to have. It makes one of the sides of the balance max out and delete the other side. So, you can enjoy a great life or give others a bad life.
summary: The ability to boost your own or others' karma in a good or bad way.
strengths: You can be as evil as you wish to be, everytime bad things start to happen just boost your karma.
You can use this power on yourself and others as much as you wish.
Someone giving you a hard time? Negative karma boost and your problem will be solved soon.
weaknesses: Boosting bad karma can cause the boosted one to die by extreme bad luck.
Santa has his own list and if you are evil, he'll know.
Karma is fragile, mess with someone's karma a bit too much and the power might consume you.

name: Theme Manager
description: Change the theme of a target to your choosing. You can make objects more effective for what they are intended to do, places more interesting and useful, and even give superpowers that fall within the theme to people. Items, places and people are still essentially the same, but the theme added on to enhances them. The theme change will last as long as the user of this power can maintain the change or until they leave the area. You cannot put two different themes on the same thing. Limited range.
summary: The ability to change the theme of any object, place, or person.
strengths: Can be used to "upgrade" items.
Can change and add utilities to an area.
Great for costume parties and trying new powers.
weaknesses: May need to be specific to get a desired outcome.
May not work on sentient things if they mentally resist.
If used to give superpowers, previous superpowers may be unavailable if they don't follow the theme.

name: Myself Power Tamer
description: This is the Myself Attribution Power; this power lets you gain all the powers you want, that Myself has made or will make. All 'Myself powers' that you gain (and any 'Myself Powers' that you already have) will have all their 'cons' taken away. You can choose which of the 'Myself Powers' to acquire and you can get them all instantly.
summary: The ability to gain all of the powers made by Myself, without suffering any of their cons
strengths: Myself has made soom excellent powers.
Useful.
Negate people's powers.
weaknesses: Myself didn't make every power on the site.
Myself didn't make many of the mainstream powers

name: Arcana: 4 The Emperor
description: This power lets you move however you want with your body. You can keep moving when it would be physically impossible to do so, like if your leg was broken or if your muscles were destroyed. This power lets you continue moving even if your body has died, with few ill effects. You are immune to pain your body feels and can even move it if you normally wouldn't be able to unless physically, and heavily, restrained.
summary: The ability to have absolute control of movement over your own body.
strengths: Can do things that you shouldn't physically be able to do.
Keep mobile while injured, or even dead.
weaknesses: Your mind (And soul) is stuck to your body, even if your body is totally destroyed.
A dead body still rots and smells, even if you can't feel it,

name: Crab Shell Armor
description: This ability allows you to generate crab-like armor all over your body. The armor provides great defense and minor heat and cold resistance. Along with the armor you can create large crab claws on your arms for a offensive weapon.
summary: The ability to generate crab-like exo-skeleton armor
strengths: Provides Defense
Provides an Offensive weapon
Armor is not as heavy as metal armor
weaknesses: Armor restricts movement

name: Age Extraction
description: This ability allows you to extract and release the essence of age from one person to another. You extract age through your left hand and release age through your right. The person's age only changes the person's body, not their minds.E.g. give a baby the age of a teenager, he/she will still crap their pants.
summary: The ability to transfer age to others
strengths: Help the seniors
Coal to diamonds
Get into R rated movies
weaknesses: Can't use on yourself
Run from the clingy seniors
Take care of the teen crapping in their pants

name: Legends: Fenrir.
description: With this power, the user conjures the mythical forces of the legendary Fenrir (literally meaning; Fen-dweller). The user gains the magnificent might of demon spawn, born of the Norse God, Loki, and the giantess, Angerboda. The user possesses a feral aptitude and transforms into a large wolf, the ability to grow stronger during battle, becomes massively invulnerable against all odds, has immense combative skills, unbreakable teeth and claws, and masters the use of an enchanted Uru hammer.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Wolf God.
strengths: The power can be activated at any given moment.
The user becomes as powerful as Fenrir himself.
The user is able to contend against the Gods with amazing powers!
weaknesses: The user may lose to a stronger God.
The user is susceptible to magic and psionic manipulation.
You might draw unwanted attention.

name: Ultimate Pain
description: With one touch, all your enemy's wounds that they ever received are brought back in one instant. This power cannot be turned off.
summary: The ability to return to the enemy every wound they have ever received.
strengths: Some people think you're cool.
You know you're awesome.
Watching people writhe is great.
weaknesses: You cannot shake anybody's hands.
You cannot make physical contact with anyone.
People fear you.

name: Language Conversion
description: The ability to convert languages, any known language even lost ones. All is possible, Japanese to English, English to Ancient Greek. The only condition is it has to be known to exist by at least two people, then it can be translated. You can choose if the original is translated or that a translated copy appears
summary: The ability to convert written language to another.
strengths: Instant text translations.
Any language, if known by two people.
weaknesses: You wont actually learn a new language.
You can be used for your skill.

name: Existence Renaming
description: This power won't let you go from living to undead for example, it lets you rename your living state. The new name for it must be known for someone to turn you into a zombie or give you immortality for example. The new name can be anything, but must incorporate a certain word in it. Ex. You're a living man: liv, bio, ani, vita or viv would have to be a part of the new name for your living existence, but aside from that, you could secretly rename yourself a abenVIVounenitiationounced man.
summary: The ability to rename your existential state and only have it changed by that name.
strengths: A new name can be as long as you want, as long as you don't have to catch your breathe.
You don't need to breathe.
weaknesses: Mind readers.
Knowledge powers.

name: Hogwarts Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport yourself and others to Hogwarts, the school for wizards. The power works both ways, so you can teleport yourself and other back from Hogwarts as well. You can send anything and anyone to Hogwarts, so if you're in the middle of a fight, you can just teleport your enemy to Hogwarts where he can be dealt with by the wizards.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself and others to Hogwarts
strengths: You can go to Hogwarts
You can teleport yourself back from Hogwarts
You can teleport your enemies to Hogwarts
weaknesses: You do not become a wizard when you go to Hogwarts

name: Kekkaishi
description: Just like in the show Kekkaishi you have the power to create Kekkai. Kekkai are barriers with six sides, such as a cube, with the length of the sides controlled by the creator. The Kekkai can be imploded, destroying what is within, or be used as a barrier. The Kekkai can be removed without having it imploded. The creator can also choose if something can pass through the barrier or not. Can do anything that is done in the show that involves the use of a Kekkai
summary: The ability to create and control Kekkai.
strengths: Create multipe barriers which can be imploded individually.
Many uses, such as shields, platforms, and cages.
Can be of any size, strength, and number.
weaknesses: Only able to use the Kekkai from Kekkaishi, not the other spells.
Kekkai can be broken by a stronger force.
The size, strength, and number of Kekkai is only limited by user's stamina.

name: Optical Illusion Inverted World
description: This power is a optical illusion which activates when the user snaps his or her finger producing a yellow spark that then turns into a gas which affects the person of your choice. It inverts an opponent's sense of direction. Up and down, left and right, as well as forward and backward are opposite. For example, I punch you in the right side of your face, but in reality I punched you in the left side of your face. The opponent will see an attack coming right but feel it on the left.
summary: The ability to invert someone's sense of direction
strengths: Ideal for group battle
The greatest trump card
What else do you think you can benefit from this?
weaknesses: Limited for 5min
Takes 30 sec to effect your opponent
You can only effect 3 people every 5min

name: Cross Blessing
description: With this ability, when you have available crosses, you can cause different effects, like making a cross with the blessing of wealth, or a cross with the blessing of strength. It can only be used for good purposes.
summary: The ability to bless people with different effects using crosses
strengths: Bless your allies with healing
Make backup crosses
Two sticks equal a cross
weaknesses: Can't do damage
Only uses good effects

name: Zero Barrier
description: This power activates when you are about to be struck with a fatal blow. The shield is nigh-inpenetrable, and will activate when the fatal blow will be struck. You can be struck by non-lethal blows, and you can be killed while unconsious
summary: The ability to generate a forcefield that only stops lethal blows
strengths: It's really hard to kill you
This shield protects you from almost anything
It activates instinctively
weaknesses: It only blocks fatal blows
You can still bleed to death
The shield doesn't work while your unconsious

name: Loyal Companion
description: The user's pet has super strength, speed, dog breath, and invulnerability and flight. The dog is big enough to ride and is completely loyal to it's owner. All the attributes of a normal dog but exaggerated.
summary: The ability to command a loyal superpowered dog
strengths: Super canine can kick all kinds of butt
Riding your steed aids in transportation, can fly places as well
Is completely loyal and will never leave your side unless commanded
weaknesses: All the problems of a normal dog, made super
Huge appetite
If you and your dog become seperated, you would have no powers around you

name: Dark Legions
description: Summon dark warriors of the dead to do your dirty work. But you can only summon 100 warriors at a time and the warriors are like humans but stronger , faster and smarter.the warriors die faster in battle and only live for 4 days.
summary: The ability to summon the dead armies
strengths: You get armies of dead warriors
The dead are strong and great warriors and are always loyal to you
The dead are armed with dark magic.
weaknesses: The dead only live for 1 week
You can only summon 100 dead warriors at a time
The dead are easier to kill in battle than humans

name: Blindfold Effect
description: With the blindfold effect you can turn anyone completley blind within a 20 yard radius. This effect is usually temporary but it can be permanent with enough concentration.
summary: The ability to blind anyone within a 20 yard radius.
strengths: Great defence mechanism
Confuse people
Make a quick getaway
weaknesses: Blinds everyone in the vicinity
Very hard to make permanent

name: Self Body Insertion
description: With this power, you can retain your much-needed powers when swapping bodies by inserting yourself into them. You will be limited to the target's powers and the ones you transferred while in their body, but you can reenter your body at will, regaining your powers.
summary: The ability to insert yourself into bodies you possess.
strengths: Retain your powers when your consciousness enters a different body.
Always have your body at hand, safe from harm.
If the possessed body dies, you automatically reenter your old body, assuming it could survive.
weaknesses: Only works if you enter a different body.
May be suspicious if your body appears or disappears in an unexplained manner.
If you gained this power when in another body, you may have a problem.

name: Super Gambler
description: The ability to a control a card. It's just a playing card, usually used by gamblers, magicians or anyone. You can change card's picture, levitate the card, can teleport the card, make the card sharp like a sword or strong like titanium or steel, and many more. You can use the teleport for yourself with this method: first, you make the card cling to your clothes, then teleport the card. In this way you can also teleport yourself, but with card clung to your clothes.
summary: The ability to control a card
strengths: You can win poker games or another game which uses a card
You can defeat your opponent easily by making a card explode like a bomb
You can be a great magician
weaknesses: Just a playing card you can control

name: E.K. Spikes
description: Though their configuration and appearance are somewhat odd, these 3-inch short metal spikes extend from your elbows and knees. The texture appears to be porous, but when you use them for combat, they can be moderately dangerous.
summary: The ability to possess retractable metal spikes within your elbows and knees.
strengths: They can prevent you from falling.
weaknesses: They can get attracted to large magnets.

name: Phosphorous Body
description: By striking your skin against itself rapidly (e.g. Snapping fingers) you can ignite like a phosphorous chemical, giving off immense amounts of heat and light. Eventually you burn out but you can just restrike yourself. Fun on Bonfire night (or the 4th of July or any firework based national holiday).
summary: The ability to burn like a phosphorous chemical
strengths: Can melt through a bank vault door just by walking into it, can melt bullets being fired at you
Anyone looking directly at you close up will be temporarily blinded or have their sight impaired
Can't be put out with water like a fire based power
weaknesses: Could accidentaly ignite, burning off your clothes and anyone you might be touching
Can't be much of a team player in a fight if any nearby teamates are blinded
Extremely unsafe, almost any type of floor you could stand on would melt or ignite.

name: Powered By Hope
description: You possess superhuman strength, flight and invulnerability which are strengthened by your own hope and the hope of those within a 100-mile radius. When alone and calm, you can bend iron bars and hover, but when powered by the hope of an entire city, you can lift over 100 tons.
summary: The ability to increase your powers by the hope of yourself and others
strengths: In theory, you can use massive super strength
When you are hopeful yourself, you possess considerable powers
You can become stronger than a foe if there are enough people around you
weaknesses: When you feel utter despair, you lose your powers
Have to live in a city with an optimistic population to use your full powers
Highly variable strength limit

name: Curiosity Doomed The Cat
description: When you have this power, anyone that is curious about your powers will become your toy. This works like this: you ask the other person if they want to know what your power is; then, you ask if they really want to know; if they say yes, then you exclaim your power is the power to control their fate since they wanted to know. By fate, it means you now control the person's past, present, and future - pretty much the other guy's entire life is in your hands.
summary: The ability to gain control over the fate of anyone who tries to find out what your power is by asking you
strengths: If a person is curious, then this will be too easy to use and a lot of people are naturally curious
This power is very broken
No one who knows what your power is can act against you
weaknesses: If a person knows what your power is from far away
If someone says that they dont want to know

name: Odontoblast Mimicry
description: Dentin is a type of bone only Odontoblast Mimics can secrete. While regular bones are vulnerable to acid, you have the option to make your dentin more resistant to acids when you secrete it. You can also telekinetically move substances containing calcium or phosphate within a short range and form tiny but extremely strong crystals out of them. Use these crystals to make your dentin harder. (Harder doesn't mean even more resistant to acid though)
summary: The ability to secrete dentin of any shape and manipulate calcium and phosphate within a short range.
strengths: Create bone structures that are more resistant to acids to those of Osteoblast Mimics.
You can use your own body (except your bones, see con 2) as a source of calcium and phosphate.
You can be a short-ranged lactokinetic.
weaknesses: The bones you create are more resistant to acid, but they are not immune to acids.
You can't manipulate calcium nor phosphate that have already been integrated into bones.
And therefore, you can't telekinetically manipulate bones, including the ones you create.

name: Eternal Dreaming
description: If you're like me, than you may find that reality just isn't good enough. With this power, you can escape reality permanently. Whenever you decide to activate this power, you will fall asleep and never wake up. In your sleep, you will forever be dreaming. Whatever happens to your physical body will not effect your dreaming. In your dreams, you will realize that you're dreaming, and from that point on, manipulate your dreams however you choose to. It will feel very much real, as if you're awake.
summary: The ability to fall asleep and dream forever
strengths: Manipulate your dreams and forever exist in your very own paradise
Dreams will feel just as real as reality, as if you're awake
You can find an escape from reality if you're unhappy with life
weaknesses: Everyone in reality will think you're in an unexplained coma
You will never see your REAL friends and family ever again
If you choose to activate this power, you can never wake up again, even if you want to

name: Reincarnation 4: Daily Back Up
description: This power is similar to Power Backup Ability; instead of making copies of your powers, every 24 hours it makes a backup of you and your live. When you die, your body heals itself to perfection from a backup. You will revive at the age of the back-up or when you acquired this ability. A new health problem will not be saved, but if you overcome one, it is. You revive instantly, but you are left powerless for 1 hour, leaving you vulnerable. Meaning you can't revive for an hour.
summary: The ability to make backups of your physical condition.
strengths: With a good enough strategy, you could be very hard to kill.
If your body overcomes a health issue, it will be copied.
Revive completely - age and all.
weaknesses: Takes a lot of time to build up a good number of backups.
You will be without powers for a short time - including this one.
If a killer waits for revival, they could kill you.

name: One True Protection
description: When you obtain this, it is sort of 'offline. ' It doesn't do anything until you arm it on one of your powers. You can change which power it's there for, until you actually need this power. At that point, it becomes locked in, utterly permanent. The power this is assigned to can never ever be denied to you. It can't be stolen, removed, negated, erased, altered, whatever. If you are targeted for your power or altered to prevent your use, you will still wake up when you would want to use the power
summary: The ability to be unable to be denied the use of one single power
strengths: An absolute and undeniable guarantee to a power
You don't have to choose anything, but you can choose when you want to
Doesn't follow the wording of this, but rather the concept
weaknesses: You can get this power multiple times (idea-wise, not site-wise), but each instance is one power
This power is utterly useless on its own, it needs another power to work with
Choosing a stupid power for this, having it locked in, then getting and losing a better one

name: Falcon Pawnch
description: The ability to make a flaming bird come from your fist. It is the strongest punch on the planet. You must yell "FALCON PAWNCH!" It has a five second charge before using it and after using this power, it completely drains you for 10 minutes.
summary: The ability to make a flaming bird come from your fist and destroy someone with a punch.
strengths: Destroy walls, vehicles, ect.
Extreme fire damage
Send superman through walls

Must yell "FALCON PAWNCH!"

name: Toy Fusion
description: When you pick up a toy eg. Buzz Lightyear, you become a life size version Buzz Lightyear with all the abilities of that toy and all
summary: The ability to become a life size version of any toy you want
strengths: You can become a real superhero
You can entertain children at parties
weaknesses: Becoming vechicles, stuffed animals and baby dolls would be usless

name: Neverending Sharpness
description: Any blade made of metal can be become permanently sharp with this power. It will never become duller but it can be made sharper than its current state.
summary: The ability to remove the possibility of dullness from a blade
strengths: Never need to sharpen or whet your blades ever again.
weaknesses: Just because it will never become duller doesn't mean it's as sharp as it can be.

name: Finger Daggers
description: You can turn your fingers into dagger blades that are still attached to your hands and back into regular fingers. Also, you can choose how many of your fingers turn into daggers at any given time.
summary: The ability to turn one's individual fingers into dagger blades
strengths: Your fingers are hidden weapons in plain sight.
You can never drop the daggers since they are attached to your hands.
weaknesses: Some rare versions of this power cannot turn the daggers back into ordinary fingers.

name: Half Elf
description: Someone with this power has higher dexterity and magical power than other beings. Also, they can move so silently that even those with enhanced hearing might not be able to hear them walk by. In addition, someone with this power has pointed ears and will always have a thin, lithe body.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-elf
strengths: You can cast spells more easily than most beings.
You can move around without people noticing you until you want to be noticed.
weaknesses: Dragons, full-elves, gods, demons, angels, and more can be far better spellcasters.

name: Power Shuffle
description: This power seeks out anyone that has superpowers in a area you designate, then reshuffles what everyone has. Every power is added to a single pool, which then randomly dolls out those powers to everyone that contributed to it. Receiving multiple powers is possible, but everyone who had their power added to the pool will receive at least one superpower back. This effect is permanent, with all powers being left with their new owners regardless of what you do after.
summary: The ability to randomly switch who has what super power in a given area.
strengths: Randomize the capabilities of every super human in an area.
If you arn't satisfied with your own powers, gamble on getting ones you like.
weaknesses: You have no control over who has what power after the shuffle.
This power is not exempt, and will be shuffled away as any power would.

name: Mirakuru Power
description: In Arrow, the Mirakuru Drug is sort of an evil version of the Super Soldier Serum. It makes you super strong, over Peak Human Levels, and almost invincible, even giving you a healing factor, but it also comes with the risk of driving you insane.  Explosives can still hurt you.
summary: The ability to have the power of the Mirakuru Drug from Arrow
strengths: Super Strong
Bulletproof
Healing Factor
weaknesses: Roid Rage
Hallucinations
Vulnerable To Explosions

name: Parisitic Energy Transmutate
description: When you are injured you can bond your body with any other person. You pretty much turn into an exo suit over tham. While you are taking in energy from them they can use all your other powers if you have any more. While you are bonded with this person you are aware of everything they do but you cannot do anything at all. If you bond with anyone with powers of their own Your combined strength is doubled while bonded. The bonding lasts for much shorter time periods with powered hosts.
summary: The ability to bond with any person in trade for their energy, they use all other powers you have.
strengths: Bond with anyone to heal your body.
You strength doubles when you bond with anyone with powers of their own.
You lend your other powers to the host body. This helps keep them from rejecting you.
weaknesses: You cannot control whats going on while you're bonded. Be careful who you connect with.
It takes time to heal, you could be stuck with each person you bond for days or even weeks.
It takes full skin to skin contact in order for this power to work, Could get weird amongst friends

name: Chains Of Typhon
description: Gain the ability to become the greatest monster in all of Greek mythology! You will be able to become a miniature version of the monster and be able to create earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, and all other manner of natural disasters. What you look like will depend on how much control you have over your ability, ranging from your normal uper body with a giant snake's lower body to being 100 feet tall with firey eyes and hundreds of serpent legs.

weaknesses: You have very little control of your own power at first
You can only start disasters, you cant stop them, not even your own
Not a very good power if your not into destroying stuff

name: Controlled Adrenaline
description: this power will allow you to activate your adrenal glands for as long as you want.Powers include increased strength,speed,quicker reflexes and thinking,and withstand pain more.

are stronger
are faster

name: Hand Manipulation
description: Hands can expand, elongate, compress, sharpen and change shape. Increasing size also increases the sizes of muscles without increasing the mass thus granting pseudosuperstrength but only in the fingers. If you wear gloves they will also have the same properties.
summary: The ability to change the size and shape of your hands

You can punch with big hands and pick up small things with a small hand
weaknesses: Only your hands can be manipulated

name: Gift: Lights
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling light than other beings. Thus their light-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of light from them. However, someone with this power can only receive light-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of light

name: Trick Arrows
description: This power allows the user to spawn any arrows used in any media (television,comics, and movies).  These can also be arrows that you can think up, but they have to be logical.
summary: The ability to spawn trick arrows used in any media.
strengths: Spawn trick arrows!
weaknesses: You have no bow, or quiver.
Must be logical if you create your own.

name: Shattering Person
description: This is an interesting power. If a truck were to hit you, intead you would shatter as soon it touched you. While shattered, you can reshape yourself. It sorta looks like liquid moving when you see it. You can also control your shatterability from china to plate glass. Also for some unkown reason, you will pass through glass. Your pieces can also teleport if they are somewhere else. You can also shatter certain parts of your body.
summary: The ability to shatter like glass.
strengths: You won't get hurt by blunt things
Broken bottle hand
Pass through glass

name: Name Strength
description: With this power you can have super strength whenever anybody on the same planet as you says your full name (i. E. Jonathan Robert Doe). After they say your name you have super strength for the next ten minutes. This power does not work if you say your own name of if you tell somebody to say your name.
summary: The ability to gain super strength whenever somebody says your full name
strengths: You can have super strength
weaknesses: They have to say your whole name
You can't say it yourself or tell other people to say it for you
It's only ten minutes

name: Delete This Mastery
description: the same
summary: The ability to combo
strengths: None.
weaknesses: None.

name: Untamed
description: This power (also called Untameability or Untamer) allows the user to create a barrier between them and those who possess a Tamer power of them so as to prevent the "Taming" that allows others to have all the powers created by the user. In addition the user gains an automatic immunity to all powers mimicked through tamers, though this is ineffectual if the person possesses a hard copy of the power being used. At advanced levels the user can even put up barriers for others who have tamers of them.
summary: The ability to be immune to and cancel the effects of tamer powers.
strengths: These barriers cannot be breached by Barrier Defiance.
Don't worry about Tamer powers gaining all abilities you made.
Acquired Total Immunity will not protect against this power even through having a hard copy.
weaknesses: The barriers will not defend against anything else other than protection of powers you have made.
Not much use if there is not a "Tamer" of you.
Only at advanced levels can barriers be spread.

name: Snap You're Dead
description: With this power, every time you snap your fingers, anybody who hears it will drop dead. All their body systems immediately shut down, and their soul automatically leaves their body. Sometimes the person's death is irreversible, but if you develop this power, the reversibility of the person's death can be decided. You might even be able to decide who can hear it. Either way, though, you should be careful when you snap your fingers with this ability.
summary: The ability to kill people every time you snap your fingers
strengths: Useful if surrounded by enemies
Immune to the effects yourself
Can sometimes be reversed by means like Resurrection, Revivification, Necromancy, etc.

name: Play Dead
description: Stop all body functions and start them later, giving you the genuine appearance of a dead person. Can move while doing this.
summary: The ability to stop all body functions and restart them later.
strengths: Play dead to avoid bears.
Play dead to avoid villains.
Play dead to copy your dog.

name: Vampire's Kiss
description: Your saliva is a potent drug that gives humans or humanoids extreme euphoria, intoxication, and lowered inhibitions. Absorption is near-instantaneous and can be delivered through skin contact or ingestion, but the lips provide the strongest path. Effects last roughly between thirty minutes to an hour, and a single drop dissolved in a glass of water is enough to induce effects. Those exposed to this drug develop a strong unconscious mental dependence which is attributed to you if you are present.
summary: The ability to secrete an immensely druglike saliva
strengths: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Your saliva is a two-pronged attack - it functions both chemically and magically.
The effect is the same on all humans and susceptible humanoids. There are no physical side effects.
weaknesses: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Delivery must be physically administered, which may already be challenging outside of combat.
Spiritual humanoids receive the narcotic only magically, which means halved strength.

name: Summerlands
description: Above
summary: The ability to concentrate hard enough on something and make it appear, also to VISIT the Summerlands
strengths: You always have everything you need
You are able to get away from danger quickly
You are fearless
weaknesses: Anyone can come with you
You can be easily discovered
You're too secretive

name: Thumbtack Grenade
description: You have the ability to summon a grenade in your hand. You can either throw it, use it as a close-combat weapon, or strike the ground with it. However, when it comes in contact with any solid surface besides your own body or clothing, it will explode. But instead of causing a normal explosion, it will shoot thumbtacks in every direction, in all kinds of colors. You cannot control the colors of thumbtacks you have.
summary: The ability to summon a grenade that sends out thumbtacks when exploding.
strengths: Have a weapon anytime you need one.
Can use it to cause pain to your enemies.
There are roughly one million thumbtacks released during each explosion.
weaknesses: They're only thumbtacks.
You could get hit by one.
You can't control what color thumbtacks fly out.

name: Quicklove
description: Make any girl instantly fall in love with you without a problem. All you have to do is concentrate and make eye contact.
summary: The ability to make any girl you want fall for you without problem
strengths: Easily get a girl
Have no problem getting any girl you want instantly
Get the girl of your dreams without question
weaknesses: It could end up hitting a girl you don't like

name: Pyramidal Neuron Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. You can understand electrical signals (only if they are meant to carry information) or special signals used by Neuron Mimics. After analysing them, and if you decide to give an order or send some other information, you can encode it and send it by generating electricity or the signals Neuron Mimics use. The greatest strength of Neuron Mimics is the formation of communication networks between them. They can put their intelligence together and act like a giant brain.
summary: The ability to perceive information out of electricity and shoot electricity to send messages.
strengths: It is not required to have received a message to send one. You can spontaneously shoot electricity.
You can understand electrical signals, though it's not guaranted you'll understand the message.
By networking with Neuron Mimics, you can discuss at light speed without speaking or writing.
weaknesses: You need help from Oligodendrocyte or Schwann Cell Mimics to send messages to other Neuron Mimics.
You need help from Astrocyte Mimics to receive messages from other Neuron Mimics.
If you're all alone, you won't be able to use this power's full strength.

name: Party Powers
description: Lets you mark people so that whenever they turn their power on non-lethal fireworks, lights, sounds, and confetti will periodically be released from their body until the power is turned off. Useful for annoying people and finding the location of people when they turn their power on. Confetti disappears after 30 seconds and fireworks after they explode. This power lasts on target until it is magically removed by user or some other power. Effects grow stronger if power is left on longer. Parties!!
summary: The ability to make confetti, lights, sounds, and even fireworks appear when a person uses their superpowers.
strengths: Amusing to watch.
Drive superpowered foes insane.
Easily find invisible or hiding foes.
weaknesses: Expect to be hated by the people you use this power on.
Only works on powers that can be turned on/off.
No offensive / defensive capabilities.

name: Pampered
description: Whenever this power is "activated", the user is automatically pampered by anyone and everyone they encounter. That's all there is to it. And because of the effect this power has on people, the user is immune to making enemies. And don't worry about getting tired of being pampered because that only happens in movies, how does someone get tired of being pampered, nobody does in real life!
summary: The ability to be pampered by everybody
strengths: Everyone pampers you
Immune to making enemies
Most-likely won't get tired of being pampered
weaknesses: Some people might get tired of being constantly pampered (if they're weird! )

name: Beserker Rage
description: Vikings did it. Indonesians called it 'running amok'. But it's really an ability called Beserker Rage, where a person can induce a state of enhanced strength, speed, agility, endurance, and ingenuity. However, this ability comes with a price: while in this state, the user's mind is in primal mode. They are only influenced by pain and rage, cannot remember anything, and are an equal threat to friend and foe.
summary: The ability to go into a beserk state with enhanced attributes
strengths: Escape is simple
You against 100 people
Multiple enhanced attributes
weaknesses: Equal threat to friend + foe
Cannot remember what happens in beserk state
Rage wearing off in middle of fight

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Cherubim
description: Cherubim have been described as the most fearsom and intimidating angels in the hierarchy. The Cherub is said to have four faces: one of each a man, an ox, a lion, and an eagle. The ox is considered as the "true face". The Cherub also has four conjoined wings covered with eyes and the feet of an ox. Cherubim usually reign in strength and lightning-fast speed; buzzing about like lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to become an angel of protection.
strengths: Strike fear into your enemies as they cower before your presence.
Your strength and power is second to none.
weaknesses: May frighten loved ones.

name: Motivator
description: With this power you can incite a strong, burning passion in those around you. The feeling can only be described as a strong desire to accomplish something together. Whether it be a class project, construction work, or a presentation, the people surrounding you will have an insatiable hunger for achievement. With concentration, you can use this power on yourself. This power is always "on" and cannot be turned off, but with time and mastery, you can suppress it almost completely.
summary: The ability to motivate people to achieve common goals.
strengths: Everywhere you go, people make things happen
You'll be paid a ton of money just to show up
Waiting in line at the DMV
weaknesses: At parties, "accomplish" may be a loose term
You might just want to kick back with friends

name: Myth Killer
description: This ability emanates from the firm but unconscious disbelief of a person to mythological beings. By his mere presence anything that is mythical in nature ceases to exist.
summary: The ability to kill mythological beings and anything associated to them.
strengths: Obliterates the existence of myth whatever its form.
Disbelief is your ultimate weapon.
weaknesses: Only works against Mythical creatures and powers.
You are unaware of this ability and those who are affected by it.
Fate, Belief, or Fascination towards anything mythological destroys this ability.

name: Hair Blades
description: With this power, one can turn their hair into blades attached to their head and back into hair. The blades' movement can be controlled so long as the blades are attached by hair to the head. One can have any number of blades so long as there is enough hair and can lengthen hair to extend the blades' range or to make bigger blade(s).
