Maximum range of blades while attached to hair is 100 m. Minimum length of blade is 1 cm. Blades will stay together for 3 hours after being detached from head.
summary: The ability to turn one's hair into blades and control the blades
strengths: Always have a weapon as long as one has hair.
Can make the hair longer to extend the range of the blades.
weaknesses: Blades can be used by others if detached.
Hair must still be attached to head.
Can only send hair a maximum of 100 m away.

name: Mirror Control
description: You can control the visual appearance, physical and chemical composition, and the location/movement of any mirror within 50 metres of your position.
summary: The ability to control mirrors that are near one
strengths: You can have the mirrors act as shields against light-based attacks.
weaknesses: If there are no mirrors around.

name: Ignorance Manipulation
description: You can control what people are ignorant about and make them want to know more or less about whatever you want.
summary: The ability to manipulate what people are ignorant about
strengths: Ambassadors, diplomats, and important etiquettes.
Diplomacy is based on not being ignorant.
Make assassins not want to know anything about you.
weaknesses: Pro: Knowledge is half the battle.

name: Super Stickiness
description: Things stick to you like glue when you have an adhesive body! You can also stick onto surfaces! Talk about stickers!
summary: The ability to stick onto things, or stick things onto you
strengths: Stick your property onto you for easy carriage.
Stick onto surfaces & climb them. You can even walk on ceilings like an insect!
Enemies will stick onto you, too, slowing down their attacks!
weaknesses: There are some things that you don't want to stick onto you, like the sharp edges of knives!
Other sticky surfaces will be more difficult to get off of, since you're sticky, too.
Stickers, tape, & glue will be more difficult to peel off of you if you want to peel them off.

name: Virus Scanner
description: Who knows what people are carrying nowadays. Well, now you will! This ability allows you to know the full virus/disease history of anyone you meet, including yourself. You'll know their current afflictions, and past ones as well.  And of course your chances of contracting STDs will plummet. You also know how to cure, though you might not be able to (two different things)
summary: The ability to know what viruses or diseases people have.
strengths: Avoid all STDs
Be one badass doctor
Dr. House will have nothing on you
weaknesses: Packed elevator rides
Shaking hands
Knowing the histories of co-workers

name: Mirror
description: Anything you feel they will feel.
summary: The ability to make others feel what you feel
strengths: Dish out a whole lot of Karma
You die they die
weaknesses: You have to hurt yourself to do any damage
You cant say that didnt hurt

name: Four Eyes: Elemental Control
description: This power is gained by having the Four Eyes power and having only the two normal eyes and upper/right eyes open. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power.
summary: The ability to utilize one element per eye
strengths: Can control four elements.
Can still use other Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have had Four Eyes and had only the normal and upper/right eyes open.
Cannot choose which element each eye allows control of when open.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Ambush Detector
description: Picture this somebody you know has been kidnapped. You receive a note telling you to meet the kidnappers somewhere. You think to yourself: maybe this is some sort of a trap. Well, with this power you can detect an ambush from thirty yards away and replan your rescue accordingly.
summary: The ability to detect an ambush from thirty yard away
strengths: You can detect if you're walking right into an ambush from thirty yards away
weaknesses: You have to be at most thirty yards away

name: Follower
description: With this power, the end receiver will be placed in a trance, where they must follow another person (that you choose) no matter where they go. They will always know where your designated "leader" is, and will follow them at all costs wherever they go. When the follower reaches the leader, they will stand as close to the leader as possible without touching them. This can get pretty damn annoying, especially when you make multiple people follow someone. Snapping your fingers releases all followers
summary: The ability to cause anyone to follow another person (physically) at all costs
strengths: Use as self defense
Mess with your buddies
weaknesses: Snapping your fingers releases ALL followers, not just ones you choose

name: Dark Eyes
description: Rules: Must have skin-to-skin contact. You must be conscious to use it. You can use it only until you run out of energy
summary: The ability to blind people
strengths: People tend to leave you alone
Helps in sticky situations
weaknesses: Black eyes that are ridiclously sensitive to light
Very hard to control; this power is linked strongly to your emotions
People fear you

name: Pain Drain
description: An ability best in the hands of someone selfless, you take the physical pain away from someone, making you feel that pain, so they don't have to. The damage will still be inflicted on the individual, but you take the pain away, easing their suffering.
summary: The ability to take the pain, when someone is inflicted with physical pain.
strengths: Drain the pain from those damaged, so they don't have to.
Ease the suffering of a terminally ill patient.
Not absorbing the damage.
weaknesses: Stating this boldly, a painful ability to use.
Damage is still inflicted.

name: Summon Leviathan
description: With this power you can summon the Leviathan a sea serpent that can breathe fire and has super sharp teeth and almost impenetrable skin. The Leviathan is under your complete control but it can't walk on land so this power is useless unless you're fighting in or at least near a body of water. When you're done with it you can just send it back to wherever it came from.
summary: The ability to summon the Leviathan
strengths: You can summon a sharp toothed, fire breathing sea serpent to help you
The Leviathan is under your complete control
weaknesses: It can't walk on land so you need to be in or at least near water for this power to be effective

name: Math
description: You would be able to subtract,add,mutiply,or divide anything with different results. For ADD-you can add any thing to anything else. Power,size,strength,speed and any other characteristic. For SUBTRACT-you can subtract any characteristic. For MUTIPLY-you can mutiply anythings characteristics. For DIVIDE- you can divide anythings charactistics.
summary: The ability to control reality with math
strengths: Educational power!
Mutiply uses
weaknesses: Educational power
Must be good at math
You might hate math

name: Free Association Prediction
description: A person with this power can know anything through free association. They can tell the future or even figure out the answer to questions on a test. Free association is stringing related words together. Unfortunately, this power is hard to control since the user could go off in wild tangents before getting the information that they are looking for.
summary: The ability to figure out any sort of truth via free association
strengths: Tell the future
Get rich
weaknesses: No one will believe you (at first)
You are right for the wrong reasons
Hard to control where your predictions end at

name: Tardigration
description: Nature has equipped the animal species known as tardigrades with a whole arsenal of survival skills and abilities that allow them to, for example, survive being cooked at over 100 degrees celsius or being radiated by thousands of gamma rays. Also, they can survive without water for years and can stay alive in the vacuum of space. This superpower allows you to adapt this biological protection and to use it to become "as tough as a tardigrade".
summary: The ability to use a tardigrade's unique survival skills.
strengths: You will survive pretty much anything.
You won't need to eat or drink for years.
weaknesses: You will also adapt other features of a tardigrade. For example, you look like a tardi-human-hybrid.

name: Delete This Cannon Punch
description: Your left hand will turn red. You'll then get the chance to lunge toward your opponent by driving your fist through them. After it's done, your left fist will let out some steam.
summary: The ability to glowingly fly forward with your fist and push them against the wall.
strengths: This is just a regular flying power!
weaknesses: None.

name: Ultimate Sidekick
description: A person with this power has all the abilities and strengths of every sidekick in existence and can use multiple abilities simultaneously. However, they can only access these powers if they are the sidekick of a hero. In addition as a sidekick, they are not allowed to outperform the hero in popularity, doing so will make them lose their powers since they are no longer a sidekick.
summary: The ability to emulate the power of any sidekick to any hero or villain from any published source
strengths: You have a lot of power, speed, and other capabilities
You are actually stronger than the hero/villain most of the time
weaknesses: No matter how strong you are, you are still treated as the sidekick
If you try to be better than the hero in public view, you will lose your powers.
You need to find a hero/villain to be a sidekick of.

name: Spinekinesis
description: The ability to grow spines and have control over all spines. You can grow spines as weaponry or break opponents' spines with a thought. You can cause paralysis by blocking signals coming from the brain, or cure it if caused by the spine. If you have this power, your body can't be taken over by mind-controlling powers because you can replace the signals going to your muscles. In the same way, you can control how other people's bodies move, unless they have direct muscle control outside the spine.
summary: The ability to create and have complete control over spines.
strengths: Spine-based offense / defense
Cause or cure paralysis
Can control signals going through the spine to control or prevent bodies from being controlled.
weaknesses: May be painful if you decide to grow spines from your body.
Ineffective if people can control their body with other means besides signals through the spine.
Takes focus to grow spines that are not grown from your own body

name: Half Raiju
description: Someone with this power has claws and fangs as well as furry wolf,cat,monkey or weasel ears and a wolf-,cat-,monkey- or weasel-like tail. They will have higher strength,speed,and magical power especially for lightning magic. They can also transform into lightning at will and transform back into their normal forms. Use of the lightning form comes at a cost of extreme pain all over the body though. Also, as a Raiju is a servant of the gods a Half-Raiju only needs to bow down to gods and demi-gods
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-raiju
strengths: You are far more powerful than most beings.
For the most part you don't have to do what others want you to do unless you want to.
Note: Raiju translates as 'Lightning Beast' but is often depicted as a wolf, weasel, cat or monkey.
weaknesses: You have to do what gods and demigods order you to do.
The lightning form is a definite last resort.

name: Gargoylenesis
description: This ability allows you to transform oneself into a powerful gargoyle with skin of stone. You can fly (with wings), perform incredible feats of maneuverability in midair, change your skin shade to blend in with different types of stone, and rip boulders from the ground to hurl. However, you must be very focused and concentrated to become a gargoyle, and it does tax your energy quite a bit, although no extra energy is used once one has transformed.
summary: The ability to transform oneself into a gargoyle made of stone
strengths: You can become a gargoyle with the powers of flight
You become very strong, fast and agile
Chameleon-like abilities
weaknesses: Takes enormous amount of focus to become, cannot be rushed.
You are terrifying and may cause innocent civilians to run to their doom off the edges of buildings
Takes a fair amount of energy to activate

name: Human Bouncing Ball
description: Whenever you or a part of your body is hit by a blunt impact, you or your body part will bounce without suffering any internal damage. The same goes if you hit something. You will still be able to cause damages, but the recoil of your hits will make you spring away. You can't be hurt if you hit yourself. This power is always active, so you can't turn it off and you are forever immune to blunt impacts.
summary: The ability to bounce upon impact.
strengths: You are immune to blunt damage.
If you fall to the ground, you will bounce in the air.
If you are punched, you can bounce against a wall and hit them back.
weaknesses: Always active. So, be careful if you accidently or impulsively hit something.
You have little control over your bounces.

name: Interbody Transfer
description: Ever had to empty your bladder, but you can't get to the bathroom, but you see someone else going in? You can teleport your urine into their bladder instead. Teleport your kidneys to a child in need. Teleport the spoiled food you just ate into someone else's stomach. Teleport that bullet you just took into your attacker's brain. But, you cannot take things from others, only send them. Just be careful what you send. The only limit is what's inside of you at the moment. Got cancer? Not anymore.
summary: The ability to teleport anything inside your body to someone else's body.
strengths: Remove any offending objects from your own body
Never worry about diseases, viruses, or anything else invading your body
Can send away objects that are even partially in your body, but only the part that is inside of you
weaknesses: The objects must go into someone else's body.
You must know about the object to purge it
To teleport dangerous things into people, they first have to be inside of your own body

name: Pokemon Maker
description: You can make your own pokemon with ease.
summary: The ability to create your own pokemon
strengths: You have cool pokemon you can make
Be the envy of your peers
weaknesses: Pokemon may suck
You might not be creative

name: Cursed Regeneration
description: A person with this power has been cursed to become a servant of some other being eventually. However in the mean time, they have the access to regenerative abilities that regrow their bodies to the ones desired by the one who granted the curse. The regrown body parts are indestructible and can give the user of this curse superstrength. However this curse can only be given by someone that dislikes you and they might send hoardes of soldiers to injure you more.
summary: The ability to regenerate except the cells destroyed are replaced with indestructable cursed cells
strengths: Can regenerate from fatal injuries
The new cells are indestructable
Cursed muscle cells give you some degree of superstrength
weaknesses: The person that cursed you must be someone that dislikes you.
Once your whole body becomes cursed you will become the eternal servant to whoever cursed you
The cursed cells prevent you from killing the person that cursed you

name: Sawtooth Fingerprint
description: With this ability you are a covert killer. You can push small sawtooth blades from beneath the skin in your fingers. These blades pop up from between the grooves of your fingerprint and are incredibly sharp. Slice, dice, cut, rip, and shred with your ten deadly digits.
summary: The ability to push small sawtooth blades from between the grooves of your fingers
strengths: A weapon at your fingertips (litterally)
A covert and concealed power
Blades stay sharp
weaknesses: Forgetting to retract the blades
Accidentally cutting yourself

name: Masculinization
description: Someone affected by this power will become more masculine in both mind and body. They will start to act like how they think a proper guy acts. Their body will also bulk up and they will gain a fully masculine body (legs, abdomen, arms, etc). Females affected by this will still act feminine, but more tomboy-ish.
summary: The ability to cause someone to become more masculine
strengths: They will be unaware that they are changing until pointed out.
weaknesses: Can be reversed, but only by other powers.

name: Tournament Field
description: You can choose an area of 4 square kilometers in which people are allowed to enter with a group of no less than 3 beings. While in the area only one person can fight at a time. If someone tries to attack an enemy while a member of their group is fighting someone else, the whole group immediately gets a cruel and unusual punishment game. The game chosen is random every single time. Don't bother trying to avoid the punishment game, because that results in death for anyone who tries.
summary: The ability to create a battlefield area where only one person in a group of three can fight at a time
strengths: Great to lure enemies into and hire mercenaries.
Telling allies the restrictions but not enemies or people who wander into the area.
Setting up cameras to watch the punishment games.
weaknesses: Punishments affect friends as well as enemies.
Have to manually alter the terrain yourself, this power only designates the zone.
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Tattoo Artist
description: With this power you can cause yourself or others to suddenly have tattoos anywhere on their body. You can send people messages by causing words to appear on their body or frighten people by causing scary images to appear on them. Or you know you could break your brother out of prison by hiding the blueprints of a maximum security prison in tattoos on your body.
summary: The ability to give yourself and others tattoos with your mind
strengths: You can cause tattoos to appear on yourself or others
You can cause the tattoos to disappear whenever you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
If the person's body is already covered in tattoos this power has no affect on them

name: Chew Bubblegum And Kick Ass
description: If you are chewing gum, once you spit it out, it will have a different effect. E. G. Juicy Fruit will create a stun effect to whoever you spit it on.
summary: The ability to spit out gum accurately with different effects depending on what flavor it is
strengths: More reasons to chew bubble gum
Nice tasting power
High accuracy
weaknesses: You need material to use your powers
You might not like the flavor of the best acting powers
It will cost money to use the power

name: Uncuttable Skin
description: A person with this power has skin that is uncuttable. No sharp or even remotely sharp weapon or object can cut his or her skin.
summary: The ability to have skin that cannot be cut or stabbed by any bladed or remotely sharp object
strengths: Can go head to head with any criminal or open that loves to use bladed weapon.
Can fight crime.
weaknesses: If the user is injured internally, operation will be almost impossible because scalpels cant be used
No other super human strength or abilities, unless the user trains themselves to combat crime
Injuries caused by kinetic force, lasers, or magic can hurt the user

name: Tornado Spin
description: Just like the Tasmanian Devil (Taz) from Looney Tunes, you can spin extremely fast, until you become like a miniature tornado. The speed and strength of the spin depends, and can get stronger with practice, but usually is strong enough to tear through obstacles, and deflect projectiles (even to tunnel into the ground). Spinning, no matter what speed, never makes you dizzy.
summary: The ability to spin incredibly fast like a mini tornado
strengths: Turn into a mini-tornado or a human drill
Tear through obstacles, deflect obstacles and drill through things
Never get dizzy, no matter how long or how fast you spin
weaknesses: You're a destructive force if you cannot control yourself
Still get tired (can't spin forever)

name: De Zombinizer
description: If anyone or everybody is bitten and/or infected, the De-Zombinizer allows you to turn people back to their normal state just by releasing a lime mist with a gesture of your hand.
summary: The ability to transform zombies back to their normal selves.
strengths: Can cure any or everyone who's totally zombified.
weaknesses: It won't work on long dead zombies risen from their graves.

name: Pokemon Taker
description: Take pokemon out of their card or game, the pokemon you take out are not limited to the moves they have in the game or card. It is limited to what TM and HM moves they can learn and what level they are.
summary: The ability to take pokemon out of their card or game.
strengths: You can bring pokemon to life.
weaknesses: They'll probably leave and steal things.
They could kill others.

name: Townsaver
description: Also called the sword of fury, Townsaver's power only activates if unarmed people are in danger. Townsaver then augments its strength and speed to the point that it could slay entire armies. While Townsaver is drawn, its user cannot die by any means regardless of injuries. Also, while its power is active, the user MUST help those in danger. It is impossible for them not to. After the fighting has stopped, all the strength and speed disappear, and if the person is badly wounded they will die.
summary: The ability to wield the sword of fury
strengths: Super-strength, Speed, and Limited Invulnerability
Increased combat ability
Well balanced, super sharp sword, resistant to most damage
weaknesses: Once the fighting is over, you go back to normal
You have to help people
The sword will use you as a human shield if necessary, and hurt you to protect people.

name: Power Food
description: Basically, when you ingest any food, this power can convert it into three things: healing, super-strength, or energy manipulation. This power only lasts for the specific day that you ate the food on. Oh and on rare occasions, if you ingest spicy food, you spit fire out of your mouth with heats reaching up to 2,000 degrees.
summary: The ability to eat any food and convert the energy to use as a power.
strengths: Two things that I love: kicking butt and eating!
weaknesses: Stomach ache if you eat a lot of food!
When your power finishes, you are highly fatigued.
The weight that you gain after eating all that food

name: Visible Music
description: When you sing or use a musical instrument, you can see notes attacking or blocking the attacks of your enemies
summary: The ability to create a visible symphony line to block or attack
strengths: Create an impenetrable note barrier and protect people
You can put enemies to sleep by singing a lullaby
You can deafen your enemies
weaknesses: Can easily damage your voice
Notes only last as long as you continue singing
Can cause lung problems

name: Rave Light
description: This ability gives the user the freedom to manipulate light that emits from glow-in-the-dark objects and form it into anything, but can only be done if it's dark or there is only little light present in the room. So the user must always carry a source of light (ex. Glow stick, etc.) to be able to use it, therefore the ability always ends up as a colorful display of shiny lights.
summary: The ability to manipulate chemiluminescence. (glow-in-the-dark)
strengths: Can be formed to be as soft as light or as hard as a rock.
It's versatility is it's strong point. Ex. Platforms, shields, projectiles etc. )
Very appealing to the eyes.
weaknesses: Can only be used to it's climax if in a pitch black environment.
Needs a source of light to be used. Ex. Glow in the dark accessories , etc. )
Very weak or nothing at all in the daylight.

name: Soothsayer
description: When you touch anyone you will know when, where and how that person will die. Be death's enemy or audience.
summary: The ability to see exactly when, where and how a person will die
strengths: You can tell anyone how much time is left in their life
You could make loads of money
You could try to stop person's death or be a sicko and just watch
weaknesses: Your power is always active, so to your intimacy will probably be depressing
If you help someone escape death, they will die another, more horrible way very soon after
Your death gets more difficult to see every time you see another's death

name: Holy Power: The Avenger
description: With this power you can "activate" the Avenger mode. You gain a powerful energy armor and the powers of the Avenger. While using the avenger you get Invulnerability, Super Strength and Superhuman Senses and Super Speed. You also become able to use all the other Avenger ability's. To acquire the Avenger you need Six Paths of Light, and you need to send a dying innocent to heaven, and his killer to hell.
summary: The ability to use the powers of The Avenger, the first Path of Light.
strengths: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Avenger.
Makes you totally immune to external damage.
Allows you to use the Avenger Shield, who brings death to all the ones who are guilty.
weaknesses: Hard to get.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Fearless
description: This ability makes you unable to feel any fear. There would be no fight or flight response. You would not feel any reason to avoid the dangerous situation, because you don't even fear death.
summary: The ability to never feel fear at all in any situation
strengths: Never feel fear ever again.
Never fear death.
Never have a fight or flight response.
weaknesses: No apparent reason to escape danger.

name: Past Life Transformation
description: Everyone has past lives and with this power you can transform into them. Any talents or traits you may have had in a past life, you can have them now with this power by transforming into your past life.
summary: The ability to transform into your past lives
strengths: Your past lives could have been rich or famous
weaknesses: Sometimes you have bad past lives

name: Spawn: Greek Shelters
description: You are able to spawn spacious,comfortable shelters where you can sleep and lounge.  Since they are based off the greek pantheon and the titans you gain special features for each cabin spawned.  Dionysus's cabin will have a big party room, Athena's will have a library, etc.  Each will have at least 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a large kitchen, and a book shelf with exclusive greek history of all the hero's, wars, and everything in between.
summary: The ability to spawn greek shelters based on their gods/goddesses.
strengths: Good if you are lost and want to rest.
Each is very spacious and comfortable.
weaknesses: Somethings are just scary (Phobus's cabin)
Some may involve you do dangerous things (A sparing arena in Are's cabin)
They are not protected on the outside.

name: Mime Control
description: Worried of mimic power users? Transform yourself into a mime and fully control them by your body actions and gestures.
summary: The ability to control mimic power users.
strengths: You can use your other abilities while this is activated.
This cannot be copied or absorbed.
Make fun of others.
weaknesses: Works only for mimic ability users.
Control only one person at a time.
Kick your victim, you'll be kick as well(unless you teleport,etc. To avoid)

name: Scar Empowerment
description: The larger the number of scars you have the higher your physical strength, endurance, and speed are, as well as all other powers you have being boosted by 1% for each scar you have. In order to gain this power one person has to punch OR kick you 10,000 times at full force.
summary: The ability to be empowered by the number of scars one has
strengths: Having this power, 'Blades of Pain', and 'Scarred'.
weaknesses: An enemy with 'Scarred' can make this power useless.
Getting lots of scars will hurt and take time.

name: Acid Immunity
description: No acid will ever hurt someone with this power.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by acids of any kind and strength
strengths: You can still digest food since the acid isn't hurting you.
Enemies with only powers having to do with acid.
weaknesses: Bases can still hurt you.

name: Osmosis Manipulation
description: Osmosis is essential to the human body; we use it when we breathe, cells get nutrients with it, and we couldn't live without it. This process is now in your power! With this ability, you can take in substances through your skin like oxygen, water, etc. You can also mess around with other people's osmosis so their cells don't get enough oxygen.
summary: The ability to control your osmosis and that of people around you
strengths: Take in more oxygen than your lungs normally do, drastically reducing the need to breathe.
Stop your enemies' cells from getting any nutrients, thereby destroying their major organs.
Change anything else in the world that requires osmosis.
weaknesses: You are more susceptible to poison.
Your chances of getting sick increases when you use your power: skin is part of the immune system.
Swimming in salt water causes your blood pressure to skyrocket.

name: Body Fat Manipulation
description: With this power, the user can use their own weight for multiple purposes. For example, one could make the fat on the front of their body become bulletproof or even use fat to enhance their strength. One of the many other applications of this power is to burn it rapidly, granting a massive energy boost (such as for powers) but it makes you lose your fat--a precious resource. The holder can store a limited amount of fat extra-dimensionally. With training, you can control your metabolism.
summary: The ability to manipulate body fat.
strengths: To prepare for a fight, simply become obese.
You can steal fat from others.
Can give regenerative stem cells.
weaknesses: If you can't gain weight easily, this is pointless.
There are some powers that prevent weight gain.
There are plenty of medical conditions which can cause weight loss.

name: Beautification Vision
description: With this ability, one merely has to look at an individual and they will immediately express the standard of beauty in that time and place for a person of their race and gender. For instance, all will become young and females will enjoy low body fat while males will experience enhanced muscle tone. Once transformed, they will revert back over time, but the effect can be reapplied. There will be no consequences before, during or after the transformation, nor after reverting.
summary: The ability to induce the current standard on any individual through sight.
strengths: Can be applied to yourself by simply looking at any part of yourself.
Change others to boost self esteem or even financial reward.
If applied continuously, targets can enjoy eternal youth and immunity to any disfiguring illnesses.
weaknesses: Restricted to the general standard of beauty, not your own.
Cannot bring back then dead (cannot restore someone to the beauty inherent in life).
Cannot cure diseases, only remove the visible signs of them.

name: Resurrection Sacrifice
description: If you bring back to life one person, you will offer one year of your lifespan. Two persons, two years, etc.
summary: The ability to bring someone who died to life again by offering certain years of your lifespan
strengths: You can bring your lovers to life
weaknesses: Your lifespan will be reduced
You can bring back one person each year
You will feel weak after using this power

name: Melanopsin Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. While exposed to light, especially a blue light, you can convert it into electricity, as well as special signals, and your body clock will remain stuck to wakefulness, keeping you alert and active no matter how much sleep you need. By sending the signals to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you may make them see what you see, though it will be unconsciously, as well as keep them awake. Also, this power responds slowly to changes of lighting.
summary: The ability to stay awake when exposed to light, convert light into electricity and make people see what you see.
strengths: You can electrocute someone when you're exposed to light.
The brighter and bluer the light, the more effective this power will be.
Feeling sleepy? Take a light therapy.
weaknesses: When you go from darkness to light, this power needs time to activate.
When you go from light to darkness, this power needs time to deactivate.
You can make people see what you see, but they may not notice as it affects unconscious sight.

name: Emotional Body Color Change
description: With this power you can change your skin color depending on your emotion. You can turn this power on and off whenever you want. When you're angry you turn red, happy yellow, sad blue, lovestruck pink, confused purple, determined orange, excited green, scared white, brave gray. This is good if you want to be able to camouflage with something all you have to do is feel a certain emotion and you change colors. The stronger you feel the emotion the darker the color is. You can use this on others too
summary: The ability to change your skin color depending on your emotion
strengths: You can change your color by feeling emotions
You can turn the power on and off
You can use it on others to see what they're feeling
weaknesses: Not much use in combat

name: Instant Friends
description: You want to be friends with someone right, but they hate you, use this power, and presto! You got a new friend. It also works on celebrities too.
summary: The ability to make anyone your friend.
strengths: Get friends quick.
Be able to go to more parties.
Meet celebrities.
weaknesses: There is such as thing as too many friends
Friends may fight for your attention

name: Endless Passageway
description: This power can affect any delimited area used for passage, such as corridors, roads, bridges, stairs, ladders, walkways or tunnels. You can make one end of any passageway unreachable. So, anyone who enters from the unaffected end will have the impression of advancing, but the other end will never get closer to them. Their only way out is to go back the way they came, unless you decide to switch your power to the other end.
summary: The ability to make the end of a passageway unreachable.
strengths: You can protect your secret hideout by affecting the passageways leading to it.
You can make a maze unexitable by affecting the very last corridor.
With practice, you can discriminate who should be stuck in the passageway and who may pass.
weaknesses: They can still reach the other end if they step out of the boundaries of the passageway.

name: Human Jack Hammer
description: When you jab or punch an object it will be slowly smashed or worn down because your fist is super hard and it moves very fast.
summary: The ability to smash an object by rapidly jabbing or punching it
strengths: Can easily destroy an obstacle in your way.
weaknesses: Bad if you jab a human.

name: Gift: Emotions
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling emotions than other beings. Thus their emotion-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of emotions from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve emotion-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of emotions
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over emotions as someone with this power.
Emotion-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only emotion-based powers now.

name: Unison Raid
description: This last a relatively short amount of time, but allowes to increase overall power as well as utility of skills. 1st Person gains all the powers of the 2nd person, and the 2nd person, losing their body, follows the 1st as a ghost, untill Unison Raid is cancelled.
summary: The ability to combine two individuals and their powers into one body.
strengths: Increases overall power.
Allows for the 1st person to use powers without having to worry about co-ordinating with a teammate.
Gives full understanding and mastery of powers for the duration.
weaknesses: Having one fighter instead of two.
Takes up extra energy to maintain, versus fighting as two separate individuals.
Can't be used too often for fear of losing personality.

name: Sunstone
description: The sunstone looks like a multicolored jewel necklace with beads and magatama with limitles solar power. It can be combine with any weapon like the moon blade to enhance  its abilities,repair it if they both get damaged or destoryed, and can combine the weapon with your body.
summary: The ability to use this jewel to enhance weapons
strengths: Enhances the moon blade abilities
Repair if damaged or destoryed
combine your weapon to your body
weaknesses: stay combined too long with your weapon and you will remain like that
going super nova will over heat you and your weapon

name: Fish Control
description: With this poer you have complete control over any species of fish, including sharks. If you're fighting underwater, you can have a shark or swordfish come and attack your enemy. You could also use this power to cheat in fishing competitions.
summary: The ability to control any species of fish
strengths: You can control any species of fish
You can make sharks and swordfish attack your enemies
You can cheat in fishing competitions
weaknesses: Has no use if you're not fighting in or at least near the water
Has no affect on sea mammals

name: Vocal Powered Strength
description: A person with this power has superstrength but only when they are talking. The good thing is that their strength increase the louder that they speak. However the limitation of talking can be very troublesome especially if people know about this weakness. For example, if you are gagged you cannot use your superstrength. Also is someone uses gas or other corrosive it can hurt your lungs.
summary: The ability to have superstrength when you are talking
strengths: Your voice gives you superstrength
The louder you speak the more powerful you get--there is no limit
weaknesses: If you cannot speak then this power is useless ie sickness, gagged, etc.
Swallowing flies, getting hit with tear gas, having objects crammed down to shut you up
Can't use this to do a surprise attack

name: Mole Detector
description: With this power you will know if their is a traitor or mole within your team or group. If a person is secretly revealing information or fighting for your enemies you will instantly know who it is and how they are interacting with the enemy. With practise, you can sense betrayal in other groups too.
summary: The ability to sense if there is a mole within your team or group
strengths: You will know if their is a mole or traitor within your team or group
With practise, you can sense betrayal in other groups too
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
No use if their is no traitor or mole

name: Unsnappable
description: Powers that need a snap to activate can't have any effect on you.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that are activated by snapping
strengths: Snap power immunity
weaknesses: None

name: King Of The Super Gators
description: With this power you can summon and control super powered alligators. The alligators can fly, breathe fire, have super strength, enhanced agility, sharp teeth and bulletproof skin. You can summon up to 20 super gators at a time and can unsummon them when you're done with them. The gators can stand on their two hind legs but cannot speak or write only communicating through growls and other animalistic sounds. The gators also have all of the abilities of a normal gator like breathing underwater.
summary: The ability to summon and control super powered alligators
strengths: You can summon and control up to twenty super gators
If one dies you can just summon another one
You can unsummon them when you're done with them
weaknesses: They cannot talk to you
You can't summon regular alligators or any kind of crocodile

name: Frictionless
description: If you are being hold onto, you will easily be able to slide right out of their arms. You can also slide on the ground without stopping until you de-activate your power & produce friction again.
summary: The ability to become frictionless
strengths: Become slippery
Slide for miles without stopping
weaknesses: Have to becareful when sliding or you might run into something

name: Beads/ Marbles To Bombs
description: The user is able to change beads/marbles into bombs that can be used to fight against their enemies. Only 5 beads/ marbles can be changed into bombs at a time.
summary: The ability to change beads/marbles into explosive beads/marbles
strengths: Beads/ marbles are compact an easy to carry
Explosive power is equivalent to a quarter pound of C4
weaknesses: Might run out of marble or beads

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Stone
description: A Philosopher's Stone ignores the law of equivalent exchange for Alchemy, "Mass for Mass". As well as, giving the ability to perform human transmutation and to create homunculus for normal alchemists.
summary: The ability to have your body act like a Philosopher's Stone.
strengths: Could create something out of nothing.
Amplifies ability.
weaknesses: You have to have some kind of Alchemy skill.
Only works on certain skills. If you do soul alchemy, you create weapons.

name: Blessing Of Qing Long
description: Qing-Long is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts and is alternatively known as the Azure Dragon of the East. When facing the direction east, you will be imbued with all the strength of a dragon, as well as control over the element of wood.
summary: The ability to become as strong as a dragon as long as you are facing east.
strengths: Become as powerful as a dragon.
Control plants and the wind.
Always know which direction east is.
weaknesses: You must be facing east for powers to activate.

name: Arceusforce: Insect
description: The user of this ability can channel the power over the insect armies under the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Bug-type. The user's skin turns olive green, their irises turn pink and pupils turn green. Under their insectoid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Bug-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Bug attacks such as Bug Bite, Spider Web, Pin Missile, Megahorn and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Bug form.
strengths: The user can resist supernatural combat, plant and earth-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of silk and insectoid aura to perform Bug attacks.
The user can climb walls like a fly.
weaknesses: The user is weak to fire, wind and mineral-based attacks,
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form

name: Tint V2
description: With this power you can cause other people to see the entire world as just one color. You can make one guy see the entire world as being blue and another person seeing it as red and so and so forth. You can undo the effects of this power whenever you want.
summary: The ability to make other people see the whole world in just one color
strengths: You can cause anyone to see the entire world as one color
You can reverse the effects of this power
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Human Battering Ram
description: With this power you can cause any door no matter how many locks it has on it to open just by touching your head to it. It only works with doors that swing inward (push doors) and not pull doors, revolving doors, sliding doors etc.
summary: The ability to cause doors to open when you touch them with your head
strengths: You can open doors just by touching your head to them
weaknesses: They have to be push doors

name: Sleep Vampirism
description: With a touch, you can drain as many hours of rest from a person that you want to use yourself. You can 'store up' sleep, ensuring you are well rested for many long days if you have drained a great deal, eliminating the need for naps or rest. Can be subtle, taking just an hour or so from many targets, or take an entire day of sleep from someone. Limited to taking 24 hours per person between rest cycles.
summary: The ability to drain the benefits of sleep from another to use yourself.
strengths: No need for caffeine
Always feel rested and at your best
Knock people out with a single touch
weaknesses: Possibly get very bored with all your extra hours of productivity
Many people around you tired
Ineffective against anything that doesn't sleep

name: Single Man Army Corp (Smac)
description: The person who has the special transformation belt, designed by the military, can transform into SMAC, the prime example of soldier and warrior. The belt gives the wearer super strength and invulnerability  The belt also has an uplink with an army satellite in orbit that can upgrade the transformation or divert power to other powers. For example, diverting power from super strength to invulnerability, making them more invulnerable but lest powerful in strength and flight.
summary: The ability to be as strong as an army corp via transformation from a special belt.
strengths: You are the ultimate soldier
You can take down most enemies
Can divert power to other sections to make you more suited to combat a certain situation.
weaknesses: Once the power source runs out it, needs to recharge
Satelite link can be hampered by bad weather

name: Bat Suit
description: The person with this power, has the ability to put on this bat themed battle suit. The suit includes a kevlar utility harness and a gas powered magnetic grappling gun. The suit is made up of a hybrid kevlar material and has reinforced padding at the joins. This made the suit bulletproof as well as invulnerable to knife stabbings. And a cape that is made up of a light weight fabric called memory cloth. The memory cloth becomes rigid when a current is applied to it
summary: The ability to put on a battle suit that has a bat theme
strengths: Good for fighting crime
Can survive in an urban hostile environment.
weaknesses: No super powers whatsoever

name: Body Part Substitution
description: This power allows you to replace any body part from libs, to eyes, even your internal organs. You can install multiple parts such as having two heats, four lungs, two sets of kidneys, etc. Any powers, or actions that were performed with that part, is also transferred to you. This can give you any number of powers, although restricted to that one part(if you take the finger from a fire manipulator, you can only use the power with that finger). You can also take the body parts of animals.
summary: The ability to replace any part of your body with other organic parts.
strengths: Have more than one power
Not worry about if you lose an arm
weaknesses: The parts all age at a faster rate
You can subcome to memories gained from said parts
Once damaged, that part can not be healed.

name: Animal Enhancement
description: With this ability, you can increase the natural abilities of any animal. This includes strength, speed, reflexes, and intelligence. The amount you can increase their abilities by depends on the mastery of the user. The average user can increase the abilities by x50. Their bodies will adapt accordingly to this change. (Ex: makes the brain larger if you boost intelligence, or the muscles larger if you boost strength. ) However, you can't reverse this ability, so grant this power carefully.
summary: The ability to enhance the abilities of animals.
strengths: Give an animal super-powered abilities.
The average user can multiply their natural abilities (strength, reflexes, intelligence, etc) by x50
Use this on your pets to give them a boost to their abilities.
weaknesses: It's not a good idea to use this on untamed animals.
You may make an animal too reckless by enhancing their abilities.
Cannot use this on humans.

name: Shear Thickening Cartilage
description: Cartilage is the soft, flexible material that connects bone and allows you to move. With this ability, your cartilage will increase in viscosity(resistance) as stress and strain increases. The greater the stress, the more the resistance becomes. You can turn this power off at any time. The setback of this is that if you put too much stress on your body, it will become much harder for you to move. It only makes cartilage nearly indestructable, not your bones. It's a non newtonian fluid!
summary: The ability to have cartilage which increases in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress.
strengths: Have your cartilage increase in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress and strain.
Cartilage resist impact and pulling more.
It's a non newtonian fluid!
weaknesses: Harder to move when power is on.
Must move slower or lift less when power is on.
Only useful in certain situations.

name: Awesome Masseur
description: With this power you give the best massages in the world. You can relax anybody and heal all back pains. In the middle of the fight you can give your enemy a massage (this might be tricky) and calm him down and then capture him.
summary: The ability to give the best massages in the world
strengths: You are the best masseur in the world
You can relax almost anybody
You can heal all back pains
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Brass Fists
description: With this ability you can turn your forearms into metal brass causing massive dammge to whoever you punch. It's like brass knuckles except now it's your whole fists.
summary: The ability to turn your forearm to your fingter tips into brass
strengths: Powerful punch
Unbreakable fists
Doesn't make your fists heavy
weaknesses: Heavy at first
Can be worn down by amonia attacks

name: This Will Hurt You More Than Me
description: If someone/something harms you, you will do more damage and harm to them. Also enhances your damage for things like punches and other powers.
summary: The ability to do more damage to the thing that hurts you
strengths: Do more harm
Do more damage
People won't want to harm you.
weaknesses: You can still be hurt
You can still die.
Do more harm.

name: Bubble Trapper
description: With this power you can take anyone as your prisoner. Know someone you don't like, trap them in a bubble. Want to ground your kids, trap them in a bubble. Or if you're just bored, trap someone is a bubble.
summary: The ability to trap people in indestructable bubbles.
strengths: It is unbreakable, so not even other superpowers can break through it.
Great for prison cells.
Unlimited air.
weaknesses: You have to give your prisoners food and such, it is only a bubble.
You can't change its size.

name: Humor Field
description: With this power you release a aura that makes everyone laugh uncontrollably. However, it is only limited to 200 yards. It's strongest on april fools day.
summary: The ability to emit an aura that cause people to laugh uncontrollably
strengths: Finally funny
Causes foes to laugh as well
Strongest on April Fools Day
weaknesses: Limited to 200 yards
Doesn't work on comedians
Doesn't defend your title

name: Dead Shed
description: If get cut, burnt, stabbed, shot etc. You would be able to peel that part of the flesh off yourself revealing perfectly healthy skin underneath. Like it never happened. Even if you die from your wounds, it takes awhile till you revive yourself & shed your dead body. This is not immortality or accelerated healing. You still feel pain & not immune to diseases & will die from them. Then you'll come back with healthy organs & bones. Its a healthy you inside a dead you.
summary: The ability to shed injuried or dead skin on yourself
strengths: Shed dead tissue to reveal healthy ones
Your insides will eventually heal after death then you'll revive
weaknesses: Not true immortality or accelerated healing
Still susceptible to illness
Still have to die in order to come back

name: Song Of The Family
description: With this power, you will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family (father, mother, sister, brother, wife, son, daughter) is in a hundred-foot radius of you. Also, when you sing while this power is in effect, only good things will happen to you, so if you sing while fighting an enemy and one of your immediate family members is near you, you will win the fight. Or, if you use this power while buying a lottery ticket, you will win the lottery.
summary: The ability to have a beautiful singing voice when near members of your immediate family.
strengths: You will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family is near you.
Only good things can happen to you when you use this power.
weaknesses: Your family members have to be near you.

name: Summon Mega Sharke
description: If you want this power, you first need to have the Summon Sharke power. Stop reading now and see what that power is and come back to this power. This power summons a sharke with the same abilities and weaknesses as a normal sharke, but it is 60 feet long and able to gulp down an object the size of a tank or take trash dumpster-sized bites out of a bigger object. A mega-sharke, if left unsupervised, will eat the same as 6 normal sharke.
summary: The ability to summon a giant temporal energy monster.
strengths: Bigger is better!
They eat tanks in one gulp.
No one will mess with you-if you're crazy enough to keep a few mega-sharke with you.
weaknesses: A 20-foot-long temporal monster is bad enough to have around-you want a 60-foot-long one?

name: Encore
description: You could compel the foe to keep using only the same move by clapping your hands. You can even use it to call for a brief extra repetition done after the main performance is complete until your opponent gets tired.
summary: The ability to make anyone repeat the same thing over again by clapping your hands.
strengths: A great, but strange use for humiliation.
weaknesses: It'll get much more annoying after a while.

name: Myth Power: Eris' Enmity
description: Eris, in Greek myth, was the goddesses of strife and discord; her dual good and bad forms were called the Erites. As such, channeling her allows one to summon Golden Apples of Discord, at will, for subjects to argue and/or fight over. In addition, one may gain physical power in the presence of natural strife. One may even split in two; one copy boosts allies' morale (getting them to feel motivated and competitive, which speeds their healing process); the other causes foes to turn on one another.
summary: The ability to channel Eris and the Erites' command over the essence of strife, discord, enmity and social chaos
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce and negate strife at will; gain physical power from natural strife/discord
Summon Golden Apples of Discord (one at a time) to wreak havoc on foes (or to feed self/others)
Split into two copies; one heals and motivates allies; the other causes foes to turn on each other
weaknesses: Subjects only follow compulsions inscribed on Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Subjects only become instigators by eating Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Thought Bubble Pop
description: Ever heard the saying "an idea blowing up in their face"? That's the idea behind this power. You see people's thought bubbles which you can pop; the bigger the bubble, the bigger the explosion. It might splat into some primordial thought goop all over their faces or unleash the horrors contained within a random thought (such as a giant chicken); if the thought survives the popping of course.
summary: The ability to see the thought bubbles of others and pop them.
strengths: People who think a lot make HUGE explosions
The explosions do damage if great enough
Random thoughts are sometimes awesome if they survive the pop
weaknesses: Bubbles are very very small for people who don't think much at all (obviously)
The "thought-goop" is just messy/nasty. Nothing else than that.
If a thought does survive the popping, some of them suck (giant chicken is arguably one of them)

name: Deathtrap Making
description: It's self explanatory. When you touch any non-living object, it will flash a silver light, indicating it's been rigged. When another person uses it, it will kill them in some sort of way. For example, a laptop and a door. When a laptop is used, it will violently elecrocute the user to death. When a door is touched, it will powerfully swing open, crushing the user to the wall. Just don't use it on anything you use daily, like your toilet, or a comb.
summary: The ability to touch any object and turn it into a fatal trap
strengths: Create your own house of death
Strategically kill your enemies
Have fun creating creative ways to kill someone
weaknesses: Touching yourself is a bad idea if you're in a relationship.

name: United We Stand
description: With this power you have super human strength parallel to that of the Incredible Hulk but only when you have at least one of your friends near you
summary: The ability to gain super strength when you have friends near you
strengths: You have incredible strength
weaknesses: You may be putting your friend in danger if you're fighting crime and need your super strength

name: Origami Manipulation
description: This strange ability has more uses than most would think. Origami is the anicent art of folding paper into different shapes. With this you can create and control all sorts of origami. So if you create a giant origami dragon, it will follow your mental orders. This ability also grants the power to become origami. When you do this, you will become a life size origami human. You then can become any number of origami shapes and creatures.
summary: The ability to manipulate origami
strengths: Become origami.
Your can create origami weapons and creatures.
All of your creations are under your control
weaknesses: A very strange ability

name: Aaimuzki
description: Based on a yokai, it gives you a cactus like appearance with needles you can throw and enlarge and retract, plus you can greatly increase and decrease your muscles, giving you heightened strength and size.
summary: The ability to gain cactus-like skin and the abilty to rapidly increase and decrease you muscle mass.
strengths: Heightened strength.
Enlargement and projectile needles.
Rapid regeneration and cactus-like physiology.
weaknesses: Huge appearance changes.
You lose your senses of smell and taste when activated.
Muscles arent high on the superhuman strength scale.

name: Currency Switch
description: Euros, yen, dollars, dinars, pesos, seashells, gold-plated latinum, etc. You can change your money into any type of currency that you want whether it is a real currency or a fictional currency, even historical currency from ancient Hawaii or Sumeria. Exchange rate is based on value of the target currency in the original currency. Ex: An ancient coin that is worth say 100 dollars will be exchanged by this power at that rate. Ex: 1 yen is aproximately 1 US cent so that would be the exchange rate.
summary: The ability to change money from one currency to another currency
strengths: Time travelers will always have the currency they need.
No fees and no banks required.
weaknesses: No combat value.

name: Cryptobiosis Gold
description: Cryptobiosis is what some animals go into to survive tough conditions. All their internal mechanisms and organs stop working, leaving the animal 'dead' until the conditions are right for it to wake up. With this power, it is similar: When the conditions aren't right for normal life, your body stops working and becomes a gold statue. Your golden body is indestructible, and you will wake up when your body can survive. But the statue is stiff; you can't move. You are put in "suspended animation".
summary: The ability to survive almost anything
strengths: Survive vacuum,pressure, lack of oxygen, too much/little heat and anything the environment has.
Cryptobiosis Gold form is indestructible.
Wake up when conditions are right, and you don't age.
weaknesses: Can't breathe, think, talk or move when in this form.
When you wake up, your friends/relatives might be dead.
You only survive conditions, not things like poisons, bullets, falling etc.

name: Brain Scramble
description: When this power is activated, an aura begins to begins to grow around you. When you choose to release it, everyone within this space, excluding you, will have their brain randomly switched to another body in the area. Basically, lots and lots of chaos. This is useful if a large group is after you. Even better if there are supers within the ranks, being that they will have to get used to new powers before they pursue you. It will have no effect if used on only one person.
summary: The ability to randomly switch the brains of people in an area
strengths: Can be used for escape or relaxation
Cannot be undone except by you
With practice, can be extended to cover the entire earth
weaknesses: No control over where the brains go
Trading the brain of a supervillain into the body of a superhero
You are excluded: no switching into a better body

name: Dinosaur Control
description: You can fully control any dinosaur you want. But you have to find them first
summary: The ability to control dinosaurs.
strengths: You can control dinosaurs
Paleontologists would seek you out if they can revive dinosaurs
weaknesses: Dinosaurs don't exist anymore
Need other powers to get/summon/revive dinosaurs

name: Normalization Fluid
description: With this power you can inject a serum that "cures" any and all superpowers. In minimum dose this acts like a tranquilizer by causing your body to tense up and combat its own power. In maximum dose this eliminates any and all superpowers of a person. This power is treated as a cure and will never be perceived as a threat by any superpower sense or barrier. The body will not reject this fluid and powers that come in contact directly with the fluid when in the body are negated.
summary: The ability to "cure" superpowers
strengths: The effects are permanent and powers cannot be regained
This power is never perceived as a threat by superpowers
You can help people who don't want their powers or take power away from supervillains
weaknesses: You have to get within range to inject the fluid
It takes times to circulate within the body and it can be sucked out or slowed down from the heart
Does not take away inherent powers such as natural intelligence or natural training

name: Willpower: State Of Permanence
description: You may not be aware of it but your freewill is the most important force that resides in you. Anything you choose to do or not to do is governed by your freewill. The excercise of freewill for a powerful ability user is important. If he plans to make use of his powers in this physical world his freewill must be free from any constraint. But freewill like any other forces that resides in us can be changed by other enities that dwell outside us. This ability blocks such changes enabling freewill.
summary: The ability to render one's freewill unaffected by unnatural change.
strengths: Let your freewill remain unchanged even if reality itself yields to such changes.
weaknesses: No offensive use

name: Radioactive Burn: Outbreak
description: You must read "Radioactive Burn" to understand this ability. When active, you can pass the radioactive burn as a disease, therefore resulting in an epidemic. Those with the virus will gain the same abilities as the carrier, but less in power, strength, endurance, and intelligence. When the "burn" is passed on, the victim's flesh will bubble like tar and metamorphose into a monstrosity. The victim is incapable of reverting back to their original form and however obeys your commands.
summary: The ability to pass on the radioactive burn as a virus.
strengths: Create an army of superpowered monsters.
You are capable of acting as a vaccine for victims of the virus.
This ability works on any living organism, including plants and insects.
weaknesses: None really.

name: Skill: Ultimate Feint Strike
description: You will perform a feint strike with any weapon that your opponent will always go to block, making it easier to win fights
summary: The ability to perform an ultimate feint attack
strengths: You can always feint your opponent in a fight
It will make you a great fighter/soldier
weaknesses: There really isn't one

name: Side Effect
description: ever wanted to give some one a side effect you see on cans of stuff and that sort? now you can and you make up your own like explosive diarrhea!
summary: The ability to give anyone a side effect!
strengths: enemy:come on!..."ploop" yes!..."BOOM!"
you'll have a lot of fun
weaknesses: can't make death a side effect  but still can make stuff like explosive diarrhea

name: Shrinking
description: The power to shrink someone to tiny sizes, making them easy to fight or unseeable.
summary: The ability to shrink someone to centimeter sizes.
strengths: You can shrink your enemies so they cannot keep up with you.
They are weaker in a fight.
weaknesses: You can't see them.
Their powers still work to their limits so they can do anything they could before.

name: Human Bomb
description: You can seep out of your body chemical compounds that make plastic explosives. Your body is can revert from normal to C4 by holding your breath. You regrow any plastic you cut off to make your explosion but only in C4 mode. So if you use a your whole arm, you have to hold your breath for that long till it grows back which could take a few minutes. Have to supply own firing pins & timer. If you are shot or contact with fire while as C4, huge explosion & unlikely you survive.
summary: The ability to produce plastic explosives from your body
strengths: Create bombs from your body
Can regrow limbs but only as C4 body
weaknesses: Have to supply your own detonating devices
Have to hold breath in order to become plastic explosive & regrow parts of body used
If damaged while in C4 mode, you'll die as you make a huge explosion

name: Think Outside The Box
description: A person with this ability has the power of materializing a box that is impervious to physical damage and has a strange effect of making anyone inside it only think and perceive things which are not inside the box.
summary: The ability to materialize an invulnerable box that makes anyone inside it think of what's outside.
strengths: The user is exempted from the effects of the box.
Telekinesis, Mind reading, Precognition, Perception Power and other Mind powers are also affected.
It comes in many different colors and sizes!
weaknesses: When everybody else is outside the box.
If you are outside the box.
It is just a box.

name: Instant Counting
description: Also known as Number Sense, a person with this power can instantly tell the number of objects there are with just a short glance. In non-combat, you can win contests and impress people -- however this can be used to keep track of how many people there are facing you (so you don't let one get away). It's also useful in scouting missions.
summary: The ability to instantly know the number of jelly beans or other things you see
strengths: Always win Jelly Bean counting contests
Excellent recon
weaknesses: None

name: Figure Inhabitation
description: When you wish to get away from someone, or appear someone you're not, you may enter a statue of a person. For example, say you are in a waxworks, you could enter one of the waxwork models and move around as that person. But, your own body will be left behind as a statue.
summary: The ability to enter a statue or other representation of a person
strengths: Become a famous person, like Daniel Craig, and lap up the praise.
Hide from anyone, almost anywhere.
Works even with paintings
weaknesses: Your body will be left behind as a staue, and could be taken away or broken
Must look human to work, no animals
Trying to enter half a waxwork or statue will result in death

name: Vampirism: Adrenal
description: Also called Adrenal Absorption or Stamina Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the literal stamina (vigor or energy) of a subject, and convert it into sustenance and energy for one's own personal use; temporarily gain a boost of strength, temporarily gain a boost of speed, or go longer at your normal pace; even resist the urge to eat or sleep for a while (as such, this power is especially helpful on a hyper foe, or a foe with an adrenaline rush)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the adrenaline of others
strengths: Take away the stamina of your foe, making them temporarily VERY tired
Taking their stamina also delays having to eat or rest
Foes with Superhuman Stamina, Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Strength, Berserker Rage, etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't absorb foes' life-force (only tires them, doesn't age them)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Vampire Control
description: With this power you can control vampires. You can make them fight battles for you or bite people and turn them into vampires to increase your army of mind controlled vampires.
summary: The ability to control vampires
strengths: You can control vampires.
You can make them bite other people turning them into vampires to increase your vampire army.
weaknesses: They can only fight at night or in dark places.
They can be defeated by garlic.

name: Ent Summon
description: With this power you can summon up to ten Ents. The Ents under your complete control and they are super smart, super strong and if they get angry enough even the sound of their voices will cause great destruction. You can have the Ents for as long as you want and then send them back when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Ents
strengths: You can summon up to ten Ents
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Pearl Effect
description: Calcium carbonate is secreted from the skin and is fashioned to any form desired ex. (sword, shield, mimicry of other objects, etc). Can create layers of calcium carbonate to make you skin tougher.
summary: The ability to generate a pearl like substance from the skin.
strengths: Denser than normal pearls.
Can be useful in different kinds of situations ex. (duplication of keys, etc.
If the user is creative, he/she can use this power to it's maximum potential.
weaknesses: It breaks if to mush pressure is applied.
Secretion of calcium carbonate is not as fast as most abilities.
Gets heavy if to much layers are created.

name: Reincarnation Detection
description: When a parent-to-be has this power, they will sense the being to inhabit their child's body when developed. It starts even before conception. If they know of the soul to be born as their child, they are able to eject it and allow another to take its place. They share these senses with the other parent.
summary: The ability to sense and repel reincarnation applying to your offspring.
strengths: Prevent someone with Reincarnation Determination inheriting your powers against you will.
Know the personality your child will have,
Your knowledge will be shared with your partner, whether they have powers or not.
weaknesses: If you aren't familiar with the new being, they may take you by surprise.
Only works on biological children.
No use if you aren't interested in having children.

name: Ace In The Hole
description: This allows for the user to deliver a perfect strike against any opponent. The strike will bypass all of the enemies defenses and is essentially a one hit knockout.
summary: The ability to deliver one decisive blow.
strengths: Thrown objects can count as the strike.
weaknesses: Activates randomly 5 minutes into any fight
Can only be used in a fight.
Decisive blow can only be through the hands.

name: "Delete This" Mimicry
description: A person with this power has all the powers that say delete this in their title. Wait a minute if you have this power doesn't this power make it so you have this power? Infinite loop!!!
summary: The ability to have all the "delete this" powers from the Superpower list
strengths: Have a lot of powers
Can use multiple powers at once and can choose to not use the powers you don't like
weaknesses: If the powers are actually deleted you lose them forever
Crazy ass drivers

name: Glass Shard Golem
description: This ability allows you to become a human sized golem made entirely of quick moving glass shards. Because the glass that composes your body is in constant motion you cut and slice everything that touches you. You become a walking storm of destruction.
summary: The ability to become a golem made of fast moving, sharp glass shards
strengths: Great for defense from most melee weapons
Great for hand to hand combat
You can change back to human at any time
weaknesses: Cuts everything that touches you

name: Induce Migraine
description: The user is able to cause an extremely painful migraine in an enemy. Low level users can only induce the migraine to one enemy, but a high level user can induce extremely painful migraines to a room full of people. A powerful enough user can incapacitate an enemy with this power
summary: The ability to cause extremely painful migraines in an enemy.
strengths: Good to stop either criminals or law enforcement
Can incapacitate an enemy
weaknesses: Might not be able to effect someone that has strong mental blocking powers

name: Pantheon
description: With this power you can split yourself into several different people each representing one aspect of your personality. You can create as many extra people as you want but as you go on the personality aspects that they represent will become more obscure (oh the one that constantly picks his nose, the one known for having red hair, the one that watches Sherlock twenty four hours a day every day).
summary: The ability to split yourself into several different beings each representing one aspect of your personality
strengths: You can split yourself into several different beings
You can reabsorb them whenever you want
weaknesses: They're not under your control
The more you make the less obscure they get

name: Point Zero
description: Zero point is the lowest possible energy, sometimes referred to as vacuum energy. Once this is activated, an area surrounding your body, its size depending on the user, creates a void. Any energy or powers entering this field are nullified, and absorbed into the user's body. This field sucks the energy and life of even humans that pass into it. This is a last resort ability, and usually results in the user's death.
summary: The ability to activate Point Zero.
strengths: Ultimate defense and offense.
Nothing can pass the field without dying.
weaknesses: Causes the user to die.
Can't move while using it.

name: Word Cracker
description: This power gives you strong knowledge of supernatural linguistics that you can apply to understand how a language-based supernatural effect works. You can then dismantle and rearrange it to produce a different effect, or destroy it. It works with any language. Written, oral or even sign. Human or non-human.
summary: The ability to understand, disrupt and cancel language-based superpowers and magic.
strengths: You can counter any magical spell, word-based power, name-based power, number-based power,...
You can change the intended effect of these powers, though the results may be unexpected.
weaknesses: Though you can understand how language-based powers work, you cannot use this power to copy one.
It may take time to fully decrypt and analyze a language-based effect, depending on its complexity.

name: Quartz Form
description:
By activating this ability you transform into a golem made of quartz. This form gives you superstrength, increased endurance, and increased defense. Being made of quartz also gives you the added ability of being immune to any energy, beam or light based attack with the quartz deflecting and dissapating it. 

Even after being destroyed while in quartz form you can regenerate by all your pieces reforming.
summary: The ability to turn into a mobile golem made of Quartz
strengths: Increased Strength, Endurance and Defense
Immune to light based attacks
weaknesses: Quartz is more brittle than you think
Being made of quartz doesn't exactly make you very threatening

name: Drill Teeth
description: With this power, you can turn your teeth into miniature drills. The drills can drill through almost anything, except for teeth and other drills. You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills and turn them back whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn your teeth into miniature drills
strengths: You can turn your teeth into drills that can drill through almost anything.
You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills.
You can turn them back to normal teeth whenever you want.
weaknesses: You can't drill through teeth or other drills.

name: Quivering Palm
description: When making a successful strike against a target, the user of this power can send vibrations into the targets body. Once the vibrations are in the targets body, the user can simply will the target to die at any point within a period of a few days. The target can resist the attack, but it is very unlikely. After a few days, or if the target resists your attempt to kill him, all current vibrations in the body would be gone. Can be used on multiple targets.
summary: The ability to send potentially fatal vibrations into another one's body.
strengths: If attack is succesful, you can instantly kill harder foes.
Threaten people to do what you want during the period the vibrations are in their body.
Can be used repeatedly to refresh the vibrations in the target's body.
weaknesses: Requires landing a succesful blow on opponent.
Vibrations only last a certain period of time.
Target can resist the killing attack if they are exceptionally skilled.

name: Evil Manipulation
description: By manipulating evil you could force someone to do an evil deed,make him steal or kill for you,but once you turned him evil,you cant turn him back to normal.
summary: The ability to manipulate evil.
strengths: Make the president steal a nuclear bomb for you.
Make a serial killer strike again.
weaknesses: You cant turn back the chosen person back to normal.
A strong willed person can resist.

name: Erythrocyte Mimicry
description: This power is always active. It changes the chemical composition of your body so it automatically absorbs dioxygen and carbon dioxide. Your body can absorb up to 40 times its volume and can use the absorbed oxygen to breathe. Your skin also becomes red in the process. To release the absorbed gas from a part of your body, you must flex or press that area. However, your body can also absorb other substances more easily, such as carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, or cyanide to the detriment of oxygen.
summary: The ability to absorb and release various gases, mainly oxygen (O2) and carbon dioxide.
strengths: Your body can contain much more oxygen and carbon dioxide at the same time.
The absorbed oxygen acts as a personal oxygen tank.
You can contain a lot of gases!
weaknesses: This power is always active. You can only turn it off through the use of other powers.
You could kill many people and animals by anoxia the first time this power is activated.
