Carbon monoxide is nearly impossible to release and they take the place of oxygen.

name: Calcium Fist Breaker
description: If someone's skeletal system is made out of normal bone, they better not punch you. If they punch you, they're fist instantly becomes hollow and possibly break. If they are wearing brass knuckles, this power doesn't work. If they have a different skeletal structure or are using superpowers, it doesn't work.
summary: The ability to have someone's fist turn hollow and break when it's made out of normal bone.
strengths: People's fist break/become hollow if they punch you.
They'll think twice about punching you.
weaknesses: If a supersayan/superhuman punches you.
If someone does something else to hurt you.
If the person is wearing brass knuckles.

name: Charging Rhino
description: This ability can also proves to be handy while playing football
summary: The ability to have the Strength and Speed of a Rhino, and its invincibility
strengths: You will be as invincible as a Rhino
You will be as fast as a rhino
You will be strong as a rhino
weaknesses: You will occasionally be dumb as a log
You will be short tempered
You will be more agressive

name: Coatl, The Ever Flowing River
description: This power allows you to be very successful in what you're doing. You'll be more productive and the quality of your work will increase, as well as any profit you can get from it. To reflect your success, your skin will shed, revealing a more appealing appearance. Your inner self will also "shed" to reveal a more attractive personality. The best thing is people won't notice the change, they only feel something's different but won't know what, unless they are very observant.
summary: The ability to increase your productivity, the quality and profitability of your work, and enhance your appearance.
strengths: Hard work and determination is undoubtedly the road to success with the help of this power.
Your family, friends and acquaintances will still recognize you after you change your appearance.
Any project you undertake can become successful if you put your heart into it.
weaknesses: Beware as it only works if you actually put effort into it: It doesn't reward laziness at all!
You can't control what appearance you will get after you shed your skin.
Using your other superpowers to help with your projects can be seen as laziness.

name: Excalibur And Avalon
description: Excalibur is the strongest sword given by the Lady of the Lake; with it you can cut through almost anything. Avalon, the sheath, lets you become invulnerable by healing all existing wounds through cellular regeneration and protecting against dimensional, magical, and physical attacks.  If the user acts unchivalrous then the effects will be negated  Both of these can be stolen, and cannot be used against each other(strongest spear/shield paradox)
summary: The ability to wield Excalibur and its sheath Avalon
strengths: You have the best weapon combination short of divine weapons
You can lead armies and create your own kingdom
weaknesses: You will die young betrayed by your most trusted knight
You must be chivalrous
Can be defeated by divine weapons

name: Bloodless
description: Normally when at least 50% of the blood is drained from a body, the body dies. However, with this power you can live even if all the blood in your body is drained away. You'll survive with nutrients getting to each cell similar to how an Arctic fish gets nutrients to each cell or a fungus alternatively.
summary: The ability to live with a body that has no blood
strengths: Can survive with no blood in your body.
Used in conjunction with Blood Manipulation.
weaknesses: When all the blood disappears from the body it will stop regenerating blood for the rest of life.

name: Anvil, Safe And Piano Drop
description: With this power you can cause anvils, safes and pianos to fall from the sky and onto your enemies, enemies' houses/bases, enemies' car or anything else that you want to drop an anvil, safe or piano on
summary: The ability to make anvils, safes and pianos fall from the sky
strengths: You can crush people/things
weaknesses: What are you going to do with the anvils/safes/pianos after they crush things

name: Sleep Sight
description: With this super power, looking into a person's eyes will make them fall asleep for up to twelve hours. The effect can vary from two hours to twelve hours. When they wake up, they will not remember falling asleep. Also, the person will not be able to be waken up until your power wears off.
summary: The ability to make people fall asleep by looking into a person's eyes.
strengths: You can cause people to fall asleep to get out of tight situations.
weaknesses: You can't control exacly how long a person will fall asleep.

name: Death Perception
description: A person with this power has the ability to predict how someone will possibly die within the next 24 hours. For an assassin this is an useful ability since you know how to kill someone. For law enforcement or a bodyguard you can prevent people from dying by predicting how they can possibly die and preventing it. This ability is only activated when the user wills it and all scenarios seen can be avoided--can avoid fate but not death--in the end.
summary: The ability to see how someone will die within the next 24 hours
strengths: You know how to kill someone, possibly even an immortal--gives you info how to kill
You know how to prevent someone from dying early
You can use this in direct combat to figure out people's weaknesses and attack them
weaknesses: You will often have to save people if you want to check the power often
You cannot predict your own death
Trying to help may sometimes be the reason someone will die but not always

name: Mass Consumption
description: With this ability, your body grows by the amount of mass consumed. You can also use this ability to steal mass from other forms of life. You can compress your body to a normal size, however the more mass you take in, the more difficult it becomes. The amount of mass your body can take is limitless, so you can become three times your normal size, or even hundreds of times your normal size.
summary: The ability to increase size based on mass consumed
strengths: You can make yourself look taller
weaknesses: Becomes harder and harder to compress to a normal size as you gain mass

name: Potent Blood
description: Your blood is potent and can enhance what it is put into. Example: A potion that enhances your strength by a factor of 10 suddenly enhances by a factor of 20. It can be any type of liquid or solid that can be ingested for some kind of effect. You cannot enhance how much your blood enhances stuff nor can the potency be reduced.
summary: The ability to have blood that enhances the effects of what it is put into
strengths: Your blood enhances potions that can make you stronger.
weaknesses: Your blood can enhance poisoned potions.
Your blood will NOT mix with gases.

name: User Rank Power Boost
description: Basically what the overview says. The power boosting number affects any power with a measurable trait. If you're not one of the 10 most powerful users then this power  works as if you were 11th most powerful user. This power allows for multiple 11th most powerful users.
summary: The ability to boost the effectiveness of any of your powers by a number equal user rank squared
strengths: Not one of 10 most powerful users? You get the best power boost.
There can be more than one 11th most powerful user.
A way to balance your powers against those of the top 10 users.
weaknesses: None or not enough of your powers have measurable traits.

name: 3 Headed Dragon Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon a three headed dragon. The dragon can fly, is invulnerable, has sharp teeth in all of its mouths and is super strong. One of the dragon's heads shoots fire, the second one shoot ice and the third one shoots out webbing. The dragon is under your complete control and you can unsummon it when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon a three headed dragon
strengths: You can summon a three headed dragon
It's under your complete control
weaknesses: It can be killed
It might be attacked by the government for being a monster

name: Blue Needles
description: You are able to rapidly throw a bunch of acupuncture needles at your opponent, and one more at their head. They then start to go a little further than skin-deep, your foe turns red and starts to feel intense pain. They'll be inflated and float on way up high. An explosion is heard as their blood, bones and organs rain down.
summary: The ability to throw them at your opponents, causing their bodies to swell and explode.
strengths: May be able to throw one or two which stops your foe from moving.
Can use it for rapid firing,
weaknesses: Kind of gross.

name: The Walking Plague
description: Those with this power can infect any living thing with any disease simply by touching them. However, the power is always active and the user has little or no control over what diseases are used with each touch (though you can learn to gain some control).
summary: The ability to infect any living thing with any disease through physical contact.
strengths: You can weaken enemies easily.
You can make enemies die painfully and slowly (if you enjoy watching others suffer).
You could discover new diseases (any disease meaning discovered and undiscovered).
weaknesses: You can kill someone by accident (say you bump them by mistake and give them cancer).
You cannot turn off your power so you risk killing any creature you touch.
The diseases are chosen at random so you could try to kill someone and end up giving them a cold.

name: Grave Re Animator
description: This power is kind of like that graveyard in Pet Cemetery except better. You can dig a hole anywhere were there's sand or soil. Your re-animates aren't killers. Missing a body part? Throw a replacement limb or entire body in the grave and get a intact re-animate. You need at least the brain and spinal column of the dead thing to want to re-animate. You can't mix up species. A re-animate dies again just dig a new grave. These re-animates can heal.
summary: The ability to dig a hole that will re-animate a dead thing.
strengths: As long as you can dig a hole you can re-animate a dead person or animal.
If you know you're dying you can dig a hole for yourself.
Grave re-animates heal.
weaknesses: You're not near sand or soil.
These re-animates might be mistaken for zombies...
You can't make minotaurs or centaurs.

name: Claws Of Dust
description: When you activate this power it gathers dust from the area around you. This takes around 3 seconds. The dust then hardens around your fingernails which takes 4 seconds. More dust can be used to make the claws denser or longer.
summary: The ability to create claws out of dust
strengths: Now you can use that dust instead of just vacuuming it up and throwing it away.
Can make the claws longer with more dust.
Dust is everywhere on most planets.
weaknesses: Some dust can be poisonous (might be pro).
Takes time to form the claws.
Being in outer space.

name: Transformers: Ironhide

weaknesses: You will need a power like teleportation if you're reduced to a human torso.

name: Hepatocyte Mimicry
description: Hepatocytes Mimics really have a huge number of abilities. The main ones are the abilities to store sugar inside their body, to neutralize various toxic subtances, such as alcohol or drugs, to produce bile (a fat solvent), to create duplicates at a extremely rapid rate, to manipulate cholesterol and to regulate cholesterol levels in other people. They can also gain or give new abilities in the vicinity of other Cellular Mimics. For example, Thrombocyte Mimics will produce sticky ropes.
summary: The ability to have all the equivalent abilities of liver cells, known as hepatocytes.
strengths: You have a wide panel of abilities. Check other Cellular Mimic pages for more.
Your duplication ability is extremely fast, near instantaneous.
You can heal people and may give them new powers if they are Cellular Mimics.
weaknesses: You can heal other people very effectively, but you can heal yourself only at a much slower rate.
A less cool ability is to convert ammonia into urea.

name: 2 For The Show V2
description: With this power you can project any episode from any TV show from your eyes onto any flat surface. All you have to do is say the name of the episode and the name of the TV show.
summary: The ability to project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
strengths: You can project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
weaknesses: Only works for TV show for movies please see Movie Projector

name: Minotaur Summon
description: With this power you can summon the mighty minotaur from Greek Mythology. When you summon it the Minotaur is under your complete control and you can make it do whatever you want. The minotaur has super strength and has sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies.
summary: The ability to summon the minotaur
strengths: You can summon the minotaur
It is under your complete control
It is super strong and has long sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies
weaknesses: The minotaur eats humans so feeding it could be a problem
There is only one so if it dies this power is useless

name: Cybear Summon
description: With this power you can summon as many Cybears as you want. The bears are under your complete control and have super strength and durability and they can shoot lasers from their eyes. You can unsumon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon Cybears
strengths: You can summon an army of Cybears
They are under your complete control
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: They can be destroyed

name: Math: Evil Negative Squared
description: When you negatively square a negative integer, the result is positive. So, -4 by -4 equals positive 16. With this power, the same rule applies, except negative is evil and positive is good. When facing an evil person, activating this power will bring forth an exact replica of this person. They will both look the same, act the same, and will both be the same amount of evil. Then they will merge in a blinding flash of light, and their alignment will change from evil to good. They are now positive.
summary: The ability to change a person from evil
strengths: Change the alignment of an evil person to good.
They will feel happier, without feeling the urge to slaughter innocents
Maths is AWESOME!
weaknesses: This is more a hero power. Sorry to disappoint the villains
It is largely irreversible.

name: Outfit Conjuring
description: Did you ever want an outfit from the mall that was just to expensive.Well, with this power, you can create with with only the power of your mind. Not only can you conjure it on your body, but your friends body too.
summary: The ability to create any outift you can think of
strengths: Create any outfit you want
Always a perfect fit
Make even the most exotic things
weaknesses: You'll miss shopping at the mall

name: Voice Swap
description: With this power you can trade voices with any other person. Once you steal their voice you will sound exactly like them and they will sound exactly like you. You do not have to be near the person for this power to work. You will not gain their speaking mannerisms and if they know how to speak other languages you will not learn them by using this power. You will however gain their accent with their voice.
summary: The ability to trade voices with anyone else
strengths: You can trade voices with any other person
weaknesses: You do not gain their speaking mannerisms or knowledge of other languages
You cannot switch other people's voices you can only switch your own with someone else's

name: Power Boomerang
description: This power is great against power stealers. If they steal it from you, it returns to you and... That's pretty much it. It does nothing else... No, really. It only gives you the power to have this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away. It can still be mimicked though... Or destroyed... Or willingly discarded if you want to get rid of it. Otherwise, there's nothing much you can do with it... B-but it cannot be stolen or tak-, oh wait, I already wrote that, didn't I?
summary: The ability to automatically have this ability come back to you if it is stolen or taken away.
strengths: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
If someone mimics this power, they will end up with an unstealable power that does nothing!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
weaknesses: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you and that's it.
It does nothing else.
It can still be mimicked, deleted, discarded, etc.

name: Myth Eater
description: There must be balance. As the Myth-Eater, you devour anything that relates to Myth, mythic gods, beasts, weapons even mythic cities. Eat titans, eat days of the week, months. You could eat time. Every myth, every pantheon, every legend. Each myth you eat gives you the strength, lifespan and power to eat the next mythic figure. Of course, a group of gods will team-up against you and you'll smile as you are surrounded knowing you will not hunger for a few millennia.
summary: The ability to devour every person, weapon, place or thing related to Myth, Legends
strengths: Instinctively gain more power to transcend mythic foes.
None of the so-called gods can escape your hunger. When you arrive, it is their end
Your hunger is precognitive ensuring each thing you devour makes you stronger than the next
weaknesses: You'll eat Cerberus, Fenrir, Laelaps, Teumessian Fox (all may be considered to be Ghostdogs)
In a mythic melee do not go against your instincts or it could be your undoing
Elder gods like Zeus & Odin have a propensity to whine quite a bit before they are devoured.

name: Strong Right Hand
description: Your right hand and arm are indestructible and possess enough superhuman strength to shatter a concrete pillar with a good punch. Your strength will increase if you work out. This power extends only to your right shoulder, and the rest of you is completely mortal.
summary: The ability to possess a super strong right hand
strengths: Can win any fight if you start it with a good right hook
Can block attacks with your right arm
Your right-handed throw or swing will be great in sports
weaknesses: The rest of you is as weak and vulnerable as anyone else is
Using your right arm extensively will leave you looking lop-sided, like swordsmen
If you use your full strength in a fight, you would kill a man

name: Jerk Healing
description: You can heal injuries, but to do so, you must tell them to stop whining. Somebody has a papercut?--"Somebody call whine-one-one! "--and it's healed! Friend on the ground, nearly dead?--"Stop being a big wuss and get up"--kick 'em in the ribs a few times, and everything's good! Actually dead? "Just get up you lazy fat sonuvagun!" You can heal yourself by downplaying injuries ("It's merely a flesh wound!").
summary: The ability to heal people by being mean
strengths: Get to make fun of people and have them thank you
You and your loved ones can live forever
weaknesses: Those who don't know what you're doing will think you're a pretty big jerk

name: Quantum Re Animation
description: You can make re-animates that are sort of like the weeping angels of doctor who. As long as these re-animates aren't being watched they are fully alive and healed. They become strong enough to rip thru steel or rip someone from limb to limb. These re-animates move so fast as to appear to teleport. When 'dead' these re-animates must be reduced to less than a finger or when not being observed these re-animates will be intact and alive again.
summary: The ability to have a dead person be alive only if that person isn't being observed.
strengths: Who's going to suspect a dead body is a threat?
Quantum re-animates reconstitute from a little as a pinkie finger.
These re-animates are only alive when not being observed(pro/con).
weaknesses: 360 degree vision, surveillance cameras or anything similar.
These re-animates are only dead when being observed(con/pro).
They can be destroyed in their stone form (but it's hard)

name: Resurrection In Killer
description: If someone kills you their soul is forced out of their body and yours is put into their body. You will keep all of your own powers but get none of theirs.
summary: The ability to come back to life in the body of the one who killed you
strengths: You can never truly be killed.
weaknesses: You can still die of old age.

name: Half Sea Serpent
description: Someone with this power has higher strength and speed than normal humans. That boost is doubled when they are in the water. They can 'breathe' water like a fish and are extremely good at swimming. They will also have finlike flaps of skin on their hands and feet, scaly skin, gills, and a scaly tail.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-sea serpent
strengths: The tail can be used as a weapon.
Hard for others to catch you in a race in the water.
weaknesses: You're not as good on land as you are in the water.

name: Dendritic Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). In normal mode, you can stick to and absorb a foe into your body, killing them. Once you've absorbed one, you'll then enter combat mode in which you grow several arms and legs, gaining enhanced mobility, and assimilate the foe's cells into your skin. When you encounter a Leukocyte Mimic who recognizes the cells as a foe's, you can make them enter combat mode too, if they haven't yet.
summary: The ability to stick to/absorb a foe, assimilate their cells and make other Leukocyte Mimics go into combat mode.
strengths: You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
Enhanced mobility skills include enhanced running, climbing, jumping, swimming skills.
In normal mode, when you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level.
weaknesses: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode, in which you can't absorb or stick to foes anymore.
As soon as you touch a foe's body, you'll get stuck to them until you manage to absorb them.
You'll automatically enter combat as soon as you absorb at least one foe.

name: The Trial
description: If the person succeeds at the trial they will have full use of all of their powers to the power's highest level, but if they fail the trial, then their powers will be locked at the current levels and never be able to become stronger. The trial for each person is based on who and what they are and thus is different for each person. Also, they cannot be disturbed while taking the trial (temporary invulnerability,) which takes place completely in the mind and thus they will not be physically harmed
summary: The ability to have anyone take a trial of which the result affects their power levels
strengths: Allies could become much stronger.
Enemies could be locked at their current power levels.
Any given person can only take the trial once. May be a con if they fail.
weaknesses: Enemies could become much stronger.
Allies could be locked at their current power levels.
Using this power on yourself is a risk.

name: Completely Ungifted
description: This power makes you 100% unaffected by any power. Inversely, you can't have or use any power or object with power. This power transfers to the nearest person when you die, so there is always someone with this ability. If the person the power transfers to has a power, it is lost forever.
summary: The ability to not be affected by any power.
strengths: Never affected by any power.
Ability transfers from person to person after death, so it's never lost.
Power is always active, and undectable.
weaknesses: Can't use any power or object with power.
People might think you're useless.
You might not know you have the power until someone attempts to use a power on you.

name: Vampric Vendetta
description: By concentrating intensely on a person you despise, you drain their vitality bit by bit until they waste away and die. However, as you drain life, you begin to take on their characteristics more and more, and if you drain them completely, these characteristics are ingrained into your personality.
summary: The ability to drain the life out of people you hate.
strengths: Destroy those who stand in your way.
Hold power over life and death literally at your whim.
weaknesses: You will become everything you hate.
In doing so you will grow to hate yourself.
The compounded self-loathing will cause you to collapse into a godlike demon of all consuming hatred

name: Demon Transf. #2 Black Dragon
description: You transform into a big, black dragon. You have all the strength and powers of a dragon (fire breath etc. ). As an additional trait you have a fear aura (everyone looks at you and becomes VERY scared)
summary: The ability to transform into a big dragon.
strengths: Dragons are cool
Fear is cool
weaknesses: You are just a scary dragon, not much to see

name: 300 Spartans
description: You can materialize 300 spartans from your back yard, your bathroom. You can be their leader and its fun.
summary: The ability to appears 300 spartans instantly.
strengths: You are the leader.
They are your friends.
You can make them disappear or reappear.
weaknesses: You have to feed them.
Take good care of them.

name: Haymaker
description: Haymaker is much similar to the fisticuff ability, but rather than delivering an endless combo of punches, haymaker delivers one superblow that can knock out any enemy with enough force to punch a wall and knock out the enemy standing on the other side. Overuse, however, can tear your own muscles or break your bones.
summary: The ability to deliver a highly powerful knockout punch
strengths: Knocks out any opponent, even if they are made of metal or standing behind a wall.
weaknesses: Can be avoided by a fast-moving enemy
Overuse can eventually tear your muscles and break your bones

name: Rise Of The Hydra
description: With this power you can fight crime as the legendary super strong five headed hydra in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into the legendary five headed hydra
strengths: Whenever someone cuts off one of your heads two more grow in it's place
Really big, strong reptile (superstrength, superendurance, strong tail, claws, fangs, etc)
weaknesses: You'll be attacked as you look pretty dangerous

name: Clean Oceans
description: With this ability, you can instantly clean sections of any body of water (depends on size). You can keep the world oceans clean, counter pollution and overfishing, protect/restore coral reefs etc.
summary: The ability to fight threats made to bodies of water
strengths: Clean oceans
Healthy fisheries
Healthy reefs
weaknesses: The bigger the body, the more you need to concentrate
Oceans are to big to do instantly, need a chopper to do it entirely

name: Imperious Interruptus
description: You can hijack the conversations of subordinates.  You can speak to one of the subordinates while you turn your back to the others.  Those others are not allowed to leave, nor to chime in.  Their only choice is to stand awkwardly waiting while forced to listen.
summary: The ability to hijack the conversation of subordinates
strengths: You can spread your wisdom to your subordinates without delay
weaknesses: You boss can use this power against you.

name: Condition Change: Water
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user's skin is visibly wet. It doesn't matter where the skin is wet. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user has visible water on their skin
strengths: Just keep them from getting wet.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.
A hydrokinetic

name: Brown Adipocyte Mimicry
description: This power is always active. Your entire body is covered in a huge amount of tiny brown spots. As soon as you touch/consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb between twice and three times your body mass. However, it won't affect your build at all. In addition to storing a lot of fat, you also have an extremely high metabolic rate and can convert fat into a huge amount of heat. The conversion aspect of this power is amplified by cold external temperatures.
summary: The ability to absorb fat and convert it into heat.
strengths: The fat you absorb also acts as a thermal insulator, protecting you from extreme cold or heat.
You look tanned (well, from a distance).
You'll never worry about becoming fat.
weaknesses: You can only generate heat as long your body contains fat.
Once you burn all the fat in your body, you'll be very vulnerable to external temperatures.
You'll become very heavy despite looking normal.

name: Flesh Melting
description: With this power you can melt people's flesh with your mind. All you have to do is think of the person and say "Flesh melter supreme!" then that person's flesh will start to melt until you shout "Supreme melter of flesh!". You cannot be harmed by anybody who has this power and this power cannot be used on people who have this power.
summary: The ability to melt people's flesh with your mind
strengths: You can melt people's flesh
You can't be affected by this power
weaknesses: You cannot affect people who have this power

name: Myth Power: Alke's Alacrity
description: Alke (Alce), in Greek myth, was the goddess of battle strength (strength in the heat of combat) and battle prowess (fighting skill). As such, channeling her allows one to gain superhuman fighting skill and weapon skill. In addition, one can psychically gauge others' physical stats, fighting skill and weapon skill, at will. Furthermore, one can share one's own fighting and weapon skill with one's allies at will. One can even psychically reduce foes' fighting and weapon skill, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Alke's command over the essence of battle strength and battle prowess
strengths: Gain superhuman fighting and weapon skill; gauge others' physical stats and fighting/weapon skill
Share one's own fighting and weapon skill with others
Psychically reduce foes' fighting and weapon skill, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Pro #3 is not permanent until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand or negate fear-based ability (including MythPowers) until developed (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide resistance until developed (NCN)

name: Want/Need Swapper
description: This power gives the user the ability to swap someones wants for their needs. For example, someone wants a designer purse, but needs water to live. When these are swapped, they now need to the purse to survive, but only want water. If someone does not obtain something they need, they die a slow death as their body shuts down.
summary: The ability to swap a persons wants and needs.
strengths: Swap your enemies basic needs with their unattainable wants.
Swap a dying person need for medicine or surgery with an easily obtained want.
Replace your need to eat, drink, and rest with your hobbies.
weaknesses: You will still want rest, food, sleep, or anything swapped in to a want.

name: Author Power Restriction.
description: Are people exploiting loopholes in powers you create and making themselves overpowered? With this power, one can set rules on your power use forbidding such things without editing the power. Be careful though; it affects you too.
summary: The ability to impose universal restrictions on powers you create.
strengths: Close loopholes others are exploiting.
The only direct defense against this is Author Power Block.
If desired, you may undo restrictions placed upon your powers.
weaknesses: Restrictions cannot have exceptions allowing you to escape the limitations you impose.
No use if you do not create powers.
People will likely find even more ways to get around your power restrictions.

name: My Name Is Legion..We Are Many
description: You are a soul devourer. You take the souls of others & replace their blank lifeless body with with part of your soul. Making more of you all mentally linked together & to you. Every soul you take gives you strength & extended life. So however many souls you have, thats how many lives you can live. If one of your slaves mortally dies, you can keep it alive like a zombie. Only way to die is shoot or whatever between eyes unless already died that way. But you all feel short agony of death.
summary: The ability to absorb souls & replace them with yours controlling zombie-ish army
strengths: You draw strength & life from each soul you take
You control an army of bodies that can live beyond mortal death
weaknesses: Your minions if zombied will die permanantly if shot between the eyes
Everyone feels the mortal death of of anyone
You have to give up a soul you converted to yours in order to zombify a body when dead

name: Scarred
description: With this power you can control the appearance of scars on a person's skin. You can remove scars allowing you to return the skin to normal, or create scars allowing you to change the appearance of the skin. You can create any type of scar, of any pattern, on any section of skin with only a thought. This is an artistic power.
summary: The ability to control the appearance of scars on a person's skin.
strengths: Make a person hideous using the scars.
Give yourself an awesome scar.
Create scar tattoos.
weaknesses: Would not have an awesome story to back up the scar.
Need some artistic skill.
No combat usage.

name: Healer 4: Lethargy Elimination
description: This ability restores the energy levels of lethargic people within range and provides equivalent amounts of energy for the user. However, lethargy will eventually return when people are out of range, since it only treats the symptoms, not the cause. The maximum range for this ability is 25 kilometers, but expands at a rate of 1 meter per year. You can turn this power off at will.
summary: The ability to energize lethargic people and gain stamina.
strengths: Cure lethargy, of any kind.
Has a range of 25 kilometers.
You gain stamina as well.
weaknesses: Cannot heal people outside the current radius.
Only treats symptoms; the cause is likely to remain.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot wounds or other ailments.

name: Mode Lock
description: Tired of fighting someone that can keep transforming. Well with this power you can stop their transformations and make them stay in any of their forms. Let's say that they were spying on you as a bug and you catch them. With a snap they permanently become a bug. Fighting a group that needs to transform to have powers. Snap! Now they can't transform.
summary: The ability to lock anyone into their current form with a snap
strengths: Lock shapeshifters in a harmless form
Keep yourself permanantly transformed into a stronger being
weaknesses: Only good against shapeshifters and people that can change forms
Might lock someone in a good form----if they are enemies this is bad

name: Flint Skin
description: With this power, you have a thin layer of flint covering your whole body. You can strike your skin against yourself or other objects to make sparks. With concentration, you can force your skin to produce thick layers of flint, allowing for resistance to blunt force attacks. You can also break off pieces and use them as daggers or shuriken. Pretty lame, but hey, no more hassling with campfires!
summary: The ability to produce sparks by striking your skin against things
strengths: Removable weapons
Great for Camping! (*sob sob* I'm so lame)
weaknesses: LAME
Mostly useless

name: Human Lantern
description: Light pours out of all your orifices (eyes, ears, mouth, wounds, and down-stairs areas) at any intensity you wish. At high enough intensities, your skin will glow (just like when you put a flashlight under your hand) and you will generate heat.  Not exactly the sneakiest power, but can dazzle and keep you warm.
summary: The ability to generate light from the inside.
strengths: Your eyes are natural headlights.
Could potentially blind enemies.
Can't freeze to death.
weaknesses: Mirrors and other reflective surfaces are your new nemesises.
Easily gives your position away when used.
You'd have a firefly-bum. (Firefly's a good alias, though... )

name: Hi My Name Is
description: If you forget names easily, this is the power for you, like if you're about to go on a date and they call you and you forgot their name, you are screwed. OK, peace!
summary: The ability to know everyone's name.
strengths: You will always know people's name.
You will know every girl's name.
You will know every actor's or actress's name.
weaknesses: You might say a random name during sex.
You might call a chinese dude Jackie Chan.
You might say a random name at a bar.

name: Mood Singing
description: Sing a note and change the mood of a person or in a room. Like as if you were to sing a bad note you make some one or a room filled with people sad. Or if you were to sing a happy note you can make people happy. You can sing a dramatic note you can make some one scared. The one rule you must follow you can not use this on yourself for any kind of reason.
summary: The ability to sing a note and change the mood of a person or in a room
strengths: Great in battle
You can have fun with it
Ummm. Yay that's most it.
weaknesses: Can not use it on yourself
Can't use to cause phsyical pain
Yay so that's it really

name: Power Murderer
description: If you kill others, you will gain their powers. This power is useless against people with no powers.  If you kill a person who has the same power as you, it will be given a boost.
summary: The ability to gain one's powers if you kill them.
strengths: If you steal a power they can come back, but if you kill them they can't.
Easier with some killing abilities.
If you kill someone indirectly, you still get their powers.
weaknesses: May be hard/dangerous to kill someone with powers.
Could feel guilty.

name: Dance Master
description: Dance any way you want and be the best, without even breaking a sweat.
summary: The ability to dance like a master (Hip-Hop, Charlie Brown, slow, etc.)
strengths: No more getting served
Won't embarrass yourself
Crime fight and dance at same time
weaknesses: Gangs will want to hurt you
Might lose friends due to jealousy

name: Rise Of The Landshark
description: With this power you can turn into a landshark. A landshark is pretty much just a shark with legs and feet where their tail should be and arms and hands were their fins should be. As a landshark you have super strength and invulnerability along with super sharp teeth and the ability to breathe under water. As a landshark you are unable to speak unless you are under water.
summary: The ability to turn into a landshark
strengths: You can turn into a super strong landshark with super sharp teeth and can breathe under water
weaknesses: You are not able to speak unless you are underwater

name: Power Health Chain
description: With this ability you can basically select one of your powers to make the base chain link. If that power get's copied all of your powers get's copied, if that power get's a strength boost all of your powers get a strength boost. This affect does not include status such as activation as in if you activate said power all of your powers do not activate at the same time as well unless you wish so.
summary: The ability to have all of your powers status be affected by the status of the one designated power.
strengths: Upgrade all of your powers by upgrading the base chain link.
As long as the base chain is not negated none of your other powers can be negated.
weaknesses: Obvious. If the base power gets negated all of your powers get negated.
If the base power becomes weakened all of your powers become weakened.
Only one power can be the base power.

name: Bio Sneeze
description: With this power you can sneeze out your own made up pathogen. You can control every thing about it from when your body gets rid of it to what symptoms you get from it.
summary: The ability to sneeze out your own species of bacteria or virus
strengths: You can give your enemies embarrassing symptoms
You can give yourself symptoms that acutely help you
weaknesses: You might not successfully give or get the germs/viruses

name: Top Chef
description: With this ability, you know every recipe for every meal in existence.  You'll know how to prepare it, exactly which ingredients you need, and you'll even be able to finish cooking within 10 minutes, no matter how many people you're cooking for or how complex the dish is.  You're just that friggin good.
summary: The ability to know how to professionally prepare any meal within 10 minutes.
strengths: Cook whatever you want quickly
Be the next Food Network Star
The ladies love a man who can cook
weaknesses: People might be embarrassed to cook for you
Paying for gourmet foods
Managing the hotel you'll probably want to open

name: Third Eye: Inner Eye
description: Through long, hard meditation the owner of this power has gained an internal third eye. This eye grants the owner the power to have visions, clairvoyance, observation of chakra and auras, precognition, and out-of-body experiences. In order to maintain the eye, the holder has to meditate, although not as much.
summary: The ability to utilize a third eye gained through meditation
strengths: It is mental and cannot be seen unlike the third eye in the Third Eye power.
The eye gives multiple powers.
weaknesses: Must meditate to gain the eye.
Have to meditate to maintain power.
Might not get the eye even for several years worth of meditation.

name: Fingernail Whip Blades
description: The blades are connected to the fingers by 1 millimetre-thick threads. The blades are sharp enough to cut through a cable of wires, and can take 10000 Newtons of force. Minimum size of the blades is 1 centimetre while maximum size of the blades is 5 centimetres. The threads can extend to be up to 500 metres long with minimum length being 2 centimetres. If the threads are destroyed, the blades immediately dissolve into raw minerals.
summary: The ability to turn one's fingernails into blades that are on the ends of threads
strengths: The blades are extremely sharp which allows cutting of most materials.
Can fight long-range battles against close-range enemies without moving that much.
Don't need to gesture to move the blade.
weaknesses: Accidently cutting yourself would be a really really horrible idea.
The blades can't take a large amount of force being put on them.
Blades and threads have the same weaknesses and hardness as fingernails.

name: Vision Displacement
description: This power enables you to make your own eyes disappear, to create two new ones wherever you want on your body and to see with them. The new eyes do not damage the organs they appear into, are fully functional and have perfect eyesight regardless of where they appear. For example, they can appear on the back of the skull where there should be bones or in the palm of the hands even though the hands themselves aren't thick enough for eyeballs to fit. The eyes can appear on separate locations.
summary: The ability to see with another part of your body
strengths: Litterally keep an eye behind you.
Look into areas you couldn't reach before.
You don't need glasses or contact lenses for your new eyes.
weaknesses: You will look creepy with your new eyes and your empty eye sockets.
You might need some time to get used to your new eyes' location.

name: Myth Power: Alala's Alarum
description: Alala (Alale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the battle-cry or war-cry, "Alala" or "Alale". As such, channeling her allows one to give a great, loud cry with three effects. Neutrals will be intimidated (often to the point of either fleeing or passing out); foes will become temporarily stunned for a few seconds; allies will have their stats, fighting skill and hostility will be amplified, and they will gain the ability to wield even their most mundane possessions like weapons of combat.
summary: The ability to channel Alala and her command over the essence of the call to arms (the battlecry or warcry)
strengths: Frighten neutral onlookers to make way for a battlefield anywhere you choose
Give allies a headstart in any fight
Turn allies into powerful warriors, who wield ordinary items like weapons of war
weaknesses: Some may actually have to yell "ALALA" or "ALALE" to activate this ability, until developed
Headstart in a fight is only by a few seconds; cannot turn mundane objects into actual weapons (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Specific Superstrength
description: You can still lift what you would normally be able to lift, but also have the option to superhumanly lift objects between 500 and 750 lbs like they're styrofoam
summary: The ability to lift between 500 and 750 pounds exactly, no more no less
strengths: Impressive party trick
Throw small vehicles and boulders like they are nothing
If you obtain a weapon of the right weight and whatnot, you can wield it
weaknesses: Anything less than 500 lbs is too heavy for you
If the object you are lifting loses weight, it may crush you

name: Toast
description: With this power you can toast bread just by looking at it. You are unable to reverse the affects of this power but you can turn it on and off.
summary: The ability to turn bread into toast just by looking at it
strengths: You can toast bread with your eyes
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Living Tattoos
description: With living tattoo you can make your body art come to life, assuming you have tattoos of course. Have a lion defend you in combat, have an escape vehicle, or a weapon, etc. When you tattoos come to life you are momentarily in a coma-like state leaving you defenseless for that short while.
summary: The ability to make your tattoos come to life.
strengths: Make your tattoos fight for you.
Have a an escape vehicle.
Create a weapon on hand.
weaknesses: Must have tattoos.
Coma-like state.
Those ridiculous tattoos.

name: Soul Whisper
description: With the Soul Whisper ability, you are able to talk to the souls of people around you and people from the past. When talking to a soul, you leave your body and your soul takes over, continuing on with your life. When in soul mode, you can talk to other souls and even convince them to leave their bodies causing their body to die. You can also ask other souls to do work for you. But beware, not all souls are good and some souls may try to harm you or trick you into danger.
summary: The ability to talk to souls
strengths: You can pretty much kill people
You can leave your body while it unconciously works
You can find information about that history assignment by talking to Abe Lincoln's soul
weaknesses: As a soul, you are more vulnerable to dying in the real world, unless your soul is strong
Prolonged exposure in the soul world can be dangerous

name: Toy Model To Real Item
description: You can turn toy models into the real thing for 1 hr. The toy can be of any material and can be anything reasonable. E. G. Toy plane to actual plane, model of a girl to actual girl. The 'item' will work just as if it was made normally.
summary: The ability to turn model toys into the real thing
strengths: Can always have a friend if you have the right model.
Can travel the world for free.
weaknesses: Transformation of objects lasts for only one hour.
If you don't have the right model(s).

name: Taming Sari Keris
description: The user with this mystical keris is granted both super human strength as well as durability. This keris can only be used by a person pure of heart as well as brave. However, to use the keris effectively, the user must be trained extensively in the art of silat first
summary: The ability to use the mystical Taming Sari Keris
strengths: Superhuman strength and durability
Can fight most threats
weaknesses: User without having physical contact with the keris will not have its power bestowed on them
Does not grant you martial arts skill to use the keris effectively

name: Giganto
description: You will be able to become strong and really big in seconds, or become weak and small again. So stay big.
summary: The ability to bulk up really fast or bulk down really fast.
strengths: Being very very strong
Looking really good
Super scary
weaknesses: Roid rage

name: Raindrop Shield
description: The raindrop-shaped shields have a radius of double your arm length and the point extends another 15 centimetres from the center. The shields have a design based on the mind, soul, and body of the user and can take damage based on the user's willpower. The shields can also have up to ten small handheld objects stored between them and the arms.
summary: The ability to create raindrop-shaped shields on one's forearms
strengths: Unique design for each individual being.
Small amount of storage space.
weaknesses: If you have no willpower.
NO tanks, planes, androids, etc. There is not enough space in the storage area.

name: Jawbreaker
description: So long as the person is within seeing range, you can snap your fingers and break the person's lower jaw. You don't have to punch them, and it won't do anything other than break the person's jaw.
summary: The ability to inexplicably break anyone's jaw at any given time.
strengths: Quick incapacitation technique without killing them
No contact needed
Shuts people up fast
weaknesses: Control may or may not be an issue
Person can make a lot of noise afterwords, not exactly stealthy

name: Description Reduction
description: You know the overview? That sentence sitting between the title and the description? This power can affect any ability so its description is reduced only to what's in the overview, losing everything else! No more title, full description, pros and cons, tags, creator name, possessors' names (excluding the name of the one on whom you use this power), statistics and comment section. The affected ability is reduced to what can be understood and interpreted from the overview alone.
summary: The ability to reduce any ability to what can be understood from its overview, and only its overview.
strengths: Has the potential to greatly improve any ability since limitations are usually lost in the process.
Used correctly, it is a great counter to Power Sacrifice (Hey, it says you're the only possessor! )
Same thing against Author Power Mimicry (Hey, it doesn't say you created this power! )
weaknesses: A lot of details can be lost during the process, possibly resulting in a vastly different power.
Nothing can be added to the description.
Some overviews are badly written or open to interpretation.

name: Tune Of Sadness
description:
You are able to make an instrument appear out of nowhere and play music on it that makes everyone sad. This effect is globally, so if you play all beings become sad. 
You don't need to be able to play the actual instrument.
summary: The ability to play music that makes everyone sad.
strengths: Make everyone understand the way you feel.
Nobody is able to move or act while you play.
You don't need to drag an instrument around everywhere you go.
weaknesses: Deaf or people who ear plugs are immune.
If everyone is sad, who will cheer you up?
The effect ends once you seize to play.

name: Vampirism
description: With this ability, you gain superior strength, speed, durability, stamina, senses, reflexes, agility, accuracy, dexterity, and basically immortality. You can turn into a bat, a wolf, a red mist, or (at the higher level) even the form of another human. In addition, you gain the power Hypnotism, and as your power develops, you may be able to fly. The only shortcoming is that, with all the traditional powers of a vampire, you also get all the traditional weaknesses.
summary: The ability to have all the traditional abilities (and weaknesses) of a vampire
strengths: Enhanced attributes and can shapeshift to assume various different forms
Immortal (longevity, regeneration, poison/disease/hanging/guns/drowing/electrocution can't kill you)
Powers of Hypnotism (including Hypnotic Charm), power to command canines, and Shapeshifting
weaknesses: You are extremely vulnerable to sunlight (if you haven't had blood in about three days)
Allergy to garlic, holy symbols, stakes and silver
Can't cross rivers, no reflection, and no shadow (until powers develop, bound to coffin)

name: Forced Standing
description: Isn't it a pain in the ass when you have to stand all day long? Well, now you can FORCE people to endure this misery! Or, you can use this for entertainment! Just think of the possibilities... Disrupting class, bathrooms, a unique form of torture, and get this: at the next football game you can choreograph and execute the PERFECT wave! How can you go wrong? Not to mention the fun you would have at church...
summary: The ability to force people to stand.
strengths: Disrupting prayer
Easily get revenge on someone while they're dropping a deuce
Endless hours of fun
weaknesses: You will be known as The Great Bringer of Discomfort

name: Dehydration
description: A Dehydrator may look normal, but you need to be wary around them. They can drain an object of its water content--wood, Kool-Aid, living things, etc.--leaving it dry and brittle. This water is then metabolized. This ability comes with an incredible thirst, as a result of the body quickly clearing water from its system. It is also difficult to stop using this ability once you have started without draining something first.
summary: The ability to suck the water out of an object
strengths: Kill easily
Re-powder Kool-Aid
Affect anything with water content
weaknesses: Comes with an incredible thirst
Hard to stop after starting without draining something
Cannot affect things with menial water content

name: Delete This Giga X Ray Assault
description: True to its name, it is an ability of a sequence that lets you look through your foe's body with an X-Ray vision. Then, you rush to your enemy, breaking off both their arms and legs, karate chopping their spine, but before launching the pile driver, you go in mid-air, breaking their ribcage, and the impact upon landing shatters their skull. Now that's gotta hurt.
summary: The ability to completely break all of your opponent's bones.
strengths: It's extremely useful when your foe is dizzy.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Bases Control
description: With this power, you can spew bases out of your hands and also change the PH level of your skin and blood. The big benefit of this power is a lot of villains have power over acids. Well, with power over bases, you can balance that acid to a PH level of 7 making it water. Also, since bases are just as strong as acids, it has offensive potential too.
summary: The ability to control bases (the opposite of acids)
strengths: You can balance villains who have acidic powers
Everyone will assume you have powers over acids when really it is bases
Since acids and bases are equal in strength, you can still fight other villains
weaknesses: There are not a lot of superhero names for someone who controls bases
You cannot really kill an acidic villain, just make his powers useless
If you cannot control it, you will melt through everything like you are acidic

name: Blessing Of Heimdallr
description: The user, once blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr, is granted a golden suit of armor, a golden great sword , a mystical horn and limited powers of the God Heimdall
summary: The ability to be blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr
strengths: Limited Precognition
Enhanced Eyesight and Hearing ( Not super )
Can summon allies with mystical horn
weaknesses: Can't fly
Armor and great sword reduces speed

name: Business Tycoon
description: This ability you do exceedingly well, at managing business and companies. Always shooting straight to the top of the corporate ladder. Whatever your business is about. You get all the clients and become extraordinarily wealthy.
summary: The ability to do extraordinary well at business management.
strengths: Always excell in business 100% of the time.
Choices you make end up making you more money.
weaknesses: Business management may not be one of your interests.

name: Floor Removal
description: This ability allows you to grab the floor and to pull it out. Once released, the floor will quickly come back into place. If there's a room under the floor, you can also open a passage to it. If your enemy or a bystander is standing on the floor, you can literally pull the floor out from under them to make them fall.
summary: The ability to pull the floor out like a rug
strengths: Make your enemies trip.
Easily open an access to the room beneath the floor.
weaknesses: Useless against flying enemies.
Works only on the floor

name: Daydream Recovery
description: You can remember past daydreams. You can daydream again. You can also make it much harder for people to interrupt your daydreams (unless you want them to). Your brain puts together what it learns during daydreaming as a side effect. Your brain exercises it's complex problem solving skills during the daydream. You might become more emphathetic. A daydream might be a stronger form of imagination.
summary: The ability to recover your ability to daydream that has been crushed by certain people.
strengths: Recover your ability to daydream.
Remember past daydreams
Daydreaming has similar benefits to sleeping.
weaknesses: Might not recover imagination.
If you daydream excessively, it becomes disruptive to your life.

name: Life Drain Backlash
description: Should the user of this power ever run a marathon, have his life-force absorbed, or otherwise exert too much energy, the consequences can be dire. When the user feels exhausted, even mentally, his body gives off a psychic version of an EMP that basically causes a foe's nerves to fire off at once. This temporarily disables their foe so they can recuperate and catch their breath.
summary: The ability to produce a backlash effect whenever you suffer a severe loss of stamina
strengths: Life-force absorbers are no match for you
Vampires are hurting themselves by trying to drink your blood (and dehydration harms dehydrators)
If you get too tired, your power goes off to give you a headstart or a leg-up
weaknesses: If you get really tired during sex
If you feel mental strain during a test
Never run a marathon, if you don't plan on being discovered

name: Super Alloy Shapeshifting
description: Just like colossus, but a lot cooler and more durable. You can withstand temperature extremes and you have immunity to most physical attacks. You can change in any alloy you want, even adamantium and vibranium.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a super-alloy while retaining organic properties
strengths: Withstand temperature extremes and most physical attacks
Can withstand almost anything like acids, bullets, TNT, etc.
Super-strength, superhuman endurance
weaknesses: Physical protection only
Can be hurt by super super strength

name: Chaos Dice
description: You can conjure 6 sided dice that you can roll. If the roll is one, the person you have picked will not die but will be painfully hurt. If you roll a six, your victim's inner organs and body explode in chaos as your victim feels the worst feeling of pain possible to feel by a human.
summary: The ability to roll dice to randomly kill someone.
strengths: Can be painful and deadly
weaknesses: You could roll a one

name: Dodge
description: This power will allow to move out of the way of some sort of attack. However, you must be aware of the attack in order to dodge it. For example, if someone hits you from behind or catches you off guard, they will most likely succeed.
summary: The ability to dodge any attack or action towards you.
strengths: Great in combat situations.
Applies to mental and physical attacks.
Can lead to good counter moves.
weaknesses: Have to be aware of the attack.
Has to be realistically dodged (tight corners can be a problem)

name: Epidermal Chroma Control
description: With this power, you can completely control the color of your skin. You can be white, black, purple, or whatever. Options are only limited to the visible light spectrum. However, you cannot alter the texture of your skin, but your skin doesn't have to be a solid color, and you could even create patterns of color on your skin. Your internal colors (including eyeballs) will not change, nor will your hair color.
summary: The ability to control the color of your own skin at will.
strengths: Can provide some degree of camouflage
Never have to put on coloring makeup again
Can have new tattoos everyday
weaknesses: Not that useful for hiding unless naked and bald
Strong emotions may trigger unintentional changes
People may want to touch and poke your skin whenever it is a non-normal color

name: Bard
description: Bards are musical warriors that can enchant others with their songs. A bard can play any instrument expertly and the songs they play can have the effect of buffing themselves and their friends or hindering their enemies. A bard's melodies can unite a group so that their strengths act in harmony. Advanced Bards can even use their melodies to mesmerize their foes and alter their minds.
summary: The ability to have the musical powers of a Bard.
strengths: Use songs to strengthen and bolster allies.
Use songs to weaken or dishearten foes.
Advanced Bards can mesmerize others.
weaknesses: Requires an instrument.
Have to play songs to effect others.
If the song is stopped or isn't heard, the effect wears off.

name: Invincible Ears
description: With this power your ears are invincible meaning they cannot be cut off, you cannot go deaf, you cannot get an ear infection, your hearing is always perfect, you can't be affected by the bang part of flashbang grenades, nothing can hurt your ears, your ears cannot feel cold or heat unless you want them to.
summary: The ability to have invincible ears
strengths: Your ears are invincible
weaknesses: Only your ears are invincible

name: Helmet Hair
description: With this power you can turn your hair (only the stuff on your head) into a helmet. The helmet is completely indestructible and you can turn it back into hair whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn your hair into a helmet
strengths: You can turn your hair into a helmet
The more hair you have the larger your helmet
weaknesses: You can really only protect the top of your head

name: The Shyamalan Effect
description: Oh what a beautiful day..... Why is my house on the moon?! What a twist! This power allows you to manipulate one's own or someone else's probability so that whatever they do next will turn out to be a "twist" like in a movie. When the killer is going after them, it might turn out that he just wants to kill that awful nail biting habit of theirs. What a twist! You can't control what kind of twist happens though. It can be good, bad or just plain weird.
summary: The ability to affect probability to force a huge random twist in a situation.
strengths: Make your enemies really confused.
Maybe you like M. Night Shyamalan movies so much that you can make your life like one.
weaknesses: You can't control what kind of twist it will be. It can be for the best or for the worst.
Maybe you hate M. Night Shyamalan movies and stupid, unexplainable twists.

name: H&V Control
description: There are 3 rules: 1. You can only control one target at a time; 2. While controling, your body will be left unconscious; 3. You can only control your target for 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to control heroes and villains
strengths: Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
weaknesses: Your original body goes into an unconscious state
You only have a limited amount of time in a body
After you leave the target's body, the target becomes conscious

name: Firework Vision
description: You are able to generate a blast of fireworks from your eyes. The blast can be any colour and you can control how strong it is. You are unable to control when the blast explodes.
summary: The ability to shoot fireworks from your eyes
strengths: You are an immediate party hit
It can be very useful
You can control the colour and how strong it is
weaknesses: You cannot control when the blast explodes

name: Reincarnation 1: Genetic
description: With this power, you have a genetic anomaly compos, which is passed on to your descendants. These genes have this power. This trait is autorecessive (look it up) Children born with two of these genes turn into "backup" bodies upon death -complete with your exact DNA, including powers. Children born with one copy will be carriers, able to produce backups and more carriers, but not otherwise affected. If they inherit neither, they are normal humans.
summary: The ability to reincarnate as your descendants.
strengths: Be very hard to kill with enough backups.
Easy to use.
If negated, the genes are passed on until the suppression is over, when they regain their powers.
weaknesses: Someone can kill all your backups and carriers.
May be hard to keep all the backups and carriers safe.
Certain causes of death will not cause the backups to revive.

name: Anatomical Automatism
description: A katana is the best thing that could happen to an Anotomical Automator. When a part of their body gets seperated from them, they control it as if it was still attached. This means that severed hands and arms can still scurry around, severed legs can still kick, and even spilled blood will crawl around. This also comes with the ability to reattach the limbs easily. However, it still hurts and the body cannot automatically detach body parts.
summary: The ability to control the parts of your body after they have been severed
strengths: Having limbs severed not such a big deal
Can reattach the parts easily
Can even control spilled blood
weaknesses: Still hurts
Cannot automatically detach body parts
Do not have a psychic link to parts

name: Black Beetle Scarab
description: The user with the black beetle scarab is able to form a black beetle armor around his or her body. The black beetle armor is symbiotic in nature, and it will help the user in times of need. The black beetle armor host a huge array of defenses and weapons. Besides that, the black beetle armor is totally invulnerable to every form of fire. The armor has only limited invulnerability to physical attacks
summary: The ability to have a black beetle armor form around the user with the use of the scarab
strengths: The symbiotic nature of the armor helps the user in times of need
Invulnerable to all types of fire
Has a huge arsenal of weapons as well as defenses
weaknesses: When they symbiote takes over, the user forgets what he or she does during that time.
Not invulnerable to physical strikes, only limited

name: For Ages Three And Up
description: Recreate any object from a child show or comedy.
summary: The ability to recreate objects from shows rated Kids and/or a comedy.
strengths: Some are helpful.
weaknesses: No Violence, Teen shows objects can be recreated with this power.

name: Balls Of Fire
description: Imagine balls.  Now, imagine balls of fire.  That's what you bring to the table.  Kick ass at any sport, as long as there's some kind of ball involved.  Make Tiger Woods look like a kitten.  Make Michael Jordan feel like a midget.  With that dirty mind of yours, you may even be thinking of less-than-PG uses for this ability.  Hey, anything goes as long as it's a sport and it involves balls, you dirty minded bastard.  Great balls of fire!
summary: The ability to be amazing at any sport involving a ball (or balls).
strengths: Kick ass any most sports
Eventually, you'll find a way to turn the horizontal tango into a sport
Never warm the benches
weaknesses: Your main weakness is badminton

name: Zero's Scroll: Dark Light
description: Dark Light is considered light, but it is pure black. Using this you can create a light made of darkness. Because this combines to conflicting elements, light and dark, it is extremely volatile. Instead of exploding, it implodes. When use on someone it will be absorbed into the targets body, and the said body will implode on itself.
summary: The ability to use Dark Light.
strengths: Create black light.
Great for offense.
weaknesses: Hard to control.
Very... Very volatile and unstable.

name: Serpent Supreme
description: With this power you can turn into a giant man eating snake whenever you want. In giant man eating snake form you are the size of an elephant and have green, nearly impenetrable skin. You have a long red forked tongue and two rows of sharp teeth. The only thing you can eat in this form is other humans; if you eat anything else, you die.
summary: The ability to turn into a giant man eating snake
strengths: You can turn into a powerful giant man eating snake
You have nearly impenetrable skin and two rows of super sharp teeth
weaknesses: All you can eat in snake mode is other humans
You have not arms or legs

name: Whistle Point
description: With this power, you can make people start whistling uncontrollably whenever you point at them. They don't even have to know how to whistle, though, after you use this power on them, they will remember how to do it later. This is useful if people are saying bad things about you, you can simply point at them and they will start to whistle instead.
summary: The ability to make people whistle when you point at them
strengths: You can make people start whistling when you point at them.
Once you use it on somebody they know how to whistle permanently.
weaknesses: You have to keep pointing at them or they'll stop whistling.

name: Bodily Malfunctions
description: This power makes a person lose their bodily functions, meaning they crap & piss themselves til you leave. You secrete & release an aerial chemical pheromone that attacks anyone else's neural inhibitor that controls their bodily functions, making them urinate & defecate uncontrollably.
summary: The ability to induce loss of bodily functions in a person
strengths: Can be used as a distraction/escape power, making people go #1 & 2
weaknesses: It's a toilet joke superpower
The mess

name: Sibling Power
description: You and your siblings possess super strength, super speed, invulnerability, healing and flight, as well as an invisible aura. When you are in a sibling's aura's range, your power's increase in ratio to your proximity. When standing next to your sibling you can withstand a nuclear blast and lift mountains, but if you are a mile away you are barely superhuman. At all times you have a telepathic connection with siblings, which either of you can block at will.
summary: The ability to have strengthened shared powers when near a sibling
strengths: When nearby you and your siblings have phenomenal power
Could be a great crimefighting duo
Playing ball games while flying would be cool
weaknesses: Have to be near your sibling to use your powers
If you hate your sibling, then superpowers will only worsen the situation
If a sibling dies, you must be near their body or ashes to use your powers

name: Battle Leather
description: You can grow a durable hide, as hard as steel, as light as silk, and it can be shed at will. The leather doesn't disappear once shed, either--it can be crafted into other armor or objects.
summary: The ability to grow a durable hide
strengths: Light, easy to use defence
Items can be crafted from the shed hide
You can grow it on other people if you are touching them
weaknesses: Hide takes up nutrients fron your body
Enemies finding and using the hide against you

name: War Zone
description: Creates a zone that causes war and fighting to be more likely to happen and intensifies them. People in the zone become more agitated to the point where they go insane with rage if inside the zone to long. People become stronger the longer the field is in place and aspects of the environment become more dangerous. Healing affects also weaken over time. Effects are quickly removed if the zone is left.
summary: The ability to create a zone that intensifies fighting.
strengths: Cause a fight when you need one.
Put on an enemy camp and destroy them from within.
Good to use against opponents that rely on their brains.
weaknesses: May go into a rage yourself.
If you start a war and are on losing side.
Has no use except to start fights.

name: Holy Power: Redemption
description: With this ability, when you defeat someone, you can chose if your defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell. If this person is "forgiven", she will be sent to Heaven. If this person is "punished", she will be sent to Hell. This ability also allows you to use other Holy Powers. This power is Hero only.
summary: The ability to chose if a defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell, and allows you to use other Holy Powers.
strengths: You can chose if our enemy deserves forgiveness or punishment.
Makes you able to learn all Holy Powers.
weaknesses: You need to be a good person to be able to use this power.

name: Soul Re Creator
description: You can turn a soul into a body, equal or less than the souls old body's weight, their body/soul slowly grows back, for someone small, less than 2 months, for a heavier person, a little longer than 4 years.
summary: The ability to turn souls into bodies while their soul slowly grows back.
strengths: For giving them back their bodies they are loyal to you.
weaknesses: How likely is it you will find a wandering soul?
It takes a while to grow back their body from their soul.

name: Superhuman Insanity
description: Joker, Hannibal Lector, and all mad scientists all have this trademark ability. They cannot be convinced  or dissuaded by ordinary means and can always come up with a convoluted scheme.This power also renders the user immune to fear based power-they are so insane that nothing scares them.
summary: The ability to be so insane that it serves as an advantage
strengths: You are not afraid of anything
You can come up with things that no rational person would have considered
You are immune to mind control
weaknesses: Sanity has its advantages--social interaction, etc.
You will be placed in the mental ward or isolate yourself from society

name: Perfect Zombie
description: A person with this power can revive as a zombie. But not just any type of zombie. You get to retain your intelligence and sentience as a human and you do not need to eat brains or do any sort of ritual. You just revive with increased strength lack of pain receptors and unlimited stamina with no need to sleep. Also you don't rot either. You can move as fast at I am Legend Zombies. However you can still be "killed" by a headshot or be burned to death.
summary: The ability to revive as a zombie with your sanity intact and you do not need to eat brains
strengths: All the normal zombie powers like unlimited stamina, can't get killed by normal wounds
Don't have to eat brains and you don't rot over time and you don't smell either
Retains brain power---as in you can still think like a normal person
weaknesses: You are already dead and your skin is pale
Can still be burned or shot in the head
No regenerative factor---your cells are dead--so you need to sew up your body the hard way

name: Axe Of Pine
description: When the holidays are coming near you want to fight your enemies in a fitting theme. With this ability anything wooden in your hands can be turned into a 7-foot long Christmas-tree-shaped axe capable of chopping enemies to bits. Also, you don't need super strength to use this weapon, but anyone else trying to use your axe WILL (it'll be extremely heavy to them). Note: Around Christmas your tree-axe is decorated.  (delete the following: This is not meant as a joke. )
summary: The ability to summon a huge pine tree shaped like a rasor sharp axe.
strengths: This axe is just as strong as any other axe.
No need to drag heavy objects with you.
It's flammable, so you can wield a flaming axe
weaknesses: Avoid using it on a necessary item (can't be reversed)
When lighting the tree-axe on fire, might burn your hands

name: Delete This Rapid Eruption

weaknesses: None.

name: Bladed Whip Tail
description: The tail is 1 metre long and 2-5 centimetres thick dependant on where it is measured. The tail can be controlled at will as it is a part of your body. The bladed end is as sharp as a 4-body katana and if it is cut off will take 3(blade only)-4(whole tail) days to grow back. The look and composition of the tail and blade vary for each being with this power.

name: Weapon Control:Armored Assault

Good combo with other WC powers

name: Miracle: Cross Bear

With this power people that hit you will lose their willpower to hurt you the more that they hit you. 

The more willpower/hatred a person puts into a punch the more drained of willpower the other person will be.

If you are a masochist then you will get over the main con of this power

name: Variables
description: This ability allows you to view and modify the variables - the invisible properties that define how an object exists in the universe - of anything. The possibilities are endless. Modify the AGE variable to change the age of an object or the COLOUR variable to change its colour. You can also change your own variables. If you are ill, increase your HEALTH variable, or if you need some extra strength, increase your STRENGTH variable.

name: Beauty Stealing
description: With this power you can become attractive by simply touching the person that you envy because of their beauty. By doing this you will replace your appearance with theirs and their appearance with yours.

Feeling good about yourself
Making the person you envy suffer from your appearance

name: Brownian Motion Manipulation
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate small particles suspended in a liquid or gas. In effect the user can manipulate any particle by controlling the kinetic heat around the particles. This can be used for various effects.

Physicists and scientists roll in their graves---This is a joke

name: Condition Change: Ownership
description: A power affected by this power will only affect that which its user owns. The power can now only affect their pets, their books, their toys, etc. This power is tactile.

Mind readers can't read your mind if they don't own you.

name: Spawn: Greek Armory
description: You are able to spawn fully stocked Greek Armories.  They will be stocked with Greek weapons, used in their wars and only those weapons, so newer weapons or weapons from a different culture will not be stocked in the armory.  Since the greeks believed in magic and magical items there is a possibility that you may spawn a magical item armory.

If you train enough you will be able to summon an armory with the gods weapons.
weaknesses: Some items might be cursed...
Since you spawn already created armory's you must do a lot of research of which is the best

name: Magic Talismans
description: Magical items created over the centuries contain numerous powers. Also boosting the magical abilities of the user. Not a power in itself but a better way to strengthen magic abilities.

Increase power with simple possession of the object.
Specialize in a school a magic by having certain items.
