name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Wrath
description: By gaining the abilities of Wrath, you would gain almost perfect swordsmanship, rarely making a mistake. You gain increased strength, speed, and agility. You also gain an ultimate eye, able to read, predict and counter any and all situations. The only weakness of the eye is that if there is an obstacle in between the eye and a situation the situation and the eye will read, and predict the situation incorrectly.

strengths: The ultimate eye
Perfect swordsmanship.
weaknesses: An obstacle in between the eye and the situation.

name: Power Reader
description: You see powers like bars on a cell phone from none to 4 as far. As you know.

description: This power allows you to bring the iron in your blood out through the pores in your skin and make it into orbs that you can throw at speeds surpassing that of a jet plane. You will not be able to use this many times because you might take all the iron out leaving you dead.

description: You raise or lower the volume in someone's head, making them insane or killing them.

name: Numbness
description:
This ability you can cause people to go numb with your mind. From fingers, toes, feet, hands, legs and arms to anywhere to everywhere in the body.
The extreme numbness of this ability can cause people to bleed. Even bleed to death.

name: Uncontrolled Rampage
description: With this ability, you cause people's aggression levels to rise, increasing their strength substantially, and they go into an uncontrollable berserk rampage, which they can only be stopped from over time. They will destroy buildings and attack people. However, no harm will come to the user.

name: Odin's Ravens
description: You can summon the Ravens Hugin and Munin. They went out into the world and told Odin what they heard and saw when they were out. You can only gain the power Odin's Ravens after obtaining Loki's staff and Thor's hammer, plus completing the challenge of defeating three frost giants. However they don't always come back so soon they sometimes come back after a month or more.

name: Superhero 4: Hulk
description:
"Don't make me angry. You wouldn't like me when I'm angry. " Where did that line come from? Hulk, maybe? 
Yeah, it was because you can be endowed with "incredible" strength, great speed, big jumps, and bulletproof skin.

name: Miquiztli, The Introspector
description: When activated, you'll change into a moving, talking skeleton. This allows you to sense when someone is neglecting their priorities or when they are turning a blind eye on their situation, and to make people have an objective point of view of themselves, meaning that they will see and judge themselves as if they were an external observer. They still retain their personal view and opinion of themselves, but it can, and most likely will, clash with the more honest and objective view you give them.
summary: The ability to make people have an external and objective point of view of their own actions.
strengths: You can help them see what's wrong with them, improve their behavior and redefine their priorities.
You can use it on yourself if you need to think about a personal problem.
If someone is acting very obnoxiously, you can put them in their place by making them realize it.
weaknesses: Truth hurts, especially true when it comes from ourselves.

Find the brown noise
Win American Idol & become the best singer in the world!

description: The skin of the holder of this power is developed so that it can accommodate from 30 to 40 butterflies inside it. These butterflies are bigger than normal, they have a strength and a high regenerative factor, and can depart for several kilometers from their "nest". When butterflies rest, the skin of the subject seems simply decorated with their wings; when they are active the skin appears normal. The subject can control these butterflies and perceive what's happening around them.

Look awesome at dance parties.

description: This ability allows any female to enchant and entice their victims into falling in love with them.  Someone poor at using this ability might not even know they have it, but anyone whom they feel they love would love them back.  Anyone whom is decent at weilding this ability would have anyone whom they come in contact with fall for them, and lastly, a master would be able to pick and chose.  This ability works on contact for anyone competent; a touch of the hand could do it.

Upon contact with another person, this liquid is quickly assimilated. Its effects are euphoria, a reducing of physical pain, and apathy. The subject must touch the drug in order to feel its effects, and some may experience mental addiction. Narcotic Emitters are immune to their own drug.

description: This power is always active. As soon as you consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb up to four times your original body mass, becoming more obese. When you consume at least twice your body mass, you can undergo mitosis, duplicating yourself into two identical individuals and cutting your fat supply in half between your two selves. Also, as you slim, the skin will readjust so you won't have any excess. Additionally, you have the power to inhibit your or other people's appetite.

Gain different fighting styles.
weaknesses: You have to be physically alone to stop it.

name: Alpha Cell Mimicry
description: This Mimicry belongs to the islets of Langerhans. You can produce glucagon, a hormone which raises the level of blood sugar in the body. You can inject a dose in anyone through touch, forcing their body to produce more sugar. You can also use it on other Cell Mimics from a distance. Hepatocyte Mimics will be forced to release their stored sugar but will be able to create more from various substances, like milk, fat, muscles,... Adipocyte Mimics will convert and release their fat as fatty acid.

name: Temporary Speed Boost
description: You can multiply your speed by a constant of 5 for 1 minute, but all your leg muscles are damaged beyond what short term rest will cure. You signal your muscles for the speed increase by tapping one foot against the other foot.

strengths: Chances are an enemy won't be able to stop your speed during that one minute.
Your bones' conditions are unchanged by this power.
weaknesses: Healing and regeneration powers will not speed up the time needed to recuperate.

name: Uncanny Faith

weaknesses: People will hate you.
People will try to kill you.
People will think you're the messiah.

name: Protective Ability Acquisition
description: Temporarily gains all abilities necessary to eradicate a person or thing that is putting the user in danger. The amount of abilities gained to protect the user are limitless. The user has full control and understanding of the abilities gained; however, once the danger has been eradicated, the user becomes completely powerless. This ability becomes triggered if the user becomes naturally ill, if the user is being attacked etc.

name: Template: Glory Angel.
description: A demented, immortal seraphim, stolen from grace. The user is able to take the form of man, but also that of an angel, whose six large wings spread feathers of glistening white. But, beneath that facade, there is deceiving; the user is composed of worms, through and through. A fever of mysterious power capable of independent movement, communication, and complete biological manipulation. The user is accompanied by unlimited strength, speed, invulnerability, and an immense regenerative factor.

weaknesses: The user may lose to a stronger being.

The user may draw unwanted attention.

name: Blob Mimicry

Almost nothing can stop you, from electricity to explosions to freezing to fire to nukes. You adapt quickly & continue to grow, but you can't form any shapes like a fist or hammer. You just look like a giant amoeba. You consume matter by breaking it down with strong acid chemical enzymes. You can return to normal after everything you ate is dissolved.

strengths: Be a giant consuming blob & continue to grow
Nearly invulnerable, adapting quickly

weaknesses: Can't take complex shapes

name: Yokai: Tengu
description: The tengu, translated as "heavenly dogs". They appear as avian humanoids with red or blue skin with either a long nose or beak. name: Olive Branch

The stitches can also be used to hold a broken body together so that the person can still use it. The stitches can also be used to bind a spirit to an object or body. strengths: Stitch objects together so that they become stuck.
Stitch wounds and a body back together so that the person does not die while healing.
Stitch the intangible and spirits as well.
weaknesses: Stitches can be broken by force.
Stitches can be manipulated or blocked by those with energy powers.
If used on self to much the stitches may become the only thing holding your body together.

name: Long Distance Bitch Slap
description: This ability allows you bitch slap anyone from a distance just by thinking about it.  They won't know it was you (unless you somehow make it obvious).  You can bitch slap them pretty hard, but you won't do any permanent damage.  This ranges from people in the room with you to even people you're watching on live TV.
summary: The ability to bitch slap someone from a distance.
strengths: Road rage
Shutting someone up
weaknesses: Road rage

name: Summon: Metal Men
description: The metal men are sentient robots that the user has created to help him or her defend peace and justice. There are a total of six metal men, consisting of gold, mercury, lead, iron, platinum , lead and tin. All of them have the ability to morph their shape, forming new weapons, they also posses super human strength and enhanced invulnerability due to their robot body. They also can combine themselves to form other objects and too form their ultimate robot form: Alloy
summary: The ability to summon the metal men that you have built
strengths: Used to fight crime
Adaptable to any situation
Cannot be reprogrammed unless initiated by the creator
weaknesses: Certain metals weak against air ( if they are exposed to extremely high concentration ie an attack )
Certain metals will melt under very high temperatures

name: Great Hammer Of Justice
description: The Great Hammer of Justice only can be used by people who are just in their heart. The hammer is also somewhat semi sentient, as it will not hurt a person if the user is wielding it for purpose of revenge, even though the target has done wrong. The hammer can also judge whether the target is really guilty of a crime. The hammer grants its wielder a steel battle armor that offers enhanced strength, flight and limited invulnerability. The hammer itself is indestructible
summary: The ability to use the Great Hammer of Justice
strengths: Can combat crime ranging from small to large crimes
You cannot use it for bad.
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: You cannot use it for vengeance
The suit the hammer gives can be destroyed or badly damaged, injuring the user

name: Exploding Sneeze
description: With this power you can cause huge explosions whenever you sneeze. You are unaffected by the explosions and you can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to cause huge explosions when you sneeze
strengths: You can explosions when you sneeze
You are unaffected by the explosion
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: It happens whenever you sneeze unless you turn it off

name: Superhuman Dent
description: Superhuman Dent or Super Dent, also called Super Strong Teeth is the ability for a person to exert force from the jaw muscles beyond that of a normal human. This can be accomplished by either fortifying the jaw muscles with psychic force, or simply having denser muscle mass in the jaw beyond that of a normal human. This ability is usually accompanied by extra strong dentine, the stuff that teeth are made of.
summary: The ability to apply force to the jaw muscles beyond that of a normal human.
strengths: Making chewing a lot easier
You can bite into almost anything, including solid substances such wood, metal, plastic etc.
Your jaw muscles will never ache from hard chewing
weaknesses: You may accidentally bite off your tongue or the side of your cheek

name: Poke Ball
description: Let's you catch people and have awesome battles.
summary: The ability to catch other people with poke balls
strengths: Use people to your advantage
Can use animals
Can capture any one
weaknesses: Have to get them when they are off gard
You can only have six at a time
Must be living

name: Primate Permutation
description: With this power, you can turn into any primate of your choosing, be it prosimians, monkeys or even great and lesser apes. You will gain the physical body of that animal while retaining your conscience and thinking capacity. You will also gain any physical abilities of the animal you become, like the lemur's jump, the howler monkey's call, the Silver-back Gorilla's strength, the agility of a spider monkey (and other monkeys, as well), just to name a few.
summary: The ability to change into any primate you want.
strengths: Become the primate of your choice, and it's also reversible.
Gain the physical abilities and traits of that animal.
You can communicate with the rest of that animal's species, (smashing language barriers).
weaknesses: You can only turn into any primate you know; you might want to take up primatology, or be limited.
You can only gain the animal's ability when you turn into that animal.
You cannot talk to humans because your voicebox cannot create human sounds

name: Spawn: Roman Armory
description: With this ability you are able to spawn roman armories, these armories are fully stocked with roman weapons, so any other weapon other than the roman culture (Greek swords,etc.)
summary: The ability to spawn unlimited amounts of roman armories.
strengths: Very strong weapons.
weaknesses: Some weapons are cursed...
They are very short swords or daggers.
Imperial Gold isn't always a good thing.

name: Aeon
description: The ability to summon and dismiss any of the eight Aeons from the game Final Fantasy X. The strength of the Aeons is equal to what the summoner is able to control, and the Aeons can be trained to improve their skills. If the Aeon dies, the summoner must wait 24 hours before the Aeon is able to be summoned again. The Aeon's overdrives must be charged by using the Aeons. When overdrive is used, it desummons the Aeon for the next 24 hours.
summary: The ability to summon the Aeons from final fantasy X.
strengths: Eight summons.
Aeons cannot be killed permanently.
Overdrives are the ultimate techniques.
weaknesses: Have to have power and skill to train Aeons to use their full potential.
After using overdrive or dieing, an Aeon is unuseable for 24 hours.
Must have knowledge from the Final Fantasy X game to use it.

name: Metal Men Summon
description: With this power you can summon the members of the DC superhero team the Metal Men. The Metal Men are not under your control but will probably help you if you're fighting crime. You can summon any version of the Metal Men from the comics, TV show etc. When you're done you can just send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon the Metal Men
strengths: You can summon the Metal Men
They will probably help you
You can send them back when you're done
weaknesses: If you're a villain they probably won't help you unless you trick them

name: Human Gaming Device
description: This power allows you to hold any game cartridge in your body and gain interesting powers. If, say, you had to put it the game cartridge in your neck, just by looking at a DS game card would allow you to put it in and gain powers. If you had a pokemon game, you would get a pokemon based on your personality.
summary: The ability to put a game cartridge in your body
strengths: Gain powers through games
Do a bunch of crazy stuff
weaknesses: Game cartridges may not last long

name: Whistler
description: This power endows you with the awareness of the battle between good and evil and the access to crucial and helpful information for either the good or evil side. If the balance is tipped, your alignment will change to match the losing side and the only information you have access to is for them. However, you can only talk in cryptic messages, which sometimes make sense if one has all the elements to understand them. This can be troublesome if you alone cannot use the information you have.
summary: The ability to maintain the balance between good and evil by giving each side valuable information
strengths: You are a precious ally to your side, and a dangerous enemy to the other side.
You have access to many useful information, as well as to whom it will be useful and how.
If one side dominates the other, you are a light of hope to the other side.
weaknesses: As long as you exist, neither side will win the battle. So, you're a hindrance to your side as well.
You can only talk in cryptics, even if you're not giving a relevant piece of information.
If you help too much, you are likely to tip the balance to the other side and change alignment.

name: Skeletal Weapons
description: If you really wanna get brutal and nasty, you may want to let out your inner arsenal--which is made from your bones of course. For example, you can wield a sword that you can pull out from your knee cap or you can use nunchucks that are made with your upper arm bones.
summary: The ability to wield weapons made from your bones.
strengths: Hidden weapons that pass metal scans
weaknesses: It can really, REALLY hurt.

name: Flag Empowerment
description: The thing about Flag Empowerment is that, once you touch any colored state or even a country flag, you gain your own personal power. Example: If you touch an American flag, you'll have patriotic powers, Canadian flag - Electromagnetism.
summary: The ability to gain new abilities by touching any flag.
strengths: Touching any flag will grant you a new perspective by becoming a worldwide hero.
You can wear mini-flags as clothing and pins, drape a flag around you or use a flag as a cape
You can wear clothing with the motif of a flag.
weaknesses: If you touched a flag with a Pirate logo on it, you'll become corrupted.
If you touched a flag with a Nazi symbol on it, you'll become consumed with extreme hatred.

name: Arm Duplication
description: With this power, you can make arms sprout from your body anywhere.
summary: The ability to duplicate your arms all over your body.
strengths: Do lots of things at once.
The arms are super-stretchy.
Dress up as a hand-covered monster for Halloween & save money.
weaknesses: You can only sprout arms on your body & nowhere else.
Con #1 also gives you a limited number of arms.
Practically useless in a battle.

name: Superhuman Summon
description: With this power you can summon any superhuman that you've ever met personally. Wether it be superpowered allies to fight crime. Or superpowered enemies to put them in prison or for combat practice. Or just superpowered people to show off your friends. You are not able to send the superhumans back unless they want to go back.
summary: The ability to summon any superhuman that you've ever met
strengths: You can summon any superhuman that you've ever met
Can summon superpowered help
Can summon superpowered enemies so you can put them in jail
weaknesses: You cannot send the back unless they want to go back
They might be angry at you for summoning them

name: Rise Of The Centaur
description: With this power you can turn into a centaur in order to fight or commit crimes. In centaur form you have powerful legs so you can run fast, jump high and have a powerful kick.
summary: The ability to turn into a centaur
strengths: You can turn into a centaur
You have powerful legs for running, jumping and kicking
weaknesses: You have a weakness for carrots and apples

name: Pheromone Immunity
description: Pheromones have abolutely no effect on someone with this power.
summary: The ability to be completely unaffected by pheromones
strengths: Can't be seduced with pheromones.
weaknesses: Colognes and perfumes are meaningless to you.

name: One Handed
description: You can do anything you could do normally with two hands with only one hand, with your strength, speed, and dexterity boosting accordingly. Can do twice as many things as you could normally do with your hands at any given time. Using both your hands for the same thing causes your power to fade, although you can avoid this by thinking that you're doing two separate things (instead of thinking"I'm gonna lift it with two hands" think"I'm gonna lift a side with one hand and a side with the other").
summary: The ability to be a master at doing things with only one hand
strengths: Can do different things with one hand each, even that which should be impossible with only one hand
Not just physical strength; everything, even powers that are used through the hands, are affected
If you lose an arm, it won't ruin your life
weaknesses: You have to be able to mentally multi-task to use both hands
Must do a bit of thinking if attempting to use two-hands for the same thing
If both your arms are lost, this power becomes worthless

name: Negative Power Boost
description: This power is very similar to Negated Superman. However, instead of increasing your strength, durability and speed while giving you flight, this enhances the powers which still function. Powers are boosted exponentially, just like your stats with Negated Superman. When you use a functioning power, it will utilize the total available power boost, unless there are multiple powers in use, in which case they are boosted evenly.
summary: The ability to amplify your powers when other powers are negated.
strengths: Your enemies will fear blocking your powers.
Enhance your functioning powers when your others are blocked.
Pairs well with Negated Superman.
weaknesses: You need a few other powers.
When your powers return, your "boosts" go away.
If you lose all your powers, this power is useless.

name: Random Ability Activation
description: With this ability you can cause your powers to activate in a random order at will. This power can be turned off and on at will. The powers will activate in an unpredictable order so that no one would be able to predict your moves. The order of the powers that activate for a person are unable to be predicted unless probability manipulation is used. If an opponent copies this power it will be unable to be turned off for them.
summary: The ability to cause your abilities to activate in a random order.
strengths: Become unpredictable with your powers activating at random.
If this power is copied, your opponent will have their powers activate at random.
More than one power can become active at one time.
weaknesses: Unable to predict yourself which power you will have at what time.
Could be stuck with terrible powers for a length of time.
Probability manipulation can cause the unpredictable side of the power to not function.

name: Tyr's Hand
description: In Norse mythology Tyr helped subdue Fenrir the giant wolf by putting his hand in the wolf's mouth so the wolf would allow them to bind it with an enchanted ribbon. You defeated the wolf who managed to escape by Loki's help and got the hand of Tyr out of it. You can now summon the wolf and have it fight for you anytime you want.
summary: The ability to control the hand of Tyr.
strengths: You have a giant wolf to help you
You can control the wolf
He works as a horse too
weaknesses: Pulling out a hand in the middle of battle might be a little odd.
He might turn on you.
Giving him baths is very hard.

name: Stature Limiter
description: A person with this power can prevent anyone from achieving a height above your waist level. You are immune to this power. This is the dream of every egotistical or sadistic person. You can defeat opponents in the cheapest ways possible such as kicking in the face or stomping while they have a hard time trying to hit you since they can't stand up to move. You can use this when playing sports to always have a height advantage. If someone is naturally shorter than your waist they can move regularly
summary: The ability to make anyone around you lower their stature to below your waist level
strengths: Everyone bows before you
Win in sports with height advantage
You are hard to fight
weaknesses: Someone naturally short will be immune to this power (unless you lie down)
If you are naturally tall
You might have sadistic tendencies or arrogance

name: Giraffe Mimicry
description: With this power you have all of the abilities of a giraffe including enhanced speed, the ability to elongate your neck, the ability to cause brown spots to appear all of your body (giraffes make the spots appear and disappear but whatever) and powerful legs for kicking.
summary: The ability to have all of the abilities of a giraffe
strengths: You have all of the abilities of a giraffe
weaknesses: You can't actually turn into a giraffe with this power

name: Rise Of The Omnidroid
description: With this power you can turn into the Omnidroid, a giant war machine that is constantly learning things about its surroundings and its opponents and using this knowledge to defeat it's enemies. In Omnidroid form you can shoot lasers from your eye and turn yourself into a giant buzz saw. You also have super strength.
summary: The ability to turn into the Omnidroid from the Incredibles
strengths: You can turn into the super smart Omnidroid
You can shoot lasers from your eye
Your super strong.
weaknesses: You are not invincible and can be defeated

name: Basilisk Summoning
description: This abillity is fun to use and control. With this ability, you can summon any of the characters in Basilisk. They will do what you want, fight for you and even die for you, and some of them will fall in love with you.
summary: The ability to summon and control the Basilisk characters
strengths: The description says it all
The Basilisk characters might fall in love with you, like Oboro.
You are the leader
weaknesses: There might be mutiny
Some of them will try to kill you
You cannot be bossy to them

name: Why So Serious? :D
description: You release an aerial chemical in the air that makes people's facial muscle tighten at mouth area to form a huge grinning smile. It'll be like having a permanent botox-injected smile.
summary: The ability to make people have a perma-grin smile.
strengths: Make people smile forever.
weaknesses: Will never know by face if someone is sad or angry.
Could make eating, drinking and talking difficult.

name: Whd's Xia
description: Youxia is the wandering force; she is a cane wielding, ethereal, godlike being capable of granting you your 25 most desired powers. These powers come at a price. You are forever her herald. She will dictate to you how your life will be led. You will be known only as Wuxia. You must entreaty her for each power you wish to possess, she must approve of the causes you fight for and the direction of your life.
summary: The ability to gain complex powers from the wandering force
strengths: You could have every one of your desired powers
If worthy of Youxia you receive much more than one power
Every 25 days you receive all 25 noble powers at once without asking for a full day
weaknesses: Does not grant basic powers (flight, strength, speed) specify the powers or Youxia canes you
Embarrass her or lose a fight or dishonoring your gifts gets you caned on the head & powers robbed
Youxia allows you to lose fights and power before she canes you then fights in you place

name: Sore Loser
description: Whenever any person is playing any game, you can force them to lose it. Anything from chess to lacrosse to a Battle of the Bands is game.
summary: The ability to make anybody lose in any game
strengths: People you hate can lose no matter what
weaknesses: Can go too far with it
Does not protect you from being beaten up

name: 4 To Go V2
description: With this power you can point at someone and say the name of a place or an address and the person will automatically do anything in their power to get to that place. You can cause villains to go to prisons or make people spend all their money on expensive plane tickets etc.
summary: The ability to make people go anywhere
strengths: You can make people go places
weaknesses: You have to point at them

name: Craft Semivif Servants
description: When you use this power, you can painlessly cut parts from yourself (which will grow back in a day) to use as crafting materials to make semivif servants. Semivif look like stringless marionettes made of human body parts. They are neither dead or alive or undead, thus powers that affect living things or (un)dead things can't work on them. They never heal nor do healing powers affect them. They can be repaired. Semivif have the intelligence of a child but are very strong. They never fatigue.
summary: The ability to craft servants from your own body that aren't truly alive, dead or undead.
strengths: Undying, strong, tireless servants.
weaknesses: Commands must be kept simple.
You can't make new servants if you are always repairing the ones you have.
People may think this is a disgusting power and stay away from you.

name: Prehensile Tail
description: This ability gives the user a tail. This tail is pretty much as good as a hand. When first obtained, the user will hear a deep voice asking what your tail will feel like. The most simple choices are; Scaly, Furry and Skin. This will not affect the power except. From fur, which allows the user to speak fluent gorilla.
summary: The ability to have a tail that acts like a hand.
strengths: Speak Gorilla!
Power can't be stolen!
You can swing from tree to tree, or lamp post to lamp post!
weaknesses: May be laughed at for having a tail.
Clothing problems...
Being shot at... More to shoot...

name: Quartz Bridging
description: This power allows its user to generate a "bridge" or binding of quartz between any two objects. To bridge the two objects the user must be in physical contact with one or both objects. There is no upper or lower limit to the size of the two bridged objects. The quartz bridge can be strengthened b prolonged contact.
summary: The ability to bridge any two objects with a quartz binding
strengths: Bind object together
Create new paths or blockades with a touch
Incapacitate enemies by binding them to other objects
weaknesses: It takes a few second for the bridge to form
Physical contact is required

name: Conditional Immortality
description: You can't die, but this immortality comes with a price. You have to be the servant of a family until they deem that you served them well. Deeming that you have done well is only done by saying, "You have done the best work you can". Nothing more than or les than that. However, you have to serve seven families total before you're free to do as you like.
summary: The ability to have immortality at a price
strengths: You can't die.
weaknesses: You're someone else's servant at least seven times (depends on whether the person releases you).
Very specific phrase for release.
You could be serving for all of eternity for a family.

name: White Rhabdomyocyte Mimicry
description: Also called White Skeletal Myocyte Mimicry. As a type of Myocyte Mimic, you have the power to contract your body heightwise: your body and limbs become much shorter and fatter. In your case, you need to use sugar to do so, or be in the presence of a Hepatocyte Mimic. Electricity can force you to use this power. Your contraction speed is fast, your contraction strength is high and your body is extremely powerful, but you are very fast to fatigue and produce lactic acid which blocks this power.
summary: The ability to contract your body heightwise and be extremely good at power exercises.
strengths: By contracting your body, you can pull yourself up or be short enough to enter through low passages.
Your body is very powerful, so you can excell at any power exercises.
If you find a way to lock your feet in place, you can pull things down by grabbing them.
weaknesses: Once contracted, you'll stay that way until you find a way to stretch yourself.
You need to have access to a source of sugar to contract your body.
Your body produces lactic acid which counteracts this power. You need oxygen to neutralize it.

name: The Keyblade
description: Just like Sora from Kingdom Hearts, you too can wield a keyblade. As long as you have a strong heart, the keyblade will remain with you. You can unlock any door, unlock any chest; you can also lock things up.
summary: The ability to wield and use a keyblade
strengths: Able to unlock and lock anything with the keyblade
weaknesses: Keyblade will find another master, if your heart becomes weak

name: The Phonebooth
description: Imagine you're watching something on TV, and you want to warn the main character about a scheme, or confuse her with a red herring. Where would the plot spiral off to? How would it conclude? What would become of the main characters? Pick up any phone while watching TV, dial the character's name, and these scenarios need be speculation no more. Uses any phone near the character, mobile or otherwise (or even cartoon, if it's an animated film. Conversation with Pumbaa anyone?).
summary: The ability to interact with characters in a movie/on TV using a phone.
strengths: A lot of fun, as you can send the plot spinning wildly off.
Can have a conversation with your favourite characters.
Non-permanent changes. Each viewing will be normal until you call in.
weaknesses: Could ruin the suspense if you warned the character of a plot twist.
Would REALLY annoy/confuse people in the cinema!

name: Meibomian Gland Cell Mimicry
description: By consuming or absorbing fat through your skin, you can create an oily substance inside your body. When you've produced enough (about three quarters of your body volume), you can burst open and spread it in all directions. If it touches any water-based substance, it will spread across the entire surface and prevent water from escaping or changing state. Note that exploding would undeniably cost you your own life. However, as long as you're still alive, you can undergo mitosis, that is cloning
summary: The ability to produce an oily substance which traps water and prevents its movements, and explode to release it.
strengths: Oil-covered water is much more difficult to move, especially through supernatural means.
It can trap water in all its states, absorbing moisture in the air or preventing ice from thawing.
You can duplicate yourself before one of you explodes in order to survive (recommended).
weaknesses: Soap or some other surfactant would break the oil layer.
If the oil layer is too thin, it will be less effective in containing water.
Exploding is bad for your health, or life in general.

name: Author Power Detection
description: With this power, you can sense when a person used a power you made, how they used it and where they are. You can also use this in a way similar to Ability Detection, only with unlimited range but only detecting powers you made. You can even sense information detected using powers you made. If the target has a power like Unpredictability, you can only gain information they are receiving, sensing their existence and occasionally how they used it.
summary: The ability to detect the powers you made, in multiple ways.
strengths: Monitor the use of your powers.
Receive information from powers you may not have.
Pairs well with several powers related to created powers.
weaknesses: Powers like Unpredictability may be annoying.
May be distracting.
Useless if you didn't create any powers.

name: Sweet Appearances
description: With this superpower you have the ability to get chocolate appear whenever and wherever you please This power is sure to make chocoholics like me happy
summary: The ability to make chocolate appear out of nowhere.
strengths: Won't ever have to buy chocolate.
Have as much chocolate as you want.
Have enough to share! (If you want)
weaknesses: People will always be asking you for chocolate. D:

name: Noble Gas Control
description: This ability allows a user to control or manipulate the noble gases inside someones body example: hydrogen oxygen and other noble gases. This ability is good for assassination job or job that nobody can detect or the user is dead. This ability is not so good for beginners because if they are too reckless the air could puncture the target and bystanders would freak out. So this ability is only for people that like to destroy their target without a trace of evidence.
summary: The ability to control noble gases inside a targets body
strengths: The user can control other elements inside someones body if they are noble gases: example H2O Co2
The user can make a kill or assassination without anybody knowing
Other power user or magic user cannot detect what the user is doing to their target
weaknesses: The user can only control noble gases that are inside the targets body

name: Cartilaginous Skeleton
description: Normally, your skeleton develops as you age into bone and becomes harder and less flexible. With this power, your skeleton goes back to how it was before it developed into bone. It becomes 100% cartilage and is now more flexible than the average human skeleton.
summary: The ability to have a skeleton made purely of cartilage
strengths: You have the same type of skeleton as a shark!
Do all those acrobatic tricks you couldn't do before.
Impacts won't hurt as much since the cartilage is more flexible than bone.
weaknesses: Cartilage isn't as strong as bone.
Bloody Knuckles will still hurt as much as it did with a bone skeleton.

name: Ram's Head
description: Whenever you headbutt someone, that headbutt becomes really powerful.
summary: The ability to have super powerfull headbutts.
strengths: Your head becomes a weapon of mass destruction
weaknesses: You have to get in close
You can't turn it off

name: Spine Covered
description: Like a porcupine, you can grow & cover your body in hard, thorny spines that can pierce even the thickest hide. You can also shoot them as projectiles.
summary: The ability to grow spiky spines out of the body
strengths: Covered in spikes
Can shoot spikes out of your body
weaknesses: Can't touch balloons
No one would want to hug you.

name: Insanity Power
description: This power is best used by those who are insane. The more insane you are, the stronger and faster you are. If you are insane enough, you may then shoot lasers from your hands. Your strength and speed decreases the saner you are, though, so if you are 100% sane you have 0% extra strength and 0% extra speed.
summary: The ability to grow more powerful while insane
strengths: If you are insane enough, you may shoot lasers to defeat your opponents.
Should be very useful for abiding supervillains
Makes it good to be insane.
weaknesses: If you are sane, you will not have any extra strength or speed.
Not good to have for sane people/superheroes.
It might be hard to do insane things without accidentally destroying something.

name: Mountain Raiser
description: With this power you can make mountains rise from the ground anywhere you want.
summary: The ability to make mountains rise from the ground
strengths: You can create a mountain under you so that you can reach things that are on high shelves in your ho
You can create a mountain under your enemy and strand him/her up there
weaknesses: You cannot put put the mountain back in the ground when you're done with it

name: Hollow Bones
description: Hollow bones ar mainly found in birds, this helps gives them the ability to fly, normal weight bones would be too heavy for them to fly with. Hollow bones make a character light in weight, which makes them very fast, but they are not as strong as normal bones, causing the owner to take alot of damage when hit.
summary: The ability to be light.
strengths: Extremely fast.
Can jump extremely high and stay in midair longer then normal.
Can fly if you have wings.
weaknesses: Take more damage then normal.
Not as strong.
Bones break easier.

name: Delete This Fistful Of Steel
description: This can be very well executed by performing to move forward, leading with your fist which is covered in Organic Steel that'll send you dashing straight forward or to leap diagonally forward, turning the move into an uppercut.
summary: The ability to rapidly lunge forward and strike the opponent with an steel covered fist.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Prehensile Hair
description: The power in which one can maneuver their own hair. The user is able to move their hair as if they were arms and hands. Can grab objects with locks. Strength of hair is equal to strength of arms.
summary: The ability to move one's hair like hands
strengths: Can grab stuff
Can move rapidly
Can slither to sneak
weaknesses: Hair is weak to many things like fire, scissors, etc
Short hair is useless
Hair can move out of one's control

name: Head Exploder
description: You would have the power to blow people's heads up by focusing on them. This can be very useful with very tough and/or stupid enemies.

strengths: Easy to use
Painless to use
Long range.

name: Parietal Cell Mimicry
description: You first need to absorb water, potassium and chloride. Then, you can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body which you can shoot hydrochloric acid from and retract when you don't need them anymore. Your body doesn't store the acid. It's just synthesized the moment you shoot it. Note that you are not immune to the effects of the acid, so be very careful. Additionally, you can undergo mitosis, that is the creation of identical copies of yourself.
summary: The ability to shoot hydrochloric acid.
strengths: You can shoot a highly corrosive acid!
You can use your appendages in other creative ways than shooting acid.
You can divide yourself to overpower a foe.
weaknesses: You need to absorb water, potassium and chloride before you can shoot acid.
You are not immune to the effects of the acid you shoot.

name: Beverage Saliva
description: With this power you can turn your saliva into any kind of beverage. This way you will never become thirsty because all you have to do is swallow and you can quench your thirst. You can also spit out different beverages.
summary: The ability to turn your saliva into any kind of beverage
strengths: You can turn your saliva into different beverages
You'll never be thirsty
weaknesses: You might have to pee a lot

name: Clay Monster
description: With this ability your entire body is made out of clay.  You can twist, bend, and stretch yourself just like when making a pot out of clay. Of course you'd have to immerse yourself in water.  As dry clay you can deliver solid strong punches. However if you fall from a fair distance; you'd shatter like a ceramic plate.
summary: The ability to have your body be made entirely out of clay,
strengths: Bend, twist and stretch yourself like wet clay.
Deliver solid strong punches as dry clay.
Immune to dry and wet. All they do is alternate your strengths and weaknesses.
weaknesses: As dry clay, you'll shatter falling from a long distance. (Best to be wet. )
As wet clay, don't possess full strength as if your dry clay.
Can not change from wet to dry clay. Need to rely on a proportioned water supply.

name: Page Ripper
description: A person with this power has the ability to peel off words or images off a surface and carry it to put on another surface. In addition they can make a copy by peeling layers off the image. The ripped off images or words can then be placed on other surfaces to be kept. The user of this power can also take images off of glass and the quality of the picture would be the same as that of normally seeing through the glass
summary: The ability to cut or copy images or words off a surface then paste them onto another surface
strengths: Steal the words from a book or steal an image from a piece of art leaving it blank
No need to have a copier or a camera
You can store a lot of images by folding them up and then releasing them
weaknesses: You would be tempted to steal/forge artwork with this power

name: Dollification
description: This power allows you to turn people into dolls. The type of doll is up to you so they could be plastic, plush, wood, etc. You can even turn them into puppets or action figures. They will still retain their physical appearance (mostly) but they will not be able to move so they can't use any powers that require movement. Effects can be reversed. Transformation is not instantaneous so it will take a few seconds and you'll need to concentrate so you will be vulnerable.
summary: The ability to turn people into living dolls
strengths: Give them to children
They won't be able to move or use powers that require movement
Your power will improve with practice, reducing time and concentration needed
weaknesses: Powerful psychics will still be able to use their powers
You can only transform one person at a time so if there is more than one enemy you're in trouble
May not be able to reverse effects if you are not adept enough

name: Pb: Body Build
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power-Boost. ' With this ability, all of your strength abilities are doubled in strength. If a superpower gives you different strengths for different situations, it simply doubles the intended effect.
summary: The ability to have all of your 'strength' superpowers doubled in strength.
strengths: Doubles the effectiveness of strength abilities.
weaknesses: If you don't have strength abilities.
Or superpowers at all.

name: Power  Rating
description: You have to get the person to explain or demonstrate their power to you then you can have this power give it a rating from 1-5. For each level under 3 the power loses 25% of its full strength, 3 causes no change, and for each level over 3 the power is boosted by 50%. This power judges only based on the power, efficiency of the use of the power, and techniques of the power. If the person improves their use of the power they could possibly get its rating changed.
summary: The ability to strengthen or weaken a power based on the rating it is given
strengths: Could possibly double the strength of your friends' powers.
Could possibly halve the strength of your enemies' powers.
2 people who have the same power can get two different ratings because of how efficient they are.
weaknesses: This power won't be nice to your friends when judging their powers, it sticks to what you saw.
You cannot get your own powers judged.

name: Keratinocyte Mimicry
description: As a Keratinocyte Mimic, you have five abilities. First, you can absorb the melanin produced by Melanocyte Mimics to protect yourself from UV rays. Second, you can control the ratio of melanin produced by a Melanocyte Mimic. Third, you can become extremely flat and sturdy, while always dying in the process. Fourth, you can undergo mitosis, creating an identical version of yourself. And fifth, when under attack, you can send a signal which attracts any Leukocyte Mimics in a large area around you.
summary: The ability to become flat, extremely sturdy and die, absorb melanin and much more.
strengths: You can transform yourself into a shield.
You can clone yourself, which is good if you intend to use the third ability.
You can influence the melanin-producing ability of Melanocyte Mimics.
weaknesses: It is not recommended to use the third ability before using the fourth one.
You can attract any Leukocyte Mimics, including enemies.
If you can't die (not necessarily without coming back to life later), you can't use the third power.

name: Expert Spoon Thrower
description: You can be more or less dangerous. With this power, any spoon can become a hurtful projectile. It gives you an intuitive sense of spoon-throwing spatial geometry, spoon-related aerodynamics and fluid dynamics, and spoon force absorption. In short, you can throw spoons like a real expert. The only drawback is you can only hit things with the bowl part of the spoon. And that it only works with spoons; it won't enhance your knife-throwing skills.
summary: The ability to be an expert at spoon throwing.
strengths: You can find spoons nearly everywhere!
Laddles are a type of spoon!
Sporks and Spives, being half-spoon, are affected by half this power.
weaknesses: It doesn't work with forks or knives.
You can only hit things with the bowl part of the spoon.
The spoons don't hardly come back once thrown.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Snap You're Bulletproof
description: With this power you can make people bullet proof by thinking of the person and snapping. The person's entire body then becomes bullet proof permanently.
summary: The ability to make people bullet proof
strengths: You can turn anybody completely bullet proof
weaknesses: You cannot make yourself bullet proof with this power
The person can still be hurt by arrows, darts and other weapons

name: Backwards!
description: With this power you can make people speak backwards. Whenever the victim speaks their words will come out backwards (hello will come out as olleh etc.). You can make them speak backwards for as long as you want and then fix their speech later.
summary: The ability to make people speak backwards
strengths: You make people speak backwards
You can make them speak backwards for as long as you want then you can fix their speech patterns
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Queen/King Of The Wasp/Hornets
description: With this power you are in complete control of all wasps and hornets. They will do anything you say and you can understand what they are saying. You will also never be stung by a wasp or hornet.
summary: The ability to control wasps and hornets
strengths: You are the king or queen of wasps and hornets
They will sting your enemies
You will never be stung by a wasp or hornet
weaknesses: Does not work on bees or yellow jackets

name: United We Stand V2
description: With this power you can cause someone else's power levels to rise when you stand in a thirty foot radius of them. This happens whenever you're a thirty foot radius of someone with superpowers so its not a good power to have if you fight superpowered villains often.
summary: The ability to cause someone else's power levels to rise when you stand near them
strengths: You can raise the power levels of others
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off

name: Soul Vampirism
description: Instead of tradition vampirism, soul vampirism allows people to suck out peoples' souls. The vampire gets stronger from the process and the victim is turned into a vampire themselves. The new vampire however is a traditional vampire and has to feed off blood.
summary: The ability to suck out peoples' souls and feed off it
strengths: Doesn't have to depend on blood; can feed off souls
Doesn't need constant replenishment
weaknesses: Has to be human souls
The vampire is forever connected to the 'victim'

name: Baysplosion V2
description: With this power you can cause explosions to appear in any movie whenever you want. Think a movie's too boring add an explosion into it. The characters will not react to the explosion and the objects and plot of the movies will not be affected in any way.
summary: The ability to cause explosions to appear in movies
strengths: You can cause explosions to appear in movies
weaknesses: The characters in the film will not react to the explosion
The explosion will do absolutely nothing to affect the plot of the film
Not much use in physical battle

name: Twimonds
description: Twimonds are specially created diamonds made out of Twilight Matter, the essence between light and darkness. These twimonds are small enough to fit in one's hands, dark purple and crystalline in appearance, but pack quite a punch. They are normally used for defense, as they can absorb and possibly reflect attacks from both light and darkness. The user may have a telekenetic control over them.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate twimonds.
strengths: The user can create up to ten twimonds at a time, which could protect them from harm.
With these, the user would be protected from attacks from darkness and light.
They can store up attacks over them and release them anyway they want.
weaknesses: While they can absorb darkness and light, they cannot reflect attacks from pure evil.
One could store up too much energy in their twimonds and cause them to explode.
Pure evil will go through the twimonds and into the user, possibly corrupting them.

name: Phone Stalling
description: If you are talking to someone on the phone, anyone wanting to engage you - such as talk to you or fight you - will stand in place tapping their foot and not take any other action, either until you finish the phonecall or until they decide to do something else not involving you in any way.
summary: The ability to make people wait patiently for you to finish talking on the phone
strengths: Can be used to avoid fights
Can take out en enemies while they're just standing there
Works on bluetooth devices provided they're connected to a phone
weaknesses: Might run out of battery or lose reception
Can't control it so it might affect people when you don't want it to.
People wanting to do something involving you such as filing taxes far away are still affected

name: Jacket Fusion
description: With this power you can freely transform into a jacket that, when worn by someone else, gives them access to all of your powers and skills in addition to combining your strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance.   You are aware of everything that is happening while you are a jacket and can transform back at any time you wish, sliding off the wearer automatically.
summary: The ability to become a jacket that, when worn, conveys all of your powers, skills, and traits to the wearer.
strengths: Pool your strength with an ally.
Enhance someone who you know is better than you for the task at hand.
Share your strength with someone you know is weaker.
weaknesses: You are trusting yourself completely to another person.
In a fight, because you are covering someone else, you will be taking hits first.

name: Ability To Manipulate Pimples
description: Control pimples to make your enemies ugly or remove them to give your allies flawless skin... You can cover yourself with indestructable pimples to use as armor.
summary: The ability to manipulate pimples so you can give yourself pimples to look older than you are
strengths: Make a popular guy ugly
Indestructable armor
Never suffer puberty
weaknesses: U look freaky and ugly while wearing armor
People will always bug you about their pimples

name: Media Mastery (Sodenio)
description: You know all and can do all media-related tasks, including filming, artistry, directing, producing, management, being a spoeksperson etc.
summary: The ability to be skilled in media-related tasks
strengths: Can make movies easy and fast
Can film great shots
Can be great in all artist related things
weaknesses: Can make any ones pictures bad or ugly
Can make films, bad or good
Can control the outcome of TV shows

name: The Unforgiving Fist
description: Ever have the urge to punch someone?  Why hold back?  With this ability, each day you can punch ANYONE you want.  As long as you can walk up to them, you can punch them and you have all to gain from it.  No retaliation.  Just pure venting in one of our most primitive and satisfying ways!  Start punching today!
summary: The ability to punch anyone you want once every day with no consequences.
strengths: Road rage at stopped traffic lights
When you feel you deserved a C, not an F
The TPS reports can wait
weaknesses: Too much punching, too little negotiating
Becoming an angry, punching, hairy gorilla (at least figuratively)
Occasionally, you might feel guilty for punching someone.

name: Trap Realm
description: You are a fighter for good and you have been fighting this evil creature possibly a demon, yet no matter what you do you'll never defeat him, but he's about to destroy all you know. Ah but you have this one time use power. You can trap him in a prison realm forever. No possible escape. Garenteed! However in order to trap him you must go in with him to lock the gate from the inside.
summary: The ability to trap the most powerful evil inside a prison realm forever.
strengths: Trap a nearly all powerful evil in a prison for all time.
Your name will live on to inspire heroes for generations.
Your world and all you care about will be saved from that particular Great Evil being.
weaknesses: All your powers are taken away when you shut the gates of this prison realm.
You can't get out because there is no escape for anyone. Not even you.
This Evil being will punish you forever because you put him there there's noone else to hurt.

name: Summon Shroudthought
description: Kyst has given shroudthoughts the appearance of blood soaked six-foot tall rag dolls. Shroudthought or just shrouds have the anti-telepathic power. They will target for death anyone with psionic powers first, you can't command them otherwise. A shroud won't even consider killing you if you don't have any psionic powers. Shrouds have the strength to rip apart man as if he were wet tissue paper. They can run 50 mph. They have standard kystian invulnerability. Shrouds are sneaky and clever.
summary: The ability to summon an anti-telepathic half-alive thing.
strengths: An anti-psionic flesh-ripping monster.
You are safe if you don't have any psionic powers.
weaknesses: A monster that will kill if you say the wrong thing-only if you are psionic.

name: Civilian Zone
description: Creates a zone that promotes commonness. Advantages and disadvantages would be removed and the total power level of everyone inside would be divided equally. While inside the zone a person with no powers would be evenly matched with superman. For things, such as competitions, advantages given by superpowers, or from other means, would be lost or given to everyone within the competition.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes commonness.
strengths: Make it impossible for people to become overpowered.
Make competitions based on skill only.
Increase the power of weaker individuals.
weaknesses: Lose any advantages you would have with superpowers inside the zone.
Unable to become stronger or better than others while within the zone.
Could lose against foes you could normally beat effortlessly.

name: Painsmith
description: You can take bones from a dead body or bodies and fuse them together to create a weapon made of bone. The weapon will have magical power based on the amount of physical pain the being(s) felt when they died. The sharpness of the weapon, if it is a bladed one, is based on the mental pain and anguish felt at death. The weapon will also have an independent mind of its own and in order to use the weapon, one must pass the weapon's test (test differs for each weapon).
summary: The ability to create weapons from the bones of dead beings that have power based on the pain felt at death
strengths: Beings tormented physically and mentally until they died yield up powerful weapons. May be a con.
Enemies may not pass the test needed to use one of the weapons.
As the creator of the weapon, you are the only one who does not need to pass the test to use it.
weaknesses: Beings who died happily in their sleep of old age will not yield up powerful weapons.
Seems like more of an evil power.
Friends may not be able to pass the weapon's test to use it.

name: Half Mummy
description: Someone with this power will have boosted physical strength and speed. They will also have bandages at various parts of their body that they can control and they will have an attractive appearance. They will also have boosted magical power for cursing other people and controlling sand. Also, they will be half-living and half-undead with a healing rate that is 3/4s that of a normal human's healing rate and they can never become dehydrated.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-mummy
strengths: People won't want to make you angry at them.
Best terrain to fight in is a desert. May be a con.
weaknesses: People might be scared of you. May be pro.

name: Condition Change: Life
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it works only when the user is saving another's life. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is saving someone's life
strengths: It will also replace Condition Change: Unneeded, if Unneeded was already on the power being altered.
Now the opponent has to help others.
weaknesses: Condition Change: Unneeded will replace this power, if this power was on the affected power first.

name: Puppet Alive
description: With this power you can bring puppets to life by pointing at them and saying "Rise Puppet! " then the puppet will come to life and be under your complete control. Since puppets generally don't have legs the puppets will be able to levitate and float around. You can use this power on as many puppets as you want but you can't turn them back to normal.
summary: The ability to cause puppets to come to life
strengths: You can have an army of puppet minions
You can have as many as you want
weaknesses: It only works on puppets
You have to say the spell

name: Acid Generation
description: This ability can be manifested through touch or as a spray.
summary: The ability to generate acid.
strengths: You would be able to secrete an acid-like sweat from the pores of your body.
You could metabolize the acid into corrosive projectile beams and shoot them from your hands.
You would be able to form acidic brass knuckles to augment your punching power.
weaknesses: You would still be harmed by your own acidic projections.
It is possible to unintentionally harm someone.
People would want to stay away from you.

name: Sickage Bender
description: You are able to make anyone sick with any cause but you are only able to make 1 person sick every 10 minutes and your able to make them be sick in any way you want
summary: The ability to turn anyone you want sick
strengths: You can give security guards a disease to get through gate a security guard is guarding
weaknesses: The time limit isn't the best so you have to use your power wisely

name: Army Of The Living Dead
description: You will be able to bring back the deceased as zombies under your control.
summary: The ability to control zombies
strengths: Have an army of walking corpses
weaknesses: Your army will rot & decompose
The smell of death

name: Chimpanzee Mimicry
description: With this power you gain all of the skills of a chimpanzee including enhanced agility and climbing skills, the ability to walk a tight rope flawlessly, opposable feet and the ability to hold up to 300 pounds in one hand.
summary: The ability to mimic the skills of a chimpanzee
strengths: You have all of the skills of a chimpanzee
weaknesses: You can't actually turn into a chimpanzee with this power

name: Myth Power: Paregoron's Paragon
description: Paregoron (Paregoros), in Greek myth, was the goddess of consolation, soothing words and coaxing words of encouragement. As such, channeling her allows one to intuitively discern how to speak to others in order to soothe, console and encourage them. In addition, one's touch amplifies the soothing effect. Furthermore, coaxing and encouraging others multiplies the effect of nearly any effort they put forth. One can even gain the same benefits when one receives words of encouragement from others.
summary: The ability to channel Paregoron's command over the essence of consolation, soothing words and coaxing
strengths: Psychically intuit how to speak to others to console/soothe/encourage them (amplified by a touch)
Coaxing and encouraging others amplifies the result of any effort they put forth
Receiving words of encouragement from others amplifies the result of any effort the user puts forth
weaknesses: Soothing words ease pain, and encouraging words speed healing only at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use soothing words to calm rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use encouraging words to induce rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Ars Goetia: Bael's Fury
description: The goetic demon king Bael is described as a chimera of a man, cat, and toad. The user is capable of transforming into this abomination along with immense strength and command over endless demonic hordes at their disposal.
summary: The ability to harness the demonic king's monstrous form.
strengths: Crush and swipe multiple targets.
A demonic king of hell. Can't get any better than this.
Prehensile tongue and cat/toad attributes.
weaknesses: Your monstrous appearance will frighten others and alert them to attack you.

name: Hunger Empowerment
description: With this power, breakfast is overrated. If you are hungry, you can gain super powers, like super strength, super speed, higher and farther jumping capacity, and super resilient skin. It also gives you a maddened psychology, doing anything for food. This power wears off if you eat anything.
summary: The ability to gain powers from being hungry
strengths: No breakfast, you carry a piano while running a marathon jumping 1 metre into the air while doing it
Doesn't matter how hungry you are, you still get the amount of powers.
Easily reversible with food, and you can trick your maddened self into doing stuff for food.
weaknesses: Maddened state, unpredictable.
Cannot stop you from dying of hunger.
You can easily be turned into a hunger slave.

name: Increased Acrobatic Skill
description: Basically you will be the best urban ninja ever. Other freerunners will be jealous and you will give the circus people a big middle finger. It ranges from jumping high or long distances, increased speed to make the jump, and massive upper body strength.
summary: The ability to perform feats that would make any acrobat, freerunner, or traceur jealous
strengths: Good for escaping
Getting up buildings will be a breeze
Falling will be easier, just swing on something
weaknesses: Basically just for escaping
A good way to get to the fight but then just look dumb jumping around your enemy
Not strong or abnormally fast unless the purpose is for basically getting somewhere quicker

name: Transformers: Astrotrain
description: With this power you are able to summon and control a sentient version of Astrotrain's Astroforce, an army of drones that resemble trains. A side effect of this power allows you to turn your skin gray.
summary: The ability to summon and control the Astroforce
strengths: You can summon the Astroforce
You can turn your skin gray
weaknesses: The Astroforce isn't really that smart and are more likely to crash into each other than anything

name: Con Activation
description: With this ability, you can essentially negate Con Negation within 100 meters of you. All powers entering the area must now be restricted by their downsides and any person must suffer the consequences of normal power use. Since this does not negate, power protection powers offer little, if any, protection. It can be easily turned on and off at will.
summary: The ability to reactivate negated cons.
strengths: Stop heavily overpowered power combinations such as Bursts of Invinicibility + Con Negation.
Even affects powers entering the area, such as a Farslayer-based attack.
Easily turned on and off.
weaknesses: Affects you too; you had better have some other ways of dealing with the cons up your sleeve.
Limited range, at least without other powers. Naturally, this is vulnerable to Radius Distortion.
Is only effective against Con Negated powers.

name: Porcelain Secretion
description: You have the ability to secrete a unique variety of porcelain from any area of your body with pores. This porcelain is secreted as a liquid but hardens almost instantly on contact with air. It is heatproof and strong enough to withstand moderate impacts, as well as incredibly light-weight.
summary: The ability to secrete fast-harden porcelain from every pore of your body
strengths: Cutting weapons will just encounter and shatter a barrier of porcelain instead of cutting you.
Fire powers will have little to no effect on you.
Doesn't slow you down much.
weaknesses: If you secrete it from jointed areas of your body, your movement will be impeded.
It's not completely indestructible, and once it shatters you have to secrete more.
Squeezing porcelain out of your pores is fairly painful.

name: Bond
description: A bond connects two people. When the two bonded people are together, they gain incredible powers. Random for every one of them.
summary: The ability to bond with somebody.
strengths: Great tag team.
Great power.
weaknesses: If one of the bonded die, the others die too.

name: Musical Brawl
description: Depending on the song itself the power can temporarily increase or decrease the fighters strength, speed, and reactions. The ability is very useful for fighters trained in hand-to-hand combat.
summary: The ability to fight within a rythem of a song the user is listening to.
strengths: Movements can be unpredictable
Possible chance of increased atributes within the duration of the song
Can enjoy music in a fight
weaknesses: Enemies can predict movements if they know of the song.
Power can not be active without music
Some music can effect the user in a negative way

name: Cyborg Summon
description: With this power you can summon an army of cyborgs. There are hundreds of different kinds of cyborgs, each of them being half of a different machine. Such as half car half human cyborgs, half television half human cyborgs etc. You can summon up to ten of each kind of cyborg and they are all under your control. Each cyborg as has super strength, invulnerability and heat vision. When you're done with them you can send them back to wherever they came from.
summary: The ability to summon an army of cyborgs
strengths: You can summon an army of cyborgs
You can have up to ten of each kind of cyborg
weaknesses: The cyborgs might be reprogrammed
The cyborgs might be destroyed

name: Transformers: Bumblebee
description: With this power whenever you punch someone it will feel like they are being stung by something. You can turn this power on and off. A side effect of this power is that children often think that you are cool.
summary: The ability to cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
strengths: You can cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
weaknesses: The sting isn't enough to defeat an enemy

name: Shakespearean Wordsmith
description: This infinitely useful power can make you seem clever and well-learned by quoting the works of Shakespeare (where such a quote relates to the unfolding situation). With each quote, whether by you or any other conversational participant, you (and any powers you may have) become stronger. Perfect for those moments when, as you lay dying, your Arch-Nemesis unwittingly quotes the second act of 'The Taming of the Shrew'. Boom.
summary: The ability to recall any quote from the complete works of Shakespeare and to derive power from them.
strengths: Shakespearean idioms have become so integrated in culture that holding a conversation requires them.
Makes one appear better educated and seem more well-read.
Invariably increases the epicness of any moment by up to 500%. Guaranteed.
weaknesses: Irrelevant quotes do not provide the same power boost as those pertaining to the situation.
Intellectually-challenged Arch-Enemies may not appreciate or understand your superior wit.
Those people who thought you were a bit weird before are going to be completely convinced of it now.

name: Chaneled Form: Sword
description: Normally a touch-type power(Ex: Death Touch) does not extend beyond the what you touch. However with this power, you can channel that power into the form of a sword. The sword is the length of a standard European shortsword and when it hits the target it does not cut, but instead goes through the target and the power's effect activates.
summary: The ability to channel a touch-type power into the form of a sword
strengths: Don't have to touch the target anymore.
weaknesses: Only 'tactile' or 'touch-type' powers.
Still a pretty small range.

name: Baka
description: Baka translates as stupid or foolish. This power works in a 100 metre radius and stupid or foolish is randomly chosen by the power itself. The effect lasts for 1 hour.
summary: The ability to make anyone absolutely stupid or foolish for an hour
strengths: You get to choose the target.
This power is great for a prank during a test.
weaknesses: The power chooses stupidity or foolishness.

name: Price Negotiator
description: With this power, you can negotiate the price of anything. While you might not get 50% off, you will always be successful at lowering the price to some degree. This works even at the grocery line, where the art of bartering has been lost completely. Sometimes you even get lucky and end up with 99% off!
summary: The ability to barter and haggle with anyone with guaranteed success
strengths: Get great deals on things you purchase
Black Friday deals are even cheaper
Save hundreds or potentially thousands of dollars
weaknesses: At the store, you might be "that guy"
No guarantees that your discount will be significant

name: Celtic Invocation: Nemetona
description: By invoking the power of Nemetona, the invoker may detect and locate places of power and sacredness, such as ley lines, sacred groves and springs, menhirs, etc. The invoker may also be able to create a sacred space, such as a circle of standing stones. Any invocations done within a sacred place created by the invoker can be strengthened or weakened, and the invoker may also strengthen or weaken the strength of natural sacred places. They can also allow or bar entry into such places.
summary: The ability to utilise the power of Nemetona, the Celtic goddess of sacred places.
strengths: Nothing can best you in a sacred space.
A hastily drawn circle can end up being a stronghold in your hands.
Find some important historic places without any effort.
weaknesses: Not much use offensively, or if not near a sacred space.
The creation of the sacred spaces are only available to the more powerful invokers.
Other users of Celtic Invocation: Nemetona, or those with the ability to pass through/destroy wards.

name: Superpower Dispersal

If stolen this power permanently affects the power it is attached to, and  this power is given to the ability thief. Can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power physically sharper by attaching this power
strengths: Sharper powers. Sharp Hair Blades!
A katana can cut through a lot.
Still have power if stolen, kind of.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Useful only for powers with edges.
One power at a time.

name: Forced Crocodiling
description: This power requires you to concentrate on someone to use this power on them. Someone affected by this power will only be able to speak in their native language. If they have more than one native language, they will use a random one among the ones they know. Don't underestimate this power's might! It is common to have someone use another language when they want to tell something secret to someone when other people are watching.
summary: The ability to force someone to use their native language when they speak.
strengths: Expose secrets when people are using an other language than their native one to tell secrets.
Make someone's in-laws believe they're talking behind their back when they use their mother tongue.
Offend Esperantists by having one of their own "crocodile" during an esperantist convention.
weaknesses: Not much use if the targeted person only knows their native language.
Not much use if the targeted person uses their native language everytime.
Not much use if the targeted person doesn't want to speak.

name: Condition Change: Body
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on the user's physical body. The arms, legs, tail, wings, and head(s) are not defined by this power as part of the body. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different body part. This power is tactile.

strengths: Now all you have to do is avoid getting hit with anything from the body.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Namazu
description: Namazu in myth was a giant catfish who could summon earthquakes. You now possess Namazu's arm guard, one made of metal and scales, with a catfish emblem on it. While wearing these you command the earth, and can even summon earthquakes.

strengths: Command earth
Summon earthquakes

Will devour your soul if overused

name: Monotissue Morph
description: You remain bipedal but can become all heart muscle, skin, eyeballs,etc. You can still see and hear. You're all eyes(360 degree sight),all lung and you can't be strangled. Solid heart muscle and you have extra toughness. Of course each form has a weakness. Blinded easier,you can't hold your breathe against gases and a giant heart is going to be easier to hear.

strengths: Each tissue-morph or organ-morph will have a unique advantage.
weaknesses: Each form has a unique weakness.

name: Attach!
description: In order to use this power you must point out to the two objects you want to attach and say ATTACH! After doing this, the objects will fly one to each other. If one of the objects cannot move, only the other will.  While flying, the objects cannot be stopped, once they are united they cannot be separated unless you say so or with extreme strength.

strengths: You can attach people or living beings.
You can move anything regardless of size or weight.
You can also attach yourself to anything.

Attached objects are not unseparable.
Need to point and south in order to use the power.

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Alphonse

strengths: Take over an object.
weaknesses: One body at a time.
Like Alphonse you could lose your body.
Only with mastery you can create bodies.

name: Intelligent Super Panda Summon
description: With this power you can summon a super smart panda who wants to become a superhero. In addition to being super smart the panda has super strength, really sharp claws and teeth, can eat though almost anything and enhanced agility. The panda is not under your control but if you're a good guy he will help you because he wants to be a superhero. However if somebody calls the panda a bear or a panda bear the panda will go berserk and try to kill them. Also if the panda dies you lose this power.

He has some other cool skills
He'll help you if you're a good guy

You cannot unsummon him

name: Four Eyes: Aura Changer
description: This power is gained by using the aura seeing part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever you have all of your eyes immersed in an aura, you absorb a tiny bit. This allows you to transform into that person at will. You can mix and match parts, but you cannot use superhuman powers or memories that they have.

You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and use the aura seeing most of the time.
