You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: Summon Slitskin
description: A slitskin looks like a 30-foot-long earthworm made from twisted flesh. Slitskins instinctively hate anything not half-alive. A slitskin lacks any intelligence. You can only unsummon it. Slitskins are strong enough to break through 20-foot thick concrete walls. Nothing will hurt them. A slitskin's skin is constantly splitting open and sealing itself. The only way to kill one is to stop the healing (it falls apart). Stopping the splitting will unsummon it.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive wormlike thing.
strengths: A good power for a desperate situation.
The threat of using this power may be enough to win.
weaknesses: You're in a situation bad enough to have to use this power.

name: Cement
description: With this power you can project balls of cement that explode upon impact at your enemies feet. This will glue them to the ground or any other surfaces
summary: The ability to glue people to the ground with cement
strengths: Glue your enemies to any surface
weaknesses: The cement is not invincible and can be broken

name: Summon Femt Cloud
description: Femts. Look like teenage sisters of nans. Femts are a million times smaller nans and a cloud numbers in the octillions. Femts can take matter apart but can also make AB matter. AB matter has properties a million times stronger than normal matter. Heat conductivity is actually more than a million. AB matter is unaffected by temperatures high as 10 billion degrees. Tensile strength and material hardness would be a million times stronger. A femt cloud moves at 5 mph.

strengths: A exotic matter battle suit could be build for you.
This power is the closest thing to actual femtotechnology.
weaknesses: Femts have the same weakness as nans and pyks.

name: Unillamas
description: With this power you can summon up to 30 Unillamas. Unillamas are basically giant llamas that have one horn on their heads. They have enhanced speed and strength and the horn can pierce almost any material. The Unillams also have super spit that can blind people if it hits them in the eye. The Unillamas are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon giant one horned llamas
strengths: You can summon up to 30 Unillamas that are under your complete control
They are super strong and fast and their horn can pierce through almost anything
Their super spit can blind people
weaknesses: They can be killed
They eat a lot

name: Oxygen Store : Iron Smash
description: Special breathing puts oxygen into sacs in the cells of your body, to store for later. This is important, because the next part of the power will stop them from getting some of the oxygen they need. The haemoglobin in your blood gives up its iron, and sends it to whatever body part you want. The part of the body turns grey and heavy. You may have an iron fist, able to smash most objects or bad guys. And every special breath you do, you gain 1 hour of no-breathing.

strengths: Every time you breathe in to fill the sacs, you gain an extra hour of holding your breath.
Iron fist, iron foot, iron chest, iron head, etc.
Reversible, so your body return to normal after the oxygen reserves have been used up.

Have to be careful not blind your allies

The users eyes turn dark violet and strange symbols appear all over his or her body. Stage 2. The user grows taller, gets fangs and the whole body turns rock solid and black purple. Stage 3. The user gets more rugged and buffed, becomes insane and looks more monstrous. Stage 4. Unknown

name: 2nd Key Of Death
description: The first key controls half of mankind, while this controls the other half. The keys have different ways of killing though; with this, their skin, muscle, and bone disintegrate rapidly, even their soul begins to disappear. Then, that body and the soul are re-created in the underworld.

Might have the wrong key for the killing someone.

name: Power Transfering
description: Ever get stuck in a situation where some superpowers you have have more power, but the superpower you need to use is too weak. With this superpower, you can transfer some or most of the energy from other powers you own to other powers. For example, let's say your hydrokinesis and technopathy is strong, but your superspeed is too weak for you to save someone far away in time. You could remove some of the energy from technopathy and hydrokinesis to make your superspeed more powerful.

name: Statue Pose
description: This power is useful for evasion. Strike a pose and at your will instantly turn your body into a stone statue. The level of detail in this form is reduced, like the removal eyelashes and smoother skin and hair, to look more convincing and unrecognisable. The catch is you cannot move or use other powers and the longer you remain as a statue the harder it is to reverse. Remain in this form for a few hours and it becomes permanent leaving you alive as an unmovable statue until you are destroyed.

There are two ways that you can make a team win, either say the sport, the opposing team and the team you want to win and then snap ("Basketball, Jazz, Knicks") or if you're watching the game either live or on TV you can just say the name of the team you want to win and then snap.

description: Ever wondered how ironic it is that "common sense" is rare? With this power, you can detect the amount of common sense a person has, who has it, what conclusions it has brought them to, who needs it and how it is currently being used. The maximum range is 100 kilometers for most functions, but you will need physical contact to see past uses of common sense.

Bacchus's will have a party room, Minerva's will have a library,etc.  Each will have at least 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a kitchen, a bookshelf with exclusive knowledge of Roman gods, heroes, adventures and everything in between.

weaknesses: Pretty much useless in other situations

Toddler/Senior Citizen, your choice. The change is instant and the results are always satisfactory.

name: Author's Power Charge
description: If you have created a lot of good powers which just don't seem strong enough at times, this is the power for you. With it, each owner, including those using mimicry, will boost your powers to the next exponent. If you lose this power, you lose the boosts. If someone is immune to this power, your powers will only affect them to the same extent as they would at their normal power level. Con Negation and similar powers do not work with this.

If the powers you made need a boost, this is a useful power for you.
Works even if someone is mimics a power you made.

If someone stops mimicing the power, you lose that exponent.
If this power is negated, stolen, etc, you lose the boosts.

name: Gastric Chief Cell Mimicry
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot enzymes and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Enzymes are catalysts, i.e. each one greatly enhances a specific chemical reaction. Yours can increase the action of acids over proteins and lipids. So, the mix of acid and your enzymes greatly increases the acid's property to break down most organic compounds. Unfortunately, your enzymes alone can't do anything on their own. And you are not immune to the effects of acid.

Dissolve and digest any kind of organic thing.

I've Spit the Table of Elements Yes I mean every single Component,

name: For Someone's Honor

However, servitude empowers you with strength, speed, regeneration, and an immunity to mind attacks and mental detection while you fulfill your master's command. Your oath of loyalty can only be given if you truly want to, so choose carefully. name: Tar Shooter

weaknesses: None actually.

name: Kystain Septuplets
description: This power requires the Kystian Sextuplets power to work. You can summon a pack (that still needs to be killed as a group) of 42 flickerspawn, or if you want 7 norr to be your bodyguards, summon them instead. Or summon 140 swiftslice. Or summon 7 times the normal number of every kystian monster that can be summoned.
summary: The ability to multiple by 7 the normal number of kystians you summon.
strengths: You've got 210 monsters to use and command.
Kyst is always coming up with new creatures to summon.
weaknesses: You'll need a bigger evil hideout.

name: Xiii Ranks
description: With this power you can place a rank on an object in the form of a roman numeral with I being the lowest and XIII being the highest. The initial rank that is placed can be anything but it can not directly be controlled until it is removed and replaced. A relative increase in power causes an increase in rank and vice versa. A higher rank has a greater effect on a lower rank and takes less effect from actions of a lower rank.
summary: The ability to place ranks on objects that changes how effective the objects are.
strengths: Can easily defeate stronger opponents by moving up in ranks.
Control the initial rank of objects and people to have an advantage.
Force opponents into playing a game to fight you.
weaknesses: Has no effect unless both objects have a rank.
If opponent gains a higher rank then you can easily be defeated regarless of actual strength.
If you are higher rank than your allies than you will recieve less aid from their actions.

name: Prehensile Tongue
description: You'll have a tongue like a chameleon or frog. Your tongue will be very long & very strong. It will also be very sticky & slimy so you can ensnare objects.
summary: The ability to have a super long & super strong tongue
strengths: Have a super long & strong tongue
Ensnare objects or people with your tongue
weaknesses: Might get tongue tied

name: Stuffed Toy Control
description: You will have the power to make those cute teddy bears and stuffed rhinos and elephants become vicious and do things for you. You can make a stuff toy army and have stuff toy slaves. You can fuse them into a huge stuff toy. But you can't enhance them with powers such as make them blow fire, shoot bullet out of their butts. You can only enhance them physically, such as strong punches and kicks. But, like any stuff toy, they'll still have the same weaknesses such as fire and scissors.
summary: The ability to control every kind of stuffed toy.
strengths: You'll have a huge army of cute stuff toys.
You can have them as slaves.
You can make your baby sister cry by taking her stuff toys against her.
weaknesses: They still have the same weaknesses.
They can't have super powers, only added strength.
You might soon find yourself cleaning a lot of stuffers and ripped or burned fabrics.

name: Pain Management
description: Can you imagine a life without pain? ,all of it just turning into anger? Works pretty well with berserker strength etc.
summary: The ability to turn pain into anger.
strengths: No more pain.
Good combo with anger-fueled powers.
weaknesses: You just get madder and madder!
Turns you insane.

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential5
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Omodamos (Omodamus- Crudebake) allows one to turn subjects into clay statues by touch; however, their form will remain loose and limp, like soft, unfired clay. In addition, one can assume a gooey clay form at will, which is malleable (pliable) and highly resistant to damage. Furthermore, one can withstand and negate petrifaction.
summary: The ability to channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
strengths: Turn foes into clay statues by touch; after they turn, this form remains loose and unable to harden
Assume a form of clay at will (highly resistant to damage and capable of shapeshifting)
Totally withstand and negate the effects of petrifaction
weaknesses: User's clay form can be hardened by intense heat and rendered immobile
Cannot restore (or manipulate) a subject's malleable clay form until the higher levels (NCN)
People with earth-based MythPowers are immune to the direct effects of this ability

name: Straws Of Fate
description: It's very simple, you have a never ending amount of unique, non-identical straws. Whenever you say draw a straw, the other is forced to draw this straw. He who has the shortest straw will simply seize to exist. If the owner of this power loses, the power is transferred to the winner.
summary: The ability to make he who draws the shortest straw seize to exist.
strengths: With a bit of luck you'll defeat everyone.
It's just like the lottery only with a way bigger chance of winning.
There's always going to be a loser, there is no way the straws will have the same length.
weaknesses: You could be the loser.
When you cheat, the universe will make your existance end instead of the other one.
If you don't own this power and you don't want it but you won the straw duel, you get it anyhow.

name: Television Nails
description: With this power, you can watch any episode of any TV show or any movie on your finger nails and toe nails. You can watch five different shows/movies on one hand/foot or you can watch the same show/movie on all your nails on one hand/foot. Can have all the nails act as one screen; it's not like you're watching the same thing on five different screens, you're watching one thing on a screen that been broken into five pieces. When you're done you can turn the screens off with your mind.
summary: The ability to watch TV on your finger and toe nails
strengths: You can watch tv/movies on your nails
You can be watching twenty different movies or shows at the same time
You can watch the same thing on all five of your fingers to make it a bigger screen
weaknesses: The screen is small unless you have really long finger/toe nails
Not much use in physical combat

name: Song Of Death
description: When the Song of Death is sung, the opponent skin, nerves, muscles peels off layer by layer, right to the bones. The process is slow and painful. When the skin is peeling off burning may happen to the opponent, their nerves burn, the pain feels like acid is being poured on your head.
summary: The ability to sing a song which peels someones skin.
strengths: This ability is powerful and it charges very fast.
weaknesses: This power takes a great strain on the users life only if the ability is succesful.
If the song has not peeled off all the skin, the user may get a few burns.
This song affects everyone in 300m radius.

name: Human Snowball Effect
description: With this ability, you can attach any object to any part of your body. Once attached, the object stays stuck. As more objects are added, control over the power wanes. In the end, you become a giant golem of junk that is constantly growing due to the amount of junk being attached. The only way to start over is to temporarily suppress your ability through some means.
summary: The ability to have any object instantly attach to any part of your body.
strengths: Become a human arsenal (e.g. attach guns and knives to your appendages).
Never lose anything.
weaknesses: Become a giant junk golem after a while.
Need some means to suppress your ability to restart.

name: Myth Power: Lyssa's Lunacy
description: Lyssa, in Greek Myth, was the goddess of mad rage. As such, channeling her allows one to amplify feelings of anger to a fever pitch, to the point subjects cannot control their impulses, and become very violent and destructive. In addition, this effect affects animals as though they have (non-lethal) rabies; tame animals become feral, and naturally-feral animals will be more likely to attack. Furthermore, one can harness a Berserker Rage for oneself, enhancing physical attributes in the process.
summary: The ability to channel Lyssa's command over the essence of fury, frenzy and mad rage
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and absorb anger/rage at will
Cause animals to go wild; tame animals become feral, and natural feral animals more likely to attack
Enter a Berserker Rage at will (gain physical power, withstand mental penetration)
weaknesses: Cannot reduce/alleviate/negate rage (or cure rabies) by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot COMPEL or COMMAND raging subjects until the higher levels (No Con Negation)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Inside Jokes
description: Think about it: a situation can be awkward when someone pulls out an inside joke and nobody else gets it. EXCEPT YOU! If you have this power, all inside jokes are laid open to your understanding.
summary: The ability to understand all inside jokes
strengths: Don't have to sit there and wait while the other person has to explain the joke to you
weaknesses: Maybe that's a joke you really didn't want to understand.

name: Explosive Fingernails
description: With this ability you can shoot explosive fingernails from any hand,though when shooting from your right hand,the fingernails tend to be weaker than the ones on your left hand.
summary: The ability to shoot explosive fingernails from the tip of your hand.
strengths: Always have a weapon that you can keep with you at airports.
They look normal until you shoot them
weaknesses: They might explode before you shoot them.
They tend to be redder than the average fingernail

name: Shark Skin
description: With this ability, your skin takes on the properties of shark's skin. It will be tough and leathery, giving you increased durability. It will also have the feel of sand paper, being covered by dermal denticles. These denticles assist in protecting you from damage and parasites. They also assist in your fluid dynamics, reducing water turbulence, thereby increasing your swimming abilities. The denticles can scrape someone else's skin. This transformation may be temporary or permanent.
summary: The ability to transform your skin to that of shark's skin
strengths: Increased swimming ablity
Added protection
weaknesses: May interfere with intimacy with others, esp. If a permanent transformation

name: Sexuality Manipulation
description: Haven't you ever seen a guy who is hot, but is gay/straight. Or a girl for that matter? With this power you would be able to turn a straight person gay, and vise versa.
summary: The ability to manipulate people's sexuality
strengths: There would always be a guy/girl for you
weaknesses: You are forcing them to change sexuality

name: Hell's Candy Maker
description: Demonic hard sweets,fudge,toffee,licorice,chocolate and any other candies. Any demonic candies you create will walk,talk and bite. Licorice demons might be able to strangle. Demonic jaw breakers could be miniature juggernauts. Marshmallow and nougat demons will be sticky. This power can be combined with the hell's baker power. Soft candy demons are exorcised like baked good demons but a gobstopper demon will be tougher to exorcise than that.
summary: The ability to create candy demons.
strengths: Create jaw breaker juggernauts.
Create a horde of marshmallow demons to stick to a foe.
This power combines with the hell's baker power.
weaknesses: Some candy demons are tougher than baked good demons.
You're better than someone with just the hell's baker power.

name: Musical Bones
description: With this skill you can make sound just by moving your bones. These sounds are amplified by the flesh, blood and skin, resulting in powerful sound blasts.   The more bones you move at the same time, the higher the power, so when you are dancing you become a unstoppable machine of destruction.
summary: The ability to make sounds and music with your bones.
strengths: You can hit your foes with tremendous power.
No need to shout to activate the power.
You will never get bored.
weaknesses: Others may find your power ridiculous.
Useless in the vacuum of space.
Need to move to release the power.

name: Spirits Into Demon(S)
description: The more spirits you put into one demon, the stronger it is. However, the strength increase is such that a demon formed from 100 spirits can beat 2 demons, one with 99 spirits the other with 1 spirit, with power to spare. That will not change, even though the purer the spirits sacrificed, the weaker the demon will be; the more corrupted the spirits, the stronger the demon. The demons will have traditional demonic powers but as the power levels rise, the traditional weaknesses go down in number.
summary: The ability to turn bodiless spirits into demons
strengths: A demon formed from 100.000 spirits might be pretty much unstoppable.
A demon formed from several spirits that are pure evil could be hard to stop.
Some of the demons will have powers that are not traditional demonic powers. Rare and may be a con.
weaknesses: Just because you created the demon, doesn't mean it will listen to you.
People might be scared of this power.

name: Talent Of Woodcraft
description: This power gives you natural skill in woodcraft. You can carve wood easily into weapons, traps, or other things. If you are lost in the woods, then you can easily make five wooden spears in two minutes or a bow in one. You have a natural sense of what wood is strong and how to get it. You never get splinters and your hands won't turn coarse from working. You can even make a shelter from wood with youre bare hands and can smooth it by gently rubbing it.
summary: The ability to posses immense skill in woodworking.
strengths: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Works great with a lost in the woods scenario.
weaknesses: Power sacrifice works on this.

name: Epic Pose
description: The superhuman ability to strike poses so amazing, people will swear you just came out of the pages of a Japanese graphic novel. When the power is activated, ridiculously awesome music will begin to play wherever you are standing, and every one will mistake you for the guy who's supposed to save the world!
summary: The ability to strike an epic pose.
strengths: You can easily become the center of attention.
You can easily take authority over any situation
The ladies will love ya!
weaknesses: People will start expecting you to save the world.
The effect only lasts as long as you maintain the pose.
You might have to use the bathroom eventually.

name: Goldworks: Sword Of Essence
description: Its origin unknown, this ancient golden weapon has a long and powerful history. Its powers are vast and mostly unknown, but it's best understood and most powerful ability is to drink and control essences. Whenever this sword stabs a living thing, it absorbs its essence. This causes the wielder to become stronger. The wielder can also channel the absorbed essence in different ways. The essence appears as a energy-like smoke or dust.
summary: The ability to wield the Sword Of Essence
strengths: Manipulating essences and learning more of the sword's powers
Becoming stronger
Can use essences in many ways
weaknesses: Must kill living things to gain power.
The sword can be stolen

name: Lucky 100th
description: Extremely useful if you've been shot at all your life. This power will repel the hundredth bullet that's ever been shot at you during the course of your whole life. It will just bounce off your body, living or dead.
summary: The ability to be immune to the 100th bullet that's shot at you.
strengths: You will have a tiny chance to survive a gunshot.
The person who will shoot the 100th bullet at you will be sure to miss.
weaknesses: You need to survive the 99 first bullets for this power to be useful.
Your body will only repel the 100th bullet.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: King Of Lollipopland
description: The power to create any sort of candy.
summary: The ability to create the best candy ever.
strengths: Make a lot of money from selling your sweets.
It will always be better than the competition.
weaknesses: Well, everyone won't like the candy.

name: Magical Bunny Blaster
description: With this power you can shoot magical bunnies from your hands. What makes them so magical, why bunnies? All very good questions which deserve some good answers. They're magical because they turn into giant monsters as soon as they hit something. And bunnies because once people see bunnies coming from your hands, they'll let their guards down, making it that much easier for the monsters to eat them.
summary: The ability to shoot magical bunnies from your hands
strengths: The monsters are under your control
weaknesses: Monsters and bunnies can be slayed

name: Turtle Mimicry
description: With this power you can mimic the skills of a turtle. You have an impenetrable shell and green skin but an unfortunate side effect is that you move slower than you normally do.
summary: The ability to mimic the skills of a turtle
strengths: You have an impenetrable shell
You have green skin
weaknesses: You move slowly

name: Oil Secretion
description: You can ooze crude oil from any sweat pore at will, only at far greater speeds and quantities if wished. This oil functions exactly the same as crude oil, and is produced naturally in your body. Your oil reserves must be emptied regularly to prevent secreting excess crude oil when you're unconscious.
summary: The ability to secrete oil from your skin
strengths: Could be used as fuel, particularly when refined
Can discharge enough to cause a pursuing car to slide on the road
Could throw oil in enemies' eyes
weaknesses: Have to discharge oil regularly to prevent build-up
Would have to wash oil off your skin after use

name: Crodo: Heroic Armor
description: Heroic armor's are used in adventures. They are made of gold,crystal,diamonds,and pure metal.
summary: The ability to summon and wear a heroic armor.
strengths: Able to withstand the strongest attack.
weaknesses: Only protects the body,not the head.
Only protects you physically.

name: Green Lantern Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Green Lantern of the Green Lantern Corps to help you fight crime.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Green Lanterns from the comic books, TV shows or movies
strengths: You can meet all sorts of cool Green Lanterns
weaknesses: Does not work with any other kind of Lantern, just green
Does not work if the Lantern is dead or they are no longer a Lantern
Does not work on the guardians aside from Ganthet

name: Elephant Shift
description: Transforming into an elephant hybrid, as big as one, but a thousand times as stronger and is as fast as lightning
summary: The ability to turn into an elephant hybrid
strengths: Never forget information
Super strength
Nose can be used as a whip
weaknesses: Can't fit in areas too big for you
Have an irrational fear of anything grave related including ghosts.
Have to be in elephant in order to remember information.

name: Summoning: Strategist's Scroll
description: The Strategist's Scroll is a unique weapon that is the collective fighting knowledge of every strategist. It contains ideas, formations, and different ways to defeat your enemies.
summary: The ability to summon the Strategist's Scroll.
strengths: Use great strategies.
weaknesses: Not great in a one-on-one fight.

name: Werewolf Tracker
description: With this power, you can know if there is a werewolf near you and you know which person near you is a werewolf.
summary: The ability to know if someone's a werewolve when they're near you
strengths: If you're a werewolf hunter, you know who to slay
weaknesses: You can't turn this power off

name: Delete This Double Whammy
description: You can rush through, then straight punch the enemy to the stomach, and finally you would leap and deliver an uppercut using both fists which would launch your foe into the air knocking them out.
summary: The ability to forward dash punch your opponent to the stomach, then end it with an uppercut using both fists.
strengths: Your enemies will sure have a headache and a stomach ache.
weaknesses: None actually.

name: Land Shark Summon
description: With this power you can summon up to twenty land sharks. They are pretty much just sharks with legs and feet where their tail should be and arms and hands were their fins should be. They have super strength and invulnerability along with super sharp teeth and the ability to breathe under water. The land sharks are under your complete control and you can send them back into the sea when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon land sharks
strengths: You can summon up to twenty land sharks
They are under your complete control
You can send them back when you're done with them
weaknesses: They might eat innocent people

name: Nail Length Changer
description: With this power you can change the length of your toe and finger nails. You can make them as long or as short as you want. You can use them to claw at your enemies or to break world records.
summary: The ability to change the length of your nails
strengths: You can make your finger and toe nails as long or as short as you want
You can break world records
You can scratch your enemies
weaknesses: You might scratch yourself

name: Summon Draja
description: A draja looks like a 5-foot-tall walking mix of at least ten different things. No two are alike. A draja is only strong enough to lift 250 pounds. Their reflexes are as fast as a human's. IQ is low genius. There are humans faster than a draja. A draja's ability is to mimic any special ability of a fellow kystian, any fellow kystian that exist in Kyst.  Only one power at a time can be used but that power can be switched at will. Draja can be merged with other kystians but can't absorb a madspawn.
summary: The ability to summon the most versatile kystian.
strengths: A draja can have the special abilities of any other kystian that exist.
A draja has the IQ to plan what abilities to use if you don't have the IQ to.
There is a power to make a draja faster and stronger.
weaknesses: You don't have the power to make draja faster and stronger.

name: 50/50 Superpower Granting
description: With this power the person has a 50 percent chance of granting a person superpowers or upgrading a person's superpower and a 50 percent chance of killing them. They can use it anywhere, as long as they know the person's name an have an image of the person they can activate this power.
summary: The ability to either give a person superpowers or kill them
strengths: You can use this power and bet on your luck
As long as you have a visual image and know the person's name you can use it
You can use it multiple times on the same person
weaknesses: You have 50 percent chance to kill someone who you wanted to give superpowers to
You have 50 percent chance to give superpowers to someone who you wanted to kill
Numerous powerups on the same person that wants to kill you

name: Condition Change: Jungles
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a jungle. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is in a jungle
strengths: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near jungles.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Key Finder
description: Sick and tired of getting frustrated because you can't find those god damn keys.  DO NOT FEAR! The Key Finder ability is here. With this power, you'll never again lose track of your keys.  Only works on finding your keys and no-one else's. This ability tracks down your keys, if they have been either lost or stolen.
summary: The ability to never lose track of those car keys.
strengths: Find those keys.
Never again be frustrated, by misplacing your keys.
Also works on keys, if they have been stolen, and not misplaced.
weaknesses: Only works for your keys.
Lame ability. (But at least I won't get frustrated anymore. )

name: Cookiekinesis
description: Make cookie dough of any flavor appear and come to life!
summary: The ability to manipulate cookie dough
strengths: Cookie dough of any flavor
Sweet and powerful ally
Instant snack at any time!
weaknesses: Nothing! Cookies!

name: Reaper Claw: 2nd Stage
description: Unlike reaper claw: 1st stage which deals damage to the soul. 2nd stage can damage and/or control the three base forms of a person. These are as follows: body, soul and aura. The body consists of the physical form and the mind. When activated, the 2nd stage allows you to control or damage everything pertaining to that person's body. For info on the soul, see 1st stage. The aura is a person's source of power, and the 2nd stage allows you to control it/steal it or dispel it leaving them powerless.
summary: The ability to split a person into the three base forms
strengths: There are no good qualities to this power
It is a somewhat dark technique
And should only be used as a last resort
weaknesses: 2nd stage has an even higher chance of injury if used improperly than 1st stage
To master this power, you must first completely master the reaper claw: 1st stage
As always there is a chance of angering azrael the angel of death

name: Musicality
description: Someone with this power has the compulsive need to express their feelings with song and dance. They're fantastic singers and dancers. They've mastered every musical instrument. When they burst into song, music appears around them created by their Musicality and they've got the ability to easily and always successfully improvise a full song relating to that moment in time. The person's songs also reflect their taste in music and people around them can't help but be the backup singers/dancers.
summary: The ability to burst into song and dance in moments of strong emotion.
strengths: Life would be more exciting.
People trust you.
Everyone can join in
weaknesses: You wouldn't be able to lie. You need to express you're true feelings.
Nightmare if you've a hangover.
Can't exactly save the day with it.

name: Sand Castle
description: You can make a giant sand castle out of surrounding sand. It can be destroyed but you can always build it back up again.
summary: The ability to make a castle out of sand.
strengths: Never be homeless
Win every sand castle contest
weaknesses: Can be turned into mud by a lot of water

name: Adhesive Secretion
description: Cryanoacrylate, a.k.a. Crazy Glue, has nothing on an Adhesive Secreter's natural glue. It is at least 10 times stronger, and highly resistant to water and abrasive materials. It can also be produced in large quantities (floods of glue from the lower arms)or in minimal amounts (a single dot). However, it is very weak against strong acids, and the Secreter is completely immune to its effects.
summary: The ability to produce a powerful glue from your skin
strengths: Be an amazing construction worker
Restrain the very strong
Can be used as a very effective defense or offense
weaknesses: Strong acids are extremely effective against it
Can run out of glue
Strength of glue dependent on your physical health

name: Hyponesioer
description: Hyponesioer is the ability to turn water into jelly. To do this, you must have a hand position (e.g. hand in a fist or stretched out). You have to focus on the water and all the particles in the water will stick together to turn into jelly. Trick: If you put your favorite squash in a bowl and use your power, you can have free jelly!
summary: The ability to turn water into jelly
strengths: Get to turn any water into jelly.
Trick your friends
Teach friends how to do it.
weaknesses: If you use your power on a friend, they could suffocate
If you use it on the weather, it could rain jelly.
That's it :)

name: Enhancement: Armor Piercing
description: This is a support and useless on its own. When it is attached to another power it makes the power pierce through armor. For this power, armor is defined as anything directly physically touching the skin. This does NOT work on shields. This means that force fields have to be touching the enemy's skin or this doesn't work. If someone tries to steal this power, it permanently makes the attached power armor piercing and gives this power to the thief. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power pierce through armor by attaching this power to it
strengths: Enemies' physical armor is useless.
You still have this power if stolen (kind of).
Could possibly make this power pierce through more things by using it.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
The 'armor' must be touching the skin.
Might not want a power to be armor-piercing or might be useless as armor-piercing.

name: Condition Change: Snap
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to requiring the user to snap their fingers to use the power. One use per snap and uses cannot be stockpiled. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only after the user has snapped their fingers
strengths: An opponent with no fingers. Gruesome but still works.
Tying your opponent's fingers together.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and affects only one power per touch.

name: G1 Perceptor's Transformation
description: In the original Transformers Generation 1 cartoon, the Autobot scientist Perceptor displayed a number of abilities in his alt mode (giant microscope): a telescope & microscope function, a laser shooting function and using the treads on the bottom of the microscope(vehicle function).
summary: The ability to turn into a microscope/telescope/laser cannon/vehicle
strengths: You have all of the abilities of Perceptor's alt mode
If you use the laser shooting function and the vehicle function at the same time you're like a tank
weaknesses: You don't have Perceptor's super brain

name: Transformation: Apache
description: The user is able to transform into a ancient Native American warrior named Apache, using a mystical axe that once belonged to the first Apache. Once the user transforms into Apache, he or she gains all the experience from previous Apaches
summary: The ability to transform into the warrior of the land, named Apache
strengths: Great fighting experience
Axe is made of a mystical metal
Has the knowledge of the shamans
weaknesses: Might get ridiculed

name: Covered Eye
description: Anytime someone with this power covers one or more of their eyes, the eyes that are uncovered have their abilities/powers boosted by 50% for each eye that is covered. You can only cover the eye with something that is not part of your body. Ex: An eyepatch will work but not your hand.
summary: The ability to by covering an eye, boost the abilities of one's other eyes
strengths: The more eyes covered the better this power works.
If your uncovered eye(s) have no powers then your eyesight will be boosted.
weaknesses: This works best if you have more than two eyes.
Need to always have one eye uncovered for this poer to work.

name: Chain Link Hits
description: Each time you hit something you can make the damage of the final hit be exponentially more powerful based on the number of previous hits, but you also have to yell, '(insert number of hits)-Chain-Linked (insert type of hit). This power can only be gained by punching one rock 1000 times full force.
summary: The ability to boost the power of a punch, kick, or other type of attack based on the number of hits beforehand
strengths: The force of the final hit is equal to the original force raised to the power of the number of hits.
weaknesses: How many giant rocks are out there? And no, the Earth does not count as the rock for this power.
Maximum number of hits for the linked hits is 100.
Only the final hit is boosted and hitting something else restarts the count.

name: Acid Sweat
description: With this power you can turn your sweat into acid which can melt through almost anything. The acid cannot burn through your skin and has no adverse affects to you at all but it can burn through other people's skin. This power can be turned on and off so you're not constantly melting things when you sweat.
summary: The ability to turn your sweat into acid
strengths: You can turn your sweat into acid
The acid has no affect on you
You can turn this power off if you want
weaknesses: It only happens when you sweat so if you want to burn something you have to work up a sweat

name: Rise Of The Gorgon
